name: Drona Parva

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
tamapratimasattvaujobalavIryaparAkramam |
hataM devavrataM shrutvA pA~nchAlyena shikhaNDinA
shlokas.2:
dhRRitarAShTrastadA rAjA shokavyAkulachetanaH |
kimacheShTata viprarShe hate pitari vIryavAn
shlokas.3:
tasya putro hi bhagavanbhIShmadroNamukhai rathaiH |
parAjitya maheShvAsAnpANDavAnrAjyamichChati
shlokas.4:
tasminhate tu bhagavanketau sarvadhanuShmatAm |
yadacheShTata kauravyastanme brUhi dvijottama
shlokas.5:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
nihataM pitaraM shrutvA dhRRitarAShTro janAdhipaH |
lebhe na shAntiM kauravyashchintAshokaparAyaNaH
shlokas.6:
tasya chintayato duHkhamanishaM pArthivasya tat |
AjagAma vishuddhAtmA punargAvalgaNistadA
shlokas.7:
shibirAtsa~njayaM prAptaM nishi nAgAhvayaM puram |
Ambikeyo mahArAja dhRRitarAShTro.anvapRRichChata
shlokas.8:
shrutvA bhIShmasya nidhanamaprahRRiShTamanA bhRRisham |
putrANAM jayamAkA~NkShanvilalApAturo yathA
shlokas.9:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sa.nsAdhya tu mahAtmAnaM bhIShmaM bhImaparAkramam |
kimakArShuH paraM tAta kuravaH kAlachoditAH
shlokas.10:
tasminvinihate shUre durAdharShe mahaujasi |
kiM nu svitkuravo.akArShurnimagnAH shokasAgare
shlokas.11:
tadudIrNaM mahatsainyaM trailokyasyApi sa~njaya |
bhayamutpAdayettIvraM pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.12:
devavrate tu nihate kurUNAmRRiShabhe tadA |
yadakArShurnRRipatayastanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.13:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjannekamanA vachanaM bruvato mama |
yatte putrAstadAkArShurhate devavrate mRRidhe
shlokas.14:
nihate tu tadA bhIShme rAjansatyaparAkrame |
tAvakAH pANDaveyAshcha prAdhyAyanta pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.15:
vismitAshcha prahRRiShTAshcha kShatradharmaM nishAmya te |
svadharmaM nindamAnAshcha praNipatya mahAtmane
shlokas.16:
shayanaM kalpayAmAsurbhIShmAyAmitatejase |
sopadhAnaM naravyAghra sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.17:
vidhAya rakShAM bhIShmAya samAbhAShya parasparam |
anumAnya cha gA~NgeyaM kRRitvA chApi pradakShiNam
shlokas.18:
krodhasa.nraktanayanAH samavekShya parasparam |
punaryuddhAya nirjagmuH kShatriyAH kAlachoditAH
shlokas.19:
tatastUryaninAdaishcha bherINAM cha mahAsvanaiH |
tAvakAnAmanIkAni pareShAM chApi niryayuH
shlokas.20:
vyAvRRitte.ahani rAjendra patite jAhnavIsute |
amarShavashamApannAH kAlopahatachetasaH
shlokas.21:
anAdRRitya vachaH pathyaM gA~Ngeyasya mahAtmanaH |
niryayurbharatashreShThAH shastrANyAdAya sarvashaH
shlokas.22:
mohAttava saputrasya vadhAchChAntanavasya cha |
kauravyA mRRityusAdbhUtAH sahitAH sarvarAjabhiH
shlokas.23:
ajAvaya ivAgopA vane shvApadasa~Nkule |
bhRRishamudvignamanaso hInA devavratena te
shlokas.24:
patite bharatashreShThe babhUva kuruvAhinI |
dyaurivApetanakShatrA hInaM khamiva vAyunA
shlokas.25:
vipannasasyeva mahI vAkchaivAsa.nskRRitA yathA |
AsurIva yathA senA nigRRihIte purA balau
shlokas.26:
vidhaveva varArohA shuShkatoyeva nimnagA |
vRRikairiva vane ruddhA pRRiShatI hatayUthapA
shlokas.27:
svAdharShA hatasiMheva mahatI girikandarA |
bhAratI bharatashreShTha patite jAhnavIsute
shlokas.28:
viShvagvAtahatA rugNA naurivAsInmahArNave |
balibhiH pANDavairvIrairlabdhalakShairbhRRishArditA
shlokas.29:
sA tadAsIdbhRRishaM senA vyAkulAshvarathadvipA |
viShaNNabhUyiShThanarA kRRipaNA draShTumAbabhau
shlokas.30:
tasyAM trastA nRRipatayaH sainikAshcha pRRithagvidhAH |
pAtAla iva majjanto hInA devavratena te
karNaM hi kuravo.asmArShuH sa hi devavratopamaH
shlokas.31:
sarvashastrabhRRitAM shreShThaM rochamAnamivAtithim |
bandhumApadgatasyeva tamevopAgamanmanaH
shlokas.32:
chukrushuH karNa karNeti tatra bhArata pArthivAH |
rAdheyaM hitamasmAkaM sUtaputraM tanutyajam
shlokas.33:
sa hi nAyudhyata tadA dashAhAni mahAyashAH |
sAmAtyabandhuH karNo vai tamAhvayata mAchiram
shlokas.34:
bhIShmeNa hi mahAbAhuH sarvakShatrasya pashyataH |
ratheShu gaNyamAneShu balavikramashAliShu
sa~NkhyAto.ardharathaH karNo dviguNaH sannararShabhaH
shlokas.35:
rathAtirathasa~NkhyAyAM yo.agraNIH shUrasaMmataH |
pitRRivittAmbudeveshAnapi yo yoddhumutsahet
shlokas.36:
sa tu tenaiva kopena rAjangA~NgeyamuktavAn |
tvayi jIvati kauravya nAhaM yotsye katha~nchana
shlokas.37:
tvayA tu pANDaveyeShu nihateShu mahAmRRidhe |
duryodhanamanuj~nApya vanaM yAsyAmi kaurava
shlokas.38:
pANDavairvA hate bhIShme tvayi svargamupeyuShi |
hantAsmyekarathenaiva kRRitsnAnyAnmanyase rathAn
shlokas.39:
evamuktvA mahArAja dashAhAni mahAyashAH |
nAyudhyata tataH karNaH putrasya tava saMmate
shlokas.40:
bhIShmaH samaravikrAntaH pANDaveyasya pArthiva |
jaghAna samare yodhAnasa~NkhyeyaparAkramaH
shlokas.41:
tasmi.nstu nihate shUre satyasandhe mahaujasi |
tvatsutAH karNamasmArShustartukAmA iva plavam
shlokas.42:
tAvakAstava putrAshcha sahitAH sarvarAjabhiH |
hA karNa iti chAkrandankAlo.ayamiti chAbruvan
shlokas.43:
jAmadagnyAbhyanuj~nAtamastre durvArapauruSham |
agamanno manaH karNaM bandhumAtyayikeShviva
shlokas.44:
sa hi shakto raNe rAja.nstrAtumasmAnmahAbhayAt |
tridashAniva govindaH satataM sumahAbhayAt
shlokas.45:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA karNaM yudhi varaM kIrtayantaM punaH punaH |
AshIviShavaduchChvasya dhRRitarAShTro.abravIdidam
shlokas.46:
yattadvaikartanaM karNamagamadvo manastadA |
apyapashyata rAdheyaM sUtaputraM tanutyajam
shlokas.47:
api tanna mRRiShAkArShIdyudhi satyaparAkramaH |
sambhrAntAnAM tadArtAnAM trastAnAM trANamichChatAm
shlokas.48:
api tatpUrayAM chakre dhanurdharavaro yudhi |
yattadvinihate bhIShme kauravANAmapAvRRitam
shlokas.49:
tatkhaNDaM pUrayAmAsa pareShAmAdadhadbhayam |
kRRitavAnmama putrANAM jayAshAM saphalAmapi

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
hataM bhIShmamAdhirathirviditvA; bhinnAM nAvamivAtyagAdhe kurUNAm |
sodaryavadvyasanAtsUtaputraH; santArayiShya.nstava putrasya senAm
shlokas.2:
shrutvA tu karNaH puruShendramachyutaM; nipAtitaM shAntanavaM mahAratham |
athopAyAttUrNamamitrakarshano; dhanurdharANAM pravarastadA vRRiShaH
shlokas.3:
hate tu bhIShme rathasattame parai;rnimajjatIM nAvamivArNave kurUn |
piteva putrA.nstvarito.abhyayAttataH; santArayiShya.nstava putrasya senAm
shlokas.4:
karNa uvAcha||
yasmindhRRitirbuddhiparAkramaujo; damaH satyaM vIraguNAshcha sarve |
astrANi divyAnyatha saMnatirhrIH; priyA cha vAganapAyIni bhIShme
shlokas.5:
brahmadviShaghne satataM kRRitaj~ne; sanAtanaM chandramasIva lakShma |
sa chetprashAntaH paravIrahantA; manye hatAneva hi sarvayodhAn
shlokas.6:
neha dhruvaM ki~nchana jAtu vidyate; asmi.Nlloke karmaNo.anityayogAt |
sUryodaye ko hi vimuktasa.nshayo; bhAvaM kurvItAdya mahAvrate hate
shlokas.7:
vasuprabhAve vasuvIryasambhave; gate vasUneva vasundharAdhipe |
vasUni putrA.nshcha vasundharAM tathA; kurU.nshcha shochadhvamimAM cha vAhinIm
shlokas.8:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
mahAprabhAve varade nipAtite; lokashreShThe shAntanave mahaujasi |
parAjiteShu bharateShu durmanAH; karNo bhRRishaM nyashvasadashru vartayan
shlokas.9:
idaM tu rAdheyavacho nishamya te; sutAshcha rAja.nstava sainikAshcha ha |
parasparaM chukrushurArtijaM bhRRishaM; tadAshru netrairmumuchurhi shabdavat
shlokas.10:
pravartamAne tu punarmahAhave; vigAhyamAnAsu chamUShu pArthivaiH |
athAbravIddharShakaraM vachastadA; ratharShabhAnsarvamahAratharShabhaH
shlokas.11:
karNa uvAcha||
jagatyanitye satataM pradhAvati; prachintayannasthiramadya lakShaye |
bhavatsu tiShThatsviha pAtito raNe; giriprakAshaH kurupu~NgavaH katham
shlokas.12:
nipAtite shAntanave mahArathe; divAkare bhUtalamAsthite yathA |
na pArthivAH soDhumalaM dhana~njayaM; giripravoDhAramivAnilaM drumAH
shlokas.13:
hatapradhAnaM tvidamArtarUpaM; parairhatotsAhamanAthamadya vai |
mayA kurUNAM paripAlyamAhave; balaM yathA tena mahAtmanA tathA
shlokas.14:
samAhitaM chAtmani bhAramIdRRishaM; jagattathAnityamidaM cha lakShaye |
nipAtitaM chAhavashauNDamAhave; kathaM nu kuryAmahamAhave bhayam
shlokas.15:
ahaM tu tAnkuruvRRiShabhAnajihmagaiH; praverayanyamasadanaM raNe charan |
yashaH paraM jagati vibhAvya vartitA; parairhato yudhi shayitAtha vA punaH
shlokas.16:
yudhiShThiro dhRRitimatidharmatattvavA;nvRRikodaro gajashatatulyavikramaH |
tathArjunastridashavarAtmajo yato; na tadbalaM sujayamathAmarairapi
shlokas.17:
yamau raNe yatra yamopamau bale; sasAtyakiryatra cha devakIsutaH |
na tadbalaM kApuruSho.abhyupeyivA;nnivartate mRRityumukhAdivAsakRRit
shlokas.18:
tapo.abhyudIrNaM tapasaiva gamyate; balaM balenApi tathA manasvibhiH |
manashcha me shatrunivAraNe dhruvaM; svarakShaNe chAchalavadvyavasthitam
shlokas.19:
evaM chaiShAM budhyamAnaH prabhAvaM; gatvaivAhaM tA~njayAmyadya sUta |
mitradroho marShaNIyo na me.ayaM; bhagne sainye yaH sahAyaH sa mitram
shlokas.20:
kartAsmyetatsatpuruShAryakarma; tyaktvA prANAnanuyAsyAmi bhIShmam |
sarvAnsa~Nkhye shatrusa~NghAnhaniShye; hatastairvA vIralokaM gamiShye
shlokas.21:
samprAkruShTe ruditastrIkumAre; parAbhUte pauruShe dhArtarAShTre |
mayA kRRityamiti jAnAmi sUta; tasmAchChatrUndhArtarAShTrasya jeShye
shlokas.22:
kurUnrakShanpANDuputrA~njighA.nsaM;styaktvA prANAnghorarUpe raNe.asmin |
sarvAnsa~Nkhye shatrusa~NghAnnihatya; dAsyAmyahaM dhArtarAShTrAya rAjyam
shlokas.23:
nibadhyatAM me kavachaM vichitraM; haimaM shubhraM maNiratnAvabhAsi |
shirastrANaM chArkasamAnabhAsaM; dhanuH sharA.nshchApi viShAhikalpAn
shlokas.24:
upAsa~NgAnShoDasha yojayantu; dhanUMShi divyAni tathAharantu |
asI.nshcha shaktIshcha gadAshcha gurvIH; sha~NkhaM cha jAmbUnadachitrabhAsam
shlokas.25:
etAM raukmIM nAgakakShyAM cha jaitrIM; jaitraM cha me dhvajamindIvarAbham |
shlakShNairvastrairvipramRRijyAnayasva; chitrAM mAlAM chAtra baddhvA sajAlAm
shlokas.26:
ashvAnagryAnpANDurAbhraprakAshA;npuShTAnsnAtAnmantrapUtAbhiradbhiH |
taptairbhANDaiH kA~nchanairabhyupetA;~nshIghrA~nshIghraM sUtaputrAnayasva
shlokas.27:
rathaM chAgryaM hemajAlAvanaddhaM; ratnaishchitraM chandrasUryaprakAshaiH |
dravyairyuktaM samprahAropapannai;rvAhairyuktaM tUrNamAvartayasva
shlokas.28:
chitrANi chApAni cha vegavanti; jyAshchottamAH saMhananopapannAH |
tUNA.nshcha pUrNAnmahataH sharANA;mAsajya gAtrAvaraNAni chaiva
shlokas.29:
prAyAtrikaM chAnayatAshu sarvaM; kanyAH pUrNaM vIrakA.nsyaM cha haimam |
AnIya mAlAmavabadhya chA~Nge; pravAdayantvAshu jayAya bherIH
shlokas.30:
prayAhi sUtAshu yataH kirITI; vRRikodaro dharmasuto yamau cha |
tAnvA haniShyAmi sametya sa~Nkhye; bhIShmAya vaiShyAmi hato dviShadbhiH
shlokas.31:
yasminrAjA satyadhRRitiryudhiShThiraH; samAsthito bhImasenArjunau cha |
vAsudevaH sAtyakiH sRRi~njayAshcha; manye balaM tadajayyaM mahIpaiH
shlokas.32:
taM chenmRRityuH sarvaharo.abhirakShe;tsadApramattaH samare kirITinam |
tathApi hantAsmi sametya sa~Nkhye; yAsyAmi vA bhIShmapathA yamAya
shlokas.33:
na tvevAhaM na gamiShyAmi teShAM; madhye shUrANAM tattathAhaM bravImi |
mitradruho durbalabhaktayo ye; pApAtmAno na mamaite sahAyAH
shlokas.34:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sa siddhimantaM rathamuttamaM dRRiDhaM; sakUbaraM hemapariShkRRitaM shubham |
patAkinaM vAtajavairhayottamai;ryuktaM samAsthAya yayau jayAya
shlokas.35:
sampUjyamAnaH kurubhirmahAtmA; ratharShabhaH pANDuravAjiyAtA |
yayau tadAyodhanamugradhanvA; yatrAvasAnaM bharatarShabhasya
shlokas.36:
varUthinA mahatA sadhvajena; suvarNamuktAmaNivajrashAlinA |
sadashvayuktena rathena karNo; meghasvanenArka ivAmitaujAH
shlokas.37:
hutAshanAbhaH sa hutAshanaprabhe; shubhaH shubhe vai svarathe dhanurdharaH |
sthito rarAjAdhirathirmahArathaH; svayaM vimAne surarADiva sthitaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sharatalpe mahAtmAnaM shayAnamamitaujasam |
mahAvAtasamUhena samudramiva shoShitam
shlokas.2:
divyairastrairmaheShvAsaM pAtitaM savyasAchinA |
jayAshAM tava putrANAM sambhagnAM sharma varma cha
shlokas.3:
apArANAmiva dvIpamagAdhe gAdhamichChatAm |
srotasA yAmuneneva sharaugheNa pariplutam
shlokas.4:
mahAntamiva mainAkamasahyaM bhuvi pAtitam |
nabhashchyutamivAdityaM patitaM dharaNItale
shlokas.5:
shatakratorivAchintyaM purA vRRitreNa nirjayam |
mohanaM sarvasainyasya yudhi bhIShmasya pAtanam
shlokas.6:
kakudaM sarvasainyAnAM lakShma sarvadhanuShmatAm |
dhana~njayasharavyAptaM pitaraM te mahAvratam
shlokas.7:
taM vIrashayane vIraM shayAnaM puruSharShabham |
bhIShmamAdhirathirdRRiShTvA bharatAnAmamadhyamam
shlokas.8:
avatIrya rathAdArto bAShpavyAkulitAkSharam |
abhivAdyA~njaliM baddhvA vandamAno.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.9:
karNo.ahamasmi bhadraM te adya mA vada bhArata |
puNyayA kShemayA vAchA chakShuShA chAvalokaya
shlokas.10:
na nUnaM sukRRitasyeha phalaM kashchitsamashnute |
yatra dharmaparo vRRiddhaH shete bhuvi bhavAniha
shlokas.11:
koshasa~njanane mantre vyUhapraharaNeShu cha |
nAthamanyaM na pashyAmi kurUNAM kurusattama
shlokas.12:
buddhyA vishuddhayA yukto yaH kurU.nstArayedbhayAt |
yodhA.nstvamaplave hitvA pitRRilokaM gamiShyasi
shlokas.13:
adya prabhRRiti sa~NkruddhA vyAghrA iva mRRigakShayam |
pANDavA bharatashreShTha kariShyanti kurukShayam
shlokas.14:
adya gANDIvaghoShasya vIryaj~nAH savyasAchinaH |
kuravaH santrasiShyanti vajrapANerivAsurAH
shlokas.15:
adya gANDIvamuktAnAmashanInAmiva svanaH |
trAsayiShyati sa~NgrAme kurUnanyA.nshcha pArthivAn
shlokas.16:
samiddho.agniryathA vIra mahAjvAlo drumAndahet |
dhArtarAShTrAnpradhakShyanti tathA bANAH kirITinaH
shlokas.17:
yena yena prasarato vAyvagnI sahitau vane |
tena tena pradahato bhagavantau yadichChataH
shlokas.18:
yAdRRisho.agniH samiddho hi tAdRRikpArtho na sa.nshayaH |
yathA vAyurnaravyAghra tathA kRRiShNo na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.19:
nadataH pA~nchajanyasya rasato gANDivasya cha |
shrutvA sarvANi sainyAni trAsaM yAsyanti bhArata
shlokas.20:
kapidhvajasya chotpAte rathasyAmitrakarshinaH |
shabdaM soDhuM na shakShyanti tvAmRRite vIra pArthivAH
shlokas.21:
ko hyarjunaM raNe yoddhuM tvadanyaH pArthivo.arhati |
yasya divyAni karmANi pravadanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.22:
amAnuShashcha sa~NgrAmastryambakena cha dhImataH |
tasmAchchaiva varaH prApto duShprApashchAkRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.23:
tamadyAhaM pANDavaM yuddhashauNDa;mamRRiShyamANo bhavatAnushiShTaH |
AshIviShaM dRRiShTiharaM sughora;miyAM puraskRRitya vadhaM jayaM vA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasya lAlapyataH shrutvA vRRiddhaH kurupitAmahaH |
deshakAlochitaM vAkyamabravItprItamAnasaH
shlokas.2:
samudra iva sindhUnAM jyotiShAmiva bhAskaraH |
satyasya cha yathA santo bIjAnAmiva chorvarA
shlokas.3:
parjanya iva bhUtAnAM pratiShThA suhRRidAM bhava |
bAndhavAstvAnujIvantu sahasrAkShamivAmarAH
shlokas.4:
svabAhubalavIryeNa dhArtarAShTrapriyaiShiNA |
karNa rAjapuraM gatvA kAmbojA nihatAstvayA
shlokas.5:
girivrajagatAshchApi nagnajitpramukhA nRRipAH |
ambaShThAshcha videhAshcha gAndhArAshcha jitAstvayA
shlokas.6:
himavaddurganilayAH kirAtA raNakarkashAH |
duryodhanasya vashagAH kRRitAH karNa tvayA purA
shlokas.7:
tatra tatra cha sa~NgrAme duryodhanahitaiShiNA |
bahavashcha jitA vIrAstvayA karNa mahaujasA
shlokas.8:
yathA duryodhanastAta saj~nAtikulabAndhavaH |
tathA tvamapi sarveShAM kauravANAM gatirbhava
shlokas.9:
shivenAbhivadAmi tvAM gachCha yudhyasva shatrubhiH |
anushAdhi kurUnsa~Nkhye dhatsva duryodhane jayam
shlokas.10:
bhavAnpautrasamo.asmAkaM yathA duryodhanastathA |
tavApi dharmataH sarve yathA tasya vayaM tathA
shlokas.11:
yaunAtsambandhakAlloke vishiShTaM sa~NgataM satAm |
sadbhiH saha narashreShTha pravadanti manIShiNaH
shlokas.12:
sa satyasa~Ngaro bhUtvA mamedamiti nishchitam |
kurUNAM pAlaya balaM yathA duryodhanastathA
shlokas.13:
iti shrutvA vachaH so.atha charaNAvabhivAdya cha |
yayau vaikartanaH karNastUrNamAyodhanaM prati
shlokas.14:
so.abhivIkShya naraughANAM sthAnamapratimaM mahat |
vyUDhapraharaNoraskaM sainyaM tatsamabRRiMhayat
shlokas.15:
karNaM dRRiShTvA maheShvAsaM yuddhAya samavasthitam |
kShveDitAsphoTitaravaiH siMhanAdaravairapi
dhanuHshabdaishcha vividhaiH kuravaH samapUjayan

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
rathasthaM puruShavyAghraM dRRiShTvA karNamavasthitam |
hRRiShTo duryodhano rAjannidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.2:
sanAthamidamatyarthaM bhavatA pAlitaM balam |
manye kiM tu samarthaM yaddhitaM tatsampradhAryatAm
shlokas.3:
karNa uvAcha||
brUhi tatpuruShavyAghra tvaM hi prAj~natamo nRRipa |
yathA chArthapatiH kRRityaM pashyate na tathetaraH
shlokas.4:
te sma sarve tava vachaH shrotukAmA nareshvara |
nAnyAyyaM hi bhavAnvAkyaM brUyAditi matirmama
shlokas.5:
duryodhana uvAcha||
bhIShmaH senApraNetAsIdvayasA vikrameNa cha |
shrutena cha susampannaH sarvairyodhaguNaistathA
shlokas.6:
tenAtiyashasA karNa ghnatA shatrugaNAnmama |
suyuddhena dashAhAni pAlitAH smo mahAtmanA
shlokas.7:
tasminnasukaraM karma kRRitavatyAsthite divam |
kaM nu senApraNetAraM manyase tadanantaram
shlokas.8:
na RRite nAyakaM senA muhUrtamapi tiShThati |
AhaveShvAhavashreShTha netRRihIneva naurjale
shlokas.9:
yathA hyakarNadhArA nau rathashchAsArathiryathA |
dravedyatheShTaM tadvatsyAdRRite senApatiM balam
shlokas.10:
sa bhavAnvIkShya sarveShu mAmakeShu mahAtmasu |
pashya senApatiM yuktamanu shAntanavAdiha
shlokas.11:
yaM hi senApraNetAraM bhavAnvakShyati sa.nyuge |
taM vayaM sahitAH sarve prakariShyAma mAriSha
shlokas.12:
karNa uvAcha||
sarva eva mahAtmAna ime puruShasattamAH |
senApatitvamarhanti nAtra kAryA vichAraNA
shlokas.13:
kulasaMhananaj~nAnairbalavikramabuddhibhiH |
yuktAH kRRitaj~nA hrImanta AhaveShvanivartinaH
shlokas.14:
yugapanna tu te shakyAH kartuM sarve puraHsarAH |
eka evAtra kartavyo yasminvaisheShikA guNAH
shlokas.15:
anyonyaspardhinAM teShAM yadyekaM satkariShyasi |
sheShA vimanaso vyaktaM na yotsyante hi bhArata
shlokas.16:
ayaM tu sarvayodhAnAmAchAryaH sthaviro guruH |
yuktaH senApatiH kartuM droNaH shastrabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.17:
ko hi tiShThati durdharShe droNe brahmaviduttame |
senApatiH syAdanyo.asmAchChukrA~NgirasadarshanAt
shlokas.18:
na cha sa hyasti te yodhaH sarvarAjasu bhArata |
yo droNaM samare yAntaM nAnuyAsyati sa.nyuge
shlokas.19:
eSha senApraNetR^INAmeSha shastrabhRRitAmapi |
eSha buddhimatAM chaiva shreShTho rAjangurushcha te
shlokas.20:
evaM duryodhanAchAryamAshu senApatiM kuru |
jigIShanto.asurAnsa~Nkhye kArttikeyamivAmarAH
shlokas.21:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
karNasya vachanaM shrutvA rAjA duryodhanastadA |
senAmadhyagataM droNamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.22:
varNashraiShThyAtkulotpattyA shrutena vayasA dhiyA |
vIryAddAkShyAdadhRRiShyatvAdarthaj~nAnAnnayAjjayAt
shlokas.23:
tapasA cha kRRitaj~natvAdvRRiddhaH sarvaguNairapi |
yukto bhavatsamo goptA rAj~nAmanyo na vidyate
shlokas.24:
sa bhavAnpAtu naH sarvAnvibudhAniva vAsavaH |
bhavannetrAH parA~njetumichChAmo dvijasattama
shlokas.25:
rudrANAmiva kApAlI vasUnAmiva pAvakaH |
kubera iva yakShANAM marutAmiva vAsavaH
shlokas.26:
vasiShTha iva viprANAM tejasAmiva bhAskaraH |
pitR^INAmiva dharmo.atha AdityAnAmivAmburAT
shlokas.27:
nakShatrANAmiva shashI ditijAnAmivoshanAH |
shreShThaH senApraNetR^INAM sa naH senApatirbhava
shlokas.28:
akShauhiNyo dashaikA cha vashagAH santu te.anagha |
tAbhiH shatrUnprativyUhya jahIndro dAnavAniva
shlokas.29:
prayAtu no bhavAnagre devAnAmiva pAvakiH |
anuyAsyAmahe tvAjau saurabheyA ivarShabham
shlokas.30:
ugradhanvA maheShvAso divyaM visphArayandhanuH |
agre bhavantaM dRRiShTvA no nArjunaH prasahiShyate
shlokas.31:
dhruvaM yudhiShThiraM sa~Nkhye sAnubandhaM sabAndhavam |
jeShyAmi puruShavyAghra bhavAnsenApatiryadi
shlokas.32:
evamukte tato droNe jayetyUchurnarAdhipAH |
siMhanAdena mahatA harShayantastavAtmajam
shlokas.33:
sainikAshcha mudA yuktA vardhayanti dvijottamam |
duryodhanaM puraskRRitya prArthayanto mahadyashaH
shlokas.34:
droNa uvAcha||
vedaM ShaDa~NgaM vedAhamarthavidyAM cha mAnavIm |
traiyambakamatheShvastramastrANi vividhAni cha
shlokas.35:
ye chApyuktA mayi guNA bhavadbhirjayakA~NkShibhiH |
chikIrShustAnahaM satyAnyodhayiShyAmi pANDavAn
shlokas.36:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sa evamabhyanuj~nAtashchakre senApatiM tataH |
droNaM tava suto rAjanvidhidRRiShTena karmaNA
shlokas.37:
athAbhiShiShichurdroNaM duryodhanamukhA nRRipAH |
senApatye yathA skandaM purA shakramukhAH surAH
shlokas.38:
tato vAditraghoSheNa saha pu.nsAM mahAsvanaiH |
prAdurAsItkRRite droNe harShaH senApatau tadA
shlokas.39:
tataH puNyAhaghoSheNa svastivAdasvanena cha |
sa.nstavairgItashabdaishcha sUtamAgadhabandinAm
shlokas.40:
jayashabdairdvijAgryANAM subhagAnartitaistathA |
satkRRitya vidhivaddroNaM jitAnmanyanta pANDavAn

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
senApatyaM tu samprApya bhAradvAjo mahArathaH |
yuyutsurvyUhya sainyAni prAyAttava sutaiH saha
shlokas.2:
saindhavashcha kali~Ngashcha vikarNashcha tavAtmajaH |
dakShiNaM pArshvamAsthAya samatiShThanta da.nshitAH
shlokas.3:
prapakShaH shakunisteShAM pravarairhayasAdibhiH |
yayau gAndhArakaiH sArdhaM vimalaprAsayodhibhiH
shlokas.4:
kRRipashcha kRRitavarmA cha chitraseno vivi.nshatiH |
duHshAsanamukhA yattAH savyaM pArshvamapAlayan
shlokas.5:
teShAM prapakShAH kAmbojAH sudakShiNapuraHsarAH |
yayurashvairmahAvegaiH shakAshcha yavanaiH saha
shlokas.6:
madrAstrigartAH sAmbaShThAH pratIchyodIchyavAsinaH |
shibayaH shUrasenAshcha shUdrAshcha maladaiH saha
shlokas.7:
sauvIrAH kitavAH prAchyA dAkShiNAtyAshcha sarvashaH |
tavAtmajaM puraskRRitya sUtaputrasya pRRiShThataH
shlokas.8:
harShayansarvasainyAni baleShu balamAdadhat |
yayau vaikartanaH karNaH pramukhe sarvadhanvinAm
shlokas.9:
tasya dIpto mahAkAyaH svAnyanIkAni harShayan |
hastikakShyAmahAketurbabhau sUryasamadyutiH
shlokas.10:
na bhIShmavyasanaM kashchiddRRiShTvA karNamamanyata |
vishokAshchAbhavansarve rAjAnaH kurubhiH saha
shlokas.11:
hRRiShTAshcha bahavo yodhAstatrAjalpanta sa~NgatAH |
na hi karNaM raNe dRRiShTvA yudhi sthAsyanti pANDavAH
shlokas.12:
karNo hi samare shakto jetuM devAnsavAsavAn |
kimu pANDusutAnyuddhe hInavIryaparAkramAn
shlokas.13:
bhIShmeNa tu raNe pArthAH pAlitA bAhushAlinA |
tA.nstu karNaH sharaistIkShNairnAshayiShyatyasa.nshayam
shlokas.14:
evaM bruvantaste.anyonyaM hRRiShTarUpA vishAM pate |
rAdheyaM pUjayantashcha prasha.nsantashcha niryayuH
shlokas.15:
asmAkaM shakaTavyUho droNena vihito.abhavat |
pareShAM krau~ncha evAsIdvyUho rAjanmahAtmanAm
prIyamANena vihito dharmarAjena bhArata
shlokas.16:
vyUhapramukhatasteShAM tasthatuH puruSharShabhau |
vAnaradhvajamuchChritya viShvaksenadhana~njayau
shlokas.17:
kakudaM sarvasainyAnAM lakShma sarvadhanuShmatAm |
AdityapathagaH ketuH pArthasyAmitatejasaH
shlokas.18:
dIpayAmAsa tatsainyaM pANDavasya mahAtmanaH |
yathA prajvalitaH sUryo yugAnte vai vasundharAm
shlokas.19:
asyatAmarjunaH shreShTho gANDIvaM dhanuShAM varam |
vAsudevashcha bhUtAnAM chakrANAM cha sudarshanam
shlokas.20:
chatvAryetAni tejA.nsi vaha~nshvetahayo rathaH |
pareShAmagratastasthau kAlachakramivodyatam
shlokas.21:
evametau mahAtmAnau balasenAgragAvubhau |
tAvakAnAM mukhaM karNaH pareShAM cha dhana~njayaH
shlokas.22:
tato jAtAbhisa.nrambhau parasparavadhaiShiNau |
avekShetAM tadAnyonyaM samare karNapANDavau
shlokas.23:
tataH prayAte sahasA bhAradvAje mahArathe |
antarnAdena ghoreNa vasudhA samakampata
shlokas.24:
tatastumulamAkAshamAvRRiNotsadivAkaram |
vAtoddhUtaM rajastIvraM kausheyanikaropamam
shlokas.25:
anabhre pravavarSha dyaurmA.nsAsthirudhirANyuta |
gRRidhrAH shyenA baDAH ka~NkA vAyasAshcha sahasrashaH
uparyupari senAM te tadA paryapatannRRipa
shlokas.26:
gomAyavashcha prAkroshanbhayadAndAruNAnravAn |
akArShurapasavyaM cha bahushaH pRRitanAM tava
chikhAdiShanto mA.nsAni pipAsantashcha shoNitam
shlokas.27:
apataddIpyamAnA cha sanirghAtA sakampanA |
ulkA jvalantI sa~NgrAme puchChenAvRRitya sarvashaH
shlokas.28:
pariveSho mahA.nshchApi savidyutstanayitnumAn |
bhAskarasyAbhavadrAjanprayAte vAhinIpatau
shlokas.29:
ete chAnye cha bahavaH prAdurAsansudAruNAH |
utpAtA yudhi vIrANAM jIvitakShayakArakAH
shlokas.30:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM parasparavadhaiShiNAm |
kurupANDavasainyAnAM shabdenAnAdayajjagat
shlokas.31:
te tvanyonyaM susa.nrabdhAH pANDavAH kauravaiH saha |
pratyaghnannishitairbANairjayagRRiddhAH prahAriNaH
shlokas.32:
sa pANDavAnAM mahatIM maheShvAso mahAdyutiH |
vegenAbhyadravatsenAM kira~nsharashataiH shitaiH
shlokas.33:
droNamabhyudyataM dRRiShTvA pANDavAH saha sRRi~njayaiH |
pratyagRRihNa.nstadA rAja~nsharavarShaiH pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.34:
sa~NkShobhyamANA droNena bhidyamAnA mahAchamUH |
vyashIryata sapA~nchAlA vAteneva balAhakAH
shlokas.35:
bahUnIha vikurvANo divyAnyastrANi sa.nyuge |
apIDayatkShaNenaiva droNaH pANDavasRRi~njayAn
shlokas.36:
te vadhyamAnA droNena vAsaveneva dAnavAH |
pA~nchAlAH samakampanta dhRRiShTadyumnapurogamAH
shlokas.37:
tato divyAstravichChUro yAj~nasenirmahArathaH |
abhinachCharavarSheNa droNAnIkamanekadhA
shlokas.38:
droNasya sharavarShaistu sharavarShANi bhAgashaH |
saMnivArya tataH senAM kurUnapyavadhIdbalI
shlokas.39:
saMhRRitya tu tato droNaH samavasthApya chAhave |
svamanIkaM mahAbAhuH pArShataM samupAdravat
shlokas.40:
sa bANavarShaM sumahadasRRijatpArShataM prati |
maghavAnsamabhikruddhaH sahasA dAnaveShviva
shlokas.41:
te kampyamAnA droNena bANaiH pANDavasRRi~njayAH |
punaH punarabhajyanta siMhenevetare mRRigAH
shlokas.42:
atha paryapataddroNaH pANDavAnAM balaM balI |
alAtachakravadrAja.nstadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.43:
khacharanagarakalpaM kalpitaM shAstradRRiShTyA; chaladanilapatAkaM hrAdinaM valgitAshvam |
sphaTikavimalaketuM tApanaM shAtravANAM; rathavaramadhirUDhaH sa~njahArArisenAm

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tathA droNamabhighnantaM sAshvasUtarathadvipAn |
vyathitAH pANDavA dRRiShTvA na chainaM paryavArayan
shlokas.2:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA dhRRiShTadyumnadhana~njayau |
abravItsarvato yattaiH kumbhayonirnivAryatAm
shlokas.3:
tatrainamarjunashchaiva pArShatashcha sahAnugaH |
paryagRRihNa.nstataH sarve samAyAntaM mahArathAH
shlokas.4:
kekayA bhImasenashcha saubhadro.atha ghaTotkachaH |
yudhiShThiro yamau matsyA drupadasyAtmajAstathA
shlokas.5:
draupadeyAshcha saMhRRiShTA dhRRiShTaketuH sasAtyakiH |
chekitAnashcha sa~Nkruddho yuyutsushcha mahArathaH
shlokas.6:
ye chAnye pArthivA rAjanpANDavasyAnuyAyinaH |
kulavIryAnurUpANi chakruH karmANyanekashaH
shlokas.7:
sa~NgRRihyamANAM tAM dRRiShTvA pANDavairvAhinIM raNe |
vyAvRRitya chakShuShI kopAdbhAradvAjo.anvavaikShata
shlokas.8:
sa tIvraM kopamAsthAya rathe samaradurmadaH |
vyadhamatpANDavAnIkamabhrANIva sadAgatiH
shlokas.9:
rathAnashvAnnarAnnAgAnabhidhAva.nstatastataH |
chachAronmattavaddroNo vRRiddho.api taruNo yathA
shlokas.10:
tasya shoNitadigdhA~NgAH shoNAste vAtaraMhasaH |
AjAneyA hayA rAjannavibhrAntAH shriyaM dadhuH
shlokas.11:
tamantakamiva kruddhamApatantaM yatavratam |
dRRiShTvA samprAdravanyodhAH pANDavasya tatastataH
shlokas.12:
teShAM pradravatAM bhImaH punarAvartatAmapi |
vIkShatAM tiShThatAM chAsIchChabdaH paramadAruNaH
shlokas.13:
shUrANAM harShajanano bhIrUNAM bhayavardhanaH |
dyAvApRRithivyorvivaraM pUrayAmAsa sarvataH
shlokas.14:
tataH punarapi droNo nAma vishrAvayanyudhi |
akarodraudramAtmAnaM kira~nsharashataiH parAn
shlokas.15:
sa tathA tAnyanIkAni pANDaveyasya dhImataH |
kAlavannyavadhIddroNo yuveva sthaviro balI
shlokas.16:
utkRRitya cha shirA.nsyugro bAhUnapi sabhUShaNAn |
kRRitvA shUnyAnrathopasthAnudakroshanmahArathaH
shlokas.17:
tasya harShapraNAdena bANavegena chAbhibho |
prAkampanta raNe yodhA gAvaH shItArditA iva
shlokas.18:
droNasya rathaghoSheNa maurvIniShpeShaNena cha |
dhanuHshabdena chAkAshe shabdaH samabhavanmahAn
shlokas.19:
athAsya bahusho bANA nishcharantaH sahasrashaH |
vyApya sarvA dishaH peturgajAshvarathapattiShu
shlokas.20:
taM kArmukamahAvegamastrajvalitapAvakam |
droNamAsAdayAM chakruH pA~nchAlAH pANDavaiH saha
shlokas.21:
tAnvai sarathahastyashvAnprAhiNodyamasAdanam |
droNo.achireNAkarochcha mahIM shoNitakardamAm
shlokas.22:
tanvatA paramAstrANi sharAnsatatamasyatA |
droNena vihitaM dikShu bANajAlamadRRishyata
shlokas.23:
padAtiShu rathAshveShu vAraNeShu cha sarvashaH |
tasya vidyudivAbhreShu charanketuradRRishyata
shlokas.24:
sa kekayAnAM pravarA.nshcha pa~ncha; pA~nchAlarAjaM cha sharaiH pramRRidya |
yudhiShThirAnIkamadInayodhI; droNo.abhyayAtkArmukabANapANiH
shlokas.25:
taM bhImasenashcha dhana~njayashcha; shineshcha naptA drupadAtmajashcha |
shaibyAtmajaH kAshipatiH shibishcha; hRRiShTA nadanto vyakira~nsharaughaiH
shlokas.26:
teShAmatho droNadhanurvimuktAH; patatriNaH kA~nchanachitrapu~NkhAH |
bhittvA sharIrANi gajAshvayUnAM; jagmurmahIM shoNitadigdhavAjAH
shlokas.27:
sA yodhasa~Nghaishcha rathaishcha bhUmiH; sharairvibhinnairgajavAjibhishcha |
prachChAdyamAnA patitairbabhUva; samantato dyauriva kAlameghaiH
shlokas.28:
shaineyabhImArjunavAhinIpA;~nshaibyAbhimanyU saha kAshirAj~nA |
anyA.nshcha vIrAnsamare pramRRidnA;ddroNaH sutAnAM tava bhUtikAmaH
shlokas.29:
etAni chAnyAni cha kauravendra; karmANi kRRitvA samare mahAtmA |
pratApya lokAniva kAlasUryo; droNo gataH svargamito hi rAjan
shlokas.30:
evaM rukmarathaH shUro hatvA shatasahasrashaH |
pANDavAnAM raNe yodhAnpArShatena nipAtitaH
shlokas.31:
akShauhiNImabhyadhikAM shUrANAmanivartinAm |
nihatya pashchAddhRRitimAnagachChatparamAM gatim
shlokas.32:
pANDavaiH saha pA~nchAlairashivaiH krUrakarmabhiH |
hato rukmaratho rAjankRRitvA karma suduShkaram
shlokas.33:
tato ninAdo bhUtAnAmAkAshe samajAyata |
sainyAnAM cha tato rAjannAchArye nihate yudhi
shlokas.34:
dyAM dharAM khaM disho vAri pradishashchAnunAdayan |
aho dhigiti bhUtAnAM shabdaH samabhavanmahAn
shlokas.35:
devatAH pitarashchaiva pUrve ye chAsya bAndhavAH |
dadRRishurnihataM tatra bhAradvAjaM mahAratham
shlokas.36:
pANDavAstu jayaM labdhvA siMhanAdAnprachakrire |
tena nAdena mahatA samakampata medinI

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kiM kurvANaM raNe droNaM jaghnuH pANDavasRRi~njayAH |
tathA nipuNamastreShu sarvashastrabhRRitAmapi
shlokas.2:
rathabha~Ngo babhUvAsya dhanurvAshIryatAsyataH |
pramatto vAbhavaddroNastato mRRityumupeyivAn
shlokas.3:
kathaM nu pArShatastAta shatrubhirduShpradharShaNam |
kirantamiShusa~NghAtAnrukmapu~NkhAnanekashaH
shlokas.4:
kShiprahastaM dvijashreShThaM kRRitinaM chitrayodhinam |
dUreShupAtinaM dAntamastrayuddhe cha pAragam
shlokas.5:
pA~nchAlaputro nyavadhIddiShTyA sa varamachyutam |
kurvANaM dAruNaM karma raNe yattaM mahAratham
shlokas.6:
vyaktaM diShTaM hi balavatpauruShAditi me matiH |
yaddroNo nihataH shUraH pArShatena mahAtmanA
shlokas.7:
astraM chaturvidhaM vIre yasminnAsItpratiShThitam |
tamiShvastravarAchAryaM droNaM sha.nsasi me hatam
shlokas.8:
shrutvA hataM rukmarathaM vaiyAghraparivAraNam |
jAtarUpapariShkAraM nAdya shokamapAnude
shlokas.9:
na nUnaM paraduHkhena kashchinmriyati sa~njaya |
yatra droNamahaM shrutvA hataM jIvAmi na mriye
shlokas.10:
ashmasAramayaM nUnaM hRRidayaM sudRRiDhaM mama |
yachChrutvA nihataM droNaM shatadhA na vidIryate
shlokas.11:
brAhme vede tatheShvastre yamupAsanguNArthinaH |
brAhmaNA rAjaputrAshcha sa kathaM mRRityunA hataH
shlokas.12:
shoShaNaM sAgarasyeva meroriva visarpaNam |
patanaM bhAskarasyeva na mRRiShye droNapAtanam
shlokas.13:
dRRiptAnAM pratiSheddhAsIddhArmikAnAM cha rakShitA |
yo.atyAkShItkRRipaNasyArthe prANAnapi parantapaH
shlokas.14:
mandAnAM mama putrANAM jayAshA yasya vikrame |
bRRihaspatyushanastulyo buddhyA sa nihataH katham
shlokas.15:
te cha shoNA bRRihanto.ashvAH saindhavA hemamAlinaH |
rathe vAtajavA yuktAH sarvashabdAtigA raNe
shlokas.16:
balino ghoShiNo dAntAH saindhavAH sAdhuvAhinaH |
dRRiDhAH sa~NgrAmamadhyeShu kachchidAsanna vihvalAH
shlokas.17:
kariNAM bRRiMhatAM yuddhe sha~Nkhadundubhinisvanam |
jyAkShepasharavarShANAM shastrANAM cha sahiShNavaH
shlokas.18:
Asha.nsantaH parA~njetuM jitashvAsA jitavyathAH |
hayAH prajavitAH shIghrA bhAradvAjarathodvahAH
shlokas.19:
te sma rukmarathe yuktA naravIrasamAhitAH |
kathaM nAbhyatara.nstAta pANDavAnAmanIkinIm
shlokas.20:
jAtarUpapariShkAramAsthAya rathamuttamam |
bhAradvAjaH kimakarochChUraH sa~Nkrandano yudhi
shlokas.21:
vidyAM yasyopajIvanti sarvalokadhanurbhRRitaH |
sa satyasandho balavAndroNaH kimakarodyudhi
shlokas.22:
divi shakramiva shreShThaM mahAmAtraM dhanurbhRRitAm |
ke nu taM raudrakarmANaM yuddhe pratyudyayU rathAH
shlokas.23:
nanu rukmarathaM dRRiShTvA pradravanti sma pANDavAH |
divyamastraM vikurvANaM senAM kShiNvantamavyayam
shlokas.24:
utAho sarvasainyena dharmarAjaH sahAnujaH |
pA~nchAlyapragraho droNaM sarvataH samavArayat
shlokas.25:
nUnamAvArayatpArtho rathino.anyAnajihmagaiH |
tato droNaM samArohatpArShataH pApakarmakRRit
shlokas.26:
na hyanyaM paripashyAmi vadhe ka~nchana shuShmiNaH |
dhRRiShTadyumnAdRRite raudrAtpAlyamAnAtkirITinA
shlokas.27:
tairvRRitaH sarvataH shUraiH pA~nchAlyApasadastataH |
kekayaishchedikArUShairmatsyairanyaishcha bhUmipaiH
shlokas.28:
vyAkulIkRRitamAchAryaM pipIlairuragaM yathA |
karmaNyasukare saktaM jaghAneti matirmama
shlokas.29:
yo.adhItya chaturo vedAnsarvAnAkhyAnapa~nchamAn |
brAhmaNAnAM pratiShThAsItsrotasAmiva sAgaraH
sa kathaM brAhmaNo vRRiddhaH shastreNa vadhamAptavAn
shlokas.30:
amarShaNo marShitavAnklishyamAnaH sadA mayA |
anarhamANaH kaunteyaH karmaNastasya tatphalam
shlokas.31:
yasya karmAnujIvanti loke sarvadhanurbhRRitaH |
sa satyasandhaH sukRRitI shrIkAmairnihataH katham
shlokas.32:
divi shakra iva shreShTho mahAsattvo mahAbalaH |
sa kathaM nihataH pArthaiH kShudramatsyairyathA timiH
shlokas.33:
kShiprahastashcha balavAndRRiDhadhanvArimardanaH |
na yasya jIvitAkA~NkShI viShayaM prApya jIvati
shlokas.34:
yaM dvau na jahataH shabdau jIvamAnaM kadAchana |
brAhmashcha vedakAmAnAM jyAghoShashcha dhanurbhRRitAm
shlokas.35:
nAhaM mRRiShye hataM droNaM siMhadviradavikramam |
kathaM sa~njaya durdharShamanAdhRRiShyayashobalam
shlokas.36:
ke.arakShandakShiNaM chakraM savyaM ke cha mahAtmanaH |
purastAtke cha vIrasya yudhyamAnasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.37:
ke cha tatra tanuM tyaktvA pratIpaM mRRityumAvrajan |
droNasya samare vIrAH ke.akurvanta parAM dhRRitim
shlokas.38:
etadAryeNa kartavyaM kRRichChrAsvApatsu sa~njaya |
parAkramedyathAshaktyA tachcha tasminpratiShThitam
shlokas.39:
muhyate me manastAta kathA tAvannivartyatAm |
bhUyastu labdhasa~nj~nastvA pariprakShyAmi sa~njaya

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM pRRiShTvA sUtaputraM hRRichChokenArdito bhRRisham |
jaye nirAshaH putrANAM dhRRitarAShTro.apatatkShitau
shlokas.2:
taM visa~nj~naM nipatitaM siShichuH parichArakAH |
jalenAtyarthashItena vIjantaH puNyagandhinA
shlokas.3:
patitaM chainamAj~nAya samantAdbharatastriyaH |
parivavrurmahArAjamaspRRisha.nshchaiva pANibhiH
shlokas.4:
utthApya chainaM shanakai rAjAnaM pRRithivItalAt |
AsanaM prApayAmAsurbAShpakaNThyo varA~NganAH
shlokas.5:
AsanaM prApya rAjA tu mUrChayAbhipariplutaH |
nishcheShTo.atiShThata tadA vIjyamAnaH samantataH
shlokas.6:
sa labdhvA shanakaiH sa~nj~nAM vepamAno mahIpatiH |
punargAvalgaNiM sUtaM paryapRRichChadyathAtatham
shlokas.7:
yattadudyannivAdityo jyotiShA praNuda.nstamaH |
AyAdajAtashatrurvai kastaM droNAdavArayat
shlokas.8:
prabhinnamiva mAta~NgaM tathA kruddhaM tarasvinam |
AsaktamanasaM dIptaM pratidviradaghAtinam
vAshitAsa~Ngame yadvadajayyaM pratiyUthapaiH
shlokas.9:
ati chAnyAnraNe yodhAnvIraH puruShasattamaH |
yo hyeko hi mahAbAhurnirdahedghorachakShuShA
kRRitsnaM duryodhanabalaM dhRRitimAnsatyasa~NgaraH
shlokas.10:
chakShurhaNaM jaye saktamiShvAsavararakShitam |
dAntaM bahumataM loke ke shUrAH paryavArayan
shlokas.11:
ke duShpradharShaM rAjAnamiShvAsavaramachyutam |
samAsedurnaravyAghraM kaunteyaM tatra mAmakAH
shlokas.12:
tarasaivAbhipatyAtha yo vai droNamupAdravat |
taM bhImasenamAyAntaM ke shUrAH paryavArayan
shlokas.13:
yadAyAjjaladaprakhyo rathaH paramavIryavAn |
parjanya iva bIbhatsustumulAmashaniM sRRijan
shlokas.14:
vavarSha sharavarShANi varShANi maghavAniva |
iShusambAdhamAkAshaM kurvankapivaradhvajaH
avasphUrjandishaH sarvAstalanemisvanena cha
shlokas.15:
chApavidyutprabho ghoro rathagulmabalAhakaH |
rathanemighoShastanitaH sharashabdAtibandhuraH
shlokas.16:
roShanirjitajImUto mano.abhiprAyashIghragaH |
marmAtigo bANadhArastumulaH shoNitodakaH
shlokas.17:
samplAvayanmahIM sarvAM mAnavairAstara.nstadA |
gadAniShTanito raudro duryodhanakRRitodyamaH
shlokas.18:
yuddhe.abhyaShi~nchadvijayo gArdhrapatraiH shilAshitaiH |
gANDIvaM dhArayandhImAnkIdRRishaM vo manastadA
shlokas.19:
kachchidgANDIvashabdena na praNashyata vai balam |
yadvaH sa bhairavaM kurvannarjuno bhRRishamabhyagAt
shlokas.20:
kachchinnApAnudaddroNAdiShubhirvo dhana~njayaH |
vAto meghAnivAvidhyanpravA~nsharavanAnilaH
ko hi gANDIvadhanvAnaM naraH soDhuM raNe.arhati
shlokas.21:
yatsenAH samakampanta yadvIrAnaspRRishadbhayam |
ke tatra nAjahurdroNaM ke kShudrAH prAdravanbhayAt
shlokas.22:
ke vA tatra tanUstyaktvA pratIpaM mRRityumAvrajan |
amAnuShANAM jetAraM yuddheShvapi dhana~njayam
shlokas.23:
na cha vegaM sitAshvasya vishakShyantIha mAmakAH |
gANDIvasya cha nirghoShaM prAvRRiDjaladanisvanam
shlokas.24:
viShvakseno yasya yantA yoddhA chaiva dhana~njayaH |
ashakyaH sa ratho jetuM manye devAsurairapi
shlokas.25:
sukumAro yuvA shUro darshanIyashcha pANDavaH |
medhAvI nipuNo dhImAnyudhi satyaparAkramaH
shlokas.26:
ArAvaM vipulaM kurvanvyathayansarvakauravAn |
yadAyAnnakulo dhImAnke shUrAH paryavArayan
shlokas.27:
AshIviSha iva kruddhaH sahadevo yadAbhyayAt |
shatrUNAM kadanaM kurva~njetAsau durjayo yudhi
shlokas.28:
AryavratamamogheShuM hrImantamaparAjitam |
droNAyAbhimukhaM yAntaM ke shUrAH paryavArayan
shlokas.29:
yaH sa sauvIrarAjasya pramathya mahatIM chamUm |
Adatta mahiShIM bhojyAM kAmyAM sarvA~NgashobhanAm
shlokas.30:
satyaM dhRRitishcha shauryaM cha brahmacharyaM cha kevalam |
sarvANi yuyudhAne.asminnityAni puruSharShabhe
shlokas.31:
balinaM satyakarmANamadInamaparAjitam |
vAsudevasamaM yuddhe vAsudevAdanantaram
shlokas.32:
yuktaM dhana~njayapreShye shUramAchAryakarmaNi |
pArthena samamastreShu kastaM droNAdavArayat
shlokas.33:
vRRiShNInAM pravaraM vIraM shUraM sarvadhanuShmatAm |
rAmeNa samamastreShu yashasA vikrameNa cha
shlokas.34:
satyaM dhRRitirdamaH shauryaM brahmacharyamanuttamam |
sAtvate tAni sarvANi trailokyamiva keshave
shlokas.35:
tameva~NguNasampannaM durvAramapi daivataiH |
samAsAdya maheShvAsaM ke vIrAH paryavArayan
shlokas.36:
pA~nchAleShUttamaM shUramuttamAbhijanapriyam |
nityamuttamakarmANamuttamaujasamAhave
shlokas.37:
yuktaM dhana~njayahite mamAnarthAya chottamam |
yamavaishravaNAdityamahendravaruNopamam
shlokas.38:
mahArathasamAkhyAtaM droNAyodyantamAhave |
tyajantaM tumule prANAnke shUrAH paryavArayan
shlokas.39:
eko.apasRRitya chedibhyaH pANDavAnyaH samAshritaH |
dhRRiShTaketuM tamAyAntaM droNAtkaH samavArayat
shlokas.40:
yo.avadhItketumA~nshUro rAjaputraM sudarshanam |
aparAntagiridvAre kastaM droNAdavArayat
shlokas.41:
strIpUrvo yo naravyAghro yaH sa veda guNAguNAn |
shikhaNDinaM yAj~nasenimamlAnamanasaM yudhi
shlokas.42:
devavratasya samare hetuM mRRityormahAtmanaH |
droNAyAbhimukhaM yAntaM ke vIrAH paryavArayan
shlokas.43:
yasminnabhyadhikA vIre guNAH sarve dhana~njayAt |
yasminnastrANi satyaM cha brahmacharyaM cha nityadA
shlokas.44:
vAsudevasamaM vIrye dhana~njayasamaM bale |
tejasAdityasadRRishaM bRRihaspatisamaM matau
shlokas.45:
abhimanyuM mahAtmAnaM vyAttAnanamivAntakam |
droNAyAbhimukhaM yAntaM ke vIrAH paryavArayan
shlokas.46:
taruNastvaruNaprakhyaH saubhadraH paravIrahA |
yadAbhyAdravata droNaM tadAsIdvo manaH katham
shlokas.47:
draupadeyA naravyAghrAH samudramiva sindhavaH |
yaddroNamAdravansa~Nkhye ke vIrAstAnavArayan
shlokas.48:
ye te dvAdasha varShANi krIDAmutsRRijya bAlakAH |
astrArthamavasanbhIShme bibhrato vratamuttamam
shlokas.49:
kShatra~njayaH kShatradevaH kShatradharmA cha mAninaH |
dhRRiShTadyumnAtmajA vIrAH ke tAndroNAdavArayan
shlokas.50:
shatAdvishiShTaM yaM yuddhe samapashyanta vRRiShNayaH |
chekitAnaM maheShvAsaM kastaM droNAdavArayat
shlokas.51:
vArdhakShemiH kali~NgAnAM yaH kanyAmAharadyudhi |
anAdhRRiShTiradInAtmA kastaM droNAdavArayat
shlokas.52:
bhrAtaraH pa~ncha kaikeyA dhArmikAH satyavikramAH |
indragopakavarNAshcha raktavarmAyudhadhvajAH
shlokas.53:
mAtRRiShvasuH sutA vIrAH pANDavAnAM jayArthinaH |
tAndroNaM hantumAyAtAnke vIrAH paryavArayan
shlokas.54:
yaM yodhayanto rAjAno nAjayanvAraNAvate |
ShaNmAsAnabhisa.nrabdhA jighA.nsanto yudhAM patim
shlokas.55:
dhanuShmatAM varaM shUraM satyasandhaM mahAbalam |
droNAtkastaM naravyAghraM yuyutsuM pratyavArayat
shlokas.56:
yaH putraM kAshirAjasya vArANasyAM mahAratham |
samare strIShu gRRidhyantaM bhallenApaharadrathAt
shlokas.57:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM maheShvAsaM pArthAnAM mantradhAriNam |
yuktaM duryodhanAnarthe sRRiShTaM droNavadhAya cha
shlokas.58:
nirdahantaM raNe yodhAndArayantaM cha sarvashaH |
droNAyAbhimukhaM yAntaM ke vIrAH paryavArayan
shlokas.59:
utsa~Nga iva sa.nvRRiddhaM drupadasyAstravittamam |
shaikhaNDinaM kShatradevaM ke taM droNAdavArayan
shlokas.60:
ya imAM pRRithivIM kRRitsnAM charmavatsamaveShTayat |
mahatA rathava.nshena mukhyArighno mahArathaH
shlokas.61:
dashAshvamedhAnAjahre svannapAnAptadakShiNAn |
nirargalAnsarvamedhAnputravatpAlayanprajAH
shlokas.62:
pibantyo dakShiNAM yasya ga~NgAsrotaH samApiban |
tAvatIrgA dadau vIra ushInarasuto.adhvare
shlokas.63:
na pUrve nApare chakruridaM kechana mAnavAH |
iti sa~nchukrushurdevAH kRRite karmaNi duShkare
shlokas.64:
pashyAmastriShu lokeShu na taM sa.nsthAsnuchAriShu |
jAtaM vApi janiShyaM vA dvitIyaM vApi samprati
shlokas.65:
anyamaushInarAchChaibyAddhuro voDhAramityuta |
gatiM yasya na yAsyanti mAnuShA lokavAsinaH
shlokas.66:
tasya naptAramAyAntaM shaibyaM kaH samavArayat |
droNAyAbhimukhaM yAntaM vyAttAnanamivAntakam
shlokas.67:
virATasya rathAnIkaM matsyasyAmitraghAtinaH |
prepsantaM samare droNaM ke vIrAH paryavArayan
shlokas.68:
sadyo vRRikodarAjjAto mahAbalaparAkramaH |
mAyAvI rAkShaso ghoro yasmAnmama mahadbhayam
shlokas.69:
pArthAnAM jayakAmaM taM putrANAM mama kaNTakam |
ghaTotkachaM mahAbAhuM kastaM droNAdavArayat
shlokas.70:
ete chAnye cha bahavo yeShAmarthAya sa~njaya |
tyaktAraH sa.nyuge prANAnkiM teShAmajitaM yudhi
shlokas.71:
yeShAM cha puruShavyAghraH shAr~NgadhanvA vyapAshrayaH |
hitArthI chApi pArthAnAM kathaM teShAM parAjayaH
shlokas.72:
lokAnAM gururatyantaM lokanAthaH sanAtanaH |
nArAyaNo raNe nAtho divyo divyAtmavAnprabhuH
shlokas.73:
yasya divyAni karmANi pravadanti manIShiNaH |
tAnyahaM kIrtayiShyAmi bhaktyA sthairyArthamAtmanaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
shRRiNu divyAni karmANi vAsudevasya sa~njaya |
kRRitavAnyAni govindo yathA nAnyaH pumAnkvachit
shlokas.2:
sa.nvardhatA gopakule bAlenaiva mahAtmanA |
vikhyApitaM balaM bAhvostriShu lokeShu sa~njaya
shlokas.3:
uchchaiHshravastulyabalaM vAyuvegasamaM jave |
jaghAna hayarAjaM yo yamunAvanavAsinam
shlokas.4:
dAnavaM ghorakarmANaM gavAM mRRityumivotthitam |
vRRiSharUpadharaM bAlye bhujAbhyAM nijaghAna ha
shlokas.5:
pralambaM narakaM jambhaM pIThaM chApi mahAsuram |
muruM chAchalasa~NkAshamavadhItpuShkarekShaNaH
shlokas.6:
tathA ka.nso mahAtejA jarAsandhena pAlitaH |
vikrameNaiva kRRiShNena sagaNaH shAtito raNe
shlokas.7:
sunAmA nAma vikrAntaH samagrAkShauhiNIpatiH |
bhojarAjasya madhyastho bhrAtA ka.nsasya vIryavAn
shlokas.8:
baladevadvitIyena kRRiShNenAmitraghAtinA |
tarasvI samare dagdhaH sasainyaH shUrasenarAT
shlokas.9:
durvAsA nAma viprarShistathA paramakopanaH |
ArAdhitaH sadAreNa sa chAsmai pradadau varAn
shlokas.10:
tathA gAndhArarAjasya sutAM vIraH svaya.nvare |
nirjitya pRRithivIpAlAnavahatpuShkarekShaNaH
shlokas.11:
amRRiShyamANA rAjAno yasya jAtyA hayA iva |
rathe vaivAhike yuktAH pratodena kRRitavraNAH
shlokas.12:
jarAsandhaM mahAbAhumupAyena janArdanaH |
pareNa ghAtayAmAsa pRRithagakShauhiNIpatim
shlokas.13:
chedirAjaM cha vikrAntaM rAjasenApatiM balI |
arghe vivadamAnaM cha jaghAna pashuvattadA
shlokas.14:
saubhaM daityapuraM svasthaM shAlvaguptaM durAsadam |
samudrakukShau vikramya pAtayAmAsa mAdhavaH
shlokas.15:
a~NgAnva~NgAnkali~NgA.nshcha mAgadhAnkAshikosalAn |
vatsagargakarUShA.nshcha puNDrA.nshchApyajayadraNe
shlokas.16:
AvantyAndAkShiNAtyA.nshcha pArvatIyAndasherakAn |
kAshmIrakAnaurasakAnpishAchA.nshcha samandarAn
shlokas.17:
kAmbojAnvATadhAnA.nshcha cholAnpANDyA.nshcha sa~njaya |
trigartAnmAlavA.nshchaiva daradA.nshcha sudurjayAn
shlokas.18:
nAnAdigbhyashcha samprAptAnvrAtAnashvashakAnprati |
jitavAnpuNDarIkAkSho yavanA.nshcha sahAnugAn
shlokas.19:
pravishya makarAvAsaM yAdobhirabhisa.nvRRitam |
jigAya varuNaM yuddhe salilAntargataM purA
shlokas.20:
yudhi pa~nchajanaM hatvA pAtAlatalavAsinam |
pA~nchajanyaM hRRiShIkesho divyaM sha~NkhamavAptavAn
shlokas.21:
khANDave pArthasahitastoShayitvA hutAshanam |
AgneyamastraM durdharShaM chakraM lebhe mahAbalaH
shlokas.22:
vainateyaM samAruhya trAsayitvAmarAvatIm |
mahendrabhavanAdvIraH pArijAtamupAnayat
shlokas.23:
tachcha marShitavA~nshakro jAna.nstasya parAkramam |
rAj~nAM chApyajitaM ka~nchitkRRiShNeneha na shushruma
shlokas.24:
yachcha tanmahadAshcharyaM sabhAyAM mama sa~njaya |
kRRitavAnpuNDarIkAkShaH kastadanya ihArhati
shlokas.25:
yachcha bhaktyA prapanno.ahamadrAkShaM kRRiShNamIshvaram |
tanme suviditaM sarvaM pratyakShamiva chAgamat
shlokas.26:
nAnto vikramayuktasya buddhyA yuktasya vA punaH |
karmaNaH shakyate gantuM hRRiShIkeshasya sa~njaya
shlokas.27:
tathA gadashcha sAmbashcha pradyumno.atha vidUrathaH |
AgAvaho.aniruddhashcha chArudeShNashcha sAraNaH
shlokas.28:
ulmuko nishaThashchaiva jhallI babhrushcha vIryavAn |
pRRithushcha vipRRithushchaiva samIko.athArimejayaH
shlokas.29:
ete vai balavantashcha vRRiShNivIrAH prahAriNaH |
katha~nchitpANDavAnIkaM shrayeyuH samare sthitAH
shlokas.30:
AhUtA vRRiShNivIreNa keshavena mahAtmanA |
tataH sa.nshayitaM sarvaM bhavediti matirmama
shlokas.31:
nAgAyutabalo vIraH kailAsashikharopamaH |
vanamAlI halI rAmastatra yatra janArdanaH
shlokas.32:
yamAhuH sarvapitaraM vAsudevaM dvijAtayaH |
api vA hyeSha pANDUnAM yotsyate.arthAya sa~njaya
shlokas.33:
sa yadA tAta saMnahyetpANDavArthAya keshavaH |
na tadA pratyanIkeShu bhavitA tasya kashchana
shlokas.34:
yadi sma kuravaH sarve jayeyuH sarvapANDavAn |
vArShNeyo.arthAya teShAM vai gRRihNIyAchChastramuttamam
shlokas.35:
tataH sarvAnnaravyAghro hatvA narapatInraNe |
kauravA.nshcha mahAbAhuH kuntyai dadyAtsa medinIm
shlokas.36:
yasya yantA hRRiShIkesho yoddhA yasya dhana~njayaH |
rathasya tasya kaH sa~Nkhye pratyanIko bhavedrathaH
shlokas.37:
na kenachidupAyena kurUNAM dRRishyate jayaH |
tasmAnme sarvamAchakShva yathA yuddhamavartata
shlokas.38:
arjunaH keshavasyAtmA kRRiShNo.apyAtmA kirITinaH |
arjune vijayo nityaM kRRiShNe kIrtishcha shAshvatI
shlokas.39:
prAdhAnyena hi bhUyiShThamameyAH keshave guNAH |
mohAdduryodhanaH kRRiShNaM yanna vettIha mAdhavam
shlokas.40:
mohito daivayogena mRRityupAshapuraskRRitaH |
na veda kRRiShNaM dAshArhamarjunaM chaiva pANDavam
shlokas.41:
pUrvadevau mahAtmAnau naranArAyaNAvubhau |
ekAtmAnau dvidhAbhUtau dRRishyete mAnavairbhuvi
shlokas.42:
manasApi hi durdharShau senAmetAM yashasvinau |
nAshayetAmihechChantau mAnuShatvAttu nechChataH
shlokas.43:
yugasyeva viparyAso lokAnAmiva mohanam |
bhIShmasya cha vadhastAta droNasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.44:
na hyeva brahmacharyeNa na vedAdhyayanena cha |
na kriyAbhirna shastreNa mRRityoH kashchidvimuchyate
shlokas.45:
lokasambhAvitau vIrau kRRitAstrau yuddhadurmadau |
bhIShmadroNau hatau shrutvA kiM nu jIvAmi sa~njaya
shlokas.46:
yAM tAM shriyamasUyAmaH purA yAtAM yudhiShThire |
adya tAmanujAnImo bhIShmadroNavadhena cha
shlokas.47:
tathA cha matkRRite prAptaH kurUNAmeSha sa~NkShayaH |
pakvAnAM hi vadhe sUta vajrAyante tRRiNAnyapi
shlokas.48:
ananyamidamaishvaryaM loke prApto yudhiShThiraH |
yasya kopAnmaheShvAsau bhIShmadroNau nipAtitau
shlokas.49:
prAptaH prakRRitito dharmo nAdharmo mAnavAnprati |
krUraH sarvavinAshAya kAlaH samativartate
shlokas.50:
anyathA chintitA hyarthA naraistAta manasvibhiH |
anyathaiva hi gachChanti daivAditi matirmama
shlokas.51:
tasmAdaparihArye.arthe samprApte kRRichChra uttame |
apAraNIye dushchintye yathAbhUtaM prachakShva me

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
hanta te varNayiShyAmi sarvaM pratyakShadarshivAn |
yathA sa nyapataddroNaH sAditaH pANDusRRi~njayaiH
shlokas.2:
senApatitvaM samprApya bhAradvAjo mahArathaH |
madhye sarvasya sainyasya putraM te vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.3:
yatkauravANAmRRiShabhAdApageyAdanantaram |
senApatyena mAM rAjannadya satkRRitavAnasi
shlokas.4:
sadRRishaM karmaNastasya phalaM prApnuhi pArthiva |
karomi kAmaM kaM te.adya pravRRiNIShva yamichChasi
shlokas.5:
tato duryodhanashchintya karNaduHshAsanAdibhiH |
tamathovAcha durdharShamAchAryaM jayatAM varam
shlokas.6:
dadAsi chedvaraM mahyaM jIvagrAhaM yudhiShThiram |
gRRihItvA rathinAM shreShThaM matsamIpamihAnaya
shlokas.7:
tataH kurUNAmAchAryaH shrutvA putrasya te vachaH |
senAM praharShayansarvAmidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.8:
dhanyaH kuntIsuto rAjA yasya grahaNamichChasi |
na vadhArthaM sudurdharSha varamadya prayAchasi
shlokas.9:
kimarthaM cha naravyAghra na vadhaM tasya kA~NkShasi |
nAsha.nsasi kriyAmetAM matto duryodhana dhruvam
shlokas.10:
Aho sviddharmaputrasya dveShTA tasya na vidyate |
yadichChasi tvaM jIvantaM kulaM rakShasi chAtmani
shlokas.11:
atha vA bharatashreShTha nirjitya yudhi pANDavAn |
rAjyA.nshaM pratidattvA cha saubhrAtraM kartumichChasi
shlokas.12:
dhanyaH kuntIsuto rAjA sujAtA chAsya dhImataH |
ajAtashatrutA satyA tasya yatsnihyate bhavAn
shlokas.13:
droNena tvevamuktasya tava putrasya bhArata |
sahasA niHsRRito bhAvo yo.asya nityaM pravartate
shlokas.14:
nAkAro gUhituM shakyo bRRihaspatisamairapi |
tasmAttava suto rAjanprahRRiShTo vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.15:
vadhe kuntIsutasyAjau nAchArya vijayo mama |
hate yudhiShThire pArtho hanyAtsarvAnhi no dhruvam
shlokas.16:
na cha shakyo raNe sarvairnihantumamarairapi |
ya eva chaiShAM sheShaH syAtsa evAsmAnna sheShayet
shlokas.17:
satyapratij~ne tvAnIte punardyUtena nirjite |
punaryAsyantyaraNyAya kaunteyAstamanuvratAH
shlokas.18:
so.ayaM mama jayo vyaktaM dIrghakAlaM bhaviShyati |
ato na vadhamichChAmi dharmarAjasya karhichit
shlokas.19:
tasya jihmamabhiprAyaM j~nAtvA droNo.arthatattvavit |
taM varaM sAntaraM tasmai dadau sa~nchintya buddhimAn
shlokas.20:
droNa uvAcha||
na chedyudhiShThiraM vIra pAlayedarjuno yudhi |
manyasva pANDavaM jyeShThamAnItaM vashamAtmanaH
shlokas.21:
na hi pArtho raNe shakyaH sendrairdevAsurairapi |
pratyudyAtumatastAta naitadAmarShayAmyaham
shlokas.22:
asa.nshayaM sa shiShyo me matpUrvashchAstrakarmaNi |
taruNaH kIrtiyuktashcha ekAyanagatashcha saH
shlokas.23:
astrANIndrAchcha rudrAchcha bhUyA.nsi samavAptavAn |
amarShitashcha te rAja.nstena nAmarShayAmyaham
shlokas.24:
sa chApakramyatAM yuddhAdyenopAyena shakyate |
apanIte tataH pArthe dharmarAjo jitastvayA
shlokas.25:
grahaNaM chejjayaM tasya manyase puruSharShabha |
etena chAbhyupAyena dhruvaM grahaNameShyati
shlokas.26:
ahaM gRRihItvA rAjAnaM satyadharmaparAyaNam |
AnayiShyAmi te rAjanvashamadya na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.27:
yadi sthAsyati sa~NgrAme muhUrtamapi me.agrataH |
apanIte naravyAghre kuntIputre dhana~njaye
shlokas.28:
phalgunasya samakShaM tu na hi pArtho yudhiShThiraH |
grahItuM samare shakyaH sendrairapi surAsuraiH
shlokas.29:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sAntaraM tu pratij~nAte rAj~no droNena nigrahe |
gRRihItaM tamamanyanta tava putrAH subAlishAH
shlokas.30:
pANDaveShu hi sApekShaM droNaM jAnAti te sutaH |
tataH pratij~nAsthairyArthaM sa mantro bahulIkRRitaH
shlokas.31:
tato duryodhanenApi grahaNaM pANDavasya tat |
sainyasthAneShu sarveShu vyAghoShitamari.ndama

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataste sainikAH shrutvA taM yudhiShThiranigraham |
siMhanAdaravA.nshchakrurbANasha~NkharavaiH saha
shlokas.2:
tattu sarvaM yathAvRRittaM dharmarAjena bhArata |
AptairAshu parij~nAtaM bhAradvAjachikIrShitam
shlokas.3:
tataH sarvAnsamAnAyya bhrAtR^InsainyA.nshcha sarvashaH |
abravIddharmarAjastu dhana~njayamidaM vachaH
shlokas.4:
shrutaM te puruShavyAghra droNasyAdya chikIrShitam |
yathA tanna bhavetsatyaM tathA nItirvidhIyatAm
shlokas.5:
sAntaraM hi pratij~nAtaM droNenAmitrakarshana |
tachchAntaramamogheShau tvayi tena samAhitam
shlokas.6:
sa tvamadya mahAbAho yudhyasva madanantaram |
yathA duryodhanaH kAmaM nemaM droNAdavApnuyAt
shlokas.7:
arjuna uvAcha||
yathA me na vadhaH kArya AchAryasya katha~nchana |
tathA tava parityAgo na me rAja.nshchikIrShitaH
shlokas.8:
apyevaM pANDava prANAnutsRRijeyamahaM yudhi |
pratIyAM nAhamAchAryaM tvAM na jahyAM katha~nchana
shlokas.9:
tvAM nigRRihyAhave rAjandhArtarAShTro yamichChati |
na sa taM jIvaloke.asminkAmaM prAptaH katha~nchana
shlokas.10:
prapateddyauH sanakShatrA pRRithivI shakalIbhavet |
na tvAM droNo nigRRihNIyAjjIvamAne mayi dhruvam
shlokas.11:
yadi tasya raNe sAhyaM kurute vajrabhRRitsvayam |
devairvA sahito daityairna tvAM prApsyatyasau mRRidhe
shlokas.12:
mayi jIvati rAjendra na bhayaM kartumarhasi |
droNAdastrabhRRitAM shreShThAtsarvashastrabhRRitAmapi
shlokas.13:
na smarAmyanRRitAM vAchaM na smarAmi parAjayam |
na smarAmi pratishrutya ki~nchidapyanapAkRRitam
shlokas.14:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH sha~NkhAshcha bheryashcha mRRida~NgAshchAnakaiH saha |
prAvAdyanta mahArAja pANDavAnAM niveshane
shlokas.15:
siMhanAdashcha sa~njaj~ne pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
dhanurjyAtalashabdashcha gaganaspRRiksubhairavaH
shlokas.16:
taM shrutvA sha~NkhanirghoShaM pANDavasya mahAtmanaH |
tvadIyeShvapyanIkeShu vAditrANyabhijaghnire
shlokas.17:
tato vyUDhAnyanIkAni tava teShAM cha bhArata |
shanairupeyuranyonyaM yotsyamAnAni sa.nyuge
shlokas.18:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM tumulaM lomaharShaNam |
pANDavAnAM kurUNAM cha droNapA~nchAlyayorapi
shlokas.19:
yatamAnAH prayatnena droNAnIkavishAtane |
na shekuH sRRi~njayA rAja.nstaddhi droNena pAlitam
shlokas.20:
tathaiva tava putrasya rathodArAH prahAriNaH |
na shekuH pANDavIM senAM pAlyamAnAM kirITinA
shlokas.21:
AstAM te stimite sene rakShyamANe parasparam |
samprasupte yathA naktaM vanarAjyau supuShpite
shlokas.22:
tato rukmaratho rAjannarkeNeva virAjatA |
varUthinA viniShpatya vyacharatpRRitanAntare
shlokas.23:
tamudyataM rathenaikamAshukAriNamAhave |
anekamiva santrAsAnmenire pANDusRRi~njayAH
shlokas.24:
tena muktAH sharA ghorA vicheruH sarvatodisham |
trAsayanto mahArAja pANDaveyasya vAhinIm
shlokas.25:
madhyaM dinamanuprApto gabhastishatasa.nvRRitaH |
yathAdRRishyata gharmA.nshustathA droNo.apyadRRishyata
shlokas.26:
na chainaM pANDaveyAnAM kashchichChaknoti mAriSha |
vIkShituM samare kruddhaM mahendramiva dAnavAH
shlokas.27:
mohayitvA tataH sainyaM bhAradvAjaH pratApavAn |
dhRRiShTadyumnabalaM tUrNaM vyadhamannishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.28:
sa dishaH sarvato ruddhvA sa.nvRRitya khamajihmagaiH |
pArShato yatra tatraiva mamRRide pANDuvAhinIm

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH sa pANDavAnIke janaya.nstumulaM mahat |
vyacharatpANDavAndroNo dahankakShamivAnalaH
shlokas.2:
nirdahantamanIkAni sAkShAdagnimivotthitam |
dRRiShTvA rukmarathaM yuddhe samakampanta sRRi~njayAH
shlokas.3:
pratataM chAsyamAnasya dhanuSho.asyAshukAriNaH |
jyAghoShaH shrUyate.atyarthaM visphUrjitamivAshaneH
shlokas.4:
rathinaH sAdinashchaiva nAgAnashvAnpadAtinaH |
raudrA hastavatA muktAH pramathnanti sma sAyakAH
shlokas.5:
nAnadyamAnaH parjanyaH sAnilaH shuchisa~NkShaye |
ashmavarShamivAvarShatpareShAmAvahadbhayam
shlokas.6:
vyacharatsa tadA rAjansenAM vikShobhayanprabhuH |
vardhayAmAsa santrAsaM shAtravANAmamAnuSham
shlokas.7:
tasya vidyudivAbhreShu chApaM hemapariShkRRitam |
bhramadrathAmbude tasmindRRishyate sma punaH punaH
shlokas.8:
sa vIraH satyavAnprAj~no dharmanityaH sudAruNaH |
yugAntakAle yanteva raudrAM prAskandayannadIm
shlokas.9:
amarShavegaprabhavAM kravyAdagaNasa~NkulAm |
balaughaiH sarvataH pUrNAM vIravRRikShApahAriNIm
shlokas.10:
shoNitodAM rathAvartAM hastyashvakRRitarodhasam |
kavachoDupasa.nyuktAM mA.nsapa~NkasamAkulAm
shlokas.11:
medomajjAsthisikatAmuShNIShavaraphenilAm |
sa~NgrAmajaladApUrNAM prAsamatsyasamAkulAm
shlokas.12:
naranAgAshvasambhUtAM sharavegaughavAhinIm |
sharIradArushRRi~NgATAM bhujanAgasamAkulAm
shlokas.13:
uttamA~NgopalatalAM nistri.nshajhaShasevitAm |
rathanAgahradopetAM nAnAbharaNanIrajAm
shlokas.14:
mahArathashatAvartAM bhUmireNUrmimAlinIm |
mahAvIryavatAM sa~Nkhye sutarAM bhIrudustarAm
shlokas.15:
shUravyAlasamAkIrNAM prANivANijasevitAm |
ChinnachChatramahAha.nsAM mukuTANDajasa~NkulAm
shlokas.16:
chakrakUrmAM gadAnakrAM sharakShudrajhaShAkulAm |
baDagRRidhrasRRigAlAnAM ghorasa~NghairniShevitAm
shlokas.17:
nihatAnprANinaH sa~Nkhye droNena balinA sharaiH |
vahantIM pitRRilokAya shatasho rAjasattama
shlokas.18:
sharIrashatasambAdhAM keshashaivalashAdvalAm |
nadIM prAvartayadrAjanbhIrUNAM bhayavardhinIm
shlokas.19:
taM jayantamanIkAni tAni tAnyeva bhArata |
sarvato.abhyadravandroNaM yudhiShThirapurogamAH
shlokas.20:
tAnabhidravataH shUrA.nstAvakA dRRiDhakArmukAH |
sarvataH pratyagRRihNanta tadabhUllomaharShaNam
shlokas.21:
shatamAyastu shakuniH sahadevaM samAdravat |
saniyantRRidhvajarathaM vivyAdha nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.22:
tasya mAdrIsutaH ketuM dhanuH sUtaM hayAnapi |
nAtikruddhaH sharaishChittvA ShaShTyA vivyAdha mAtulam
shlokas.23:
saubalastu gadAM gRRihya prachaskanda rathottamAt |
sa tasya gadayA rAjanrathAtsUtamapAtayat
shlokas.24:
tatastau virathau rAjangadAhastau mahAbalau |
chikrIDatU raNe shUrau sashRRi~NgAviva parvatau
shlokas.25:
droNaH pA~nchAlarAjAnaM viddhvA dashabhirAshugaiH |
bahubhistena chAbhyastastaM vivyAdha shatAdhikaiH
shlokas.26:
vivi.nshatiM bhImaseno vi.nshatyA nishitaiH sharaiH |
viddhvA nAkampayadvIrastadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.27:
vivi.nshatistu sahasA vyashvaketusharAsanam |
bhImaM chakre mahArAja tataH sainyAnyapUjayan
shlokas.28:
sa tanna mamRRiShe vIraH shatrorvijayamAhave |
tato.asya gadayA dAntAnhayAnsarvAnapAtayat
shlokas.29:
shalyastu nakulaM vIraH svasrIyaM priyamAtmanaH |
vivyAdha prahasanbANairlADayankopayanniva
shlokas.30:
tasyAshvAnAtapatraM cha dhvajaM sUtamatho dhanuH |
nipAtya nakulaH sa~Nkhye sha~NkhaM dadhmau pratApavAn
shlokas.31:
dhRRiShTaketuH kRRipenAstA~nChittvA bahuvidhA~nsharAn |
kRRipaM vivyAdha saptatyA lakShma chAsyAharattribhiH
shlokas.32:
taM kRRipaH sharavarSheNa mahatA samavAkirat |
nivArya cha raNe vipro dhRRiShTaketumayodhayat
shlokas.33:
sAtyakiH kRRitavarmANaM nArAchena stanAntare |
viddhvA vivyAdha saptatyA punaranyaiH smayanniva
shlokas.34:
saptasaptatibhirbhojastaM viddhvA nishitaiH sharaiH |
nAkampayata shaineyaM shIghro vAyurivAchalam
shlokas.35:
senApatiH susharmANaM shIghraM marmasvatADayat |
sa chApi taM tomareNa jatrudeshe atADayat
shlokas.36:
vaikartanaM tu samare virATaH pratyavArayat |
saha matsyairmahAvIryaistadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.37:
tatpauruShamabhUttatra sUtaputrasya dAruNam |
yatsainyaM vArayAmAsa sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.38:
drupadastu svayaM rAjA bhagadattena sa~NgataH |
tayoryuddhaM mahArAja chitrarUpamivAbhavat
bhUtAnAM trAsajananaM chakrAte.astravishAradau
shlokas.39:
bhUrishravA raNe rAjanyAj~naseniM mahAratham |
mahatA sAyakaughena ChAdayAmAsa vIryavAn
shlokas.40:
shikhaNDI tu tataH kruddhaH saumadattiM vishAM pate |
navatyA sAyakAnAM tu kampayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.41:
rAkShasau bhImakarmANau haiDimbAlambusAvubhau |
chakrAte.atyadbhutaM yuddhaM parasparavadhaiShiNau
shlokas.42:
mAyAshatasRRijau dRRiptau mAyAbhiritaretaram |
antarhitau cheratustau bhRRishaM vismayakAriNau
shlokas.43:
chekitAno.anuvindena yuyudhe tvatibhairavam |
yathA devAsure yuddhe balashakrau mahAbalau
shlokas.44:
lakShmaNaH kShatradevena vimardamakarodbhRRisham |
yathA viShNuH purA rAjanhiraNyAkSheNa sa.nyuge
shlokas.45:
tataH prajavitAshvena vidhivatkalpitena cha |
rathenAbhyapatadrAjansaubhadraM pauravo nadan
shlokas.46:
tato.abhiyAya tvarito yuddhAkA~NkShI mahAbalaH |
tena chakre mahadyuddhamabhimanyurari.ndamaH
shlokas.47:
pauravastvatha saubhadraM sharavrAtairavAkirat |
tasyArjunirdhvajaM ChatraM dhanushchorvyAmapAtayat
shlokas.48:
saubhadraH pauravaM tvanyairviddhvA saptabhirAshugaiH |
pa~nchabhistasya vivyAdha hayAnsUtaM cha sAyakaiH
shlokas.49:
tataH saMharShayansenAM siMhavadvinadanmuhuH |
samAdattArjunistUrNaM pauravAntakaraM sharam
shlokas.50:
dvAbhyAM sharAbhyAM hArdikyashchakarta sasharaM dhanuH |
tadutsRRijya dhanushChinnaM saubhadraH paravIrahA
udbabarha sitaM khaDgamAdadAnaH sharAvaram
shlokas.51:
sa tenAnekatAreNa charmaNA kRRitahastavat |
bhrAntAsiracharanmArgAndarshayanvIryamAtmanaH
shlokas.52:
bhrAmitaM punarudbhrAntamAdhUtaM punaruchChritam |
charmanistri.nshayo rAjannirvisheShamadRRishyata
shlokas.53:
sa pauravarathasyeShAmAplutya sahasA nadan |
pauravaM rathamAsthAya keshapakShe parAmRRishat
shlokas.54:
jaghAnAsya padA sUtamasinApAtayaddhvajam |
vikShobhyAmbhonidhiM tArkShyastaM nAgamiva chAkShipat
shlokas.55:
tamAkalitakeshAntaM dadRRishuH sarvapArthivAH |
ukShANamiva siMhena pAtyamAnamachetanam
shlokas.56:
tamArjunivashaM prAptaM kRRiShyamANamanAthavat |
pauravaM patitaM dRRiShTvA nAmRRiShyata jayadrathaH
shlokas.57:
sa barhiNamahAvAjaM ki~NkiNIshatajAlavat |
charma chAdAya khaDgaM cha nadanparyapatadrathAt
shlokas.58:
tataH saindhavamAlokya kArShNirutsRRijya pauravam |
utpapAta rathAttUrNaM shyenavannipapAta cha
shlokas.59:
prAsapaTTishanistri.nshA~nshatrubhiH sampraveritAn |
chichChedAthAsinA kArShNishcharmaNA sa.nrurodha cha
shlokas.60:
sa darshayitvA sainyAnAM svabAhubalamAtmanaH |
tamudyamya mahAkhaDgaM charma chAtha punarbalI
shlokas.61:
vRRiddhakShatrasya dAyAdaM pituratyantavairiNam |
sasArAbhimukhaH shUraH shArdUla iva ku~njaram
shlokas.62:
tau parasparamAsAdya khaDgadantanakhAyudhau |
hRRiShTavatsamprajahrAte vyAghrakesariNAviva
shlokas.63:
sampAteShvabhipAteShu nipAteShvasicharmaNoH |
na tayorantaraM kashchiddadarsha narasiMhayoH
shlokas.64:
avakShepo.asinirhrAdaH shastrAntaranidarshanam |
bAhyAntaranipAtashcha nirvisheShamadRRishyata
shlokas.65:
bAhyamAbhyantaraM chaiva charantau mArgamuttamam |
dadRRishAte mahAtmAnau sapakShAviva parvatau
shlokas.66:
tato vikShipataH khaDgaM saubhadrasya yashasvinaH |
sharAvaraNapakShAnte prajahAra jayadrathaH
shlokas.67:
rukmapakShAntare saktastasmi.nshcharmaNi bhAsvare |
sindhurAjabaloddhUtaH so.abhajyata mahAnasiH
shlokas.68:
bhagnamAj~nAya nistri.nshamavaplutya padAni ShaT |
so.adRRishyata nimeSheNa svarathaM punarAsthitaH
shlokas.69:
taM kArShNiM samarAnmuktamAsthitaM rathamuttamam |
sahitAH sarvarAjAnaH parivavruH samantataH
shlokas.70:
tatashcharma cha khaDgaM cha samutkShipya mahAbalaH |
nanAdArjunadAyAdaH prekShamANo jayadratham
shlokas.71:
sindhurAjaM parityajya saubhadraH paravIrahA |
tApayAmAsa tatsainyaM bhuvanaM bhAskaro yathA
shlokas.72:
tasya sarvAyasIM shaktiM shalyaH kanakabhUShaNAm |
chikShepa samare ghorAM dIptAmagnishikhAmiva
shlokas.73:
tAmavaplutya jagrAha sakoshaM chAkarodasim |
vainateyo yathA kArShNiH patantamuragottamam
shlokas.74:
tasya lAghavamAj~nAya sattvaM chAmitatejasaH |
sahitAH sarvarAjAnaH siMhanAdamathAnadan
shlokas.75:
tatastAmeva shalyasya saubhadraH paravIrahA |
mumocha bhujavIryeNa vaiDUryavikRRitAjirAm
shlokas.76:
sA tasya rathamAsAdya nirmuktabhujagopamA |
jaghAna sUtaM shalyasya rathAchchainamapAtayat
shlokas.77:
tato virATadrupadau dhRRiShTaketuryudhiShThiraH |
sAtyakiH kekayA bhImo dhRRiShTadyumnashikhaNDinau
yamau cha draupadeyAshcha sAdhu sAdhviti chukrushuH
shlokas.78:
bANashabdAshcha vividhAH siMhanAdAshcha puShkalAH |
prAdurAsanharShayantaH saubhadramapalAyinam
tannAmRRiShyanta putrAste shatrorvijayalakShaNam
shlokas.79:
athainaM sahasA sarve samantAnnishitaiH sharaiH |
abhyAkiranmahArAja jaladA iva parvatam
shlokas.80:
teShAM cha priyamanvichChansUtasya cha parAbhavAt |
ArtAyaniramitraghnaH kruddhaH saubhadramabhyayAt

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
bahUni suvichitrANi dva.ndvayuddhAni sa~njaya |
tvayoktAni nishamyAhaM spRRihayAmi sachakShuShAm
shlokas.2:
AshcharyabhUtaM lokeShu kathayiShyanti mAnavAH |
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha yuddhaM devAsuropamam
shlokas.3:
na hi me tRRiptirastIha shRRiNvato yuddhamuttamam |
tasmAdArtAyaneryuddhaM saubhadrasya cha sha.nsa me
shlokas.4:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sAditaM prekShya yantAraM shalyaH sarvAyaShIM gadAm |
samutkShipya nadankruddhaH prachaskanda rathottamAt
shlokas.5:
taM dIptamiva kAlAgniM daNDahastamivAntakam |
javenAbhyapatadbhImaH pragRRihya mahatIM gadAm
shlokas.6:
saubhadro.apyashaniprakhyAM pragRRihya mahatIM gadAm |
ehyehItyabravIchChalyaM yatnAdbhImena vAritaH
shlokas.7:
vArayitvA tu saubhadraM bhImasenaH pratApavAn |
shalyamAsAdya samare tasthau giririvAchalaH
shlokas.8:
tathaiva madrarAjo.api bhImaM dRRiShTvA mahAbalam |
sasArAbhimukhastUrNaM shArdUla iva ku~njaram
shlokas.9:
tatastUryaninAdAshcha sha~NkhAnAM cha sahasrashaH |
siMhanAdAshcha sa~njaj~nurbherINAM cha mahAsvanAH
shlokas.10:
pashyatAM shatasho hyAsIdanyonyasamachetasAm |
pANDavAnAM kurUNAM cha sAdhu sAdhviti nisvanaH
shlokas.11:
na hi madrAdhipAdanyaH sarvarAjasu bhArata |
soDhumutsahate vegaM bhImasenasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.12:
tathA madrAdhipasyApi gadAvegaM mahAtmanaH |
soDhumutsahate loke ko.anyo yudhi vRRikodarAt
shlokas.13:
paTTairjAmbUnadairbaddhA babhUva janaharShiNI |
prajajvAla tathAviddhA bhImena mahatI gadA
shlokas.14:
tathaiva charato mArgAnmaNDalAni cha bhAgashaH |
mahAvidyutpratIkAshA shalyasya shushubhe gadA
shlokas.15:
tau vRRiShAviva nardantau maNDalAni vicheratuH |
AvarjitagadAshRRi~NgAvubhau shalyavRRikodarau
shlokas.16:
maNDalAvartamArgeShu gadAviharaNeShu cha |
nirvisheShamabhUdyuddhaM tayoH puruShasiMhayoH
shlokas.17:
tADitA bhImasenena shalyasya mahatI gadA |
sAgnijvAlA mahAraudrA gadAchUrNamashIryata
shlokas.18:
tathaiva bhImasenasya dviShatAbhihatA gadA |
varShApradoShe khadyotairvRRito vRRikSha ivAbabhau
shlokas.19:
gadA kShiptA tu samare madrarAjena bhArata |
vyoma sa.ndIpayAnA sA sasRRije pAvakaM bahu
shlokas.20:
tathaiva bhImasenena dviShate preShitA gadA |
tApayAmAsa tatsainyaM maholkA patatI yathA
shlokas.21:
te chaivobhe gade shreShThe samAsAdya parasparam |
shvasantyau nAgakanyeva sasRRijAte vibhAvasum
shlokas.22:
nakhairiva mahAvyAghrau dantairiva mahAgajau |
tau vicheraturAsAdya gadAbhyAM cha parasparam
shlokas.23:
tato gadAgrAbhihatau kShaNena rudhirokShitau |
dadRRishAte mahAtmAnau puShpitAviva ki.nshukau
shlokas.24:
shushruve dikShu sarvAsu tayoH puruShasiMhayoH |
gadAbhighAtasaMhrAdaH shakrAshanirivopamaH
shlokas.25:
gadayA madrarAjena savyadakShiNamAhataH |
nAkampata tadA bhImo bhidyamAna ivAchalaH
shlokas.26:
tathA bhImagadAvegaistADyamAno mahAbalaH |
dhairyAnmadrAdhipastasthau vajrairgiririvAhataH
shlokas.27:
ApetaturmahAvegau samuchChritamahAgadau |
punarantaramArgasthau maNDalAni vicheratuH
shlokas.28:
athAplutya padAnyaShTau saMnipatya gajAviva |
sahasA lohadaNDAbhyAmanyonyamabhijaghnatuH
shlokas.29:
tau parasparavegAchcha gadAbhyAM cha bhRRishAhatau |
yugapatpetaturvIrau kShitAvindradhvajAviva
shlokas.30:
tato vihvalamAnaM taM niHshvasantaM punaH punaH |
shalyamabhyapatattUrNaM kRRitavarmA mahArathaH
shlokas.31:
dRRiShTvA chainaM mahArAja gadayAbhinipIDitam |
vicheShTantaM yathA nAgaM mUrChayAbhipariplutam
shlokas.32:
tataH sagadamAropya madrANAmadhipaM ratham |
apovAha raNAttUrNaM kRRitavarmA mahArathaH
shlokas.33:
kShIbavadvihvalo vIro nimeShAtpunarutthitaH |
bhImo.api sumahAbAhurgadApANiradRRishyata
shlokas.34:
tato madrAdhipaM dRRiShTvA tava putrAH parA~Nmukham |
sanAgarathapattyashvAH samakampanta mAriSha
shlokas.35:
te pANDavairardyamAnAstAvakA jitakAshibhiH |
bhItA disho.anvapadyanta vAtanunnA ghanA iva
shlokas.36:
nirjitya dhArtarAShTrA.nstu pANDaveyA mahArathAH |
vyarochanta raNe rAjandIpyamAnA yashasvinaH
shlokas.37:
siMhanAdAnbhRRishaM chakruH sha~NkhAndadhmushcha harShitAH |
bherIshcha vAdayAmAsurmRRida~NgA.nshchAnakaiH saha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tadbalaM sumahaddIrNaM tvadIyaM prekShya vIryavAn |
dadhAraiko raNe pANDUnvRRiShaseno.astramAyayA
shlokas.2:
sharA dasha disho muktA vRRiShasenena mAriSha |
vicheruste vinirbhidya naravAjirathadvipAn
shlokas.3:
tasya dIptA mahAbANA vinishcheruH sahasrashaH |
bhAnoriva mahAbAho grIShmakAle marIchayaH
shlokas.4:
tenArditA mahArAja rathinaH sAdinastathA |
nipetururvyAM sahasA vAtanunnA iva drumAH
shlokas.5:
hayaughA.nshcha rathaughA.nshcha gajaughA.nshcha samantataH |
apAtayadraNe rAja~nshatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.6:
dRRiShTvA tamevaM samare vicharantamabhItavat |
sahitAH sarvarAjAnaH parivavruH samantataH
shlokas.7:
nAkulistu shatAnIko vRRiShasenaM samabhyayAt |
vivyAdha chainaM dashabhirnArAchairmarmabhedibhiH
shlokas.8:
tasya karNAtmajashchApaM ChittvA ketumapAtayat |
taM bhrAtaraM parIpsanto draupadeyAH samabhyayuH
shlokas.9:
karNAtmajaM sharavrAtaishchakrushchAdRRishyama~njasA |
tAnnadanto.abhyadhAvanta droNaputramukhA rathAH
shlokas.10:
ChAdayanto mahArAja draupadeyAnmahArathAn |
sharairnAnAvidhaistUrNaM parvatA~njaladA iva
shlokas.11:
tAnpANDavAH pratyagRRihNa.nstvaritAH putragRRiddhinaH |
pA~nchAlAH kekayA matsyAH sRRi~njayAshchodyatAyudhAH
shlokas.12:
tadyuddhamabhavadghoraM tumulaM lomaharShaNam |
tvadIyaiH pANDuputrANAM devAnAmiva dAnavaiH
shlokas.13:
evamuttamasa.nrambhA yuyudhuH kurupANDavAH |
parasparamudIkShantaH parasparakRRitAgasaH
shlokas.14:
teShAM dadRRishire kopAdvapUMShyamitatejasAm |
yuyutsUnAmivAkAshe patatrivarabhoginAm
shlokas.15:
bhImakarNakRRipadroNadrauNipArShatasAtyakaiH |
babhAse sa raNoddeshaH kAlasUryairivoditaiH
shlokas.16:
tadAsIttumulaM yuddhaM nighnatAmitaretaram |
mahAbalAnAM balibhirdAnavAnAM yathA suraiH
shlokas.17:
tato yudhiShThirAnIkamuddhUtArNavanisvanam |
tvadIyamavadhItsainyaM sampradrutamahAratham
shlokas.18:
tatprabhagnaM balaM dRRiShTvA shatrubhirbhRRishamarditam |
alaM drutena vaH shUrA iti droNo.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.19:
tataH shoNahayaH kruddhashchaturdanta iva dvipaH |
pravishya pANDavAnIkaM yudhiShThiramupAdravat
shlokas.20:
tamavidhyachChitairbANaiH ka~NkapatrairyudhiShThiraH |
tasya droNo dhanushChittvA taM drutaM samupAdravat
shlokas.21:
chakrarakShaH kumArastu pA~nchAlAnAM yashaskaraH |
dadhAra droNamAyAntaM veleva saritAM patim
shlokas.22:
droNaM nivAritaM dRRiShTvA kumAreNa dvijarShabham |
siMhanAdaravo hyAsItsAdhu sAdhviti bhAShatAm
shlokas.23:
kumArastu tato droNaM sAyakena mahAhave |
vivyAdhorasi sa~NkruddhaH siMhavachchAnadanmuhuH
shlokas.24:
sa.nvArya tu raNe droNaH kumAraM vai mahAbalaH |
sharairanekasAhasraiH kRRitahasto jitaklamaH
shlokas.25:
taM shUramAryavratinamastrArthakRRitanishramam |
chakrarakShamapAmRRidnAtkumAraM dvijasattamaH
shlokas.26:
sa madhyaM prApya senAyAH sarvAH paricharandishaH |
tava sainyasya goptAsIdbhAradvAjo ratharShabhaH
shlokas.27:
shikhaNDinaM dvAdashabhirvi.nshatyA chottamaujasam |
nakulaM pa~nchabhirviddhvA sahadevaM cha saptabhiH
shlokas.28:
yudhiShThiraM dvAdashabhirdraupadeyA.nstribhistribhiH |
sAtyakiM pa~nchabhirviddhvA matsyaM cha dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.29:
vyakShobhayadraNe yodhAnyathAmukhyAnabhidravan |
abhyavartata samprepsuH kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.30:
yugandharastato rAjanbhAradvAjaM mahAratham |
vArayAmAsa sa~NkruddhaM vAtoddhUtamivArNavam
shlokas.31:
yudhiShThiraM sa viddhvA tu sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
yugandharaM cha bhallena rathanIDAdapAharat
shlokas.32:
tato virATadrupadau kekayAH sAtyakiH shibiH |
vyAghradattashcha pA~nchAlyaH siMhasenashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.33:
ete chAnye cha bahavaH parIpsanto yudhiShThiram |
Avavrustasya panthAnaM kirantaH sAyakAnbahUn
shlokas.34:
vyAghradattashcha pA~nchAlyo droNaM vivyAdha mArgaNaiH |
pa~nchAshadbhiH shitai rAja.nstata uchchukrushurjanAH
shlokas.35:
tvaritaM siMhasenastu droNaM viddhvA mahAratham |
prAhasatsahasA hRRiShTastrAsayanvai yatavratam
shlokas.36:
tato visphArya nayane dhanurjyAmavamRRijya cha |
talashabdaM mahatkRRitvA droNastaM samupAdravat
shlokas.37:
tatastu siMhasenasya shiraH kAyAtsakuNDalam |
vyAghradattasya chAkramya bhallAbhyAmaharadbalI
shlokas.38:
tAnpramRRidya sharavrAtaiH pANDavAnAM mahArathAn |
yudhiShThirasamabhyAshe tasthau mRRityurivAntakaH
shlokas.39:
tato.abhavanmahAshabdo rAjanyaudhiShThire bale |
hRRito rAjeti yodhAnAM samIpasthe yatavrate
shlokas.40:
abruvansainikAstatra dRRiShTvA droNasya vikramam |
adya rAjA dhArtarAShTraH kRRitArtho vai bhaviShyati
AgamiShyati no nUnaM dhArtarAShTrasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.41:
evaM sa~njalpatAM teShAM tAvakAnAM mahArathaH |
AyAjjavena kaunteyo rathaghoSheNa nAdayan
shlokas.42:
shoNitodAM rathAvartAM kRRitvA vishasane nadIm |
shUrAsthichayasa~NkIrNAM pretakUlApahAriNIm
shlokas.43:
tAM sharaughamahAphenAM prAsamatsyasamAkulAm |
nadImuttIrya vegena kurUnvidrAvya pANDavaH
shlokas.44:
tataH kirITI sahasA droNAnIkamupAdravat |
ChAdayanniShujAlena mahatA mohayanniva
shlokas.45:
shIghramabhyasyato bANAnsa.ndadhAnasya chAnisham |
nAntaraM dadRRishe kashchitkaunteyasya yashasvinaH
shlokas.46:
na disho nAntarikShaM cha na dyaurnaiva cha medinI |
adRRishyata mahArAja bANabhUtamivAbhavat
shlokas.47:
nAdRRishyata tadA rAja.nstatra ki~nchana sa.nyuge |
bANAndhakAre mahati kRRite gANDIvadhanvanA
shlokas.48:
sUrye chAstamanuprApte rajasA chAbhisa.nvRRite |
nAj~nAyata tadA shatrurna suhRRinna cha ki~nchana
shlokas.49:
tato.avahAraM chakruste droNaduryodhanAdayaH |
tAnviditvA bhRRishaM trastAnayuddhamanasaH parAn
shlokas.50:
svAnyanIkAni bIbhatsuH shanakairavahArayat |
tato.abhituShTuvuH pArthaM prahRRiShTAH pANDusRRi~njayAH
pA~nchAlAshcha manoj~nAbhirvAgbhiH sUryamivarShayaH
shlokas.51:
evaM svashibiraM prAyAjjitvA shatrUndhana~njayaH |
pRRiShThataH sarvasainyAnAM mudito vai sakeshavaH
shlokas.52:
masAragalvarkasuvarNarUpyai;rvajrapravAlasphaTikaishcha mukhyaiH |
chitre rathe pANDusuto babhAse; nakShatrachitre viyatIva chandraH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
te sene shibiraM gatvA nyavishetAM vishAM pate |
yathAbhAgaM yathAnyAyaM yathAgulmaM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.2:
kRRitvAvahAraM sainyAnAM droNaH paramadurmanAH |
duryodhanamabhiprekShya savrIDamidamabravIt
shlokas.3:
uktametanmayA pUrvaM na tiShThati dhana~njaye |
shakyo grahItuM sa~NgrAme devairapi yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.4:
iti tadvaH prayatatAM kRRitaM pArthena sa.nyuge |
mAtisha~NkIrvacho mahyamajeyau kRRiShNapANDavau
shlokas.5:
apanIte tu yogena kenachichChvetavAhane |
tata eShyati te rAjanvashamadya yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.6:
kashchidAhvayatAM sa~Nkhye deshamanyaM prakarShatu |
tamajitvA tu kaunteyo na nivartetkatha~nchana
shlokas.7:
etasminnantare shUnye dharmarAjamahaM nRRipa |
grahIShyAmi chamUM bhittvA dhRRiShTadyumnasya pashyataH
shlokas.8:
arjunena vihInastu yadi notsRRijate raNam |
mAmupAyAntamAlokya gRRihItamiti viddhi tam
shlokas.9:
evaM te sahasA rAjandharmaputraM yudhiShThiram |
samAneShyAmi sagaNaM vashamadya na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.10:
yadi tiShThati sa~NgrAme muhUrtamapi pANDavaH |
athApayAti sa~NgrAmAdvijayAttadvishiShyate
shlokas.11:
droNasya tu vachaH shrutvA trigartAdhipatistataH |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahito rAjannidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.12:
vayaM vinikRRitA rAjansadA gANDIvadhanvanA |
anAgaHsvapi chAgaskRRidasmAsu bharatarShabha
shlokas.13:
te vayaM smaramANAstAnvinikArAnpRRithagvidhAn |
krodhAgninA dahyamAnA na shemahi sadA nishAH
shlokas.14:
sa no divyAstrasampannashchakShurviShayamAgataH |
kartAraH sma vayaM sarvaM yachchikIrShAma hRRidgatam
shlokas.15:
bhavatashcha priyaM yatsyAdasmAkaM cha yashaskaram |
vayamenaM haniShyAmo nikRRiShyAyodhanAdbahiH
shlokas.16:
adyAstvanarjunA bhUmiratrigartAtha vA punaH |
satyaM te pratijAnImo naitanmithyA bhaviShyati
shlokas.17:
evaM satyarathashchoktvA satyadharmA cha bhArata |
satyavarmA cha satyeShuH satyakarmA tathaiva cha
shlokas.18:
sahitA bhrAtaraH pa~ncha rathAnAmayutena cha |
nyavartanta mahArAja kRRitvA shapathamAhave
shlokas.19:
mAlavAstuNDikerAshcha rathAnAmayutaistribhiH |
susharmA cha naravyAghrastrigartaH prasthalAdhipaH
shlokas.20:
mAchellakairlalitthaishcha sahito madrakairapi |
rathAnAmayutenaiva so.ashapadbhrAtRRibhiH saha
shlokas.21:
nAnAjanapadebhyashcha rathAnAmayutaM punaH |
samutthitaM vishiShTAnAM sa.nshapArthamupAgatam
shlokas.22:
tato jvalanamAdAya hutvA sarve pRRithakpRRithak |
jagRRihuH kushachIrANi chitrANi kavachAni cha
shlokas.23:
te cha baddhatanutrANA ghRRitAktAH kushachIriNaH |
maurvImekhalino vIrAH sahasrashatadakShiNAH
shlokas.24:
yajvAnaH putriNo lokyAH kRRitakRRityAstanutyajaH |
yokShyamANAstadAtmAnaM yashasA vijayena cha
shlokas.25:
brahmacharyashrutimukhaiH kratubhishchAptadakShiNaiH |
prApya lokAnsuyuddhena kShiprameva yiyAsavaH
shlokas.26:
brAhmaNA.nstarpayitvA cha niShkAndattvA pRRithakpRRithak |
gAshcha vAsA.nsi cha punaH samAbhAShya parasparam
shlokas.27:
prajvAlya kRRiShNavartmAnamupAgamya raNe vratam |
tasminnagnau tadA chakruH pratij~nAM dRRiDhanishchayAH
shlokas.28:
shRRiNvatAM sarvabhUtAnAmuchchairvAchaH sma menire |
dhRRitvA dhana~njayavadhe pratij~nAM chApi chakrire
shlokas.29:
ye vai lokAshchAnRRitAnAM ye chaiva brahmaghAtinAm |
pAnapasya cha ye lokA gurudAraratasya cha
shlokas.30:
brahmasvahAriNashchaiva rAjapiNDApahAriNaH |
sharaNAgataM cha tyajato yAchamAnaM tathA ghnataH
shlokas.31:
agAradAhinAM ye cha ye cha gAM nighnatAmapi |
apachAriNAM cha ye lokA ye cha brahmadviShAmapi
shlokas.32:
jAyAM cha RRitukAle vai ye mohAdabhigachChatAm |
shrAddhasa~NgatikAnAM cha ye chApyAtmApahAriNAm
shlokas.33:
nyAsApahAriNAM ye cha shrutaM nAshayatAM cha ye |
kopena yudhyamAnAnAM ye cha nIchAnusAriNAm
shlokas.34:
nAstikAnAM cha ye lokA ye.agnihorApitRRityajAm |
tAnApnuyAmahe lokAnye cha pApakRRitAmapi
shlokas.35:
yadyahatvA vayaM yuddhe nivartema dhana~njayam |
tena chAbhyarditAstrAsAdbhavema hi parA~NmukhAH
shlokas.36:
yadi tvasukaraM loke karma kuryAma sa.nyuge |
iShTAnpuNyakRRitAM lokAnprApnuyAma na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.37:
evamuktvA tato rAja.nste.abhyavartanta sa.nyuge |
Ahvayanto.arjunaM vIrAH pitRRijuShTAM dishaM prati
shlokas.38:
AhUtastairnaravyAghraiH pArthaH parapura~njayaH |
dharmarAjamidaM vAkyamapadAntaramabravIt
shlokas.39:
AhUto na nivarteyamiti me vratamAhitam |
sa.nshaptakAshcha mAM rAjannAhvayanti punaH punaH
shlokas.40:
eSha cha bhrAtRRibhiH sArdhaM susharmAhvayate raNe |
vadhAya sagaNasyAsya mAmanuj~nAtumarhasi
shlokas.41:
naitachChaknomi sa.nsoDhumAhvAnaM puruSharShabha |
satyaM te pratijAnAmi hatAnviddhi parAnyudhi
shlokas.42:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
shrutametattvayA tAta yaddroNasya chikIrShitam |
yathA tadanRRitaM tasya bhavettadvatsamAchara
shlokas.43:
droNo hi balavA~nshUraH kRRitAstrashcha jitashramaH |
pratij~nAtaM cha tenaitadgrahaNaM me mahAratha
shlokas.44:
arjuna uvAcha||
ayaM vai satyajidrAjannadya te rakShitA yudhi |
dhriyamANe hi pA~nchAlye nAchAryaH kAmamApsyati
shlokas.45:
hate tu puruShavyAghre raNe satyajiti prabho |
sarvairapi sametairvA na sthAtavyaM katha~nchana
shlokas.46:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
anuj~nAtastato rAj~nA pariShvaktashcha phalgunaH |
premNA dRRiShTashcha bahudhA AshiShA cha prayojitaH
shlokas.47:
vihAyainaM tataH pArthastrigartAnpratyayAdbalI |
kShudhitaH kShudvighAtArthaM siMho mRRigagaNAniva
shlokas.48:
tato dauryodhanaM sainyaM mudA paramayA yutam |
gate.arjune bhRRishaM kruddhaM dharmarAjasya nigrahe
shlokas.49:
tato.anyonyena te sene samAjagmaturojasA |
ga~NgAsarayvorvegena prAvRRiShIvolbaNodake

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH sa.nshaptakA rAjansame deshe vyavasthitAH |
vyUhyAnIkaM rathaireva chandrArdhAkhyaM mudAnvitAH
shlokas.2:
te kirITinamAyAntaM dRRiShTvA harSheNa mAriSha |
udakroshannaravyAghrAH shabdena mahatA tadA
shlokas.3:
sa shabdaH pradishaH sarvA dishaH khaM cha samAvRRiNot |
AvRRitatvAchcha lokasya nAsIttatra pratisvanaH
shlokas.4:
atIva samprahRRiShTA.nstAnupalabhya dhana~njayaH |
ki~nchidabhyutsmayankRRiShNamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.5:
pashyaitAndevakImAtarmumUrShUnadya sa.nyuge |
bhrAtR^I.nstraigartakAnevaM roditavye praharShitAn
shlokas.6:
atha vA harShakAlo.ayaM traigartAnAmasa.nshayam |
kunarairduravApAnhi lokAnprApsyantyanuttamAn
shlokas.7:
evamuktvA mahAbAhurhRRiShIkeshaM tato.arjunaH |
AsasAda raNe vyUDhAM traigartAnAmanIkinIm
shlokas.8:
sa devadattamAdAya sha~NkhaM hemapariShkRRitam |
dadhmau vegena mahatA phalgunaH pUrayandishaH
shlokas.9:
tena shabdena vitrastA sa.nshaptakavarUthinI |
nishcheShTAvasthitA sa~Nkye ashmasAramayI yathA
shlokas.10:
vAhAsteShAM vivRRittAkShAH stabdhakarNashirodharAH |
viShTabdhacharaNA mUtraM rudhiraM cha prasusruvuH
shlokas.11:
upalabhya cha te sa~nj~nAmavasthApya cha vAhinIm |
yugapatpANDuputrAya chikShipuH ka~NkapatriNaH
shlokas.12:
tAnyarjunaH sahasrANi dasha pa~nchaiva chAshugaiH |
anAgatAnyeva sharaishchichChedAshuparAkramaH
shlokas.13:
tato.arjunaM shitairbANairdashabhirdashabhiH punaH |
pratyavidhya.nstataH pArthastAnavidhyattribhistribhiH
shlokas.14:
ekaikastu tataH pArthaM rAjanvivyAdha pa~nchabhiH |
sa cha tAnprativivyAdha dvAbhyAM dvAbhyAM parAkramI
shlokas.15:
bhUya eva tu sa.nrabdhAste.arjunaM sahakeshavam |
ApUraya~nsharaistIkShNaistaTAkamiva vRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.16:
tataH sharasahasrANi prApatannarjunaM prati |
bhramarANAmiva vrAtAH phulladrumagaNe vane
shlokas.17:
tataH subAhustri.nshadbhiradrisAramayairdRRiDhaiH |
avidhyadiShubhirgADhaM kirITe savyasAchinam
shlokas.18:
taiH kirITI kirITasthairhemapu~NkhairajihmagaiH |
shAtakumbhamayApIDo babhau yUpa ivochChritaH
shlokas.19:
hastAvApaM subAhostu bhallena yudhi pANDavaH |
chichCheda taM chaiva punaH sharavarShairavAkirat
shlokas.20:
tataH susharmA dashabhiH surathashcha kirITinam |
sudharmA sudhanushchaiva subAhushcha samarpayan
shlokas.21:
tA.nstu sarvAnpRRithagbANairvAnarapravaradhvajaH |
pratyavidhyaddhvajA.nshchaiShAM bhallaishchichCheda kA~nchanAn
shlokas.22:
sudhanvano dhanushChittvA hayAnvai nyavadhIchCharaiH |
athAsya sashirastrANaM shiraH kAyAdapAharat
shlokas.23:
tasmi.nstu patite vIre trastAstasya padAnugAH |
vyadravanta bhayAdbhItA yena dauryodhanaM balam
shlokas.24:
tato jaghAna sa~Nkruddho vAsavistAM mahAchamUm |
sharajAlairavichChinnaistamaH sUrya ivA.nshubhiH
shlokas.25:
tato bhagne bale tasminviprayAte samantataH |
savyasAchini sa~Nkruddhe traigartAnbhayamAvishat
shlokas.26:
te vadhyamAnAH pArthena sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
amuhya.nstatra tatraiva trastA mRRigagaNA iva
shlokas.27:
tatastrigartarATkruddhastAnuvAcha mahArathAn |
alaM drutena vaH shUrA na bhayaM kartumarhatha
shlokas.28:
shaptvA tu shapathAnghorAnsarvasainyasya pashyataH |
gatvA dauryodhanaM sainyaM kiM vai vakShyatha mukhyagAH
shlokas.29:
