nAvahAsyAH kathaM loke karmaNAnena sa.nyuge |
bhavema sahitAH sarve nivartadhvaM yathAbalam
shlokas.30:
evamuktAstu te rAjannudakroshanmuhurmuhuH |
sha~NkhA.nshcha dadhmire vIrA harShayantaH parasparam
shlokas.31:
tataste saMnyavartanta sa.nshaptakagaNAH punaH |
nArAyaNAshcha gopAlAH kRRitvA mRRityuM nivartanam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
dRRiShTvA tu saMnivRRittA.nstAnsa.nshaptakagaNAnpunaH |
vAsudevaM mahAtmAnamarjunaH samabhAShata
shlokas.2:
chodayAshvAnhRRiShIkesha sa.nshaptakagaNAnprati |
naite hAsyanti sa~NgrAmaM jIvanta iti me matiH
shlokas.3:
pashya me.astrabalaM ghoraM bAhvoriShvasanasya cha |
adyaitAnpAtayiShyAmi kruddho rudraH pashUniva
shlokas.4:
tataH kRRiShNaH smitaM kRRitvA pariNandya shivena tam |
prAveshayata durdharSho yatra yatraichChadarjunaH
shlokas.5:
babhrAje sa ratho.atyarthamuhyamAno raNe tadA |
uhyamAnamivAkAshe vimAnaM pANDurairhayaiH
shlokas.6:
maNDalAni tatashchakre gatapratyAgatAni cha |
yathA shakraratho rAjanyuddhe devAsure purA
shlokas.7:
atha nArAyaNAH kruddhA vividhAyudhapANayaH |
ChAdayantaH sharavrAtaiH parivavrurdhana~njayam
shlokas.8:
adRRishyaM cha muhUrtena chakruste bharatarShabha |
kRRiShNena sahitaM yuddhe kuntIputraM dhana~njayam
shlokas.9:
kruddhastu phalgunaH sa~Nkhye dviguNIkRRitavikramaH |
gANDIvamupasaMmRRijya tUrNaM jagrAha sa.nyuge
shlokas.10:
baddhvA cha bhRRikuTIM vaktre krodhasya pratilakShaNam |
devadattaM mahAsha~NkhaM pUrayAmAsa pANDavaH
shlokas.11:
athAstramarisa~NghaghnaM tvAShTramabhyasyadarjunaH |
tato rUpasahasrANi prAdurAsanpRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.12:
AtmanaH pratirUpaistairnAnArUpairvimohitAH |
anyonyamarjunaM matvA svamAtmAnaM cha jaghnire
shlokas.13:
ayamarjuno.ayaM govinda imau yAdavapANDavau |
iti bruvANAH saMmUDhA jaghnuranyonyamAhave
shlokas.14:
mohitAH paramAstreNa kShayaM jagmuH parasparam |
ashobhanta raNe yodhAH puShpitA iva ki.nshukAH
shlokas.15:
tataH sharasahasrANi tairvimuktAni bhasmasAt |
kRRitvA tadastraM tAnvIrAnanayadyamasAdanam
shlokas.16:
atha prahasya bIbhatsurlalitthAnmAlavAnapi |
mAchellakA.nstrigartA.nshcha yaudheyA.nshchArdayachCharaiH
shlokas.17:
te vadhyamAnA vIreNa kShatriyAH kAlachoditAH |
vyasRRija~nsharavarShANi pArthe nAnAvidhAni cha
shlokas.18:
tato naivArjunastatra na ratho na cha keshavaH |
pratyadRRishyata ghoreNa sharavarSheNa sa.nvRRitaH
shlokas.19:
tataste labdhalakShyatvAdanyonyamabhichukrushuH |
hatau kRRiShNAviti prItA vAsA.nsyAdudhuvustadA
shlokas.20:
bherImRRida~Ngasha~NkhA.nshcha dadhmurvIrAH sahasrashaH |
siMhanAdaravA.nshchogrA.nshchakrire tatra mAriSha
shlokas.21:
tataH prasiShvide kRRiShNaH khinnashchArjunamabravIt |
kvAsi pArtha na pashye tvAM kachchijjIvasi shatruhan
shlokas.22:
tasya taM mAnuShaM bhAvaM bhAvaj~no.a.aj~nAya pANDavaH |
vAyavyAstreNa tairastAM sharavRRiShTimapAharat
shlokas.23:
tataH sa.nshaptakavrAtAnsAshvadviparathAyudhAn |
uvAha bhagavAnvAyuH shuShkaparNachayAniva
shlokas.24:
uhyamAnAstu te rAjanbahvashobhanta vAyunA |
praDInAH pakShiNaH kAle vRRikShebhya iva mAriSha
shlokas.25:
tA.nstathA vyAkulIkRRitya tvaramANo dhana~njayaH |
jaghAna nishitairbANaiH sahasrANi shatAni cha
shlokas.26:
shirA.nsi bhallairaharadbAhUnapi cha sAyudhAn |
hastihastopamA.nshchorU~nsharairurvyAmapAtayat
shlokas.27:
pRRiShThachChinnAnvicharaNAnvimastiShkekShaNA~NgulIn |
nAnA~NgAvayavairhInA.nshchakArArIndhana~njayaH
shlokas.28:
gandharvanagarAkArAnvidhivatkalpitAnrathAn |
sharairvishakalIkurva.nshchakre vyashvarathadvipAn
shlokas.29:
muNDatAlavanAnIva tatra tatra chakAshire |
ChinnadhvajarathavrAtAH kechitkechitkvachitkvachit
shlokas.30:
sottarAyudhino nAgAH sapatAkA~NkushAyudhAH |
petuH shakrAshanihatA drumavanta ivAchalAH
shlokas.31:
chAmarApIDakavachAH srastAntranayanAsavaH |
sArohAsturagAH petuH pArthabANahatAH kShitau
shlokas.32:
vipraviddhAsinakharAshChinnavarmarShTishaktayaH |
pattayashChinnavarmANaH kRRipaNaM sherate hatAH
shlokas.33:
tairhatairhanyamAnaishcha patadbhiH patitairapi |
bhramadbhirniShTanadbhishcha ghoramAyodhanaM babhau
shlokas.34:
rajashcha mahadudbhUtaM shAntaM rudhiravRRiShTibhiH |
mahI chApyabhavaddurgA kabandhashatasa~NkulA
shlokas.35:
tadbabhau raudrabIbhatsaM bIbhatsoryAnamAhave |
AkrIDa iva rudrasya ghnataH kAlAtyaye pashUn
shlokas.36:
te vadhyamAnAH pArthena vyAkulAshvarathadvipAH |
tamevAbhimukhAH kShINAH shakrasyAtithitAM gatAH
shlokas.37:
sA bhUmirbharatashreShTha nihataistairmahArathaiH |
AstIrNA sambabhau sarvA pretIbhUtaiH samantataH
shlokas.38:
etasminnantare chaiva pramatte savyasAchini |
vyUDhAnIkastato droNo yudhiShThiramupAdravat
shlokas.39:
taM pratyagRRihNa.nstvaritA vyUDhAnIkAH prahAriNaH |
yudhiShThiraM parIpsantastadAsIttumulaM mahat

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
pariNAmya nishAM tAM tu bhAradvAjo mahArathaH |
bahUktvA cha tato rAjanrAjAnaM cha suyodhanam
shlokas.2:
vidhAya yogaM pArthena sa.nshaptakagaNaiH saha |
niShkrAnte cha raNAtpArthe sa.nshaptakavadhaM prati
shlokas.3:
vyUDhAnIkastato droNaH pANDavAnAM mahAchamUm |
abhyayAdbharatashreShTha dharmarAjajighRRikShayA
shlokas.4:
vyUhaM dRRiShTvA suparNaM tu bhAradvAjakRRitaM tadA |
vyUhena maNDalArdhena pratyavyUhadyudhiShThiraH
shlokas.5:
mukhamAsItsuparNasya bhAradvAjo mahArathaH |
shiro duryodhano rAjA sodaryaiH sAnugaiH saha
shlokas.6:
chakShuShI kRRitavarmA cha gautamashchAsyatAM varaH |
bhUtavarmA kShemasharmA karakarShashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.7:
kali~NgAH siMhalAH prAchyAH shUrAbhIrA dasherakAH |
shakA yavanakAmbojAstathA ha.nsapadAshcha ye
shlokas.8:
grIvAyAM shUrasenAshcha daradA madrakekayAH |
gajAshvarathapattyaughAstasthuH shatasahasrashaH
shlokas.9:
bhUrishravAH shalaH shalyaH somadattashcha bAhlikaH |
akShauhiNyA vRRitA vIrA dakShiNaM pakShamAshritAH
shlokas.10:
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau kAmbojashcha sudakShiNaH |
vAmaM pakShaM samAshritya droNaputrAgragAH sthitAH
shlokas.11:
pRRiShThe kali~NgAH sAmbaShThA mAgadhAH paundramadrakAH |
gAndhArAH shakuniprAgyAH pArvatIyA vasAtayaH
shlokas.12:
puchChe vaikartanaH karNaH saputraj~nAtibAndhavaH |
mahatyA senayA tasthau nAnAdhvajasamutthayA
shlokas.13:
jayadratho bhImarathaH sA.nyAtrikasabho jayaH |
bhUmi~njayo vRRiShakrAtho naiShadhashcha mahAbalaH
shlokas.14:
vRRitA balena mahatA brahmalokapuraskRRitAH |
vyUhasyopari te rAjansthitA yuddhavishAradAH
shlokas.15:
droNena vihito vyUhaH padAtyashvarathadvipaiH |
vAtoddhUtArNavAkAraH pravRRitta iva lakShyate
shlokas.16:
tasya pakShaprapakShebhyo niShpatanti yuyutsavaH |
savidyutstanitA meghAH sarvadigbhya ivoShNage
shlokas.17:
tasya prAgjyotiSho madhye vidhivatkalpitaM gajam |
AsthitaH shushubhe rAjanna.nshumAnudaye yathA
shlokas.18:
mAlyadAmavatA rAjA shvetachChatreNa dhAryatA |
kRRittikAyogayuktena paurNamAsyAmivendunA
shlokas.19:
nIlA~njanachayaprakhyo madAndho dvirado babhau |
abhivRRiShTo mahAmeghairyathA syAtparvato mahAn
shlokas.20:
nAnAnRRipatibhirvIrairvividhAyudhabhUShaNaiH |
samanvitaH pArvatIyaiH shakro devagaNairiva
shlokas.21:
tato yudhiShThiraH prekShya vyUhaM tamatimAnuSham |
ajayyamaribhiH sa~Nkhye pArShataM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.22:
brAhmaNasya vashaM nAhamiyAmadya yathA prabho |
pArAvatasavarNAshva tathA nItirvidhIyatAm
shlokas.23:
dhRRiShTadyumna uvAcha||
droNasya yatamAnasya vashaM naiShyasi suvrata |
ahamAvArayiShyAmi droNamadya sahAnugam
shlokas.24:
mayi jIvati kauravya nodvegaM kartumarhasi |
na hi shakto raNe droNo vijetuM mAM katha~nchana
shlokas.25:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamuktvA kiranbANAndrupadasya suto balI |
pArAvatasavarNAshvaH svayaM droNamupAdravat
shlokas.26:
aniShTadarshanaM dRRiShTvA dhRRiShTadyumnamavasthitam |
kShaNenaivAbhavaddroNo nAtihRRiShTamanA iva
shlokas.27:
taM tu samprekShya putraste durmukhaH shatrukarshanaH |
priyaM chikIrShandroNasya dhRRiShTadyumnamavArayat
shlokas.28:
sa samprahArastumulaH samarUpa ivAbhavat |
pArShatasya cha shUrasya durmukhasya cha bhArata
shlokas.29:
pArShataH sharajAlena kShipraM prachChAdya durmukham |
bhAradvAjaM sharaugheNa mahatA samavArayat
shlokas.30:
droNamAvAritaM dRRiShTvA bhRRishAyastastavAtmajaH |
nAnAli~NgaiH sharavrAtaiH pArShataM samamohayat
shlokas.31:
tayorviShaktayoH sa~Nkhye pA~nchAlyakurumukhyayoH |
droNo yaudhiShThiraM sainyaM bahudhA vyadhamachCharaiH
shlokas.32:
anilena yathAbhrANi vichChinnAni samantataH |
tathA pArthasya sainyAni vichChinnAni kvachitkvachit
shlokas.33:
muhUrtamiva tadyuddhamAsInmadhuradarshanam |
tata unmattavadrAjannirmaryAdamavartata
shlokas.34:
naiva sve na pare rAjannaj~nAyanta parasparam |
anumAnena sa~nj~nAbhiryuddhaM tatsamavartata
shlokas.35:
chUDAmaNiShu niShkeShu bhUShaNeShvasicharmasu |
teShAmAdityavarNAbhA marIchyaH prachakAshire
shlokas.36:
tatprakIrNapatAkAnAM rathavAraNavAjinAm |
balAkAshabalAbhrAbhaM dadRRishe rUpamAhave
shlokas.37:
narAneva narA jaghnurudagrAshcha hayA hayAn |
rathA.nshcha rathino jaghnurvAraNA varavAraNAn
shlokas.38:
samuchChritapatAkAnAM gajAnAM paramadvipaiH |
kShaNena tumulo ghoraH sa~NgrAmaH samavartata
shlokas.39:
teShAM sa.nsaktagAtrANAM karShatAmitaretaram |
dantasa~NghAtasa~NgharShAtsadhUmo.agnirajAyata
shlokas.40:
viprakIrNapatAkAste viShANajanitAgnayaH |
babhUvuH khaM samAsAdya savidyuta ivAmbudAH
shlokas.41:
vikSharadbhirnadadbhishcha nipatadbhishcha vAraNaiH |
sambabhUva mahI kIrNA meghairdyauriva shAradI
shlokas.42:
teShAmAhanyamAnAnAM bANatomaravRRiShTibhiH |
vAraNAnAM ravo jaj~ne meghAnAmiva samplave
shlokas.43:
tomarAbhihatAH kechidbANaishcha paramadvipAH |
vitresuH sarvabhUtAnAM shabdamevApare.avrajan
shlokas.44:
viShANAbhihatAshchApi kechittatra gajA gajaiH |
chakrurArtasvaraM ghoramutpAtajaladA iva
shlokas.45:
pratIpaM hriyamANAshcha vAraNA varavAraNaiH |
unmathya punarAjahruH preritAH paramA~NkushaiH
shlokas.46:
mahAmAtrA mahAmAtraistADitAH sharatomaraiH |
gajebhyaH pRRithivIM jagmurmuktapraharaNA~NkushAH
shlokas.47:
nirmanuShyAshcha mAta~NgA vinadantastatastataH |
ChinnAbhrANIva sampetuH sampravishya parasparam
shlokas.48:
hatAnparivahantashcha yantritAH paramAyudhaiH |
disho jagmurmahAnAgAH kechidekacharA iva
shlokas.49:
tADitAstADyamAnAshcha tomararShTiparashvadhaiH |
peturArtasvaraM kRRitvA tadA vishasane gajAH
shlokas.50:
teShAM shailopamaiH kAyairnipatadbhiH samantataH |
AhatA sahasA bhUmishchakampe cha nanAda cha
shlokas.51:
sAditaiH sagajArohaiH sapatAkaiH samantataH |
mAta~NgaiH shushubhe bhUmirvikIrNairiva parvataiH
shlokas.52:
gajasthAshcha mahAmAtrA nirbhinnahRRidayA raNe |
rathibhiH pAtitA bhallairvikIrNA~NkushatomarAH
shlokas.53:
krau~nchavadvinadanto.anye nArAchAbhihatA gajAH |
parAnsvA.nshchApi mRRidnantaH paripeturdisho dasha
shlokas.54:
gajAshvarathasa~NghAnAM sharIraughasamAvRRitA |
babhUva pRRithivI rAjanmA.nsashoNitakardamA
shlokas.55:
pramathya cha viShANAgraiH samutkShipya cha vAraNaiH |
sachakrAshcha vichakrAshcha rathaireva mahArathAH
shlokas.56:
rathAshcha rathibhirhInA nirmanuShyAshcha vAjinaH |
hatArohAshcha mAta~NgA disho jagmuH sharAturAH
shlokas.57:
jaghAnAtra pitA putraM putrashcha pitaraM tathA |
ityAsIttumulaM yuddhaM na praj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.58:
A gulphebhyo.avasIdanta narAH shoNitakardame |
dIpyamAnaiH parikShiptA dAvairiva mahAdrumAH
shlokas.59:
shoNitaiH sichyamAnAni vastrANi kavachAni cha |
ChatrANi cha patAkAshcha sarvaM raktamadRRishyata
shlokas.60:
hayaughAshcha rathaughAshcha naraughAshcha nipAtitAH |
sa.nvRRittAH punarAvRRittA bahudhA rathanemibhiH
shlokas.61:
sa gajaughamahAvegaH parAsunarashaivalaH |
rathaughatumulAvartaH prababhau sainyasAgaraH
shlokas.62:
taM vAhanamahAnaubhiryodhA jayadhanaiShiNaH |
avagAhyAvamajjanto naiva mohaM prachakrire
shlokas.63:
sharavarShAbhivRRiShTeShu yodheShvajitalakShmasu |
na hi svachittatAM lebhe kashchidAhatalakShaNaH
shlokas.64:
vartamAne tathA yuddhe ghorarUpe bhaya~Nkare |
mohayitvA parAndroNo yudhiShThiramupAdravat

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato yudhiShThiro droNaM dRRiShTvAntikamupAgatam |
mahatA sharavarSheNa pratyagRRihNAdabhItavat
shlokas.2:
tato halahalAshabda AsIdyaudhiShThire bale |
jighRRikShati mahAsiMhe gajAnAmiva yUthapam
shlokas.3:
dRRiShTvA droNaM tataH shUraH satyajitsatyavikramaH |
yudhiShThiraM pariprepsumAchAryaM samupAdravat
shlokas.4:
tata AchAryapA~nchAlyau yuyudhAte parasparam |
vikShobhayantau tatsainyamindravairochanAviva
shlokas.5:
tataH satyajitaM tIkShNairdashabhirmarmabhedibhiH |
avidhyachChIghramAchAryashChittvAsya sasharaM dhanuH
shlokas.6:
sa shIghrataramAdAya dhanuranyatpratApavAn |
droNaM so.abhijaghAnAshu vi.nshadbhiH ka~NkapatribhiH
shlokas.7:
j~nAtvA satyajitA droNaM grasyamAnamivAhave |
vRRikaH sharashataistIkShNaiH pA~nchAlyo droNamardayat
shlokas.8:
sa~nChAdyamAnaM samare droNaM dRRiShTvA mahAratham |
chukrushuH pANDavA rAjanvastrANi dudhuvushcha ha
shlokas.9:
vRRikastu paramakruddho droNaM ShaShTyA stanAntare |
vivyAdha balavAnrAja.nstadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.10:
droNastu sharavarSheNa ChAdyamAno mahArathaH |
vegaM chakre mahAvegaH krodhAdudvRRitya chakShuShI
shlokas.11:
tataH satyajitashchApaM ChittvA droNo vRRikasya cha |
ShaDbhiH sasUtaM sahayaM sharairdroNo.avadhIdvRRikam
shlokas.12:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya satyajidvegavattaram |
sAshvaM sasUtaM vishikhairdroNaM vivyAdha sadhvajam
shlokas.13:
sa tanna mamRRiShe droNaH pA~nchAlyenArdanaM mRRidhe |
tatastasya vinAshAya satvaraM vyasRRijachCharAn
shlokas.14:
hayAndhvajaM dhanurmuShTimubhau cha pArShNisArathI |
avAkirattato droNaH sharavarShaiH sahasrashaH
shlokas.15:
tathA sa~nChidyamAneShu kArmukeShu punaH punaH |
pA~nchAlyaH paramAstraj~naH shoNAshvaM samayodhayat
shlokas.16:
sa satyajitamAlakShya tathodIrNaM mahAhave |
ardhachandreNa chichCheda shirastasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.17:
tasminhate mahAmAtre pA~nchAlAnAM ratharShabhe |
apAyAjjavanairashvairdroNAttrasto yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.18:
pA~nchAlAH kekayA matsyAshchedikArUShakosalAH |
yudhiShThiramudIkShanto hRRiShTA droNamupAdravan
shlokas.19:
tato yudhiShThiraprepsurAchAryaH shatrupUgahA |
vyadhamattAnyanIkAni tUlarAshimivAnilaH
shlokas.20:
nirdahantamanIkAni tAni tAni punaH punaH |
droNaM matsyAdavarajaH shatAnIko.abhyavartata
shlokas.21:
sUryarashmipratIkAshaiH karmAraparimArjitaiH |
ShaDbhiH sasUtaM sahayaM droNaM viddhvAnadadbhRRisham
shlokas.22:
tasya nAnadato droNaH shiraH kAyAtsakuNDalam |
kShureNApAharattUrNaM tato matsyAH pradudruvuH
shlokas.23:
matsyA~njitvAjayachchedInkArUShAnkekayAnapi |
pA~nchAlAnsRRi~njayAnpANDUnbhAradvAjaH punaH punaH
shlokas.24:
taM dahantamanIkAni kruddhamagniM yathA vanam |
dRRiShTvA rukmarathaM kruddhaM samakampanta sRRi~njayAH
shlokas.25:
uttamaM hyAdadhAnasya dhanurasyAshukAriNaH |
jyAghoSho nighnato.amitrAndikShu sarvAsu shushruve
shlokas.26:
nAgAnashvAnpadAtI.nshcha rathino gajasAdinaH |
raudrA hastavatA muktAH pramathnanti sma sAyakAH
shlokas.27:
nAnadyamAnaH parjanyo mishravAto himAtyaye |
ashmavarShamivAvarShatpareShAM bhayamAdadhat
shlokas.28:
sarvA dishaH samacharatsainyaM vikShobhayanniva |
balI shUro maheShvAso mitrANAmabhaya~NkaraH
shlokas.29:
tasya vidyudivAbhreShu chApaM hemapariShkRRitam |
dikShu sarvAsvapashyAma droNasyAmitatejasaH
shlokas.30:
droNastu pANDavAnIke chakAra kadanaM mahat |
yathA daityagaNe viShNuH surAsuranamaskRRitaH
shlokas.31:
sa shUraH satyavAkprAj~no balavAnsatyavikramaH |
mahAnubhAvaH kAlAnte raudrIM bhIruvibhIShaNAm
shlokas.32:
kavachormidhvajAvartAM martyakUlApahAriNIm |
gajavAjimahAgrAhAmasimInAM durAsadAm
shlokas.33:
vIrAsthisharkarAM raudrAM bherImurajakachChapAm |
charmavarmaplavAM ghorAM keshashaivalashADvalAm
shlokas.34:
sharaughiNIM dhanuHsrotAM bAhupannagasa~NkulAm |
raNabhUmivahAM ghorAM kurusRRi~njayavAhinIm
manuShyashIrShapAShANAM shaktimInAM gadoDupAm
shlokas.35:
uShNIShaphenavasanAM niShkIrNAntrasarIsRRipAm |
vIrApahAriNImugrAM mA.nsashoNitakardamAm
shlokas.36:
hastigrAhAM ketuvRRikShAM kShatriyANAM nimajjanIm |
krUrAM sharIrasa~NghATAM sAdinakrAM duratyayAm
droNaH prAvartayattatra nadImantakagAminIm
shlokas.37:
kravyAdagaNasa~NghuShTAM shvashRRigAlagaNAyutAm |
niShevitAM mahAraudraiH pishitAshaiH samantataH
shlokas.38:
taM dahantamanIkAni rathodAraM kRRitAntavat |
sarvato.abhyadravandroNaM kuntIputrapurogamAH
shlokas.39:
tA.nstu shUrAnmaheShvAsA.nstAvakAbhyudyatAyudhAH |
rAjAno rAjaputrAshcha samantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.40:
tato droNaH satyasandhaH prabhinna iva ku~njaraH |
abhyatItya rathAnIkaM dRRiDhasenamapAtayat
shlokas.41:
tato rAjAnamAsAdya praharantamabhItavat |
avidhyannavabhiH kShemaM sa hataH prApatadrathAt
shlokas.42:
sa madhyaM prApya sainyAnAM sarvAH pravicharandishaH |
trAtA hyabhavadanyeShAM na trAtavyaH katha~nchana
shlokas.43:
shikhaNDinaM dvAdashabhirvi.nshatyA chottamaujasam |
vasudAnaM cha bhallena preShayadyamasAdanam
shlokas.44:
ashItyA kShatravarmANaM ShaDvi.nshatyA sudakShiNam |
kShatradevaM tu bhallena rathanIDAdapAharat
shlokas.45:
yudhAmanyuM chatuHShaShTyA tri.nshatA chaiva sAtyakim |
viddhvA rukmarathastUrNaM yudhiShThiramupAdravat
shlokas.46:
tato yudhiShThiraH kShipraM kitavo rAjasattamaH |
apAyAjjavanairashvaiH pA~nchAlyo droNamabhyayAt
shlokas.47:
taM droNaH sadhanuShkaM tu sAshvayantAramakShiNot |
sa hataH prApatadbhUmau rathAjjyotirivAmbarAt
shlokas.48:
tasminhate rAjaputre pA~nchAlAnAM yashaskare |
hata droNaM hata droNamityAsIttumulaM mahat
shlokas.49:
tA.nstathA bhRRishasa~NkruddhAnpA~nchAlAnmatsyakekayAn |
sRRi~njayAnpANDavA.nshchaiva droNo vyakShobhayadbalI
shlokas.50:
sAtyakiM chekitAnaM cha dhRRiShTadyumnashikhaNDinau |
vArdhakShemiM chitrasenaM senAbinduM suvarchasam
shlokas.51:
etA.nshchAnyA.nshcha subahUnnAnAjanapadeshvarAn |
sarvAndroNo.ajayadyuddhe kurubhiH parivAritaH
shlokas.52:
tAvakAstu mahArAja jayaM labdhvA mahAhave |
pANDaveyAnraNe jaghnurdravamANAnsamantataH
shlokas.53:
te dAnavA ivendreNa vadhyamAnA mahAtmanA |
pA~nchAlAH kekayA matsyAH samakampanta bhArata

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
bhAradvAjena bhagneShu pANDaveShu mahAmRRidhe |
pA~nchAleShu cha sarveShu kashchidanyo.abhyavartata
shlokas.2:
AryAM yuddhe matiM kRRitvA kShatriyANAM yashaskarIm |
asevitAM kApuruShaiH sevitAM puruSharShabhaiH
shlokas.3:
sa hi vIro naraH sUta yo bhagneShu nivartate |
aho nAsItpumAnkashchiddRRiShTvA droNaM vyavasthitam
shlokas.4:
jRRimbhamANamiva vyAghraM prabhinnamiva ku~njaram |
tyajantamAhave prANAnsaMnaddhaM chitrayodhinam
shlokas.5:
maheShvAsaM naravyAghraM dviShatAmaghavardhanam |
kRRitaj~naM satyanirataM duryodhanahitaiShiNam
shlokas.6:
bhAradvAjaM tathAnIke dRRiShTvA shUramavasthitam |
ke vIrAH saMnyavartanta tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.7:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tAndRRiShTvA chalitAnsa~Nkhye praNunnAndroNasAyakaiH |
pA~nchAlAnpANDavAnmatsyAnsRRi~njayA.nshchedikekayAn
shlokas.8:
droNachApavimuktena sharaugheNAsuhAriNA |
sindhoriva mahaughena hriyamANAnyathA plavAn
shlokas.9:
kauravAH siMhanAdena nAnAvAdyasvanena cha |
rathadvipanarAshvaishcha sarvataH paryavArayan
shlokas.10:
tAnpashyansainyamadhyastho rAjA svajanasa.nvRRitaH |
duryodhano.abravItkarNaM prahRRiShTaH prahasanniva
shlokas.11:
pashya rAdheya pA~nchAlAnpraNunnAndroNasAyakaiH |
siMheneva mRRigAnvanyA.nstrAsitAndRRiDhadhanvanA
shlokas.12:
naite jAtu punaryuddhamIheyuriti me matiH |
yathA tu bhagnA droNena vAteneva mahAdrumAH
shlokas.13:
ardyamAnAH sharairete rukmapu~NkhairmahAtmanA |
pathA naikena gachChanti ghUrNamAnAstatastataH
shlokas.14:
saMniruddhAshcha kauravyairdroNena cha mahAtmanA |
ete.anye maNDalIbhUtAH pAvakeneva ku~njarAH
shlokas.15:
bhramarairiva chAviShTA droNasya nishitaiH sharaiH |
anyonyaM samalIyanta palAyanaparAyaNAH
shlokas.16:
eSha bhImo dRRiDhakrodho hInaH pANDavasRRi~njayaiH |
madIyairAvRRito yodhaiH karNa tarjayatIva mAm
shlokas.17:
vyaktaM droNamayaM lokamadya pashyati durmatiH |
nirAsho jIvitAnnUnamadya rAjyAchcha pANDavaH
shlokas.18:
karNa uvAcha||
naiSha jAtu mahAbAhurjIvannAhavamutsRRijet |
na chemAnpuruShavyAghra siMhanAdAnvishakShyate
shlokas.19:
na chApi pANDavA yuddhe bhajyeranniti me matiH |
shUrAshcha balavantashcha kRRitAstrA yuddhadurmadAH
shlokas.20:
viShAgnidyUtasa~NkleshAnvanavAsaM cha pANDavAH |
smaramANA na hAsyanti sa~NgrAmamiti me matiH
shlokas.21:
nikRRito hi mahAbAhuramitaujA vRRikodaraH |
varAnvarAnhi kaunteyo rathodArAnhaniShyati
shlokas.22:
asinA dhanuShA shaktyA hayairnAgairnarai rathaiH |
Ayasena cha daNDena vrAtAnvrAtAnhaniShyati
shlokas.23:
tamete chAnuvartante sAtyakipramukhA rathAH |
pA~nchAlAH kekayA matsyAH pANDavAshcha visheShataH
shlokas.24:
shUrAshcha balavantashcha vikrAntAshcha mahArathAH |
visheShatashcha bhImena sa.nrabdhenAbhichoditAH
shlokas.25:
te droNamabhivartante sarvataH kurupu~NgavAH |
vRRikodaraM parIpsantaH sUryamabhragaNA iva
shlokas.26:
ekAyanagatA hyete pIDayeyuryatavratam |
arakShyamANaM shalabhA yathA dIpaM mumUrShavaH
asa.nshayaM kRRitAstrAshcha paryAptAshchApi vAraNe
shlokas.27:
atibhAraM tvahaM manye bhAradvAje samAhitam |
te shIghramanugachChAmo yatra droNo vyavasthitaH
kAkA iva mahAnAgaM mA vai hanyuryatavratam
shlokas.28:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
rAdheyasya vachaH shrutvA rAjA duryodhanastadA |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahito rAjanprAyAddroNarathaM prati
shlokas.29:
tatrArAvo mahAnAsIdekaM droNaM jighA.nsatAm |
pANDavAnAM nivRRittAnAM nAnAvarNairhayottamaiH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sarveShAmeva me brUhi rathachihnAni sa~njaya |
ye droNamabhyavartanta kruddhA bhImapurogamAH
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
RRishyavarNairhayairdRRiShTvA vyAyachChantaM vRRikodaram |
rajatAshvastataH shUraH shaineyaH saMnyavartata
shlokas.3:
darshanIyAstu kAmbojAH shukapatraparichChadAH |
vahanto nakulaM shIghraM tAvakAnabhidudruvuH
shlokas.4:
kRRiShNAstu meghasa~NkAshAH sahadevamudAyudham |
bhImavegA naravyAghramavahanvAtaraMhasaH
shlokas.5:
hemottamapratichChannairhayairvAtasamairjave |
abhyavartanta sainyAni sarvANyeva yudhiShThiram
shlokas.6:
rAj~nastvanantaraM rAjA pA~nchAlyo drupado.abhavat |
jAtarUpamayachChatraH sarvaiH svairabhirakShitaH
shlokas.7:
lalAmairharibhiryuktaiH sarvashabdakShamairyudhi |
rAj~nAM madhye maheShvAsaH shAntabhIrabhyavartata
shlokas.8:
taM virATo.anvayAtpashchAtsaha shUrairmahArathaiH |
kekayAshcha shikhaNDI cha dhRRiShTaketustathaiva cha
svaiH svaiH sainyaiH parivRRitA matsyarAjAnamanvayuH
shlokas.9:
te tu pATalapuShpANAM samavarNA hayottamAH |
vahamAnA vyarAjanta matsyasyAmitraghAtinaH
shlokas.10:
hAridrasamavarNAstu javanA hemamAlinaH |
putraM virATarAjasya satvarAH samudAvahan
shlokas.11:
indragopakavarNaistu bhrAtaraH pa~ncha kekayAH |
jAtarUpasamAbhAsaH sarve lohitakadhvajAH
shlokas.12:
te hemamAlinaH shUrAH sarve yuddhavishAradAH |
varShanta iva jImUtAH pratyadRRishyanta da.nshitAH
shlokas.13:
AmapAtranibhAkArAH pA~nchAlyamamitaujasam |
dAntAstAmrAruNA yuktAH shikhaNDinamudAvahan
shlokas.14:
tathA dvAdashasAhasrAH pA~nchAlAnAM mahArathAH |
teShAM tu ShaTsahasrANi ye shikhaNDinamanvayuH
shlokas.15:
putraM tu shishupAlasya narasiMhasya mAriSha |
AkrIDanto vahanti sma sAra~NgashabalA hayAH
shlokas.16:
dhRRiShTaketushcha chedInAmRRiShabho.atibaloditaH |
kAmbojaiH shabalairashvairabhyavartata durjayaH
shlokas.17:
bRRihatkShatraM tu kaikeyaM sukumAraM hayottamAH |
palAladhUmavarNAbhAH saindhavAH shIghramAvahan
shlokas.18:
mallikAkShAH padmavarNA bAhlijAtAH svala~NkRRitAH |
shUraM shikhaNDinaH putraM kShatradevamudAvahan
shlokas.19:
yuvAnamavahanyuddhe krau~nchavarNA hayottamAH |
kAshyasyAbhibhuvaH putraM sukumAraM mahAratham
shlokas.20:
shvetAstu prativindhyaM taM kRRiShNagrIvA manojavAH |
yantuH preShyakarA rAjanrAjaputramudAvahan
shlokas.21:
sutasomaM tu yaM dhaumyAtpArthaH putramayAchata |
mAShapuShpasavarNAstamavahanvAjino raNe
shlokas.22:
sahasrasomapratimA babhUvuH; pure kurUNAmudayendunAmni |
tasmi~njAtaH somasa~Nkrandamadhye; yasmAttasmAtsutasomo.abhavatsaH
shlokas.23:
nAkuliM tu shatAnIkaM shAlapuShpanibhA hayAH |
AdityataruNaprakhyAH shlAghanIyamudAvahan
shlokas.24:
kA~nchanapratimairyoktrairmayUragrIvasaMnibhAH |
draupadeyaM naravyAghraM shrutakarmANamAvahan
shlokas.25:
shrutakIrtiM shrutanidhiM draupadeyaM hayottamAH |
UhuH pArthasamaM yuddhe chAShapatranibhA hayAH
shlokas.26:
yamAhuradhyardhaguNaM kRRiShNAtpArthAchcha sa.nyuge |
abhimanyuM pisha~NgAstaM kumAramavahanraNe
shlokas.27:
ekastu dhArtarAShTrebhyaH pANDavAnyaH samAshritaH |
taM bRRihanto mahAkAyA yuyutsumavahanraNe
shlokas.28:
palAlakANDavarNAstu vArdhakShemiM tarasvinam |
UhuH sutumule yuddhe hayA hRRiShTAH svala~NkRRitAH
shlokas.29:
kumAraM shitipAdAstu rukmapatrairurashChadaiH |
sauchittimavahanyuddhe yantuH preShyakarA hayAH
shlokas.30:
rukmapRRiShThAvakIrNAstu kausheyasadRRishA hayAH |
suvarNamAlinaH kShAntAH shreNimantamudAvahan
shlokas.31:
rukmamAlAdharAH shUrA hemavarNAH svala~NkRRitAH |
kAshirAjaM hayashreShThAH shlAghanIyamudAvahan
shlokas.32:
astrANAM cha dhanurvede brAhme vede cha pAragam |
taM satyadhRRitimAyAntamaruNAH samudAvahan
shlokas.33:
yaH sa pA~nchAlasenAnIrdroNama.nshamakalpayat |
pArAvatasavarNAshvA dhRRiShTadyumnamudAvahan
shlokas.34:
tamanvayAtsatyadhRRitiH sauchittiryuddhadurmadaH |
shreNimAnvasudAnashcha putraH kAshyasya chAbhibho
shlokas.35:
yuktaiH paramakAmbojairjavanairhemamAlibhiH |
bhIShayanto dviShatsainyaM yamavaishravaNopamAH
shlokas.36:
prabhadrakAstu pA~nchAlAH ShaTsahasrANyudAyudhAH |
nAnAvarNairhayashreShThairhemachitrarathadhvajAH
shlokas.37:
sharavrAtairvidhunvantaH shatrUnvitatakArmukAH |
samAnamRRityavo bhUtvA dhRRiShTadyumnaM samanvayuH
shlokas.38:
babhrukausheyavarNAstu suvarNavaramAlinaH |
UhuraglAnamanasashchekitAnaM hayottamAH
shlokas.39:
indrAyudhasavarNaistu kuntibhojo hayottamaiH |
AyAtsuvashyaiH purujinmAtulaH savyasAchinaH
shlokas.40:
antarikShasavarNAstu tArakAchitritA iva |
rAjAnaM rochamAnaM te hayAH sa~Nkhye samAvahan
shlokas.41:
karburAH shitipAdAstu svarNajAlaparichChadAH |
jArAsandhiM hayashreShThAH sahadevamudAvahan
shlokas.42:
ye tu puShkaranAlasya samavarNA hayottamAH |
jave shyenasamAshchitrAH sudAmAnamudAvahan
shlokas.43:
shashalohitavarNAstu pANDurodgatarAjayaH |
pA~nchAlyaM gopateH putraM siMhasenamudAvahan
shlokas.44:
pA~nchAlAnAM naravyAghro yaH khyAto janamejayaH |
tasya sarShapapuShpANAM tulyavarNA hayottamAH
shlokas.45:
mAShavarNAstu javanA bRRihanto hemamAlinaH |
dadhipRRiShThAshchandramukhAH pA~nchAlyamavahandrutam
shlokas.46:
shUrAshcha bhadrakAshchaiva sharakANDanibhA hayAH |
padmaki~njalkavarNAbhA daNDadhAramudAvahan
shlokas.47:
bibhrato hemamAlAshcha chakravAkodarA hayAH |
kosalAdhipateH putraM sukShatraM vAjino.avahan
shlokas.48:
shabalAstu bRRihanto.ashvA dAntA jAmbUnadasrajaH |
yuddhe satyadhRRitiM kShaimimavahanprA.nshavaH shubhAH
shlokas.49:
ekavarNena sarveNa dhvajena kavachena cha |
ashvaishcha dhanuShA chaiva shuklaiH shuklo nyavartata
shlokas.50:
samudrasenaputraM tu sAmudrA rudratejasam |
ashvAH shashA~NkasadRRishAshchandradevamudAvahan
shlokas.51:
nIlotpalasavarNAstu tapanIyavibhUShitAH |
shaibyaM chitrarathaM yuddhe chitramAlyAvahanhayAH
shlokas.52:
kalAyapuShpavarNAstu shvetalohitarAjayaH |
rathasenaM hayashreShThAH samUhuryuddhadurmadam
shlokas.53:
yaM tu sarvamanuShyebhyaH prAhuH shUrataraM nRRipam |
taM paTachcharahantAraM shukavarNAvahanhayAH
shlokas.54:
chitrAyudhaM chitramAlyaM chitravarmAyudhadhvajam |
UhuH ki.nshukapuShpANAM tulyavarNA hayottamAH
shlokas.55:
ekavarNena sarveNa dhvajena kavachena cha |
dhanuShA rathavAhaishcha nIlairnIlo.abhyavartata
shlokas.56:
nAnArUpai ratnachitrairvarUthadhvajakArmukaiH |
vAjidhvajapatAkAbhishchitraishchitro.abhyavartata
shlokas.57:
ye tu puShkarapatrasya tulyavarNA hayottamAH |
te rochamAnasya sutaM hemavarNamudAvahan
shlokas.58:
yodhAshcha bhadrakArAshcha sharadaNDAnudaNDajAH |
shvetANDAH kukkuTANDAbhA daNDaketumudAvahan
shlokas.59:
ATarUShakapuShpAbhA hayAH pANDyAnuyAyinAm |
avahanrathamukhyAnAmayutAni chaturdasha
shlokas.60:
nAnArUpeNa varNena nAnAkRRitimukhA hayAH |
rathachakradhvajaM vIraM ghaTotkachamudAvahan
shlokas.61:
suvarNavarNA dharmaj~namanIkasthaM yudhiShThiram |
rAjashreShThaM hayashreShThAH sarvataH pRRiShThato.anvayuH
varNaishchochchAvachairdivyaiH sadashvAnAM prabhadrakAH
shlokas.62:
te yattA bhImasenena sahitAH kA~nchanadhvajAH |
pratyadRRishyanta rAjendra sendrA iva divaukasaH
shlokas.63:
atyarochata tAnsarvAndhRRiShTadyumnaH samAgatAn |
sarvANyapi cha sainyAni bhAradvAjo.atyarochata

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
vyathayeyurime senAM devAnAmapi sa.nyuge |
Ahave ye nyavartanta vRRikodaramukhA rathAH
shlokas.2:
samprayuktaH kilaivAyaM diShTairbhavati pUruShaH |
tasminneva tu sarvArthA dRRishyante vai pRRithagvidhAH
shlokas.3:
dIrghaM viproShitaH kAlamaraNye jaTilo.ajinI |
aj~nAtashchaiva lokasya vijahAra yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.4:
sa eva mahatIM senAM samAvartayadAhave |
kimanyaddaivasa.nyogAnmama putrasya chAbhavat
shlokas.5:
yukta eva hi bhAgyena dhruvamutpadyate naraH |
sa tathAkRRiShyate tena na yathA svayamichChati
shlokas.6:
dyUtavyasanamAsAdya kleshito hi yudhiShThiraH |
sa punarbhAgadheyena sahAyAnupalabdhavAn
shlokas.7:
ardhaM me kekayA labdhAH kAshikAH kosalAshcha ye |
chedayashchApare va~NgA mAmeva samupAshritAH
shlokas.8:
pRRithivI bhUyasI tAta mama pArthasya no tathA |
iti mAmabravItsUta mando duryodhanastadA
shlokas.9:
tasya senAsamUhasya madhye droNaH surakShitaH |
nihataH pArShatenAjau kimanyadbhAgadheyataH
shlokas.10:
madhye rAj~nAM mahAbAhuM sadA yuddhAbhinandinam |
sarvAstrapAragaM droNaM kathaM mRRityurupeyivAn
shlokas.11:
samanuprAptakRRichChro.ahaM saMmohaM paramaM gataH |
bhIShmadroNau hatau shrutvA nAhaM jIvitumutsahe
shlokas.12:
yanmA kShattAbravIttAta prapashyanputragRRiddhinam |
duryodhanena tatsarvaM prAptaM sUta mayA saha
shlokas.13:
nRRisha.nsaM tu paraM tatsyAttyaktvA duryodhanaM yadi |
putrasheShaM chikIrSheyaM kRRichChraM na maraNaM bhavet
shlokas.14:
yo hi dharmaM parityajya bhavatyarthaparo naraH |
so.asmAchcha hIyate lokAtkShudrabhAvaM cha gachChati
shlokas.15:
adya chApyasya rAShTrasya hatotsAhasya sa~njaya |
avasheShaM na pashyAmi kakude mRRidite sati
shlokas.16:
kathaM syAdavasheShaM hi dhuryayorabhyatItayoH |
yau nityamanujIvAmaH kShamiNau puruSharShabhau
shlokas.17:
vyaktameva cha me sha.nsa yathA yuddhamavartata |
ke.ayudhyanke vyapAkarShanke kShudrAH prAdravanbhayAt
shlokas.18:
dhana~njayaM cha me sha.nsa yadyachchakre ratharShabhaH |
tasmAdbhayaM no bhUyiShThaM bhrAtRRivyAchcha visheShataH
shlokas.19:
yathAsIchcha nivRRitteShu pANDaveShu cha sa~njaya |
mama sainyAvasheShasya saMnipAtaH sudAruNaH
mAmakAnAM cha ye shUrAH kA.nstatra samavArayan

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
mahadbhairavamAsInnaH saMnivRRitteShu pANDuShu |
dRRiShTvA droNaM ChAdyamAnaM tairbhAskaramivAmbudaiH
shlokas.2:
taishchoddhUtaM rajastIvramavachakre chamUM tava |
tato hatamamanyAma droNaM dRRiShTipathe hate
shlokas.3:
tA.nstu shUrAnmaheShvAsAnkrUraM karma chikIrShataH |
dRRiShTvA duryodhanastUrNaM svasainyaM samachUchudat
shlokas.4:
yathAshakti yathotsAhaM yathAsattvaM narAdhipAH |
vArayadhvaM yathAyogaM pANDavAnAmanIkinIm
shlokas.5:
tato durmarShaNo bhImamabhyagachChatsutastava |
ArAddRRiShTvA kiranbANairichChandroNasya jIvitam
shlokas.6:
taM bANairavatastAra kruddho mRRityumivAhave |
taM cha bhImo.atudadbANaistadAsIttumulaM mahat
shlokas.7:
ta IshvarasamAdiShTAH prAj~nAH shUrAH prahAriNaH |
bAhyaM mRRityubhayaM kRRitvA pratyatiShThanparAnyudhi
shlokas.8:
kRRitavarmA shineH putraM droNaprepsuM vishAM pate |
paryavArayadAyAntaM shUraM samitishobhanam
shlokas.9:
taM shaineyaH sharavrAtaiH kruddhaH kruddhamavArayat |
kRRitavarmA cha shaineyaM matto mattamiva dvipam
shlokas.10:
saindhavaH kShatradharmANamApatantaM sharaughiNam |
ugradhanvA maheShvAsaM yatto droNAdavArayat
shlokas.11:
kShatradharmA sindhupateshChittvA ketanakArmuke |
nArAchairbahubhiH kruddhaH sarvamarmasvatADayat
shlokas.12:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya saindhavaH kRRitahastavat |
vivyAdha kShatradharmANaM raNe sarvAyasaiH sharaiH
shlokas.13:
yuyutsuM pANDavArthAya yatamAnaM mahAratham |
subAhurbhrAtaraM shUraM yatto droNAdavArayat
shlokas.14:
subAhoH sadhanurbANAvasyataH parighopamau |
yuyutsuH shitapItAbhyAM kShurAbhyAmachChinadbhujau
shlokas.15:
rAjAnaM pANDavashreShThaM dharmAtmAnaM yudhiShThiram |
veleva sAgaraM kShubdhaM madrarATsamavArayat
shlokas.16:
taM dharmarAjo bahubhirmarmabhidbhiravAkirat |
madreshastaM chatuHShaShTyA sharairviddhvAnadadbhRRisham
shlokas.17:
tasya nAnadataH ketumuchchakarta sakArmukam |
kShurAbhyAM pANDavashreShThastata uchchukrushurjanAH
shlokas.18:
tathaiva rAjA bAhlIko rAjAnaM drupadaM sharaiH |
AdravantaM sahAnIkaM sahAnIko nyavArayat
shlokas.19:
tadyuddhamabhavadghoraM vRRiddhayoH sahasenayoH |
yathA mahAyUthapayordvipayoH samprabhinnayoH
shlokas.20:
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau virATaM matsyamArchChatAm |
sahasainyau sahAnIkaM yathendrAgnI purA balim
shlokas.21:
tadutpi~njalakaM yuddhamAsIddevAsuropamam |
matsyAnAM kekayaiH sArdhamabhItAshvarathadvipam
shlokas.22:
nAkuliM tu shatAnIkaM bhUtakarmA sabhApatiH |
asyantamiShujAlAni yAntaM droNAdavArayat
shlokas.23:
tato nakuladAyAdastribhirbhallaiH susa.nshitaiH |
chakre vibAhushirasaM bhUtakarmANamAhave
shlokas.24:
sutasomaM tu vikrAntamApatantaM sharaughiNam |
droNAyAbhimukhaM vIraM vivi.nshatiravArayat
shlokas.25:
sutasomastu sa~NkruddhaH svapitRRivyamajihmagaiH |
vivi.nshatiM sharairviddhvA nAbhyavartata da.nshitaH
shlokas.26:
atha bhImarathaH shAlvamAshugairAyasaiH shitaiH |
ShaDbhiH sAshvaniyantAramanayadyamasAdanam
shlokas.27:
shrutakarmANamAyAntaM mayUrasadRRishairhayaiH |
chaitrasenirmahArAja tava pautro nyavArayat
shlokas.28:
tau pautrau tava durdharShau parasparavadhaiShiNau |
pitR^INAmarthasiddhyarthaM chakraturyuddhamuttamam
shlokas.29:
tiShThantamagrato dRRiShTvA prativindhyaM tamAhave |
drauNirmAnaM pituH kurvanmArgaNaiH samavArayat
shlokas.30:
taM kruddhaH prativivyAdha prativindhyaH shitaiH sharaiH |
siMhalA~NgUlalakShmANaM piturarthe vyavasthitam
shlokas.31:
pravapanniva bIjAni bIjakAle nararShabha |
drauNAyanirdraupadeyaM sharavarShairavAkirat
shlokas.32:
yastu shUratamo rAjansenayorubhayormataH |
taM paTachcharahantAraM lakShmaNaH samavArayat
shlokas.33:
sa lakShmaNasyeShvasanaM ChittvA lakShma cha bhArata |
lakShmaNe sharajAlAni visRRijanbahvashobhata
shlokas.34:
vikarNastu mahAprAj~no yAj~naseniM shikhaNDinam |
paryavArayadAyAntaM yuvAnaM samare yuvA
shlokas.35:
tatastamiShujAlena yAj~naseniH samAvRRiNot |
vidhUya tadbANajAlaM babhau tava suto balI
shlokas.36:
a~Ngado.abhimukhaH shUramuttamaujasamAhave |
droNAyAbhimukhaM yAntaM vatsadantairavArayat
shlokas.37:
sa samprahArastumulastayoH puruShasiMhayoH |
sainikAnAM cha sarveShAM tayoshcha prItivardhanaH
shlokas.38:
durmukhastu maheShvAso vIraM purujitaM balI |
droNAyAbhimukhaM yAntaM kuntibhojamavArayat
shlokas.39:
sa durmukhaM bhruvormadhye nArAchena vyatADayat |
tasya tadvibabhau vaktraM sanAlamiva pa~Nkajam
shlokas.40:
karNastu kekayAnbhrAtR^Inpa~ncha lohitakadhvajAn |
droNAyAbhimukhaM yAtA~nsharavarShairavArayat
shlokas.41:
te chainaM bhRRishasa~NkruddhAH sharavrAtairavAkiran |
sa cha tA.nshChAdayAmAsa sharajAlaiH punaH punaH
shlokas.42:
naiva karNo na te pa~ncha dadRRishurbANasa.nvRRitAH |
sAshvasUtadhvajarathAH parasparasharAchitAH
shlokas.43:
putraste durjayashchaiva jayashcha vijayashcha ha |
nIlaM kAshyaM jayaM shUrAstrayastrInpratyavArayan
shlokas.44:
tadyuddhamabhavadghoramIkShitRRiprItivardhanam |
siMhavyAghratarakShUNAM yathebhamahiSharShabhaiH
shlokas.45:
kShemadhUrtibRRihantau tau bhrAtarau sAtvataM yudhi |
droNAyAbhimukhaM yAntaM sharaistIkShNaistatakShatuH
shlokas.46:
tayostasya cha tadyuddhamatyadbhutamivAbhavat |
siMhasya dvipamukhyAbhyAM prabhinnAbhyAM yathA vane
shlokas.47:
rAjAnaM tu tathAmbaShThamekaM yuddhAbhinandinam |
chedirAjaH sharAnasyankruddho droNAdavArayat
shlokas.48:
tamambaShTho.asthibhedinyA niravidhyachChalAkayA |
sa tyaktvA sasharaM chApaM rathAdbhUmimathApatat
shlokas.49:
vArdhakShemiM tu vArShNeyaM kRRipaH shAradvataH sharaiH |
akShudraH kShudrakairdroNAtkruddharUpamavArayat
shlokas.50:
yudhyantau kRRipavArShNeyau ye.apashya.nshchitrayodhinau |
te yuddhasaktamanaso nAnyA bubudhire kriyAH
shlokas.51:
saumadattistu rAjAnaM maNimantamatandritam |
paryavArayadAyAntaM yasho droNasya vardhayan
shlokas.52:
sa saumadattestvaritashChittveShvasanaketane |
punaH patAkAM sUtaM cha ChatraM chApAtayadrathAt
shlokas.53:
athAplutya rathAttUrNaM yUpaketuramitrahA |
sAshvasUtadhvajarathaM taM chakarta varAsinA
shlokas.54:
rathaM cha svaM samAsthAya dhanurAdAya chAparam |
svayaM yachChanhayAnrAjanvyadhamatpANDavIM chamUm
shlokas.55:
musalairmudgaraishchakrairbhiNDipAlaiH parashvadhaiH |
pA.nsuvAtAgnisalilairbhasmaloShThatRRiNadrumaiH
shlokas.56:
Arujanprarujanbha~njannighnanvidrAvayankShipan |
senAM vibhIShayannAyAddroNaprepsurghaTotkachaH
shlokas.57:
taM tu nAnApraharaNairnAnAyuddhavisheShaNaiH |
rAkShasaM rAkShasaH kruddhaH samAjaghne hyalambusaH
shlokas.58:
tayostadabhavadyuddhaM rakShogrAmaNimukhyayoH |
tAdRRigyAdRRikpurA vRRittaM shambarAmararAjayoH
shlokas.59:
evaM dva.ndvashatAnyAsanrathavAraNavAjinAm |
padAtInAM cha bhadraM te tava teShAM cha sa~Nkulam
shlokas.60:
naitAdRRisho dRRiShTapUrvaH sa~NgrAmo naiva cha shrutaH |
droNasyAbhAvabhAveShu prasaktAnAM yathAbhavat
shlokas.61:
idaM ghoramidaM chitramidaM raudramiti prabho |
tatra yuddhAnyadRRishyanta pratatAni bahUni cha

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
teShvevaM saMnivRRitteShu pratyudyAteShu bhAgashaH |
kathaM yuyudhire pArthA mAmakAshcha tarasvinaH
shlokas.2:
kimarjunashchApyakarotsa.nshaptakabalaM prati |
sa.nshaptakA vA pArthasya kimakurvata sa~njaya
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tathA teShu nivRRitteShu pratyudyAteShu bhAgashaH |
svayamabhyadravadbhImaM nAgAnIkena te sutaH
shlokas.4:
sa nAga iva nAgena govRRiSheNeva govRRiShaH |
samAhUtaH svayaM rAj~nA nAgAnIkamupAdravat
shlokas.5:
sa yuddhakushalaH pArtho bAhuvIryeNa chAnvitaH |
abhinatku~njarAnIkamachireNaiva mAriSha
shlokas.6:
te gajA girisa~NkAshAH kSharantaH sarvato madam |
bhImasenasya nArAchairvimukhA vimadIkRRitAH
shlokas.7:
vidhamedabhrajAlAni yathA vAyuH samantataH |
vyadhamattAnyanIkAni tathaiva pavanAtmajaH
shlokas.8:
sa teShu visRRijanbANAnbhImo nAgeShvashobhata |
bhuvaneShviva sarveShu gabhastInudito raviH
shlokas.9:
te bhImabANaiH shatashaH sa.nsyUtA vibabhurgajAH |
gabhastibhirivArkasya vyomni nAnAbalAhakAH
shlokas.10:
tathA gajAnAM kadanaM kurvANamanilAtmajam |
kruddho duryodhano.abhyetya pratyavidhyachChitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.11:
tataH kShaNena kShitipaM kShatajapratimekShaNaH |
kShayaM ninIShurnishitairbhImo vivyAdha patribhiH
shlokas.12:
sa sharArpitasarvA~NgaH kruddho vivyAdha pANDavam |
nArAchairarkarashmyAbhairbhImasenaM smayanniva
shlokas.13:
tasya nAgaM maNimayaM ratnachitraM dhvaje sthitam |
bhallAbhyAM kArmukaM chaiva kShipraM chichCheda pANDavaH
shlokas.14:
duryodhanaM pIDyamAnaM dRRiShTvA bhImena mAriSha |
chukShobhayiShurabhyAgAda~Ngo mAta~NgamAsthitaH
shlokas.15:
tamApatantaM mAta~Ngamambudapratimasvanam |
kumbhAntare bhImaseno nArAchenArdayadbhRRisham
shlokas.16:
tasya kAyaM vinirbhidya mamajja dharaNItale |
tataH papAta dvirado vajrAhata ivAchalaH
shlokas.17:
tasyAvarjitanAgasya mlechChasyAvapatiShyataH |
shirashchichCheda bhallena kShiprakArI vRRikodaraH
shlokas.18:
tasminnipatite vIre samprAdravata sA chamUH |
sambhrAntAshvadviparathA padAtInavamRRidnatI
shlokas.19:
teShvanIkeShu sarveShu vidravatsu samantataH |
prAgjyotiShastato bhImaM ku~njareNa samAdravat
shlokas.20:
yena nAgena maghavAnajayaddaityadAnavAn |
sa nAgapravaro bhImaM sahasA samupAdravat
shlokas.21:
shravaNAbhyAmatho padbhyAM saMhatena kareNa cha |
vyAvRRittanayanaH kruddhaH pradahanniva pANDavam
shlokas.22:
tataH sarvasya sainyasya nAdaH samabhavanmahAn |
hA hA vinihato bhImaH ku~njareNeti mAriSha
shlokas.23:
tena nAdena vitrastA pANDavAnAmanIkinI |
sahasAbhyadravadrAjanyatra tasthau vRRikodaraH
shlokas.24:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA hataM matvA vRRikodaram |
bhagadattaM sapA~nchAlaH sarvataH samavArayat
shlokas.25:
taM rathai rathinAM shreShThAH parivArya samantataH |
avAkira~nsharaistIkShNaiH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.26:
sa vighAtaM pRRiShatkAnAma~Nkushena samAcharan |
gajena pANDupA~nchAlAnvyadhamatparvateshvaraH
shlokas.27:
tadadbhutamapashyAma bhagadattasya sa.nyuge |
tathA vRRiddhasya charitaM ku~njareNa vishAM pate
shlokas.28:
tato rAjA dashArNAnAM prAgjyotiShamupAdravat |
tiryagyAtena nAgena samadenAshugAminA
shlokas.29:
tayoryuddhaM samabhavannAgayorbhImarUpayoH |
sapakShayoH parvatayoryathA sadrumayoH purA
shlokas.30:
prAgjyotiShapaternAgaH saMnipatyApavRRitya cha |
pArshve dashArNAdhipaterbhittvA nAgamapAtayat
shlokas.31:
tomaraiH sUryarashmyAbhairbhagadatto.atha saptabhiH |
jaghAna dviradasthaM taM shatruM prachalitAsanam
shlokas.32:
upasRRitya tu rAjAnaM bhagadattaM yudhiShThiraH |
rathAnIkena mahatA sarvataH paryavArayat
shlokas.33:
sa ku~njarastho rathibhiH shushubhe sarvato vRRitaH |
parvate vanamadhyastho jvalanniva hutAshanaH
shlokas.34:
maNDalaM sarvataH shliShTaM rathinAmugradhanvinAm |
kiratAM sharavarShANi sa nAgaH paryavartata
shlokas.35:
tataH prAgjyotiSho rAjA parigRRihya dviparShabham |
preShayAmAsa sahasA yuyudhAnarathaM prati
shlokas.36:
shineH pautrasya tu rathaM parigRRihya mahAdvipaH |
abhichikShepa vegena yuyudhAnastvapAkramat
shlokas.37:
bRRihataH saindhavAnashvAnsamutthApya tu sArathiH |
tasthau sAtyakimAsAdya samplutastaM rathaM punaH
shlokas.38:
sa tu labdhvAntaraM nAgastvarito rathamaNDalAt |
nishchakrAma tataH sarvAnparichikShepa pArthivAn
shlokas.39:
te tvAshugatinA tena trAsyamAnA nararShabhAH |
tamekaM dviradaM sa~Nkhye menire shatasho nRRipAH
shlokas.40:
te gajasthena kAlyante bhagadattena pANDavAH |
airAvatasthena yathA devarAjena dAnavAH
shlokas.41:
teShAM pradravatAM bhImaH pA~nchAlAnAmitastataH |
gajavAjikRRitaH shabdaH sumahAnsamajAyata
shlokas.42:
bhagadattena samare kAlyamAneShu pANDuShu |
prAgjyotiShamabhikruddhaH punarbhImaH samabhyayAt
shlokas.43:
tasyAbhidravato vAhAnhastamuktena vAriNA |
siktvA vyatrAsayannAgaste pArthamahara.nstataH
shlokas.44:
tatastamabhyayAttUrNaM ruchiparvAkRRitIsutaH |
samukSha~nsharavarSheNa rathastho.antakasaMnibhaH
shlokas.45:
tato ruchiraparvANaM shareNa nataparvaNA |
suparvA parvatapatirninye vaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.46:
tasminnipatite vIre saubhadro draupadIsutAH |
chekitAno dhRRiShTaketuryuyutsushchArdayandvipam
shlokas.47:
ta enaM sharadhArAbhirdhArAbhiriva toyadAH |
siShichurbhairavAnnAdAnvinadanto jighA.nsavaH
shlokas.48:
tataH pArShNya~NkushA~NguShThaiH kRRitinA chodito dvipaH |
prasAritakaraH prAyAtstabdhakarNekShaNo drutam
shlokas.49:
so.adhiShThAya padA vAhAnyuyutsoH sUtamArujat |
putrastu tava sambhrAntaH saubhadrasyApluto ratham
shlokas.50:
sa ku~njarastho visRRijanniShUnariShu pArthivaH |
babhau rashmInivAdityo bhuvaneShu samutsRRijan
shlokas.51:
tamArjunirdvAdashabhiryuyutsurdashabhiH sharaiH |
tribhistribhirdraupadeyA dhRRiShTaketushcha vivyadhuH
shlokas.52:
so.ariyatnArpitairbANairAchito dvirado babhau |
sa.nsyUta iva sUryasya rashmibhirjalado mahAn
shlokas.53:
niyantuH shilpayatnAbhyAM preShito.arisharArditaH |
parichikShepa tAnnAgaH sa ripUnsavyadakShiNam
shlokas.54:
gopAla iva daNDena yathA pashugaNAnvane |
AveShTayata tAM senAM bhagadattastathA muhuH
shlokas.55:
kShipraM shyenAbhipannAnAM vAyasAnAmiva svanaH |
babhUva pANDaveyAnAM bhRRishaM vidravatAM svanaH
shlokas.56:
sa nAgarAjaH pravarA~NkushAhataH; purA sapakSho.adrivaro yathA nRRipa |
bhayaM tathA ripuShu samAdadhadbhRRishaM; vaNiggaNAnAM kShubhito yathArNavaH
shlokas.57:
tato dhvanirdviradarathAshvapArthivai;rbhayAddravadbhirjanito.atibhairavaH |
kShitiM viyaddyAM vidisho dishastathA; samAvRRiNotpArthiva sa.nyuge tadA
shlokas.58:
sa tena nAgapravareNa pArthivo; bhRRishaM jagAhe dviShatAmanIkinIm |
purA suguptAM vibudhairivAhave; virochano devavarUthinImiva
shlokas.59:
bhRRishaM vavau jvalanasakho viyadrajaH; samAvRRiNonmuhurapi chaiva sainikAn |
tamekanAgaM gaNasho yathA gajAH; samantato drutamiva menire janAH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
yanmAM pArthasya sa~NgrAme karmANi paripRRichChasi |
tachChRRiNuShva mahArAja pArtho yadakaronmRRidhe
shlokas.2:
rajo dRRiShTvA samudbhUtaM shrutvA cha gajanisvanam |
bhajyatAM bhagadattena kaunteyaH kRRiShNamabravIt
shlokas.3:
yathA prAgjyotiSho rAjA gajena madhusUdana |
tvaramANo.abhyatikrAnto dhruvaM tasyaiSha nisvanaH
shlokas.4:
indrAdanavaraH sa~Nkhye gajayAnavishAradaH |
prathamo vA dvitIyo vA pRRithivyAmiti me matiH
shlokas.5:
sa chApi dviradashreShThaH sadApratigajo yudhi |
sarvashabdAtigaH sa~Nkhye kRRitakarmA jitaklamaH
shlokas.6:
sahaH shastranipAtAnAmagnisparshasya chAnagha |
sa pANDavabalaM vyaktamadyaiko nAshayiShyati
shlokas.7:
na chAvAbhyAmRRite.anyo.asti shaktastaM pratibAdhitum |
tvaramANastato yAhi yataH prAgjyotiShAdhipaH
shlokas.8:
shakrasakhyAddvipabalairvayasA chApi vismitam |
adyainaM preShayiShyAmi balahantuH priyAtithim
shlokas.9:
vachanAdatha kRRiShNastu prayayau savyasAchinaH |
dAryate bhagadattena yatra pANDavavAhinI
shlokas.10:
taM prayAntaM tataH pashchAdAhvayanto mahArathAH |
sa.nshaptakAH samArohansahasrANi chaturdasha
shlokas.11:
dashaiva tu sahasrANi trigartAnAM narAdhipa |
chatvAri tu sahasrANi vAsudevasya ye.anugAH
shlokas.12:
dAryamANAM chamUM dRRiShTvA bhagadattena mAriSha |
AhUyamAnasya cha tairabhavaddhRRidayaM dvidhA
shlokas.13:
kiM nu shreyaskaraM karma bhavediti vichintayan |
ito vA vinivarteyaM gachCheyaM vA yudhiShThiram
shlokas.14:
tasya buddhyA vichAryaitadarjunasya kurUdvaha |
abhavadbhUyasI buddhiH sa.nshaptakavadhe sthirA
shlokas.15:
sa saMnivRRittaH sahasA kapipravaraketanaH |
eko rathasahasrANi nihantuM vAsavI raNe
shlokas.16:
sA hi duryodhanasyAsInmatiH karNasya chobhayoH |
arjunasya vadhopAye tena dvaidhamakalpayat
shlokas.17:
sa tu sa.nvartayAmAsa dvaidhIbhAvena pANDavaH |
rathena tu rathAgryANAmakarottAM mRRiShA tadA
shlokas.18:
tataH shatasahasrANi sharANAM nataparvaNAm |
vyasRRijannarjune rAjansa.nshaptakamahArathAH
shlokas.19:
naiva kuntIsutaH pArtho naiva kRRiShNo janArdanaH |
na hayA na ratho rAjandRRishyante sma sharaishchitAH
shlokas.20:
yadA mohamanuprAptaH sasvedashcha janArdanaH |
tatastAnprAyashaH pArtho vajrAstreNa nijaghnivAn
shlokas.21:
shatashaH pANayashChinnAH seShujyAtalakArmukAH |
ketavo vAjinaH sUtA rathinashchApatankShitau
shlokas.22:
drumAchalAgrAmbudharaiH samarUpAH sukalpitAH |
hatArohAH kShitau peturdvipAH pArthasharAhatAH
shlokas.23:
vipraviddhakuthAvalgAshChinnabhANDAH parAsavaH |
sArohAsturagAH peturmathitAH pArthamArgaNaiH
shlokas.24:
sarShTicharmAsinakharAH samudgaraparashvadhAH |
sa~nChinnA bAhavaH peturnRRiNAM bhallaiH kirITinA
shlokas.25:
bAlAdityAmbujendUnAM tulyarUpANi mAriSha |
sa~nChinnAnyarjunasharaiH shirA.nsyurvIM prapedire
shlokas.26:
jajvAlAla~NkRRitaiH senA patribhiH prANabhojanaiH |
nAnAli~NgaistadAmitrAnkruddhe nighnati phalgune
shlokas.27:
kShobhayantaM tadA senAM dviradaM nalinImiva |
dhana~njayaM bhUtagaNAH sAdhu sAdhvityapUjayan
shlokas.28:
dRRiShTvA tatkarma pArthasya vAsavasyeva mAdhavaH |
vismayaM paramaM gatvA talamAhatya pUjayat
shlokas.29:
tataH sa.nshaptakAnhatvA bhUyiShThaM ye vyavasthitAH |
bhagadattAya yAhIti pArthaH kRRiShNamachodayat

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
yiyAsatastataH kRRiShNaH pArthasyAshvAnmanojavAn |
apraiShIddhemasa~nChannAndroNAnIkAya pANDurAn
shlokas.2:
taM prayAntaM kurushreShThaM svA.nstrAtuM droNatApitAn |
susharmA bhrAtRRibhiH sArdhaM yuddhArthI pRRiShThato.anvayAt
shlokas.3:
tataH shvetahayaH kRRiShNamabravIdajitaM jayaH |
eSha mAM bhrAtRRibhiH sArdhaM susharmAhvayate.achyuta
shlokas.4:
dIryate chottareNaitatsainyaM naH shatrusUdana |
dvaidhIbhUtaM mano me.adya kRRitaM sa.nshaptakairidam
shlokas.5:
kiM nu sa.nshaptakAnhanmi svAnrakShAmyahitArditAn |
iti me tvaM mataM vettha tatra kiM sukRRitaM bhavet
shlokas.6:
evamuktastu dAshArhaH syandanaM pratyavartayat |
yena trigartAdhipatiH pANDavaM samupAhvayat
shlokas.7:
tato.arjunaH susharmANaM viddhvA saptabhirAshugaiH |
dhvajaM dhanushchAsya tathA kShurAbhyAM samakRRintata
shlokas.8:
trigartAdhipateshchApi bhrAtaraM ShaDbhirAyasaiH |
sAshvaM sasUtaM tvaritaH pArthaH praiShIdyamakShayam
shlokas.9:
tato bhujagasa~NkAshAM susharmA shaktimAyasIm |
chikShepArjunamAdishya vAsudevAya tomaram
shlokas.10:
shaktiM tribhiH sharaishChittvA tomaraM tribhirarjunaH |
susharmANaM sharavrAtairmohayitvA nyavartata
shlokas.11:
taM vAsavamivAyAntaM bhUrivarShasharaughiNam |
rAja.nstAvakasainyAnAM nograM kashchidavArayat
shlokas.12:
tato dhana~njayo bANaistata eva mahArathAn |
AyAdvinighnankauravyAndahankakShamivAnalaH
shlokas.13:
tasya vegamasahyaM tu kuntIputrasya dhImataH |
nAshaknuva.nste sa.nsoDhuM sparshamagneriva prajAH
shlokas.14:
sa.nveShTayannanIkAni sharavarSheNa pANDavaH |
suparNapAtavadrAjannAyAtprAgjyotiShaM prati
shlokas.15:
yattadAnAmayajjiShNurbharatAnAmapAyinAm |
dhanuH kShemakaraM sa~Nkhye dviShatAmashruvardhanam
shlokas.16:
tadeva tava putrasya rAjandurdyUtadevinaH |
kRRite kShatravinAshAya dhanurAyachChadarjunaH
shlokas.17:
tathA vikShobhyamANA sA pArthena tava vAhinI |
vyadIryata mahArAja naurivAsAdya parvatam
shlokas.18:
tato dasha sahasrANi nyavartanta dhanuShmatAm |
matiM kRRitvA raNe kruddhA vIrA jayaparAjaye
shlokas.19:
vyapetahRRidayatrAsa ApaddharmAtigo rathaH |
ArChatpArtho guruM bhAraM sarvabhArasaho yudhi
shlokas.20:
yathA naDavanaM kruddhaH prabhinnaH ShaShTihAyanaH |
mRRidnIyAttadvadAyastaH pArtho.amRRidnAchchamUM tava
shlokas.21:
tasminpramathite sainye bhagadatto narAdhipaH |
tena nAgena sahasA dhana~njayamupAdravat
shlokas.22:
taM rathena naravyAghraH pratyagRRihNAdabhItavat |
sa saMnipAtastumulo babhUva rathanAgayoH
shlokas.23:
kalpitAbhyAM yathAshAstraM rathena cha gajena cha |
sa~NgrAme cheraturvIrau bhagadattadhana~njayau
shlokas.24:
tato jImUtasa~NkAshAnnAgAdindra ivAbhibhUH |
abhyavarShachCharaugheNa bhagadatto dhana~njayam
shlokas.25:
sa chApi sharavarShaM tachCharavarSheNa vAsaviH |
aprAptameva chichCheda bhagadattasya vIryavAn
shlokas.26:
tataH prAgjyotiSho rAjA sharavarShaM nivArya tat |
sharairjaghne mahAbAhuM pArthaM kRRiShNaM cha bhArata
shlokas.27:
tataH sa sharajAlena mahatAbhyavakIrya tau |
chodayAmAsa taM nAgaM vadhAyAchyutapArthayoH
shlokas.28:
tamApatantaM dviradaM dRRiShTvA kruddhamivAntakam |
chakre.apasavyaM tvaritaH syandanena janArdanaH
shlokas.29:
samprAptamapi neyeSha parAvRRittaM mahAdvipam |
sArohaM mRRityusAtkartuM smarandharmaM dhana~njayaH
shlokas.30:
sa tu nAgo dviparathAnhayA.nshchArujya mAriSha |
prAhiNonmRRityulokAya tato.akrudhyaddhana~njayaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tathA kruddhaH kimakarodbhagadattasya pANDavaH |
prAgjyotiSho vA pArthasya tanme sha.nsa yathAtatham
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
prAgjyotiSheNa sa.nsaktAvubhau dAshArhapANDavau |
mRRityorivAntikaM prAptau sarvabhUtAni menire
shlokas.3:
tathA hi sharavarShANi pAtayatyanishaM prabho |
bhagadatto gajaskandhAtkRRiShNayoH syandanasthayoH
shlokas.4:
atha kArShNAyasairbANaiH pUrNakArmukaniHsRRitaiH |
avidhyaddevakIputraM hemapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH
shlokas.5:
agnisparshasamAstIkShNA bhagadattena choditAH |
nirbhidya devakIputraM kShitiM jagmuH sharAstataH
shlokas.6:
tasya pArtho dhanushChittvA sharAvApaM nihatya cha |
lADayanniva rAjAnaM bhagadattamayodhayat
shlokas.7:
so.arkarashminibhA.nstIkShNA.nstomarAnvai chaturdasha |
prerayatsavyasAchI tA.nstridhaikaikamathAchChinat
shlokas.8:
tato nAgasya tadvarma vyadhamatpAkashAsaniH |
sharajAlena sa babhau vyabhraH parvatarADiva
shlokas.9:
tataH prAgjyotiShaH shaktiM hemadaNDAmayasmayIm |
vyasRRijadvAsudevAya dvidhA tAmarjuno.achChinat
shlokas.10:
tatashChatraM dhvajaM chaiva ChittvA rAj~no.arjunaH sharaiH |
vivyAdha dashabhistUrNamutsmayanparvatAdhipam
shlokas.11:
so.atividdho.arjunasharaiH supu~NkhaiH ka~NkapatribhiH |
bhagadattastataH kruddhaH pANDavasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.12:
vyasRRijattomarAnmUrdhni shvetAshvasyonnanAda cha |
tairarjunasya samare kirITaM parivartitam
shlokas.13:
parivRRittaM kirITaM taM yamayanneva phalgunaH |
sudRRiShTaH kriyatAM loka iti rAjAnamabravIt
shlokas.14:
evamuktastu sa~NkruddhaH sharavarSheNa pANDavam |
abhyavarShatsagovindaM dhanurAdAya bhAsvaram
shlokas.15:
tasya pArtho dhanushChittvA tUNIrAnsaMnikRRitya cha |
tvaramANo dvisaptatyA sarvamarmasvatADayat
shlokas.16:
viddhastathApyavyathito vaiShNavAstramudIrayan |
abhimantryA~NkushaM kruddho vyasRRijatpANDavorasi
shlokas.17:
visRRiShTaM bhagadattena tadastraM sarvaghAtakam |
urasA pratijagrAha pArthaM sa~nChAdya keshavaH
shlokas.18:
vaijayantyabhavanmAlA tadastraM keshavorasi |
tato.arjunaH klAntamanAH keshavaM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.19:
ayudhyamAnasturagAnsa.nyantAsmi janArdana |
ityuktvA puNDarIkAkSha pratij~nAM svAM na rakShasi
shlokas.20:
yadyahaM vyasanI vA syAmashakto vA nivAraNe |
tatastvayaivaM kAryaM syAnna tu kAryaM mayi sthite
shlokas.21:
sabANaH sadhanushchAhaM sasurAsuramAnavAn |
shakto lokAnimA~njetuM tachchApi viditaM tava
shlokas.22:
tato.arjunaM vAsudevaH pratyuvAchArthavadvachaH |
shRRiNu guhyamidaM pArtha yathA vRRittaM purAnagha
shlokas.23:
chaturmUrtirahaM shashvallokatrANArthamudyataH |
AtmAnaM pravibhajyeha lokAnAM hitamAdadhe
shlokas.24:
ekA mUrtistapashcharyAM kurute me bhuvi sthitA |
aparA pashyati jagatkurvANaM sAdhvasAdhunI
shlokas.25:
aparA kurute karma mAnuShaM lokamAshritA |
shete chaturthI tvaparA nidrAM varShasahasrikAm
shlokas.26:
yAsau varShasahasrAnte mUrtiruttiShThate mama |
varArhebhyo varA~nshreShThA.nstasminkAle dadAti sA
shlokas.27:
taM tu kAlamanuprAptaM viditvA pRRithivI tadA |
prAyAchata varaM yaM mAM narakArthAya taM shRRiNu
shlokas.28:
devAnAmasurANAM cha avadhyastanayo.astu me |
upeto vaiShNavAstreNa tanme tvaM dAtumarhasi
shlokas.29:
evaM varamahaM shrutvA jagatyAstanaye tadA |
amoghamastramadadaM vaiShNavaM tadahaM purA
shlokas.30:
avochaM chaitadastraM vai hyamoghaM bhavatu kShame |
narakasyAbhirakShArthaM nainaM kashchidvadhiShyati
shlokas.31:
anenAstreNa te guptaH sutaH parabalArdanaH |
bhaviShyati durAdharShaH sarvalokeShu sarvadA
shlokas.32:
tathetyuktvA gatA devI kRRitakAmA manasvinI |
sa chApyAsIddurAdharSho narakaH shatrutApanaH
shlokas.33:
tasmAtprAgjyotiShaM prAptaM tadastraM pArtha mAmakam |
nAsyAvadhyo.asti lokeShu sendrarudreShu mAriSha
shlokas.34:
tanmayA tvatkRRitenaitadanyathA vyapanAshitam |
viyuktaM paramAstreNa jahi pArtha mahAsuram
shlokas.35:
vairiNaM yudhi durdharShaM bhagadattaM suradviSham |
yathAhaM jaghnivAnpUrvaM hitArthaM narakaM tathA
shlokas.36:
evamuktastataH pArthaH keshavena mahAtmanA |
bhagadattaM shitairbANaiH sahasA samavAkirat
shlokas.37:
tataH pArtho mahAbAhurasambhrAnto mahAmanAH |
kumbhayorantare nAgaM nArAchena samArpayat
shlokas.38:
samAsAdya tu taM nAgaM bANo vajra ivAchalam |
abhyagAtsaha pu~Nkhena valmIkamiva pannagaH
shlokas.39:
sa tu viShTabhya gAtrANi dantAbhyAmavaniM yayau |
nadannArtasvaraM prANAnutsasarja mahAdvipaH
shlokas.40:
tatashchandrArdhabimbena shareNa nataparvaNA |
bibheda hRRidayaM rAj~no bhagadattasya pANDavaH
shlokas.41:
sa bhinnahRRidayo rAjA bhagadattaH kirITinA |
sharAsanaM sharA.nshchaiva gatAsuH pramumocha ha
shlokas.42:
shirasastasya vibhraShTaH papAta cha varA~NkushaH |
nAlatADanavibhraShTaM palAshaM nalinAdiva
shlokas.43:
sa hemamAlI tapanIyabhANDA;tpapAta nAgAdgirisaMnikAshAt |
supuShpito mArutavegarugNo; mahIdharAgrAdiva karNikAraH
shlokas.44:
nihatya taM narapatimindravikramaM; sakhAyamindrasya tathaindrirAhave |
tato.aparA.nstava jayakA~NkShiNo narA;nbabha~nja vAyurbalavAndrumAniva

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
priyamindrasya satataM sakhAyamamitaujasam |
hatvA prAgjyotiShaM pArthaH pradakShiNamavartata
shlokas.2:
tato gAndhArarAjasya sutau parapura~njayau |
ArChetAmarjunaM sa~Nkhye bhrAtarau vRRiShakAchalau
shlokas.3:
tau sametyArjunaM vIrau puraH pashchAchcha dhanvinau |
avidhyetAM mahAvegairnishitairAshugairbhRRisham
shlokas.4:
vRRiShakasya hayAnsUtaM dhanushChatraM rathaM dhvajam |
tilasho vyadhamatpArthaH saubalasya shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.5:
tato.arjunaH sharavrAtairnAnApraharaNairapi |
gAndhArAnvyAkulA.nshchakre saubalapramukhAnpunaH
shlokas.6:
tataH pa~nchashatAnvIrAngAndhArAnudyatAyudhAn |
prAhiNonmRRityulokAya kruddho bANairdhana~njayaH
shlokas.7:
hatAshvAttu rathAttUrNamavatIrya mahAbhujaH |
Aruroha rathaM bhrAturanyachcha dhanurAdade
shlokas.8:
tAvekarathamArUDhau bhrAtarau vRRiShakAchalau |
sharavarSheNa bIbhatsumavidhyetAM punaH punaH
shlokas.9:
syAlau tava mahAtmAnau rAjAnau vRRiShakAchalau |
bhRRishaM nijaghnatuH pArthamindraM vRRitrabalAviva
shlokas.10:
labdhalakShyau tu gAndhArAvahatAM pANDavaM punaH |
nidAghavArShikau mAsau lokaM gharmAmbubhiryathA
shlokas.11:
tau rathasthau naravyAghrau rAjAnau vRRiShakAchalau |
sa.nshliShTA~Ngau sthitau rAja~njaghAnaikeShuNArjunaH
shlokas.12:
tau rathAtsiMhasa~NkAshau lohitAkShau mahAbhujau |
gatAsU petaturvIrau sodaryAvekalakShaNau
shlokas.13:
tayordehau rathAdbhUmiM gatau bandhujanapriyau |
yasho dasha dishaH puNyaM gamayitvA vyavasthitau
shlokas.14:
dRRiShTvA vinihatau sa~Nkhye mAtulAvapalAyinau |
bhRRishaM mumuchurashrUNi putrAstava vishAM pate
shlokas.15:
nihatau bhrAtarau dRRiShTvA mAyAshatavishAradaH |
kRRiShNau saMmohayanmAyAM vidadhe shakunistataH
shlokas.16:
laguDAyoguDAshmAnaH shataghnyashcha sashaktayaH |
gadAparighanistri.nshashUlamudgarapaTTishAH
shlokas.17:
sakampanarShTinakharA musalAni parashvadhAH |
kShurAH kShurapranAlIkA vatsadantAstrisandhinaH
shlokas.18:
chakrANi vishikhAH prAsA vividhAnyAyudhAni cha |
prapetuH sarvato digbhyaH pradigbhyashchArjunaM prati
shlokas.19:
kharoShTramahiShAH siMhA vyAghrAH sRRimarachillikAH |
RRikShAH sAlAvRRikA gRRidhrAH kapayo.atha sarIsRRipAH
shlokas.20:
vividhAni cha rakShA.nsi kShudhitAnyarjunaM prati |
sa~NkruddhAnyabhyadhAvanta vividhAni vayA.nsi cha
shlokas.21:
tato divyAstravichChUraH kuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
visRRijanniShujAlAni sahasA tAnyatADayat
shlokas.22:
te hanyamAnAH shUreNa pravaraiH sAyakairdRRiDhaiH |
viruvanto mahArAvAnvineshuH sarvato hatAH
shlokas.23:
tatastamaH prAdurabhUdarjunasya rathaM prati |
tasmAchcha tamaso vAchaH krUrAH pArthamabhartsayan
shlokas.24:
tattamo.astreNa mahatA jyotiSheNArjuno.avadhIt |
hate tasmi~njalaughAstu prAdurAsanbhayAnakAH
shlokas.25:
ambhasastasya nAshArthamAdityAstramathArjunaH |
prAyu~NktAmbhastatastena prAyasho.astreNa shoShitam
shlokas.26:
evaM bahuvidhA mAyAH saubalasya kRRitAH kRRitAH |
jaghAnAstrabalenAshu prahasannarjunastadA
shlokas.27:
tathA hatAsu mAyAsu trasto.arjunasharAhataH |
apAyAjjavanairashvaiH shakuniH prAkRRito yathA
shlokas.28:
tato.arjuno.astravichChraiShThyaM darshayannAtmano.ariShu |
abhyavarShachCharaugheNa kauravANAmanIkinIm
shlokas.29:
sA hanyamAnA pArthena putrasya tava vAhinI |
dvaidhIbhUtA mahArAja ga~NgevAsAdya parvatam
shlokas.30:
droNamevAnvapadyanta kechittatra mahArathAH |
kechidduryodhanaM rAjannardyamAnAH kirITinA
shlokas.31:
nApashyAma tatastvetatsainyaM vai tamasAvRRitam |
gANDIvasya cha nirghoShaH shruto dakShiNato mayA
shlokas.32:
sha~NkhadundubhinirghoShaM vAditrANAM cha nisvanam |
gANDIvasya cha nirghoSho vyatikramyAspRRishaddivam
shlokas.33:
tataH punardakShiNataH sa~NgrAmashchitrayodhinAm |
suyuddhamarjunasyAsIdahaM tu droNamanvagAm
shlokas.34:
nAnAvidhAnyanIkAni putrANAM tava bhArata |
arjuno vyadhamatkAle divIvAbhrANi mArutaH
shlokas.35:
taM vAsavamivAyAntaM bhUrivarShasharaughiNam |
maheShvAsaM naravyAghraM nograM kashchidavArayat
shlokas.36:
te hanyamAnAH pArthena tvadIyA vyathitA bhRRisham |
svAneva bahavo jaghnurvidravantastatastataH
shlokas.37:
te.arjunena sharA muktAH ka~NkapatrAstanuchChidaH |
shalabhA iva sampetuH sa.nvRRiNvAnA disho dasha
shlokas.38:
turagaM rathinaM nAgaM padAtimapi mAriSha |
vinirbhidya kShitiM jagmurvalmIkamiva pannagAH
shlokas.39:
na cha dvitIyaM vyasRRijatku~njarAshvanareShu saH |
pRRithagekasharArugNA nipetuste gatAsavaH
shlokas.40:
hatairmanuShyaisturagaishcha sarvataH; sharAbhivRRiShTairdviradaishcha pAtitaiH |
tadA shvagomAyubaDAbhinAditaM; vichitramAyodhashiro babhUva ha
shlokas.41:
pitA sutaM tyajati suhRRidvaraM suhRRi;ttathaiva putraH pitaraM sharAturaH |
svarakShaNe kRRitamatayastadA janA;styajanti vAhAnapi pArthapIDitAH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
teShvanIkeShu bhagneShu pANDuputreNa sa~njaya |
chalitAnAM drutAnAM cha kathamAsInmano hi vaH
shlokas.2:
anIkAnAM prabhagnAnAM vyavasthAnamapashyatAm |
duShkaraM pratisandhAnaM tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tathApi tava putrasya priyakAmA vishAM pate |
yashaH pravIrA lokeShu rakShanto droNamanvayuH
shlokas.4:
samudyateShu shastreShu samprApte cha yudhiShThire |
akurvannAryakarmANi bhairave satyabhItavat
shlokas.5:
antaraM bhImasenasya prApatannamitaujasaH |
sAtyakeshchaiva shUrasya dhRRiShTadyumnasya chAbhibho
shlokas.6:
droNaM droNamiti krUrAH pA~nchAlAH samachodayan |
mA droNamiti putrAste kurUnsarvAnachodayan
shlokas.7:
droNaM droNamiti hyeke mA droNamiti chApare |
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha droNadyUtamavartata
shlokas.8:
yaM yaM sma bhajate droNaH pA~nchAlAnAM rathavrajam |
tatra tatra sma pA~nchAlyo dhRRiShTadyumno.atha dhIyate
shlokas.9:
yathAbhAgaviparyAse sa~NgrAme bhairave sati |
vIrAH samAsadanvIrAnagachChanbhIravaH parAn
shlokas.10:
akampanIyAH shatrUNAM babhUvustatra pANDavAH |
akampaya.nstvanIkAni smarantaH kleshamAtmanaH
shlokas.11:
te tvamarShavashaM prAptA hrImantaH sattvachoditAH |
tyaktvA prANAnnyavartanta ghnanto droNaM mahAhave
shlokas.12:
ayasAmiva sampAtaH shilAnAmiva chAbhavat |
dIvyatAM tumule yuddhe prANairamitatejasAm
shlokas.13:
na tu smaranti sa~NgrAmamapi vRRiddhAstathAvidham |
dRRiShTapUrvaM mahArAja shrutapUrvamathApi vA
shlokas.14:
prAkampateva pRRithivI tasminvIrAvasAdane |
pravartatA balaughena mahatA bhArapIDitA
shlokas.15:
ghUrNato hi balaughasya divaM stabdhveva nisvanaH |
ajAtashatroH kruddhasya putrasya tava chAbhavat
shlokas.16:
samAsAdya tu pANDUnAmanIkAni sahasrashaH |
droNena charatA sa~Nkhye prabhagnAni shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.17:
teShu pramathyamAneShu droNenAdbhutakarmaNA |
paryavArayadAsAdya droNaM senApatiH svayam
shlokas.18:
tadadbhutamabhUdyuddhaM droNapA~nchAlyayostadA |
naiva tasyopamA kAchitsambhavediti me matiH
shlokas.19:
tato nIlo.analaprakhyo dadAha kuruvAhinIm |
sharasphuli~NgashchApArchirdahankakShamivAnalaH
shlokas.20:
taM dahantamanIkAni droNaputraH pratApavAn |
pUrvAbhibhAShI sushlakShNaM smayamAno.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.21:
nIla kiM bahubhirdagdhaistava yodhaiH sharArchiShA |
mayaikena hi yudhyasva kruddhaH prahara chAshugaiH
shlokas.22:
taM padmanikarAkAraM padmapatranibhekShaNam |
vyAkoshapadmAbhamukhaM nIlo vivyAdha sAyakaiH
shlokas.23:
tenAtividdhaH sahasA drauNirbhallaiH shitaistribhiH |
dhanurdhvajaM cha ChatraM cha dviShataH sa nyakRRintata
shlokas.24:
sotplutya syandanAttasmAnnIlashcharmavarAsidhRRik |
droNAyaneH shiraH kAyAddhartumaichChatpatatrivat
shlokas.25:
tasyodyatAseH sunasaM shiraH kAyAtsakuNDalam |
bhallenApAharaddrauNiH smayamAna ivAnagha
shlokas.26:
sampUrNachandrAbhamukhaH padmapatranibhekShaNaH |
prA.nshurutpalagarbhAbho nihato nyapatatkShitau
shlokas.27:
tataH pravivyathe senA pANDavI bhRRishamAkulA |
AchAryaputreNa hate nIle jvalitatejasi
shlokas.28:
achintaya.nshcha te sarve pANDavAnAM mahArathAH |
kathaM no vAsavistrAyAchChatrubhya iti mAriSha
shlokas.29:
dakShiNena tu senAyAH kurute kadanaM balI |
sa.nshaptakAvasheShasya nArAyaNabalasya cha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
pratighAtaM tu sainyasya nAmRRiShyata vRRikodaraH |
so.abhinadbAhlikaM ShaShTyA karNaM cha dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.2:
tasya droNaH shitairbANaistIkShNadhArairayasmayaiH |
jIvitAntamabhiprepsurmarmaNyAshu jaghAna ha
shlokas.3:
karNo dvAdashabhirbANairashvatthAmA cha saptabhiH |
ShaDbhirduryodhano rAjA tata enamavAkirat
shlokas.4:
bhImaseno.api tAnsarvAnpratyavidhyanmahAbalaH |
droNaM pa~nchAshateShUNAM karNaM cha dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.5:
duryodhanaM dvAdashabhirdrauNiM chAShTAbhirAshugaiH |
ArAvaM tumulaM kurvannabhyavartata tAnraNe
shlokas.6:
tasminsantyajati prANAnmRRityusAdhAraNIkRRite |
ajAtashatrustAnyodhAnbhImaM trAtetyachodayat
shlokas.7:
te yayurbhImasenasya samIpamamitaujasaH |
yuyudhAnaprabhRRitayo mAdrIputrau cha pANDavau
shlokas.8:
te sametya susa.nrabdhAH sahitAH puruSharShabhAH |
maheShvAsavarairguptaM droNAnIkaM bibhitsavaH
shlokas.9:
samApeturmahAvIryA bhImaprabhRRitayo rathAH |
tAnpratyagRRihNAdavyagro droNo.api rathinAM varaH
shlokas.10:
mahAbalAnatirathAnvIrAnsamarashobhinaH |
bAhyaM mRRityubhayaM kRRitvA tAvakAH pANDavAnyayuH
shlokas.11:
sAdinaH sAdino.abhyaghna.nstathaiva rathino rathAn |
AsIchChaktyasisampAto yuddhamAsItparashvadhaiH
shlokas.12:
nikRRiShTamasiyuddhaM cha babhUva kaTukodayam |
ku~njarANAM cha sa~NghAtairyuddhamAsItsudAruNam
shlokas.13:
apatatku~njarAdanyo hayAdanyastvavAkShirAH |
naro bANena nirbhinno rathAdanyashcha mAriSha
shlokas.14:
tatrAnyasya cha saMmarde patitasya vivarmaNaH |
shiraH pradhva.nsayAmAsa vakShasyAkramya ku~njaraH
shlokas.15:
apare.apyaparA~njaghnurvAraNAH patitAnnarAn |
viShANaishchAvaniM gatvA vyabhindanrathino bahUn
shlokas.16:
narAntraiH kechidapare viShANAlagnasa.nsravaiH |
babhramuH shatasho nAgA mRRidnantaH shatasho narAn
shlokas.17:
kA.nsyAyasatanutrANAnnarAshvarathaku~njarAn |
patitAnpothayAM chakrurdvipAH sthUlanaDAniva
shlokas.18:
gRRidhrapatrAdhivAsA.nsi shayanAni narAdhipAH |
hrImantaH kAlasampakvAH suduHkhAnyadhisherate
shlokas.19:
hanti smAtra pitA putraM rathenAbhyativartate |
putrashcha pitaraM mohAnnirmaryAdamavartata
shlokas.20:
akSho bhagno dhvajashChinnashChatramurvyAM nipAtitam |
yugArdhaM ChinnamAdAya pradudrAva tathA hayaH
shlokas.21:
sAsirbAhurnipatitaH shirashChinnaM sakuNDalam |
gajenAkShipya balinA rathaH sa~nchUrNitaH kShitau
shlokas.22:
rathinA tADito nAgo nArAchenApatadvyasuH |
sArohashchApatadvAjI gajenAtADito bhRRisham
shlokas.23:
nirmaryAdaM mahadyuddhamavartata sudAruNam |
hA tAta hA putra sakhe kvAsi tiShTha kva dhAvasi
shlokas.24:
praharAhara jahyenaM smitakShveDitagarjitaiH |
ityevamuchcharantyaH sma shrUyante vividhA giraH
shlokas.25:
narasyAshvasya nAgasya samasajjata shoNitam |
upAshAmyadrajo bhaumaM bhIrUnkashmalamAvishat
shlokas.26:
AsItkeshaparAmarsho muShTiyuddhaM cha dAruNam |
nakhairdantaishcha shUrANamadvIpe dvIpamichChatAm
shlokas.27:
tatrAchChidyata vIrasya sakhaDgo bAhurudyataH |
sadhanushchAparasyApi sasharaH sA~NkushastathA
shlokas.28:
prAkroshadanyamanyo.atra tathAnyo vimukho.adravat |
anyaH prAptasya chAnyasya shiraH kAyAdapAharat
shlokas.29:
shabdamabhyadravachchAnyaH shabdAdanyo.adravadbhRRisham |
svAnanyo.atha parAnanyo jaghAna nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.30:
girishRRi~NgopamashchAtra nArAchena nipAtitaH |
mAta~Ngo nyapatadbhUmau nadIrodha ivoShNage
shlokas.31:
tathaiva rathinaM nAgaH kSharangiririvArujat |
adhyatiShThatpadA bhUmau sahAshvaM sahasArathim
shlokas.32:
shUrAnpraharato dRRiShTvA kRRitAstrAnrudhirokShitAn |
bahUnapyAvishanmoho bhIrUnhRRidayadurbalAn
shlokas.33:
sarvamAvignamabhavanna prAj~nAyata ki~nchana |
sainye cha rajasA dhvaste nirmaryAdamavartata
shlokas.34:
tataH senApatiH shIghramayaM kAla iti bruvan |
nityAbhitvaritAneva tvarayAmAsa pANDavAn
shlokas.35:
kurvantaH shAsanaM tasya pANDaveyA yashasvinaH |
saro ha.nsA ivApeturghnanto droNarathaM prati
shlokas.36:
gRRihNItAdravatAnyonyaM vibhItA vinikRRintata |
ityAsIttumulaH shabdo durdharShasya rathaM prati
shlokas.37:
tato droNaH kRRipaH karNo drauNI rAjA jayadrathaH |
vindAnuvindAvavantyau shalyashchainAnavArayan
shlokas.38:
te tvAryadharmasa.nrabdhA durnivAryA durAsadAH |
sharArtA na juhurdroNaM pA~nchAlAH pANDavaiH saha
shlokas.39:
tato droNo.abhisa~Nkruddho visRRija~nshatashaH sharAn |
chedipA~nchAlapANDUnAmakarotkadanaM mahat
shlokas.40:
tasya jyAtalanirghoShaH shushruve dikShu mAriSha |
vajrasa~NghAtasa~NkAshastrAsayanpANDavAnbahUn
shlokas.41:
etasminnantare jiShNurhatvA sa.nshaptakAnbalI |
abyayAttatra yatra sma droNaH pANDUnpramardati
shlokas.42:
taM sharaughamahAvartaM shoNitodaM mahAhradam |
tIrNaH sa.nshaptakAnhatvA pratyadRRishyata phalgunaH
shlokas.43:
tasya kIrtimato lakShma sUryapratimatejasaH |
dIpyamAnamapashyAma tejasA vAnaradhvajam
shlokas.44:
sa.nshaptakasamudraM tamuchChoShyAstragabhastibhiH |
sa pANDavayugAntArkaH kurUnapyabhyatItapat
shlokas.45:
pradadAha kurUnsarvAnarjunaH shastratejasA |
yugAnte sarvabhUtAni dhUmaketurivotthitaH
shlokas.46:
tena bANasahasraughairgajAshvarathayodhinaH |
tADyamAnAH kShitiM jagmurmuktashastrAH sharArditAH
shlokas.47:
kechidArtasvaraM chakrurvinedurapare punaH |
pArthabANahatAH kechinnipeturvigatAsavaH
shlokas.48:
teShAmutpatatAM kA.nshchitpatitA.nshcha parA~NmukhAn |
na jaghAnArjuno yodhAnyodhavratamanusmaran
shlokas.49:
te vishIrNarathAshvebhAH prAyashashcha parA~NmukhAH |
kuravaH karNa karNeti hA heti cha vichukrushuH
shlokas.50:
tamAdhirathirAkrandaM vij~nAya sharaNaiShiNAm |
mA bhaiShTeti pratishrutya yayAvabhimukho.arjunam
shlokas.51:
sa bhAratarathashreShThaH sarvabhArataharShaNaH |
prAdushchakre tadAgneyamastramastravidAM varaH
shlokas.52:
tasya dIptasharaughasya dIptachApadharasya cha |
sharaughA~nsharajAlena vidudhAva dhana~njayaH
astramastreNa sa.nvArya prANadadvisRRija~nsharAn
shlokas.53:
dhRRiShTadyumnashcha bhImashcha sAtyakishcha mahArathaH |
vivyadhuH karNamAsAdya tribhistribhirajihmagaiH
shlokas.54:
arjunAstraM tu rAdheyaH sa.nvArya sharavRRiShTibhiH |
teShAM trayANAM chApAni chichCheda vishikhaistribhiH
shlokas.55:
te nikRRittAyudhAH shUrA nirviShA bhujagA iva |
rathashaktIH samutkShipya bhRRishaM siMhA ivAnadan
shlokas.56:
tA bhujAgrairmahAvegA visRRiShTA bhujagopamAH |
dIpyamAnA mahAshaktyo jagmurAdhirathiM prati
shlokas.57:
tA nikRRitya shitairbANaistribhistribhirajihmagaiH |
nanAda balavAnkarNaH pArthAya visRRija~nsharAn
shlokas.58:
arjunashchApi rAdheyaM viddhvA saptabhirAshugaiH |
karNAdavarajaM bANairjaghAna nishitaistribhiH
shlokas.59:
tataH shatru~njayaM hatvA pArthaH ShaDbhirajihmagaiH |
jahAra sadyo bhallena vipATasya shiro rathAt
shlokas.60:
pashyatAM dhArtarAShTrANAmekenaiva kirITinA |
pramukhe sUtaputrasya sodaryA nihatAstrayaH
shlokas.61:
tato bhImaH samutpatya svarathAdvainateyavat |
varAsinA karNapakShA~njaghAna dasha pa~ncha cha
shlokas.62:
punaH svarathamAsthAya dhanurAdAya chAparam |
vivyAdha dashabhiH karNaM sUtamashvA.nshcha pa~nchabhiH
shlokas.63:
dhRRiShTadyumno.apyasivaraM charma chAdAya bhAsvaram |
jaghAna chandravarmANaM bRRihatkShatraM cha pauravam
shlokas.64:
tataH svarathamAsthAya pA~nchAlyo.anyachcha kArmukam |
AdAya karNaM vivyAdha trisaptatyA nadanraNe
shlokas.65:
shaineyo.apyanyadAdAya dhanurindrAyudhadyuti |
sUtaputraM chatuHShaShTyA viddhvA siMha ivAnadat
shlokas.66:
bhallabhyAM sAdhumuktAbhyAM ChittvA karNasya kArmukam |
punaH karNaM tribhirbANairbAhvorurasi chArpayat
shlokas.67:
tato duryodhano droNo rAjA chaiva jayadrathaH |
nimajjamAnaM rAdheyamujjahruH sAtyakArNavAt
shlokas.68:
dhRRiShTadyumnashcha bhImashcha saubhadro.arjuna eva cha |
nakulaH sahadevashcha sAtyakiM jugupU raNe
shlokas.69:
evameSha mahAraudraH kShayArthaM sarvadhanvinAm |
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha tyaktvA prANAnabhUdraNaH
shlokas.70:
padAtirathanAgAshvairgajAshvarathapattayaH |
rathino nAgapattyashvai rathapattI rathadvipaiH
shlokas.71:
ashvairashvA gajairnAgA rathino rathibhiH saha |
sa.nsaktAH samadRRishyanta pattayashchApi pattibhiH
shlokas.72:
evaM sukalilaM yuddhamAsItkravyAdaharShaNam |
mahadbhistairabhItAnAM yamarAShTravivardhanam
shlokas.73:
tato hatA nararathavAjiku~njarai;ranekasho dviparathavAjipattayaH |
gajairgajA rathibhirudAyudhA rathA; hayairhayAH pattigaNaishcha pattayaH
shlokas.74:
rathairdvipA dviradavarairmahAhayA; hayairnarA vararathibhishcha vAjinaH |
nirastajihvAdashanekShaNAH kShitau; kShayaM gatAH pramathitavarmabhUShaNAH
shlokas.75:
tathA parairbahukaraNairvarAyudhai;rhatA gatAH pratibhayadarshanAH kShitim |
vipothitA hayagajapAdatADitA; bhRRishAkulA rathakhuranemibhirhatAH
shlokas.76:
pramodane shvApadapakShirakShasAM; janakShaye vartati tatra dAruNe |
mahAbalAste kupitAH parasparaM; niShUdayantaH pravicherurojasA
shlokas.77:
tato bale bhRRishalulite parasparaM; nirIkShamANe rudhiraughasamplute |
divAkare.asta~NgirimAsthite shanai;rubhe prayAte shibirAya bhArata

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
pUrvamasmAsu bhagneShu phalgunenAmitaujasA |
droNe cha moghasa~Nkalpe rakShite cha yudhiShThire
shlokas.2:
sarve vidhvastakavachAstAvakA yudhi nirjitAH |
rajasvalA bhRRishodvignA vIkShamANA disho dasha
shlokas.3:
avahAraM tataH kRRitvA bhAradvAjasya saMmate |
labdhalakShyaiH parairdInA bhRRishAvahasitA raNe
shlokas.4:
shlAghamAneShu bhUteShu phalgunasyAmitAnguNAn |
keshavasya cha sauhArde kIrtyamAne.arjunaM prati
abhishastA ivAbhUvandhyAnamUkatvamAsthitAH
shlokas.5:
tataH prabhAtasamaye droNaM duryodhano.abravIt |
praNayAdabhimAnAchcha dviShadvRRiddhyA cha durmanAH
shRRiNvatAM sarvabhUtAnAM sa.nrabdho vAkyakovidaH
shlokas.6:
nUnaM vayaM vadhyapakShe bhavato brahmavittama |
tathA hi nAgrahIH prAptaM samIpe.adya yudhiShThiram
shlokas.7:
ichChataste na muchyeta chakShuHprApto raNe ripuH |
jighRRikShato rakShyamANaH sAmarairapi pANDavaiH
shlokas.8:
varaM dattvA mama prItaH pashchAdvikRRitavAnasi |
AshAbha~NgaM na kurvanti bhaktasyAryAH katha~nchana
shlokas.9:
tato.aprItastathoktaH sa bhAradvAjo.abravInnRRipam |
nArhase mAnyathA j~nAtuM ghaTamAnaM tava priye
shlokas.10:
sasurAsuragandharvAH sayakShoragarAkShasAH |
nAlaM lokA raNe jetuM pAlyamAnaM kirITinA
shlokas.11:
vishvasRRigyatra govindaH pRRitanAristahArjunaH |
tatra kasya balaM krAmedanyatra tryambakAtprabhoH
shlokas.12:
satyaM tu te bravImyadya naitajjAtvanyathA bhavet |
adyaiShAM pravaraM vIraM pAtayiShye mahAratham
shlokas.13:
taM cha vyUhaM vidhAsyAmi yo.abhedyastridashairapi |
yogena kenachidrAjannarjunastvapanIyatAm
shlokas.14:
na hyaj~nAtamasAdhyaM vA tasya sa~Nkhye.asti ki~nchana |
tena hyupAttaM balavatsarvaj~nAnamitastataH
shlokas.15:
droNena vyAhRRite tvevaM sa.nshaptakagaNAH punaH |
AhvayannarjunaM sa~Nkhye dakShiNAmabhito disham
shlokas.16:
tatrArjunasyAtha paraiH sArdhaM samabhavadraNaH |
tAdRRisho yAdRRisho nAnyaH shruto dRRiShTo.api vA kvachit
shlokas.17:
tato droNena vihito rAjanvyUho vyarochata |
charanmadhya.ndine sUryaH pratapanniva durdRRishaH
shlokas.18:
taM chAbhimanyurvachanAtpiturjyeShThasya bhArata |
bibheda durbhidaM sa~Nkhye chakravyUhamanekadhA
shlokas.19:
sa kRRitvA duShkaraM karma hatvA vIrAnsahasrashaH |
ShaTsu vIreShu sa.nsakto dauHshAsanivashaM gataH
shlokas.20:
vayaM paramasaMhRRiShTAH pANDavAH shokakarshitAH |
saubhadre nihate rAjannavahAramakurvata
shlokas.21:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
putraM puruShasiMhasya sa~njayAprAptayauvanam |
raNe vinihataM shrutvA bhRRishaM me dIryate manaH
shlokas.22:
dAruNaH kShatradharmo.ayaM vihito dharmakartRRibhiH |
yatra rAjyepsavaH shUrA bAle shastramapAtayan
shlokas.23:
bAlamatyantasukhinaM vicharantamabhItavat |
kRRitAstrA bahavo jaghnurbrUhi gAvalgaNe katham
shlokas.24:
bibhitsatA rathAnIkaM saubhadreNAmitaujasA |
vikrIDitaM yathA sa~Nkhye tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.25:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
yanmAM pRRichChasi rAjendra saubhadrasya nipAtanam |
tatte kArtsnyena vakShyAmi shRRiNu rAjansamAhitaH
vikrIDitaM kumAreNa yathAnIkaM bibhitsatA
shlokas.26:
dAvAgnyabhiparItAnAM bhUrigulmatRRiNadrume |
vanaukasAmivAraNye tvadIyAnAmabhUdbhayam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
samare.atyugrakarmANaH karmabhirvya~njitashramAH |
sakRRiShNAH pANDavAH pa~ncha devairapi durAsadAH
shlokas.2:
sattvakarmAnvayairbuddhyA prakRRityA yashasA shriyA |
naiva bhUto na bhavitA kRRiShNatulyaguNaH pumAn
shlokas.3:
satyadharmaparo dAtA viprapUjAdibhirguNaiH |
sadaiva tridivaM prApto rAjA kila yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.4:
yugAnte chAntako rAja~njAmadagnyashcha vIryavAn |
raNastho bhImasenashcha kathyante sadRRishAstrayaH
shlokas.5:
pratij~nAkarmadakShasya raNe gANDIvadhanvanaH |
upamAM nAdhigachChAmi pArthasya sadRRishIM kShitau
shlokas.6:
guruvAtsalyamatyantaM naibhRRityaM vinayo damaH |
nakule.aprAtirUpyaM cha shauryaM cha niyatAni ShaT
shlokas.7:
shrutagAmbhIryamAdhuryasattvavIryaparAkramaiH |
sadRRisho devayorvIraH sahadevaH kilAshvinoH
shlokas.8:
ye cha kRRiShNe guNAH sphItAH pANDaveShu cha ye guNAH |
abhimanyau kilaikasthA dRRishyante guNasa~nchayAH
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThirasya dhairyeNa kRRiShNasya charitena cha |
karmabhirbhImasenasya sadRRisho bhImakarmaNaH
shlokas.10:
dhana~njayasya rUpeNa vikrameNa shrutena cha |
vinayAtsahadevasya sadRRisho nakulasya cha
shlokas.11:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
abhimanyumahaM sUta saubhadramaparAjitam |
shrotumichChAmi kArtsnyena kathamAyodhane hataH
shlokas.12:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
chakravyUho mahArAja AchAryeNAbhikalpitaH |
tatra shakropamAH sarve rAjAno viniveshitAH
shlokas.13:
sa~NghAto rAjaputrANAM sarveShAmabhavattadA |
kRRitAbhisamayAH sarve suvarNavikRRitadhvajAH
shlokas.14:
raktAmbaradharAH sarve sarve raktavibhUShaNAH |
sarve raktapatAkAshcha sarve vai hemamAlinaH
shlokas.15:
teShAM dashasahasrANi babhUvurdRRiDhadhanvinAm |
pautraM tava puraskRRitya lakShmaNaM priyadarshanam
shlokas.16:
anyonyasamaduHkhAste anyonyasamasAhasAH |
anyonyaM spardhamAnAshcha anyonyasya hite ratAH
shlokas.17:
karNaduHshAsanakRRipairvRRito rAjA mahArathaiH |
devarAjopamaH shrImA~nshvetachChatrAbhisa.nvRRitaH
chAmaravyajanAkShepairudayanniva bhAskaraH
shlokas.18:
pramukhe tasya sainyasya droNo.avasthitanAyake |
sindhurAjastathAtiShThachChrImAnmerurivAchalaH
shlokas.19:
sindhurAjasya pArshvasthA ashvatthAmapurogamAH |
sutAstava mahArAja tri.nshattridashasaMnibhAH
shlokas.20:
gAndhArarAjaH kitavaH shalyo bhUrishravAstathA |
pArshvataH sindhurAjasya vyarAjanta mahArathAH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tadanIkamanAdhRRiShyaM bhAradvAjena rakShitam |
pArthAH samabhyavartanta bhImasenapurogamAH
shlokas.2:
sAtyakishchekitAnashcha dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
kuntibhojashcha vikrAnto drupadashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.3:
ArjuniH kShatradharmA cha bRRihatkShatrashcha vIryavAn |
chedipo dhRRiShTaketushcha mAdrIputrau ghaTotkachaH
shlokas.4:
yudhAmanyushcha vikrAntaH shikhaNDI chAparAjitaH |
uttamaujAshcha durdharSho virATashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.5:
draupadeyAshcha sa.nrabdhAH shaishupAlishcha vIryavAn |
kekayAshcha mahAvIryAH sRRi~njayAshcha sahasrashaH
shlokas.6:
ete chAnye cha sagaNAH kRRitAstrA yuddhadurmadAH |
samabhyadhAvansahasA bhAradvAjaM yuyutsavaH
shlokas.7:
samavetA.nstu tAnsarvAnbhAradvAjo.api vIryavAn |
asambhrAntaH sharaugheNa mahatA samavArayat
shlokas.8:
mahaughAH salilasyeva girimAsAdya durbhidam |
droNaM te nAbhyavartanta velAmiva jalAshayAH
shlokas.9:
pIDyamAnAH sharai rAjandroNachApaviniHsRRitaiH |
na shekuH pramukhe sthAtuM bhAradvAjasya pANDavAH
shlokas.10:
tadadbhutamapashyAma droNasya bhujayorbalam |
yadenaM nAbhyavartanta pA~nchAlAH sRRi~njayaiH saha
shlokas.11:
tamAyAntamabhikruddhaM droNaM dRRiShTvA yudhiShThiraH |
bahudhA chintayAmAsa droNasya prativAraNam
shlokas.12:
ashakyaM tu tamanyena droNaM matvA yudhiShThiraH |
aviShahyaM guruM bhAraM saubhadre samavAsRRijat
shlokas.13:
vAsudevAdanavaraM phalgunAchchAmitaujasam |
abravItparavIraghnamabhimanyumidaM vachaH
shlokas.14:
etya no nArjuno garhedyathA tAta tathA kuru |
chakravyUhasya na vayaM vidma bhedaM katha~nchana
shlokas.15:
tvaM vArjuno vA kRRiShNo vA bhindyAtpradyumna eva vA |
chakravyUhaM mahAbAho pa~nchamo.anyo na vidyate
shlokas.16:
abhimanyo varaM tAta yAchatAM dAtumarhasi |
pitR^INAM mAtulAnAM cha sainyAnAM chaiva sarvashaH
shlokas.17:
dhana~njayo hi nastAta garhayedetya sa.nyugAt |
kShipramastraM samAdAya droNAnIkaM vishAtaya
shlokas.18:
abhimanyuruvAcha||
droNasya dRRiDhamavyagramanIkapravaraM yudhi |
pitR^INAM jayamAkA~NkShannavagAhe bhinadmi cha
shlokas.19:
upadiShTo hi me pitrA yogo.anIkasya bhedane |
notsahe tu vinirgantumahaM kasyA~nchidApadi
shlokas.20:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
bhindhyanIkaM yudhA shreShTha dvAraM sa~njanayasva naH |
vayaM tvAnugamiShyAmo yena tvaM tAta yAsyasi
shlokas.21:
dhana~njayasamaM yuddhe tvAM vayaM tAta sa.nyuge |
praNidhAyAnuyAsyAmo rakShantaH sarvatomukhAH
shlokas.22:
bhIma uvAcha||
ahaM tvAnugamiShyAmi dhRRiShTadyumno.atha sAtyakiH |
pA~nchAlAH kekayA matsyAstathA sarve prabhadrakAH
shlokas.23:
sakRRidbhinnaM tvayA vyUhaM tatra tatra punaH punaH |
vayaM pradhva.nsayiShyAmo nighnamAnA varAnvarAn
shlokas.24:
abhimanyuruvAcha||
ahametatpravekShyAmi droNAnIkaM durAsadam |
pata~Nga iva sa~Nkruddho jvalitaM jAtavedasam
shlokas.25:
tatkarmAdya kariShyAmi hitaM yadva.nshayordvayoH |
mAtulasya cha yA prItirbhaviShyati pitushcha me
shlokas.26:
shishunaikena sa~NgrAme kAlyamAnAni sa~NghashaH |
adya drakShyanti bhUtAni dviShatsainyAni vai mayA
shlokas.27:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
evaM te bhAShamANasya balaM saubhadra vardhatAm |
yastvamutsahase bhettuM droNAnIkaM sudurbhidam
shlokas.28:
rakShitaM puruShavyAghrairmaheShvAsaiH prahAribhiH |
sAdhyarudramarutkalpairvasvagnyAdityavikramaiH
shlokas.29:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA sa yantAramachodayat |
sumitrAshvAnraNe kShipraM droNAnIkAya chodaya

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
saubhadrastu vachaH shrutvA dharmarAjasya dhImataH |
achodayata yantAraM droNAnIkAya bhArata
shlokas.2:
tena sa~nchodyamAnastu yAhi yAhIti sArathiH |
pratyuvAcha tato rAjannabhimanyumidaM vachaH
shlokas.3:
atibhAro.ayamAyuShmannAhitastvayi pANDavaiH |
sampradhArya kShamaM buddhyA tatastvaM yoddhumarhasi
shlokas.4:
AchAryo hi kRRitI droNaH paramAstre kRRitashramaH |
atyantasukhasa.nvRRiddhastvaM cha yuddhavishAradaH
shlokas.5:
tato.abhimanyuH prahasansArathiM vAkyamabravIt |
sArathe ko nvayaM droNaH samagraM kShatrameva vA
shlokas.6:
airAvatagataM shakraM sahAmaragaNairaham |
yodhayeyaM raNamukhe na me kShatre.adya vismayaH
na mamaitaddviShatsainyaM kalAmarhati ShoDashIm
shlokas.7:
api vishvajitaM viShNuM mAtulaM prApya sUtaja |
pitaraM chArjunaM sa~Nkhye na bhIrmAmupayAsyati
shlokas.8:
tato.abhimanyustAM vAchaM kadarthIkRRitya sAratheH |
