yAhItyevAbravIdenaM droNAnIkAya mAchiram
shlokas.9:
tataH sa~nchodayAmAsa hayAnasya trihAyanAn |
nAtihRRiShTamanAH sUto hemabhANDaparichChadAn
shlokas.10:
te preShitAH sumitreNa droNAnIkAya vAjinaH |
droNamabhyadravanrAjanmahAvegaparAkramAH
shlokas.11:
tamudIkShya tathAyAntaM sarve droNapurogamAH |
abhyavartanta kauravyAH pANDavAshcha tamanvayuH
shlokas.12:
sa karNikArapravarochChritadhvajaH; suvarNavarmArjunirarjunAdvaraH |
yuyutsayA droNamukhAnmahArathA;nsamAsadatsiMhashishuryathA gajAn
shlokas.13:
te vi.nshatipade yattAH samprahAraM prachakrire |
AsIdgA~Nga ivAvarto muhUrtamudadheriva
shlokas.14:
shUrANAM yudhyamAnAnAM nighnatAmitaretaram |
sa~NgrAmastumulo rAjanprAvartata sudAruNaH
shlokas.15:
pravartamAne sa~NgrAme tasminnatibhaya~Nkare |
droNasya miShato vyUhaM bhittvA prAvishadArjuniH
shlokas.16:
taM praviShTaM parAnghnantaM shatrumadhye mahAbalam |
hastyashvarathapattyaughAH parivavrurudAyudhAH
shlokas.17:
nAnAvAditraninadaiH kShveDitotkruShTagarjitaiH |
hu~NkAraiH siMhanAdaishcha tiShTha tiShTheti nisvanaiH
shlokas.18:
ghorairhalahalAshabdairmA gAstiShThaihi mAmiti |
asAvahamamutreti pravadanto muhurmuhuH
shlokas.19:
bRRiMhitaiH shi~njitairhAsaiH khuranemisvanairapi |
saMnAdayanto vasudhAmabhidudruvurArjunim
shlokas.20:
teShAmApatatAM vIraH pUrvaM shIghramatho dRRiDham |
kShiprAstro nyavadhIdvrAtAnmarmaj~no marmabhedibhiH
shlokas.21:
te hanyamAnAshcha tathA nAnAli~NgaiH shitaiH sharaiH |
abhipetustamevAjau shalabhA iva pAvakam
shlokas.22:
tatasteShAM sharIraishcha sharIrAvayavaishcha saH |
santastAra kShitiM kShipraM kushairvedimivAdhvare
shlokas.23:
baddhagodhA~NgulitrANAnsasharAvarakArmukAn |
sAsicharmA~NkushAbhIshUnsatomaraparashvadhAn
shlokas.24:
saguDAyomukhaprAsAnsarShTitomarapaTTishAn |
sabhiNDipAlaparighAnsashaktivarakampanAn
shlokas.25:
sapratodamahAsha~NkhAnsakuntAnsakachagrahAn |
samudgarakShepaNIyAnsapAshaparighopalAn
shlokas.26:
sakeyUrA~NgadAnbAhUnhRRidyagandhAnulepanAn |
sa~nchichChedArjunirvRRittA.nstvadIyAnAM sahasrashaH
shlokas.27:
taiH sphuradbhirmahArAja shushubhe lohitokShitaiH |
pa~nchAsyaiH pannagaishChinnairgaruDeneva mAriSha
shlokas.28:
sunAsAnanakeshAntairavraNaishchArukuNDalaiH |
sa.ndaShTauShThapuTaiH krodhAtkSharadbhiH shoNitaM bahu
shlokas.29:
chArusra~NmukuToShNIShairmaNiratnavirAjitaiH |
vinAlanalinAkArairdivAkarashashiprabhaiH
shlokas.30:
hitapriya.nvadaiH kAle bahubhiH puNyagandhibhiH |
dviShachChirobhiH pRRithivImavatastAra phAlguNiH
shlokas.31:
gandharvanagarAkArAnvidhivatkalpitAnrathAn |
vIShAmukhAnvitriveNUnvyastadaNDakabandhurAn
shlokas.32:
vija~NghakUbarAkShA.nshcha vinemInanarAnapi |
vichakropaskaropasthAnbhagnopakaraNAnapi
shlokas.33:
prashAtitopakaraNAnhatayodhAnsahasrashaH |
sharairvishakalIkurvandikShu sarvAsvadRRishyata
shlokas.34:
punardvipAndvipArohAnvaijayantya~NkushadhvajAn |
tUNAnvarmANyatho kakShyA graiveyAnatha kambalAn
shlokas.35:
ghaNTAH shuNDAnviShANAgrAnkShurapAlAnpadAnugAn |
sharairnishitadhArAgraiH shAtravANAmashAtayat
shlokas.36:
vanAyujAnpArvatIyAnkAmbojAraTTabAhlikAn |
sthiravAladhikarNAkShA~njavanAnsAdhuvAhinaH
shlokas.37:
svArUDhA~nshikShitairyodhaiH shaktyRRiShTiprAsayodhibhiH |
vidhvastachAmarakuthAnviprakIrNaprakIrNakAn
shlokas.38:
nirastajihvAnayanAnniShkIrNAntrayakRRidghanAn |
hatArohAnbhinnabhANDAnkravyAdagaNamodanAn
shlokas.39:
nikRRittavarmakavachA~nshakRRinmUtrAsRRigAplutAn |
nipAtayannashvavarA.nstAvakAnso.abhyarochata
shlokas.40:
eko viShNurivAchintyaH kRRitvA prAkkarma duShkaram |
tathA vimathitaM tena trya~NgaM tava balaM mahat
vyahanatsa padAtyoghA.nstvadIyAneva bhArata
shlokas.41:
evamekena tAM senAM saubhadreNa shitaiH sharaiH |
bhRRishaM viprahatAM dRRiShTvA skandenevAsurIM chamUm
shlokas.42:
tvadIyAstava putrAshcha vIkShamANA disho dasha |
sa.nshuShkAsyAshchalannetrAH prasvinnA lomaharShaNAH
shlokas.43:
palAyanakRRitotsAhA nirutsAhA dviShajjaye |
gotranAmabhiranyonyaM krandanto jIvitaiShiNaH
shlokas.44:
hatAnputrA.nstathA pitR^InsuhRRitsambandhibAndhavAn |
prAtiShThanta samutsRRijya tvarayanto hayadvipAn

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tAM prabhagnAM chamUM dRRiShTvA saubhadreNAmitaujasA |
duryodhano bhRRishaM kruddhaH svayaM saubhadramabhyayAt
shlokas.2:
tato rAjAnamAvRRittaM saubhadraM prati sa.nyuge |
dRRiShTvA droNo.abravIdyodhAnparyApnuta narAdhipam
shlokas.3:
purAbhimanyurlakShyaM naH pashyatAM hanti vIryavAn |
tamAdravata mA bhaiShTa kShipraM rakShata kauravam
shlokas.4:
tataH kRRitaj~nA balinaH suhRRido jitakAshinaH |
trAsyamAnA bhayAdvIraM parivavrustavAtmajam
shlokas.5:
droNo drauNiH kRRipaH karNaH kRRitavarmA cha saubalaH |
bRRihadbalo madrarAjo bhUrirbhUrishravAH shalaH
shlokas.6:
pauravo vRRiShasenashcha visRRijantaH shitA~nsharAn |
saubhadraM sharavarSheNa mahatA samavAkiran
shlokas.7:
saMmohayitvA tamatha duryodhanamamochayan |
AsyAdgrAsamivAkShiptaM mamRRiShe nArjunAtmajaH
shlokas.8:
tA~nsharaugheNa mahatA sAshvasUtAnmahArathAn |
vimukhIkRRitya saubhadraH siMhanAdamathAnadat
shlokas.9:
tasya nAdaM tataH shrutvA siMhasyevAmiShaiShiNaH |
nAmRRiShyanta susa.nrabdhAH punardroNamukhA rathAH
shlokas.10:
ta enaM koShThakIkRRitya rathava.nshena mAriSha |
vyasRRijanniShujAlAni nAnAli~NgAni sa~NghashaH
shlokas.11:
tAnyantarikShe chichCheda pautrastava shitaiH sharaiH |
tA.nshchaiva prativivyAdha tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.12:
tataste kopitAstena sharairAshIviShopamaiH |
parivavrurjighA.nsantaH saubhadramapalAyinam
shlokas.13:
samudramiva paryastaM tvadIyaM tadbalArNavam |
abhimanyurdadhAraiko veleva makarAlayam
shlokas.14:
shUrANAM yudhyamAnAnAM nighnatAmitaretaram |
abhimanyoH pareShAM cha nAsItkashchitparA~NmukhaH
shlokas.15:
tasmi.nstu ghore sa~NgrAme vartamAne bhaya~Nkare |
duHsaho navabhirbANairabhimanyumavidhyata
shlokas.16:
duHshAsano dvAdashabhiH kRRipaH shAradvatastribhiH |
droNastu saptadashabhiH sharairAshIviShopamaiH
shlokas.17:
vivi.nshatistu vi.nshatyA kRRitavarmA cha saptabhiH |
bRRihadbalastathAShTAbhirashvatthAmA cha saptabhiH
shlokas.18:
bhUrishravAstribhirbANairmadreshaH ShaDbhirAshugaiH |
dvAbhyAM sharAbhyAM shakunistribhirduryodhano nRRipaH
shlokas.19:
sa tu tAnprativivyAdha tribhistribhirajihmagaiH |
nRRityanniva mahArAja chApahastaH pratApavAn
shlokas.20:
tato.abhimanyuH sa~NkruddhastApyamAnastavAtmajaiH |
vidarshayanvai sumahachChikShaurasakRRitaM balam
shlokas.21:
garuDAnilaraMhobhiryanturvAkyakarairhayaiH |
dAntairashmakadAyAdaM tvaramANo.abhyahArayat
vivyAdha chainaM dashabhirbANaistiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.22:
tasyAbhimanyurdashabhirbANaiH sUtaM hayAndhvajam |
bAhU dhanuH shirashchorvyAM smayamAno.abhyapAtayat
shlokas.23:
tatastasminhate vIre saubhadreNAshmakeshvare |
sa~nchachAla balaM sarvaM palAyanaparAyaNam
shlokas.24:
tataH karNaH kRRipo droNo drauNirgAndhArarATshalaH |
shalyo bhUrishravAH krAthaH somadatto vivi.nshatiH
shlokas.25:
vRRiShasenaH suSheNashcha kuNDabhedI pratardanaH |
vRRindArako lalitthashcha prabAhurdIrghalochanaH
duryodhanashcha sa~NkruddhaH sharavarShairavAkiran
shlokas.26:
so.atikruddho maheShvAsairabhimanyurajihmagaiH |
sharamAdatta karNAya parakAyAvabhedanam
shlokas.27:
tasya bhittvA tanutrANaM dehaM nirbhidya chAshugaH |
prAvishaddharaNIM rAjanvalmIkamiva pannagaH
shlokas.28:
sa tenAtiprahAreNa vyathito vihvalanniva |
sa~nchachAla raNe karNaH kShitikampe yathAchalaH
shlokas.29:
athAnyairnishitairbANaiH suSheNaM dIrghalochanam |
kuNDabhediM cha sa~NkruddhastribhistrInavadhIdbalI
shlokas.30:
karNastaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA nArAchAnAM samarpayat |
ashvatthAmA cha vi.nshatyA kRRitavarmA cha saptabhiH
shlokas.31:
sa sharArditasarvA~NgaH kruddhaH shakrAtmajAtmajaH |
vicharandRRishyate sainye pAshahasta ivAntakaH
shlokas.32:
shalyaM cha bANavarSheNa samIpasthamavAkirat |
udakroshanmahAbAhustava sainyAni bhIShayan
shlokas.33:
tataH sa viddho.astravidA marmabhidbhirajihmagaiH |
shalyo rAjanrathopasthe niShasAda mumoha cha
shlokas.34:
taM hi viddhaM tathA dRRiShTvA saubhadreNa yashasvinA |
samprAdravachchamUH sarvA bhAradvAjasya pashyataH
shlokas.35:
prekShantastaM mahAbAhuM rukmapu~NkhaiH samAvRRitam |
tvadIyAshcha palAyante mRRigAH siMhArditA iva
shlokas.36:
sa tu raNayashasAbhipUjyamAnaH; pitRRisurachAraNasiddhayakShasa~NghaiH |
avanitalagataishcha bhUtasa~Nghai;rativibabhau hutabhugyathAjyasiktaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tathA pramathamAnaM taM maheShvAsamajihmagaiH |
ArjuniM mAmakAH sarve ke tvenaM samavAkiran
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjankumArasya raNe vikrIDitaM mahat |
bibhitsato rathAnIkaM bhAradvAjena rakShitam
shlokas.3:
madreshaM sAditaM dRRiShTvA saubhAdreNAshugai raNe |
shalyAdavarajaH kruddhaH kiranbANAnsamabhyayAt
shlokas.4:
sa viddhvA dashabhirbANaiH sAshvayantAramArjunim |
udakroshanmahAshabdaM tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.5:
tasyArjuniH shirogrIvaM pANipAdaM dhanurhayAn |
ChatraM dhvajaM niyantAraM triveNuM shamyupaskaram
shlokas.6:
chakre yugeShAM tUNIrAnanukarShaM cha sAyakaiH |
patAkAM chakragoptArau sarvopakaraNAni cha
vyadhamallAghavAttachcha dadRRishe nAsya kashchana
shlokas.7:
sa papAta kShitau kShINaH praviddhAbharaNAmbaraH |
vAyuneva mahAchaityaH sambhagno.amitatejasA
anugAshchAsya vitrastAH prAdravansarvatodisham
shlokas.8:
ArjuneH karma taddRRiShTva praNedushcha samantataH |
nAdena sarvabhUtAni sAdhu sAdhviti bhArata
shlokas.9:
shalyabhrAtaryathArugNe bahushastasya sainikAH |
kulAdhivAsanAmAni shrAvayanto.arjunAtmajam
shlokas.10:
abhyavartanta sa~NkruddhA vividhAyudhapANayaH |
rathairashvairgajaishchAnye pAdAtaishcha balotkaTAH
shlokas.11:
bANashabdena mahatA khuranemisvanena cha |
hu~NkAraiH kShveDitotkruShTaiH siMhanAdaiH sagarjitaiH
shlokas.12:
jyAtalatrasvanairanye garjanto.arjunanandanam |
bruvantashcha na no jIvanmokShyase jIvatAmiti
shlokas.13:
tA.nstathA bruvato dRRiShTvA saubhadraH prahasanniva |
yo yaH sma prAharatpUrvaM taM taM vivyAdha patribhiH
shlokas.14:
sa.ndarshayiShyannastrANi chitrANi cha laghUni cha |
ArjuniH samare shUro mRRidupUrvamayudhyata
shlokas.15:
vAsudevAdupAttaM yadyadastraM cha dhana~njayAt |
adarshayata tatkArShNiH kRRiShNAbhyAmavisheShayan
shlokas.16:
dUramasyanguruM bhAraM sAdhaya.nshcha punaH punaH |
sa.ndadhadvisRRija.nshcheShUnnirvisheShamadRRishyata
shlokas.17:
chApamaNDalamevAsya visphuraddikShvadRRishyata |
tamo ghnataH sudIptasya saviturmaNDalaM yathA
shlokas.18:
jyAshabdaH shushruve tasya talashabdashcha dAruNaH |
mahAshanimuchaH kAle payodasyeva nisvanaH
shlokas.19:
hrImAnamarShI saubhadro mAnakRRitpriyadarshanaH |
saMmimAnayiShurvIrAniShvAsA.nshchApyayudhyata
shlokas.20:
mRRidurbhUtvA mahArAja dAruNaH samapadyata |
varShAbhyatIto bhagavA~nsharadIva divAkaraH
shlokas.21:
sharAnvichitrAnmahato rukmapu~NkhA~nshilAshitAn |
mumocha shatashaH kruddho gabhastIniva bhAskaraH
shlokas.22:
kShuraprairvatsadantaishcha vipAThaishcha mahAyashAH |
nArAchairardhanArAchairbhallairaj~nalikairapi
shlokas.23:
avAkiradrathAnIkaM bhAradvAjasya pashyataH |
tatastatsainyamabhavadvimukhaM sharapIDitam

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
dvaidhIbhavati me chittaM hriyA tuShTyA cha sa~njaya |
mama putrasya yatsainyaM saubhadraH samavArayat
shlokas.2:
vistareNaiva me sha.nsa sarvaM gAvalgaNe punaH |
vikrIDitaM kumArasya skandasyevAsuraiH saha
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
hanta te sampravakShyAmi vimardamatidAruNam |
ekasya cha bahUnAM cha yathAsIttumulo raNaH
shlokas.4:
abhimanyuH kRRitotsAhaH kRRitotsAhAnari.ndamAn |
rathastho rathinaH sarvA.nstAvakAnapyaharShayat
shlokas.5:
droNaM karNaM kRRipaM shalyaM drauNiM bhojaM bRRihadbalam |
duryodhanaM saumadattiM shakuniM cha mahAbalam
shlokas.6:
nAnAnRRipAnnRRipasutAnsainyAni vividhAni cha |
alAtachakravatsarvA.nshcharanbANaiH samabhyayAt
shlokas.7:
nighnannamitrAnsaubhadraH paramAstraH pratApavAn |
adarshayata tejasvI dikShu sarvAsu bhArata
shlokas.8:
taddRRiShTvA charitaM tasya saubhadrasyAmitaujasaH |
samakampanta sainyAni tvadIyAni punaH punaH
shlokas.9:
athAbravInmahAprAj~no bhAradvAjaH pratApavAn |
harSheNotphullanayanaH kRRipamAbhAShya satvaram
shlokas.10:
ghaTTayanniva marmANi tava putrasya mAriSha |
abhimanyuM raNe dRRiShTvA tadA raNavishAradam
shlokas.11:
eSha gachChati saubhadraH pArthAnAmagrato yuvA |
nandayansuhRRidaH sarvAnrAjAnaM cha yudhiShThiram
shlokas.12:
nakulaM sahadevaM cha bhImasenaM cha pANDavam |
bandhUnsambandhinashchAnyAnmadhyasthAnsuhRRidastathA
shlokas.13:
nAsya yuddhe samaM manye ka~nchidanyaM dhanurdharam |
ichChanhanyAdimAM senAM kimarthamapi nechChati
shlokas.14:
droNasya prItisa.nyuktaM shrutvA vAkyaM tavAtmajaH |
ArjuniM prati sa~Nkruddho droNaM dRRiShTvA smayanniva
shlokas.15:
atha duryodhanaH karNamabravIdbAhlikaM kRRipam |
duHsAsanaM madrarAjaM tA.nstA.nshchAnyAnmahArathAn
shlokas.16:
sarvamUrdhAvasiktAnAmAchAryo brahmavittamaH |
arjunasya sutaM mUDhaM nAbhihantumihechChati
shlokas.17:
na hyasya samare muchyedantako.apyAtatAyinaH |
kima~Nga punarevAnyo martyaH satyaM bravImi vaH
shlokas.18:
arjunasya sutaM tveSha shiShyatvAdabhirakShati |
putrAH shiShyAshcha dayitAstadapatyaM cha dharmiNAm
shlokas.19:
sa.nrakShyamANo droNena manyate vIryamAtmanaH |
AtmasambhAvito mUDhastaM pramathnIta mAchiram
shlokas.20:
evamuktAstu te rAj~nA sAtvatIputramabhyayuH |
sa.nrabdhAstaM jighA.nsanto bhAradvAjasya pashyataH
shlokas.21:
duHshAsanastu tachChrutvA duryodhanavachastadA |
abravItkurushArdUlo duryodhanamidaM vachaH
shlokas.22:
ahamenaM haniShyAmi mahArAja bravImi te |
miShatAM pANDuputrANAM pA~nchAlAnAM cha pashyatAm
grasiShyAmyadya saubhadraM yathA rAhurdivAkaram
shlokas.23:
utkrushya chAbravIdvAkyaM kururAjamidaM punaH |
shrutvA kRRiShNau mayA grastaM saubhadramatimAninau
gamiShyataH pretalokaM jIvalokAnna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.24:
tau cha shrutvA mRRitau vyaktaM pANDoH kShetrodbhavAH sutAH |
ekAhnA sasuhRRidvargAH klaibyAddhAsyanti jIvitam
shlokas.25:
tasmAdasminhate shatrau hatAH sarve.ahitAstava |
shivena dhyAhi mA rAjanneSha hanmi ripuM tava
shlokas.26:
evamuktvA nadanrAjanputro duHshAsanastava |
saubhadramabhyayAtkruddhaH sharavarShairavAkiran
shlokas.27:
tamabhikruddhamAyAntaM tava putramari.ndamaH |
abhimanyuH sharaistIkShNaiH ShaDvi.nshatyA samarpayat
shlokas.28:
duHshAsanastu sa~NkruddhaH prabhinna iva ku~njaraH |
ayodhayata saubhadramabhimanyushcha taM raNe
shlokas.29:
tau maNDalAni chitrANi rathAbhyAM savyadakShiNam |
charamANAvayudhyetAM rathashikShAvishAradau
shlokas.30:
atha paNavamRRida~NgadundubhInAM; kRRikaramahAnakabherijharjharANAm |
ninadamatibhRRishaM narAH prachakru;rlavaNajalodbhavasiMhanAdamishram

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sharavikShatagAtrastu pratyamitramavasthitam |
abhimanyuH smayandhImAnduHshAsanamathAbravIt
shlokas.2:
diShTyA pashyAmi sa~NgrAme mAninaM shatrumAgatam |
niShThuraM tyaktadharmANamAkroshanaparAyaNam
shlokas.3:
yatsabhAyAM tvayA rAj~no dhRRitarAShTrasya shRRiNvataH |
kopitaH paruShairvAkyairdharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
jayonmattena bhImashcha bahvabaddhaM prabhAShatA
shlokas.4:
paravittApahArasya krodhasyAprashamasya cha |
lobhasya j~nAnanAshasya drohasyAtyAhitasya cha
shlokas.5:
pitR^INAM mama rAjyasya haraNasyogradhanvinAm |
tattvAmidamanuprAptaM tatkopAdvai mahAtmanAm
shlokas.6:
sadyashchogramadharmasya phalaM prApnuhi durmate |
shAsitAsmyadya te bANaiH sarvasainyasya pashyataH
shlokas.7:
adyAhamanRRiNastasya kopasya bhavitA raNe |
amarShitAyAH kRRiShNAyAH kA~NkShitasya cha me pituH
shlokas.8:
adya kauravya bhImasya bhavitAsmyanRRiNo yudhi |
na hi me mokShyase jIvanyadi notsRRijase raNam
shlokas.9:
evamuktvA mahAbAhurbANaM duHshAsanAntakam |
sa.ndadhe paravIraghnaH kAlAgnyanilavarchasam
shlokas.10:
tasyorastUrNamAsAdya jatrudeshe vibhidya tam |
athainaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA punashchaiva samarpayat
shlokas.11:
sa gADhaviddho vyathito rathopastha upAvishat |
duHshAsano mahArAja kashmalaM chAvishanmahat
shlokas.12:
sArathistvaramANastu duHshAsanamachetasam |
raNamadhyAdapovAha saubhadrasharapIDitam
shlokas.13:
pANDavA draupadeyAshcha virATashcha samIkShya tam |
pA~nchAlAH kekayAshchaiva siMhanAdamathAnadan
shlokas.14:
vAditrANi cha sarvANi nAnAli~NgAni sarvashaH |
prAvAdayanta saMhRRiShTAH pANDUnAM tatra sainikAH
shlokas.15:
pashyantaH smayamAnAshcha saubhadrasya vicheShTitam |
atyantavairiNaM dRRiptaM dRRiShTvA shatruM parAjitam
shlokas.16:
dharmamArutashakrANAmAshvinoH pratimAstathA |
dhArayanto dhvajAgreShu draupadeyA mahArathAH
shlokas.17:
sAtyakishchekitAnashcha dhRRiShTadyumnashikhaNDinau |
kekayA dhRRiShTaketushcha matsyapA~nchAlasRRi~njayAH
shlokas.18:
pANDavAshcha mudA yuktA yudhiShThirapurogamAH |
abhyavartanta sahitA droNAnIkaM bibhitsavaH
shlokas.19:
tato.abhavanmahadyuddhaM tvadIyAnAM paraiH saha |
jayamAkA~NkShamANAnAM shUrANAmanivartinAm
shlokas.20:
duryodhano mahArAja rAdheyamidamabravIt |
pashya duHshAsanaM vIramabhimanyuvashaM gatam
shlokas.21:
pratapantamivAdityaM nighnantaM shAtravAnraNe |
saubhadramudyatAstrAtumabhidhAvanti pANDavAH
shlokas.22:
tataH karNaH sharaistIkShNairabhimanyuM durAsadam |
abhyavarShata sa~NkruddhaH putrasya hitakRRittava
shlokas.23:
tasya chAnucharA.nstIkShNairvivyAdha parameShubhiH |
avaj~nApUrvakaM vIraH saubhadrasya raNAjire
shlokas.24:
abhimanyustu rAdheyaM trisaptatyA shilImukhaiH |
avidhyattvarito rAjandroNaM prepsurmahAmanAH
shlokas.25:
taM tadA nAshakatkashchiddroNAdvArayituM raNe |
ArujantaM rathashreShThAnvajrahastamivAsurAn
shlokas.26:
tataH karNo jayaprepsurmAnI sarvadhanurbhRRitAm |
saubhadraM shatasho.avidhyaduttamAstrANi darshayan
shlokas.27:
so.astrairastravidAM shreShTho rAmashiShyaH pratApavAn |
samare shatrudurdharShamabhimanyumapIDayat
shlokas.28:
sa tathA pIDyamAnastu rAdheyenAstravRRiShTibhiH |
samare.amarasa~NkAshaH saubhadro na vyaShIdata
shlokas.29:
tataH shilAshitaistIkShNairbhallaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
ChittvA dhanUMShi shUrANAmArjuniH karNamArdayat
sa dhvajaM kArmukaM chAsya ChittvA bhUmau nyapAtayat
shlokas.30:
tataH kRRichChragataM karNaM dRRiShTvA karNAdanantaraH |
saubhadramabhyayAttUrNaM dRRiDhamudyamya kArmukam
shlokas.31:
tata uchchukrushuH pArthAsteShAM chAnucharA janAH |
vAditrANi cha sa~njaghnuH saubhadraM chApi tuShTuvuH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
so.abhigarjandhanuShpANirjyAM vikarShanpunaH punaH |
tayormahAtmanostUrNaM rathAntaramavApatat
shlokas.2:
so.avidhyaddashabhirbANairabhimanyuM durAsadam |
sachChatradhvajayantAraM sAshvamAshu smayanniva
shlokas.3:
pitRRipaitAmahaM karma kurvANamatimAnuSham |
dRRiShTvArditaM sharaiH kArShNiM tvadIyA hRRiShitAbhavan
shlokas.4:
tasyAbhimanyurAyamya smayannekena patriNA |
shiraH prachyAvayAmAsa sa rathAtprApatadbhuvi
shlokas.5:
karNikAramivoddhUtaM vAtena mathitaM nagAt |
bhrAtaraM nihataM dRRiShTvA rAjankarNo vyathAM yayau
shlokas.6:
vimukhIkRRitya karNaM tu saubhadraH ka~NkapatribhiH |
anyAnapi maheShvAsA.nstUrNamevAbhidudruve
shlokas.7:
tatastadvitataM jAlaM hastyashvarathapattimat |
jhaShaH kruddha ivAbhindadabhimanyurmahAyashAH
shlokas.8:
karNastu bahubhirbANairardyamAno.abhimanyunA |
apAyAjjavanairashvaistato.anIkamabhidyata
shlokas.9:
shalabhairiva chAkAshe dhArAbhiriva chAvRRite |
abhimanyoH sharai rAjanna prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.10:
tAvakAnAM tu yodhAnAM vadhyatAM nishitaiH sharaiH |
anyatra saindhavAdrAjanna sma kashchidatiShThata
shlokas.11:
saubhadrastu tataH sha~NkhaM pradhmApya puruSharShabhaH |
shIghramabhyapatatsenAM bhAratIM bharatarShabha
shlokas.12:
sa kakShe.agnirivotsRRiShTo nirdaha.nstarasA ripUn |
madhye bhAratasainyAnAmArjuniH paryavartata
shlokas.13:
rathanAgAshvamanujAnardayannishitaiH sharaiH |
sa pravishyAkarodbhUmiM kabandhagaNasa~NkulAm
shlokas.14:
saubhadrachApaprabhavairnikRRittAH parameShubhiH |
svAnevAbhimukhAnghnantaH prAdrava~njIvitArthinaH
shlokas.15:
te ghorA raudrakarmANo vipAThAH pRRithavaH shitAH |
nighnanto rathanAgAshvA~njagmurAshu vasundharAm
shlokas.16:
sAyudhAH sA~NgulitrANAH sakhaDgAH sA~NgadA raNe |
dRRishyante bAhavashChinnA hemAbharaNabhUShitAH
shlokas.17:
sharAshchApAni khaDgAshcha sharIrANi shirA.nsi cha |
sakuNDalAni sragvINi bhUmAvAsansahasrashaH
shlokas.18:
apaskarairadhiShThAnairIShAdaNDakabandhuraiH |
akShairvimathitaishchakrairbhagnaishcha bahudhA rathaiH
shaktichApAyudhaishchApi patitaishcha mahAdhvajaiH
shlokas.19:
nihataiH kShatriyairashvairvAraNaishcha vishAM pate |
agamyakalpA pRRithivI kShaNenAsItsudAruNA
shlokas.20:
vadhyatAM rAjaputrANAM krandatAmitaretaram |
prAdurAsInmahAshabdo bhIrUNAM bhayavardhanaH
sa shabdo bharatashreShTha dishaH sarvA vyanAdayat
shlokas.21:
saubhadrashchAdravatsenAM nighnannashvarathadvipAn |
vyacharatsa dishaH sarvAH pradishashchAhitAnrujan
shlokas.22:
taM tadA nAnupashyAma sainyena rajasAvRRitam |
AdadAnaM gajAshvAnAM nRRiNAM chAyUMShi bhArata
shlokas.23:
kShaNena bhUyo.apashyAma sUryaM madhya.ndine yathA |
abhimanyuM mahArAja pratapantaM dviShadgaNAn
shlokas.24:
sa vAsavasamaH sa~Nkhye vAsavasyAtmajAtmajaH |
abhimanyurmahArAja sainyamadhye vyarochata

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
bAlamatyantasukhinamavAryabaladarpitam |
yuddheShu kushalaM vIraM kulaputraM tanutyajam
shlokas.2:
gAhamAnamanIkAni sadashvaistaM trihAyanaiH |
api yaudhiShThirAtsainyAtkashchidanvapatadrathI
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
yudhiShThiro bhImasenaH shikhaNDI sAtyakiryamau |
dhRRiShTadyumno virATashcha drupadashcha sakekayaH
dhRRiShTaketushcha sa.nrabdho matsyAshchAnvapatanraNe
shlokas.4:
abhyadravanparIpsanto vyUDhAnIkAH prahAriNaH |
tAndRRiShTvA dravataH shUrA.nstvadIyA vimukhAbhavan
shlokas.5:
tatastadvimukhaM dRRiShTvA tava sUnormahadbalam |
jAmAtA tava tejasvI viShTambhayiShurAdravat
shlokas.6:
saindhavasya mahArAja putro rAjA jayadrathaH |
sa putragRRiddhinaH pArthAnsahasainyAnavArayat
shlokas.7:
ugradhanvA maheShvAso divyamastramudIrayan |
vArdhakShatrirupAsedhatpravaNAdiva ku~njarAn
shlokas.8:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
atibhAramahaM manye saindhave sa~njayAhitam |
yadekaH pANDavAnkruddhAnputragRRiddhInavArayat
shlokas.9:
atyadbhutamidaM manye balaM shauryaM cha saindhave |
tadasya brUhi me vIryaM karma chAgryaM mahAtmanaH
shlokas.10:
kiM dattaM hutamiShTaM vA sutaptamatha vA tapaH |
sindhurAjena yenaikaH kruddhAnpArthAnavArayat
shlokas.11:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
draupadIharaNe yattadbhImasenena nirjitaH |
mAnAtsa taptavAnrAjA varArthI sumahattapaH
shlokas.12:
indriyANIndriyArthebhyaH priyebhyaH saMnivartya saH |
kShutpipAsAtapasahaH kRRisho dhamanisantataH
devamArAdhayachCharvaM gRRiNanbrahma sanAtanam
shlokas.13:
bhaktAnukampI bhagavA.nstasya chakre tato dayAm |
svapnAnte.apyatha chaivAha haraH sindhupateH sutam
varaM vRRiNIShva prIto.asmi jayadratha kimichChasi
shlokas.14:
evamuktastu sharveNa sindhurAjo jayadrathaH |
uvAcha praNato rudraM prA~njalirniyatAtmavAn
shlokas.15:
pANDaveyAnahaM sa~Nkhye bhImavIryaparAkramAn |
eko raNe dhArayeyaM samastAniti bhArata
shlokas.16:
evamuktastu devesho jayadrathamathAbravIt |
dadAmi te varaM saumya vinA pArthaM dhana~njayam
shlokas.17:
dhArayiShyasi sa~NgrAme chaturaH pANDunandanAn |
evamastviti deveshamuktvAbudhyata pArthivaH
shlokas.18:
sa tena varadAnena divyenAstrabalena cha |
ekaH sandhArayAmAsa pANDavAnAmanIkinIm
shlokas.19:
tasya jyAtalaghoSheNa kShatriyAnbhayamAvishat |
parA.nstu tava sainyasya harShaH paramako.abhavat
shlokas.20:
dRRiShTvA tu kShatriyA bhAraM saindhave sarvamarpitam |
utkrushyAbhyadravanrAjanyena yaudhiShThiraM balam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
yanmA pRRichChasi rAjendra sindhurAjasya vikramam |
shRRiNu tatsarvamAkhyAsye yathA pANDUnayodhayat
shlokas.2:
tamUhuH sArathervashyAH saindhavAH sAdhuvAhinaH |
vikurvANA bRRihanto.ashvAH shvasanopamaraMhasaH
shlokas.3:
gandharvanagarAkAraM vidhivatkalpitaM ratham |
tasyAbhyashobhayatketurvArAho rAjato mahAn
shlokas.4:
shvetachChatrapatAkAbhishchAmaravyajanena cha |
sa babhau rAjali~NgaistaistArApatirivAmbare
shlokas.5:
muktAvajramaNisvarNairbhUShitaM tadayasmayam |
varUthaM vibabhau tasya jyotirbhiH khamivAvRRitam
shlokas.6:
sa visphArya mahachchApaM kiranniShugaNAnbahUn |
tatkhaNDaM pUrayAmAsa yadvyadArayadArjuniH
shlokas.7:
sa sAtyakiM tribhirbANairaShTabhishcha vRRikodaram |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM tathA ShaShTyA virATaM dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.8:
drupadaM pa~nchabhistIkShNairdashabhishcha shikhaNDinam |
kekayAnpa~nchavi.nshatyA draupadeyA.nstribhistribhiH
shlokas.9:
yudhiShThiraM cha saptatyA tataH sheShAnapAnudat |
iShujAlena mahatA tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.10:
athAsya shitapItena bhallenAdishya kArmukam |
chichCheda prahasanrAjA dharmaputraH pratApavAn
shlokas.11:
akShNornimeShamAtreNa so.anyadAdAya kArmukam |
vivyAdha dashabhiH pArtha tA.nshchaivAnyA.nstribhistribhiH
shlokas.12:
tasya tallAghavaM j~nAtvA bhImo bhallaistribhiH punaH |
dhanurdhvajaM cha ChatraM cha kShitau kShipramapAtayat
shlokas.13:
so.anyadAdAya balavAnsajyaM kRRitvA cha kArmukam |
bhImasyApothayatketuM dhanurashvA.nshcha mAriSha
shlokas.14:
sa hatAshvAdavaplutya ChinnadhanvA rathottamAt |
sAtyakerApluto yAnaM giryagramiva kesarI
shlokas.15:
tatastvadIyAH saMhRRiShTAH sAdhu sAdhviti chukrushuH |
sindhurAjasya tatkarma prekShyAshraddheyamuttamam
shlokas.16:
sa~NkruddhAnpANDavAneko yaddadhArAstratejasA |
tattasya karma bhUtAni sarvANyevAbhyapUjayan
shlokas.17:
saubhadreNa hataiH pUrvaM sottarAyudhibhirdvipaiH |
pANDUnAM darshitaH panthAH saindhavena nivAritaH
shlokas.18:
yatamAnAstu te vIrA matsyapA~nchAlakekayAH |
pANDavAshchAnvapadyanta pratyaikashyena saindhavam
shlokas.19:
yo yo hi yatate bhettuM droNAnIkaM tavAhitaH |
taM taM devavaraprAptyA saindhavaH pratyavArayat

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
saindhavena niruddheShu jayagRRiddhiShu pANDuShu |
sughoramabhavadyuddhaM tvadIyAnAM paraiH saha
shlokas.2:
pravishya tvArjuniH senAM satyasandho durAsadAm |
vyakShobhayata tejasvI makaraH sAgaraM yathA
shlokas.3:
taM tathA sharavarSheNa kShobhayantamari.ndamam |
yathApradhAnAH saubhadramabhyayuH kurusattamAH
shlokas.4:
teShAM tasya cha saMmardo dAruNaH samapadyata |
sRRijatAM sharavarShANi prasaktamamitaujasAm
shlokas.5:
rathavrajena sa.nruddhastairamitrairathArjuniH |
vRRiShasenasya yantAraM hatvA chichCheda kArmukam
shlokas.6:
tasya vivyAdha balavA~nsharairashvAnajihmagaiH |
vAtAyamAnairatha tairashvairapahRRito raNAt
shlokas.7:
tenAntareNAbhimanyoryantApAsArayadratham |
rathavrajAstato hRRiShTAH sAdhu sAdhviti chukrushuH
shlokas.8:
taM siMhamiva sa~NkruddhaM pramathnantaM sharairarIn |
ArAdAyAntamabhyetya vasAtIyo.abhyayAddrutam
shlokas.9:
so.abhimanyuM sharaiH ShaShTyA rukmapu~NkhairavAkirat |
abravIchcha na me jIva~njIvato yudhi mokShyase
shlokas.10:
tamayasmayavarmANamiShuNA AshupAtinA |
vivyAdha hRRidi saubhadraH sa papAta vyasuH kShitau
shlokas.11:
vasAtyaM nihataM dRRiShTvA kruddhAH kShatriyapu~NgavAH |
parivavrustadA rAja.nstava pautraM jighA.nsavaH
shlokas.12:
visphArayantashchApAni nAnArUpANyanekashaH |
tadyuddhamabhavadraudraM saubhadrasyAribhiH saha
shlokas.13:
teShAM sharAnseShvasanA~nsharIrANi shirA.nsi cha |
sakuNDalAni sragvINi kruddhashchichCheda phAlguniH
shlokas.14:
sakhaDgAH sA~NgulitrANAH sapaTTishaparashvadhAH |
adRRishyanta bhujAshChinnA hemAbharaNabhUShitAH
shlokas.15:
sragbhirAbharaNairvastraiH patitaishcha mahAdhvajaiH |
varmabhishcharmabhirhArairmukuTaishChatrachAmaraiH
shlokas.16:
apaskarairadhiShThAnairIShAdaNDakabandhuraiH |
akShairvimathitaishchakrairbhagnaishcha bahudhA yugaiH
shlokas.17:
anukarShaiH patAkAbhistathA sArathivAjibhiH |
rathaishcha bhagnairnAgaishcha hataiH kIrNAbhavanmahI
shlokas.18:
nihataiH kShatriyaiH shUrairnAnAjanapadeshvaraiH |
jayagRRiddhairvRRitA bhUmirdAruNA samapadyata
shlokas.19:
disho vicharatastasya sarvAshcha pradishastathA |
raNe.abhimanyoH kruddhasya rUpamantaradhIyata
shlokas.20:
kA~nchanaM yadyadasyAsIdvarma chAbharaNAni cha |
dhanuShashcha sharANAM cha tadapashyAma kevalam
shlokas.21:
taM tadA nAshakatkashchichchakShurbhyAmabhivIkShitum |
AdadAnaM sharairyodhAnmadhye sUryamiva sthitam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
AdadAnastu shUrANAmAyUMShyabhavadArjuniH |
antakaH sarvabhUtAnAM prANAnkAla ivAgate
shlokas.2:
sa shakra iva vikrAntaH shakrasUnoH suto balI |
abhimanyustadAnIkaM loDayanbahvashobhata
shlokas.3:
pravishyaiva tu rAjendra kShatriyendrAntakopamaH |
satyashravasamAdatta vyAghro mRRigamivolbaNam
shlokas.4:
satyashravasi chAkShipte tvaramANA mahArathAH |
pragRRihya vipulaM shastramabhimanyumupAdravan
shlokas.5:
ahaM pUrvamahaM pUrvamiti kShatriyapu~NgavAH |
spardhamAnAH samAjagmurjighA.nsanto.arjunAtmajam
shlokas.6:
kShatriyANAmanIkAni pradrutAnyabhidhAvatAm |
jagrAsa timirAsAdya kShudramatsyAnivArNave
shlokas.7:
ye kechana gatAstasya samIpamapalAyinaH |
na te pratinyavartanta samudrAdiva sindhavaH
shlokas.8:
mahAgrAhagRRihIteva vAtavegabhayArditA |
samakampata sA senA vibhraShTA naurivArNave
shlokas.9:
atha rukmaratho nAma madreshvarasuto balI |
trastAmAshvAsayansenAmatrasto vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.10:
alaM trAsena vaH shUrA naiSha kashchinmayi sthite |
ahamenaM grahIShyAmi jIvagrAhaM na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.11:
evamuktvA tu saubhadramabhidudrAva vIryavAn |
sukalpitenohyamAnaH syandanena virAjatA
shlokas.12:
so.abhimanyuM tribhirbANairviddhvA vakShasyathAnadat |
tribhishcha dakShiNe bAhau savye cha nishitaistribhiH
shlokas.13:
sa tasyeShvasanaM ChittvA phAlguNiH savyadakShiNau |
bhujau shirashcha svakShibhru kShitau kShipramapAtayat
shlokas.14:
dRRiShTvA rukmarathaM rugNaM putraM shalyasya mAninam |
jIvagrAhaM jighRRikShantaM saubhadreNa yashasvinA
shlokas.15:
sa~NgrAmadurmadA rAjanrAjaputrAH prahAriNaH |
vayasyAH shalyaputrasya suvarNavikRRitadhvajAH
shlokas.16:
tAlamAtrANi chApAni vikarShanto mahArathAH |
ArjuniM sharavarSheNa samantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.17:
shUraiH shikShAbalopetaistaruNairatyamarShaNaiH |
dRRiShTvaikaM samare shUraM saubhadramaparAjitam
shlokas.18:
ChAdyamAnaM sharavrAtairhRRiShTo duryodhano.abhavat |
vaivasvatasya bhavanaM gatamenamamanyata
shlokas.19:
suvarNapu~NkhairiShubhirnAnAli~NgaistribhistribhiH |
adRRishyamArjuniM chakrurnimeShAtte nRRipAtmajAH
shlokas.20:
sasUtAshvadhvajaM tasya syandanaM taM cha mAriSha |
AchitaM samapashyAma shvAvidhaM shalalairiva
shlokas.21:
sa gADhaviddhaH kruddhashcha tottrairgaja ivArditaH |
gAndharvamastramAyachChadrathamAyAM cha yojayat
shlokas.22:
arjunena tapastaptvA gandharvebhyo yadAhRRitam |
tumburupramukhebhyo vai tenAmohayatAhitAn
shlokas.23:
ekaH sa shatadhA rAjandRRishyate sma sahasradhA |
alAtachakravatsa~Nkhye kShipramastrANi darshayan
shlokas.24:
rathacharyAstramAyAbhirmohayitvA parantapaH |
bibheda shatadhA rAja~nsharIrANi mahIkShitAm
shlokas.25:
prANAH prANabhRRitAM sa~Nkhye preShitA nishitaiH sharaiH |
rAjanprApuramuM lokaM sharIrANyavaniM yayuH
shlokas.26:
dhanUMShyashvAnniyantR^I.nshcha dhvajAnbAhU.nshcha sA~NgadAn |
shirA.nsi cha shitairbhallaisteShAM chichCheda phAlguniH
shlokas.27:
chUtArAmo yathA bhagnaH pa~nchavarShaphalopagaH |
rAjaputrashataM tadvatsaubhadreNApataddhatam
shlokas.28:
kruddhAshIviShasa~NkAshAnsukumArAnsukhochitAn |
ekena nihatAndRRiShTvA bhIto duryodhano.abhavat
shlokas.29:
rathinaH ku~njarAnashvAnpadAtI.nshchAvamarditAn |
dRRiShTvA duryodhanaH kShipramupAyAttamamarShitaH
shlokas.30:
tayoH kShaNamivApUrNaH sa~NgrAmaH samapadyata |
athAbhavatte vimukhaH putraH sharashatArditaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yathA vadasi me sUta ekasya bahubhiH saha |
sa~NgrAmaM tumulaM ghoraM jayaM chaiva mahAtmanaH
shlokas.2:
ashraddheyamivAshcharyaM saubhadrasyAtha vikramam |
kiM tu nAtyadbhutaM teShAM yeShAM dharmo vyapAshrayaH
shlokas.3:
duryodhane.atha vimukhe rAjaputrashate hate |
saubhadre pratipattiM kAM pratyapadyanta mAmakAH
shlokas.4:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sa.nshuShkAsyAshchalannetrAH prasvinnA lomaharShiNaH |
palAyanakRRitotsAhA nirutsAhA dviShajjaye
shlokas.5:
hatAnbhrAtR^InpitR^InputrAnsuhRRitsambandhibAndhavAn |
utsRRijyotsRRijya samiyustvarayanto hayadvipAn
shlokas.6:
tAnprabhagnA.nstathA dRRiShTvA droNo drauNirbRRihadbalaH |
kRRipo duryodhanaH karNaH kRRitavarmAtha saubalaH
shlokas.7:
abhidrutAH susa~NkruddhAH saubhadramaparAjitam |
te.api pautreNa te rAjanprAyasho vimukhIkRRitAH
shlokas.8:
ekastu sukhasa.nvRRiddho bAlyAddarpAchcha nirbhayaH |
iShvastravinmahAtejA lakShmaNo.a.arjunimabhyayAt
shlokas.9:
tamanvagevAsya pitA putragRRiddhI nyavartata |
anu duryodhanaM chAnye nyavartanta mahArathAH
shlokas.10:
taM te.abhiShiShichurbANairmeghA girimivAmbubhiH |
sa cha tAnpramamAthaiko viShvagvAto yathAmbudAn
shlokas.11:
pautraM tu tava durdharShaM lakShmaNaM priyadarshanam |
pituH samIpe tiShThantaM shUramudyatakArmukam
shlokas.12:
atyantasukhasa.nvRRiddhaM dhaneshvarasutopamam |
AsasAda raNe kArShNirmatto mattamiva dvipam
shlokas.13:
lakShmaNena tu sa~Ngamya saubhadraH paravIrahA |
sharaiH sunishitaistIkShNairbAhvorurasi chArpitaH
shlokas.14:
sa~Nkruddho vai mahAbAhurdaNDAhata ivoragaH |
pautrastava mahArAja tava pautramabhAShata
shlokas.15:
sudRRiShTaH kriyatAM loko amuM lokaM gamiShyasi |
pashyatAM bAndhavAnAM tvAM nayAmi yamasAdanam
shlokas.16:
evamuktvA tato bhallaM saubhadraH paravIrahA |
udbabarha mahAbAhurnirmuktoragasaMnibham
shlokas.17:
sa tasya bhujanirmukto lakShmaNasya sudarshanam |
sunasaM subhru keshAntaM shiro.ahArShItsakuNDalam
lakShmaNaM nihataM dRRiShTvA hA hetyuchchukrushurjanAH
shlokas.18:
tato duryodhanaH kruddhaH priye putre nipAtite |
hatainamiti chukrosha kShatriyAnkShatriyarShabhaH
shlokas.19:
tato droNaH kRRipaH karNo droNaputro bRRihadbalaH |
kRRitavarmA cha hArdikyaH ShaDrathAH paryavArayan
shlokas.20:
sa tAnviddhvA shitairbANairvimukhIkRRitya chArjuniH |
vegenAbhyapatatkruddhaH saindhavasya mahadbalam
shlokas.21:
Avavrustasya panthAnaM gajAnIkena da.nshitAH |
kali~NgAshcha niShAdAshcha krAthaputrashcha vIryavAn
tatprasaktamivAtyarthaM yuddhamAsIdvishAM pate
shlokas.22:
tatastatku~njarAnIkaM vyadhamaddhRRiShTamArjuniH |
yathA vivAnnityagatirjaladA~nshatasho.ambare
shlokas.23:
tataH krAthaH sharavrAtairArjuniM samavAkirat |
athetare saMnivRRittAH punardroNamukhA rathAH
paramAstrANi dhunvAnAH saubhadramabhidudruvuH
shlokas.24:
tAnnivAryArjunirbANaiH krAthaputramathArdayat |
sharaugheNAprameyeNa tvaramANo jighA.nsayA
shlokas.25:
sadhanurbANakeyUrau bAhU samukuTaM shiraH |
ChatraM dhvajaM niyantAramashvA.nshchAsya nyapAtayat
shlokas.26:
kulashIlashrutabalaiH kIrtyA chAstrabalena cha |
yukte tasminhate vIrAH prAyasho vimukhAbhavan

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tathA praviShTaM taruNaM saubhadramaparAjitam |
kulAnurUpaM kurvANaM sa~NgrAmeShvapalAyinam
shlokas.2:
AjAneyaiH subalibhiryuktamashvaistrihAyanaiH |
plavamAnamivAkAshe ke shUrAH samavArayan
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
abhimanyuH pravishyaiva tAvakAnnishitaiH sharaiH |
akarodvimukhAnsarvAnpArthivAnpANDunandanaH
shlokas.4:
taM tu droNaH kRRipaH karNo drauNishcha sabRRihadbalaH |
kRRitavarmA cha hArdikyaH ShaDrathAH paryavArayan
shlokas.5:
dRRiShTvA tu saindhave bhAramatimAtraM samAhitam |
sainyaM tava mahArAja yudhiShThiramupAdravat
shlokas.6:
saubhadramitare vIramabhyavarSha~nsharAmbubhiH |
tAlamAtrANi chApAni vikarShanto mahArathAH
shlokas.7:
tA.nstu sarvAnmaheShvAsAnsarvavidyAsu niShThitAn |
vyaShTambhayadraNe bANaiH saubhadraH paravIrahA
shlokas.8:
droNaM pa~nchAshatA viddhvA vi.nshatyA cha bRRihadbalam |
ashItyA kRRitavarmANaM kRRipaM ShaShTyA shilImukhaiH
shlokas.9:
rukmapu~NkhairmahAvegairAkarNasamachoditaiH |
avidhyaddashabhirbANairashvatthAmAnamArjuniH
shlokas.10:
sa karNaM karNinA karNe pItena nishitena cha |
phAlgunirdviShatAM madhye vivyAdha parameShuNA
shlokas.11:
pAtayitvA kRRipasyAshvA.nstathobhau pArShNisArathI |
athainaM dashabhirbANaiH pratyavidhyatstanAntare
shlokas.12:
tato vRRindArakaM vIraM kurUNAM kIrtivardhanam |
putrANAM tava vIrANAM pashyatAmavadhIdbalI
shlokas.13:
taM drauNiH pa~nchavi.nshatyA kShudrakANAM samarpayat |
varaM varamamitrANAmArujantamabhItavat
shlokas.14:
sa tu bANaiH shitaistUrNaM pratyavidhyata mAriSha |
pashyatAM dhArtarAShTrANAmashvatthAmAnamArjuniH
shlokas.15:
ShaShTyA sharANAM taM drauNistigmadhAraiH sutejanaiH |
ugrairnAkampayadviddhvA mainAkamiva parvatam
shlokas.16:
sa tu drauNiM trisaptatyA hemapu~NkhairajihmagaiH |
pratyavidhyanmahAtejA balavAnapakAriNam
shlokas.17:
tasmindroNo bANashataM putragRRiddhI nyapAtayat |
ashvatthAmA tathAShTau cha parIpsanpitaraM raNe
shlokas.18:
karNo dvAvi.nshatiM bhallAnkRRitavarmA chaturdasha |
bRRihadbalastu pa~nchAshatkRRipaH shAradvato dasha
shlokas.19:
tA.nstu pratyavadhItsarvAndashabhirdashabhiH sharaiH |
tairardyamAnaH saubhadraH sarvato nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.20:
taM kosalAnAmadhipaH karNinAtADayaddhRRidi |
sa tasyAshvAndhvajaM chApaM sUtaM chApAtayatkShitau
shlokas.21:
atha kosalarAjastu virathaH khaDgacharmadhRRit |
iyeSha phAlguneH kAyAchChiro hartuM sakuNDalam
shlokas.22:
sa kosalAnAM bhartAraM rAjaputraM bRRihadbalam |
hRRidi vivyAdha bANena sa bhinnahRRidayo.apatat
shlokas.23:
babha~nja cha sahasrANi dasha rAjanmahAtmanAm |
sRRijatAmashivA vAchaH khaDgakArmukadhAriNAm
shlokas.24:
tathA bRRihadbalaM hatvA saubhadro vyacharadraNe |
viShTambhayanmaheShvAsAnyodhA.nstava sharAmbubhiH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sa karNaM karNinA karNe punarvivyAdha phAlguniH |
sharaiH pa~nchAshatA chainamavidhyatkopayanbhRRisham
shlokas.2:
prativivyAdha rAdheyastAvadbhiratha taM punaH |
sa tairAchitasarvA~Ngo bahvashobhata bhArata
shlokas.3:
karNaM chApyakarotkruddho rudhirotpIDavAhinam |
karNo.api vibabhau shUraH sharaishchitro.asRRigAplutaH
shlokas.4:
tAvubhau sharachitrA~Ngau rudhireNa samukShitau |
babhUvaturmahAtmAnau puShpitAviva ki.nshukau
shlokas.5:
atha karNasya sachivAnShaTshUrA.nshchitrayodhinaH |
sAshvasUtadhvajarathAnsaubhadro nijaghAna ha
shlokas.6:
athetarAnmaheShvAsAndashabhirdashabhiH sharaiH |
pratyavidhyadasambhrAntastadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.7:
mAgadhasya punaH putraM hatvA ShaDbhirajihmagaiH |
sAshvaM sasUtaM taruNamashvaketumapAtayat
shlokas.8:
mArtikAvatakaM bhojaM tataH ku~njaraketanam |
kShurapreNa samunmathya nanAda visRRija~nsharAn
shlokas.9:
tasya dauHshAsanirviddhvA chaturbhishchaturo hayAn |
sUtamekena vivyAdha dashabhishchArjunAtmajam
shlokas.10:
tato dauHshAsaniM kArShNirviddhvA saptabhirAshugaiH |
sa.nrambhAdraktanayano vAkyamuchchairathAbravIt
shlokas.11:
pitA tavAhavaM tyaktvA gataH kApuruSho yathA |
diShTyA tvamapi jAnIShe yoddhuM na tvadya mokShyase
shlokas.12:
etAvaduktvA vachanaM karmAraparimArjitam |
nArAchaM visasarjAsmai taM drauNistribhirAchChinat
shlokas.13:
tasyArjunirdhvajaM ChittvA shalyaM tribhiratADayat |
taM shalyo navabhirbANairgArdhrapatrairatADayat
shlokas.14:
tasyArjunirdhvajaM ChittvA ubhau cha pArShNisArathI |
taM vivyAdhAyasaiH ShaDbhiH so.apakrAmadrathAntaram
shlokas.15:
shatru~njayaM chandraketuM meghavegaM suvarchasam |
sUryabhAsaM cha pa~nchaitAnhatvA vivyAdha saubalam
shlokas.16:
taM saubalastribhirviddhvA duryodhanamathAbravIt |
sarva enaM pramathnImaH puraikaikaM hinasti naH
shlokas.17:
athAbravIttadA droNaM karNo vaikartano vRRiShA |
purA sarvAnpramathnAti brUhyasya vadhamAshu naH
shlokas.18:
tato droNo maheShvAsaH sarvA.nstAnpratyabhAShata |
asti vo.asyAntaraM kashchitkumArasya prapashyati
shlokas.19:
anvasya pitaraM hyadya charataH sarvatodisham |
shIghratAM narasiMhasya pANDaveyasya pashyata
shlokas.20:
dhanurmaNDalamevAsya rathamArgeShu dRRishyate |
sa.ndadhAnasya vishikhA~nshIghraM chaiva vimu~nchataH
shlokas.21:
Arujanniva me prANAnmohayannapi sAyakaiH |
praharShayati mA bhUyaH saubhadraH paravIrahA
shlokas.22:
ati mA nandayatyeSha saubhadro vicharanraNe |
antaraM yasya sa.nrabdhA na pashyanti mahArathAH
shlokas.23:
asyato laghuhastasya dishaH sarvA maheShubhiH |
na visheShaM prapashyAmi raNe gANDIvadhanvanaH
shlokas.24:
atha karNaH punardroNamAhArjunisharArditaH |
sthAtavyamiti tiShThAmi pIDyamAno.abhimanyunA
shlokas.25:
tejasvinaH kumArasya sharAH paramadAruNAH |
kShiNvanti hRRidayaM me.adya ghorAH pAvakatejasaH
shlokas.26:
tamAchAryo.abravItkarNaM shanakaiH prahasanniva |
abhedyamasya kavachaM yuvA chAshuparAkramaH
shlokas.27:
upadiShTA mayA asya pituH kavachadhAraNA |
tAmeSha nikhilAM vetti dhruvaM parapura~njayaH
shlokas.28:
shakyaM tvasya dhanushChettuM jyAM cha bANaiH samAhitaiH |
abhIshavo hayAshchaiva tathobhau pArShNisArathI
shlokas.29:
etatkuru maheShvAsa rAdheya yadi shakyate |
athainaM vimukhIkRRitya pashchAtpraharaNaM kuru
shlokas.30:
sadhanuShko na shakyo.ayamapi jetuM surAsuraiH |
virathaM vidhanuShkaM cha kuruShvainaM yadIchChasi
shlokas.31:
tadAchAryavachaH shrutvA karNo vaikartanastvaran |
asyato laghuhastasya pRRiShatkairdhanurAchChinat
shlokas.32:
ashvAnasyAvadhIdbhojo gautamaH pArShNisArathI |
sheShAstu ChinnadhanvAnaM sharavarShairavAkiran
shlokas.33:
tvaramANAstvarAkAle virathaM ShaNmahArathAH |
sharavarShairakaruNA bAlamekamavAkiran
shlokas.34:
sa ChinnadhanvA virathaH svadharmamanupAlayan |
khaDgacharmadharaH shrImAnutpapAta vihAyasam
shlokas.35:
mArgaiH sa kaishikAdyaishcha lAghavena balena cha |
Arjunirvyacharadvyomni bhRRishaM vai pakShirADiva
shlokas.36:
mayyeva nipatatyeSha sAsirityUrdhvadRRiShTayaH |
vivyadhustaM maheShvAsAH samare ChidradarshinaH
shlokas.37:
tasya droNo.achChinanmuShTau khaDgaM maNimayatsarum |
rAdheyo nishitairbANairvyadhamachcharma chottamam
shlokas.38:
vyasicharmeShupUrNA~NgaH so.antarikShAtpunaH kShitim |
Asthitashchakramudyamya droNaM kruddho.abhyadhAvata
shlokas.39:
sa chakrareNUjjvalashobhitA~Ngo; babhAvatIvonnatachakrapANiH |
raNe.abhimanyuH kShaNadAsubhadraH; sa vAsubhadrAnukRRitiM prakurvan
shlokas.40:
srutarudhirakRRitaikarAgavaktro; bhrukuTipuTAkuTilo.atisiMhanAdaH |
prabhuramitabalo raNe.abhimanyu;rnRRipavaramadhyagato bhRRishaM vyarAjat

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
viShNoH svasAnandikaraH sa viShNvAyudhabhUShitaH |
rarAjAtirathaH sa~Nkhye janArdana ivAparaH
shlokas.2:
mArutoddhUtakeshAntamudyatArivarAyudham |
vapuH samIkShya pRRithvIshA duHsamIkShyaM surairapi
shlokas.3:
tachchakraM bhRRishamudvignAH sa~nchichChiduranekadhA |
mahArathastataH kArShNiH sa~njagrAha mahAgadAm
shlokas.4:
vidhanuHsyandanAsistairvichakrashchAribhiH kRRitaH |
abhimanyurgadApANirashvatthAmAnamAdravat
shlokas.5:
sa gadAmudyatAM dRRiShTvA jvalantImashanImiva |
apAkrAmadrathopasthAdvikramA.nstrInnararShabhaH
shlokas.6:
tasyAshvAngadayA hatvA tathobhau pArShNisArathI |
sharAchitA~NgaH saubhadraH shvAvidvatpratyadRRishyata
shlokas.7:
tataH subaladAyAdaM kAlakeyamapothayat |
jaghAna chAsyAnucharAngAndhArAnsaptasaptatim
shlokas.8:
punarbrahmavasAtIyA~njaghAna rathino dasha |
kekayAnAM rathAnsapta hatvA cha dasha ku~njarAn
dauHshAsanirathaM sAshvaM gadayA samapothayat
shlokas.9:
tato dauHshAsaniH kruddho gadAmudyamya mAriSha |
abhidudrAva saubhadraM tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.10:
tAvudyatagadau vIrAvanyonyavadhakA~NkShiNau |
bhrAtRRivyau samprajahrAte pureva tryambakAntakau
shlokas.11:
tAvanyonyaM gadAgrAbhyAM saMhatya patitau kShitau |
indradhvajAvivotsRRiShTau raNamadhye parantapau
shlokas.12:
dauHshAsanirathotthAya kurUNAM kIrtivardhanaH |
prottiShThamAnaM saubhadraM gadayA mUrdhnyatADayat
shlokas.13:
gadAvegena mahatA vyAyAmena cha mohitaH |
vichetA nyapatadbhUmau saubhadraH paravIrahA
evaM vinihato rAjanneko bahubhirAhave
shlokas.14:
kShobhayitvA chamUM sarvAM nalinImiva ku~njaraH |
ashobhata hato vIro vyAdhairvanagajo yathA
shlokas.15:
taM tathA patitaM shUraM tAvakAH paryavArayan |
dAvaM dagdhvA yathA shAntaM pAvakaM shishirAtyaye
shlokas.16:
vimRRidya tarushRRi~NgANi saMnivRRittamivAnilam |
astaM gatamivAdityaM taptvA bhAratavAhinIm
shlokas.17:
upaplutaM yathA somaM sa.nshuShkamiva sAgaram |
pUrNachandrAbhavadanaM kAkapakShavRRitAkShakam
shlokas.18:
taM bhUmau patitaM dRRiShTvA tAvakAste mahArathAH |
mudA paramayA yuktAshchukrushuH siMhavanmuhuH
shlokas.19:
AsItparamako harShastAvakAnAM vishAM pate |
itareShAM tu vIrANAM netrebhyaH prApatajjalam
shlokas.20:
abhikroshanti bhUtAni antarikShe vishAM pate |
dRRiShTvA nipatitaM vIraM chyutaM chandramivAmbarAt
shlokas.21:
droNakarNamukhaiH ShaDbhirdhArtarAShTrairmahArathaiH |
eko.ayaM nihataH shete naiSha dharmo mato hi naH
shlokas.22:
tasmi.nstu nihate vIre bahvashobhata medinI |
dyauryathA pUrNachandreNa nakShatragaNamAlinI
shlokas.23:
rukmapu~Nkhaishcha sampUrNA rudhiraughapariplutA |
uttamA~Ngaishcha vIrANAM bhrAjamAnaiH sakuNDalaiH
shlokas.24:
vichitraishcha paristomaiH patAkAbhishcha sa.nvRRitA |
chAmaraishcha kuthAbhishcha praviddhaishchAmbarottamaiH
shlokas.25:
rathAshvanaranAgAnAmala~NkAraishcha suprabhaiH |
khaDgaishcha nishitaiH pItairnirmuktairbhujagairiva
shlokas.26:
chApaishcha vishikhaishChinnaiH shaktyRRiShTiprAsakampanaiH |
vividhairAyudhaishchAnyaiH sa.nvRRitA bhUrashobhata
shlokas.27:
vAjibhishchApi nirjIvaiH svapadbhiH shoNitokShitaiH |
sArohairviShamA bhUmiH saubhadreNa nipAtitaiH
shlokas.28:
sA~NkushaiH samahAmAtraiH savarmAyudhaketubhiH |
parvatairiva vidhvastairvishikhonmathitairgajaiH
shlokas.29:
pRRithivyAmanukIrNaishcha vyashvasArathiyodhibhiH |
hradairiva prakShubhitairhatanAgai rathottamaiH
shlokas.30:
padAtisa~Nghaishcha hatairvividhAyudhabhUShaNaiH |
bhIrUNAM trAsajananI ghorarUpAbhavanmahI
shlokas.31:
taM dRRiShTvA patitaM bhUmau chandrArkasadRRishadyutim |
tAvakAnAM parA prItiH pANDUnAM chAbhavadvyathA
shlokas.32:
abhimanyau hate rAja~nshishuke.aprAptayauvane |
samprAdravachchamUH sarvA dharmarAjasya pashyataH
shlokas.33:
dIryamANaM balaM dRRiShTvA saubhadre vinipAtite |
ajAtashatruH svAnvIrAnidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.34:
svargameSha gataH shUro yo hato naparA~NmukhaH |
sa.nstambhayata mA bhaiShTa vijeShyAmo raNe ripUn
shlokas.35:
ityevaM sa mahAtejA duHkhitebhyo mahAdyutiH |
dharmarAjo yudhAM shreShTho bruvanduHkhamapAnudat
shlokas.36:
yuddhe hyAshIviShAkArAnrAjaputrAnraNe bahUn |
pUrvaM nihatya sa~NgrAme pashchAdArjuniranvagAt
shlokas.37:
hatvA dashasahasrANi kausalyaM cha mahAratham |
kRRiShNArjunasamaH kArShNiH shakrasadma gato dhruvam
shlokas.38:
rathAshvanaramAta~NgAnvinihatya sahasrashaH |
avitRRiptaH sa sa~NgrAmAdashochyaH puNyakarmakRRit
shlokas.39:
vayaM tu pravaraM hatvA teShAM taiH sharapIDitAH |
niveshAyAbhyupAyAma sAyAhne rudhirokShitAH
shlokas.40:
nirIkShamANAstu vayaM pare chAyodhanaM shanaiH |
apayAtA mahArAja glAniM prAptA vichetasaH
shlokas.41:
tato nishAyA divasasya chAshivaH; shivArutaH sandhiravartatAdbhutaH |
kusheshayApIDanibhe divAkare; vilambamAne.astamupetya parvatam
shlokas.42:
varAsishaktyRRiShTivarUthacharmaNAM; vibhUShaNAnAM cha samAkShipanprabhAm |
divaM cha bhUmiM cha samAnayanniva; priyAM tanuM bhAnurupaiti pAvakam
shlokas.43:
mahAbhrakUTAchalashRRi~NgasaMnibhai;rgajairanekairiva vajrapAtitaiH |
savaijayantya~NkushavarmayantRRibhi;rnipAtitairniShTanatIva gaushchitA
shlokas.44:
hateshvaraishchUrNitapattyupaskarai;rhatAshvasUtairvipatAkaketubhiH |
mahArathairbhUH shushubhe vichUrNitaiH; purairivAmitrahatairnarAdhipa
shlokas.45:
rathAshvavRRindaiH sahasAdibhirhataiH; praviddhabhANDAbharaNaiH pRRithagvidhaiH |
nirastajihvAdashanAntralochanai;rdharA babhau ghoravirUpadarshanA
shlokas.46:
praviddhavarmAbharaNA varAyudhA; vipannahastyashvarathAnugA narAH |
mahArhashayyAstaraNochitAH sadA; kShitAvanAthA iva sherate hatAH
shlokas.47:
atIva hRRiShTAH shvasRRigAlavAyasA; baDAH suparNAshcha vRRikAstarakShavaH |
vayA.nsyasRRikpAnyatha rakShasAM gaNAH; pishAchasa~NghAshcha sudAruNA raNe
shlokas.48:
tvacho vinirbhidya pibanvasAmasRRi;ktathaiva majjAM pishitAni chAshnuvan |
vapAM vilumpanti hasanti gAnti cha; prakarShamANAH kuNapAnyanekashaH
shlokas.49:
sharIrasa~NghATavahA asRRigjalA; rathoDupA ku~njarashailasa~NkaTA |
manuShyashIrShopalamA.nsakardamA; praviddhanAnAvidhashastramAlinI
shlokas.50:
mahAbhayA vaitaraNIva dustarA; pravartitA yodhavaraistadA nadI |
uvAha madhyena raNAjiraM bhRRishaM; bhayAvahA jIvamRRitapravAhinI
shlokas.51:
pibanti chAshnanti cha yatra durdRRishAH; pishAchasa~NghA vividhAH subhairavAH |
sunanditAH prANabhRRitAM bhaya~NkarAH; samAnabhakShAH shvasRRigAlapakShiNaH
shlokas.52:
tathA tadAyodhanamugradarshanaM; nishAmukhe pitRRipatirAShTrasaMnibham |
nirIkShamANAH shanakairjahurnarAH; samutthitAruNDakulopasa~Nkulam
shlokas.53:
apetavidhvastamahArhabhUShaNaM; nipAtitaM shakrasamaM mahAratham |
raNe.abhimanyuM dadRRishustadA janA; vyapoDhahavyaM sadasIva pAvakam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasmi.nstu nihate vIre saubhadre rathayUthape |
vimuktarathasaMnAhAH sarve nikShiptakArmukAH
shlokas.2:
upopaviShTA rAjAnaM parivArya yudhiShThiram |
tadeva duHkhaM dhyAyantaH saubhadragatamAnasAH
shlokas.3:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA vilalApa suduHkhitaH |
abhimanyau hate vIre bhrAtuH putre mahArathe
shlokas.4:
droNAnIkamasambAdhaM mama priyachikIrShayA |
bhittvA vyUhaM praviShTo.asau gomadhyamiva kesarI
shlokas.5:
yasya shUrA maheShvAsAH pratyanIkagatA raNe |
prabhagnA vinivartante kRRitAstrA yuddhadurmadAH
shlokas.6:
atyantashatrurasmAkaM yena duHshAsanaH sharaiH |
kShipraM hyabhimukhaH sa~Nkye visa~nj~no vimukhIkRRitaH
shlokas.7:
sa tIrtvA dustaraM vIro droNAnIkamahArNavam |
prApya dauHshAsaniM kArShNiryAto vaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.8:
kathaM drakShyAmi kaunteyaM saubhadre nihate.arjunam |
subhadrAM vA mahAbhAgAM priyaM putramapashyatIm
shlokas.9:
kiM svidvayamapetArthamashliShTamasama~njasam |
tAvubhau prativakShyAmo hRRiShIkeshadhana~njayau
shlokas.10:
ahameva subhadrAyAH keshavArjunayorapi |
priyakAmo jayAkA~NkShI kRRitavAnidamapriyam
shlokas.11:
na lubdho budhyate doShAnmohAllobhaH pravartate |
madhu lipsurhi nApashyaM prapAtamidamIdRRisham
shlokas.12:
yo hi bhojye puraskAryo yAneShu shayaneShu cha |
bhUShaNeShu cha so.asmAbhirbAlo yudhi puraskRRitaH
shlokas.13:
kathaM hi bAlastaruNo yuddhAnAmavishAradaH |
sadashva iva sambAdhe viShame kShemamarhati
shlokas.14:
no cheddhi vayamapyenaM mahImanushayImahi |
bIbhatsoH kopadIptasya dagdhAH kRRipaNachakShuShA
shlokas.15:
alubdho matimAnhrImAnkShamAvAnrUpavAnbalI |
vapuShmAnmAnakRRidvIraH priyaH satyaparAyaNaH
shlokas.16:
yasya shlAghanti vibudhAH karmANyUrjitakarmaNaH |
nivAtakavachA~njaghne kAlakeyA.nshcha vIryavAn
shlokas.17:
mahendrashatravo yena hiraNyapuravAsinaH |
akShNornimeShamAtreNa paulomAH sagaNA hatAH
shlokas.18:
parebhyo.apyabhayArthibhyo yo dadAtyabhayaM vibhuH |
tasyAsmAbhirna shakitastrAtumadyAtmajo bhayAt
shlokas.19:
bhayaM tu sumahatprAptaM dhArtarAShTraM mahadbalam |
pArthaH putravadhAtkruddhaH kauravA~nshoShayiShyati
shlokas.20:
kShudraH kShudrasahAyashcha svapakShakShayamAturaH |
vyaktaM duryodhano dRRiShTvA shochanhAsyati jIvitam
shlokas.21:
na me jayaH prItikaro na rAjyaM; na chAmaratvaM na suraiH salokatA |
imaM samIkShyAprativIryapauruShaM; nipAtitaM devavarAtmajAtmajam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasminnahani nirvRRitte ghore prANabhRRitAM kShaye |
Aditye.asta~Ngate shrImAnsandhyAkAla upasthite
shlokas.2:
vyapayAteShu sainyeShu vAsAya bharatarShabha |
hatvA sa.nshaptakavrAtAndivyairastraiH kapidhvajaH
shlokas.3:
prAyAtsvashibiraM jiShNurjaitramAsthAya taM ratham |
gachChanneva cha govindaM sannakaNTho.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.4:
kiM nu me hRRidayaM trastaM vAkyaM sajjati keshava |
spandanti chApyaniShTAni gAtraM sIdati chAchyuta
shlokas.5:
aniShTaM chaiva me shliShTaM hRRidayAnnApasarpati |
bhuvi yaddikShu chApyugrA utpAtAstrAsayanti mAm
shlokas.6:
bahuprakArA dRRishyante sarva evAghasha.nsinaH |
api svasti bhavedrAj~naH sAmAtyasya gurormama
shlokas.7:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
vyaktaM shivaM tava bhrAtuH sAmAtyasya bhaviShyati |
mA shuchaH ki~nchidevAnyattatrAniShTaM bhaviShyati
shlokas.8:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH sandhyAmupAsyaiva vIrau vIrAvasAdane |
kathayantau raNe vRRittaM prayAtau rathamAsthitau
shlokas.9:
tataH svashibiraM prAptau hatAnandaM hatatviSham |
vAsudevo.arjunashchaiva kRRitvA karma suduShkaram
shlokas.10:
dhvastAkAraM samAlakShya shibiraM paravIrahA |
bIbhatsurabravItkRRiShNamasvasthahRRidayastataH
shlokas.11:
nAdya nandanti tUryANi ma~NgalyAni janArdana |
mishrA dundubhinirghoShaiH sha~NkhAshchADambaraiH saha
vINA vA nAdya vAdyante shamyAtAlasvanaiH saha
shlokas.12:
ma~NgalyAni cha gItAni na gAyanti paThanti cha |
stutiyuktAni ramyANi mamAnIkeShu bandinaH
shlokas.13:
yodhAshchApi hi mAM dRRiShTvA nivartante hyadhomukhAH |
karmANi cha yathApUrvaM kRRitvA nAbhivadanti mAm
shlokas.14:
api svasti bhavedadya bhrAtRRibhyo mama mAdhava |
na hi shudhyati me bhAvo dRRiShTvA svajanamAkulam
shlokas.15:
api pA~nchAlarAjasya virATasya cha mAnada |
sarveShAM chaiva yodhAnAM sAmagryaM syAnmamAchyuta
shlokas.16:
na cha mAmadya saubhadraH prahRRiShTo bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
raNAdAyAntamuchitaM pratyudyAti hasanniva
shlokas.17:
evaM sa~Nkathayantau tau praviShTau shibiraM svakam |
dadRRishAte bhRRishAsvasthAnpANDavAnnaShTachetasaH
shlokas.18:
dRRiShTvA bhrAtR^I.nshcha putrA.nshcha vimanA vAnaradhvajaH |
apashya.nshchaiva saubhadramidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.19:
mukhavarNo.aprasanno vaH sarveShAmeva lakShyate |
na chAbhimanyuM pashyAmi na cha mAM pratinandatha
shlokas.20:
mayA shrutashcha droNena chakravyUho vinirmitaH |
na cha vastasya bhettAsti RRite saubhadramAhave
shlokas.21:
na chopadiShTastasyAsInmayAnIkavinirgamaH |
kachchinna bAlo yuShmAbhiH parAnIkaM praveshitaH
shlokas.22:
bhittvAnIkaM maheShvAsaH pareShAM bahusho yudhi |
kachchinna nihataH shete saubhadraH paravIrahA
shlokas.23:
lohitAkShaM mahAbAhuM jAtaM siMhamivAdriShu |
upendrasadRRishaM brUta kathamAyodhane hataH
shlokas.24:
sukumAraM maheShvAsaM vAsavasyAtmajAtmajam |
sadA mama priyaM brUta kathamAyodhane hataH
shlokas.25:
vArShNeyIdayitaM shUraM mayA satatalAlitam |
ambAyAshcha priyaM nityaM ko.avadhItkAlachoditaH
shlokas.26:
sadRRisho vRRiShNisiMhasya keshavasya mahAtmanaH |
vikramashrutamAhAtmyaiH kathamAyodhane hataH
shlokas.27:
subhadrAyAH priyaM nityaM draupadyAH keshavasya cha |
yadi putraM na pashyAmi yAsyAmi yamasAdanam
shlokas.28:
mRRiduku~nchitakeshAntaM bAlaM bAlamRRigekShaNam |
mattadviradavikrAntaM shAlapotamivodgatam
shlokas.29:
smitAbhibhAShiNaM dAntaM guruvAkyakaraM sadA |
bAlye.apyabAlakarmANaM priyavAkyamamatsaram
shlokas.30:
mahotsAhaM mahAbAhuM dIrgharAjIvalochanam |
bhaktAnukampinaM dAntaM na cha nIchAnusAriNam
shlokas.31:
kRRitaj~naM j~nAnasampannaM kRRitAstramanivartinam |
yuddhAbhinandinaM nityaM dviShatAmaghavardhanam
shlokas.32:
sveShAM priyahite yuktaM pitR^INAM jayagRRiddhinam |
na cha pUrvaprahartAraM sa~NgrAme naShTasambhramam
yadi putraM na pashyAmi yAsyAmi yamasAdanam
shlokas.33:
sulalATaM sukeshAntaM subhrvakShidashanachChadam |
apashyatastadvadanaM kA shAntirhRRidayasya me
shlokas.34:
tantrIsvanasukhaM ramyaM pu.nskokilasamadhvanim |
ashRRiNvataH svanaM tasya kA shAntirhRRidayasya me
shlokas.35:
rUpaM chApratirUpaM tattridasheShvapi durlabham |
apashyato.adya vIrasya kA shAntirhRRidayasya me
shlokas.36:
abhivAdanadakShaM taM pitR^INAM vachane ratam |
nAdyAhaM yadi pashyAmi kA shAntirhRRidayasya me
shlokas.37:
sukumAraH sadA vIro mahArhashayanochitaH |
bhUmAvanAthavachChete nUnaM nAthavatAM varaH
shlokas.38:
shayAnaM samupAsanti yaM purA paramastriyaH |
tamadya vipraviddhA~NgamupAsantyashivAH shivAH
shlokas.39:
yaH purA bodhyate suptaH sUtamAgadhabandibhiH |
bodhayantyadya taM nUnaM shvApadA vikRRitaiH svaraiH
shlokas.40:
ChatrachChAyAsamuchitaM tasya tadvadanaM shubham |
nUnamadya rajodhvastaM raNe reNuH kariShyati
shlokas.41:
hA putrakAvitRRiptasya satataM putradarshane |
bhAgyahInasya kAlena yathA me nIyase balAt
shlokas.42:
sAdya sa.nyamanI nUnaM sadA sukRRitinAM gatiH |
svabhAbhirbhAsitA ramyA tvayAtyarthaM virAjate
shlokas.43:
nUnaM vaivasvatashcha tvA varuNashcha priyAtithiH |
shatakraturdhaneshashcha prAptamarchantyabhIrukam
shlokas.44:
evaM vilapya bahudhA bhinnapoto vaNigyathA |
duHkhena mahatAviShTo yudhiShThiramapRRichChata
shlokas.45:
kachchitsa kadanaM kRRitvA pareShAM pANDunandana |
svargato.abhimukhaH sa~Nkhye yudhyamAno nararShabhaH
shlokas.46:
sa nUnaM bahubhiryattairyudhyamAno nararShabhaiH |
asahAyaH sahAyArthI mAmanudhyAtavAndhruvam
shlokas.47:
pIDyamAnaH sharairbAlastAta sAdhvabhidhAva mAm |
iti vipralapanmanye nRRisha.nsairbahubhirhataH
shlokas.48:
atha vA matprasUtashcha svasrIyo mAdhavasya cha |
subhadrAyAM cha sambhUto naivaM vaktumihArhati
shlokas.49:
vajrasAramayaM nUnaM hRRidayaM sudRRiDhaM mama |
apashyato dIrghabAhuM raktAkShaM yanna dIryate
shlokas.50:
kathaM bAle maheShvAse nRRisha.nsA marmabhedinaH |
svasrIye vAsudevasya mama putre.akShipa~nsharAn
shlokas.51:
yo mAM nityamadInAtmA pratyudgamyAbhinandati |
upayAntaM ripUnhatvA so.adya mAM kiM na pashyati
shlokas.52:
nUnaM sa patitaH shete dharaNyAM rudhirokShitaH |
shobhayanmedinIM gAtrairAditya iva pAtitaH
shlokas.53:
raNe vinihataM shrutvA shokArtA vai vina~NkShyati |
subhadrA vakShyate kiM mAmabhimanyumapashyatI
draupadI chaiva duHkhArte te cha vakShyAmi kiM nvaham
shlokas.54:
vajrasAramayaM nUnaM hRRidayaM yanna yAsyati |
sahasradhA vadhUM dRRiShTvA rudatIM shokakarshitAm
shlokas.55:
hRRiShTAnAM dhArtarAShTrANAM siMhanAdo mayA shrutaH |
yuyutsushchApi kRRiShNena shruto vIrAnupAlabhan
shlokas.56:
ashaknuvanto bIbhatsuM bAlaM hatvA mahArathAH |
kiM nadadhvamadharmaj~nAH pArthe vai dRRishyatAM balam
shlokas.57:
kiM tayorvipriyaM kRRitvA keshavArjunayormRRidhe |
siMhavannadata prItAH shokakAla upasthite
shlokas.58:
AgamiShyati vaH kShipraM phalaM pApasya karmaNaH |
adharmo hi kRRitastIvraH kathaM syAdaphalashchiram
shlokas.59:
iti tAnprati bhAShanvai vaishyAputro mahAmatiH |
apAyAchChastramutsRRijya kopaduHkhasamanvitaH
shlokas.60:
kimarthametannAkhyAtaM tvayA kRRiShNa raNe mama |
adhakShyaM tAnahaM sarvA.nstadA krUrAnmahArathAn
shlokas.61:
nigRRihya vAsudevastaM putrAdhibhirabhiplutam |
maivamityabravItkRRiShNastIvrashokasamanvitam
shlokas.62:
sarveShAmeSha vai panthAH shUrANAmanivartinAm |
kShatriyANAM visheSheNa yeShAM yuddhena jIvikA
shlokas.63:
eShA vai yudhyamAnAnAM shUrANAmanivartinAm |
vihitA dharmashAstraj~nairgatirgatimatAM vara
shlokas.64:
dhruvaM yuddhe hi maraNaM shUrANAmanivartinAm |
gataH puNyakRRitAM lokAnabhimanyurna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.65:
etachcha sarvavIrANAM kA~NkShitaM bharatarShabha |
sa~NgrAme.abhimukhA mRRityuM prapnuyAmeti mAnada
shlokas.66:
sa cha vIrAnraNe hatvA rAjaputrAnmahAbalAn |
vIrairAkA~NkShitaM mRRityuM samprApto.abhimukho raNe
shlokas.67:
mA shuchaH puruShavyAghra pUrvaireSha sanAtanaH |
dharmakRRidbhiH kRRito dharmaH kShatriyANAM raNe kShayaH
shlokas.68:
ime te bhrAtaraH sarve dInA bharatasattama |
tvayi shokasamAviShTe nRRipAshcha suhRRidastava
shlokas.69:
etA.nstvaM vachasA sAmnA samAshvAsaya mAnada |
viditaM veditavyaM te na shokaM kartumarhasi
shlokas.70:
evamAshvAsitaH pArthaH kRRiShNenAdbhutakarmaNA |
tato.abravIttadA bhrAtR^InsarvAnpArthaH sagadgadAn
shlokas.71:
sa dIrghabAhuH pRRithva.nso dIrgharAjIvalochanaH |
abhimanyuryathA vRRittaH shrotumichChAmyahaM tathA
shlokas.72:
sanAgasyandanahayAndrakShyadhvaM nihatAnmayA |
sa~NgrAme sAnubandhA.nstAnmama putrasya vairiNaH
shlokas.73:
kathaM cha vaH kRRitAstrANAM sarveShAM shastrapANinAm |
saubhadro nidhanaM gachChedvajriNApi samAgataH
shlokas.74:
yadyevamahamaj~nAsyamashaktAnrakShaNe mama |
putrasya pANDupA~nchAlAnmayA gupto bhavettataH
shlokas.75:
kathaM cha vo rathasthAnAM sharavarShANi mu~nchatAm |
nIto.abhimanyurnidhanaM kadarthIkRRitya vaH paraiH
shlokas.76:
aho vaH pauruShaM nAsti na cha vo.asti parAkramaH |
yatrAbhimanyuH samare pashyatAM vo nipAtitaH
shlokas.77:
AtmAnameva garheyaM yadahaM vaH sudurbalAn |
yuShmAnAj~nAya niryAto bhIrUnakRRitanishramAn
shlokas.78:
Aho svidbhUShaNArthAya varmashastrAyudhAni vaH |
vAchashcha vaktuM sa.nsatsu mama putramarakShatAm
shlokas.79:
evamuktvA tato vAkyaM tiShTha.nshchApavarAsimAn |
na smAshakyata bIbhatsuH kenachitprasamIkShitum
shlokas.80:
tamantakamiva kruddhaM niHshvasantaM muhurmuhuH |
putrashokAbhisantaptamashrupUrNamukhaM tadA
shlokas.81:
nAbhibhAShTuM shaknuvanti draShTuM vA suhRRido.arjunam |
anyatra vAsudevAdvA jyeShTAdvA pANDunandanAt
shlokas.82:
sarvAsvavasthAsu hitAvarjunasya manonugau |
bahumAnAtpriyatvAchcha tAvenaM vaktumarhataH
shlokas.83:
tatastaM putrashokena bhRRishaM pIDitamAnasam |
rAjIvalochanaM kruddhaM rAjA vachanamabravIt

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
tvayi yAte mahAbAho sa.nshaptakabalaM prati |
prayatnamakarottIvramAchAryo grahaNe mama
shlokas.2:
vyADhAnIkaM vayaM droNaM varayAmaH sma sarvashaH |
prativyUhya rathAnIkaM yatamAnaM tathA raNe
shlokas.3:
sa vAryamANo rathibhI rakShitena mayA tathA |
asmAnapi jaghAnAshu pIDayannishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.4:
te pIDyamAnA droNena droNAnIkaM na shaknumaH |
prativIkShitumapyAjau bhettuM tatkuta eva tu
shlokas.5:
vayaM tvapratimaM vIrye sarve saubhadramAtmajam |
uktavantaH sma te tAta bhindhyanIkamiti prabho
shlokas.6:
sa tathA chodito.asmAbhiH sadashva iva vIryavAn |
asahyamapi taM bhAraM voDhumevopachakrame
shlokas.7:
sa tavAstropadeshena vIryeNa cha samanvitaH |
prAvishattadbalaM bAlaH suparNa iva sAgaram
shlokas.8:
te.anuyAtA vayaM vIraM sAtvatIputramAhave |
praveShTukAmAstenaiva yena sa prAvishachchamUm
shlokas.9:
tataH saindhavako rAjA kShudrastAta jayadrathaH |
varadAnena rudrasya sarvAnnaH samavArayat
shlokas.10:
tato droNaH kRRipaH karNo drauNishcha sa bRRihadbalaH |
kRRitavarmA cha saubhadraM ShaDrathAH paryavArayan
shlokas.11:
parivArya tu taiH sarvairyudhi bAlo mahArathaiH |
yatamAnaH paraM shaktyA bahubhirvirathIkRRitaH
shlokas.12:
tato dauHshAsaniH kShipraM tathA tairvirathIkRRitam |
sa.nshayaM paramaM prApya diShTAntenAbhyayojayat
shlokas.13:
sa tu hatvA sahasrANi dvipAshvarathasAdinAm |
rAjaputrashataM chAgryaM vIrA.nshchAlakShitAnbahUn
shlokas.14:
bRRihadbalaM cha rAjAnaM svargeNAjau prayojya ha |
tataH paramadharmAtmA diShTAntamupajagmivAn
shlokas.15:
etAvadeva nirvRRittamasmAkaM shokavardhanam |
sa chaivaM puruShavyAghraH svargalokamavAptavAn
shlokas.16:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato.arjuno vachaH shrutvA dharmarAjena bhAShitam |
hA putra iti niHshvasya vyathito nyapatadbhuvi
shlokas.17:
viShaNNavadanAH sarve parigRRihya dhana~njayam |
netrairanimiShairdInAH pratyavekShanparasparam
shlokas.18:
pratilabhya tataH sa~nj~nAM vAsaviH krodhamUrChitaH |
kampamAno jvareNeva niHshvasa.nshcha muhurmuhuH
shlokas.19:
pANiM pANau viniShpiShya shvasamAno.ashrunetravAn |
unmatta iva viprekShannidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.20:
satyaM vaH pratijAnAmi shvo.asmi hantA jayadratham |
na chedvadhabhayAdbhIto dhArtarAShTrAnprahAsyati
shlokas.21:
na chAsmA~nsharaNaM gachChetkRRiShNaM vA puruShottamam |
bhavantaM vA mahArAja shvo.asmi hantA jayadratham
shlokas.22:
dhArtarAShTrapriyakaraM mayi vismRRitasauhRRidam |
pApaM bAlavadhe hetuM shvo.asmi hantA jayadratham
shlokas.23:
rakShamANAshcha taM sa~Nkhye ye mAM yotsyanti kechana |
api droNakRRipau vIrau ChAdayiShyAmi tA~nsharaiH
shlokas.24:
yadyetadevaM sa~NgrAme na kuryAM puruSharShabhAH |
mA sma puNyakRRitAM lokAnprApnuyAM shUrasaMmatAn
shlokas.25:
ye lokA mAtRRihantR^INAM ye chApi pitRRighAtinAm |
gurudAragAminAM ye cha pishunAnAM cha ye tathA
shlokas.26:
sAdhUnasUyatAM ye cha ye chApi parivAdinAm |
ye cha nikShepahartR^INAM ye cha vishvAsaghAtinAm
shlokas.27:
bhuktapUrvAM striyaM ye cha nindatAmaghasha.nsinAm |
brahmaghnAnAM cha ye lokA ye cha goghAtinAmapi
shlokas.28:
pAyasaM vA yavAnnaM vA shAkaM kRRisarameva vA |
sa.nyAvApUpamA.nsAni ye cha lokA vRRithAshnatAm
tAnahnaivAdhigachCheyaM na cheddhanyAM jayadratham
shlokas.29:
vedAdhyAyinamatyarthaM sa.nshitaM vA dvijottamam |
avamanyamAno yAnyAti vRRiddhAnsAdhU.nstathA gurUn
shlokas.30:
spRRishatAM brAhmaNaM gAM cha pAdenAgniM cha yAM labhet |
yApsu shleShma purIShaM vA mUtraM vA mu~nchatAM gatiH
tAM gachCheyaM gatiM ghorAM na cheddhanyAM jayadratham
shlokas.31:
nagnasya snAyamAnasya yA cha vandhyAtithergatiH |
utkochinAM mRRiShoktInAM va~nchakAnAM cha yA gatiH
AtmApahAriNAM yA cha yA cha mithyAbhisha.nsinAm
shlokas.32:
bhRRityaiH sa.ndRRishyamAnAnAM putradArAshritaistathA |
asa.nvibhajya kShudrANAM yA gatirmRRiShTamashnatAm
tAM gachCheyaM gatiM ghorAM na cheddhanyAM jayadratham
shlokas.33:
sa.nshritaM vApi yastyaktvA sAdhuM tadvachane ratam |
na bibharti nRRisha.nsAtmA nindate chopakAriNam
shlokas.34:
arhate prAtiveshyAya shrAddhaM yo na dadAti cha |
anarhate cha yo dadyAdvRRiShalIpatyureva cha
shlokas.35:
madyapo bhinnamaryAdaH kRRitaghno bhrAtRRinindakaH |
teShAM gatimiyAM kShipraM na cheddhanyAM jayadratham
shlokas.36:
dharmAdapetA ye chAnye mayA nAtrAnukIrtitAH |
ye chAnukIrtitAH kShipraM teShAM gatimavApnuyAm
yadi vyuShTAmimAM rAtriM shvo na hanyAM jayadratham
shlokas.37:
imAM chApyaparAM bhUyaH pratij~nAM me nibodhata |
yadyasminnahate pApe sUryo.astamupayAsyati
ihaiva sampraveShTAhaM jvalitaM jAtavedasam
shlokas.38:
asurasuramanuShyAH pakShiNo voragA vA; pitRRirajanicharA vA brahmadevarShayo vA |
charamacharamapIdaM yatparaM chApi tasmA;ttadapi mama ripuM taM rakShituM naiva shaktAH
shlokas.39:
yadi vishati rasAtalaM tadagryaM; viyadapi devapuraM diteH puraM vA |
tadapi sharashatairahaM prabhAte; bhRRishamabhipatya ripoH shiro.abhihartA
shlokas.40:
evamuktvA vichikShepa gANDIvaM savyadakShiNam |
tasya shabdamatikramya dhanuHshabdo.aspRRishaddivam
shlokas.41:
arjunena pratij~nAte pA~nchajanyaM janArdanaH |
pradadhmau tatra sa~Nkruddho devadattaM dhana~njayaH
shlokas.42:
sa pA~nchajanyo.achyutavaktravAyunA; bhRRishaM supUrNodaraniHsRRitadhvaniH |
jagatsapAtAlaviyaddigIshvaraM; prakampayAmAsa yugAtyaye yathA
shlokas.43:
tato vAditraghoShAshcha prAdurAsansamantataH |
siMhanAdAshcha pANDUnAM pratij~nAte mahAtmanA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shrutvA tu taM mahAshabdaM pANDUnAM putragRRiddhinAm |
chAraiH pravedite tatra samutthAya jayadrathaH
shlokas.2:
shokasaMmUDhahRRidayo duHkhenAbhihato bhRRisham |
majjamAna ivAgAdhe vipule shokasAgare
shlokas.3:
jagAma samitiM rAj~nAM saindhavo vimRRishanbahu |
sa teShAM naradevAnAM sakAshe paridevayan
shlokas.4:
abhimanyoH piturbhItaH savrIDo vAkyamabravIt |
yo.asau pANDoH kila kShetre jAtaH shakreNa kAminA
shlokas.5:
sa ninIShati durbuddhirmAM kilaikaM yamakShayam |
tatsvasti vo.astu yAsyAmi svagRRihaM jIvitepsayA
shlokas.6:
atha vA stha pratibalAstrAtuM mAM kShatriyarShabhAH |
pArthena prArthitaM vIrAste dadantu mamAbhayam
shlokas.7:
droNaduryodhanakRRipAH karNamadreshabAhlikAH |
duHshAsanAdayaH shaktAstrAtumapyantakAdritam
shlokas.8:
kima~Nga punarekena phalgunena jighA.nsatA |
na trAyeyurbhavanto mAM samastAH patayaH kShiteH
shlokas.9:
praharShaM pANDaveyAnAM shrutvA mama mahadbhayam |
sIdantIva cha me.a~NgAni mumUrShoriva pArthivAH
shlokas.10:
vadho nUnaM pratij~nAto mama gANDIvadhanvanA |
tathA hi hRRiShTAH kroshanti shokakAle.api pANDavAH
shlokas.11:
na devA na cha gandharvA nAsuroragarAkShasAH |
utsahante.anyathA kartuM kuta eva narAdhipAH
shlokas.12:
tasmAnmAmanujAnIta bhadraM vo.astu nararShabhAH |
adarshanaM gamiShyAmi na mAM drakShyanti pANDavAH
shlokas.13:
evaM vilapamAnaM taM bhayAdvyAkulachetasam |
AtmakAryagarIyastvAdrAjA duryodhano.abravIt
shlokas.14:
na bhetavyaM naravyAghra ko hi tvA puruSharShabha |
madhye kShatriyavIrANAM tiShThantaM prArthayedyudhi
shlokas.15:
ahaM vaikartanaH karNashchitraseno vivi.nshatiH |
bhUrishravAH shalaH shalyo vRRiShaseno durAsadaH
shlokas.16:
purumitro jayo bhojaH kAmbojashcha sudakShiNaH |
satyavrato mahAbAhurvikarNo durmukhaH sahaH
shlokas.17:
duHshAsanaH subAhushcha kali~NgashchApyudAyudhaH |
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau droNo drauNiH sasaubalaH
shlokas.18:
tvaM chApi rathinAM shreShThaH svayaM shUro.amitadyutiH |
sa kathaM pANDaveyebhyo bhayaM pashyasi saindhava
shlokas.19:
akShauhiNyo dashaikA cha madIyAstava rakShaNe |
yattA yotsyanti mA bhaistvaM saindhava vyetu te bhayam
shlokas.20:
evamAshvAsito rAjanputreNa tava saindhavaH |
duryodhanena sahito droNaM rAtrAvupAgamat
shlokas.21:
upasa~NgrahaNaM kRRitvA droNAya sa vishAM pate |
upopavishya praNataH paryapRRichChadidaM tadA
shlokas.22:
nimitte dUrapAtitve laghutve dRRiDhavedhane |
mama bravItu bhagavAnvisheShaM phalgunasya cha
shlokas.23:
vidyAvisheShamichChAmi j~nAtumAchArya tattvataH |
mamArjunasya cha vibho yathAtattvaM prachakShva me
shlokas.24:
droNa uvAcha||
samamAchAryakaM tAta tava chaivArjunasya cha |
yogAdduHkhochitatvAchcha tasmAttvatto.adhiko.arjunaH
shlokas.25:
na tu te yudhi santrAsaH kAryaH pArthAtkatha~nchana |
ahaM hi rakShitA tAta bhayAttvAM nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.26:
na hi madbAhuguptasya prabhavantyamarA api |
vyUhiShyAmi cha taM vyUhaM yaM pArtho na tariShyati
shlokas.27:
tasmAdyudhyasva mA bhaistvaM svadharmamanupAlaya |
pitRRipaitAmahaM mArgamanuyAhi narAdhipa
shlokas.28:
adhItya vidhivadvedAnagnayaH suhutAstvayA |
iShTaM cha bahubhiryaj~nairna te mRRityubhayAdbhayam
shlokas.29:
durlabhaM mAnuShairmandairmahAbhAgyamavApya tu |
bhujavIryArjitA.NllokAndivyAnprApsyasyanuttamAn
shlokas.30:
kuravaH pANDavAshchaiva vRRiShNayo.anye cha mAnavAH |
ahaM cha saha putreNa adhruvA iti chintyatAm
shlokas.31:
paryAyeNa vayaM sarve kAlena balinA hatAH |
paralokaM gamiShyAmaH svaiH svaiH karmabhiranvitAH
shlokas.32:
tapastaptvA tu yA.NllokAnprApnuvanti tapasvinaH |
kShatradharmAshritAH shUrAH kShatriyAH prApnuvanti tAn
shlokas.33:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamAshvAsito rAjanbhAradvAjena saindhavaH |
apAnudadbhayaM pArthAdyuddhAya cha mano dadhe

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
pratij~nAte tu pArthena sindhurAjavadhe tadA |
vAsudevo mahAbAhurdhana~njayamabhAShata
shlokas.2:
bhrAtR^INAM matamAj~nAya tvayA vAchA pratishrutam |
saindhavaM shvo.asmi hanteti tatsAhasatamaM kRRitam
shlokas.3:
asaMmantrya mayA sArdhamatibhAro.ayamudyataH |
kathaM nu sarvalokasya nAvahAsyA bhavemahi
shlokas.4:
dhArtarAShTrasya shibire mayA praNihitAshcharAH |
ta ime shIghramAgamya pravRRittiM vedayanti naH
shlokas.5:
tvayA vai sampratij~nAte sindhurAjavadhe tadA |
siMhanAdaH savAditraH sumahAniha taiH shrutaH
shlokas.6:
tena shabdena vitrastA dhArtarAShTrAH sasaindhavAH |
nAkasmAtsiMhanAdo.ayamiti matvA vyavasthitAH
shlokas.7:
sumahA~nshabdasampAtaH kauravANAM mahAbhuja |
AsInnAgAshvapattInAM rathaghoShashcha bhairavaH
shlokas.8:
abhimanyuvadhaM shrutvA dhruvamArto dhana~njayaH |
rAtrau niryAsyati krodhAditi matvA vyavasthitAH
shlokas.9:
tairyatadbhiriyaM satyA shrutA satyavatastava |
pratij~nA sindhurAjasya vadhe rAjIvalochana
shlokas.10:
tato vimanasaH sarve trastAH kShudramRRigA iva |
AsansuyodhanAmAtyAH sa cha rAjA jayadrathaH
shlokas.11:
athotthAya sahAmAtyairdInaH shibiramAtmanaH |
AyAtsauvIrasindhUnAmIshvaro bhRRishaduHkhitaH
shlokas.12:
sa mantrakAle saMmantrya sarvA naiHshreyasIH kriyAH |
suyodhanamidaM vAkyamabravIdrAjasa.nsadi
shlokas.13:
mAmasau putrahanteti shvo.abhiyAtA dhana~njayaH |
pratij~nAto hi senAyA madhye tena vadho mama
shlokas.14:
tAM na devA na gandharvA nAsuroragarAkShasAH |
utsahante.anyathA kartuM pratij~nAM savyasAchinaH
shlokas.15:
te mAM rakShata sa~NgrAme mA vo mUrdhni dhana~njayaH |
padaM kRRitvApnuyAllakShyaM tasmAdatra vidhIyatAm
shlokas.16:
atha rakShA na me sa~Nkhye kriyate kurunandana |
anujAnIhi mAM rAjangamiShyAmi gRRihAnprati
shlokas.17:
evamuktastvavAkShIrSho vimanAH sa suyodhanaH |
shrutvAbhishaptavantaM tvAM dhyAnamevAnvapadyata
shlokas.18:
tamArtamabhisamprekShya rAjA kila sa saindhavaH |
mRRidu chAtmahitaM chaiva sApekShamidamuktavAn
shlokas.19:
nAhaM pashyAmi bhavatAM tathAvIryaM dhanurdharam |
yo.arjunasyAstramastreNa pratihanyAnmahAhave
shlokas.20:
vAsudevasahAyasya gANDIvaM dhunvato dhanuH |
ko.arjunasyAgratastiShThetsAkShAdapi shatakratuH
shlokas.21:
maheshvaro.api pArthena shrUyate yodhitaH purA |
padAtinA mahAtejA girau himavati prabhuH
shlokas.22:
dAnavAnAM sahasrANi hiraNyapuravAsinAm |
jaghAnekarathenaiva devarAjaprachoditaH
shlokas.23:
samAyukto hi kaunteyo vAsudevena dhImatA |
sAmarAnapi lokA.nstrInnihanyAditi me matiH
shlokas.24:
so.ahamichChAmyanuj~nAtuM rakShituM vA mahAtmanA |
droNena sahaputreNa vIreNa yadi manyase
shlokas.25:
sa rAj~nA svayamAchAryo bhRRishamAkrandito.arjuna |
sa.nvidhAnaM cha vihitaM rathAshcha kila sajjitAH
shlokas.26:
karNo bhUrishravA drauNirvRRiShasenashcha durjayaH |
kRRipashcha madrarAjashcha ShaDete.asya purogamAH
shlokas.27:
shakaTaH padmapashchArdho vyUho droNena kalpitaH |
padmakarNikamadhyasthaH sUchIpAshe jayadrathaH
sthAsyate rakShito vIraiH sindhurADyuddhadurmadaiH
shlokas.28:
dhanuShyastre cha vIrye cha prANe chaiva tathorasi |
aviShahyatamA hyete nishchitAH pArtha ShaDrathAH
etAnajitvA sagaNAnnaiva prApyo jayadrathaH
shlokas.29:
teShAmekaikasho vIryaM ShaNNAM tvamanuchintaya |
sahitA hi naravyAghrA na shakyA jetuma~njasA
shlokas.30:
bhUyashcha chintayiShyAmi nItimAtmahitAya vai |
mantraj~naiH sachivaiH sArdhaM suhRRidbhiH kAryasiddhaye
shlokas.31:
arjuna uvAcha||
ShaDrathAndhArtarAShTrasya manyase yAnbalAdhikAn |
teShAM vIryaM mamArdhena na tulyamiti lakShaye
shlokas.32:
astramastreNa sarveShAmeteShAM madhusUdana |
mayA drakShyasi nirbhinnaM jayadrathavadhaiShiNA
shlokas.33:
droNasya miShataH so.ahaM sagaNasya vilapyataH |
mUrdhAnaM sindhurAjasya pAtayiShyAmi bhUtale
shlokas.34:
yadi sAdhyAshcha rudrAshcha vasavashcha sahAshvinaH |
marutashcha sahendreNa vishvedevAstathAsurAH
shlokas.35:
pitaraH sahagandharvAH suparNAH sAgarAdrayaH |
dyaurviyatpRRithivI cheyaM dishashcha sadigIshvarAH
shlokas.36:
grAmyAraNyAni bhUtAni sthAvarANi charANi cha |
trAtAraH sindhurAjasya bhavanti madhusUdana
shlokas.37:
tathApi bANairnihataM shvo draShTAsi raNe mayA |
satyena te shape kRRiShNa tathaivAyudhamAlabhe
shlokas.38:
yashcha goptA maheShvAsastasya pApasya durmateH |
tameva prathamaM droNamabhiyAsyAmi keshava
shlokas.39:
tasmindyUtamidaM baddhaM manyate sma suyodhanaH |
tasmAttasyaiva senAgraM bhittvA yAsyAmi saindhavam
shlokas.40:
draShTAsi shvo maheShvAsAnnArAchaistigmatejanaiH |
shRRi~NgANIva girervajrairdAryamANAnmayA yudhi
shlokas.41:
naranAgAshvadehebhyo visraviShyati shoNitam |
patadbhyaH patitebhyashcha vibhinnebhyaH shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.42:
gANDIvapreShitA bANA manonilasamA jave |
nRRinAgAshvAnvidehAsUnkartArashcha sahasrashaH
shlokas.43:
yamAtkuberAdvaruNAdrudrAdindrAchcha yanmayA |
upAttamastraM ghoraM vai taddraShTAro narA yudhi
shlokas.44:
brAhmeNAstreNa chAstrANi hanyamAnAni sa.nyuge |
mayA draShTAsi sarveShAM saindhavasyAbhirakShiNAm
shlokas.45:
sharavegasamutkRRittai rAj~nAM keshava mUrdhabhiH |
AstIryamANAM pRRithivIM draShTAsi shvo mayA yudhi
shlokas.46:
kravyAdA.nstarpayiShyAmi drAvayiShyAmi shAtravAn |
suhRRido nandayiShyAmi pAtayiShyAmi saindhavam
shlokas.47:
bahvAgaskRRitkusambandhI pApadeshasamudbhavaH |
mayA saindhavako rAjA hataH svA~nshochayiShyati
shlokas.48:
sarvakShIrAnnabhoktAraH pApAchArA raNAjire |
mayA sarAjakA bANairnunnA na~NkShyanti saindhavAH
shlokas.49:
tathA prabhAte kartAsmi yathA kRRiShNa suyodhanaH |
nAnyaM dhanurdharaM loke ma.nsyate matsamaM yudhi
shlokas.50:
gANDIvaM cha dhanurdivyaM yoddhA chAhaM nararShabha |
tvaM cha yantA hRRiShIkesha kiM nu syAdajitaM mayA
shlokas.51:
yathA hi lakShma chandre vai samudre cha yathA jalam |
evametAM pratij~nAM me satyAM viddhi janArdana
shlokas.52:
mAvama.nsthA mamAstrANi mAvama.nsthA dhanurdRRiDham |
mAvama.nsthA balaM bAhvormAvama.nsthA dhana~njayam
shlokas.53:
yathA hi yAtvA sa~NgrAme na jIye vijayAmi cha |
tena satyena sa~NgrAme hataM viddhi jayadratham
shlokas.54:
dhruvaM vai brAhmaNe satyaM dhruvA sAdhuShu saMnatiH |
shrIrdhruvA chApi dakSheShu dhruvo nArAyaNe jayaH
shlokas.55:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamuktvA hRRiShIkeshaM svayamAtmAnamAtmanA |
sa.ndideshArjuno nardanvAsaviH keshavaM prabhum
shlokas.56:
yathA prabhAtAM rajanIM kalpitaH syAdratho mama |
tathA kAryaM tvayA kRRiShNa kAryaM hi mahadudyatam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tAM nishAM duHkhashokArtau shvasantAviva choragau |
nidrAM naivopalebhAte vAsudevadhana~njayau
shlokas.2:
naranArAyaNau kruddhau j~nAtvA devAH savAsavAH |
vyathitAshchintayAmAsuH kiM svidetadbhaviShyati
shlokas.3:
vavushcha dAruNA vAtA rUkShA gorAbhisha.nsinaH |
sakabandhastathAditye parighaH samadRRishyata
shlokas.4:
shuShkAshanyashcha niShpetuH sanirghAtAH savidyutaH |
chachAla chApi pRRithivI sashailavanakAnanA
shlokas.5:
chukShubhushcha mahArAja sAgarA makarAlayAH |
pratisrotaH pravRRittAshcha tathA gantuM samudragAH
shlokas.6:
rathAshvanaranAgAnAM pravRRittamadharottaram |
kravyAdAnAM pramodArthaM yamarAShTravivRRiddhaye
shlokas.7:
vAhanAni shakRRinmUtre mumuchU rurudushcha ha |
tAndRRiShTvA dAruNAnsarvAnutpAtA.NllomaharShaNAn
shlokas.8:
sarve te vyathitAH sainyAstvadIyA bharatarShabha |
shrutvA mahAbalasyogrAM pratij~nAM savyasAchinaH
shlokas.9:
atha kRRiShNaM mahAbAhurabravItpAkashAsaniH |
AshvAsaya subhadrAM tvaM bhaginIM snuShayA saha
shlokas.10:
snuShA shvashvrAnaghAyaste vishoke kuru mAdhava |
sAmnA satyena yuktena vachasAshvAsaya prabho
shlokas.11:
tato.arjunagRRihaM gatvA vAsudevaH sudurmanAH |
bhaginIM putrashokArtAmAshvAsayata duHkhitAm
shlokas.12:
mA shokaM kuru vArShNeyi kumAraM prati sasnuShA |
sarveShAM prANinAM bhIru niShThaiShA kAlanirmitA
shlokas.13:
kule jatasya vIrasya kShatriyasya visheShataH |
sadRRishaM maraNaM hyetattava putrasya mA shuchaH
shlokas.14:
diShTyA mahAratho vIraH pitustulyaparAkramaH |
kShAtreNa vidhinA prApto vIrAbhilaShitAM gatim
shlokas.15:
jitvA subahushaH shatrUnpreShayitvA cha mRRityave |
gataH puNyakRRitAM lokAnsarvakAmaduho.akShayAn
shlokas.16:
tapasA brahmacharyeNa shrutena praj~nayApi cha |
santo yAM gatimichChanti prAptastAM tava putrakaH
shlokas.17:
vIrasUrvIrapatnI tvaM vIrashvashurabAndhavA |
mA shuchastanayaM bhadre gataH sa paramAM gatim
shlokas.18:
prApsyate chApyasau kShudraH saindhavo bAlaghAtakaH |
asyAvalepasya phalaM sasuhRRidgaNabAndhavaH
shlokas.19:
vyuShTAyAM tu varArohe rajanyAM pApakarmakRRit |
na hi mokShyati pArthAtsa praviShTo.apyamarAvatIm
shlokas.20:
shvaH shiraH shroShyase tasya saindhavasya raNe hRRitam |
samantapa~nchakAdbAhyaM vishokA bhava mA rudaH
shlokas.21:
kShatradharmaM puraskRRitya gataH shUraH satAM gatim |
yAM vayaM prApnuyAmeha ye chAnye shastrajIvinaH
shlokas.22:
vyUDhorasko mahAbAhuranivartI varapraNut |
gatastava varArohe putraH svargaM jvaraM jahi
shlokas.23:
anu jAtashcha pitaraM mAtRRipakShaM cha vIryavAn |
sahasrasho ripUnhatvA hataH shUro mahArathaH
shlokas.24:
AshvAsaya snuShAM rAj~ni mA shuchaH kShatriye bhRRiSham |
shvaH priyaM sumahachChrutvA vishokA bhava nandini
shlokas.25:
yatpArthena pratij~nAtaM tattathA na tadanyathA |
chikIrShitaM hi te bharturna bhavejjAtu niShphalam
shlokas.26:
yadi cha manujapannagAH pishAchA; rajanicharAH patagAH surAsurAshcha |
raNagatamabhiyAnti sindhurAjaM; na sa bhavitA saha tairapi prabhAte

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
etachChrutvA vachastasya keshavasya mahAtmanaH |
subhadrA putrashokArtA vilalApa suduHkhitA
shlokas.2:
hA putra mama mandAyAH kathaM sa.nyugametya ha |
nidhanaM prAptavA.nstAta pitRRitulyaparAkramaH
shlokas.3:
kathamindIvarashyAmaM sudaMShTraM chArulochanam |
mukhaM te dRRishyate vatsa guNThitaM raNareNunA
shlokas.4:
nUnaM shUraM nipatitaM tvAM pashyantyanivartinam |
sushirogrIvabAhva.nsaM vyUDhoraskaM nirUdaram
shlokas.5:
chArUpachitasarvA~NgaM svakShaM shastrakShatAchitam |
bhUtAni tvA nirIkShante nUnaM chandramivoditam
shlokas.6:
shayanIyaM purA yasya spardhyAstaraNasa.nvRRitam |
bhUmAvadya kathaM sheShe vipraviddhaH sukhochitaH
shlokas.7:
yo.anvAsyata purA vIro varastrIbhirmahAbhujaH |
kathamanvAsyate so.adya shivAbhiH patito mRRidhe
shlokas.8:
yo.astUyata purA hRRiShTaiH sUtamAgadhabandibhiH |
so.adya kravyAdgaNairghorairvinadadbhirupAsyate
shlokas.9:
pANDaveShu cha nAtheShu vRRiShNivIreShu chAbhibho |
pA~nchAleShu cha vIreShu hataH kenAsyanAthavat
shlokas.10:
atRRiptadarshanA putra darshanasya tavAnagha |
mandabhAgyA gamiShyAmi vyaktamadya yamakShayam
shlokas.11:
vishAlAkShaM sukeshAntaM chAruvAkyaM sugandhi cha |
tava putra kadA bhUyo mukhaM drakShyAmi nirvraNam
shlokas.12:
dhigbalaM bhImasenasya dhikpArthasya dhanuShmatAm |
dhigvIryaM vRRiShNivIrANAM pA~nchAlAnAM cha dhigbalam
shlokas.13:
dhikkekayA.nstathA chedInmatsyA.nshchaivAtha sRRi~njayAn |
ye tvA raNe gataM vIraM na jAnanti nipAtitam
shlokas.14:
adya pashyAmi pRRithivIM shUnyAmiva hatatviSham |
abhimanyumapashyantI shokavyAkulalochanA
shlokas.15:
svasrIyaM vAsudevasya putraM gANDIvadhanvanaH |
kathaM tvA virathaM vIraM drakShyAmyanyairnipAtitam
shlokas.16:
hA vIra dRRiShTo naShTashcha dhanaM svapna ivAsi me |
aho hyanityaM mAnuShyaM jalabudbudacha~nchalam
shlokas.17:
imAM te taruNIM bhAryAM tvadAdhibhirabhiplutAm |
kathaM sandhArayiShyAmi vivatsAmiva dhenukAm
shlokas.18:
aho hyakAle prasthAnaM kRRitavAnasi putraka |
vihAya phalakAle mAM sugRRiddhAM tava darshane
shlokas.19:
nUnaM gatiH kRRitAntasya prAj~nairapi sudurvidA |
yatra tvaM keshave nAthe sa~NgrAme.anAthavaddhataH
shlokas.20:
yajvanAM dAnashIlAnAM brAhmaNAnAM kRRitAtmanAm |
charitabrahmacharyANAM puNyatIrthAvagAhinAm
shlokas.21:
kRRitaj~nAnAM vadAnyAnAM gurushushrUShiNAmapi |
sahasradakShiNAnAM cha yA gatistAmavApnuhi
shlokas.22:
yA gatiryudhyamAnAnAM shUrANAmanivartinAm |
hatvArInnihatAnAM cha sa~NgrAme tAM gatiM vraja
shlokas.23:
gosahasrapradAtR^INAM kratudAnAM cha yA gatiH |
naiveshikaM chAbhimataM dadatAM yA gatiH shubhA
shlokas.24:
brahmacharyeNa yAM yAnti munayaH sa.nshitavratA |
ekapatnyashcha yAM yAnti tAM gatiM vraja putraka
shlokas.25:
rAj~nAM sucharitairyA cha gatirbhavati shAshvatI |
chaturAshramiNAM puNyaiH pAvitAnAM surakShitaiH
shlokas.26:
dInAnukampinAM yA cha satataM sa.nvibhAginAm |
paishunyAchcha nivRRittAnAM tAM gatiM vraja putraka
shlokas.27:
vratinAM dharmashIlAnAM gurushushrUShiNAmapi |
amoghAtithinAM yA cha tAM gatiM vraja putraka
shlokas.28:
RRitukAle svakAM patnIM gachChatAM yA manasvinAm |
na chAnyadArasevInAM tAM gatiM vraja putraka
shlokas.29:
sAmnA ye sarvabhUtAni gachChanti gatamatsarAH |
nAruntudAnAM kShamiNAM yA gatistAmavApnuhi
shlokas.30:
madhumA.nsanivRRittAnAM madAddambhAttathAnRRitAt |
paropatApatyaktAnAM tAM gatiM vraja putraka
shlokas.31:
hrImantaH sarvashAstraj~nA j~nAnatRRiptA jitendriyAH |
