yAM gatiM sAdhavo yAnti tAM gatiM vraja putraka
shlokas.32:
evaM vilapatIM dInAM subhadrAM shokakarshitAm |
abhyapadyata pA~nchAlI vairATIsahitA tadA
shlokas.33:
tAH prakAmaM ruditvA cha vilapya cha suduHkhitAH |
unmattavattadA rAjanvisa~nj~nA nyapatankShitau
shlokas.34:
sopachArastu kRRiShNastAM duHkhitAM bhRRishaduHkhitaH |
siktvAmbhasA samAshvAsya tattaduktvA hitaM vachaH
shlokas.35:
visa~nj~nakalpAM rudatImapaviddhAM pravepatIm |
bhaginIM puNDarIkAkSha idaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.36:
subhadre mA shuchaH putraM pA~nchAlyAshvAsayottarAm |
gato.abhimanyuH prathitAM gatiM kShatriyapu~NgavaH
shlokas.37:
ye chAnye.api kule santi puruShA no varAnane |
sarve te vai gatiM yAntu abhimanyoryashasvinaH
shlokas.38:
kuryAma tadvayaM karma kriyAsuH suhRRidashcha naH |
kRRitavAnyAdRRigadyaikastava putro mahArathaH
shlokas.39:
evamAshvAsya bhaginIM draupadImapi chottarAm |
pArthasyaiva mahAbAhuH pArshvamAgAdari.ndamaH
shlokas.40:
tato.abhyanuj~nAya nRRipAnkRRiShNo bandhU.nstathAbhibhUH |
viveshAntaHpuraM rAja.nste.anye jagmuryathAlayam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato.arjunasya bhavanaM pravishyApratimaM vibhuH |
spRRiShTvAmbhaH puNDarIkAkShaH sthaNDile shubhalakShaNe
santastAra shubhAM shayyAM darbhairvaiDUryasaMnibhaiH
shlokas.2:
tato mAlyena vidhivallAjairgandhaiH suma~NgalaiH |
ala~nchakAra tAM shayyAM parivAryAyudhottamaiH
shlokas.3:
tataH spRRiShTodakaM pArthaM vinItAH parichArakAH |
darshayAM naityakaM chakrurnaishaM traiyambakaM balim
shlokas.4:
tataH prItamanAH pArtho gandhairmAlyaishcha mAdhavam |
ala~NkRRityopahAraM taM naishamasmai nyavedayat
shlokas.5:
smayamAnastu govindaH phalgunaM pratyabhAShata |
supyatAM pArtha bhadraM te kalyANAya vrajAmyaham
shlokas.6:
sthApayitvA tato dvAHsthAngoptR^I.nshchAttAyudhAnnarAn |
dArukAnugataH shrImAnvivesha shibiraM svakam
shishye cha shayane shubhre bahukRRityaM vichintayan
shlokas.7:
na pANDavAnAM shibire kashchitsuShvApa tAM nishAm |
prajAgaraH sarvajanamAvivesha vishAM pate
shlokas.8:
putrashokAbhibhUtena pratij~nAto mahAtmanA |
sahasA sindhurAjasya vadho gANDIvadhanvanA
shlokas.9:
tatkathaM nu mahAbAhurvAsaviH paravIrahA |
pratij~nAM saphalAM kuryAditi te samachintayan
shlokas.10:
kaShTaM hIdaM vyavasitaM pANDavena mahAtmanA |
putrashokAbhitaptena pratij~nA mahatI kRRitA
shlokas.11:
bhrAtarashchApi vikrAntA bahulAni balAni cha |
dhRRitarAShTrasya putreNa sarvaM tasmai niveditam
shlokas.12:
sa hatvA saindhavaM sa~Nkhye punaretu dhana~njayaH |
jitvA ripugaNA.nshchaiva pArayatvarjuno vratam
shlokas.13:
ahatvA sindhurAjaM hi dhUmaketuM pravekShyati |
na hyetadanRRitaM kartumarhaH pArtho dhana~njayaH
shlokas.14:
dharmaputraH kathaM rAjA bhaviShyati mRRite.arjune |
tasminhi vijayaH kRRitsnaH pANDavena samAhitaH
shlokas.15:
yadi naH sukRRitaM ki~nchidyadi dattaM hutaM yadi |
phalena tasya sarvasya savyasAchI jayatvarIn
shlokas.16:
evaM kathayatAM teShAM jayamAsha.nsatAM prabho |
kRRichChreNa mahatA rAjanrajanI vyatyavartata
shlokas.17:
tasyAM rajanyAM madhye tu pratibuddho janArdanaH |
smRRitvA pratij~nAM pArthasya dArukaM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.18:
arjunena pratij~nAtamArtena hatabandhunA |
jayadrathaM haniShyAmi shvobhUta iti dAruka
shlokas.19:
tattu duryodhanaH shrutvA mantribhirmantrayiShyati |
yathA jayadrathaM pArtho na hanyAditi sa.nyuge
shlokas.20:
akShauhiNyo hi tAH sarvA rakShiShyanti jayadratham |
droNashcha saha putreNa sarvAstravidhipAragaH
shlokas.21:
eko vIraH sahasrAkSho daityadAnavamarditA |
so.api taM notsahetAjau hantuM droNena rakShitam
shlokas.22:
so.ahaM shvastatkariShyAmi yathA kuntIsuto.arjunaH |
aprApte.astaM dinakare haniShyati jayadratham
shlokas.23:
na hi dArA na mitrANi j~nAtayo na cha bAndhavAH |
kashchinnAnyaH priyataraH kuntIputrAnmamArjunAt
shlokas.24:
anarjunamimaM lokaM muhUrtamapi dAruka |
udIkShituM na shakto.ahaM bhavitA na cha tattathA
shlokas.25:
ahaM dhvajinyaH shatrUNAM sahayAH sarathadvipAH |
arjunArthe haniShyAmi sakarNAH sasuyodhanAH
shlokas.26:
shvo nirIkShantu me vIryaM trayo lokA mahAhave |
dhana~njayArthaM samare parAkrAntasya dAruka
shlokas.27:
shvo narendrasahasrANi rAjaputrashatAni cha |
sAshvadviparathAnyAjau vidraviShyanti dAruka
shlokas.28:
shvastAM chakrapramathitAM drakShyase nRRipavAhinIm |
mayA kruddena samare pANDavArthe nipAtitAm
shlokas.29:
shvaH sadevAH sagandharvAH pishAchoragarAkShasAH |
j~nAsyanti lokAH sarve mAM suhRRidaM savyasAchinaH
shlokas.30:
yastaM dveShTi sa mAM dveShTi yastamanu sa mAmanu |
iti sa~NkalpyatAM buddhyA sharIrArdhaM mamArjunaH
shlokas.31:
yathA tvamaprabhAtAyAmasyAM nishi rathottamam |
kalpayitvA yathAshAstramAdAya vratasa.nyataH
shlokas.32:
gadAM kaumodakIM divyAM shaktiM chakraM dhanuH sharAn |
Aropya vai rathe sUta sarvopakaraNAni cha
shlokas.33:
sthAnaM hi kalpayitvA cha rathopasthe dhvajasya me |
vainateyasya vIrasya samare rathashobhinaH
shlokas.34:
ChatraM jAmbUnadairjAlairarkajvalanasaMnibhaiH |
vishvakarmakRRitairdivyairashvAnapi cha bhUShitAn
shlokas.35:
balAhakaM meghapuShpaM sainyaM sugrIvameva cha |
yuktvA vAjivarAnyattaH kavachI tiShTha dAruka
shlokas.36:
pA~nchajanyasya nirghoShamArShabheNaiva pUritam |
shrutvA tu bhairavaM nAdamupayAyA javena mAm
shlokas.37:
ekAhnAhamamarShaM cha sarvaduHkhAni chaiva ha |
bhrAtuH pitRRiShvaseyasya vyapaneShyAmi dAruka
shlokas.38:
sarvopAyairyatiShyAmi yathA bIbhatsurAhave |
pashyatAM dhArtarAShTrANAM haniShyati jayadratham
shlokas.39:
yasya yasya cha bIbhatsurvadhe yatnaM kariShyati |
Asha.nse sArathe tatra bhavitAsya dhruvo jayaH
shlokas.40:
dAruka uvAcha||
jaya eva dhruvastasya kuta eva parAjayaH |
yasya tvaM puruShavyAghra sArathyamupajagmivAn
shlokas.41:
evaM chaitatkariShyAmi yathA mAmanushAsasi |
suprabhAtAmimAM rAtriM jayAya vijayasya hi

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
kuntIputrastu taM mantraM smaranneva dhana~njayaH |
pratij~nAmAtmano rakShanmumohAchintyavikramaH
shlokas.2:
taM tu shokena santaptaM svapne kapivaradhvajam |
AsasAda mahAtejA dhyAyantaM garuDadhvajaH
shlokas.3:
pratyutthAnaM tu kRRiShNasya sarvAvasthaM dhana~njayaH |
nAlopayata dharmAtmA bhaktyA premNA cha sarvadA
shlokas.4:
pratyutthAya cha govindaM sa tasmAyAsanaM dadau |
na chAsane svayaM buddhiM bIbhatsurvyadadhAttadA
shlokas.5:
tataH kRRiShNo mahAtejA jAnanpArthasya nishchayam |
kuntIputramidaM vAkyamAsInaH sthitamabravIt
shlokas.6:
mA viShAde manaH pArtha kRRithAH kAlo hi durjayaH |
kAlaH sarvANi bhUtAni niyachChati pare vidhau
shlokas.7:
kimarthaM cha viShAdaste tadbrUhi vadatAM vara |
na shochitavyaM viduShA shokaH kAryavinAshanaH
shlokas.8:
shochannandayate shatrUnkarshayatyapi bAndhavAn |
kShIyate cha narastasmAnna tvaM shochitumarhasi
shlokas.9:
ityukto vAsudevena bIbhatsuraparAjitaH |
AbabhAShe tadA vidvAnidaM vachanamarthavat
shlokas.10:
mayA pratij~nA mahatI jayadrathavadhe kRRitA |
shvo.asmi hantA durAtmAnaM putraghnamiti keshava
shlokas.11:
matpratij~nAvighAtArthaM dhArtarAShTraiH kilAchyuta |
pRRiShThataH saindhavaH kAryaH sarvairgupto mahArathaiH
shlokas.12:
dasha chaikA cha tAH kRRiShNa akShauhiNyaH sudurjayAH |
pratij~nAyAM cha hInAyAM kathaM jIveta madvidhaH
shlokas.13:
duHkhopAyasya me vIra vikA~NkShA parivartate |
drutaM cha yAti savitA tata etadbravImyaham
shlokas.14:
shokasthAnaM tu tachChrutvA pArthasya dvijaketanaH |
sa.nspRRishyAmbhastataH kRRiShNaH prA~NmukhaH samavasthitaH
shlokas.15:
idaM vAkyaM mahAtejA babhAShe puShkarekShaNaH |
hitArthaM pANDuputrasya saindhavasya vadhe vRRitaH
shlokas.16:
pArtha pAshupataM nAma paramAstraM sanAtanam |
yena sarvAnmRRidhe daityA~njaghne devo maheshvaraH
shlokas.17:
yadi tadviditaM te.adya shvo hantAsi jayadratham |
atha j~nAtuM prapadyasva manasA vRRiShabhadhvajam
shlokas.18:
taM devaM manasA dhyAya~njoShamAssva dhana~njaya |
tatastasya prasAdAttvaM bhaktaH prApsyasi tanmahat
shlokas.19:
tataH kRRiShNavachaH shrutvA sa.nspRRishyAmbho dhana~njayaH |
bhUmAvAsIna ekAgro jagAma manasA bhavam
shlokas.20:
tataH praNihite brAhme muhUrte shubhalakShaNe |
AtmAnamarjuno.apashyadgagane sahakeshavam
shlokas.21:
jyotirbhishcha samAkIrNaM siddhachAraNasevitam |
vAyuvegagatiH pArthaH khaM bheje sahakeshavaH
shlokas.22:
keshavena gRRihItaH sa dakShiNe vibhunA bhuje |
prekShamANo bahUnbhAvA~njagAmAdbhutadarshanAn
shlokas.23:
udIchyAM dishi dharmAtmA so.apashyachChvetaparvatam |
kuberasya vihAre cha nalinIM padmabhUShitAm
shlokas.24:
sarichChreShThAM cha tAM ga~NgAM vIkShamANo bahUdakAm |
sadApuShpaphalairvRRikShairupetAM sphaTikopalAm
shlokas.25:
siMhavyAghrasamAkIrNAM nAnAmRRigagaNAkulAm |
puNyAshramavatIM ramyAM manoj~nANDajasevitAm
shlokas.26:
mandarasya pradeshA.nshcha kiMnarodgItanAditAn |
hemarUpyamayaiH shRRi~NgairnAnauShadhividIpitAn
tathA mandAravRRikShaishcha puShpitairupashobhitAn
shlokas.27:
snigdhA~njanachayAkAraM samprAptaH kAlaparvatam |
puNyaM himavataH pAdaM maNimantaM cha parvatam
brahmatu~NgaM nadIshchAnyAstathA janapadAnapi
shlokas.28:
sushRRi~NgaM shatashRRi~NgaM cha sharyAtivanameva cha |
puNyamashvashiraHsthAnaM sthAnamAtharvaNasya cha
shlokas.29:
vRRiShada.nshaM cha shailendraM mahAmandarameva cha |
apsarobhiH samAkIrNaM kiMnaraishchopashobhitam
shlokas.30:
tA.nshcha shailAnvrajanpArthaH prekShate sahakeshavaH |
shubhaiH prasravaNairjuShTAnhemadhAtuvibhUShitAn
shlokas.31:
chandrarashmiprakAshA~NgIM pRRithivIM puramAlinIm |
samudrA.nshchAdbhutAkArAnapashyadbahulAkarAn
shlokas.32:
viyaddyAM pRRithivIM chaiva pashyanviShNupade vrajan |
vismitaH saha kRRiShNena kShipto bANa ivAtyagAt
shlokas.33:
grahanakShatrasomAnAM sUryAgnyoshcha samatviSham |
apashyata tadA pArtho jvalantamiva parvatam
shlokas.34:
samAsAdya tu taM shailaM shailAgre samavasthitam |
taponityaM mahAtmAnamapashyadvRRiShabhadhvajam
shlokas.35:
sahasramiva sUryANAM dIpyamAnaM svatejasA |
shUlinaM jaTilaM gauraM valkalAjinavAsasam
shlokas.36:
nayanAnAM sahasraishcha vichitrA~NgaM mahaujasam |
pArvatyA sahitaM devaM bhUtasa~Nghaishcha bhAsvaraiH
shlokas.37:
gItavAditrasaMhrAdaistAlalAsyasamanvitam |
valgitAsphoTitotkruShTaiH puNyagandhaishcha sevitam
shlokas.38:
stUyamAnaM stavairdivyairmunibhirbrahmavAdibhiH |
goptAraM sarvabhUtAnAmiShvAsadharamachyutam
shlokas.39:
vAsudevastu taM dRRiShTvA jagAma shirasA kShitim |
pArthena saha dharmAtmA gRRiNanbrahma sanAtanam
shlokas.40:
lokAdiM vishvakarmANamajamIshAnamavyayam |
manasaH paramAM yoniM khaM vAyuM jyotiShAM nidhim
shlokas.41:
sraShTAraM vAridhArANAM bhuvashcha prakRRitiM parAm |
devadAnavayakShANAM mAnavAnAM cha sAdhanam
shlokas.42:
yoginAM paramaM brahma vyaktaM brahmavidAM nidhim |
charAcharasya sraShTAraM pratihartArameva cha
shlokas.43:
kAlakopaM mahAtmAnaM shakrasUryaguNodayam |
avandata tadA kRRiShNo vA~NmanobuddhikarmabhiH
shlokas.44:
yaM prapashyanti vidvA.nsaH sUkShmAdhyAtmapadaiShiNaH |
tamajaM kAraNAtmAnaM jagmatuH sharaNaM bhavam
shlokas.45:
arjunashchApi taM devaM bhUyo bhUyo.abhyavandata |
j~nAtvaikaM bhUtabhavyAdiM sarvabhUtabhavodbhavam
shlokas.46:
tatastAvAgatau sharvaH provAcha prahasanniva |
svAgataM vAM narashreShThAvuttiShThetAM gataklamau
kiM cha vAmIpsitaM vIrau manasaH kShipramuchyatAm
shlokas.47:
yena kAryeNa samprAptau yuvAM tatsAdhayAmi vAm |
vriyatAmAtmanaH shreyastatsarvaM pradadAni vAm
shlokas.48:
tatastadvachanaM shrutvA pratyutthAya kRRitA~njalI |
vAsudevArjunau sharvaM tuShTuvAte mahAmatI
shlokas.49:
namo bhavAya sharvAya rudrAya varadAya cha |
pashUnAM pataye nityamugrAya cha kapardine
shlokas.50:
mahAdevAya bhImAya tryambakAya cha shambhave |
IshAnAya bhagaghnAya namo.astvandhakaghAtine
shlokas.51:
kumAragurave nityaM nIlagrIvAya vedhase |
vilohitAya dhUmrAya vyAdhAyAnaparAjite
shlokas.52:
nityaM nIlashikhaNDAya shUline divyachakShuShe |
hantre goptre trinetrAya vyAdhAya vasuretase
shlokas.53:
achintyAyAmbikAbhartre sarvadevastutAya cha |
vRRiShadhvajAya pi~NgAya jaTine brahmachAriNe
shlokas.54:
tapyamAnAya salile brahmaNyAyAjitAya cha |
vishvAtmane vishvasRRije vishvamAvRRitya tiShThate
shlokas.55:
namo namaste sevyAya bhUtAnAM prabhave sadA |
brahmavaktrAya sharvAya sha~NkarAya shivAya cha
shlokas.56:
namo.astu vAchaspataye prajAnAM pataye namaH |
namo vishvasya pataye mahatAM pataye namaH
shlokas.57:
namaH sahasrashirase sahasrabhujamanyave |
sahasranetrapAdAya namo.asa~NkhyeyakarmaNe
shlokas.58:
namo hiraNyavarNAya hiraNyakavachAya cha |
bhaktAnukampine nityaM sidhyatAM nau varaH prabho
shlokas.59:
evaM stutvA mahAdevaM vAsudevaH sahArjunaH |
prasAdayAmAsa bhavaM tadA hyastropalabdhaye
shlokas.60:
tato.arjunaH prItamanA vavande vRRiShabhadhvajam |
dadarshotphullanayanaH samastaM tejasAM nidhim
shlokas.61:
taM chopahAraM svakRRitaM naishaM naityakamAtmanaH |
dadarsha tryambakAbhyAshe vAsudevaniveditam
shlokas.62:
tato.abhipUjya manasA sharvaM kRRiShNaM cha pANDavaH |
ichChAmyahaM divyamastramityabhAShata sha~Nkaram
shlokas.63:
tataH pArthasya vij~nAya varArthe vachanaM prabhuH |
vAsudevArjunau devaH smayamAno.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.64:
saro.amRRitamayaM divyamabhyAshe shatrusUdanau |
tatra me taddhanurdivyaM sharashcha nihitaH purA
shlokas.65:
yena devArayaH sarve mayA yudhi nipAtitAH |
tata AnIyatAM kRRiShNau sasharaM dhanuruttamam
shlokas.66:
tathetyuktvA tu tau vIrau taM sharvaM pArShadaiH saha |
prasthitau tatsaro divyaM divyAshcharyashatairvRRitam
shlokas.67:
nirdiShTaM yadvRRiShA~Nkena puNyaM sarvArthasAdhakam |
tajjagmaturasambhrAntau naranArAyaNAvRRiShI
shlokas.68:
tatastu tatsaro gatvA sUryamaNDalasaMnibham |
nAgamantarjale ghoraM dadRRishAte.arjunAchyutau
shlokas.69:
dvitIyaM chAparaM nAgaM sahasrashirasaM varam |
vamantaM vipulAM jvAlAM dadRRishAte.agnivarchasam
shlokas.70:
tataH kRRiShNashcha pArthashcha sa.nspRRishyApaH kRRitA~njalI |
tau nAgAvupatasthAte namasyantau vRRiShadhvajam
shlokas.71:
gRRiNantau vedaviduShau tadbrahma shatarudriyam |
aprameyaM praNamantau gatvA sarvAtmanA bhavam
shlokas.72:
tatastau rudramAhAtmyAddhitvA rUpaM mahoragau |
dhanurbANashcha shatrughnaM taddva.ndvaM samapadyata
shlokas.73:
tato jagRRihatuH prItau dhanurbANaM cha suprabham |
AjahraturmahAtmAnau dadatushcha mahAtmane
shlokas.74:
tataH pArshvAdvRRiShA~Nkasya brahmachArI nyavartata |
pi~NgAkShastapasaH kShetraM balavAnnIlalohitaH
shlokas.75:
sa tadgRRihya dhanuHshreShThaM tasthau sthAnaM samAhitaH |
vyakarShachchApi vidhivatsasharaM dhanuruttamam
shlokas.76:
tasya maurvIM cha muShTiM cha sthAnaM chAlakShya pANDavaH |
shrutvA mantraM bhavaproktaM jagrAhAchintyavikramaH
shlokas.77:
sarasyeva cha taM bANaM mumochAtibalaH prabhuH |
chakAra cha punarvIrastasminsarasi taddhanuH
shlokas.78:
tataH prItaM bhavaM j~nAtvA smRRitimAnarjunastadA |
varamAraNyakaM dattaM darshanaM sha~Nkarasya cha
manasA chintayAmAsa tanme sampadyatAmiti
shlokas.79:
tasya tanmatamAj~nAya prItaH prAdAdvaraM bhavaH |
tachcha pAshupataM ghoraM pratij~nAyAshcha pAraNam
shlokas.80:
saMhRRiShTaromA durdharShaH kRRitaM kAryamamanyata |
vavandatushcha saMhRRiShTau shirobhyAM tau maheshvaram
shlokas.81:
anuj~nAtau kShaNe tasminbhavenArjunakeshavau |
prAptau svashibiraM vIrau mudA paramayA yutau
indrAviShNU yathA prItau jambhasya vadhakA~NkShiNau

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tayoH sa.nvadatoreva kRRiShNadArukayostadA |
sAtyagAdrajanI rAjannatha rAjAnvabudhyata
shlokas.2:
paThanti pANisvanikA mAgadhA madhuparkikAH |
vaitAlikAshcha sUtAshcha tuShTuvuH puruSharShabham
shlokas.3:
nartakAshchApyanRRityanta jagurgItAni gAyakAH |
kuruva.nshastavArthAni madhuraM raktakaNThinaH
shlokas.4:
mRRida~NgA jharjharA bheryaH paNavAnakagomukhAH |
ADambarAshcha sha~NkhAshcha dundubhyashcha mahAsvanAH
shlokas.5:
evametAni sarvANi tathAnyAnyapi bhArata |
vAdayanti sma saMhRRiShTAH kushalAH sAdhushikShitAH
shlokas.6:
sa meghasamanirghoSho mahA~nshabdo.aspRRishaddivam |
pArthivapravaraM suptaM yudhiShThiramabodhayat
shlokas.7:
pratibuddhaH sukhaM supto mahArhe shayanottame |
utthAyAvashyakAryArthaM yayau snAnagRRihaM tataH
shlokas.8:
tataH shuklAmbarAH snAtAstaruNAShTottaraM shatam |
snApakAH kA~nchanaiH kumbhaiH pUrNaiH samupatasthire
shlokas.9:
bhadrAsane sUpaviShTaH paridhAyAmbaraM laghu |
sasnau chandanasa.nyuktaiH pAnIyairabhimantritaiH
shlokas.10:
utsAditaH kaShAyeNa balavadbhiH sushikShitaiH |
AplutaH sAdhivAsena jalena cha sugandhinA
shlokas.11:
hariNA chandanenA~Ngamanulipya mahAbhujaH |
sragvI chAkliShTavasanaH prA~NmukhaH prA~njaliH sthitaH
shlokas.12:
jajApa japyaM kaunteyaH satAM mArgamanuShThitaH |
tato.agnisharaNaM dIptaM pravivesha vinItavat
shlokas.13:
samiddhaM sa pavitrAbhiragnimAhutibhistathA |
mantrapUtAbhirarchitvA nishchakrAma gRRihAttataH
shlokas.14:
dvitIyAM puruShavyAghraH kakShyAM niShkramya pArthivaH |
tatra vedavido viprAnapashyadbrAhmaNarShabhAn
shlokas.15:
dAntAnvedavratasnAtAnsnAtAnavabhRRitheShu cha |
sahasrAnucharAnsaurAnaShTau dashashatAni cha
shlokas.16:
akShataiH sumanobhishcha vAchayitvA mahAbhujaH |
tAndvijAnmadhusarpirbhyAM phalaiH shreShThaiH suma~NgalaiH
shlokas.17:
prAdAtkA~nchanamekaikaM niShkaM viprAya pANDavaH |
ala~NkRRitaM chAshvashataM vAsA.nsIShTAshcha dakShiNAH
shlokas.18:
tathA gAH kapilA dogdhrIH sarShabhAH pANDunandanaH |
hemashRRi~NgI rUpyakhurA dattvA chakre pradakShiNam
shlokas.19:
svastikAnvardhamAnA.nshcha nandyAvartA.nshcha kA~nchanAn |
mAlyaM cha jalakumbhA.nshcha jvalitaM cha hutAshanam
shlokas.20:
pUrNAnyakShatapAtrANi ruchakAnrochanA.nstathA |
svala~NkRRitAH shubhAH kanyA dadhisarpirmadhUdakam
shlokas.21:
ma~NgalyAnpakShiNashchaiva yachchAnyadapi pUjitam |
dRRiShTvA spRRiShTvA cha kaunteyo bAhyAM kakShyAmagAttataH
shlokas.22:
tatastasya mahAbAhostiShThataH parichArakAH |
sauvarNaM sarvatobhadraM muktAvaiDUryamaNDitam
shlokas.23:
parArdhyAstaraNAstIrNaM sottarachChadamRRiddhimat |
vishvakarmakRRitaM divyamupajahrurvarAsanam
shlokas.24:
tatra tasyopaviShTasya bhUShaNAni mahAtmanaH |
upajahrurmahArhANi preShyAH shubhrANi sarvashaH
shlokas.25:
yuktAbharaNaveShasya kaunteyasya mahAtmanaH |
rUpamAsInmahArAja dviShatAM shokavardhanam
shlokas.26:
pANDaraishchandrarashmyAbhairhemadaNDaishcha chAmaraiH |
dodhUyamAnaH shushubhe vidyudbhiriva toyadaH
shlokas.27:
sa.nstUyamAnaH sUtaishcha vandyamAnashcha bandibhiH |
upagIyamAno gandharvairAste sma kurunandanaH
shlokas.28:
tato muhUrtAdAsIttu bandinAM nisvano mahAn |
nemighoShashcha rathinAM khuraghoShashcha vAjinAm
shlokas.29:
hrAdena gajaghaNTAnAM sha~NkhAnAM ninadena cha |
narANAM padashabdaishcha kampatIva sma medinI
shlokas.30:
tataH shuddhAntamAsAdya jAnubhyAM bhUtale sthitaH |
shirasA vandanIyaM tamabhivandya jagatpatim
shlokas.31:
kuNDalI baddhanistri.nshaH saMnaddhakavacho yuvA |
abhipraNamya shirasA dvAHstho dharmAtmajAya vai
nyavedayaddhRRiShIkeshamupayAtaM mahAtmane
shlokas.32:
so.abravItpuruShavyAghraH svAgatenaiva mAdhavam |
arghyaM chaivAsanaM chAsmai dIyatAM paramArchitam
shlokas.33:
tataH praveshya vArShNeyamupaveshya varAsane |
satkRRitya satkRRitastena paryapRRichChadyudhiShThiraH

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
sukhena rajanI vyuShTA kachchitte madhusUdana |
kachchijj~nAnAni sarvANi prasannAni tavAchyuta
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vAsudevo.api tadyuktaM paryapRRichChadyudhiShThiram |
tataH kShattA prakRRitayo nyavedayadupasthitAH
shlokas.3:
anuj~nAtashcha rAj~nA sa prAveshayata taM janam |
virATaM bhImasenaM cha dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha sAtyakim
shlokas.4:
shikhaNDinaM yamau chaiva chekitAnaM cha kekayAn |
yuyutsuM chaiva kauravyaM pA~nchAlyaM chottamaujasam
shlokas.5:
ete chAnye cha bahavaH kShatriyAH kShatriyarShabham |
upatasthurmahAtmAnaM vivishushchAsaneShu te
shlokas.6:
ekasminnAsane vIrAvupaviShTau mahAbalau |
kRRiShNashcha yuyudhAnashcha mahAtmAnau mahAdyutI
shlokas.7:
tato yudhiShThirasteShAM shRRiNvatAM madhusUdanam |
abravItpuNDarIkAkShamAbhAShya madhuraM vachaH
shlokas.8:
ekaM tvAM vayamAshritya sahasrAkShamivAmarAH |
prArthayAmo jayaM yuddhe shAshvatAni sukhAni cha
shlokas.9:
tvaM hi rAjyavinAshaM cha dviShadbhishcha nirAkriyAm |
kleshA.nshcha vividhAnkRRiShNa sarvA.nstAnapi vettha naH
shlokas.10:
tvayi sarvesha sarveShAmasmAkaM bhaktavatsala |
sukhamAyattamatyarthaM yAtrA cha madhusUdana
shlokas.11:
sa tathA kuru vArShNeya yathA tvayi mano mama |
arjunasya yathA satyA pratij~nA syAchchikIrShitA
shlokas.12:
sa bhavA.nstArayatvasmAdduHkhAmarShamahArNavAt |
pAraM titIrShatAmadya plavo no bhava mAdhava
shlokas.13:
na hi tatkurute sa~Nkhye kArtavIryasamastvapi |
rathI yatkurute kRRiShNa sArathiryatnamAsthitaH
shlokas.14:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
sAmareShvapi lokeShu sarveShu na tathAvidhaH |
sharAsanadharaH kashchidyathA pArtho dhana~njayaH
shlokas.15:
vIryavAnastrasampannaH parAkrAnto mahAbalaH |
yuddhashauNDaH sadAmarShI tejasA paramo nRRiNAm
shlokas.16:
sa yuvA vRRiShabhaskandho dIrghabAhurmahAbalaH |
siMharShabhagatiH shrImAndviShataste haniShyati
shlokas.17:
ahaM cha tatkariShyAmi yathA kuntIsuto.arjunaH |
dhArtarAShTrasya sainyAni dhakShyatyagnirivotthitaH
shlokas.18:
adya taM pApakarmANaM kShudraM saubhadraghAtinam |
apunardarshanaM mArgamiShubhiH kShepsyate.arjunaH
shlokas.19:
tasyAdya gRRidhrAH shyenAshcha vaDagomAyavastathA |
bhakShayiShyanti mA.nsAni ye chAnye puruShAdakAH
shlokas.20:
yadyasya devA goptAraH sendrAH sarve tathApyasau |
rAjadhAnIM yamasyAdya hataH prApsyati sa~Nkule
shlokas.21:
nihatya saindhavaM jiShNuradya tvAmupayAsyati |
vishoko vijvaro rAjanbhava bhUtipuraskRRitaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tathA sambhAShatAM teShAM prAdurAsIddhana~njayaH |
didRRikShurbharatashreShThaM rAjAnaM sasuhRRidgaNam
shlokas.2:
taM praviShTaM shubhAM kakShyAmabhivAdyAgrataH sthitam |
samutthAyArjunaM premNA sasvaje pANDavarShabhaH
shlokas.3:
mUrdhni chainamupAghrAya pariShvajya cha bAhunA |
AshiShaH paramAH prochya smayamAno.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.4:
vyaktamarjuna sa~NgrAme dhruvaste vijayo mahAn |
yAdRRigrUpA hi te ChAyA prasannashcha janArdanaH
shlokas.5:
tamabravIttato jiShNurmahadAshcharyamuttamam |
dRRiShTavAnasmi bhadraM te keshavasya prasAdajam
shlokas.6:
tatastatkathayAmAsa yathAdRRiShTaM dhana~njayaH |
AshvAsanArthaM suhRRidAM tryambakena samAgamam
shlokas.7:
tataH shirobhiravaniM spRRiShTvA sarve cha vismitAH |
namaskRRitya vRRiShA~NkAya sAdhu sAdhvityathAbruvan
shlokas.8:
anuj~nAtAstataH sarve suhRRido dharmasUnunA |
tvaramANAH susaMnaddhA hRRiShTA yuddhAya niryayuH
shlokas.9:
abhivAdya tu rAjAnaM yuyudhAnAchyutArjunAH |
hRRiShTA viniryayuste vai yudhiShThiraniveshanAt
shlokas.10:
rathenaikena durdharShau yuyudhAnajanArdanau |
jagmatuH sahitau vIrAvarjunasya niveshanam
shlokas.11:
tatra gatvA hRRiShIkeshaH kalpayAmAsa sUtavat |
rathaM rathavarasyAjau vAnararShabhalakShaNam
shlokas.12:
sa meghasamanirghoShastaptakA~nchanasaprabhaH |
babhau rathavaraH kL^iptaH shishurdivasakRRidyathA
shlokas.13:
tataH puruShashArdUlaH sajjaH sajjaM puraHsaraH |
kRRitAhnikAya pArthAya nyavedayata taM ratham
shlokas.14:
taM tu loke varaH pu.nsAM kirITI hemavarmabhRRit |
bANabANAsanI vAhaM pradakShiNamavartata
shlokas.15:
tato vidyAvayovRRiddhaiH kriyAvadbhirjitendriyaiH |
stUyamAno jayAshIbhirAruroha mahAratham
shlokas.16:
jaitraiH sA~NgrAmikairmantraiH pUrvameva rathottamam |
abhimantritamarchiShmAnudayaM bhAskaro yathA
shlokas.17:
sa rathe rathinAM shreShThaH kA~nchane kA~nchanAvRRitaH |
vibabhau vimalo.archiShmAnmerAviva divAkaraH
shlokas.18:
anvArurohatuH pArthaM yuyudhAnajanArdanau |
sharyAteryaj~namAyAntaM yathendraM devamashvinau
shlokas.19:
atha jagrAha govindo rashmInrashmivatAM varaH |
mAtalirvAsavasyeva vRRitraM hantuM prayAsyataH
shlokas.20:
sa tAbhyAM sahitaH pArtho rathapravaramAsthitaH |
sahito budhashukrAbhyAM tamo nighnanyathA shashI
shlokas.21:
saindhavasya vadhaprepsuH prayAtaH shatrupUgahA |
sahAmbupatimitrAbhyAM yathendrastArakAmaye
shlokas.22:
tato vAditranirghoShairma~Ngalyaishcha stavaiH shubhaiH |
prayAntamarjunaM sUtA mAgadhAshchaiva tuShTuvuH
shlokas.23:
sajayAshIH sapuNyAhaH sUtamAgadhanisvanaH |
yukto vAditraghoSheNa teShAM ratikaro.abhavat
shlokas.24:
tamanuprayato vAyuH puNyagandhavahaH shuchiH |
vavau saMharShayanpArthaM dviShatashchApi shoShayan
shlokas.25:
prAdurAsannimittAni vijayAya bahUni cha |
pANDavAnAM tvadIyAnAM viparItAni mAriSha
shlokas.26:
dRRiShTvArjuno nimittAni vijayAya pradakShiNam |
yuyudhAnaM maheShvAsamidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.27:
yuyudhAnAdya yuddhe me dRRishyate vijayo dhruvaH |
yathA hImAni li~NgAni dRRishyante shinipu~Ngava
shlokas.28:
so.ahaM tatra gamiShyAmi yatra saindhavako nRRipaH |
yiyAsuryamalokAya mama vIryaM pratIkShate
shlokas.29:
yathA paramakaM kRRityaM saindhavasya vadhe mama |
tathaiva sumahatkRRityaM dharmarAjasya rakShaNe
shlokas.30:
sa tvamadya mahAbAho rAjAnaM paripAlaya |
yathaiva hi mayA guptastvayA gupto bhavettathA
shlokas.31:
tvayi chAhaM parAshvasya pradyumne vA mahArathe |
shaknuyAM saindhavaM hantumanapekSho nararShabha
shlokas.32:
mayyapekShA na kartavyA katha~nchidapi sAtvata |
rAjanyeva parA guptiH kAryA sarvAtmanA tvayA
shlokas.33:
na hi yatra mahAbAhurvAsudevo vyavasthitaH |
ki~nchidvyApadyate tatra yatrAhamapi cha dhruvam
shlokas.34:
evamuktastu pArthena sAtyakiH paravIrahA |
tathetyuktvAgamattatra yatra rAjA yudhiShThiraH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
shvobhUte kimakArShuste duHkhashokasamanvitAH |
abhimanyau hate tatra ke vAyudhyanta mAmakAH
shlokas.2:
jAnantastasya karmANi kuravaH savyasAchinaH |
kathaM tatkilbiShaM kRRitvA nirbhayA brUhi mAmakAH
shlokas.3:
putrashokAbhisantaptaM kruddhaM mRRityumivAntakam |
AyAntaM puruShavyAghraM kathaM dadRRishurAhave
shlokas.4:
kapirAjadhvajaM sa~Nkhye vidhunvAnaM mahaddhanuH |
dRRiShTvA putraparidyUnaM kimakurvanta mAmakAH
shlokas.5:
kiM nu sa~njaya sa~NgrAme vRRittaM duryodhanaM prati |
paridevo mahAnatra shruto me nAbhinandanam
shlokas.6:
babhUvurye manogrAhyAH shabdAH shrutisukhAvahAH |
na shrUyante.adya te sarve saindhavasya niveshane
shlokas.7:
stuvatAM nAdya shrUyante putrANAM shibire mama |
sUtamAgadhasa~NghAnAM nartakAnAM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.8:
shabdena nAditAbhIkShNamabhavadyatra me shrutiH |
dInAnAmadya taM shabdaM na shRRiNomi samIritam
shlokas.9:
niveshane satyadhRRiteH somadattasya sa~njaya |
AsIno.ahaM purA tAta shabdamashrauShamuttamam
shlokas.10:
tadadya hInapuNyo.ahamArtasvaraninAditam |
niveshanaM hatotsAhaM putrANAM mama lakShaye
shlokas.11:
vivi.nshaterdurmukhasya chitrasenavikarNayoH |
anyeShAM cha sutAnAM me na tathA shrUyate dhvaniH
shlokas.12:
brAhmaNAH kShatriyA vaishyA yaM shiShyAH paryupAsate |
droNaputraM maheShvAsaM putrANAM me parAyaNam
shlokas.13:
vitaNDAlApasa.nlApairhutayAchitavanditaiH |
gItaishcha vividhairiShTai ramate yo divAnisham
shlokas.14:
upAsyamAno bahubhiH kurupANDavasAtvataiH |
sUta tasya gRRihe shabdho nAdya drauNeryathA purA
shlokas.15:
droNaputraM maheShvAsaM gAyanA nartakAshcha ye |
atyarthamupatiShThanti teShAM na shrUyate dhvaniH
shlokas.16:
vindAnuvindayoH sAyaM shibire yo mahAdhvaniH |
shrUyate so.adya na tathA kekayAnAM cha veshmasu
shlokas.17:
nityapramuditAnAM cha tAlagItasvano mahAn |
nRRityatAM shrUyate tAta gaNAnAM so.adya na dhvaniH
shlokas.18:
saptatantUnvitanvAnA yamupAsanti yAjakAH |
saumadattiM shrutanidhiM teShAM na shrUyate dhvaniH
shlokas.19:
jyAghoSho brahmaghoShashcha tomarAsirathadhvaniH |
droNasyAsIdavirato gRRihe tanna shRRiNomyaham
shlokas.20:
nAnAdeshasamutthAnAM gItAnAM yo.abhavatsvanaH |
vAditranAditAnAM cha so.adya na shrUyate mahAn
shlokas.21:
yadA prabhRRityupaplavyAchChAntimichCha~njanArdanaH |
AgataH sarvabhUtAnAmanukampArthamachyutaH
shlokas.22:
tato.ahamabruvaM sUta mandaM duryodhanaM tadA |
vAsudevena tIrthena putra sa.nshAmya pANDavaiH
shlokas.23:
kAlaprAptamahaM manye mA tvaM duryodhanAtigAH |
shame chedyAchamAnaM tvaM pratyAkhyAsyasi keshavam
hitArthamabhijalpantaM na tathAstyaparAjayaH
shlokas.24:
pratyAchaShTa sa dAshArhamRRiShabhaM sarvadhanvinAm |
anuneyAni jalpantamanayAnnAnvapadyata
shlokas.25:
tato duHshAsanasyaiva karNasya cha mataM dvayoH |
anvavartata hitvA mAM kRRiShTaH kAlena durmatiH
shlokas.26:
na hyahaM dyUtamichChAmi viduro na prasha.nsati |
saindhavo nechChate dyUtaM bhIShmo na dyUtamichChati
shlokas.27:
shalyo bhUrishravAshchaiva purumitro jayastathA |
ashvatthAmA kRRipo droNo dyUtaM nechChanti sa~njaya
shlokas.28:
eteShAM matamAj~nAya yadi varteta putrakaH |
saj~nAtimitraH sasuhRRichchiraM jIvedanAmayaH
shlokas.29:
shlakShNA madhurasambhAShA j~nAtimadhye priya.nvadAH |
kulInAH saMmatAH prAj~nAH sukhaM prApsyanti pANDavAH
shlokas.30:
dharmApekSho naro nityaM sarvatra labhate sukham |
pretyabhAve cha kalyANaM prasAdaM pratipadyate
shlokas.31:
arhantyardhaM pRRithivyAste bhoktuM sAmarthyasAdhanAH |
teShAmapi samudrAntA pitRRipaitAmahI mahI
shlokas.32:
niyujyamAnAH sthAsyanti pANDavA dharmavartmani |
santi no j~nAtayastAta yeShAM shroShyanti pANDavAH
shlokas.33:
shalyasya somadattasya bhIShmasya cha mahAtmanaH |
droNasyAtha vikarNasya bAhlikasya kRRipasya cha
shlokas.34:
anyeShAM chaiva vRRiddhAnAM bharatAnAM mahAtmanAm |
tvadarthaM bruvatAM tAta kariShyanti vacho hitam
shlokas.35:
kaM vA tvaM manyase teShAM yastvA brUyAdato.anyathA |
kRRiShNo na dharmaM sa~njahyAtsarve te cha tvadanvayAH
shlokas.36:
mayApi choktAste vIrA vachanaM dharmasaMhitam |
nAnyathA prakariShyanti dharmAtmAno hi pANDavAH
shlokas.37:
ityahaM vilapansUta bahushaH putramuktavAn |
na cha me shrutavAnmUDho manye kAlasya paryayam
shlokas.38:
vRRikodarArjunau yatra vRRiShNivIrashcha sAtyakiH |
uttamaujAshcha pA~nchAlyo yudhAmanyushcha durjayaH
shlokas.39:
dhRRiShTadyumnashcha durdharShaH shikhaNDI chAparAjitaH |
ashmakAH kekayAshchaiva kShatradharmA cha saumakiH
shlokas.40:
chaidyashcha chekitAnashcha putraH kAshyasya chAbhibhuH |
draupadeyA virATashcha drupadashcha mahArathaH
yamau cha puruShavyAghrau mantrI cha madhusUdanaH
shlokas.41:
ka etA~njAtu yudhyeta loke.asminvai jijIviShuH |
divyamastraM vikurvANAnsaMhareyurari.ndamAH
shlokas.42:
anyo duryodhanAtkarNAchChakuneshchApi saubalAt |
duHshAsanachaturthAnAM nAnyaM pashyAmi pa~nchamam
shlokas.43:
yeShAmabhIshuhastaH syAdviShvakseno rathe sthitaH |
saMnaddhashchArjuno yoddhA teShAM nAsti parAjayaH
shlokas.44:
teShAM mama vilApAnAM na hi duryodhanaH smaret |
hatau hi puruShavyAghrau bhIShmadroNau tvamAttha me
shlokas.45:
teShAM viduravAkyAnAmuktAnAM dIrghadarshinAm |
dRRiShTvemAM phalanirvRRittiM manye shochanti putrakAH
shlokas.46:
himAtyaye yathA kakShaM shuShkaM vAterito mahAn |
agnirdahettathA senAM mAmikAM sa dhana~njayaH
shlokas.47:
AchakShva taddhi naH sarvaM kushalo hyasi sa~njaya |
yadupAyAttu sAyAhne kRRitvA pArthasya kilbiSham
abhimanyau hate tAta kathamAsInmano hi vaH
shlokas.48:
na jAtu tasya karmANi yudhi gANDIvadhanvanaH |
apakRRitvA mahattAta soDhuM shakShyanti mAmakAH
shlokas.49:
kiM nu duryodhanaH kRRityaM karNaH kRRityaM kimabravIt |
duHshAsanaH saubalashcha teShAmevaM gate api
sarveShAM samavetAnAM putrANAM mama sa~njaya
shlokas.50:
yadvRRittaM tAta sa~NgrAme mandasyApanayairbhRRisham |
lobhAnugatadurbuddheH krodhena vikRRitAtmanaH
shlokas.51:
rAjyakAmasya mUDhasya rAgopahatachetasaH |
durnItaM vA sunItaM vA tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
hanta te sampravakShyAmi sarvaM pratyakShadarshivAn |
shushrUShasva sthiro bhUtvA tava hyapanayo mahAn
shlokas.2:
gatodake setubandho yAdRRiktAdRRigayaM tava |
vilApo niShphalo rAjanmA shucho bharatarShabha
shlokas.3:
anatikramaNIyo.ayaM kRRitAntasyAdbhuto vidhiH |
mA shucho bharatashreShTha diShTametatpurAtanam
shlokas.4:
yadi hi tvaM purA dyUtAtkuntIputraM yudhiShThiram |
nivartayethAH putrA.nshcha na tvAM vyasanamAvrajet
shlokas.5:
yuddhakAle punaH prApte tadaiva bhavatA yadi |
nivartitAH syuH sa.nrabdhA na tvAM vyasanamAvrajet
shlokas.6:
duryodhanaM chAvidheyaM badhnIteti purA yadi |
kurUnachodayiShyastvaM na tvAM vyasanamAvrajet
shlokas.7:
tatte buddhivyabhIchAramupalapsyanti pANDavAH |
pA~nchAlA vRRiShNayaH sarve ye chAnye.api mahAjanAH
shlokas.8:
sa kRRitvA pitRRikarma tvaM putraM sa.nsthApya satpathe |
vartethA yadi dharmeNa na tvAM vyasanamAvrajet
shlokas.9:
tvaM tu prAj~natamo loke hitvA dharmaM sanAtanam |
duryodhanasya karNasya shakuneshchAnvagA matam
shlokas.10:
tatte vilapitaM sarvaM mayA rAjannishAmitam |
arthe nivishamAnasya viShamishraM yathA madhu
shlokas.11:
na tathA manyate kRRiShNo rAjAnaM pANDavaM purA |
na bhIShmaM naiva cha droNaM yathA tvAM manyate nRRipa
shlokas.12:
vyajAnata yadA tu tvAM rAjadharmAdadhashchyutam |
tadA prabhRRiti kRRiShNastvAM na tathA bahu manyate
shlokas.13:
paruShANyuchyamAnA.nshcha yathA pArthAnupekShase |
tasyAnubandhaH prAptastvAM putrANAM rAjyakAmukam
shlokas.14:
pitRRipaitAmahaM rAjyamapavRRittaM tadAnagha |
atha pArthairjitAM kRRitsnAM pRRithivIM pratyapadyathAH
shlokas.15:
pANDunAvarjitaM rAjyaM kauravANAM yashastathA |
tatashchAbhyadhikaM bhUyaH pANDavairdharmachAribhiH
shlokas.16:
teShAM tattAdRRishaM karma tvAmAsAdya suniShphalam |
yatpitryAdbhra.nshitA rAjyAttvayehAmiShagRRiddhinA
shlokas.17:
yatpunaryuddhakAle tvaM putrAngarhayase nRRipa |
bahudhA vyAharandoShAnna tadadyopapadyate
shlokas.18:
na hi rakShanti rAjAno yudhyanto jIvitaM raNe |
chamUM vigAhya pArthAnAM yudhyante kShatriyarShabhAH
shlokas.19:
yAM tu kRRiShNArjunau senAM yAM sAtyakivRRikodarau |
rakSheranko nu tAM yudhyechchamUmanyatra kauravaiH
shlokas.20:
yeShAM yoddhA guDAkesho yeShAM mantrI janArdanaH |
yeShAM cha sAtyakirgoptA yeShAM goptA vRRikodaraH
shlokas.21:
ko hi tAnviShahedyoddhuM martyadharmA dhanurdharaH |
anyatra kauraveyebhyo ye vA teShAM padAnugAH
shlokas.22:
yAvattu shakyate kartumanuraktairjanAdhipaiH |
kShatradharmarataiH shUraistAvatkurvanti kauravAH
shlokas.23:
yathA tu puruShavyAghrairyuddhaM paramasa~NkaTam |
kurUNAM pANDavaiH sArdhaM tatsarvaM shRRiNu tattvataH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasyAM nishAyAM vyuShTAyAM droNaH shastrabhRRitAM varaH |
svAnyanIkAni sarvANi prAkrAmadvyUhituM tataH
shlokas.2:
shUrANAM garjatAM rAjansa~NkruddhAnAmamarShiNAm |
shrUyante sma girashchitrAH parasparavadhaiShiNAm
shlokas.3:
visphArya cha dhanUMShyAjau jyAH karaiH parimRRijya cha |
viniHshvasantaH prAkroshankvedAnIM sa dhana~njayaH
shlokas.4:
vikoshAnsutsarUnanye kRRitadhArAnsamAhitAn |
pItAnAkAshasa~NkAshAnasInkechichcha chikShipuH
shlokas.5:
charantastvasimArgA.nshcha dhanurmArgA.nshcha shikShayA |
sa~NgrAmamanasaH shUrA dRRishyante sma sahasrashaH
shlokas.6:
saghaNTAshchandanAdigdhAH svarNavajravibhUShitAH |
samutkShipya gadAshchAnye paryapRRichChanta pANDavam
shlokas.7:
anye balamadonmattAH parighairbAhushAlinaH |
chakruH sambAdhamAkAshamuchChritendradhvajopamaiH
shlokas.8:
nAnApraharaNaishchAnye vichitrasragala~NkRRitAH |
sa~NgrAmamanasaH shUrAstatra tatra vyavasthitAH
shlokas.9:
kvArjunaH kva cha govindaH kva cha mAnI vRRikodaraH |
kva cha te suhRRidasteShAmAhvayanto raNe tadA
shlokas.10:
tataH sha~NkhamupAdhmAya tvarayanvAjinaH svayam |
itastatastAnrachayandroNashcharati vegitaH
shlokas.11:
teShvanIkeShu sarveShu sthiteShvAhavanandiShu |
bhAradvAjo mahArAja jayadrathamathAbravIt
shlokas.12:
tvaM chaiva saumadattishcha karNashchaiva mahArathaH |
ashvatthAmA cha shalyashcha vRRiShasenaH kRRipastathA
shlokas.13:
shataM chAshvasahasrANAM rathAnAmayutAni ShaT |
dviradAnAM prabhinnAnAM sahasrANi chaturdasha
shlokas.14:
padAtInAM sahasrANi da.nshitAnyekavi.nshatiH |
gavyUtiShu trimAtreShu mAmanAsAdya tiShThata
shlokas.15:
tatrasthaM tvAM na sa.nsoDhuM shaktA devAH savAsavAH |
kiM punaH pANDavAH sarve samAshvasihi saindhava
shlokas.16:
evamuktaH samAshvastaH sindhurAjo jayadrathaH |
samprAyAtsaha gAndhArairvRRitastaishcha mahArathaiH
varmibhiH sAdibhiryattaiH prAsapANibhirAsthitaiH
shlokas.17:
chAmarApIDinaH sarve jAmbUnadavibhUShitAH |
jayadrathasya rAjendra hayAH sAdhupravAhinaH
te chaiva saptasAhasrA dvisAhasrAshcha saindhavAH
shlokas.18:
mattAnAmadhirUDhAnAM hastyArohairvishAradaiH |
nAgAnAM bhImarUpANAM varmiNAM raudrakarmiNAm
shlokas.19:
adhyardhena sahasreNa putro durmarShaNastava |
agrataH sarvasainyAnAM yotsyamAno vyavasthitaH
shlokas.20:
tato duHshAsanashchaiva vikarNashcha tavAtmajau |
sindhurAjArthasiddhyarthamagrAnIke vyavasthitau
shlokas.21:
dIrgho dvAdashagavyUtiH pashchArdhe pa~ncha vistRRitaH |
vyUhaH sa chakrashakaTo bhAradvAjena nirmitaH
shlokas.22:
nAnAnRRipatibhirvIraistatra tatra vyavasthitaiH |
rathAshvagajapattyoghairdroNena vihitaH svayam
shlokas.23:
pashchArdhe tasya padmastu garbhavyUhaH sudurbhidaH |
sUchI padmasya madhyastho gUDho vyUhaH punaH kRRitaH
shlokas.24:
evametaM mahAvyUhaM vyUhya droNo vyavasthitaH |
sUchImukhe maheShvAsaH kRRitavarmA vyavasthitaH
shlokas.25:
anantaraM cha kAmbojo jalasandhashcha mAriSha |
duryodhanaH sahAmAtyastadanantarameva cha
shlokas.26:
tataH shatasahasrANi yodhAnAmanivartinAm |
vyavasthitAni sarvANi shakaTe sUchirakShiNaH
shlokas.27:
teShAM cha pRRiShThato rAja balena mahatA vRRitaH |
jayadrathastato rAjansUchipAshe vyavasthitaH
shlokas.28:
shakaTasya tu rAjendra bhAradvAjo mukhe sthitaH |
anu tasyAbhavadbhojo jugopainaM tataH svayam
shlokas.29:
shvetavarmAmbaroShNISho vyUDhorasko mahAbhujaH |
dhanurvisphArayandroNastasthau kruddha ivAntakaH
shlokas.30:
patAkinaM shoNahayaM vedIkRRiShNAjinadhvajam |
droNasya rathamAlokya prahRRiShTAH kuravo.abhavan
shlokas.31:
siddhachAraNasa~NghAnAM vismayaH sumahAnabhUt |
droNena vihitaM dRRiShTvA vyUhaM kShubdhArNavopamam
shlokas.32:
sashailasAgaravanAM nAnAjanapadAkulAm |
grasedvyUhaH kShitiM sarvAmiti bhUtAni menire
shlokas.33:
bahurathamanujAshvapattinAgaM; pratibhayanisvanamadbhutAbharUpam |
ahitahRRidayabhedanaM mahadvai; shakaTamavekShya kRRitaM nananda rAjA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato vyUDheShvanIkeShu samutkruShTeShu mAriSha |
tADyamAnAsu bherIShu mRRida~NgeShu nadatsu cha
shlokas.2:
anIkAnAM cha saMhrAde vAditrANAM cha nisvane |
pradhmApiteShu sha~NkheShu saMnAde lomaharShaNe
shlokas.3:
abhihArayatsu shanakairbharateShu yuyutsuShu |
raudre muhUrte samprApte savyasAchI vyadRRishyata
shlokas.4:
vaDAnAM vAyasAnAM cha purastAtsavyasAchinaH |
bahulAni sahasrANi prAkrIDa.nstatra bhArata
shlokas.5:
mRRigAshcha ghorasaMnAdAH shivAshchAshivadarshanAH |
dakShiNena prayAtAnAmasmAkaM prANada.nstathA
shlokas.6:
sanirghAtA jvalantyashcha peturulkAH samantataH |
chachAla cha mahI kRRitsnA bhaye ghore samutthite
shlokas.7:
viShvagvAtAH sanirghAtA rUkShAH sharkaravarShiNaH |
vavurAyAti kaunteye sa~NgrAme samupasthite
shlokas.8:
nAkulistu shatAnIko dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
pANDavAnAmanIkAni prAj~nau tau vyUhatustadA
shlokas.9:
tato rathasahasreNa dviradAnAM shatena cha |
tribhirashvasahasraishcha padAtInAM shataiH shataiH
shlokas.10:
adhyardhamAtre dhanuShAM sahasre tanayastava |
agrataH sarvasainyAnAM sthitvA durmarShaNo.abravIt
shlokas.11:
adya gANDIvadhanvAnaM tapantaM yuddhadurmadam |
ahamAvArayiShyAmi veleva makarAlayam
shlokas.12:
adya pashyantu sa~NgrAme dhana~njayamamarShaNam |
viShaktaM mayi durdharShamashmakUTamivAshmani
shlokas.13:
evaM bruvanmahArAja mahAtmA sa mahAmatiH |
maheShvAsairvRRito rAjanmaheShvAso vyavasthitaH
shlokas.14:
tato.antaka iva kruddhaH savajra iva vAsavaH |
daNDapANirivAsahyo mRRityuH kAlena choditaH
shlokas.15:
shUlapANirivAkShobhyo varuNaH pAshavAniva |
yugAntAgnirivArchiShmAnpradhakShyanvai punaH prajAH
shlokas.16:
krodhAmarShabaloddhUto nivAtakavachAntakaH |
jayo jetA sthitaH satye pArayiShyanmahAvratam
shlokas.17:
AmuktakavachaH khaDgI jAmbUnadakirITabhRRit |
shubhravarmAmbaradharaH sva~NgadI chArukuNDalI
shlokas.18:
rathapravaramAsthAya naro nArAyaNAnugaH |
vidhunvangANDivaM sa~Nkhye babhau sUrya ivoditaH
shlokas.19:
so.agrAnIkasya mahata iShupAte dhana~njayaH |
vyavasthApya rathaM sajjaM sha~NkhaM dadhmau pratApavAn
shlokas.20:
atha kRRiShNo.apyasambhrAntaH pArthena saha mAriSha |
prAdhmApayatpA~nchajanyaM sha~NkhapravaramojasA
shlokas.21:
tayoH sha~NkhapraNAdena tava sainye vishAM pate |
AsansaMhRRiShTaromANaH kampitA gatachetasaH
shlokas.22:
yathA trasanti bhUtAni sarvANyashaninisvanAt |
tathA sha~NkhapraNAdena vitresustava sainikAH
shlokas.23:
prasusruvuH shakRRinmUtraM vAhanAni cha sarvashaH |
evaM savAhanaM sarvamAvignamabhavadbalam
shlokas.24:
vyaShIdanta narA rAja~nsha~Nkhashabdena mAriSha |
visa~nj~nAshchAbhavankechitkechidrAjanvitatrasuH
shlokas.25:
tataH kapirmahAnAdaM saha bhUtairdhvajAlayaiH |
akarodvyAditAsyashcha bhIShaya.nstava sainikAn
shlokas.26:
tataH sha~NkhAshcha bheryashcha mRRida~NgAshchAnakaiH saha |
punarevAbhyahanyanta tava sainyapraharShaNAH
shlokas.27:
nAnAvAditrasaMhrAdaiH kShveDitAsphoTitAkulaiH |
siMhanAdaiH savAditraiH samAhUtairmahArathaiH
shlokas.28:
tasminsutumule shabde bhIrUNAM bhayavardhane |
atIva hRRiShTo dAshArhamabravItpAkashAsaniH
shlokas.29:
chodayAshvAnhRRiShIkesha yatra durmarShaNaH sthitaH |
etadbhittvA gajAnIkaM pravekShyAmyarivAhinIm
shlokas.30:
evamukto mahAbAhuH keshavaH savyasAchinA |
achodayaddhayA.nstatra yatra durmarShaNaH sthitaH
shlokas.31:
sa samprahArastumulaH sampravRRittaH sudAruNaH |
ekasya cha bahUnAM cha rathanAganarakShayaH
shlokas.32:
tataH sAyakavarSheNa parjanya iva vRRiShTimAn |
parAnavAkiratpArthaH parvatAniva nIradaH
shlokas.33:
te chApi rathinaH sarve tvaritAH kRRitahastavat |
avAkiranbANajAlaistataH kRRiShNadhana~njayau
shlokas.34:
tataH kruddho mahAbAhurvAryamANaH parairyudhi |
shirA.nsi rathinAM pArthaH kAyebhyo.apAharachCharaiH
shlokas.35:
udbhrAntanayanairvaktraiH sa.ndaShToShThapuTaiH shubhaiH |
sakuNDalashirastrANairvasudhA samakIryata
shlokas.36:
puNDarIkavanAnIva vidhvastAni samantataH |
vinikIrNAni yodhAnAM vadanAni chakAshire
shlokas.37:
tapanIyavichitrANi siktAni rudhireNa cha |
adRRishyanta yathA rAjanmeghasa~NghAH savidyutaH
shlokas.38:
shirasAM patatAM rAja~nshabdo.abhUtpRRithivItale |
kAlena paripakvAnAM tAlAnAM patatAmiva
shlokas.39:
tataH kabandhaH kashchittu dhanurAlambya tiShThati |
kashchitkhaDgaM viniShkRRiShya bhujenodyamya tiShThati
shlokas.40:
nAjAnanta shirA.nsyurvyAM patitAni nararShabhAH |
amRRiShyamANAH kaunteyaM sa~NgrAme jayagRRiddhinaH
shlokas.41:
hayAnAmuttamA~Ngaishcha hastihastaishcha medinI |
bAhubhishcha shirobhishcha vIrANAM samakIryata
shlokas.42:
ayaM pArthaH kutaH pArtha eSha pArtha iti prabho |
tava sainyeShu yodhAnAM pArthabhUtamivAbhavat
shlokas.43:
anyonyamapi chAjaghnurAtmAnamapi chApare |
pArthabhUtamamanyanta jagatkAlena mohitAH
shlokas.44:
niShTanantaH sarudhirA visa~nj~nA gADhavedanAH |
shayAnA bahavo vIrAH kIrtayantaH suhRRijjanam
shlokas.45:
sabhiNDipAlAH saprAsAH sashaktyRRiShTiparashvadhAH |
saniryUhAH sanistri.nshAH sasharAsanatomarAH
shlokas.46:
sabANavarmAbharaNAH sagadAH sA~NgadA raNe |
mahAbhujagasa~NkAshA bAhavaH parighopamAH
shlokas.47:
udveShTanti vicheShTanti sa.nveShTanti cha sarvashaH |
vegaM kurvanti sa.nrabdhA nikRRittAH parameShubhiH
shlokas.48:
yo yaH sma samare pArthaM pratisa.nrabhate naraH |
tasya tasyAntako bANaH sharIramupasarpati
shlokas.49:
nRRityato rathamArgeShu dhanurvyAyachChatastathA |
na kashchittatra pArthasya dadarshAntaramaNvapi
shlokas.50:
yattasya ghaTamAnasya kShipraM vikShipataH sharAn |
lAghavAtpANDuputrasya vyasmayanta pare janAH
shlokas.51:
hastinaM hastiyantAramashvamAshvikameva cha |
abhinatphalguno bANai rathinaM cha sasArathim
shlokas.52:
AvartamAnamAvRRittaM yudhyamAnaM cha pANDavaH |
pramukhe tiShThamAnaM cha na ka~nchinna nihanti saH
shlokas.53:
yathodayanvai gagane sUryo hanti mahattamaH |
tathArjuno gajAnIkamavadhItka~NkapatribhiH
shlokas.54:
hastibhiH patitairbhinnaistava sainyamadRRishyata |
antakAle yathA bhUmirvinikIrNairmahIdharaiH
shlokas.55:
yathA madhya.ndine sUryo duShprekShyaH prANibhiH sadA |
tathA dhana~njayaH kruddho duShprekShyo yudhi shatrubhiH
shlokas.56:
tattathA tava putrasya sainyaM yudhi parantapa |
prabhagnaM drutamAvignamatIva sharapIDitam
shlokas.57:
mAruteneva mahatA meghAnIkaM vidhUyatA |
prakAlyamAnaM tatsainyaM nAshakatprativIkShitum
shlokas.58:
pratodaishchApakoTIbhirhu~NkAraiH sAdhuvAhitaiH |
kashApArShNyabhighAtaishcha vAgbhirugrAbhireva cha
shlokas.59:
chodayanto hayA.nstUrNaM palAyante sma tAvakAH |
sAdino rathinashchaiva pattayashchArjunArditAH
shlokas.60:
pArShNya~NguShThA~NkushairnAgA.nshchodayantastathApare |
sharaiH saMmohitAshchAnye tamevAbhimukhA yayau
tava yodhA hatotsAhA vibhrAntamanasastadA

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tasminprabhagne sainyAgre vadhyamAne kirITinA |
ke nu tatra raNe vIrAH pratyudIyurdhana~njayam
shlokas.2:
Aho svichChakaTavyUhaM praviShTA moghanishchayAH |
droNamAshritya tiShThantaH prAkAramakutobhayAH
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tathArjunena sambhagne tasmi.nstava bale tadA |
hatavIre hatotsAhe palAyanakRRitakShaNe
shlokas.4:
pAkashAsaninAbhIkShNaM vadhyamAne sharottamaiH |
na tatra kashchitsa~NgrAme shashAkArjunamIkShitum
shlokas.5:
tatastava suto rAjandRRiShTvA sainyaM tathAgatam |
duHshAsano bhRRishaM kruddho yuddhAyArjunamabhyayAt
shlokas.6:
sa kA~nchanavichitreNa kavachena samAvRRitaH |
jAmbUnadashirastrANaH shUrastIvraparAkramaH
shlokas.7:
nAgAnIkena mahatA grasanniva mahImimAm |
duHshAsano mahArAja savyasAchinamAvRRiNot
shlokas.8:
hrAdena gajaghaNTAnAM sha~NkhAnAM ninadena cha |
jyAkShepaninadaishchaiva virAveNa cha dantinAm
shlokas.9:
bhUrdishashchAntarikShaM cha shabdenAsItsamAvRRitam |
sa muhUrtaM pratibhayo dAruNaH samapadyata
shlokas.10:
tAndRRiShTvA patatastUrNama~NkushairabhichoditAn |
vyAlambahastAnsa.nrabdhAnsapakShAniva parvatAn
shlokas.11:
siMhanAdena mahatA narasiMho dhana~njayaH |
gajAnIkamamitrANAmabhito vyadhamachCharaiH
shlokas.12:
mahormiNamivoddhUtaM shvasanena mahArNavam |
kirITI tadgajAnIkaM prAvishanmakaro yathA
shlokas.13:
kAShThAtIta ivAdityaH pratapanyugasa~NkShaye |
dadRRishe dikShu sarvAsu pArthaH parapura~njayaH
shlokas.14:
khurashabdena chAshvAnAM nemighoSheNa tena cha |
tena chotkruShTashabdena jyAninAdena tena cha
devadattasya ghoSheNa gANDIvaninadena cha
shlokas.15:
mandavegatarA nAgA babhUvuste vichetasaH |
sharairAshIviShasparshairnirbhinnAH savyasAchinA
shlokas.16:
te gajA vishikhaistIkShNairyudhi gANDIvachoditaiH |
anekashatasAhasraiH sarvA~NgeShu samarpitAH
shlokas.17:
ArAvaM paramaM kRRitvA vadhyamAnAH kirITinA |
nipeturanishaM bhUmau ChinnapakShA ivAdrayaH
shlokas.18:
apare dantaveShTeShu kumbheShu cha kaTeShu cha |
sharaiH samarpitA nAgAH krau~nchavadvyanadanmuhuH
shlokas.19:
gajaskandhagatAnAM cha puruShANAM kirITinA |
AchChidyantottamA~NgAni bhallaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.20:
sakuNDalAnAM patatAM shirasAM dharaNItale |
padmAnAmiva sa~NghAtaiH pArthashchakre nivedanam
shlokas.21:
yantrabaddhA vikavachA vraNArtA rudhirokShitAH |
bhramatsu yudhi nAgeShu manuShyA vilalambire
shlokas.22:
kechidekena bANena sumuktena patatriNA |
dvau trayashcha vinirbhinnA nipeturdharaNItale
shlokas.23:
maurvIM dhanurdhvajaM chaiva yugAnIShAstathaiva cha |
rathinAM kuTTayAmAsa bhallaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.24:
na sa.ndadhanna chApyasyanna vimu~nchanna choddharan |
maNDalenaiva dhanuShA nRRityanpArthaH sma dRRishyate
shlokas.25:
atividdhAshcha nArAchairvamanto rudhiraM mukhaiH |
muhUrtAnnipatantyanye vAraNA vasudhAtale
shlokas.26:
utthitAnyagaNeyAni kabandhAni samantataH |
adRRishyanta mahArAja tasminparamasa~Nkule
shlokas.27:
sachApAH sA~NgulitrANAH sakhaDgAH sA~NgadA raNe |
adRRishyanta bhujAshChinnA hemAbharaNabhUShitAH
shlokas.28:
sUpaskarairadhiShThAnairIShAdaNDakabandhuraiH |
chakrairvimathitairakShai bhagnaishcha bahudhA yugaiH
shlokas.29:
varmachApasharaishchaiva vyavakIrNaistatastataH |
sragbhirAbharaNairvastraiH patitaishcha mahAdhvajaiH
shlokas.30:
nihatairvAraNairashvaiH kShatriyaishcha nipAtitaiH |
adRRishyata mahI tatra dAruNapratidarshanA
shlokas.31:
evaM duHshAsanabalaM vadhyamAnaM kirITinA |
samprAdravanmahArAja vyathitaM vai sanAyakam
shlokas.32:
tato duHshAsanastrastaH sahAnIkaH sharArditaH |
droNaM trAtAramAkA~NkSha~nshakaTavyUhamabhyagAt

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
duHshAsanabalaM hatvA savyasAchI dhana~njayaH |
sindhurAjaM parIpsanvai droNAnIkamupAdravat
shlokas.2:
sa tu droNaM samAsAdya vyUhasya pramukhe sthitam |
kRRitA~njaliridaM vAkyaM kRRiShNasyAnumate.abravIt
shlokas.3:
shivena dhyAhi mAM brahmansvasti chaiva vadasva me |
bhavatprasAdAdichChAmi praveShTuM durbhidAM chamUm
shlokas.4:
bhavAnpitRRisamo mahyaM dharmarAjasamo.api cha |
tathA kRRiShNasamashchaiva satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.5:
ashvatthAmA yathA tAta rakShaNIyastavAnagha |
tathAhamapi te rakShyaH sadaiva dvijasattama
shlokas.6:
tava prasAdAdichChAmi sindhurAjAnamAhave |
nihantuM dvipadAM shreShTha pratij~nAM rakSha me vibho
shlokas.7:
evamuktastadAchAryaH pratyuvAcha smayanniva |
mAmajitvA na bIbhatso shakyo jetuM jayadrathaH
shlokas.8:
etAvaduktvA taM droNaH sharavrAtairavAkirat |
sarathAshvadhvajaM tIkShNaiH prahasanvai sasArathim
shlokas.9:
tato.arjunaH sharavrAtAndroNasyAvArya sAyakaiH |
droNamabhyardayadbANairghorarUpairmahattaraiH
shlokas.10:
vivyAdha cha raNe droNamanumAnya vishAM pate |
kShatradharmaM samAsthAya navabhiH sAyakaiH punaH
shlokas.11:
tasyeShUniShubhishChittvA droNo vivyAdha tAvubhau |
viShAgnijvalanaprakhyairiShubhiH kRRiShNapANDavau
shlokas.12:
iyeSha pANDavastasya bANaishChettuM sharAsanam |
tasya chintayatastvevaM phalgunasya mahAtmanaH
droNaH sharairasambhrAnto jyAM chichChedAshu vIryavAn
shlokas.13:
vivyAdha cha hayAnasya dhvajaM sArathimeva cha |
arjunaM cha sharairvIraM smayamAno.abhyavAkirat
shlokas.14:
etasminnantare pArthaH sajjaM kRRitvA mahaddhanuH |
visheShayiShyannAchAryaM sarvAstraviduShAM varam
mumocha ShaTshatAnbANAngRRihItvaikamiva drutam
shlokas.15:
punaH sapta shatAnanyAnsahasraM chAnivartinAm |
chikShepAyutashashchAnyA.nste.aghnandroNasya tAM chamUm
shlokas.16:
taiH samyagastairbalinA kRRitinA chitrayodhinA |
manuShyavAjimAta~NgA viddhAH peturgatAsavaH
shlokas.17:
vidrutAshcha raNe petuH sa~nChinnAyudhajIvitAH |
rathino rathamukhyebhyaH sahayAH sharapIDitAH
shlokas.18:
chUrNitAkShiptadagdhAnAM vajrAnilahutAshanaiH |
tulyarUpA gajAH peturgiryagrAmbudaveshmanAm
shlokas.19:
peturashvasahasrANi prahatAnyarjuneShubhiH |
ha.nsA himavataH pRRiShThe vAriviprahatA iva
shlokas.20:
rathAshvadvipapattyoghAH salilaughA ivAdbhutAH |
yugAntAdityarashmyAbhaiH pANDavAstasharairhatAH
shlokas.21:
taM pANDavAdityasharA.nshujAlaM; kurupravIrAnyudhi niShTapantam |
sa droNameghaH sharavarShavegaiH; prAchChAdayanmegha ivArkarashmIn
shlokas.22:
athAtyarthavisRRiShTena dviShatAmasubhojinA |
Ajaghne vakShasi droNo nArAchena dhana~njayam
shlokas.23:
sa vihvalitasarvA~NgaH kShitikampe yathAchalaH |
dhairyamAlambya bIbhatsurdroNaM vivyAdha patribhiH
shlokas.24:
droNastu pa~nchabhirbANairvAsudevamatADayat |
arjunaM cha trisaptatyA dhvajaM chAsya tribhiH sharaiH
shlokas.25:
visheShayiShya~nshiShyaM cha droNo rAjanparAkramI |
adRRishyamarjunaM chakre nimeShAchCharavRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.26:
prasaktAnpatato.adrAkShma bhAradvAjasya sAyakAn |
maNDalIkRRitamevAsya dhanushchAdRRishyatAdbhutam
shlokas.27:
te.abhyayuH samare rAjanvAsudevadhana~njayau |
droNasRRiShTAH subahavaH ka~NkapatraparichChadAH
shlokas.28:
taddRRiShTvA tAdRRishaM yuddhaM droNapANDavayostadA |
vAsudevo mahAbuddhiH kAryavattAmachintayat
shlokas.29:
tato.abravIdvAsudevo dhana~njayamidaM vachaH |
pArtha pArtha mahAbAho na naH kAlAtyayo bhavet
shlokas.30:
droNamutsRRijya gachChAmaH kRRityametanmahattaram |
pArthashchApyabravItkRRiShNaM yatheShTamiti keshava
shlokas.31:
tataH pradakShiNaM kRRitvA droNaM prAyAnmahAbhujaH |
parivRRittashcha bIbhatsuragachChadvisRRija~nsharAn
shlokas.32:
tato.abravItsmayandroNaH kvedaM pANDava gamyate |
nanu nAma raNe shatrumajitvA na nivartase
shlokas.33:
arjuna uvAcha||
gururbhavAnna me shatruH shiShyaH putrasamo.asmi te |
na chAsti sa pumA.Nlloke yastvAM yudhi parAjayet
shlokas.34:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evaM bruvANo bIbhatsurjayadrathavadhotsukaH |
tvarAyukto mahAbAhustatsainyaM samupAdravat
shlokas.35:
taM chakrarakShau pA~nchAlyau yudhAmanyUttamaujasau |
anvayAtAM mahAtmAnau vishantaM tAvakaM balam
shlokas.36:
tato jayo mahArAja kRRitavarmA cha sAttvataH |
kAmbojashcha shrutAyushcha dhana~njayamavArayan
shlokas.37:
teShAM dashasahasrANi rathAnAmanuyAyinAm |
abhIShAhAH shUrasenAH shibayo.atha vasAtayaH
shlokas.38:
mAchellakA lalitthAshcha kekayA madrakAstathA |
nArAyaNAshcha gopAlAH kAmbojAnAM cha ye gaNAH
shlokas.39:
karNena vijitAH pUrvaM sa~NgrAme shUrasaMmatAH |
bhAradvAjaM puraskRRitya tyaktAtmAno.arjunaM prati
shlokas.40:
putrashokAbhisantaptaM kruddhaM mRRityumivAntakam |
tyajantaM tumule prANAnsaMnaddhaM chitrayodhinam
shlokas.41:
gAhamAnamanIkAni mAta~Ngamiva yUthapam |
maheShvAsaM parAkrAntaM naravyAghramavArayan
shlokas.42:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM tumulaM lomaharShaNam |
anyonyaM vai prArthayatAM yodhAnAmarjunasya cha
shlokas.43:
jayadrathavadhaprepsumAyAntaM puruSharShabham |
nyavArayanta sahitAH kriyA vyAdhimivotthitam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
saMniruddhastu taiH pArtho mahAbalaparAkramaH |
drutaM samanuyAtashcha droNena rathinAM varaH
shlokas.2:
kiranniShugaNA.nstikShNAnsvarashmIniva bhAskaraH |
tApayAmAsa tatsainyaM dehaM vyAdhigaNo yathA
shlokas.3:
ashvo viddho dhvajashChinnaH sArohaH patito gajaH |
ChatrANi chApaviddhAni rathAshchakrairvinA kRRitAH
shlokas.4:
vidrutAni cha sainyAni sharArtAni samantataH |
ityAsIttumulaM yuddhaM na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.5:
teShAmAyachChatAM sa~Nkhye parasparamajihmagaiH |
arjuno dhvajinIM rAjannabhIkShNaM samakampayat
shlokas.6:
satyAM chikIrShamANastu pratij~nAM satyasa~NgaraH |
abhyadravadrathashreShThaM shoNAshvaM shvetavAhanaH
shlokas.7:
taM droNaH pa~nchavi.nshatyA marmabhidbhirajihmagaiH |
antevAsinamAchAryo maheShvAsaM samardayat
shlokas.8:
taM tUrNamiva bIbhatsuH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH |
abhyadhAvadiShUnasyanniShuvegavighAtakAn
shlokas.9:
tasyAshu kShipato bhallAnbhallaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
pratyavidhyadameyAtmA brahmAstraM samudIrayan
shlokas.10:
tadadbhutamapashyAma droNasyAchAryakaM yudhi |
yatamAno yuvA nainaM pratyavidhyadyadarjunaH
shlokas.11:
kSharanniva mahAmegho vAridhArAH sahasrashaH |
droNameghaH pArthashailaM vavarSha sharavRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.12:
arjunaH sharavarShaM tadbrahmAstreNaiva mAriSha |
pratijagrAha tejasvI bANairbANAnvishAtayan
shlokas.13:
droNastu pa~nchavi.nshatyA shvetavAhanamArdayat |
vAsudevaM cha saptatyA bAhvorurasi chAshugaiH
shlokas.14:
pArthastu prahasandhImAnAchAryaM sa sharaughiNam |
visRRijantaM shitAnbANAnavArayata taM yudhi
shlokas.15:
atha tau vadhyamAnau tu droNena rathasattamau |
AvarjayetAM durdharShaM yugAntAgnimivotthitam
shlokas.16:
varjayannishitAnbANAndroNachApaviniHsRRitAn |
kirITamAlI kaunteyo bhojAnIkaM nyapAtayat
shlokas.17:
so.antarA kRRitavarmANaM kAmbojaM cha sudakShiNam |
abhyayAdvarjayandroNaM mainAkamiva parvatam
shlokas.18:
tato bhojo naravyAghraM duHsahaH kurusattama |
avidhyattUrNamavyagro dashabhiH ka~NkapatribhiH
shlokas.19:
tamarjunaH shitenAjau rAjanvivyAdha patriNA |
punashchAnyaistribhirbANairmohayanniva sAtvatam
shlokas.20:
bhojastu prahasanpArthaM vAsudevaM cha mAdhavam |
ekaikaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA sAyakAnAM samArpayat
shlokas.21:
tasyArjuno dhanushChittvA vivyAdhainaM trisaptabhiH |
sharairagnishikhAkAraiH kruddhAshIviShasaMnibhaiH
shlokas.22:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya kRRitavarmA mahArathaH |
pa~nchabhiH sAyakaistUrNaM vivyAdhorasi bhArata
shlokas.23:
punashcha nishitairbANaiH pArthaM vivyAdha pa~nchabhiH |
taM pArtho navabhirbANairAjaghAna stanAntare
shlokas.24:
viShaktaM dRRishya kaunteyaM kRRitavarmarathaM prati |
chintayAmAsa vArShNeyo na naH kAlAtyayo bhavet
shlokas.25:
tataH kRRiShNo.abravItpArthaM kRRitavarmaNi mA dayAm |
kurusAmbandhikaM kRRitvA pramathyainaM vishAtaya
shlokas.26:
tataH sa kRRitavarmANaM mohayitvArjunaH sharaiH |
abhyagAjjavanairashvaiH kAmbojAnAmanIkinIm
shlokas.27:
amarShitastu hArdikhyaH praviShTe shvetavAhane |
vidhunvansasharaM chApaM pA~nchAlyAbhyAM samAgataH
shlokas.28:
chakrarakShau tu pA~nchAlyAvarjunasya padAnugau |
paryavArayadAyAntau kRRitavarmA ratheShubhiH
shlokas.29:
tAvavidhyattato bhojaH sarvapArashavaiH sharaiH |
tribhireva yudhAmanyuM chaturbhishchottamaujasam
shlokas.30:
tAvapyenaM vivyadhaturdashabhirdashabhiH sharaiH |
sa~nchichChidaturapyasya dhvajaM kArmukameva cha
shlokas.31:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya hArdikyaH krodhamUrChitaH |
kRRitvA vidhanuShau vIrau sharavarShairavAkirat
shlokas.32:
tAvanye dhanuShI sajye kRRitvA bhojaM vijaghnatuH |
tenAntareNa bIbhatsurviveshAmitravAhinIm
shlokas.33:
na lebhAte tu tau dvAraM vAritau kRRitavarmaNA |
dhArtarAShTreShvanIkeShu yatamAnau nararShabhau
shlokas.34:
anIkAnyardayanyuddhe tvaritaH shvetavAhanaH |
nAvadhItkRRitavarmANaM prAptamapyarisUdanaH
shlokas.35:
taM dRRiShTvA tu tathAyAntaM shUro rAjA shrutAyudhaH |
abhyadravatsusa~Nkruddho vidhunvAno mahaddhanuH
shlokas.36:
sa pArthaM tribhirAnarChatsaptatyA cha janArdanam |
kShurapreNa sutIkShNena pArthaketumatADayat
shlokas.37:
tamarjuno navatyA tu sharANAM nataparvaNAm |
AjaghAna bhRRishaM kruddhastottrairiva mahAdvipam
shlokas.38:
sa tanna mamRRiShe rAjanpANDaveyasya vikramam |
athainaM saptasaptatyA nArAchAnAM samArpayat
shlokas.39:
tasyArjuno dhanushChittvA sharAvApaM nikRRitya cha |
AjaghAnorasi kruddhaH saptabhirnataparvabhiH
shlokas.40:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya sa rAjA krodhamUrChitaH |
vAsaviM navabhirbANairbAhvorurasi chArpayat
shlokas.41:
tato.arjunaH smayanneva shrutAyudhamari.ndamaH |
sharairanekasAhasraiH pIDayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.42:
ashvA.nshchAsyAvadhIttUrNaM sArathiM cha mahArathaH |
vivyAdha chainaM saptatyA nArAchAnAM mahAbalaH
shlokas.43:
hatAshvaM rathamutsRRijya sa tu rAjA shrutAyudhaH |
abhyadravadraNe pArthaM gadAmudyamya vIryavAn
shlokas.44:
varuNasyAtmajo vIraH sa tu rAjA shrutAyudhaH |
parNAshA jananI yasya shItatoyA mahAnadI
shlokas.45:
tasya mAtAbravIdvAkyaM varuNaM putrakAraNAt |
avadhyo.ayaM bhavelloke shatrUNAM tanayo mama
shlokas.46:
varuNastvabravItprIto dadAmyasmai varaM hitam |
divyamastraM sutaste.ayaM yanAvadhyo bhaviShyati
shlokas.47:
nAsti chApyamaratvaM vai manuShyasya katha~nchana |
sarveNAvashyamartavyaM jAtena saritAM vare
shlokas.48:
durdharShastveSha shatrUNAM raNeShu bhavitA sadA |
astrasyAsya prabhAvAdvai vyetu te mAnaso jvaraH
shlokas.49:
ityuktvA varuNaH prAdAdgadAM mantrapuraskRRitAm |
yAmAsAdya durAdharShaH sarvaloke shrutAyudhaH
shlokas.50:
uvAcha chainaM bhagavAnpunareva jaleshvaraH |
ayudhyati na moktavyA sA tvayyeva patediti
shlokas.51:
sa tayA vIraghAtinyA janArdanamatADayat |
pratijagrAha tAM kRRiShNaH pInenA.nsena vIryavAn
shlokas.52:
nAkampayata shauriM sA vindhyaM girimivAnilaH |
pratyabhyayAttaM viproDhA kRRityeva duradhiShThitA
shlokas.53:
jaghAna chAsthitaM vIraM shrutAyudhamamarShaNam |
hatvA shrutAyudhaM vIraM jagatImanvapadyata
shlokas.54:
hAhAkAro mahA.nstatra sainyAnAM samajAyata |
svenAstreNa hataM dRRiShTvA shrutAyudhamari.ndamam
shlokas.55:
ayudhyamAnAya hi sA keshavAya narAdhipa |
kShiptA shrutAyudhenAtha tasmAttamavadhIdgadA
shlokas.56:
yathoktaM varuNenAjau tathA sa nidhanaM gataH |
vyasushchApyapatadbhUmau prekShatAM sarvadhanvinAm
shlokas.57:
patamAnastu sa babhau parNAshAyAH priyaH sutaH |
sambhagna iva vAtena bahushAkho vanaspatiH
shlokas.58:
tataH sarvANi sainyAni senAmukhyAshcha sarvashaH |
prAdravanta hataM dRRiShTvA shrutAyudhamari.ndamam
shlokas.59:
tatha kAmbojarAjasya putraH shUraH sudakShiNaH |
abhyayAjjavanairashvaiH phalgunaM shatrusUdanam
shlokas.60:
tasya pArthaH sharAnsapta preShayAmAsa bhArata |
te taM shUraM vinirbhidya prAvishandharaNItalam
shlokas.61:
so.atividdhaH sharaistIkShNairgANDIvapreShitairmRRidhe |
arjunaM prativivyAdha dashabhiH ka~NkapatribhiH
shlokas.62:
vAsudevaM tribhirviddhvA punaH pArthaM cha pa~nchabhiH |
tasya pArtho dhanushChittvA ketuM chichCheda mAriSha
shlokas.63:
bhallAbhyAM bhRRishatIkShNAbhyAM taM cha vivyAdha pANDavaH |
sa tu pArthaM tribhirviddhvA siMhanAdamathAnadat
shlokas.64:
sarvapArashavIM chaiva shaktiM shUraH sudakShiNaH |
saghaNTAM prAhiNodghorAM kruddho gANDIvadhanvane
shlokas.65:
sA jvalantI maholkeva tamAsAdya mahAratham |
savisphuli~NgA nirbhidya nipapAta mahItale
shlokas.66:
taM chaturdashabhiH pArtho nArAchaiH ka~NkapatribhiH |
sAshvadhvajadhanuHsUtaM vivyAdhAchintyavikramaH
rathaM chAnyaiH subahubhishchakre vishakalaM sharaiH
shlokas.67:
sudakShiNaM tu kAmbojaM moghasa~Nkalpavikramam |
bibheda hRRidi bANena pRRithudhAreNa pANDavaH
shlokas.68:
sa bhinnamarmA srastA~NgaH prabhraShTamukuTA~NgadaH |
papAtAbhimukhaH shUro yantramukta iva dhvajaH
shlokas.69:
gireH shikharajaH shrImAnsushAkhaH supratiShThitaH |
nirbhagna iva vAtena karNikAro himAtyaye
shlokas.70:
shete sma nihato bhUmau kAmbojAstaraNochitaH |
sudarshanIyastAmrAkShaH karNinA sa sudakShiNaH
putraH kAmbojarAjasya pArthena vinipAtitaH
shlokas.71:
tataH sarvANi sainyAni vyadravanta sutasya te |
hataM shrutAyudhaM dRRiShTvA kAmbojaM cha sudakShiNam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
hate sudakShiNe rAjanvIre chaiva shrutAyudhe |
javenAbhyadravanpArthaM kupitAH sainikAstava
shlokas.2:
abhIShAhAH shUrasenAH shibayo.atha vasAtayaH |
abhyavarSha.nstato rAja~nsharavarShairdhana~njayam
shlokas.3:
teShAM ShaShTishatAnAryAnprAmathnAtpANDavaH sharaiH |
te sma bhItAH palAyanta vyAghrAtkShudramRRigA iva
shlokas.4:
te nivRRitya punaH pArthaM sarvataH paryavArayan |
raNe sapatnAnnighnantaM jigIShantanparAnyudhi
shlokas.5:
teShAmApatatAM tUrNaM gANDIvapreShitaiH sharaiH |
shirA.nsi pAtayAmAsa bAhU.nshchaiva dhana~njayaH
shlokas.6:
shirobhiH patitaistatra bhUmirAsInnirantarA |
abhrachChAyeva chaivAsIddhvA~NkShagRRidhravaDairyudhi
shlokas.7:
teShu tUtsAdyamAneShu krodhAmarShasamanvitau |
shrutAyushchAchyutAyushcha dhana~njayamayudhyatAm
shlokas.8:
balinau spardhinau vIrau kulajau bAhushAlinau |
tAvenaM sharavarShANi savyadakShiNamasyatAm
shlokas.9:
tvarAyuktau mahArAja prArthayAnau mahadyashaH |
arjunasya vadhaprepsU putrArthe tava dhanvinau
shlokas.10:
tAvarjunaM sahasreNa patriNAM nataparvaNAm |
pUrayAmAsatuH kruddhau taDAgaM jaladau yathA
shlokas.11:
shrutAyushcha tataH kruddhastomareNa dhana~njayam |
AjaghAna rathashreShThaH pItena nishitena cha
shlokas.12:
so.atividdho balavatA shatruNA shatrukarshanaH |
AjagAma paraM mohaM mohayankeshavaM raNe
shlokas.13:
etasminneva kAle tu so.achyutAyurmahArathaH |
shUlena bhRRishatIkShNena tADayAmAsa pANDavam
shlokas.14:
kShate kShAraM sa hi dadau pANDavasya mahAtmanaH |
pArtho.api bhRRishasa.nviddho dhvajayaShTiM samAshritaH
shlokas.15:
tataH sarvasya sainyasya tAvakasya vishAM pate |
siMhanAdo mahAnAsIddhataM matvA dhana~njayam
shlokas.16:
kRRiShNashcha bhRRishasantapto dRRiShTvA pArthaM vichetasam |
AshvAsayatsuhRRidyAbhirvAgbhistatra dhana~njayam
shlokas.17:
tatastau rathinAM shreShThau labdhalakShau dhana~njayam |
vAsudevaM cha vArShNeyaM sharavarShaiH samantataH
shlokas.18:
sachakrakUbararathaM sAshvadhvajapatAkinam |
adRRishyaM chakraturyuddhe tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.19:
pratyAshvastastu bIbhatsuH shanakairiva bhArata |
pretarAjapuraM prApya punaH pratyAgato yathA
shlokas.20:
sa~nChannaM sharajAlena rathaM dRRiShTvA sakeshavam |
shatrU chAbhimukhau dRRiShTvA dIpyamAnAvivAnalau
shlokas.21:
prAdushchakre tataH pArthaH shAkramastraM mahArathaH |
tasmAdAsansahasrANi sharANAM nataparvaNAm
shlokas.22:
te jaghnustau maheShvAsau tAbhyAM sRRiShTA.nshcha sAyakAn |
vicherurAkAshagatAH pArthabANavidAritAH
shlokas.23:
pratihatya sharA.nstUrNaM sharavegena pANDavaH |
pratasthe tatra tatraiva yodhayanvai mahArathAn
shlokas.24:
tau cha phalgunabANaughairvibAhushirasau kRRitau |
vasudhAmanvapadyetAM vAtanunnAviva drumau
shlokas.25:
shrutAyuShashcha nidhanaM vadhashchaivAchyutAyuShaH |
lokavismApanamabhUtsamudrasyeva shoShaNam
shlokas.26:
tayoH padAnugAnhatvA punaH pa~nchashatAnrathAn |
abhyagAdbhAratIM senAM nighnanpArtho varAnvarAn
shlokas.27:
shrutAyuShaM cha nihataM prekShya chaivAchyutAyuSham |
ayutAyushcha sa~Nkruddho dIrghAyushchaiva bhArata
shlokas.28:
putrau tayornarashreShThau kaunteyaM pratijagmatuH |
kirantau vividhAnbANAnpitRRivyasanakarshitau
shlokas.29:
tAvarjuno muhUrtena sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
preShayatparamakruddho yamasya sadanaM prati
shlokas.30:
loDayantamanIkAni dvipaM padmasaro yathA |
nAshaknuvanvArayituM pArthaM kShatriyapu~NgavAH
shlokas.31:
a~NgAstu gajavAreNa pANDavaM paryavArayan |
kruddhAH sahasrasho rAja~nshikhitA hastisAdinaH
shlokas.32:
duryodhanasamAdiShTAH ku~njaraiH parvatopamaiH |
prAchyAshcha dAkShiNAtyAshcha kali~NgapramukhA nRRipAH
shlokas.33:
teShAmApatatAM shIghraM gANDIvapreShitaiH sharaiH |
nichakarta shirA.nsyugrau bAhUnapi subhUShaNAn
shlokas.34:
taiH shirobhirmahI kIrNA bAhubhishcha sahA~NgadaiH |
babhau kanakapAShANA bhujagairiva sa.nvRRitA
shlokas.35:
bAhavo vishikhaishChinnAH shirA.nsyunmathitAni cha |
chyavamAnAnyadRRishyanta drumebhya iva pakShiNaH
shlokas.36:
sharaiH sahasrasho viddhA dvipAH prasrutashoNitAH |
vyadRRishyantAdrayaH kAle gairikAmbusravA iva
shlokas.37:
nihatAH sherate smAnye bIbhatsornishitaiH sharaiH |
gajapRRiShThagatA mlechChA nAnAvikRRitadarshanAH
shlokas.38:
nAnAveShadharA rAjannAnAshastraughasa.nvRRitAH |
rudhireNAnuliptA~NgA bhAnti chitraiH sharairhatAH
shlokas.39:
shoNitaM nirvamanti sma dvipAH pArthasharAhatAH |
sahasrashashChinnagAtrAH sArohAH sapadAnugAH
shlokas.40:
chukrushushcha nipetushcha babhramushchApare dishaH |
bhRRishaM trastAshcha bahudhA svAnena mamRRidurgajAH
sAntarAyudhikA mattA dvipAstIkShNaviShopamAH
shlokas.41:
vidantyasuramAyAM ye sughorA ghorachakShuShaH |
yavanAH pAradAshchaiva shakAshcha sunikaiH saha
shlokas.42:
goyoniprabhavA mlechChAH kAlakalpAH prahAriNaH |
dArvAbhisArA daradAH puNDrAshcha saha bAhlikaiH
shlokas.43:
na te sma shakyAH sa~NkhyAtuM vrAtAH shatasahasrashaH |
vRRiShTistathAvidhA hyAsIchChalabhAnAmivAyatiH
shlokas.44:
abhrachChAyAmiva sharaiH sainye kRRitvA dhana~njayaH |
muNDArdhamuNDajaTilAnashuchI~njaTilAnanAn
mlechChAnashAtayatsarvAnsametAnastramAyayA
shlokas.45:
sharaishcha shatasho viddhAste sa~NghAH sa~NghachAriNaH |
prAdravanta raNe bhItA girigahvaravAsinaH
shlokas.46:
gajAshvasAdimlechChAnAM patitAnAM shataiH sharaiH |
vaDAH ka~NkA vRRikA bhUmAvapibanrudhiraM mudA
shlokas.47:
pattyashvarathanAgaishcha prachChannakRRitasa~NkramAm |
sharavarShaplavAM ghorAM keshashaivalashADvalAm
prAvartayannadImugrAM shoNitaughatara~NgiNIm
shlokas.48:
shirastrANakShudramatsyAM yugAnte kAlasambhRRitAm |
akarodgajasambAdhAM nadImuttarashoNitAm
dehebhyo rAjaputrANAM nAgAshvarathasAdinAm
shlokas.49:
yathA sthalaM cha nimnaM cha na syAdvarShati vAsave |
tathAsItpRRithivI sarvA shoNitena pariplutA
shlokas.50:
ShaTsahasrAnvarAnvIrAnpunardashashatAnvarAn |
prAhiNonmRRityulokAya kShatriyAnkShatriyarShabhaH
shlokas.51:
sharaiH sahasrasho viddhA vidhivatkalpitA dvipAH |
sherate bhUmimAsAdya shailA vajrahatA iva
shlokas.52:
sa vAjirathamAta~NgAnnighnanvyacharadarjunaH |
prabhinna iva mAta~Ngo mRRidnannaDavanaM yathA
shlokas.53:
bhUridrumalatAgulmaM shuShkendhanatRRiNolapam |
nirdahedanalo.araNyaM yathA vAyusamIritaH
shlokas.54:
sainyAraNyaM tava tathA kRRiShNAnilasamIritaH |
sharArchiradahatkruddhaH pANDavAgnirdhana~njayaH
shlokas.55:
shUnyAnkurvanrathopasthAnmAnavaiH sa.nstaranmahIm |
prAnRRityadiva sambAdhe chApahasto dhana~njayaH
shlokas.56:
vajrakalpaiH sharairbhUmiM kurvannuttarashoNitAm |
prAvishadbhAratIM senAM sa~Nkruddho vai dhana~njayaH
taM shrutAyustathAmbaShTho vrajamAnaM nyavArayat
shlokas.57:
tasyArjunaH sharaistIkShNaiH ka~NkapatraparichChadaiH |
nyapAtayaddhayA~nshIghraM yatamAnasya mAriSha
dhanushchAsyAparaishChittvA sharaiH pArtho vichakrame
shlokas.58:
ambaShThastu gadAM gRRihya krodhaparyAkulekShaNaH |
AsasAda raNe pArthaM keshavaM cha mahAratham
shlokas.59:
tataH sa prahasanvIro gadAmudyamya bhArata |
rathamAvArya gadayA keshavaM samatADayat
shlokas.60:
gadayA tADitaM dRRiShTvA keshavaM paravIrahA |
arjuno bhRRishasa~NkruddhaH so.ambaShThaM prati bhArata
shlokas.61:
tataH sharairhemapu~NkhaiH sagadaM rathinAM varam |
ChAdayAmAsa samare meghaH sUryamivoditam
shlokas.62:
tato.aparaiH sharaishchApi gadAM tasya mahAtmanaH |
achUrNayattadA pArthastadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.63:
atha tAM patitAM dRRiShTvA gRRihyAnyAM mahatIM gadAm |
arjunaM vAsudevaM cha punaH punaratADayat
shlokas.64:
tasyArjunaH kShuraprAbhyAM sagadAvudyatau bhujau |
chichChedendradhvajAkArau shirashchAnyena patriNA
shlokas.65:
sa papAta hato rAjanvasudhAmanunAdayan |
indradhvaja ivotsRRiShTo yantranirmuktabandhanaH
shlokas.66:
rathAnIkAvagADhashcha vAraNAshvashatairvRRitaH |
so.adRRishyata tadA pArtho ghanaiH sUrya ivAvRRitaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH praviShTe kaunteye sindhurAjajighA.nsayA |
droNAnIkaM vinirbhidya bhojAnIkaM cha dustaram
shlokas.2:
kAmbojasya cha dAyAde hate rAjansudakShiNe |
shrutAyudhe cha vikrAnte nihate savyasAchinA
shlokas.3:
vipradruteShvanIkeShu vidhvasteShu samantataH |
prabhagnaM svabalaM dRRiShTvA putraste droNamabhyayAt
shlokas.4:
tvarannekarathenaiva sametya droNamabravIt |
gataH sa puruShavyAghraH pramathyemAM mahAchamUm
shlokas.5:
atra buddhyA samIkShasva kiM nu kAryamanantaram |
arjunasya vighAtAya dAruNe.asmi~njanakShaye
shlokas.6:
yathA sa puruShavyAghro na hanyeta jayadrathaH |
tathA vidhatsva bhadraM te tvaM hi naH paramA gatiH
shlokas.7:
asau dhana~njayAgnirhi kopamArutachoditaH |
senAkakShaM dahati me vahniH kakShamivotthitaH
shlokas.8:
atikrAnte hi kaunteye bhittvA sainyaM parantapa |
jayadrathasya goptAraH sa.nshayaM paramaM gatAH
shlokas.9:
sthirA buddhirnarendrANAmAsIdbrahmavidAM vara |
nAtikramiShyati droNaM jAtu jIvandhana~njayaH
shlokas.10:
so.asau pArtho vyatikrAnto miShataste mahAdyute |
sarvaM hyadyAturaM manye naitadasti balaM mama
shlokas.11:
jAnAmi tvAM mahAbhAga pANDavAnAM hite ratam |
tathA muhyAmi cha brahmankAryavattAM vichintayan
shlokas.12:
yathAshakti cha te brahmanvartaye vRRittimuttamAm |
prINAmi cha yathAshakti tachcha tvaM nAvabudhyase
shlokas.13:
asmAnna tvaM sadA bhaktAnichChasyamitavikrama |
pANDavAnsatataM prINAsyasmAkaM vipriye ratAn
shlokas.14:
asmAnevopajIva.nstvamasmAkaM vipriye rataH |
na hyahaM tvAM vijAnAmi madhudigdhamiva kShuram
shlokas.15:
nAdAsyachchedvaraM mahyaM bhavAnpANDavanigrahe |
nAvArayiShyaM gachChantamahaM sindhupatiM gRRihAn
shlokas.16:
mayA tvAsha.nsamAnena tvattastrANamabuddhinA |
AshvAsitaH sindhupatirmohAddattashcha mRRityave
shlokas.17:
yamadaMShTrAntaraM prApto muchyetApi hi mAnavaH |
nArjunasya vashaM prApto muchyetAjau jayadrathaH
shlokas.18:
sa tathA kuru shoNAshva yathA rakShyeta saindhavaH |
mama chArtapralApAnAM mA krudhaH pAhi saindhavam
shlokas.19:
droNa uvAcha||
nAbhyasUyAmi te vAchamashvatthAmnAsi me samaH |
satyaM tu te pravakShyAmi tajjuShasva vishAM pate
shlokas.20:
sArathiH pravaraH kRRiShNaH shIghrAshchAsya hayottamAH |
alpaM cha vivaraM kRRitvA tUrNaM yAti dhana~njayaH
shlokas.21:
kiM nu pashyasi bANaughAnkroshamAtre kirITinaH |
pashchAdrathasya patitAnkShiptA~nshIghraM hi gachChataH
shlokas.22:
na chAhaM shIghrayAne.adya samartho vayasAnvitaH |
senAmukhe cha pArthAnAmetadbalamupasthitam
shlokas.23:
yudhiShThirashcha me grAhyo miShatAM sarvadhanvinAm |
evaM mayA pratij~nAtaM kShatramadhye mahAbhuja
shlokas.24:
dhana~njayena chotsRRiShTo vartate pramukhe mama |
tasmAdvyUhamukhaM hitvA nAhaM yAsyAmi phalgunam
shlokas.25:
tulyAbhijanakarmANaM shatrumekaM sahAyavAn |
gatvA yodhaya mA bhaistvaM tvaM hyasya jagataH patiH
shlokas.26:
rAjA shUraH kRRitI dakSho vairamutpAdya pANDavaiH |
vIra svayaM prayAhyAshu yatra yAto dhana~njayaH
shlokas.27:
duryodhana uvAcha||
kathaM tvAmapyatikrAntaH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH |
dhana~njayo mayA shakya AchArya pratibAdhitum
shlokas.28:
api shakyo raNe jetuM vajrahastaH pura.ndaraH |
nArjunaH samare shakyo jetuM parapura~njayaH
shlokas.29:
yena bhojashcha hArdikyo bhavA.nshcha tridashopamaH |
astrapratApena jitau shrutAyushcha nibarhitaH
shlokas.30:
sudakShiNashcha nihataH sa cha rAjA shrutAyudhaH |
shrutAyushchAchyutAyushcha mlechChAshcha shatasho hatAH
shlokas.31:
taM kathaM pANDavaM yuddhe dahantamahitAnbahUn |
pratiyotsyAmi durdharShaM tanme sha.nsAstrakovida
shlokas.32:
kShamaM chenmanyase yuddhaM mama tenAdya shAdhi mAm |
paravAnasmi bhavati preShyakRRidrakSha me yashaH
shlokas.33:
droNa uvAcha||
satyaM vadasi kauravya durAdharSho dhana~njayaH |
ahaM tu tatkariShyAmi yathainaM prasahiShyasi
shlokas.34:
adbhutaM chAdya pashyantu loke sarvadhanurdharAH |
viShaktaM tvayi kaunteyaM vAsudevasya pashyataH
shlokas.35:
eSha te kavachaM rAja.nstathA badhnAmi kA~nchanam |
yathA na bANA nAstrANi viShahiShyanti te raNe
shlokas.36:
yadi tvAM sAsurasurAH sayakShoragarAkShasAH |
yodhayanti trayo lokAH sanarA nAsti te bhayam
shlokas.37:
na kRRiShNo na cha kaunteyo na chAnyaH shastrabhRRidraNe |
sharAnarpayituM kashchitkavache tava shakShyati
shlokas.38:
sa tvaM kavachamAsthAya kruddhamadya raNe.arjunam |
tvaramANaH svayaM yAhi na chAsau tvAM sahiShyate
shlokas.39:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamuktvA tvarandroNaH spRRiShTvAmbho varma bhAsvaram |
AbabandhAdbhutatamaM japanmantraM yathAvidhi
shlokas.40:
raNe tasminsumahati vijayAya sutasya te |
visismApayiShurlokaM vidyayA brahmavittamaH
shlokas.41:
droNa uvAcha||
karotu svasti te brahmA svasti chApi dvijAtayaH |
sarIsRRipAshcha ye shreShThAstebhyaste svasti bhArata
shlokas.42:
yayAtirnahuShashchaiva dhundhumAro bhagIrathaH |
tubhyaM rAjarShayaH sarve svasti kurvantu sarvashaH
shlokas.43:
svasti te.astvekapAdebhyo bahupAdebhya eva cha |
svastyastvapAdakebhyashcha nityaM tava mahAraNe
shlokas.44:
svAhA svadhA shachI chaiva svasti kurvantu te sadA |
lakShmIrarundhatI chaiva kurutAM svasti te.anagha
shlokas.45:
asito devalashchaiva vishvAmitrastathA~NgirAH |
vasiShThaH kashyapashchaiva svasti kurvantu te nRRipa
shlokas.46:
dhAtA vidhAtA lokesho dishashcha sadigIshvarAH |
svasti te.adya prayachChantu kArttikeyashcha ShaNmukhaH
shlokas.47:
vivasvAnbhagavAnsvasti karotu tava sarvashaH |
diggajAshchaiva chatvAraH kShitiH khaM gaganaM grahAH
shlokas.48:
adhastAddharaNIM yo.asau sadA dhArayate nRRipa |
sa sheShaH pannagashreShThaH svasti tubhyaM prayachChatu
shlokas.49:
gAndhAre yudhi vikramya nirjitAH surasattamAH |
purA vRRitreNa daityena bhinnadehAH sahasrashaH
shlokas.50:
hRRitatejobalAH sarve tadA sendrA divaukasaH |
brahmANaM sharaNaM jagmurvRRitrAdbhItA mahAsurAt
shlokas.51:
devA UchuH||
pramarditAnAM vRRitreNa devAnAM devasattama |
gatirbhava surashreShTha trAhi no mahato bhayAt
shlokas.52:
droNa uvAcha||
atha pArshve sthitaM viShNuM shakrAdI.nshcha surottamAn |
prAha tathyamidaM vAkyaM viShaNNAnsurasattamAn
shlokas.53:
rakShyA me satataM devAH sahendrAH sadvijAtayaH |
tvaShTuH sudurdharaM tejo yena vRRitro vinirmitaH
shlokas.54:
tvaShTrA purA tapastaptvA varShAyutashataM tadA |
vRRitro vinirmito devAH prApyAnuj~nAM maheshvarAt
shlokas.55:
sa tasyaiva prasAdAdvai hanyAdeva ripurbalI |
nAgatvA sha~NkarasthAnaM bhagavAndRRishyate haraH
shlokas.56:
dRRiShTvA haniShyatha ripuM kShipraM gachChata mandaram |
yatrAste tapasAM yonirdakShayaj~navinAshanaH
pinAkI sarvabhUtesho bhaganetranipAtanaH
shlokas.57:
te gatvA sahitA devA brahmaNA saha mandaram |
apashya.nstejasAM rAshiM sUryakoTisamaprabham
shlokas.58:
so.abravItsvAgataM devA brUta kiM karavANyaham |
amoghaM darshanaM mahyaM kAmaprAptirato.astu vaH
shlokas.59:
evamuktAstu te sarve pratyUchustaM divaukasaH |
tejo hRRitaM no vRRitreNa gatirbhava divaukasAm
shlokas.60:
mUrtIrIkShaShva no deva prahArairjarjarIkRRitAH |
sharaNaM tvAM prapannAH sma gatirbhava maheshvara
shlokas.61:
maheshvara uvAcha||
viditaM me yathA devAH kRRityeyaM sumahAbalA |
tvaShTustejobhavA ghorA durnivAryAkRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.62:
avashyaM tu mayA kAryaM sAhyaM sarvadivaukasAm |
mamedaM gAtrajaM shakra kavachaM gRRihya bhAsvaram
badhAnAnena mantreNa mAnasena sureshvara
shlokas.63:
droNa uvAcha||
ityuktvA varadaH prAdAdvarma tanmantrameva cha |
sa tena varmaNA guptaH prAyAdvRRitrachamUM prati
shlokas.64:
nAnAvidhaishcha shastraughaiH pAtyamAnairmahAraNe |
na sandhiH shakyate bhettuM varmabandhasya tasya tu
shlokas.65:
tato jaghAna samare vRRitraM devapatiH svayam |
taM cha matramayaM bandhaM varma chA~Ngirase dadau
shlokas.66:
a~NgirAH prAha putrasya mantraj~nasya bRRihaspateH |
bRRihaspatirathovAcha agniveshyAya dhImate
shlokas.67:
agniveshyo mama prAdAttena badhnAmi varma te |
tavAdya deharakShArthaM mantreNa nRRipasattama
shlokas.68:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamuktvA tato droNastava putraM mahAdyutiH |
punareva vachaH prAha shanairAchAryapu~NgavaH
shlokas.69:
brahmasUtreNa badhnAmi kavachaM tava pArthiva |
hiraNyagarbheNa yathA baddhaM viShNoH purA raNe
shlokas.70:
yathA cha brahmaNA baddhaM sa~NgrAme tArakAmaye |
shakrasya kavachaM divyaM tathA badhnAmyahaM tava
shlokas.71:
baddhvA tu kavachaM tasya mantreNa vidhipUrvakam |
preShayAmAsa rAjAnaM yuddhAya mahate dvijaH
shlokas.72:
sa saMnaddho mahAbAhurAchAryeNa mahAtmanA |
rathAnAM cha sahasreNa trigartAnAM prahAriNAm
shlokas.73:
tathA dantisahasreNa mattAnAM vIryashAlinAm |
ashvAnAmayutenaiva tathAnyaishcha mahArathaiH
shlokas.74:
vRRitaH prAyAnmahAbAhurarjunasya rathaM prati |
nAnAvAditraghoSheNa yathA vairochanistathA
shlokas.75:
tataH shabdo mahAnAsItsainyAnAM tava bhArata |
agAdhaM prasthitaM dRRiShTvA samudramiva kauravam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
praviShTayormahArAja pArthavArShNeyayostadA |
duryodhane prayAte cha pRRiShThataH puruSharShabhe
shlokas.2:
javenAbhyadravandroNaM mahatA nisvanena cha |
pANDavAH somakaiH sArdhaM tato yuddhamavartata
shlokas.3:
tadyuddhamabhavadghoraM tumulaM lomaharShaNam |
pA~nchAlAnAM kurUNAM cha vyUhasya purato.adbhutam
shlokas.4:
rAjankadAchinnAsmAbhirdRRiShTaM tAdRRi~Nna cha shrutam |
yAdRRi~Nmadhyagate sUrye yuddhamAsIdvishAM pate
shlokas.5:
dhRRiShTadyumnamukhAH pArthA vyUDhAnIkAH prahAriNaH |
droNasya sainyaM te sarve sharavarShairavAkiran
shlokas.6:
vayaM droNaM puraskRRitya sarvashastrabhRRitAM varam |
pArShatapramukhAnpArthAnabhyavarShAma sAyakaiH
shlokas.7:
mahAmeghAvivodIrNau mishravAtau himAtyaye |
senAgre viprakAshete ruchire rathabhUShite
shlokas.8:
sametya tu mahAsene chakraturvegamuttamam |
jAhnavIyamune nadyau prAvRRiShIvolbaNodake
shlokas.9:
nAnAshastrapurovAto dvipAshvarathasa.nvRRitaH |
gadAvidyunmahAraudraH sa~NgrAmajalado mahAn
shlokas.10:
bhAradvAjAniloddhUtaH sharadhArAsahasravAn |
abhyavarShanmahAraudraH pANDusenAgnimuddhatam
shlokas.11:
samudramiva gharmAnte vivAnghoro mahAnilaH |
vyakShobhayadanIkAni pANDavAnAM dvijottamaH
shlokas.12:
te.api sarvaprayatnena droNameva samAdravan |
bibhitsanto mahAsetuM vAryoghAH prabalA iva
shlokas.13:
vArayAmAsa tAndroNo jalaughAnachalo yathA |
pANDavAnsamare kruddhAnpA~nchAlA.nshcha sakekayAn
shlokas.14:
athApare.api rAjAnaH parAvRRitya samantataH |
mahAbalA raNe shUrAH pA~nchAlAnanvavArayan
shlokas.15:
tato raNe naravyAghraH pArShataH pANDavaiH saha |
sa~njaghAnAsakRRiddroNaM bibhitsurarivAhinIm
shlokas.16:
yathaiva sharavarShANi droNo varShati pArShate |
tathaiva sharavarShANi dhRRiShTadyumno.abhyavarShata
shlokas.17:
sanistri.nshapurovAtaH shaktiprAsarShTisa.nvRRitaH |
jyAvidyuchchApasaMhrAdo dhRRiShTadyumnabalAhakaH
shlokas.18:
sharadhArAshmavarShANi vyasRRijatsarvatodisham |
nighnanrathavarAshvaughA.nshChAdayAmAsa vAhinIm
shlokas.19:
yaM yamArChachCharairdroNaH pANDavAnAM rathavrajam |
tatastataH sharairdroNamapAkarShata pArShataH
shlokas.20:
tathA tu yatamAnasya droNasya yudhi bhArata |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM samAsAdya tridhA sainyamabhidyata
shlokas.21:
bhojameke nyavartanta jalasandhamathApare |
pANDavairhanyamAnAshcha droNamevApare.avrajan
shlokas.22:
sainyAnyaghaTayadyAni droNastu rathinAM varaH |
vyadhamachchApi tAnyasya dhRRiShTadyumno mahArathaH
shlokas.23:
dhArtarAShTrAstridhAbhUtA vadhyante pANDusRRi~njayaiH |
agopAH pashavo.araNye bahubhiH shvApadairiva
shlokas.24:
kAlaH sa~Ngrasate yodhAndhRRiShTadyumnena mohitAn |
sa~NgrAme tumule tasminniti saMmenire janAH
shlokas.25:
kunRRipasya yathA rAShTraM durbhikShavyAdhitaskaraiH |
drAvyate tadvadApannA pANDavaistava vAhinI
shlokas.26:
arkarashmiprabhinneShu shastreShu kavacheShu cha |
chakShUMShi pratihanyante sainyena rajasA tathA
shlokas.27:
tridhAbhUteShu sainyeShu vadhyamAneShu pANDavaiH |
amarShitastato droNaH pA~nchAlAnvyadhamachCharaiH
shlokas.28:
mRRidnatastAnyanIkAni nighnatashchApi sAyakaiH |
babhUva rUpaM droNasya kAlAgneriva dIpyataH
shlokas.29:
rathaM nAgaM hayaM chApi pattinashcha vishAM pate |
ekaikeneShuNA sa~Nkhye nirbibheda mahArathaH
shlokas.30:
pANDavAnAM tu sainyeShu nAsti kashchitsa bhArata |
dadhAra yo raNe bANAndroNachApachyutA~nshitAn
shlokas.31:
tatpachyamAnamarkeNa droNasAyakatApitam |
babhrAma pArShataM sainyaM tatra tatraiva bhArata
shlokas.32:
tathaiva pArShatenApi kAlyamAnaM balaM tava |
abhavatsarvato dIptaM shuShkaM vanamivAgninA
shlokas.33:
vadhyamAneShu sainyeShu droNapArShatasAyakaiH |
tyaktvA prANAnparaM shaktyA prAyudhyanta sma sainikAH
shlokas.34:
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha yudhyatAM bharatarShabha |
nAsItkashchinmahArAja yo.atyAkShItsa.nyugaM bhayAt
shlokas.35:
bhImasenaM tu kaunteyaM sodaryAH paryavArayan |
vivi.nshatishchitraseno vikarNashcha mahArathaH
shlokas.36:
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau kShemadhUrtishcha vIryavAn |
trayANAM tava putrANAM traya evAnuyAyinaH
shlokas.37:
bAhlIkarAjastejasvI kulaputro mahArathaH |
sahasenaH sahAmAtyo draupadeyAnavArayat
shlokas.38:
shaibyo govAsano rAjA yodhairdashashatAvaraiH |
kAshyasyAbhibhuvaH putraM parAkrAntamavArayat
shlokas.39:
ajAtashatruM kaunteyaM jvalantamiva pAvakam |
madrANAmIshvaraH shalyo rAjA rAjAnamAvRRiNot
shlokas.40:
duHshAsanastvavasthApya svamanIkamamarShaNaH |
sAtyakiM prayayau kruddhaH shUro rathavaraM yudhi
shlokas.41:
svakenAhamanIkena saMnaddhakavachAvRRitaH |
chatuHshatairmaheShvAsaishchekitAnamavArayam
shlokas.42:
shakunistu sahAnIko mAdrIputramavArayat |
gAndhArakaiH saptashataishchApashaktisharAsibhiH
shlokas.43:
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau virATaM matsyamArChatAm |
prANA.nstyaktvA maheShvAsau mitrArthe.abhyudyatau yudhi
