shlokas.44:
shikhaNDinaM yAj~naseniM rundhAnamaparAjitam |
bAhlikaH pratisa.nyattaH parAkrAntamavArayat
shlokas.45:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha pA~nchAlyaM krUraiH sArdhaM prabhadrakaiH |
AvantyaH saha sauvIraiH kruddharUpamavArayat
shlokas.46:
ghaTotkachaM tathA shUraM rAkShasaM krUrayodhinam |
alAyudho.adravattUrNaM kruddhamAyAntamAhave
shlokas.47:
alambusaM rAkShasendraM kuntibhojo mahArathaH |
sainyena mahatA yuktaH kruddharUpamavArayat
shlokas.48:
saindhavaH pRRiShThatastvAsItsarvasainyasya bhArata |
rakShitaH parameShvAsaiH kRRipaprabhRRitibhI rathaiH
shlokas.49:
tasyAstAM chakrarakShau dvau saindhavasya bRRihattamau |
drauNirdakShiNato rAjansUtaputrashcha vAmataH
shlokas.50:
pRRiShThagopAstu tasyAsansaumadattipurogamAH |
kRRipashcha vRRiShasenashcha shalaH shalyashcha durjayaH
shlokas.51:
nItimanto maheShvAsAH sarve yuddhavishAradAH |
saindhavasya vidhAyaivaM rakShAM yuyudhire tadA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
rAjansa~NgrAmamAshcharyaM shRRiNu kIrtayato mama |
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha yathA yuddhamavartata
shlokas.2:
bhAradvAjaM samAsAdya vyUhasya pramukhe sthitam |
ayodhayanraNe pArthA droNAnIkaM bibhitsavaH
shlokas.3:
rakShamANAH svakaM vyUhaM droNasyApi cha sainikAH |
ayodhayanraNe pArthAnprArthayanto mahadyashaH
shlokas.4:
vindAnuvindAvAvantyau virATaM dashabhiH sharaiH |
AjaghnatuH susa~Nkruddhau tava putrahitaiShiNau
shlokas.5:
virATashcha mahArAja tAvubhau samare sthitau |
parAkrAntau parAkramya yodhayAmAsa sAnugau
shlokas.6:
teShAM yuddhaM samabhavaddAruNaM shoNitodakam |
siMhasya dvipamukhyAbhyAM prabhinnAbhyAM yathA vane
shlokas.7:
bAhlIkaM rabhasaM yuddhe yAj~nasenirmahAbalaH |
Ajaghne vishikhaistIkShNairghorairmarmAsthibhedibhiH
shlokas.8:
bAhlIko yAj~naseniM tu hemapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH |
AjaghAna bhRRishaM kruddho navabhirnataparvabhiH
shlokas.9:
tadyuddhamabhavadghoraM sharashaktisamAkulam |
bhIrUNAM trAsajananaM shUrANAM harShavardhanam
shlokas.10:
tAbhyAM tatra sharairmuktairantarikShaM dishastathA |
abhavatsa.nvRRitaM sarvaM na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.11:
shaibyo govAsano yuddhe kAshyaputraM mahAratham |
sasainyo yodhayAmAsa gajaH pratigajaM yathA
shlokas.12:
bAhlIkarAjaH sa.nrabdho draupadeyAnmahArathAn |
manaH pa~nchendriyANIva shushubhe yodhayanraNe
shlokas.13:
ayodhaya.nste cha bhRRishaM taM sharaughaiH samantataH |
indriyArthA yathA dehaM shashvaddehabhRRitAM vara
shlokas.14:
vArShNeyaM sAtyakiM yuddhe putro duHshAsanastava |
Ajaghne sAyakaistIkShNairnavabhirnataparvabhiH
shlokas.15:
so.atividdho balavatA maheShvAsena dhanvinA |
IShanmUrChAM jagAmAshu sAtyakiH satyavikramaH
shlokas.16:
samAshvastastu vArShNeyastava putraM mahAratham |
vivyAdha dashabhistUrNaM sAyakaiH ka~NkapatribhiH
shlokas.17:
tAvanyonyaM dRRiDhaM viddhAvanyonyasharavikShatau |
rejatuH samare rAjanpuShpitAviva ki.nshukau
shlokas.18:
alambusastu sa~NkruddhaH kuntibhojasharArditaH |
ashobhata paraM lakShmyA puShpADhya iva ki.nshukaH
shlokas.19:
kuntibhojaM tato rakSho viddhvA bahubhirAyasaiH |
anadadbhairavaM nAdaM vAhinyAH pramukhe tava
shlokas.20:
tatastau samare shUrau yodhayantau parasparam |
dadRRishuH sarvabhUtAni shakrajambhau yathA purA
shlokas.21:
shakuniM rabhasaM yuddhe kRRitavairaM cha bhArata |
mAdrIputrau cha sa.nrabdhau sharairardayatAM mRRidhe
shlokas.22:
tanmUlaH sa mahArAja prAvartata janakShayaH |
tvayA sa~njanito.atyarthaM karNena cha vivardhitaH
shlokas.23:
uddhukShitashcha putreNa tava krodhahutAshanaH |
ya imAM pRRithivIM rAjandagdhuM sarvAM samudyataH
shlokas.24:
shakuniH pANDuputrAbhyAM kRRitaH sa vimukhaH sharaiH |
nAbhyajAnata kartavyaM yudhi ki~nchitparAkramam
shlokas.25:
vimukhaM chainamAlokya mAdrIputrau mahArathau |
vavarShatuH punarbANairyathA meghau mahAgirim
shlokas.26:
sa vadhyamAno bahubhiH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
samprAyAjjavanairashvairdroNAnIkAya saubalaH
shlokas.27:
ghaTotkachastathA shUraM rAkShasaM tamalAyudham |
abhyayAdrabhasaM yuddhe vegamAsthAya madhyamam
shlokas.28:
tayoryuddhaM mahArAja chitrarUpamivAbhavat |
yAdRRishaM hi purA vRRittaM rAmarAvaNayormRRidhe
shlokas.29:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA madrarAjAnamAhave |
viddhvA pa~nchAshatA bANaiH punarvivyAdha saptabhiH
shlokas.30:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM tayoratyadbhutaM nRRipa |
yathA pUrvaM mahadyuddhaM shambarAmararAjayoH
shlokas.31:
vivi.nshatishchitraseno vikarNashcha tavAtmajaH |
ayodhayanbhImasenaM mahatyA senayA vRRitAH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tathA tasminpravRRitte tu sa~NgrAme lomaharShaNe |
kauraveyA.nstridhAbhUtAnpANDavAH samupAdravan
shlokas.2:
jalasandhaM mahAbAhurbhImaseno nyavArayat |
yudhiShThiraH sahAnIkaH kRRitavarmANamAhave
shlokas.3:
kirantaM sharavarShANi rochamAna ivA.nshumAn |
dhRRiShTadyumno mahArAja droNamabhyadravadraNe
shlokas.4:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM tvaratAM sarvadhanvinAm |
kurUNAM somakAnAM cha sa~NkruddhAnAM parasparam
shlokas.5:
sa~NkShaye tu tathA bhUte vartamAne mahAbhaye |
dva.ndvIbhUteShu sainyeShu yudhyamAneShvabhItavat
shlokas.6:
droNaH pA~nchAlaputreNa balI balavatA saha |
vichikShepa pRRiShatkaughA.nstadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.7:
puNDarIkavanAnIva vidhvastAni samantataH |
chakrAte droNapA~nchAlyau nRRiNAM shIrShANyanekashaH
shlokas.8:
vinikIrNAni vIrANAmanIkeShu samantataH |
vastrAbharaNashastrANi dhvajavarmAyudhAni cha
shlokas.9:
tapanIyavichitrA~NgAH sa.nsiktA rudhireNa cha |
sa.nsaktA iva dRRishyante meghasa~NghAH savidyutaH
shlokas.10:
ku~njarAshvanarAnsa~Nkhye pAtayantaH patatribhiH |
tAlamAtrANi chApAni vikarShanto mahArathAH
shlokas.11:
asicharmANi chApAni shirA.nsi kavachAni cha |
viprakIryanta shUrANAM samprahAre mahAtmanAm
shlokas.12:
utthitAnyagaNeyAni kabandhAni samantataH |
adRRishyanta mahArAja tasminparamasa~Nkule
shlokas.13:
gRRidhrAH ka~NkA vaDAH shyenA vAyasA jambukAstathA |
bahavaH pishitAshAshcha tatrAdRRishyanta mAriSha
shlokas.14:
bhakShayantaH sma mA.nsAni pibantashchApi shoNitam |
vilumpantaH sma keshA.nshcha majjAshcha bahudhA nRRipa
shlokas.15:
AkarShantaH sharIrANi sharIrAvayavA.nstathA |
narAshvagajasa~NghAnAM shirA.nsi cha tatastataH
shlokas.16:
kRRitAstrA raNadIkShAbhirdIkShitAH sharadhAriNaH |
raNe jayaM prArthayanto bhRRishaM yuyudhire tadA
shlokas.17:
asimArgAnbahuvidhAnvicherustAvakA raNe |
RRiShTibhiH shaktibhiH prAsaiH shUlatomarapaTTishaiH
shlokas.18:
gadAbhiH parighaishchAnye vyAyudhAshcha bhujairapi |
anyonyaM jaghnire kruddhA yuddhara~NgagatA narAH
shlokas.19:
rathino rathibhiH sArdhamashvArohAshcha sAdibhiH |
mAta~NgA varamAta~NgaiH padAtAshcha padAtibhiH
shlokas.20:
kShIbA ivAnye chonmattA ra~NgeShviva cha chAraNAH |
uchchukrushustathAnyonyaM jaghnuranyonyamAhave
shlokas.21:
vartamAne tathA yuddhe nirmaryAde vishAM pate |
dhRRiShTadyumno hayAnashvairdroNasya vyatyamishrayat
shlokas.22:
te hayA sAdhvashobhanta vimishrA vAtaraMhasaH |
pArAvatasavarNAshcha raktashoNAshcha sa.nyuge
hayAH shushubhire rAjanmeghA iva savidyutaH
shlokas.23:
dhRRiShTadyumnashcha samprekShya droNamabhyAshamAgatam |
asicharmAdade vIro dhanurutsRRijya bhArata
shlokas.24:
chikIrShurduShkaraM karma pArShataH paravIrahA |
IShayA samatikramya droNasya rathamAvishat
shlokas.25:
atiShThadyugamadhye sa yugasaMnahaneShu cha |
jaghAnArdheShu chAshvAnAM tatsainyAnyabhyapUjayan
shlokas.26:
khaDgena charatastasya shoNAshvAnadhitiShThataH |
na dadarshAntaraM droNastadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.27:
yathA shyenasya patanaM vaneShvAmiShagRRiddhinaH |
tathaivAsIdabhIsArastasya droNaM jighA.nsataH
shlokas.28:
tataH sharashatenAsya shatachandraM samAkShipat |
droNo drupadaputrasya khaDgaM cha dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.29:
hayA.nshchaiva chatuHShaShTyA sharANAM jaghnivAnbalI |
dhvajaM ChatraM cha bhallAbhyAM tathobhau pArShNisArathI
shlokas.30:
athAsmai tvarito bANamaparaM jIvitAntakam |
AkarNapUrNaM chikShepa vajraM vajradharo yathA
shlokas.31:
taM chaturdashabhirbANairbANaM chichCheda sAtyakiH |
grastamAchAryamukhyena dhRRiShTadyumnamamochayat
shlokas.32:
siMheneva mRRigaM grastaM narasiMhena mAriSha |
droNena mochayAmAsa pA~nchAlyaM shinipu~NgavaH
shlokas.33:
sAtyakiM prekShya goptAraM pA~nchAlyasya mahAhave |
sharANAM tvarito droNaH ShaDvi.nshatyA samarpayat
shlokas.34:
tato droNaM shineH pautro grasantamiva sRRi~njayAn |
pratyavidhyachChitairbANaiH ShaDvi.nshatyA stanAntare
shlokas.35:
tataH sarve rathAstUrNaM pA~nchAlA jayagRRiddhinaH |
sAtvatAbhisRRite droNe dhRRiShTadyumnamamochayan

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
bANe tasminnikRRitte tu dhRRiShTadyumne cha mokShite |
tena vRRiShNipravIreNa yuyudhAnena sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
amarShito maheShvAsaH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH |
naravyAghraH shineH pautre droNaH kimakarodyudhi
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sampradrutaH krodhaviSho vyAditAsyasharAsanaH |
tIkShNadhAreShudashanaH shitanArAchadaMShTravAn
shlokas.4:
sa.nrambhAmarShatAmrAkSho mahAhiriva niHshvasan |
naravIrapramuditaiH shoNairashvairmahAjavaiH
shlokas.5:
utpatadbhirivAkAshaM kramadbhiriva sarvataH |
rukmapu~NkhA~nsharAnasyanyuyudhAnamupAdravat
shlokas.6:
sharapAtamahAvarShaM rathaghoShabalAhakam |
kArmukAkarShavikShiptaM nArAchabahuvidyutam
shlokas.7:
shaktikhaDgAshanidharaM krodhavegasamutthitam |
droNameghamanAvAryaM hayamArutachoditam
shlokas.8:
dRRiShTvaivAbhipatantaM taM shUraH parapura~njayaH |
uvAcha sUtaM shaineyaH prahasanyuddhadurmadaH
shlokas.9:
etaM vai brAhmaNaM krUraM svakarmaNyanavasthitam |
AshrayaM dhArtarAShTrasya rAj~no duHkhabhayAvaham
shlokas.10:
shIghraM prajavitairashvaiH pratyudyAhi prahRRiShTavat |
AchAryaM rAjaputrANAM satataM shUramAninam
shlokas.11:
tato rajatasa~NkAshA mAdhavasya hayottamAH |
droNasyAbhimukhAH shIghramagachChanvAtaraMhasaH
shlokas.12:
iShujAlAvRRitaM ghoramandhakAramanantaram |
anAdhRRiShyamivAnyeShAM shUrANAmabhavattadA
shlokas.13:
tataH shIghrAstraviduShordroNasAtvatayostadA |
nAntaraM sharavRRiShTInAM dRRishyate narasiMhayoH
shlokas.14:
iShUNAM saMnipAtena shabdo dhArAbhighAtajaH |
shushruve shakramuktAnAmashanInAmiva svanaH
shlokas.15:
nArAchairatividdhAnAM sharANAM rUpamAbabhau |
AshIviShavidaShTAnAM sarpANAmiva bhArata
shlokas.16:
tayorjyAtalanirghoSho vyashrUyata sudAruNaH |
ajasraM shailashRRi~NgANAM vajreNAhanyatAmiva
shlokas.17:
ubhayostau rathau rAja.nste chAshvAstau cha sArathI |
rukmapu~NkhaiH sharaishChannAshchitrarUpA babhustadA
shlokas.18:
nirmalAnAmajihmAnAM nArAchAnAM vishAM pate |
nirmuktAshIviShAbhAnAM sampAto.abhUtsudAruNaH
shlokas.19:
ubhayoH patite Chatre tathaiva patitau dhvajau |
ubhau rudhirasiktA~NgAvubhau cha vijayaiShiNau
shlokas.20:
sravadbhiH shoNitaM gAtraiH prasrutAviva vAraNau |
anyonyamabhividhyetAM jIvitAntakaraiH sharaiH
shlokas.21:
garjitotkruShTasaMnAdAH sha~NkhadundubhinisvanAH |
upAramanmahArAja vyAjahAra na kashchana
shlokas.22:
tUShNImbhUtAnyanIkAni yodhA yuddhAdupAraman |
dadRRishe dvairathaM tAbhyAM jAtakautUhalo janaH
shlokas.23:
rathino hastiyantAro hayArohAH padAtayaH |
avaikShantAchalairnetraiH parivArya ratharShabhau
shlokas.24:
hastyanIkAnyatiShThanta tathAnIkAni vAjinAm |
tathaiva rathavAhinyaH prativyUhya vyavasthitAH
shlokas.25:
muktAvidrumachitraishcha maNikA~nchanabhUShitaiH |
dhvajairAbharaNaishchitraiH kavachaishcha hiraNmayaiH
shlokas.26:
vaijayantIpatAkAbhiH paristomA~NgakambalaiH |
vimalairnishitaiH shastrairhayAnAM cha prakIrNakaiH
shlokas.27:
jAtarUpamayIbhishcha rAjatIbhishcha mUrdhasu |
gajAnAM kumbhamAlAbhirdantaveShTaishcha bhArata
shlokas.28:
sabalAkAH sakhadyotAH sairAvatashatahradAH |
adRRishyantoShNaparyAye meghAnAmiva vAgurAH
shlokas.29:
apashyannasmadIyAshcha te cha yaudhiShThirAH sthitAH |
tadyuddhaM yuyudhAnasya droNasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.30:
vimAnAgragatA devA brahmashakrapurogamAH |
siddhachAraNasa~NghAshcha vidyAdharamahoragAH
shlokas.31:
gatapratyAgatAkShepaishchitraiH shastravighAtibhiH |
vividhairvismayaM jagmustayoH puruShasiMhayoH
shlokas.32:
hastalAghavamastreShu darshayantau mahAbalau |
anyonyaM samavidhyetAM sharaistau droNasAtyakI
shlokas.33:
tato droNasya dAshArhaH sharA.nshchichCheda sa.nyuge |
patribhiH sudRRiDhairAshu dhanushchaiva mahAdyute
shlokas.34:
nimeShAntaramAtreNa bhAradvAjo.aparaM dhanuH |
sajyaM chakAra tachchAshu chichChedAsya sa sAtyakiH
shlokas.35:
tatastvaranpunardroNo dhanurhasto vyatiShThata |
sajyaM sajyaM punashchAsya chichCheda nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.36:
tato.asya sa.nyuge droNo dRRiShTvA karmAtimAnuSham |
yuyudhAnasya rAjendra manasedamachintayat
shlokas.37:
etadastrabalaM rAme kArtavIrye dhana~njaye |
bhIShme cha puruShavyAghre yadidaM sAtvatAM vare
shlokas.38:
taM chAsya manasA droNaH pUjayAmAsa vikramam |
lAghavaM vAsavasyeva samprekShya dvijasattamaH
shlokas.39:
tutoShAstravidAM shreShThastathA devAH savAsavAH |
na tAmAlakShayAmAsurlaghutAM shIghrakAriNaH
shlokas.40:
devAshcha yuyudhAnasya gandharvAshcha vishAM pate |
siddhachAraNasa~NghAshcha vidurdroNasya karma tat
shlokas.41:
tato.anyaddhanurAdAya droNaH kShatriyamardanaH |
astrairastravidAM shreShTho yodhayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.42:
tasyAstrANyastramAyAbhiH pratihanya sa sAtyakiH |
jaghAna nishitairbANaistadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.43:
tasyAtimAnuShaM karma dRRiShTvAnyairasamaM raNe |
yuktaM yogena yogaj~nAstAvakAH samapUjayan
shlokas.44:
yadastramasyati droNastadevAsyati sAtyakiH |
tamAchAryo.apyasambhrAnto.ayodhayachChatrutApanaH
shlokas.45:
tataH kruddho mahArAja dhanurvedasya pAragaH |
vadhAya yuyudhAnasya divyamastramudairayat
shlokas.46:
tadAgneyaM mahAghoraM ripughnamupalakShya saH |
astraM divyaM maheShvAso vAruNaM samudairayat
shlokas.47:
hAhAkAro mahAnAsIddRRiShTvA divyAstradhAriNau |
na vicherustadAkAshe bhUtAnyAkAshagAnyapi
shlokas.48:
astre te vAruNAgneye tAbhyAM bANasamAhite |
na tAvadabhiShajyete vyAvartadatha bhAskaraH
shlokas.49:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA bhImasenashcha pANDavaH |
nakulaH sahadevashcha paryarakShanta sAtyakim
shlokas.50:
dhRRiShTadyumnamukhaiH sArdhaM virATashcha sakekayaH |
matsyAH shAlveyasenAshcha droNamAjagmura~njasA
shlokas.51:
duHshAsanaM puraskRRitya rAjaputrAH sahasrashaH |
droNamabhyupapadyanta sapatnaiH parivAritam
shlokas.52:
tato yuddhamabhUdrAja.nstava teShAM cha dhanvinAm |
rajasA sa.nvRRite loke sharajAlasamAvRRite
shlokas.53:
sarvamAvignamabhavanna prAj~nAyata ki~nchana |
sainyena rajasA dhvaste nirmaryAdamavartata

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
parivartamAne tvAditye tatra sUryasya rashmibhiH |
rajasA kIryamANAshcha mandIbhUtAshcha sainikAH
shlokas.2:
tiShThatAM yudhyamAnAnAM punarAvartatAmapi |
bhajyatAM jayatAM chaiva jagAma tadahaH shanaiH
shlokas.3:
tathA teShu viShakteShu sainyeShu jayagRRiddhiShu |
arjuno vAsudevashcha saindhavAyaiva jagmatuH
shlokas.4:
rathamArgapramANaM tu kaunteyo nishitaiH sharaiH |
chakAra tatra panthAnaM yayau yena janArdanaH
shlokas.5:
yatra yatra ratho yAti pANDavasya mahAtmanaH |
tatra tatraiva dIryante senAstava vishAM pate
shlokas.6:
rathashikShAM tu dAshArho darshayAmAsa vIryavAn |
uttamAdhamamadhyAni maNDalAni vidarshayan
shlokas.7:
te tu nAmA~NkitAH pItAH kAlajvalanasaMnibhAH |
snAyunaddhAH suparvANaH pRRithavo dIrghagAminaH
shlokas.8:
vaiNavAyasmayasharAH svAyatA vividhAnanAH |
rudhiraM patagaiH sArdhaM prANinAM papurAhave
shlokas.9:
rathasthitaH kroshamAtre yAnasyatyarjunaH sharAn |
rathe kroshamatikrAnte tasya te ghnanti shAtravAn
shlokas.10:
tArkShyamArutaraMhobhirvAjibhiH sAdhuvAhibhiH |
tathAgachChaddhRRiShIkeshaH kRRitsnaM vismApaya~njagat
shlokas.11:
na tathA gachChati rathastapanasya vishAM pate |
nendrasya na cha rudrasya nApi vaishravaNasya cha
shlokas.12:
nAnyasya samare rAjangatapUrvastathA rathaH |
yathA yayAvarjunasya manobhiprAyashIghragaH
shlokas.13:
pravishya tu raNe rAjankeshavaH paravIrahA |
senAmadhye hayA.nstUrNaM chodayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.14:
tatastasya rathaughasya madhyaM prApya hayottamAH |
kRRichChreNa rathamUhustaM kShutpipAsAshramAnvitAH
shlokas.15:
kShatAshcha bahubhiH shastrairyuddhashauNDairanekashaH |
maNDalAni vichitrANi vicheruste muhurmuhuH
shlokas.16:
hatAnAM vAjinAgAnAM rathAnAM cha naraiH saha |
upariShTAdatikrAntAH shailAbhAnAM sahasrashaH
shlokas.17:
etasminnantare vIrAvAvantyau bhrAtarau nRRipa |
sahasenau samArChetAM pANDavaM klAntavAhanam
shlokas.18:
tAvarjunaM chatuHShaShTyA saptatyA cha janArdanam |
sharANAM cha shatenAshvAnavidhyetAM mudAnvitau
shlokas.19:
tAvarjuno mahArAja navabhirnataparvabhiH |
AjaghAna raNe kruddho marmaj~no marmabhedibhiH
shlokas.20:
tatastau tu sharaugheNa bIbhatsuM sahakeshavam |
AchChAdayetAM sa.nrabdhau siMhanAdaM cha nedatuH
shlokas.21:
tayostu dhanuShI chitre bhallAbhyAM shvetavAhanaH |
chichCheda samare tUrNaM dhvajau cha kanakojjvalau
shlokas.22:
athAnye dhanuShI rAjanpragRRihya samare tadA |
pANDavaM bhRRishasa~NkruddhAvardayAmAsatuH sharaiH
shlokas.23:
tayostu bhRRishasa~NkruddhaH sharAbhyAM pANDunandanaH |
chichCheda dhanuShI tUrNaM bhUya eva dhana~njayaH
shlokas.24:
tathAnyairvishikhaistUrNaM hemapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH |
jaghAnAshvAnsapadAtA.nstathobhau pArShNisArathI
shlokas.25:
jyeShThasya cha shiraH kAyAtkShurapreNa nyakRRintata |
sa papAta hataH pRRithvyAM vAtarugNa iva drumaH
shlokas.26:
vindaM tu nihataM dRRiShTvA anuvindaH pratApavAn |
hatAshvaM rathamutsRRijya gadAM gRRihya mahAbalaH
shlokas.27:
abhyadravata sa~NgrAme bhrAturvadhamanusmaran |
gadayA gadinAM shreShTho nRRityanniva mahArathaH
shlokas.28:
anuvindastu gadayA lalATe madhusUdanam |
spRRiShTvA nAkampayatkruddho mainAkamiva parvatam
shlokas.29:
tasyArjunaH sharaiH ShaDbhirgrIvAM pAdau bhujau shiraH |
nichakarta sa sa~nChinnaH papAtAdrichayo yathA
shlokas.30:
tatastau nihatau dRRiShTvA tayo rAjanpadAnugAH |
abhyadravanta sa~NkruddhAH kirantaH shatashaH sharAn
shlokas.31:
tAnarjunaH sharaistUrNaM nihatya bharatarShabha |
vyarochata yathA vahnirdAvaM dagdhvA himAtyaye
shlokas.32:
tayoH senAmatikramya kRRichChrAnniryAddhana~njayaH |
vibabhau jaladAnbhittvA divAkara ivoditaH
shlokas.33:
taM dRRiShTvA kuravastrastAH prahRRiShTAshchAbhavanpunaH |
abhyavarSha.nstadA pArthaM samantAdbharatarShabha
shlokas.34:
shrAntaM chainaM samAlakShya j~nAtvA dUre cha saindhavam |
siMhanAdena mahatA sarvataH paryavArayan
shlokas.35:
tA.nstu dRRiShTvA susa.nrabdhAnutsmayanpuruSharShabhaH |
shanakairiva dAshArhamarjuno vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.36:
sharArditAshcha glAnAshcha hayA dUre cha saindhavaH |
kimihAnantaraM kAryaM jyAyiShThaM tava rochate
shlokas.37:
brUhi kRRiShNa yathAtattvaM tvaM hi prAj~natamaH sadA |
bhavannetrA raNe shatrUnvijeShyantIha pANDavAH
shlokas.38:
mama tvanantaraM kRRityaM yadvai tatsaMnibodha me |
hayAnvimuchya hi sukhaM vishalyAnkuru mAdhava
shlokas.39:
evamuktastu pArthena keshavaH pratyuvAcha tam |
mamApyetanmataM pArtha yadidaM te prabhAShitam
shlokas.40:
arjuna uvAcha||
ahamAvArayiShyAmi sarvasainyAni keshava |
tvamapyatra yathAnyAyaM kuru kAryamanantaram
shlokas.41:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
so.avatIrya rathopasthAdasambhrAnto dhana~njayaH |
gANDIvaM dhanurAdAya tasthau giririvAchalaH
shlokas.42:
tamabhyadhAvankroshantaH kShatriyA jayakA~NkShiNaH |
idaM Chidramiti j~nAtvA dharaNIsthaM dhana~njayam
shlokas.43:
tamekaM rathava.nshena mahatA paryavArayan |
vikarShantashcha chApAni visRRijantashcha sAyakAn
shlokas.44:
astrANi cha vichitrANi kruddhAstatra vyadarshayan |
ChAdayantaH sharaiH pArthaM meghA iva divAkaram
shlokas.45:
abhyadravanta vegena kShatriyAH kShatriyarShabham |
rathasiMhaM rathodArAH siMhaM mattA iva dvipAH
shlokas.46:
tatra pArthasya bhujayormahadbalamadRRishyata |
yatkruddho bahulAH senAH sarvataH samavArayat
shlokas.47:
astrairastrANi sa.nvArya dviShatAM sarvato vibhuH |
iShubhirbahubhistUrNaM sarvAneva samAvRRiNot
shlokas.48:
tatrAntarikShe bANAnAM pragADhAnAM vishAM pate |
sa~NgharSheNa mahArchiShmAnpAvakaH samajAyata
shlokas.49:
tatra tatra maheShvAsaiH shvasadbhiH shoNitokShitaiH |
hayairnAgaishcha sambhinnairnadadbhishchArikarshanaiH
shlokas.50:
sa.nrabdhaishchAribhirvIraiH prArthayadbhirjayaM mRRidhe |
ekasthairbahubhiH kruddhairUShmeva samajAyata
shlokas.51:
sharormiNaM dhvajAvartaM nAganakraM duratyayam |
padAtimatsyakalilaM sha~Nkhadundubhinisvanam
shlokas.52:
asa~NkhyeyamapAraM cha rajo.a.abhIlamatIva cha |
uShNIShakamaThachChannaM patAkAphenamAlinam
shlokas.53:
rathasAgaramakShobhyaM mAta~NgA~NgashilAchitam |
velAbhUtastadA pArthaH patribhiH samavArayat
shlokas.54:
tato janArdanaH sa~Nkhye priyaM puruShasattamam |
asambhrAnto mahAbAhurarjunaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.55:
udapAnamihAshvAnAM nAlamasti raNe.arjuna |
parIpsante jalaM cheme peyaM na tvavagAhanam
shlokas.56:
idamastItyasambhrAnto bruvannastreNa medinIm |
abhihatyArjunashchakre vAjipAnaM saraH shubham
shlokas.57:
sharava.nshaM sharasthUNaM sharAchChAdanamadbhutam |
sharaveshmAkarotpArthastvaShTevAdbhutakarmakRRit
shlokas.58:
tataH prahasya govindaH sAdhu sAdhvityathAbravIt |
sharaveshmani pArthena kRRite tasminmahAraNe

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
salile janite tasminkaunteyena mahAtmanA |
nivArite dviShatsainye kRRite cha sharaveshmani
shlokas.2:
vAsudevo rathAttUrNamavatIrya mahAdyutiH |
mochayAmAsa turagAnvitunnAnka~NkapatribhiH
shlokas.3:
adRRiShTapUrvaM taddRRiShTvA siMhanAdo mahAnabhUt |
siddhachAraNasa~NghAnAM sainikAnAM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.4:
padAtinaM tu kaunteyaM yudhyamAnaM nararShabhAH |
nAshaknuvanvArayituM tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.5:
Apatatsu rathaugheShu prabhUtagajavAjiShu |
nAsambhramattadA pArthastadasya puruShAnati
shlokas.6:
vyasRRijanta sharaughA.nste pANDavaM prati pArthivAH |
na chAvyathata dharmAtmA vAsaviH paravIrahA
shlokas.7:
sa tAni sharajAlAni gadAH prAsA.nshcha vIryavAn |
AgatAnagrasatpArthaH saritaH sAgaro yathA
shlokas.8:
astravegena mahatA pArtho bAhubalena cha |
sarveShAM pArthivendrANAmagrasattA~nsharottamAn
shlokas.9:
tattu pArthasya vikrAntaM vAsudevasya chobhayoH |
apUjayanmahArAja kauravAH paramAdbhutam
shlokas.10:
kimadbhutataraM loke bhavitApyatha vApyabhUt |
yadashvAnpArthagovindau mochayAmAsatU raNe
shlokas.11:
bhayaM vipulamasmAsu tAvadhattAM narottamau |
tejo vidadhatushchograM visrabdhau raNamUrdhani
shlokas.12:
athotsmayanhRRiShIkeshaH strImadhya iva bhArata |
arjunena kRRite sa~Nkhye sharagarbhagRRihe tadA
shlokas.13:
upAvartayadavyagrastAnashvAnpuShkarekShaNaH |
miShatAM sarvasainyAnAM tvadIyAnAM vishAM pate
shlokas.14:
teShAM shramaM cha glAniM cha vepathuM vamathuM vraNAn |
sarvaM vyapAnudatkRRiShNaH kushalo hyashvakarmaNi
shlokas.15:
shalyAnuddhRRitya pANibhyAM parimRRijya cha tAnhayAn |
upAvRRitya yathAnyAyaM pAyayAmAsa vAri saH
shlokas.16:
sa tA.NllabdhodakAnsnAtA~njagdhAnnAnvigataklamAn |
yojayAmAsa saMhRRiShTaH punareva rathottame
shlokas.17:
sa taM rathavaraM shauriH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH |
samAsthAya mahAtejAH sArjunaH prayayau drutam
shlokas.18:
rathaM rathavarasyAjau yuktaM labdhodakairhayaiH |
dRRiShTvA kurubalashreShThAH punarvimanaso.abhavan
shlokas.19:
viniHshvasantaste rAjanbhagnadaMShTrA ivoragAH |
dhigaho dhiggataH pArthaH kRRiShNashchetyabruvanpRRithak
shlokas.20:
sarvakShatrasya miShato rathenaikena da.nshitau |
bAlakrIDanakeneva kadarthIkRRitya no balam
shlokas.21:
kroshatAM yatamAnAnAmasa.nsaktau parantapau |
darshayitvAtmano vIryaM prayAtau sarvarAjasu
shlokas.22:
tau prayAtau punardRRiShTvA tadAnye sainikAbruvan |
tvaradhvaM kuravaH sarve vadhe kRRiShNakirITinoH
shlokas.23:
rathaM yuktvA hi dAshArho miShatAM sarvadhanvinAm |
jayadrathAya yAtyeSha kadarthIkRRitya no raNe
shlokas.24:
tatra kechinmitho rAjansamabhAShanta bhUmipAH |
adRRiShTapUrvaM sa~NgrAme taddRRiShTvA mahadadbhutam
shlokas.25:
sarvasainyAni rAjA cha dhRRitarAShTro.atyayaM gataH |
duryodhanAparAdhena kShatraM kRRitsnA cha medinI
shlokas.26:
vilayaM samanuprAptA tachcha rAjA na budhyate |
ityevaM kShatriyAstatra bruvantyanye cha bhArata
shlokas.27:
sindhurAjasya yatkRRityaM gatasya yamasAdanam |
tatkarotu vRRithAdRRiShTirdhArtarAShTro.anupAyavit
shlokas.28:
tataH shIghrataraM prAyAtpANDavaH saindhavaM prati |
nivartamAne tigmA.nshau hRRiShTaiH pItodakairhayaiH
shlokas.29:
taM prayAntaM mahAbAhuM sarvashastrabhRRitAM varam |
nAshaknuvanvArayituM yodhAH kruddhamivAntakam
shlokas.30:
vidrAvya tu tataH sainyaM pANDavaH shatrutApanaH |
yathA mRRigagaNAnsiMhaH saindhavArthe vyaloDayat
shlokas.31:
gAhamAnastvanIkAni tUrNamashvAnachodayat |
balAkavarNAndAshArhaH pA~nchajanyaM vyanAdayat
shlokas.32:
kaunteyenAgrataH sRRiShTA nyapatanpRRiShThataH sharAH |
tUrNAttUrNataraM hyashvAste.avahanvAtaraMhasaH
shlokas.33:
vAtoddhUtapatAkAntaM rathaM jaladanisvanam |
ghoraM kapidhvajaM dRRiShTvA viShaNNA rathino.abhavan
shlokas.34:
divAkare.atha rajasA sarvataH sa.nvRRite bhRRisham |
sharArtAshcha raNe yodhA na kRRiShNau shekurIkShitum
shlokas.35:
tato nRRipatayaH kruddhAH parivavrurdhana~njayam |
kShatriyA bahavashchAnye jayadrathavadhaiShiNam
shlokas.36:
apanIyatsu shalyeShu dhiShThitaM puruSharShabham |
duryodhanastvagAtpArthaM tvaramANo mahAhave

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sra.nsanta iva majjAnastAvakAnAM bhayAnnRRipa |
tau dRRiShTvA samatikrAntau vAsudevadhana~njayau
shlokas.2:
sarve tu pratisa.nrabdhA hrImantaH sattvachoditAH |
sthirIbUtA mahAtmAnaH pratyagachChandhana~njayam
shlokas.3:
ye gatAH pANDavaM yuddhe krodhAmarShasamanvitAH |
te.adyApi na nivartante sindhavaH sAgarAdiva
shlokas.4:
asantastu nyavartanta vedebhya iva nAstikAH |
narakaM bhajamAnAste pratyapadyanta kilbiSham
shlokas.5:
tAvatItya rathAnIkaM vimuktau puruSharShabhau |
dadRRishAte yathA rAhorAsyAnmuktau prabhAkarau
shlokas.6:
matsyAviva mahAjAlaM vidArya vigatajvarau |
tathA kRRiShNAvadRRishyetAM senAjAlaM vidArya tat
shlokas.7:
vimuktau shastrasambAdhAddroNAnIkAtsudurbhidAt |
adRRishyetAM mahAtmAnau kAlasUryAvivoditau
shlokas.8:
astrasambAdhanirmuktau vimuktau shastrasa~NkaTAt |
adRRishyetAM mahAtmAnau shatrusambAdhakAriNau
shlokas.9:
vimuktau jvalanasparshAnmakarAsyAjjhaShAviva |
vyakShobhayetAM senAM tau samudraM makarAviva
shlokas.10:
tAvakAstava putrAshcha droNAnIkasthayostayoH |
naitau tariShyato droNamiti chakrustadA matim
shlokas.11:
tau tu dRRiShTvA vyatikrAntau droNAnIkaM mahAdyutI |
nAshasha.nsurmahArAja sindhurAjasya jIvitam
shlokas.12:
AshA balavatI rAjanputrANAmabhavattava |
droNahArdikyayoH kRRiShNau na mokShyete iti prabho
shlokas.13:
tAmAshAM viphalAM kRRitvA nistIrNau tau parantapau |
droNAnIkaM mahArAja bhojAnIkaM cha dustaram
shlokas.14:
atha dRRiShTvA vyatikrAntau jvalitAviva pAvakau |
nirAshAH sindhurAjasya jIvitaM nAshasha.nsire
shlokas.15:
mithashcha samabhAShetAmabhItau bhayavardhanau |
jayadrathavadhe vAchastAstAH kRRiShNadhana~njayau
shlokas.16:
asau madhye kRRitaH ShaDbhirdhArtarAShTrairmahArathaiH |
chakShurviShayasamprApto na nau mokShyati saindhavaH
shlokas.17:
yadyasya samare goptA shakro devagaNaiH saha |
tathApyenaM haniShyAva iti kRRiShNAvabhAShatAm
shlokas.18:
iti kRRiShNau mahAbAhU mithaH kathayatAM tadA |
sindhurAjamavekShantau tatputrAstava shushruvuH
shlokas.19:
atItya marudhanveva prayAntau tRRiShitau gajau |
pItvA vAri samAshvastau tathaivAstAmari.ndamau
shlokas.20:
vyAghrasiMhagajAkIrNAnatikramyeva parvatAn |
adRRishyetAM mahAbAhU yathA mRRityujarAtigau
shlokas.21:
tathA hi mukhavarNo.ayamanayoriti menire |
tAvakA dRRishya muktau tau vikroshanti sma sarvataH
shlokas.22:
droNAdAshIviShAkArAjjvalitAdiva pAvakAt |
anyebhyaH pArthivebhyashcha bhAsvantAviva bhAskarau
shlokas.23:
tau muktau sAgaraprakhyAddroNAnIkAdari.ndamau |
adRRishyetAM mudA yuktau samuttIryArNavaM yathA
shlokas.24:
shastraughAnmahato muktau droNahArdikyarakShitAn |
rochamAnAvadRRishyetAmindrAgnyoH sadRRishau raNe
shlokas.25:
udbhinnarudhirau kRRiShNau bhAradvAjasya sAyakaiH |
shitaishchitau vyarochetAM karNikArairivAchalau
shlokas.26:
droNagrAhahradAnmuktau shaktyAshIviShasa~NkaTAt |
ayaHsharogramakarAtkShatriyapravarAmbhasaH
shlokas.27:
jyAghoShatalanirhrAdAdgadAnistri.nshavidyutaH |
droNAstrameghAnnirmuktau sUryendU timirAdiva
shlokas.28:
bAhubhyAmiva santIrNau sindhuShaShThAH samudragAH |
tapAnte saritaH pUrNA mahAgrAhasamAkulAH
shlokas.29:
iti kRRiShNau maheShvAsau yashasA lokavishrutau |
sarvabhUtAnyamanyanta droNAstrabalavismayAt
shlokas.30:
jayadrathaM samIpasthamavekShantau jighA.nsayA |
ruruM nipAne lipsantau vyAghravattAvatiShThatAm
shlokas.31:
yathA hi mukhavarNo.ayamanayoriti menire |
tava yodhA mahArAja hatameva jayadratham
shlokas.32:
lohitAkShau mahAbAhU sa.nyattau kRRiShNapANDavau |
sindhurAjamabhiprekShya hRRiShTau vyanadatAM muhuH
shlokas.33:
shaurerabhIshuhastasya pArthasya cha dhanuShmataH |
tayorAsItpratibhrAjaH sUryapAvakayoriva
shlokas.34:
harSha eva tayorAsIddroNAnIkapramuktayoH |
samIpe saindhavaM dRRiShTvA shyenayorAmiShaM yathA
shlokas.35:
tau tu saindhavamAlokya vartamAnamivAntike |
sahasA petatuH kruddhau kShipraM shyenAvivAmiShe
shlokas.36:
tau tu dRRiShTvA vyatikrAntau hRRiShIkeshadhana~njayau |
sindhurAjasya rakShArthaM parAkrAntaH sutastava
shlokas.37:
droNenAbaddhakavacho rAjA duryodhanastadA |
yayAvekarathenAjau hayasa.nskAravitprabho
shlokas.38:
kRRiShNapArthau maheShvAsau vyatikramyAtha te sutaH |
agrataH puNDarIkAkShaM pratIyAya narAdhipa
shlokas.39:
tataH sarveShu sainyeShu vAditrANi prahRRiShTavat |
prAvAdyansamatikrAnte tava putre dhana~njayam
shlokas.40:
siMhanAdaravAshchAsa~nsha~NkhadundubhimishritAH |
dRRiShTvA duryodhanaM tatra kRRiShNayoH pramukhe sthitam
shlokas.41:
ye cha te sindhurAjasya goptAraH pAvakopamAH |
te prahRRiShyanta samare dRRiShTvA putraM tavAbhibho
shlokas.42:
dRRiShTvA duryodhanaM kRRiShNastvatikrAntaM sahAnugam |
abravIdarjunaM rAjanprAptakAlamidaM vachaH

shlokas.1:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
suyodhanamatikrAntamenaM pashya dhana~njaya |
ApadgatamimaM manye nAstyasya sadRRisho rathaH
shlokas.2:
dUrapAtI maheShvAsaH kRRitAstro yuddhadurmadaH |
dRRiDhAstrashchitrayodhI cha dhArtarAShTro mahAbalaH
shlokas.3:
atyantasukhasa.nvRRiddho mAnitashcha mahArathaiH |
kRRitI cha satataM pArtha nityaM dveShTi cha pANDavAn
shlokas.4:
tena yuddhamahaM manye prAptakAlaM tavAnagha |
atra vo dyUtamAyAtaM vijayAyetarAya vA
shlokas.5:
atra krodhaviShaM pArtha vimu~ncha chirasambhRRitam |
eSha mUlamanarthAnAM pANDavAnAM mahArathaH
shlokas.6:
so.ayaM prAptastavAkShepaM pashya sAphalyamAtmanaH |
kathaM hi rAjA rAjyArthI tvayA gachCheta sa.nyugam
shlokas.7:
diShTyA tvidAnIM samprApta eSha te bANagocharam |
sa yathA jIvitaM jahyAttathA kuru dhana~njaya
shlokas.8:
aishvaryamadasaMmUDho naiSha duHkhamupeyivAn |
na cha te sa.nyuge vIryaM jAnAti puruSharShabha
shlokas.9:
tvAM hi lokAstrayaH pArtha sasurAsuramAnuShAH |
notsahante raNe jetuM kimutaikaH suyodhanaH
shlokas.10:
sa diShTyA samanuprAptastava pArtha rathAntikam |
jahyenaM vai mahAbAho yathA vRRitraM pura.ndaraH
shlokas.11:
eSha hyanarthe satataM parAkrAntastavAnagha |
nikRRityA dharmarAjaM cha dyUte va~nchitavAnayam
shlokas.12:
bahUni sunRRisha.nsAni kRRitAnyetena mAnada |
yuShmAsu pApamatinA apApeShveva nityadA
shlokas.13:
tamanAryaM sadA kShudraM puruShaM kAmachAriNam |
AryAM yuddhe matiM kRRitvA jahi pArthAvichArayan
shlokas.14:
nikRRityA rAjyaharaNaM vanavAsaM cha pANDava |
parikleshaM cha kRRiShNAyA hRRidi kRRitvA parAkrama
shlokas.15:
diShTyaiSha tava bANAnAM gochare parivartate |
pratighAtAya kAryasya diShTyA cha yatate.agrataH
shlokas.16:
diShTyA jAnAti sa~NgrAme yoddhavyaM hi tvayA saha |
diShTyA cha saphalAH pArtha sarve kAmA hi kAmitAH
shlokas.17:
tasmAjjahi raNe pArtha dhArtarAShTraM kulAdhamam |
yathendreNa hataH pUrvaM jambho devAsure mRRidhe
shlokas.18:
asminhate tvayA sainyamanAthaM bhidyatAmidam |
vairasyAsyAstvavabhRRitho mUlaM Chindhi durAtmanAm
shlokas.19:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
taM tathetyabravItpArthaH kRRityarUpamidaM mama |
sarvamanyadanAdRRitya gachCha yatra suyodhanaH
shlokas.20:
yenaitaddIrghakAlaM no bhuktaM rAjyamakaNTakam |
apyasya yudhi vikramya ChindyAM mUrdhAnamAhave
shlokas.21:
api tasyA anarhAyAH parikleshasya mAdhava |
kRRiShNAyAH shaknuyAM gantuM padaM keshapradharShaNe
shlokas.22:
ityevaM vAdinau hRRiShTau kRRiShNau shvetAnhayottamAn |
preShayAmAsatuH sa~Nkhye prepsantau taM narAdhipam
shlokas.23:
tayoH samIpaM samprApya putraste bharatarShabha |
na chakAra bhayaM prApte bhaye mahati mAriSha
shlokas.24:
tadasya kShatriyAstatra sarva evAbhyapUjayan |
yadarjunahRRiShIkeshau pratyudyAto.avichArayan
shlokas.25:
tataH sarvasya sainyasya tAvakasya vishAM pate |
mahAnnAdo hyabhUttatra dRRiShTvA rAjAnamAhave
shlokas.26:
tasmi~njanasamunnAde pravRRitte bhairave sati |
kadarthIkRRitya te putraH pratyamitramavArayat
shlokas.27:
AvAritastu kaunteyastava putreNa dhanvinA |
sa.nrambhamagamadbhUyaH sa cha tasminparantapaH
shlokas.28:
tau dRRiShTvA pratisa.nrabdhau duryodhanadhana~njayau |
abhyavaikShanta rAjAno bhImarUpAH samantataH
shlokas.29:
dRRiShTvA tu pArthaM sa.nrabdhaM vAsudevaM cha mAriSha |
prahasanniva putraste yoddhukAmaH samAhvayat
shlokas.30:
tataH prahRRiShTo dAshArhaH pANDavashcha dhana~njayaH |
vyAkroshetAM mahAnAdaM dadhmatushchAmbujottamau
shlokas.31:
tau hRRiShTarUpau samprekShya kauraveyAshcha sarvashaH |
nirAshAH samapadyanta putrasya tava jIvite
shlokas.32:
shokamIyuH paraM chaiva kuravaH sarva eva te |
amanyanta cha putraM te vaishvAnaramukhe hutam
shlokas.33:
tathA tu dRRiShTvA yodhAste prahRRiShTau kRRiShNapANDavau |
hato rAjA hato rAjetyUchurevaM bhayArditAH
shlokas.34:
janasya saMninAdaM tu shrutvA duryodhano.abravIt |
vyetu vo bhIrahaM kRRiShNau preShayiShyAmi mRRityave
shlokas.35:
ityuktvA sainikAnsarvA~njayApekShI narAdhipaH |
pArthamAbhAShya sa.nrambhAdidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.36:
pArtha yachChikShitaM te.astraM divyaM mAnuShameva cha |
taddarshaya mayi kShipraM yadi jAto.asi pANDunA
shlokas.37:
yadbalaM tava vIryaM cha keshavasya tathaiva cha |
tatkuruShva mayi kShipraM pashyAmastava pauruSham
shlokas.38:
asmatparokShaM karmANi pravadanti kRRitAni te |
svAmisatkArayuktAni yAni tAnIha darshaya

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamuktvArjunaM rAjA tribhirmarmAtigaiH sharaiH |
pratyavidhyanmahAvegaishchaturbhishchaturo hayAn
shlokas.2:
vAsudevaM cha dashabhiH pratyavidhyatstanAntare |
pratodaM chAsya bhallena ChittvA bhUmAvapAtayat
shlokas.3:
taM chaturdashabhiH pArthashchitrapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH |
avidhyattUrNamavyagraste.asyAbhrashyanta varmaNaH
shlokas.4:
teShAM vaiphalyamAlokya punarnava cha pa~ncha cha |
prAhiNonnishitAnbANA.nste chAbhrashyanta varmaNaH
shlokas.5:
aShTAvi.nshattu tAnbANAnastAnviprekShya niShphalAn |
abravItparavIraghnaH kRRiShNo.arjunamidaM vachaH
shlokas.6:
adRRiShTapUrvaM pashyAmi shilAnAmiva sarpaNam |
tvayA sampreShitAH pArtha nArthaM kurvanti patriNaH
shlokas.7:
kachchidgANDIvataH prANAstathaiva bharatarShabha |
muShTishcha te yathApUrvaM bhujayoshcha balaM tava
shlokas.8:
na chedvidherayaM kAlaH prAptaH syAdadya pashchimaH |
tava chaivAsya shatroshcha tanmamAchakShva pRRichChataH
shlokas.9:
vismayo me mahAnpArtha tava dRRiShTvA sharAnimAn |
vyarthAnnipatataH sa~Nkhye duryodhanarathaM prati
shlokas.10:
vajrAshanisamA ghorAH parakAyAvabhedinaH |
sharAH kurvanti te nArthaM pArtha kAdya viDambanA
shlokas.11:
arjuna uvAcha||
droNenaiShA matiH kRRiShNa dhArtarAShTre niveshitA |
ante vihitamastrANAmetatkavachadhAraNam
shlokas.12:
asminnantarhitaM kRRiShNa trailokyamapi varmaNi |
eko droNo hi vedaitadahaM tasmAchcha sattamAt
shlokas.13:
na shakyametatkavachaM bANairbhettuM katha~nchana |
api vajreNa govinda svayaM maghavatA yudhi
shlokas.14:
jAna.nstvamapi vai kRRiShNa mAM vimohayase katham |
yadvRRittaM triShu lokeShu yachcha keshava vartate
shlokas.15:
tathA bhaviShyadyachchaiva tatsarvaM viditaM tava |
na tvevaM veda vai kashchidyathA tvaM madhusUdana
shlokas.16:
eSha duryodhanaH kRRiShNa droNena vihitAmimAm |
tiShThatyabhItavatsa~Nkhye bibhratkavachadhAraNAm
shlokas.17:
yattvatra vihitaM kAryaM naiSha tadvetti mAdhava |
strIvadeSha bibhartyetAM yuktAM kavachadhAraNAm
shlokas.18:
pashya bAhvoshcha me vIryaM dhanuShashcha janArdana |
parAjayiShye kauravyaM kavachenApi rakShitam
shlokas.19:
idama~Ngirase prAdAddevesho varma bhAsvaram |
punardadau surapatirmahyaM varma sasa~Ngraham
shlokas.20:
daivaM yadyasya varmaitadbrahmaNA vA svayaM kRRitam |
naitadgopsyati durbuddhimadya bANahataM mayA
shlokas.21:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamuktvArjuno bANAnabhimantrya vyakarShayat |
vikRRiShyamANA.nstenaivaM dhanurmadhyagatA~nsharAn
tAnasyAstreNa chichCheda drauNiH sarvAstraghAtinA
shlokas.22:
tAnnikRRittAniShUndRRiShTvA dUrato brahmavAdinA |
nyavedayatkeshavAya vismitaH shvetavAhanaH
shlokas.23:
naitadastraM mayA shakyaM dviH prayoktuM janArdana |
astraM mAmeva hanyAddhi pashya tvadya balaM mama
shlokas.24:
tato duryodhanaH kRRiShNau navabhirnataparvabhiH |
avidhyata raNe rAja~nsharairAshIviShopamaiH
bhUya evAbhyavarShachcha samare kRRiShNapANDavau
shlokas.25:
sharavarSheNa mahatA tato.ahRRiShyanta tAvakAH |
chakrurvAditraninadAnsiMhanAdaravA.nstathA
shlokas.26:
tataH kruddho raNe pArthaH sRRikkaNI parisa.nlihan |
nApashyata tato.asyA~NgaM yanna syAdvarmarakShitam
shlokas.27:
tato.asya nishitairbANaiH sumuktairantakopamaiH |
hayA.nshchakAra nirdehAnubhau cha pArShNisArathI
shlokas.28:
dhanurasyAchChinachchitraM hastAvApaM cha vIryavAn |
rathaM cha shakalIkartuM savyasAchI prachakrame
shlokas.29:
duryodhanaM cha bANAbhyAM tIkShNAbhyAM virathIkRRitam |
avidhyaddhastatalayorubhayorarjunastadA
shlokas.30:
taM kRRichChrAmApadaM prAptaM dRRiShTvA paramadhanvinaH |
samApetuH parIpsanto dhana~njayasharArditam
shlokas.31:
te rathairbahusAhasraiH kalpitaiH ku~njarairhayaiH |
padAtyoghaishcha sa.nrabdhaiH parivavrurdhana~njayam
shlokas.32:
atha nArjunagovindau ratho vApi vyadRRishyata |
astravarSheNa mahatA janaughaishchApi sa.nvRRitau
shlokas.33:
tato.arjuno.astravIryeNa nijaghne tAM varUthinIm |
tatra vya~NgIkRRitAH petuH shatasho.atha rathadvipAH
shlokas.34:
te hatA hanyamAnAshcha nyagRRihNa.nstaM rathottamam |
sa rathastambhitastasthau kroshamAtraM samantataH
shlokas.35:
tato.arjunaM vRRiShNivIrastvarito vAkyamabravIt |
dhanurvisphArayAtyarthamahaM dhmAsyAmi chAmbujam
shlokas.36:
tato visphArya balavadgANDIvaM jaghnivAnripUn |
mahatA sharavarSheNa talashabdena chArjunaH
shlokas.37:
pA~nchajanyaM cha balavaddadhmau tAreNa keshavaH |
rajasA dhvastapakShmAntaH prasvinnavadano bhRRisham
shlokas.38:
tasya sha~Nkhasya nAdena dhanuSho nisvanena cha |
niHsattvAshcha sasattvAshcha kShitau petustadA janAH
shlokas.39:
tairvimukto ratho reje vAyvIrita ivAmbudaH |
jayadrathasya goptArastataH kShubdhAH sahAnugAH
shlokas.40:
te dRRiShTvA sahasA pArthaM goptAraH saindhavasya tu |
chakrurnAdAnbahuvidhAnkampayanto vasundharAm
shlokas.41:
bANashabdaravA.nshchogrAnvimishrA~nsha~NkhanisvanaiH |
prAdushchakrurmahAtmAnaH siMhanAdaravAnapi
shlokas.42:
taM shrutvA ninadaM ghoraM tAvakAnAM samutthitam |
pradadhmatustadA sha~Nkhau vAsudevadhana~njayau
shlokas.43:
tena shabdena mahatA pUriteyaM vasundharA |
sashailA sArNavadvIpA sapAtAlA vishAM pate
shlokas.44:
sa shabdo bharatashreShTha vyApya sarvA disho dasha |
pratisasvAna tatraiva kurupANDavayorbale
shlokas.45:
tAvakA rathinastatra dRRiShTvA kRRiShNadhana~njayau |
sa.nrambhaM paramaM prAptAstvaramANA mahArathAH
shlokas.46:
atha kRRiShNau mahAbhAgau tAvakA dRRishya da.nshitau |
abhyadravanta sa~NkruddhAstadadbhutamivAbhavat

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tAvakAstu samIkShyaiva vRRiShNyandhakakurUttamau |
prAgatvara~njighA.nsantastathaiva vijayaH parAn
shlokas.2:
suvarNachitrairvaiyAghraiH svanavadbhirmahArathaiH |
dIpayanto dishaH sarvA jvaladbhiriva pAvakaiH
shlokas.3:
rukmapRRiShThaishcha duShprekShyaiH kArmukaiH pRRithivIpate |
kUjadbhiratulAnnAdAnroShitairuragairiva
shlokas.4:
bhUrishravAH shalaH karNo vRRiShaseno jayadrathaH |
kRRipashcha madrarAjashcha drauNishcha rathinAM varaH
shlokas.5:
te pibanta ivAkAshamashvairaShTau mahArathAH |
vyarAjayandasha disho vaiyAghrairhemachandrakaiH
shlokas.6:
te da.nshitAH susa.nrabdhA rathairmeghaughanisvanaiH |
samAvRRiNvandishaH sarvAH pArthaM cha vishikhaiH shitaiH
shlokas.7:
kaulUtakA hayAshchitrA vahantastAnmahArathAn |
vyashobhanta tadA shIghrA dIpayanto disho dasha
shlokas.8:
AjAneyairmahAvegairnAnAdeshasamutthitaiH |
pArvatIyairnadIjaishcha saindhavaishcha hayottamaiH
shlokas.9:
kuruyodhavarA rAja.nstava putraM parIpsavaH |
dhana~njayarathaM shIghraM sarvataH samupAdravan
shlokas.10:
te pragRRihya mahAsha~NkhAndadhmuH puruShasattamAH |
pUrayanto divaM rAjanpRRithivIM cha sasAgarAm
shlokas.11:
tathaiva dadhmatuH sha~Nkhau vAsudevadhana~njayau |
pravarau sarvabhUtAnAM sarvasha~Nkhavarau bhuvi
devadattaM cha kaunteyaH pA~nchajanyaM cha keshavaH
shlokas.12:
shabdastu devadattasya dhana~njayasamIritaH |
pRRithivIM chAntarikShaM cha dishashchaiva samAvRRiNot
shlokas.13:
tathaiva pA~nchajanyo.api vAsudevasamIritaH |
sarvashabdAnatikramya pUrayAmAsa rodasI
shlokas.14:
tasmi.nstathA vartamAne dAruNe nAdasa~Nkule |
bhIrUNAM trAsajanane shUrANAM harShavardhane
shlokas.15:
pravAditAsu bherIShu jharjhareShvAnakeShu cha |
mRRida~NgeShu cha rAjendra vAdyamAneShvanekashaH
shlokas.16:
mahArathasamAkhyAtA duryodhanahitaiShiNaH |
amRRiShyamANAstaM shabdaM kruddhAH paramadhanvinaH
nAnAdeshyA mahIpAlAH svasainyaparirakShiNaH
shlokas.17:
amarShitA mahAsha~NkhAndadhmurvIrA mahArathAH |
kRRite pratikariShyantaH keshavasyArjunasya cha
shlokas.18:
babhUva tava tatsainyaM sha~NkhashabdasamIritam |
udvignarathanAgAshvamasvasthamiva chAbhibho
shlokas.19:
tatprayuktamivAkAshaM shUraiH sha~NkhaninAditam |
babhUva bhRRishamudvignaM nirghAtairiva nAditam
shlokas.20:
sa shabdaH sumahAnrAjandishaH sarvA vyanAdayat |
trAsayAmAsa tatsainyaM yugAnta iva sambhRRitaH
shlokas.21:
tato duryodhano.aShTau cha rAjAnaste mahArathAH |
jayadrathasya rakShArthaM pANDavaM paryavArayan
shlokas.22:
tato drauNistrisaptatyA vAsudevamatADayat |
arjunaM cha tribhirbhallairdhvajamashvA.nshcha pa~nchabhiH
shlokas.23:
tamarjunaH pRRiShatkAnAM shataiH ShaDbhiratADayat |
atyarthamiva sa~NkruddhaH pratividdhe janArdane
shlokas.24:
karNaM dvAdashabhirviddhvA vRRiShasenaM tribhistathA |
shalyasya sasharaM chApaM muShTau chichCheda vIryavAn
shlokas.25:
gRRihItvA dhanuranyattu shalyo vivyAdha pANDavam |
bhUrishravAstribhirbANairhemapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH
shlokas.26:
karNo dvAtri.nshatA chaiva vRRiShasenashcha pa~nchabhiH |
jayadrathastrisaptatyA kRRipashcha dashabhiH sharaiH
madrarAjashcha dashabhirvivyadhuH phalgunaM raNe
shlokas.27:
tataH sharANAM ShaShTyA tu drauNiH pArthamavAkirat |
vAsudevaM cha saptatyA punaH pArthaM cha pa~nchabhiH
shlokas.28:
prahasa.nstu naravyAghraH shvetAshvaH kRRiShNasArathiH |
pratyavidhyatsa tAnsarvAndarshayanpANilAghavam
shlokas.29:
karNaM dvAdashabhirviddhvA vRRiShasenaM tribhiH sharaiH |
shalyasya samare chApaM muShTideshe nyakRRintata
shlokas.30:
saumadattiM tribhirviddhvA shalyaM cha dashabhiH sharaiH |
shitairagnishikhAkArairdrauNiM vivyAdha chAShTabhiH
shlokas.31:
gautamaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA shaindhavaM cha shatena ha |
punardrauNiM cha saptatyA sharANAM so.abhyatADayat
shlokas.32:
bhUrishravAstu sa~NkruddhaH pratodaM chichChide hareH |
arjunaM cha trisaptatyA bANAnAmAjaghAna ha
shlokas.33:
tataH sharashataistIkShNaistAnarI~nshvetavAhanaH |
pratyaShedhaddrutaM kruddho mahAvAto ghanAniva

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
dhvajAnbahuvidhAkArAnbhrAjamAnAnatishriyA |
pArthAnAM mAmakAnAM cha tAnmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
dhvajAnbahuvidhAkArA~nshRRiNu teShAM mahAtmanAm |
rUpato varNatashchaiva nAmatashcha nibodha me
shlokas.3:
teShAM tu rathamuhyAnAM ratheShu vividhA dhvajAH |
pratyadRRishyanta rAjendra jvalitA iva pAvakAH
shlokas.4:
kA~nchanAH kA~nchanApIDAH kA~nchanasragala~NkRRitAH |
kA~nchanAnIva shRRi~NgANi kA~nchanasya mahAgireH
shlokas.5:
te dhvajAH sa.nvRRitAsteShAM patAkAbhiH samantataH |
nAnAvarNavirAgAbhirvibabhuH sarvato vRRitAH
shlokas.6:
patAkAshcha tatastAstu shvasanena samIritAH |
nRRityamAnAH vyadRRishyanta ra~Ngamadhye vilAsikAH
shlokas.7:
indrAyudhasavarNAbhAH patAkA bharatarShabha |
dodhUyamAnA rathinAM shobhayanti mahArathAn
shlokas.8:
siMhalA~NgUlamugrAsyaM dhajaM vAnaralakShaNam |
dhana~njayasya sa~NgrAme pratyapashyAma bhairavam
shlokas.9:
sa vAnaravaro rAjanpatAkAbhirala~NkRRitaH |
trAsayAmAsa tatsainyaM dhvajo gANDIvadhanvanaH
shlokas.10:
tathaiva siMhalA~NgUlaM droNaputrasya bhArata |
dhvajAgraM samapashyAma bAlasUryasamaprabham
shlokas.11:
kA~nchanaM pavanoddhUtaM shakradhvajasamaprabham |
nandanaM kauravendrANAM drauNerlakShaNamuchChritam
shlokas.12:
hastikakShyA punarhaimI babhUvAdhiratherdhvaje |
Ahave khaM mahArAja dadRRishe pUrayanniva
shlokas.13:
patAkI kA~nchanasragvI dhvajaH karNasya sa.nyuge |
nRRityatIva rathopasthe shvasanena samIritaH
shlokas.14:
AchAryasya cha pANDUnAM brAhmaNasya yashasvinaH |
govRRiSho gautamasyAsItkRRipasya supariShkRRitaH
shlokas.15:
sa tena bhrAjate rAjangovRRiSheNa mahArathaH |
tripuraghnaratho yadvadgovRRiSheNa virAjate
shlokas.16:
mayUro vRRiShasenasya kA~nchano maNiratnavAn |
vyAhariShyannivAtiShThatsenAgramapi shobhayan
shlokas.17:
tena tasya ratho bhAti mayUreNa mahAtmanaH |
yathA skandasya rAjendra mayUreNa virAjatA
shlokas.18:
madrarAjasya shalyasya dhvajAgre.agnishikhAmiva |
sauvarNIM pratipashyAma sItAmapratimAM shubhAm
shlokas.19:
sA sItA bhrAjate tasya rathamAsthAya mAriSha |
sarvabIjavirUDheva yathA sItA shriyA vRRitA
shlokas.20:
varAhaH sindhurAjasya rAjato.abhivirAjate |
dhvajAgre.alohitArkAbho hemajAlapariShkRRitaH
shlokas.21:
shushubhe ketunA tena rAjatena jayadrathaH |
yathA devAsure yuddhe purA pUShA sma shobhate
shlokas.22:
saumadatteH punaryUpo yaj~nashIlasya dhImataH |
dhvajaH sUrya ivAbhAti somashchAtra pradRRishyate
shlokas.23:
sa yUpaH kA~nchano rAjansaumadattervirAjate |
rAjasUye makhashreShThe yathA yUpaH samuchChritaH
shlokas.24:
shalasya tu mahArAja rAjato dvirado mahAn |
ketuH kA~nchanachitrA~NgairmayUrairupashobhitaH
shlokas.25:
sa ketuH shobhayAmAsa sainyaM te bharatarShabha |
yathA shveto mahAnAgo devarAjachamUM tathA
shlokas.26:
nAgo maNimayo rAj~no dhvajaH kanakasa.nvRRitaH |
ki~NkiNIshatasaMhrAdo bhrAja.nshchitre rathottame
shlokas.27:
vyabhrAjata bhRRishaM rAjanputrastava vishAM pate |
dhvajena mahatA sa~Nkhye kurUNAmRRiShabhastadA
shlokas.28:
navaite tava vAhinyAmuchChritAH paramadhvajAH |
vyadIpaya.nste pRRitanAM yugAntAdityasaMnibhAH
shlokas.29:
dashamastvarjunasyAsIdeka eva mahAkapiH |
adIpyatArjuno yena himavAniva vahninA
shlokas.30:
tatashchitrANi shubhrANi sumahAnti mahArathAH |
kArmukANyAdadustUrNamarjunArthe parantapAH
shlokas.31:
tathaiva dhanurAyachChatpArthaH shatruvinAshanaH |
gANDIvaM divyakarmA tadrAjandurmantrite tava
shlokas.32:
tavAparAdhAddhi narA nihatA bahudhA yudhi |
nAnAdigbhyaH samAhUtAH sahayAH sarathadvipAH
shlokas.33:
teShAmAsIdvyatikShepo garjatAmitaretaram |
duryodhanamukhAnAM cha pANDUnAmRRiShabhasya cha
shlokas.34:
tatrAdbhutaM paraM chakre kaunteyaH kRRiShNasArathiH |
yadeko bahubhiH sArdhaM samAgachChadabhItavat
shlokas.35:
ashobhata mahAbAhurgANDIvaM vikShipandhanuH |
jigIShustAnnaravyAghrA~njighA.nsushcha jayadratham
shlokas.36:
tatrArjuno mahArAja sharairmuktaiH sahasrashaH |
adRRishyAnakarodyodhA.nstAvakA~nshatrutApanaH
shlokas.37:
tataste.api naravyAghrAH pArthaM sarve mahArathAH |
adRRishyaM samare chakruH sAyakaughaiH samantataH
shlokas.38:
sa.nvRRite narasiMhaistaiH kurUNAmRRiShabhe.arjune |
mahAnAsItsamuddhUtastasya sainyasya nisvanaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
arjune saindhavaM prApte bhAradvAjena sa.nvRRitAH |
pA~nchAlAH kurubhiH sArdhaM kimakurvata sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
aparAhNe mahArAja sa~NgrAme lomaharShaNe |
pA~nchAlAnAM kurUNAM cha droNe dyUtamavartata
shlokas.3:
pA~nchAlA hi jighA.nsanto droNaM saMhRRiShTachetasaH |
abhyavarShanta garjantaH sharavarShANi mAriSha
shlokas.4:
tataH sutumulasteShAM sa~NgrAmo.avartatAdbhutaH |
pA~nchAlAnAM kurUNAM cha ghoro devAsuropamaH
shlokas.5:
sarve droNarathaM prApya pA~nchAlAH paNDavaiH saha |
tadanIkaM bibhitsanto mahAstrANi vyadarshayan
shlokas.6:
droNasya rathaparyantaM rathino rathamAsthitAH |
kampayanto.abhyavartanta vegamAsthAya madhyamam
shlokas.7:
tamabhyagAdbRRihatkShatraH kekayAnAM mahArathaH |
pravapannishitAnbANAnmahendrAshanisaMnibhAn
shlokas.8:
taM tu pratyudiyAchChIghraM kShemadhUrtirmahAyashAH |
vimu~nchannishitAnbANA~nshatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.9:
dhRRiShTaketushcha chedInAmRRiShabho.atibaloditaH |
tvarito.abhyadravaddroNaM mahendra iva shambaram
shlokas.10:
tamApatantaM sahasA vyAditAsyamivAntakam |
vIradhanvA maheShvAsastvaramANaH samabhyayAt
shlokas.11:
yudhiShThiraM mahArAja jigIShuM samavasthitam |
sahAnIkaM tato droNo nyavArayata vIryavAn
shlokas.12:
nakulaM kushalaM yuddhe parAkrAntaM parAkramI |
abhyagachChatsamAyAntaM vikarNaste sutaH prabho
shlokas.13:
sahadevaM tathAyAntaM durmukhaH shatrukarshanaH |
sharairanekasAhasraiH samavAkiradAshugaiH
shlokas.14:
sAtyakiM tu naravyAghraM vyAghradattastvavArayat |
sharaiH sunishitaistIkShNaiH kampayanvai muhurmuhuH
shlokas.15:
draupadeyAnnaravyAghrAnmu~nchataH sAyakottamAn |
sa.nrabdhAnrathinAM shreShThAnsaumadattiravArayat
shlokas.16:
bhImasenaM tathA kruddhaM bhImarUpo bhayAnakam |
pratyavArayadAyAntamArShyashRRi~NgirmahArathaH
shlokas.17:
tayoH samabhavadyuddhaM nararAkShasayormRRidhe |
yAdRRigeva purA vRRittaM rAmarAvaNayornRRipa
shlokas.18:
tato yudhiShThiro droNaM navatyA nataparvaNAm |
Ajaghne bharatashreShTha sarvamarmasu bhArata
shlokas.19:
taM droNaH pa~nchavi.nshatyA nijaghAna stanAntare |
roShito bharatashreShTha kaunteyena yashasvinA
shlokas.20:
bhUya eva tu vi.nshatyA sAyakAnAM samAchinot |
sAshvasUtadhvajaM droNaH pashyatAM sarvadhanvinAm
shlokas.21:
tA~nsharAndroNamuktA.nstu sharavarSheNa pANDavaH |
avArayata dharmAtmA darshayanpANilAghavam
shlokas.22:
tato droNo bhRRishaM kruddho dharmarAjasya sa.nyuge |
chichCheda sahasA dhanvI dhanustasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.23:
athainaM ChinnadhanvAnaM tvaramANo mahArathaH |
sharairanekasAhasraiH purayAmAsa sarvataH
shlokas.24:
adRRishyaM dRRishya rAjAnaM bhAradvAjasya sAyakaiH |
sarvabhUtAnyamanyanta hatameva yudhiShThiram
shlokas.25:
kechichchainamamanyanta tathA vai vimukhIkRRitam |
hRRito rAjeti rAjendra brAhmaNena yashasvinA
shlokas.26:
sa kRRichChraM paramaM prApto dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
tyaktvA tatkArmukaM ChinnaM bhAradvAjena sa.nyuge
Adade.anyaddhanurdivyaM bhAraghnaM vegavattaram
shlokas.27:
tatastAnsAyakAnsarvAndroNamuktAnsahasrashaH |
chichCheda samare vIrastadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.28:
ChittvA cha tA~nsharAnrAjA krodhasa.nraktalochanaH |
shaktiM jagrAha samare girINAmapi dAraNIm
svarNadaNDAM mahAghorAmaShTaghaNTAM bhayAvahAm
shlokas.29:
samutkShipya cha tAM hRRiShTo nanAda balavadbalI |
nAdena sarvabhUtAni trAsayanniva bhArata
shlokas.30:
shaktiM samudyatAM dRRiShTvA dharmarAjena sa.nyuge |
svasti droNAya sahasA sarvabhUtAnyathAbruvan
shlokas.31:
sA rAjabhujanirmuktA nirmuktoragasaMnibhA |
prajvAlayantI gaganaM dishashcha vidishastathA
droNAntikamanuprAptA dIptAsyA pannagI yathA
shlokas.32:
tAmApatantIM sahasA prekShya droNo vishAM pate |
prAdushchakre tato brAhmamastramastravidAM varaH
shlokas.33:
tadastraM bhasmasAtkRRitvA tAM shaktiM ghoradarshanAm |
jagAma syandanaM tUrNaM pANDavasya yashasvinaH
shlokas.34:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA droNAstraM tatsamudyatam |
ashAmayanmahAprAj~no brahmAstreNaiva bhArata
shlokas.35:
vivyAdha cha raNe droNaM pa~nchabhirnataparvabhiH |
kShurapreNa cha tIkShNena chichChedAsya mahaddhanuH
shlokas.36:
tadapAsya dhanushChinnaM droNaH kShatriyamardanaH |
gadAM chikShepa sahasA dharmaputrAya mAriSha
shlokas.37:
tAmApatantIM sahasA gadAM dRRiShTvA yudhiShThiraH |
gadAmevAgrahItkruddhashchikShepa cha parantapaH
shlokas.38:
te gade sahasA mukte samAsAdya parasparam |
sa~NgharShAtpAvakaM muktvA sameyAtAM mahItale
shlokas.39:
tato droNo bhRRishaM kruddho dharmarAjasya mAriSha |
chaturbhirnishitaistIkShNairhayA~njaghne sharottamaiH
shlokas.40:
dhanushchaikena bANena chichChedendradhvajopamam |
ketumekena chichCheda pANDavaM chArdayattribhiH
shlokas.41:
hatAshvAttu rathAttUrNamavaplutya yudhiShThiraH |
tasthAvUrdhvabhujo rAjA vyAyudho bharatarShabha
shlokas.42:
virathaM taM samAlokya vyAyudhaM cha visheShataH |
droNo vyamohayachChatrUnsarvasainyAni chAbhibho
shlokas.43:
mu~nchanniShugaNA.nstIkShNA.Nllaghuhasto dRRiDhavrataH |
abhidudrAva rAjAnaM siMho mRRigamivolbaNaH
shlokas.44:
tamabhidrutamAlokya droNenAmitraghAtinA |
hA heti sahasA shabdaH pANDUnAM samajAyata
shlokas.45:
hRRito rAjA hRRito rAjA bhAradvAjena mAriSha |
ityAsItsumahA~nshabdaH pANDusainyasya sarvataH
shlokas.46:
tatastvaritamAruhya sahadevarathaM nRRipaH |
apAyAjjavanairashvaiH kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
bRRihatkShatramathAyAntaM kekayaM dRRiDhavikramam |
kShemadhUrtirmahArAja vivyAdhorasi mArgaNaiH
shlokas.2:
bRRihatkShatrastu taM rAjA navatyA nataparvaNAm |
Ajaghne tvarito yuddhe droNAnIkabibhitsayA
shlokas.3:
kShemadhUrtistu sa~NkruddhaH kekayasya mahAtmanaH |
dhanushchichCheda bhallena pItena nishitena cha
shlokas.4:
athainaM ChinnadhanvAnaM shareNa nataparvaNA |
vivyAdha hRRidaye tUrNaM pravaraM sarvadhanvinAm
shlokas.5:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya bRRihatkShatro hasanniva |
vyashvasUtadhvajaM chakre kShemadhUrtiM mahAratham
shlokas.6:
tato.apareNa bhallena pItena nishitena cha |
jahAra nRRipateH kAyAchChiro jvalitakuNDalam
shlokas.7:
tachChinnaM sahasA tasya shiraH ku~nchitamUrdhajam |
sakirITaM mahIM prApya babhau jyotirivAmbarAt
shlokas.8:
taM nihatya raNe hRRiShTo bRRihatkShatro mahArathaH |
sahasAbhyapatatsainyaM tAvakaM pArthakAraNAt
shlokas.9:
dhRRiShTaketumathAyAntaM droNahetoH parAkramI |
vIradhanvA maheShvAso vArayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.10:
tau parasparamAsAdya sharadaMShTrau tarasvinau |
sharairanekasAhasrairanyonyamabhijaghnatuH
shlokas.11:
tAvubhau narashArdUlau yuyudhAte parasparam |
mahAvane tIvramadau vAraNAviva yUthapau
shlokas.12:
girigahvaramAsAdya shArdUlAviva roShitau |
yuyudhAte mahAvIryau parasparajighA.nsayA
shlokas.13:
tadyuddhamAsIttumulaM prekShaNIyaM vishAM pate |
siddhachAraNasa~NghAnAM vismayAdbhutadarshanam
shlokas.14:
vIradhanvA tataH kruddho dhRRiShTaketoH sharAsanam |
dvidhA chichCheda bhallena prahasanniva bhArata
shlokas.15:
tadutsRRijya dhanushChinnaM chedirAjo mahArathaH |
shaktiM jagrAha vipulAM rukmadaNDAmayasmayIm
shlokas.16:
tAM tu shaktiM mahAvIryAM dorbhyAmAyamya bhArata |
chikShepa sahasA yatto vIradhanvarathaM prati
shlokas.17:
sa tayA vIraghAtinyA shaktyA tvabhihato bhRRisham |
nirbhinnahRRidayastUrNaM nipapAta rathAnmahIm
shlokas.18:
tasminvinihate shUre trigartAnAM mahArathe |
balaM te.abhajyata vibho pANDaveyaiH samantataH
shlokas.19:
sahadeve tataH ShaShTiM sAyakAndurmukho.akShipat |
nanAda cha mahAnAdaM tarjayanpANDavaM raNe
shlokas.20:
madreyastu tataH kruddho durmukhaM dashabhiH sharaiH |
bhrAtA bhrAtaramAyAntaM vivyAdha prahasanniva
shlokas.21:
taM raNe rabhasaM dRRiShTvA sahadevaM mahAbalam |
durmukho navabhirbANaistADayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.22:
durmukhasya tu bhallena ChittvA ketuM mahAbalaH |
jaghAna chaturo vAhA.nshchaturbhirnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.23:
athApareNa bhallena pItena nishitena cha |
chichCheda sAratheH kAyAchChiro jvalitakuNDalam
shlokas.24:
kShurapreNa cha tIkShNena kauravyasya mahaddhanuH |
sahadevo raNe ChittvA taM cha vivyAdha pa~nchabhiH
shlokas.25:
hatAshvaM tu rathaM tyaktvA durmukho vimanAstadA |
Aruroha rathaM rAjanniramitrasya bhArata
shlokas.26:
sahadevastataH kruddho niramitraM mahAhave |
jaghAna pRRitanAmadhye bhallena paravIrahA
shlokas.27:
sa papAta rathopasthAnniramitro janeshvaraH |
trigartarAjasya suto vyathaya.nstava vAhinIm
shlokas.28:
taM tu hatvA mahAbAhuH sahadevo vyarochata |
yathA dAsharathI rAmaH kharaM hatvA mahAbalam
shlokas.29:
hAhAkAro mahAnAsIttrigartAnAM janeshvara |
rAjaputraM hataM dRRiShTvA niramitraM mahAbalam
shlokas.30:
nakulaste sutaM rAjanvikarNaM pRRithulochanam |
muhUrtAjjitavAnsa~Nkhye tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.31:
sAtyakiM vyAghradattastu sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
chakre.adRRishyaM sAshvasUtaM sadhvajaM pRRitanAntare
shlokas.32:
tAnnivArya sharA~nshUraH shaineyaH kRRitahastavat |
sAshvasUtadhvajaM bANairvyAghradattamapAtayat
shlokas.33:
kumAre nihate tasminmagadhasya sute prabho |
mAgadhAH sarvato yattA yuyudhAnamupAdravan
shlokas.34:
visRRijantaH sharA.nshchaiva tomarA.nshcha sahasrashaH |
bhiNDipAlA.nstathA prAsAnmudgarAnmusalAnapi
shlokas.35:
ayodhayanraNe shUrAH sAtvataM yuddhadurmadam |
tA.nstu sarvAnsa balavAnsAtyaktiryuddhadurmadaH
nAtikRRichChrAddhasanneva vijigye puruSharShabha
shlokas.36:
mAgadhAndravato dRRiShTvA hatasheShAnsamantataH |
balaM te.abhajyata vibho yuyudhAnasharArditam
shlokas.37:
nAshayitvA raNe sainyaM tvadIyaM mAdhavottamaH |
vidhunvAno dhanuHshreShThaM vyabhrAjata mahAyashAH
shlokas.38:
bhajyamAnaM balaM rAjansAtvatena mahAtmanA |
nAbhyavartata yuddhAya trAsitaM dIrghabAhunA
shlokas.39:
tato droNo bhRRishaM kruddhaH sahasodvRRitya chakShuShI |
sAtyakiM satyakarmANaM svayamevAbhidudruve

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
draupadeyAnmaheShvAsAnsaumadattirmahAyashAH |
ekaikaM pa~nchabhirviddhvA punarvivyAdha saptabhiH
shlokas.2:
te pIDitA bhRRishaM tena raudreNa sahasA vibho |
pramUDhA naiva vividurmRRidhe kRRityaM sma ki~nchana
shlokas.3:
nAkulistu shatAnIkaH saumadattiM nararShabham |
dvAbhyAM viddhvAnadaddhRRiShTaH sharAbhyAM shatrutApanaH
shlokas.4:
tathetare raNe yattAstribhistribhirajihmagaiH |
vivyadhuH samare tUrNaM saumadattimamarShaNam
shlokas.5:
sa tAnprati mahArAja chikShipe pa~ncha sAyakAn |
ekaikaM hRRidi chAjaghne ekaikena mahAyashAH
shlokas.6:
tataste bhrAtaraH pa~ncha sharairviddhA mahAtmanA |
parivArya rathairvIraM vivyadhuH sAyakairbhRRisham
shlokas.7:
Arjunistu hayA.nstasya chaturbhirnishitaiH sharaiH |
preShayAmAsa sa~Nkruddho yamasya sadanaM prati
shlokas.8:
bhaimasenirdhanushChittvA saumadattermahAtmanaH |
nanAda balavannAdaM vivyAdha cha shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.9:
yaudhiShThiro dhvajaM tasya ChittvA bhUmAvapAtayat |
nAkulishchAshvayantAraM rathanIDAdapAharat
shlokas.10:
sAhadevistu taM j~nAtvA bhrAtRRibhirvimukhIkRRitam |
kShurapreNa shiro rAjannichakarta mahAmanAH
shlokas.11:
tachChiro nyapatadbhUmau tapanIyavibhUShitam |
bhrAjayantaM raNoddeshaM bAlasUryasamaprabham
shlokas.12:
saumadatteH shiro dRRiShTvA nipatattanmahAtmanaH |
vitrastAstAvakA rAjanpradudruvuranekadhA
shlokas.13:
alambusastu samare bhImasenaM mahAbalam |
yodhayAmAsa sa~Nkruddho lakShmaNaM rAvaNiryathA
shlokas.14:
samprayuddhau raNe dRRiShTvA tAvubhau nararAkShasau |
vismayaH sarvabhUtAnAM praharShashchAbhavattadA
shlokas.15:
ArShyashRRi~NgiM tato bhImo navabhirnishitaiH sharaiH |
vivyAdha prahasanrAjanrAkShasendramamarShaNam
shlokas.16:
tadrakShaH samare viddhaM kRRitvA nAdaM bhayAvaham |
abhyadravattato bhImaM ye cha tasya padAnugAH
shlokas.17:
sa bhImaM pa~nchabhirviddhvA sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
bhImAnugA~njaghAnAshu rathA.nstri.nshadari.ndamaH
punashchatuHshatAnhatvA bhImaM vivyAdha patriNA
shlokas.18:
so.atividdhastadA bhImo rAkShasena mahAbalaH |
niShasAda rathopasthe mUrChayAbhipariplutaH
shlokas.19:
pratilabhya tataH sa~nj~nAM mArutiH krodhamUrChitaH |
vikRRiShya kArmukaM ghoraM bhArasAdhanamuttamam
alambusaM sharaistIkShNairardayAmAsa sarvataH
shlokas.20:
sa viddho bahubhirbANairnIlA~njanachayopamaH |
shushubhe sarvato rAjanpradIpta iva ki.nshukaH
shlokas.21:
sa vadhyamAnaH samare bhImachApachyutaiH sharaiH |
smaranbhrAtRRivadhaM chaiva pANDavena mahAtmanA
shlokas.22:
ghoraM rUpamatho kRRitvA bhImasenamabhAShata |
tiShThedAnIM raNe pArtha pashya me.adya parAkramam
shlokas.23:
bako nAma sudurbuddhe rAkShasapravaro balI |
parokShaM mama tadvRRittaM yadbhrAtA me hatastvayA
shlokas.24:
evamuktvA tato bhImamantardhAnagatastadA |
mahAtA sharavarSheNa bhRRishaM taM samavAkirat
shlokas.25:
bhImastu samare rAjannadRRishye rAkShase tadA |
AkAshaM pUrayAmAsa sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.26:
sa vadhyamAno bhImena nimeShAdrathamAsthitaH |
jagAma dharaNIM kShudraH khaM chaiva sahasAgamat
shlokas.27:
uchchAvachAni rUpANi chakAra subahUni cha |
uchchAvachAstathA vAcho vyAjahAra samantataH
shlokas.28:
tena pANDavasainyAnAM mRRiditA yudhi vAraNAH |
hayAshcha bahavo rAjanpattayashcha tathA punaH
rathebhyo rathinaH petustasya nunnAH sma sAyakaiH
shlokas.29:
shoNitodAM rathAvartAM hastigrAhasamAkulAm |
Chatraha.nsAM kardaminIM bAhupannagasa~NkulAm
shlokas.30:
nadIM pravartayAmAsa rakShogaNasamAkulAm |
vahantIM bahudhA rAja.nshchedipA~nchAlasRRi~njayAn
shlokas.31:
taM tathA samare rAjanvicharantamabhItavat |
pANDavA bhRRishasa.nvignAH prApashya.nstatsya vikramam
shlokas.32:
tAvakAnAM tu sainyAnAM praharShaH samajAyata |
vAditraninadashchograH sumahA.NllomaharShaNaH
shlokas.33:
taM shrutvA ninadaM ghoraM tava sainyasya pANDavaH |
nAmRRiShyata yathA nAgastalashabdaM samIritam
shlokas.34:
tataH krodhAbhitAmrAkSho nirdahanniva pAvakaH |
sa.ndadhe tvAShTramastraM sa svayaM tvaShTeva mAriSha
shlokas.35:
tataH sharasahasrANi prAdurAsansamantataH |
taiH sharaistava sainyasya vidrAvaH sumahAnabhUt
shlokas.36:
tadastraM preShitaM tena bhImasenena sa.nyuge |
rAkShasasya mahAmAyAM hatvA rAkShasamArdayat
shlokas.37:
sa vadhyamAno bahudhA bhImasenena rAkShasaH |
santyajya sa.nyuge bhImaM droNAnIkamupAdravat
shlokas.38:
tasmi.nstu nirjite rAjanrAkShasendre mahAtmanA |
anAdayansiMhanAdaiH pANDavAH sarvatodisham
shlokas.39:
apUjayanmArutiM cha saMhRRiShTAste mahAbalam |
prahrAdaM samare jitvA yathA shakraM marudgaNAH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
alambusaM tathA yuddhe vicharantamabhItavat |
haiDimbaH prayayau tUrNaM vivyAdha cha shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.2:
tayoH pratibhayaM yuddhamAsIdrAkShasasiMhayoH |
kurvatorvividhA mAyAH shakrashambarayoriva
shlokas.3:
alambuso bhRRishaM kruddho ghaTotkachamatADayat |
ghaTotkachastu vi.nshatyA nArAchAnAM stanAntare
alambusamatho viddhvA siMhavadvyanadanmuhuH
shlokas.4:
tathaivAlambuso rAjanhaiDimbaM yuddhadurmadam |
viddhvA viddhvAnadaddhRRiShTaH pUrayankhaM samantataH
shlokas.5:
tathA tau bhRRishasa~Nkruddhau rAkShasendrau mahAbalau |
nirvisheShamayudhyetAM mAyAbhiritaretaram
shlokas.6:
mAyAshatasRRijau dRRiptau mohayantau parasparam |
mAyAyuddhe sukushalau mAyAyuddhamayudhyatAm
shlokas.7:
yAM yAM ghaTotkacho yuddhe mAyAM darshayate nRRipa |
tAM tAmalambuso rAjanmAyayaiva nijaghnivAn
shlokas.8:
taM tathA yudhyamAnaM tu mAyAyuddhavishAradam |
alambusaM rAkShasendraM dRRiShTvAkrudhyanta pANDavAH
shlokas.9:
ta enaM bhRRishasa~NkruddhAH sarvataH pravarA rathaiH |
abhyadravanta sa~NkruddhA bhImasenAdayo nRRipa
shlokas.10:
ta enaM koShThakIkRRitya rathava.nshena mAriSha |
sarvato vyakiranbANairulkAbhiriva ku~njaram
shlokas.11:
sa teShAmastravegaM taM pratihatyAstramAyayA |
tasmAdrathavrajAnmukto vanadAhAdiva dvipaH
shlokas.12:
sa visphArya dhanurghoramindrAshanisamasvanam |
mArutiM pa~nchavi.nshatyA bhaimaseniM cha pa~nchabhiH
yudhiShThiraM tribhirviddhvA sahadevaM cha saptabhiH
shlokas.13:
nakulaM cha trisaptatyA drupadeyA.nshcha mAriSha |
pa~nchabhiH pa~nchabhirviddhvA ghoraM nAdaM nanAda ha
shlokas.14:
taM bhImaseno navabhiH sahadevashcha pa~nchabhiH |
yudhiShThiraH shatenaiva rAkShasaM pratyavidhyata
nakulashcha chatuHShaShTyA draupadeyAstribhistribhiH
shlokas.15:
haiDimbo rAkShasaM viddhvA yuddhe pa~nchAshatA sharaiH |
punarvivyAdha saptatyA nanAda cha mahAbalaH
shlokas.16:
so.atividdho maheShvAsaH sarvatastairmahArathaiH |
prativivyAdha tAnsarvAnpa~nchabhiH pa~nchabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.17:
taM kruddhaM rAkShasaM yuddhe pratikruddhastu rAkShasaH |
haiDimbo bharatashreShTha sharairvivyAdha saptabhiH
shlokas.18:
so.atividdho balavatA rAkShasendro mahAbalaH |
vyasRRijatsAyakA.nstUrNaM svarNapu~NkhA~nshilAshitAn
shlokas.19:
te sharA nataparvANo vivishU rAkShasaM tadA |
ruShitAH pannagA yadvadgirimugrA mahAbalAH
shlokas.20:
tataste pANDavA rAjansamantAnnishitA~nsharAn |
preShayAmAsurudvignA haiDimbashcha ghaTotkachaH
shlokas.21:
sa vadhyamAnaH samare pANDavairjitakAshibhiH |
dagdhAdrikUTashRRi~NgAbhaM bhinnA~njanachayopamam
shlokas.22:
samutkShipya cha bAhubhyAmAvidhya cha punaH punaH |
niShpipeSha kShitau kShipraM pUrNakumbhamivAshmani
shlokas.23:
balalAghavasampannaH sampanno vikrameNa cha |
bhaimasenI raNe kruddhaH sarvasainyAnyabhIShayat
shlokas.24:
sa visphuTitasarvA~NgashchUrNitAsthivibhUShaNaH |
ghaTotkachena vIreNa hataH sAlakaTa~NkaTaH
shlokas.25:
tataH sumanasaH pArthA hate tasminnishAchare |
chukrushuH siMhanAdA.nshcha vAsA.nsyAdudhuvushcha ha
shlokas.26:
tAvakAshcha hataM dRRiShTvA rAkShasendraM mahAbalam |
alambusaM bhImarUpaM vishIrNamiva parvatam
hAhAkAramakurvanta sainyAni bharatarShabha
shlokas.27:
janAshcha taddadRRishire rakShaH kautUhalAnvitAH |
yadRRichChayA nipatitaM bhUmAva~NgArakaM yathA
shlokas.28:
ghaTotkachastu taddhatvA rakSho balavatAM varam |
mumocha balavannAdaM balaM hatveva vAsavaH
shlokas.29:
sa pUjyamAnaH pitRRibhiH sabAndhavai;rghaTotkachaH karmaNi duShkare kRRite |
ripuM nihatyAbhinananda vai tadA; alambusaM pakvamalambusaM yathA
shlokas.30:
tato ninAdaH sumahAnsamutthitaH; sasha~NkhanAnAvidhabANaghoShavAn |
nishamya taM pratyanada.nstu kauravA;stato dhvanirbhuvanamathAspRRishadbhRRisham

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
bhAradvAjaM kathaM yuddhe yuyudhAno.abhyavArayat |
sa~njayAchakShva tattvena paraM kautUhalaM hi me
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjanmahAprAj~na sa~NgrAmaM lomaharShaNam |
droNasya pANDavaiH sArdhaM yuyudhAnapurogamaiH
shlokas.3:
vadhyamAnaM balaM dRRiShTvA yuyudhAnena mAriSha |
abhyadravatsvayaM droNaH sAtyakiM satyavikramam
shlokas.4:
tamApatantaM sahasA bhAradvAjaM mahAratham |
sAtyakiH pa~nchavi.nshatyA kShudrakANAM samArpayat
shlokas.5:
droNo.api yudhi vikrAnto yuyudhAnaM samAhitaH |
avidhyatpa~nchabhistUrNaM hemapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH
shlokas.6:
te varma bhittvA sudRRiDhaM dviShatpishitabhojanAH |
abhyagurdharaNIM rAja~nshvasanta iva pannagAH
shlokas.7:
dIrghabAhurabhikruddhastottrArdita iva dvipaH |
droNaM pa~nchAshatAvidhyannArAchairagnisaMnibhaiH
shlokas.8:
bhAradvAjo raNe viddho yuyudhAnena satvaram |
sAtyakiM bahubhirbANairyatamAnamavidhyata
shlokas.9:
tataH kruddho maheShvAso bhUya eva mahAbalaH |
sAtvataM pIDayAmAsa shatena nataparvaNA
shlokas.10:
sa vadhyamAnaH samare bhAradvAjena sAtyakiH |
nAbhyapadyata kartavyaM ki~nchideva vishAM pate
shlokas.11:
viShaNNavadanashchApi yuyudhAno.abhavannRRipa |
bhAradvAjaM raNe dRRiShTvA visRRijantaM shitA~nsharAn
shlokas.12:
taM tu samprekShya te putrAH sainikAshcha vishAM pate |
prahRRiShTamanaso bhUtvA siMhavadvyanadanmuhuH
shlokas.13:
taM shrutvA ninadaM ghoraM pIDyamAnaM cha mAdhavam |
yudhiShThiro.abravIdrAjansarvasainyAni bhArata
shlokas.14:
eSha vRRiShNivaro vIraH sAtyakiH satyakarmakRRit |
grasyate yudhi vIreNa bhAnumAniva rAhuNA
abhidravata gachChadhvaM sAtyakiryatra yudhyate
shlokas.15:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha pA~nchAlyamidamAha janAdhipa |
abhidrava drutaM droNaM kiM nu tiShThasi pArShata
na pashyasi bhayaM ghoraM droNAnnaH samupasthitam
shlokas.16:
asau droNo maheShvAso yuyudhAnena sa.nyuge |
krIDate sUtrabaddhena pakShiNA bAlako yathA
shlokas.17:
tatraiva sarve gachChantu bhImasenamukhA rathAH |
tvayaiva sahitA yattA yuyudhAnarathaM prati
shlokas.18:
pRRiShThato.anugamiShyAmi tvAmahaM sahasainikaH |
sAtyakiM mokShayasvAdya yamadaMShTrAntaraM gatam
shlokas.19:
evamuktvA tato rAjA sarvasainyena pANDavaH |
abhyadravadraNe droNaM yuyudhAnasya kAraNAt
shlokas.20:
tatrArAvo mahAnAsIddroNamekaM yuyutsatAm |
pANDavAnAM cha bhadraM te sRRi~njayAnAM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.21:
te sametya naravyAghrA bhAradvAjaM mahAratham |
abhyavarSha~nsharaistIkShNaiH ka~NkabarhiNavAjitaiH
shlokas.22:
smayanneva tu tAnvIrAndroNaH pratyagrahItsvayam |
atithInAgatAnyadvatsalilenAsanena cha
shlokas.23:
tarpitAste sharaistasya bhAradvAjasya dhanvinaH |
AtitheyagRRihaM prApya nRRipate.atithayo yathA
shlokas.24:
bhAradvAjaM cha te sarve na shekuH prativIkShitum |
madhya.ndinamanuprAptaM sahasrA.nshumiva prabho
shlokas.25:
tA.nstu sarvAnmaheShvAsAndroNaH shastrabhRRitAM varaH |
atApayachCharavrAtairgabhastibhirivA.nshumAn
shlokas.26:
vadhyamAnA raNe rAjanpANDavAH sRRi~njayAstathA |
trAtAraM nAdhyagachChanta pa~NkamagnA iva dvipAH
shlokas.27:
droNasya cha vyadRRishyanta visarpanto mahAsharAH |
ghabhastaya ivArkasya pratapantaH samantataH
shlokas.28:
tasmindroNena nihatAH pA~nchAlAH pa~nchavi.nshatiH |
mahArathasamAkhyAtA dhRRiShTadyumnasya saMmatAH
shlokas.29:
pANDUnAM sarvasainyeShu pA~nchAlAnAM tathaiva cha |
droNaM sma dadRRishuH shUraM vinighnantaM varAnvarAn
shlokas.30:
kekayAnAM shataM hatvA vidrAvya cha samantataH |
droNastasthau mahArAja vyAditAsya ivAntakaH
shlokas.31:
pA~nchAlAnsRRi~njayAnmatsyAnkekayAnpANDavAnapi |
droNo.ajayanmahAbAhuH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.32:
teShAM samabhavachChabdo vadhyatAM droNasAyakaiH |
vanaukasAmivAraNye dahyatAM dhUmaketunA
shlokas.33:
tatra devAH sagandharvAH pitarashchAbruvannRRipa |
ete dravanti pA~nchAlAH pANDavAshcha sasainikAH
shlokas.34:
taM tathA samare droNaM nighnantaM somakAnraNe |
na chApyabhiyayuH kechidapare naiva vivyadhuH
shlokas.35:
vartamAne tathA raudre tasminvIravarakShaye |
ashRRiNotsahasA pArthaH pA~nchajanyasya nisvanam
shlokas.36:
pUrito vAsudevena sha~NkharATsvanate bhRRisham |
yudhyamAneShu vIreShu saindhavasyAbhirakShiShu
nadatsu dhArtarAShTreShu vijayasya rathaM prati
shlokas.37:
gANDIvasya cha nirghoShe vipranaShTe samantataH |
kashmalAbhihato rAjA chintayAmAsa pANDavaH
shlokas.38:
na nUnaM svasti pArthasya yathA nadati sha~NkharAT |
kauravAshcha yathA hRRiShTA vinadanti muhurmuhuH
shlokas.39:
evaM sa~nchintayitvA tu vyAkulenAntarAtmanA |
ajAtashatruH kaunteyaH sAtvataM pratyabhAShata
shlokas.40:
bAShpagadgadayA vAchA muhyamAno muhurmuhuH |
kRRityasyAnantarApekShI shaineyaM shinipu~Ngavam
shlokas.41:
yaH sa dharmaH purA dRRiShTaH sadbhiH shaineya shAshvataH |
sAmparAye suhRRitkRRitye tasya kAlo.ayamAgataH
shlokas.42:
sarveShvapi cha yodheShu chintaya~nshinipu~Ngava |
tvattaH suhRRittamaM ka~nchinnAbhijAnAmi sAtyake
shlokas.43:
yo hi prItamanA nityaM yashcha nityamanuvrataH |
sa kArye sAmparAye tu niyojya iti me matiH
shlokas.44:
yathA cha keshavo nityaM pANDavAnAM parAyaNam |
tathA tvamapi vArShNeya kRRiShNatulyaparAkramaH
shlokas.45:
so.ahaM bhAraM samAdhAsye tvayi taM voDhumarhasi |
abhiprAyaM cha me nityaM na vRRithA kartumarhasi
shlokas.46:
sa tvaM bhrAturvayasyasya gurorapi cha sa.nyuge |
kuru kRRichChre sahAyArthamarjunasya nararShabha
shlokas.47:
tvaM hi satyavrataH shUro mitrANAmabhaya~NkaraH |
loke vikhyAyase vIra karmabhiH satyavAgiti
shlokas.48:
yo hi shaineya mitrArthe yudhyamAnastyajettanum |
pRRithivIM vA dvijAtibhyo yo dadyAtsamameva tat
shlokas.49:
shrutAshcha bahavo.asmAbhI rAjAno ye divaM gatAH |
dattvemAM pRRithivIM kRRitsnAM brAhmaNebhyo yathAvidhi
shlokas.50:
evaM tvAmapi dharmAtmanprayAche.ahaM kRRitA~njaliH |
pRRithivIdAnatulyaM syAdadhikaM vA phalaM vibho
shlokas.51:
eka eva sadA kRRiShNo mitrANAmabhaya~NkaraH |
raNe santyajati prANAndvitIyastvaM cha sAtyake
shlokas.52:
vikrAntasya cha vIrasya yuddhe prArthayato yashaH |
shUra eva sahAyaH syAnnetaraH prAkRRito janaH
shlokas.53:
IdRRishe tu parAmarde vartamAnasya mAdhava |
tvadanyo hi raNe goptA vijayasya na vidyate
shlokas.54:
shlAghanneva hi karmANi shatashastava pANDavaH |
mama sa~njanayanharShaM punaH punarakIrtayat
shlokas.55:
laghvastrashchitrayodhI cha tathA laghuparAkramaH |
prAj~naH sarvAstravichChUro muhyate na cha sa.nyuge
shlokas.56:
mahAskandho mahorasko mahAbAhurmahAdhanuH |
mahAbalo mahAvIryaH sa mahAtmA mahArathaH
shlokas.57:
shiShyo mama sakhA chaiva priyo.asyAhaM priyashcha me |
yuyudhAnaH sahAyo me pramathiShyati kauravAn
shlokas.58:
asmadarthaM cha rAjendra saMnahyedyadi keshavaH |
rAmo vApyaniruddho vA pradyumno vA mahArathaH
shlokas.59:
gado vA sAraNo vApi sAmbo vA saha vRRiShNibhiH |
sahAyArthaM mahArAja sa~NgrAmottamamUrdhani
shlokas.60:
tathApyahaM naravyAghraM shaineyaM satyavikramam |
sAhAyye viniyokShyAmi nAsti me.anyo hi tatsamaH
shlokas.61:
iti dvaitavane tAta mAmuvAcha dhana~njayaH |
parokShaM tvadguNA.nstathyAnkathayannAryasa.nsadi
shlokas.62:
tasya tvamevaM sa~NkalpaM na vRRithA kartumarhasi |
dhana~njayasya vArShNeya mama bhImasya chobhayoH
shlokas.63:
yachchApi tIrthAni charannagachChaM dvArakAM prati |
tatrAhamapi te bhaktimarjunaM prati dRRiShTavAn
shlokas.64:
na tatsauhRRidamanyeShu mayA shaineya lakShitam |
yathA tvamasmAnbhajase vartamAnAnupaplave
shlokas.65:
so.abhijAtyA cha bhaktyA cha sakhyasyAchAryakasya cha |
sauhRRidasya cha vIryasya kulInatvasya mAdhava
shlokas.66:
satyasya cha mahAbAho anukampArthameva cha |
anurUpaM maheShvAsa karma tvaM kartumarhasi
shlokas.67:
soyodhano hi sahasA gato droNena da.nshitaH |
pUrvameva tu yAtAste kauravANAM mahArathAH
shlokas.68:
sumahAnninadashchaiva shrUyate vijayaM prati |
sa shaineya javenAtra gantumarhasi mAdhava
shlokas.69:
bhImaseno vayaM chaiva sa.nyattAH sahasainikAH |
droNamAvArayiShyAmo yadi tvAM prati yAsyati
shlokas.70:
pashya shaineya sainyAni dravamANAni sa.nyuge |
mahAntaM cha raNe shabdaM dIryamANAM cha bhAratIm
shlokas.71:
mahAmArutavegena samudramiva parvasu |
dhArtarAShTrabalaM tAta vikShiptaM savyasAchinA
shlokas.72:
rathairviparidhAvadbhirmanuShyaishcha hayaishcha ha |
sainyaM rajaHsamuddhUtametatsamparivartate
shlokas.73:
sa.nvRRitaH sindhusauvIrairnakharaprAsayodhibhiH |
atyantApachitaiH shUraiH phalgunaH paravIrahA
shlokas.74:
naitadbalamasa.nvArya shakyo hantuM jayadrathaH |
ete hi saindhavasyArthe sarve santyaktajIvitAH
shlokas.76:
shRRiNu dundubhinirghoShaM sha~NkhashabdA.nshcha puShkalAn |
siMhanAdaravA.nshchaiva rathanemisvanA.nstathA
shlokas.77:
nAgAnAM shRRiNu shabdaM cha pattInAM cha sahasrashaH |
sAdinAM dravatAM chaiva shRRiNu kampayatAM mahIm
shlokas.78:
purastAtsaindhavAnIkaM droNAnIkasya pRRiShThataH |
bahutvAddhi naravyAghra devendramapi pIDayet
shlokas.79:
aparyante bale magno jahyAdapi cha jIvitam |
tasmi.nshcha nihate yuddhe kathaM jIveta mAdRRishaH
sarvathAhamanuprAptaH sukRRichChraM bata jIvitam
shlokas.80:
shyAmo yuvA guDAkesho darshanIyashcha pANDavaH |
laghvastrashchitrayodhI cha praviShTastAta bhAratIm
shlokas.81:
sUryodaye mahAbAhurdivasashchAtivartate |
tanna jAnAmi vArShNeya yadi jIvati vA na vA
kurUNAM chApi tatsainyaM sAgarapratimaM mahat
shlokas.82:
eka eva cha bIbhatsuH praviShTastAta bhAratIm |
aviShahyAM mahAbAhuH surairapi mahAmRRidhe
shlokas.83:
na cha me vartate buddhiradya yuddhe katha~nchana |
droNo.api rabhaso yuddhe mama pIDayate balam
pratyakShaM te mahAbAho yathAsau charati dvijaH
shlokas.84:
yugapachcha sametAnAM kAryANAM tvaM vichakShaNaH |
mahArthaM laghusa.nyuktaM kartumarhasi mAdhava
shlokas.85:
tasya me sarvakAryeShu kAryametanmataM sadA |
arjunasya paritrANaM kartavyamiti sa.nyuge
shlokas.86:
nAhaM shochAmi dAshArhaM goptAraM jagataH prabhum |
sa hi shakto raNe tAta trI.NllokAnapi sa~NgatAn
shlokas.87:
vijetuM puruShavyAghra satyametadbravImi te |
kiM punardhArtarAShTrasya balametatsudurbalam
shlokas.88:
arjunastveva vArShNeya pIDito bahubhiryudhi |
prajahyAtsamare prANA.nstasmAdvindAmi kashmalam
shlokas.89:
tasya tvaM padavIM gachCha gachCheyustvAdRRishA yathA |
tAdRRishasyedRRishe kAle mAdRRishenAbhichoditaH
shlokas.90:
raNe vRRiShNipravIrANAM dvAvevAtirathau smRRitau |
pradyumnashcha mahAbAhustvaM cha sAtvata vishrutaH
shlokas.91:
astre nArAyaNasamaH sa~NkarShaNasamo bale |
vIratAyAM naravyAghra dhana~njayasamo hyasi
shlokas.92:
bhIShmadroNAvatikramya sarvayuddhavishAradam |
tvAmadya puruShavyAghraM loke santaH prachakShate
shlokas.93:
nAsAdhyaM vidyate loke sAtyakeriti mAdhava |
tattvAM yadabhivakShyAmi tatkuruShva mahAbala
shlokas.94:
sambhAvanA hi lokasya tava pArthasya chobhayoH |
nAnyathA tAM mahAbAho samprakartumihArhasi
shlokas.95:
parityajya priyAnprANAnraNe vichara vIravat |
na hi shaineya dAshArhA raNe rakShanti jIvitam
shlokas.96:
ayuddhamanavasthAnaM sa~NgrAme cha palAyanam |
bhIrUNAmasatAM mArgo naiSha dAshArhasevitaH
shlokas.97:
tavArjuno gurustAta dharmAtmA shinipu~Ngava |
vAsudevo gurushchApi tava pArthasya dhImataH
shlokas.98:
kAraNadvayametaddhi jAnAnastvAhamabruvam |
mAvama.nsthA vacho mahyaM gurustava gurorhyaham
shlokas.99:
vAsudevamataM chaitanmama chaivArjunasya cha |
satyametanmayoktaM te yAhi yatra dhana~njayaH
shlokas.100:
etadvachanamAj~nAya mama satyaparAkrama |
pravishaitadbalaM tAta dhArtarAShTrasya durmateH
shlokas.101:
pravishya cha yathAnyAyaM sa~Ngamya cha mahArathaiH |
yathArhamAtmanaH karma raNe sAtvata darshaya

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
prItiyuktaM cha hRRidyaM cha madhurAkSharameva cha |
kAlayuktaM cha chitraM cha svatayA chAbhibhAShitam
shlokas.2:
dharmarAjasya tadvAkyaM nishamya shinipu~NgavaH |
sAtyakirbharatashreShTha pratyuvAcha yudhiShThiram
shlokas.3:
shrutaM te gadato vAkyaM sarvametanmayAchyuta |
nyAyayuktaM cha chitraM cha phalgunArthe yashaskaram
shlokas.4:
eva.nvidhe tathA kAle madRRishaM prekShya saMmatam |
vaktumarhasi rAjendra yathA pArthaM tathaiva mAm
shlokas.5:
na me dhana~njayasyArthe prANA rakShyAH katha~nchana |
tvatprayuktaH punarahaM kiM na kuryAM mahAhave
shlokas.6:
lokatrayaM yodhayeyaM sadevAsuramAnuSham |
tvatprayukto narendreha kimutaitatsudurbalam
shlokas.7:
suyodhanabalaM tvadya yodhayiShye samantataH |
vijeShye cha raNe rAjansatyametadbravImi te
shlokas.8:
kushalyahaM kushalinaM samAsAdya dhana~njayam |
hate jayadrathe rAjanpunareShyAmi te.antikam
shlokas.9:
avashyaM tu mayA sarvaM vij~nApyastvaM narAdhipa |
vAsudevasya yadvAkyaM phalgunasya cha dhImataH
shlokas.10:
dRRiDhaM tvabhiparIto.ahamarjunena punaH punaH |
madhye sarvasya sainyasya vAsudevasya shRRiNvataH
shlokas.11:
adya mAdhava rAjAnamapramatto.anupAlaya |
AryAM yuddhe matiM kRRitvA yAvaddhanmi jayadratham
shlokas.12:
tvayi vAhaM mahAbAho pradyumne vA mahArathe |
nRRipaM nikShipya gachCheyaM nirapekSho jayadratham
shlokas.13:
jAnIShe hi raNe droNaM rabhasaM shreShThasaMmatam |
pratij~nA chApi te nityaM shrutA droNasya mAdhava
shlokas.14:
grahaNaM dharmarAjasya bhAradvAjo.anugRRidhyati |
shaktashchApi raNe droNo nigRRihItuM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.15:
evaM tvayi samAdhAya dharmarAjaM narottamam |
ahamadya gamiShyAmi saindhavasya vadhAya hi
shlokas.16:
jayadrathamahaM hatvA dhruvameShyAmi mAdhava |
dharmarAjaM yathA droNo nigRRihNIyAdraNe balAt
shlokas.17:
nigRRihIte narashreShThe bhAradvAjena mAdhava |
saindhavasya vadho na syAnmamAprItistathA bhavet
shlokas.18:
evaM gate narashreShTha pANDave satyavAdini |
asmAkaM gamanaM vyaktaM vanaM prati bhavetpunaH
shlokas.19:
so.ayaM mama jayo vyaktaM vyartha eva bhaviShyati |
yadi droNo raNe kruddho nigRRihNIyAdyudhiShThiram
shlokas.20:
sa tvamadya mahAbAho priyArthaM mama mAdhava |
jayArthaM cha yashorthaM cha rakSha rAjAnamAhave
shlokas.21:
sa bhavAnmayi nikShepo nikShiptaH savyasAchinA |
bhAradvAjAdbhayaM nityaM pashyamAnena te prabho
shlokas.22:
tasyApi cha mahAbAho nityaM pashyati sa.nyuge |
nAnyaM hi pratiyoddhAraM raukmiNeyAdRRite prabho
mAM vApi manyate yuddhe bhAradvAjasya dhImataH
shlokas.23:
so.ahaM sambhAvanAM chaitAmAchAryavachanaM cha tat |
pRRiShThato notsahe kartuM tvAM vA tyaktuM mahIpate
shlokas.24:
AchAryo laghuhastatvAdabhedyakavachAvRRitaH |
upalabhya raNe krIDedyathA shakuninA shishuH
shlokas.25:
yadi kArShNirdhanuShpANiriha syAnmakaradhvajaH |
tasmai tvAM visRRijeyaM vai sa tvAM rakShedyathArjunaH
shlokas.26:
kuru tvamAtmano guptiM kaste goptA gate mayi |
yaH pratIyAdraNe droNaM yAvadgachChAmi pANDavam
shlokas.27:
mA cha te bhayamadyAstu rAjannarjunasambhavam |
na sa jAtu mahAbAhurbhAramudyamya sIdati
shlokas.28:
ye cha sauvIrakA yodhAstathA saindhavapauravAH |
udIchyA dAkShiNAtyAshcha ye chAnye.api mahArathAH
shlokas.29:
ye cha karNamukhA rAjanrathodArAH prakIrtitAH |
ete.arjunasya kruddhasya kalAM nArhanti ShoDashIm
shlokas.30:
udyuktA pRRithivI sarvA sasurAsuramAnuShA |
sarAkShasagaNA rAjansakiMnaramahoragA
shlokas.31:
ja~NgamAH sthAvaraiH sArdhaM nAlaM pArthasya sa.nyuge |
evaM j~nAtvA mahArAja vyetu te bhIrdhana~njaye
shlokas.32:
yatra vIrau maheShvAsau kRRiShNau satyaparAkramau |
na tatra karmaNo vyApatkatha~nchidapi vidyate
shlokas.33:
daivaM kRRitAstratAM yogamamarShamapi chAhave |
kRRitaj~natAM dayAM chaiva bhrAtustvamanuchintaya
shlokas.34:
mayi chApyapayAte vai gachChamAne.arjunaM prati |
droNe chitrAstratAM sa~Nkhye rAja.nstvamanuchintaya
shlokas.35:
AchAryo hi bhRRishaM rAjannigrahe tava gRRidhyati |
pratij~nAmAtmano rakShansatyAM kartuM cha bhArata
shlokas.36:
kuruShvAdyAtmano guptiM kaste goptA gate mayi |
yasyAhaM pratyayAtpArtha gachCheyaM phalgunaM prati
shlokas.37:
na hyahaM tvA mahArAja anikShipya mahAhave |
kvachidyAsyAmi kauravya satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.38:
etadvichArya bahusho buddhyA buddhimatAM vara |
dRRiShTvA shreyaH paraM buddhyA tato rAjanprashAdhi mAm
shlokas.39:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
evametanmahAbAho yathA vadasi mAdhava |
na tu me shudhyate bhAvaH shvetAshvaM prati mAriSha
shlokas.40:
kariShye paramaM yatnamAtmano rakShaNaM prati |
gachCha tvaM samanuj~nAto yatra yAto dhana~njayaH
shlokas.41:
Atmasa.nrakShaNaM sa~Nkhye gamanaM chArjunaM prati |
vichAryaitaddvayaM buddhyA gamanaM tatra rochaye
shlokas.42:
sa tvamAtiShTha yAnAya yatra yAto dhana~njayaH |
mamApi rakShaNaM bhImaH kariShyati mahAbalaH
shlokas.43:
pArShatashcha sasodaryaH pArthivAshcha mahAbalAH |
draupadeyAshcha mAM tAta rakShiShyanti na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.44:
kekayA bhrAtaraH pa~ncha rAkShasashcha ghaTotkachaH |
virATo drupadashchaiva shikhaNDI cha mahArathaH
shlokas.45:
dhRRiShTaketushcha balavAnkuntibhojashcha mAriSha |
nakulaH sahadevashcha pA~nchAlAH sRRi~njayAstathA
ete samAhitAstAta rakShiShyanti na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.46:
na droNaH saha sainyena kRRitavarmA cha sa.nyuge |
samAsAdayituM shakto na cha mAM dharShayiShyati
shlokas.47:
dhRRiShTadyumnashcha samare droNaM kruddhaM parantapaH |
vArayiShyati vikramya veleva makarAlayam
shlokas.48:
