yatra sthAsyati sa~NgrAme pArShataH paravIrahA |
na droNasainyaM balavatkrAmettatra katha~nchana
shlokas.49:
eSha droNavinAshAya samutpanno hutAshanAt |
kavachI sa sharI khaDgI dhanvI cha varabhUShaNaH
shlokas.50:
vishrabdho gachCha shaineya mA kArShIrmayi sambhramam |
dhRRiShTadyumno raNe kruddho droNamAvArayiShyati

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
dharmarAjasya tadvAkyaM nishamya shinipu~NgavaH |
pArthAchcha bhayamAsha~NkanparityAgAnmahIpateH
shlokas.2:
apavAdaM hyAtmanashcha lokAdrakShanvisheShataH |
na mAM bhIta iti brUyurAyAntaM phalgunaM prati
shlokas.3:
nishchitya bahudhaivaM sa sAtyakiryuddhadurmadaH |
dharmarAjamidaM vAkyamabravItpuruSharShabha
shlokas.4:
kRRitAM chenmanyase rakShAM svasti te.astu vishAM pate |
anuyAsyAmi bIbhatsuM kariShye vachanaM tava
shlokas.5:
na hi me pANDavAtkashchittriShu lokeShu vidyate |
yo vai priyataro rAjansatyametadbravImi te
shlokas.6:
tasyAhaM padavIM yAsye sa.ndeshAttava mAnada |
tvatkRRite na cha me ki~nchidakartavyaM katha~nchana
shlokas.7:
yathA hi me gurorvAkyaM vishiShTaM dvipadAM vara |
tathA tavApi vachanaM vishiShTatarameva me
shlokas.8:
priye hi tava vartete bhrAtarau kRRiShNapANDavau |
tayoH priye sthitaM chaiva viddhi mAM rAjapu~Ngava
shlokas.9:
tavAj~nAM shirasA gRRihya pANDavArthamahaM prabho |
bhittvedaM durbhidaM sainyaM prayAsye narasattama
shlokas.10:
droNAnIkaM vishAmyeSha kruddho jhaSha ivArNavam |
tatra yAsyAmi yatrAsau rAjanrAjA jayadrathaH
shlokas.11:
yatra senAM samAshritya bhItastiShThati pANDavAt |
gupto rathavarashreShThairdrauNikarNakRRipAdibhiH
shlokas.12:
itastriyojanaM manye tamadhvAnaM vishAM pate |
yatra tiShThati pArtho.asau jayadrathavadhodyataH
shlokas.13:
triyojanagatasyApi tasya yAsyAmyahaM padam |
AsaindhavavadhAdrAjansudRRiDhenAntarAtmanA
shlokas.14:
anAdiShTastu guruNA ko nu yudhyeta mAnavaH |
AdiShTastu tvayA rAjanko na yudhyeta mAdRRishaH
abhijAnAmi taM deshaM yatra yAsyAmyahaM prabho
shlokas.15:
huDashaktigadAprAsakhaDgacharmarShTitomaram |
iShvastravarasambAdhaM kShobhayiShye balArNavam
shlokas.16:
yadetatku~njarAnIkaM sAhasramanupashyasi |
kulama~njanakaM nAma yatraite vIryashAlinaH
shlokas.17:
AsthitA bahubhirmlechChairyuddhashauNDaiH prahAribhiH |
nAgA meghanibhA rAjankSharanta iva toyadAH
shlokas.18:
naite jAtu nivarteranpreShitA hastisAdibhiH |
anyatra hi vadhAdeShAM nAsti rAjanparAjayaH
shlokas.19:
atha yAnrathino rAjansamantAdanupashyasi |
ete rukmarathA nAma rAjaputrA mahArathAH
shlokas.20:
ratheShvastreShu nipuNA nAgeShu cha vishAM pate |
dhanurvede gatAH pAraM muShTiyuddhe cha kovidAH
shlokas.21:
gadAyuddhavisheShaj~nA niyuddhakushalAstathA |
khaDgapraharaNe yuktAH sampAte chAsicharmaNoH
shlokas.22:
shUrAshcha kRRitavidyAshcha spardhante cha parasparam |
nityaM cha samare rAjanvijigIShanti mAnavAn
shlokas.23:
karNena vijitA rAjanduHshAsanamanuvratAH |
etA.nstu vAsudevo.api rathodArAnprasha.nsati
shlokas.24:
satataM priyakAmAshcha karNasyaite vashe sthitAH |
tasyaiva vachanAdrAjannivRRittAH shvetavAhanAt
shlokas.25:
te na kShatA na cha shrAntA dRRiDhAvaraNakArmukAH |
madarthaM viShThitA nUnaM dhArtarAShTrasya shAsanAt
shlokas.26:
etAnpramathya sa~NgrAme priyArthaM tava kaurava |
prayAsyAmi tataH pashchAtpadavIM savyasAchinaH
shlokas.27:
yA.nstvetAnaparAnrAjannAgAnsaptashatAni cha |
prekShase varmasa~nChannAnkirAtaiH samadhiShThitAn
shlokas.28:
kirAtarAjo yAnprAdAdgRRihItaH savyasAchinA |
svala~NkRRitA.nstathA preShyAnichCha~njIvitamAtmanaH
shlokas.29:
Asannete purA rAja.nstava karmakarA dRRiDham |
tvAmevAdya yuyutsante pashya kAlasya paryayam
shlokas.30:
teShAmete mahAmAtrAH kirAtA yuddhadurmadAH |
hastishikShAvidashchaiva sarve chaivAgniyonayaH
shlokas.31:
ete vinirjitAH sarve sa~NgrAme savyasAchinA |
madarthamadya sa.nyattA duryodhanavashAnugAH
shlokas.32:
etAnbhittvA sharai rAjankirAtAnyuddhadurmadAn |
saindhavasya vadhe yuktamanuyAsyAmi pANDavam
shlokas.33:
ye tvete sumahAnAgA a~njanasya kulodbhavAH |
karkashAshcha vinItAshcha prabhinnakaraTAmukhAH
shlokas.34:
jAmbUnadamayaiH sarvairvarmabhiH suvibhUShitAH |
labdhalakShyA raNe rAjannairAvaNasamA yudhi
shlokas.35:
uttarAtparvatAdete tIkShNairdasyubhirAsthitAH |
karkashaiH pravarairyodhaiH kArShNAyasatanuchChadaiH
shlokas.36:
santi goyonayashchAtra santi vAnarayonayaH |
anekayonayashchAnye tathA mAnuShayonayaH
shlokas.37:
anIkamasatAmetaddhUmavarNamudIryate |
mlechChAnAM pApakartR^INAM himavaddurgavAsinAm
shlokas.38:
etadduryodhano labdhvA samagraM nAgamaNDalam |
kRRipaM cha saumadattiM cha droNaM cha rathinAM varam
shlokas.39:
sindhurAjaM tathA karNamavamanyata pANDavAn |
kRRitArthamatha chAtmAnaM manyate kAlachoditaH
shlokas.40:
te cha sarve.anusamprAptA mama nArAchagocharam |
na vimokShyanti kaunteya yadyapi syurmanojavAH
shlokas.41:
tena sambhAvitA nityaM paravIryopajIvinA |
vinAshamupayAsyanti machCharaughanipIDitAH
shlokas.42:
ye tvete rathino rAjandRRishyante kA~nchanadhvajAH |
ete durvAraNA nAma kAmbojA yadi te shrutAH
shlokas.43:
shUrAshcha kRRitavidyAshcha dhanurvede cha niShThitAH |
saMhatAshcha bhRRishaM hyete anyonyasya hitaiShiNaH
shlokas.44:
akShauhiNyashcha sa.nrabdhA dhArtarAShTrasya bhArata |
yattA madarthaM tiShThanti kuruvIrAbhirakShitAH
shlokas.45:
apramattA mahArAja mAmeva pratyupasthitAH |
tA.nstvahaM pramathiShyAmi tRRiNAnIva hutAshanaH
shlokas.46:
tasmAtsarvAnupAsa~NgAnsarvopakaraNAni cha |
rathe kurvantu me rAjanyathAvadrathakalpakAH
shlokas.47:
asmi.nstu khalu sa~NgrAme grAhyaM vividhamAyudham |
yathopadiShTamAchAryaiH kAryaH pa~nchaguNo rathaH
shlokas.48:
kAmbojairhi sameShyAmi kruddhairAshIviShopamaiH |
nAnAshastrasamAvApairvividhAyudhayodhibhiH
shlokas.49:
kirAtaishcha sameShyAmi viShakalpaiH prahAribhiH |
lAlitaiH satataM rAj~nA duryodhanahitaiShibhiH
shlokas.50:
shakaishchApi sameShyAmi shakratulyaparAkramaiH |
agnikalpairdurAdharShaiH pradIptairiva pAvakaiH
shlokas.51:
tathAnyairvividhairyodhaiH kAlakalpairdurAsadaiH |
sameShyAmi raNe rAjanbahubhiryuddhadurmadaiH
shlokas.52:
tasmAdvai vAjino mukhyA vishrAntAH shubhalakShaNAH |
upAvRRittAshcha pItAshcha punaryujyantu me rathe
shlokas.53:
tasya sarvAnupAsa~NgAnsarvopakaraNAni cha |
rathe prAsthApayadrAjA shastrANi vividhAni cha
shlokas.54:
tatastAnsarvato muktvA sadashvA.nshchaturo janAH |
rasavatpAyayAmAsuH pAnaM madasamIriNam
shlokas.55:
pItopavRRittAnsnAtA.nshcha jagdhAnnAnsamala~NkRRitAn |
vinItashalyA.nsturagA.nshchaturo hemamAlinaH
shlokas.56:
tAnyattAnrukmavarNAbhAnvinItA~nshIghragAminaH |
saMhRRiShTamanaso.avyagrAnvidhivatkalpite rathe
shlokas.57:
mahAdhvajena siMhena hemakesaramAlinA |
sa.nvRRite ketanairhemairmaNividrumachitritaiH
pANDurAbhraprakAshAbhiH patAkAbhirala~NkRRite
shlokas.58:
hemadaNDochChritachChatre bahushastraparichChade |
yojayAmAsa vidhivaddhemabhANDavibhUShitAn
shlokas.59:
dArukasyAnujo bhrAtA sUtastasya priyaH sakhA |
nyavedayadrathaM yuktaM vAsavasyeva mAtaliH
shlokas.60:
tataH snAtaH shuchirbhUtvA kRRitakautukama~NgalaH |
snAtakAnAM sahasrasya svarNaniShkAnadApayat
AshIrvAdaiH pariShvaktaH sAtyakiH shrImatAM varaH
shlokas.61:
tataH sa madhuparkArhaH pItvA kailAvataM madhu |
lohitAkSho babhau tatra madavihvalalochanaH
shlokas.62:
Alabhya vIrakA.nsyaM cha harSheNa mahatAnvitaH |
dviguNIkRRitatejA hi prajvalanniva pAvakaH
utsa~Nge dhanurAdAya sasharaM rathinAM varaH
shlokas.63:
kRRitasvastyayano vipraiH kavachI samala~NkRRitaH |
lAjairgandhaistathA mAlyaiH kanyAbhishchAbhinanditaH
shlokas.64:
yudhiShThirasya charaNAvabhivAdya kRRitA~njaliH |
tena mUrdhanyupAghrAta Aruroha mahAratham
shlokas.65:
tataste vAjino hRRiShTAH supuShTA vAtaraMhasaH |
ajayyA jaitramUhustaM vikurvantaH sma saindhavAH
shlokas.66:
atha harShaparItA~NgaH sAtyakirbhImamabravIt |
tvaM bhIma rakSha rAjAnametatkAryatamaM hi te
shlokas.67:
ahaM bhittvA pravekShyAmi kAlapakvamidaM balam |
AyatyAM cha tadAtve cha shreyo rAj~no.abhirakShaNam
shlokas.68:
jAnIShe mama vIryaM tvaM tava chAhamari.ndama |
tasmAdbhIma nivartasva mama chedichChasi priyam
shlokas.69:
tathoktaH sAtyakiM prAha vraja tvaM kAryasiddhaye |
ahaM rAj~naH kariShyAmi rakShAM puruShasattama
shlokas.70:
evamuktaH pratyuvAcha bhImasenaM sa mAdhavaH |
gachCha gachCha drutaM pArtha dhruvo.adya vijayo mama
shlokas.71:
yanme snigdho.anuraktashcha tvamadya vashagaH sthitaH |
nimittAni cha dhanyAni yathA bhIma vadanti me
shlokas.72:
nihate saindhave pApe pANDavena mahAtmanA |
pariShvajiShye rAjAnaM dharmAtmAnaM na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.73:
etAvaduktvA bhImaM tu visRRijya cha mahAmanAH |
sampraikShattAvakaM sainyaM vyAghro mRRigagaNAniva
shlokas.74:
taM dRRiShTvA pravivikShantaM sainyaM tava janAdhipa |
bhUya evAbhavanmUDhaM subhRRishaM chApyakampata
shlokas.75:
tataH prayAtaH sahasA sainyaM tava sa sAtyakiH |
didRRikShurarjunaM rAjandharmarAjasya shAsanAt

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
prayAte tava sainyaM tu yuyudhAne yuyutsayA |
dharmarAjo mahArAja svenAnIkena sa.nvRRitaH
prAyAddroNarathaprepsuryuyudhAnasya pRRiShThataH
shlokas.2:
tataH pA~nchAlarAjasya putraH samaradurmadaH |
prAkroshatpANDavAnIke vasudAnashcha pArthivaH
shlokas.3:
AgachChata praharata drutaM viparidhAvata |
yathA sukhena gachCheta sAtyakiryuddhadurmadaH
shlokas.4:
mahArathA hi bahavo yatiShyantyasya nirjaye |
iti bruvanto vegena samApeturbalaM tava
shlokas.5:
vayaM pratijigIShantastatra tAnsamabhidrutAH |
tataH shabdo mahAnAsIdyuyudhAnarathaM prati
shlokas.6:
prakampyamAnA mahatI tava putrasya vAhinI |
sAtvatena mahArAja shatadhAbhivyadIryata
shlokas.7:
tasyAM vidIryamANAyAM shineH pautro mahArathaH |
sapta vIrAnmaheShvAsAnagrAnIke vyapothayat
shlokas.8:
te bhItA mRRidyamAnAshcha pramRRiShTA dIrghabAhunA |
AyodhanaM jahurvIrA dRRiShTvA tamatimAnuSham
shlokas.9:
rathairvimathitAkShaishcha bhagnanIDaishcha mAriSha |
chakrairvimathitaishChinnairdhvajaishcha vinipAtitaiH
shlokas.10:
anukarShaiH patAkAbhiH shirastrANaiH sakA~nchanaiH |
bAhubhishchandanAdigdhaiH sA~Ngadaishcha vishAM pate
shlokas.11:
hastihastopamaishchApi bhujagAbhogasaMnibhaiH |
UrubhiH pRRithivI ChannA manujAnAM narottama
shlokas.12:
shashA~NkasaMnikAshaishcha vadanaishchArukuNDalaiH |
patitairvRRiShabhAkShANAM babhau bhArata medinI
shlokas.13:
gajaishcha bahudhA ChinnaiH shayAnaiH parvatopamaiH |
rarAjAtibhRRishaM bhUmirvikIrNairiva parvataiH
shlokas.14:
tapanIyamayairyoktrairmuktAjAlavibhUShitaiH |
urashChadairvichitraishcha vyashobhanta tura~NgamAH
gatasattvA mahIM prApya pramRRiShTA dIrghabAhunA
shlokas.15:
nAnAvidhAni sainyAni tava hatvA tu sAtvataH |
praviShTastAvakaM sainyaM drAvayitvA chamUM bhRRisham
shlokas.16:
tatastenaiva mArgeNa yena yAto dhana~njayaH |
iyeSha sAtyakirgantuM tato droNena vAritaH
shlokas.17:
bharadvAjaM samAsAdya yuyudhAnastu mAriSha |
nAbhyavartata sa~Nkruddho velAmiva jalAshayaH
shlokas.18:
nivArya tu raNe droNo yuyudhAnaM mahAratham |
vivyAdha nishitairbANaiH pa~nchabhirmarmabhedibhiH
shlokas.19:
sAtyakistu raNe droNaM rAjanvivyAdha saptabhiH |
hemapu~NkhaiH shilAdhautaiH ka~NkabarhiNavAjitaiH
shlokas.20:
taM ShaDbhiH sAyakairdroNaH sAshvayantAramArdayat |
sa taM na mamRRiShe droNaM yuyudhAno mahArathaH
shlokas.21:
siMhanAdaM tataH kRRitvA droNaM vivyAdha sAtyakiH |
dashabhiH sAyakaishchAnyaiH ShaDbhiraShTAbhireva cha
shlokas.22:
yuyudhAnaH punardroNaM vivyAdha dashabhiH sharaiH |
ekena sArathiM chAsya chaturbhishchaturo hayAn
dhvajamekena bANena vivyAdha yudhi mAriSha
shlokas.23:
taM droNaH sAshvayantAraM sarathadhvajamAshugaiH |
tvaranprAchChAdayadbANaiH shalabhAnAmiva vrajaiH
shlokas.24:
tathaiva yuyudhAno.api droNaM bahubhirAshugaiH |
prAchChAdayadasambhrAntastato droNa uvAcha ha
shlokas.25:
tavAchAryo raNaM hitvA gataH kApuruSho yathA |
yudhyamAnaM hi mAM hitvA pradakShiNamavartata
shlokas.26:
tvaM hi me yudhyato nAdya jIvanmokShyasi mAdhava |
yadi mAM tvaM raNe hitvA na yAsyAchAryavaddrutam
shlokas.27:
sAtyakiruvAcha||
dhana~njayasya padavIM dharmarAjasya shAsanAt |
gachChAmi svasti te brahmanna me kAlAtyayo bhavet
shlokas.28:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
etAvaduktvA shaineya AchAryaM parivarjayan |
prayAtaH sahasA rAjansArathiM chedamabravIt
shlokas.29:
droNaH kariShyate yatnaM sarvathA mama vAraNe |
yatto yAhi raNe sUta shRRiNu chedaM vachaH param
shlokas.30:
etadAlokyate sainyamAvantyAnAM mahAprabham |
asyAnantaratastvetaddAkShiNAtyaM mahAbalam
shlokas.31:
tadanantarametachcha bAhlikAnAM balaM mahat |
bAhlikAbhyAshato yuktaM karNasyApi mahadbalam
shlokas.32:
anyonyena hi sainyAni bhinnAnyetAni sArathe |
anyonyaM samupAshritya na tyakShyanti raNAjiram
shlokas.33:
etadantaramAsAdya chodayAshvAnprahRRiShTavat |
madhyamaM javamAsthAya vaha mAmatra sArathe
shlokas.34:
bAhlikA yatra dRRishyante nAnApraharaNodyatAH |
dAkShiNAtyAshcha bahavaH sUtaputrapurogamAH
shlokas.35:
hastyashvarathasambAdhaM yachchAnIkaM vilokyate |
nAnAdeshasamutthaishcha padAtibhiradhiShThitam
shlokas.36:
etAvaduktvA yantAraM brahmANaM parivarjayan |
sa vyatIyAya yatrograM karNasya sumahadbalam
shlokas.37:
taM droNo.anuyayau kruddho vikiranvishikhAnbahUn |
yuyudhAnaM mahAbAhuM gachChantamanivartinam
shlokas.38:
karNasya sainyaM sumahadabhihatya shitaiH sharaiH |
prAvishadbhAratIM senAmaparyantAM sa sAtyakiH
shlokas.39:
praviShTe yuyudhAne tu sainikeShu druteShu cha |
amarShI kRRitavarmA tu sAtyakiM paryavArayat
shlokas.40:
tamApatantaM vishikhaiH ShaDbhirAhatya sAtyakiH |
chaturbhishchaturo.asyAshvAnAjaghAnAshu vIryavAn
shlokas.41:
tataH punaH ShoDashabhirnataparvabhirAshugaiH |
sAtyakiH kRRitavarmANaM pratyavidhyatstanAntare
shlokas.42:
sa tudyamAno vishikhairbahubhistigmatejanaiH |
sAtvatena mahArAja kRRitavarmA na chakShame
shlokas.43:
sa vatsadantaM sandhAya jihmagAnalasaMnibham |
AkRRiShya rAjannAkarNAdvivyAdhorasi sAtyakim
shlokas.44:
sa tasya dehAvaraNaM bhittvA dehaM cha sAyakaH |
sapatrapu~NkhaH pRRithivIM vivesha rudhirokShitaH
shlokas.45:
athAsya bahubhirbANairachChinatparamAstravit |
samArgaNaguNaM rAjankRRitavarmA sharAsanam
shlokas.46:
vivyAdha cha raNe rAjansAtyakiM satyavikramam |
dashabhirvishikhaistIkShNairabhikruddhaH stanAntare
shlokas.47:
tataH prashIrNe dhanuShi shaktyA shaktimatAM varaH |
abhyahandakShiNaM bAhuM sAtyakiH kRRitavarmaNaH
shlokas.48:
tato.anyatsudRRiDhaM vIro dhanurAdAya sAtyakiH |
vyasRRijadvishikhA.nstUrNaM shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.49:
sarathaM kRRitavarmANaM samantAtparyavAkirat |
ChAdayitvA raNe.atyarthaM hArdikyaM tu sa sAtyakiH
shlokas.50:
athAsya bhallena shiraH sAratheH samakRRintata |
sa papAta hataH sUto hArdikyasya mahArathAt
tataste yantari hate prAdrava.nsturagA bhRRisham
shlokas.51:
atha bhojastvasambhrAnto nigRRihya turagAnsvayam |
tasthau sharadhanuShpANistatsainyAnyabhyapUjayan
shlokas.52:
sa muhUrtamivAshvasya sadashvAnsamachodayat |
vyapetabhIramitrANAmAvahatsumahadbhayam
sAtyakishchAbhyagAttasmAtsa tu bhImamupAdravat
shlokas.53:
yuyudhAno.api rAjendra droNAnIkAdviniHsRRitaH |
prayayau tvaritastUrNaM kAmbojAnAM mahAchamUm
shlokas.54:
sa tatra bahubhiH shUraiH saMniruddho mahArathaiH |
na chachAla tadA rAjansAtyakiH satyavikramaH
shlokas.55:
sandhAya cha chamUM droNo bhoje bhAraM niveshya cha |
anvadhAvadraNe yatto yuyudhAnaM yuyutsayA
shlokas.56:
tathA tamanudhAvantaM yuyudhAnasya pRRiShThataH |
nyavArayanta sa~NkruddhAH pANDusainye bRRihattamAH
shlokas.57:
samAsAdya tu hArdikyaM rathAnAM pravaraM ratham |
pA~nchAlA vigatotsAhA bhImasenapurogamAH
vikramya vAritA rAjanvIreNa kRRitavarmaNA
shlokas.58:
yatamAnA.nstu tAnsarvAnIShadvigatachetasaH |
abhitastA~nsharaugheNa klAntavAhAnavArayat
shlokas.59:
nigRRihItAstu bhojena bhojAnIkepsavo raNe |
atiShThannAryavadvIrAH prArthayanto mahadyashaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
evaM bahuvidhaM sainyamevaM pravichitaM varam |
vyUDhamevaM yathAnyAyamevaM bahu cha sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
nityaM pUjitamasmAbhirabhikAmaM cha naH sadA |
prauDhamatyadbhutAkAraM purastAddRRiDhavikramam
shlokas.3:
nAtivRRiddhamabAlaM cha na kRRishaM nAtipIvaram |
laghuvRRittAyataprANaM sAragAtramanAmayam
shlokas.4:
AttasaMnAhasampannaM bahushastraparichChadam |
shastragrahaNavidyAsu bahvIShu pariniShThitam
shlokas.5:
Arohe paryavaskande saraNe sAntaraplute |
samyakpraharaNe yAne vyapayAne cha kovidam
shlokas.6:
nAgeShvashveShu bahusho ratheShu cha parIkShitam |
parIkShya cha yathAnyAyaM vetanenopapAditam
shlokas.7:
na goShThyA nopachAreNa na sambandhanimittataH |
nAnAhUto na hyabhRRito mama sainye babhUva ha
shlokas.8:
kulInAryajanopetaM tuShTapuShTamanuddhatam |
kRRitamAnopakAraM cha yashasvi cha manasvi cha
shlokas.9:
sachivaishchAparairmukhyairbahubhirmukhyakarmabhiH |
lokapAlopamaistAta pAlitaM narasattamaiH
shlokas.10:
bahubhiH pArthivairguptamasmatpriyachikIrShubhiH |
asmAnabhisRRitaiH kAmAtsabalaiH sapadAnugaiH
shlokas.11:
mahodadhimivApUrNamApagAbhiH samantataH |
apakShaiH pakShisa~NkAshai rathairashvaishcha sa.nvRRitam
shlokas.12:
yodhAkShayyajalaM bhImaM vAhanormitara~NgiNam |
kShepaNyasigadAshaktisharaprAsajhaShAkulam
shlokas.13:
dhvajabhUShaNasambAdhaM ratnapaTTena sa~nchitam |
vAhanairapi dhAvadbhirvAyuvegavikampitam
shlokas.14:
droNagambhIrapAtAlaM kRRitavarmamahAhradam |
jalasandhamahAgrAhaM karNachandrodayoddhatam
shlokas.15:
gate sainyArNavaM bhittvA tarasA pANDavarShabhe |
sa~njayaikarathenaiva yuyudhAne cha mAmakam
shlokas.16:
tatra sheShaM na pashyAmi praviShTe savyasAchini |
sAtvate cha rathodAre mama sainyasya sa~njaya
shlokas.17:
tau tatra samatikrAntau dRRiShTvAbhItau tarasvinau |
sindhurAjaM cha samprekShya gANDIvasyeShugochare
shlokas.18:
kiM tadA kuravaH kRRityaM vidadhuH kAlachoditAH |
dAruNaikAyane kAle kathaM vA pratipedire
shlokas.19:
grastAnhi kauravAnmanye mRRityunA tAta sa~NgatAn |
vikramo hi raNe teShAM na tathA dRRishyate.adya vai
shlokas.20:
akShatau sa.nyuge tatra praviShTau kRRiShNapANDavau |
na cha vArayitA kashchittayorastIha sa~njaya
shlokas.21:
bhRRitAshcha bahavo yodhAH parIkShyaiva mahArathAH |
vetanena yathAyogyaM priyavAdena chApare
shlokas.22:
akAraNabhRRitastAta mama sainye na vidyate |
karmaNA hyanurUpeNa labhyate bhaktavetanam
shlokas.23:
na cha yodho.abhavatkashchinmama sainye tu sa~njaya |
alpadAnabhRRitastAta na kupyabhRRitako naraH
shlokas.24:
pUjitA hi yathAshaktyA dAnamAnAsanairmayA |
tathA putraishcha me tAta j~nAtibhishcha sabAndhavaiH
shlokas.25:
te cha prApyaiva sa~NgrAme nirjitAH savyasAchinA |
shaineyena parAmRRiShTAH kimanyadbhAgadheyataH
shlokas.26:
rakShyate yashcha sa~NgrAme ye cha sa~njaya rakShiNaH |
ekaH sAdhAraNaH panthA rakShyasya saha rakShibhiH
shlokas.27:
arjunaM samare dRRiShTvA saindhavasyAgrataH sthitam |
putro mama bhRRishaM mUDhaH kiM kAryaM pratyapadyata
shlokas.28:
sAtyakiM cha raNe dRRiShTvA pravishantamabhItavat |
kiM nu duryodhanaH kRRityaM prAptakAlamamanyata
shlokas.29:
sarvashastrAtigau senAM praviShTau rathasattamau |
dRRiShTvA kAM vai dhRRitiM yuddhe pratyapadyanta mAmakAH
shlokas.30:
dRRiShTvA kRRiShNaM tu dAshArhamarjunArthe vyavasthitam |
shinInAmRRiShabhaM chaiva manye shochanti putrakAH
shlokas.31:
dRRiShTvA senAM vyatikrAntAM sAtvatenArjunena cha |
palAyamAnA.nshcha kurUnmanye shochanti putrakAH
shlokas.32:
vidrutAnrathino dRRiShTvA nirutsAhAndviShajjaye |
palAyane kRRitotsAhAnmanye shochanti putrakAH
shlokas.33:
shUnyAnkRRitAnrathopasthAnsAtvatenArjunena cha |
hatA.nshcha yodhAnsa.ndRRishya manye shochanti putrakAH
shlokas.34:
vyashvanAgarathAndRRiShTvA tatra vIrAnsahasrashaH |
dhAvamAnAnraNe vyagrAnmanye shochanti putrakAH
shlokas.35:
vivIrA.nshcha kRRitAnashvAnvirathA.nshcha kRRitAnnarAn |
tatra sAtyakipArthAbhyAM manye shochanti putrakAH
shlokas.36:
pattisa~NghAnraNe dRRiShTvA dhAvamAnA.nshcha sarvashaH |
nirAshA vijaye sarve manye shochanti putrakAH
shlokas.37:
droNasya samatikrAntAvanIkamaparAjitau |
kShaNena dRRiShTvA tau vIrau manye shochanti putrakAH
shlokas.38:
saMmUDho.asmi bhRRishaM tAta shrutvA kRRiShNadhana~njayau |
praviShTau mAmakaM sainyaM sAtvatena sahAchyutau
shlokas.39:
tasminpraviShTe pRRitanAM shinInAM pravare rathe |
bhojAnIkaM vyatikrAnte kathamAsanhi kauravAH
shlokas.40:
tathA droNena samare nigRRihIteShu pANDuShu |
kathaM yuddhamabhUttatra tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.41:
droNo hi balavA~nshUraH kRRitAstro dRRiDhavikramaH |
pA~nchAlAstaM maheShvAsaM pratyayudhyankathaM raNe
shlokas.42:
baddhavairAstathA droNe dharmarAjajayaiShiNaH |
bhAradvAjastathA teShu kRRitavairo mahArathaH
shlokas.43:
arjunashchApi yachchakre sindhurAjavadhaM prati |
tanme sarvaM samAchakShva kushalo hyasi sa~njaya

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
AtmAparAdhAtsambhUtaM vyasanaM bharatarShabha |
prApya prAkRRitavadvIra na tvaM shochitumarhasi
shlokas.2:
tava nirguNatAM j~nAtvA pakShapAtaM suteShu cha |
dvaidhIbhAvaM tathA dharme pANDaveShu cha matsaram
ArtapralApA.nshcha bahUnmanujAdhipasattama
shlokas.3:
sarvalokasya tattvaj~naH sarvalokaguruH prabhuH |
vAsudevastato yuddhaM kurUNAmakaronmahat
shlokas.4:
AtmAparAdhAtsumahAnprAptaste vipulaH kShayaH |
na hi te sukRRitaM ki~nchidAdau madhye cha bhArata
dRRishyate pRRiShThatashchaiva tvanmUlo hi parAjayaH
shlokas.5:
tasmAdadya sthiro bhUtvA j~nAtvA lokasya nirNayam |
shRRiNu yuddhaM yathA vRRittaM ghoraM devAsuropamam
shlokas.6:
praviShTe tava sainyaM tu shaineye satyavikrame |
bhImasenamukhAH pArthAH pratIyurvAhinIM tava
shlokas.7:
AgachChatastAnsahasA kruddharUpAnsahAnugAn |
dadhAraiko raNe pANDUnkRRitavarmA mahArathaH
shlokas.8:
yathodvRRittaM dhArayate velA vai salilArNavam |
pANDusainyaM tathA sa~Nkhye hArdikyaH samavArayat
shlokas.9:
tatrAdbhutamamanyanta hArdikyasya parAkramam |
yadenaM sahitAH pArthA nAtichakramurAhave
shlokas.10:
tato bhImastribhirviddhvA kRRitavarmANamAyasaiH |
sha~NkhaM dadhmau mahAbAhurharShayansarvapANDavAn
shlokas.11:
sahadevastu vi.nshatyA dharmarAjashcha pa~nchabhiH |
shatena nakulashchApi hArdikyaM samavidhyata
shlokas.12:
draupadeyAstrisaptatyA saptabhishcha ghaTotkachaH |
dhRRiShTadyumnastribhishchApi kRRitavarmANamArdayat
virATo drupadashchaiva yAj~nasenishcha pa~nchabhiH
shlokas.13:
shikhaNDI chApi hArdikyaM viddhvA pa~nchabhirAshugaiH |
punarvivyAdha vi.nshatyA sAyakAnAM hasanniva
shlokas.14:
kRRitavarmA tato rAjansarvatastAnmahArathAn |
ekaikaM pa~nchabhirviddhvA bhImaM vivyAdha saptabhiH
dhanurdhvajaM cha sa.nyatto rathAdbhUmAvapAtayat
shlokas.15:
athainaM ChinnadhanvAnaM tvaramANo mahArathaH |
AjaghAnorasi kruddhaH saptatyA nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.16:
sa gADhaviddho balavAnhArdikyasya sharottamaiH |
chachAla rathamadhyasthaH kShitikampe yathAchalaH
shlokas.17:
bhImasenaM tathA dRRiShTvA dharmarAjapurogamAH |
visRRijantaH sharAnghorAnkRRitavarmANamArdayan
shlokas.18:
taM tathA koShThakIkRRitya rathava.nshena mAriSha |
vivyadhuH sAyakairhRRiShTA rakShArthaM mArutermRRidhe
shlokas.19:
pratilabhya tataH sa~nj~nAM bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
shaktiM jagrAha samare hemadaNDAmayasmayIm
chikShepa cha rathAttUrNaM kRRitavarmarathaM prati
shlokas.20:
sA bhImabhujanirmuktA nirmuktoragasaMnibhA |
kRRitavarmANamabhitaH prajajvAla sudAruNA
shlokas.21:
tAmApatantIM sahasA yugAntAgnisamaprabhAm |
dvAbhyAM sharAbhyAM hArdikyo nichakarta dvidhA tadA
shlokas.22:
sA ChinnA patitA bhUmau shaktiH kanakabhUShaNA |
dyotayantI disho rAjanmaholkeva divashchyutA
shaktiM vinihatAM dRRiShTvA bhImashchukrodha vai bhRRisham
shlokas.23:
tato.anyaddhanurAdAya vegavatsumahAsvanam |
bhImaseno raNe kruddho hArdikyaM samavArayat
shlokas.24:
athainaM pa~nchabhirbANairAjaghAna stanAntare |
bhImo bhImabalo rAja.nstava durmantritena ha
shlokas.25:
bhojastu kShatasarvA~Ngo bhImasenena mAriSha |
raktAshoka ivotphullo vyabhrAjata raNAjire
shlokas.26:
tataH kruddhastribhirbANairbhImasenaM hasanniva |
abhihatya dRRiDhaM yuddhe tAnsarvAnpratyavidhyata
shlokas.27:
tribhistribhirmaheShvAso yatamAnAnmahArathAn |
te.api taM pratyavidhyanta saptabhiH saptabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.28:
shikhaNDinastataH kruddhaH kShurapreNa mahArathaH |
dhanushchichCheda samare prahasanniva bhArata
shlokas.29:
shikhaNDI tu tataH kruddhashChinne dhanuShi satvaram |
asiM jagrAha samare shatachandraM cha bhAsvaram
shlokas.30:
bhrAmayitvA mahAcharma chAmIkaravibhUShitam |
tamasiM preShayAmAsa kRRitavarmarathaM prati
shlokas.31:
sa tasya sasharaM chApaM ChittvA sa~Nkhye mahAnasiH |
abhyagAddharaNIM rAja.nshchyutaM jyotirivAmbarAt
shlokas.32:
etasminneva kAle tu tvaramANA mahArathAH |
vivyadhuH sAyakairgADhaM kRRitavarmANamAhave
shlokas.33:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya tyaktvA tachcha mahaddhanuH |
vishIrNaM bharatashreShTha hArdikyaH paravIrahA
shlokas.34:
vivyAdha pANDavAnyuddhe tribhistribhirajihmagaiH |
shikhaNDinaM cha vivyAdha tribhiH pa~nchabhireva cha
shlokas.35:
dhanuranyatsamAdAya shikhaNDI tu mahAyashAH |
avArayatkUrmanakhairAshugairhRRidikAtmajam
shlokas.36:
tataH kruddho raNe rAjanhRRidikasyAtmasambhavaH |
abhidudrAva vegena yAj~naseniM mahAratham
shlokas.37:
bhIShmasya samare rAjanmRRityorhetuM mahAtmanaH |
vidarshayanbalaM shUraH shArdUla iva ku~njaram
shlokas.38:
tau dishAgajasa~NkAshau jvalitAviva pAvakau |
samAsedaturanyonyaM sharasa~Nghairari.ndamau
shlokas.39:
vidhunvAnau dhanuHshreShThe sa.ndadhAnau cha sAyakAn |
visRRijantau cha shatasho gabhastIniva bhAskarau
shlokas.40:
tApayantau sharaistIkShNairanyonyaM tau mahArathau |
yugAntapratimau vIrau rejaturbhAskarAviva
shlokas.41:
kRRitavarmA tu rabhasaM yAj~naseniM mahAratham |
viddhveShUNAM trisaptatyA punarvivyAdha saptabhiH
shlokas.42:
sa gADhaviddho vyathito rathopastha upAvishat |
visRRijansasharaM chApaM mUrChayAbhipariplutaH
shlokas.43:
taM viShaNNaM rathe dRRiShTvA tAvakA bharatarShabha |
hArdikyaM pUjayAmAsurvAsA.nsyAdudhuvushcha ha
shlokas.44:
shikhaNDinaM tathA j~nAtvA hArdikyasharapIDitam |
apovAha raNAdyantA tvaramANo mahAratham
shlokas.45:
sAditaM tu rathopasthe dRRiShTvA pArthAH shikhaNDinam |
parivavrU rathaistUrNaM kRRitavarmANamAhave
shlokas.46:
tatrAdbhutaM paraM chakre kRRitavarmA mahArathaH |
yadekaH samare pArthAnvArayAmAsa sAnugAn
shlokas.47:
pArthA~njitvAjayachchedInpA~nchAlAnsRRi~njayAnapi |
kekayA.nshcha mahAvIryAnkRRitavarmA mahArathaH
shlokas.48:
te vadhyamAnAH samare hArdikyena sma pANDavAH |
itashchetashcha dhAvanto naiva chakrurdhRRitiM raNe
shlokas.49:
jitvA pANDusutAnyuddhe bhImasenapurogamAn |
hArdikyaH samare.atiShThadvidhUma iva pAvakaH
shlokas.50:
te drAvyamANAH samare hArdikyena mahArathAH |
vimukhAH samapadyanta sharavRRiShTibhirarditAH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shRRiNuShvaikamanA rAjanyanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi |
drAvyamANe bale tasminhArdikyena mahAtmanA
shlokas.2:
lajjayAvanate chApi prahRRiShTaishchaiva tAvakaiH |
dvIpo ya AsItpANDUnAmagAdhe gAdhamichChatAm
shlokas.3:
shrutvA tu ninadaM bhImaM tAvakAnAM mahAhave |
shaineyastvarito rAjankRRitavarmANamabhyayAt
shlokas.4:
kRRitavarmA tu hArdikyaH shaineyaM nishitaiH sharaiH |
avAkiratsusa~Nkruddhastato.akrudhyata sAtyakiH
shlokas.5:
tataH sunishitaM bhallaM shaineyaH kRRitavarmaNe |
preShayAmAsa samare sharA.nshcha chaturo.aparAn
shlokas.6:
te tasya jaghnire vAhAnbhallenAsyAchChinaddhanuH |
pRRiShTharakShaM tathA sUtamavidhyannishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.7:
tatastaM virathaM kRRitvA sAtyakiH satyavikramaH |
senAmasyArdayAmAsa sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.8:
sAbhajyatAtha pRRitanA shaineyasharapIDitA |
tataH prAyAdvai tvaritaH sAtyakiH satyavikramaH
shlokas.9:
shRRiNu rAjanyadakarottava sainyeShu vIryavAn |
atItya sa mahArAja droNAnIkamahArNavam
shlokas.10:
parAjitya cha saMhRRiShTaH kRRitavarmANamAhave |
yantAramabravIchChUraH shanairyAhItyasambhramam
shlokas.11:
dRRiShTvA tu tava tatsainyaM rathAshvadvipasa~Nkulam |
padAtijanasampUrNamabravItsArathiM punaH
shlokas.12:
yadetanmeghasa~NkAshaM droNAnIkasya savyataH |
sumahatku~njarAnIkaM yasya rukmaratho mukham
shlokas.13:
ete hi bahavaH sUta durnivAryAshcha sa.nyuge |
duryodhanasamAdiShTA madarthe tyaktajIvitAH
rAjaputrA maheShvAsAH sarve vikrAntayodhinaH
shlokas.14:
trigartAnAM rathodArAH suvarNavikRRitadhvajAH |
mAmevAbhimukhA vIrA yotsyamAnA vyavasthitAH
shlokas.15:
atra mAM prApaya kShipramashvA.nshchodaya sArathe |
trigartaiH saha yotsyAmi bhAradvAjasya pashyataH
shlokas.16:
tataH prAyAchChanaiH sUtaH sAtvatasya mate sthitaH |
rathenAdityavarNena bhAsvareNa patAkinA
shlokas.17:
tamUhuH sArathervashyA valgamAnA hayottamAH |
vAyuvegasamAH sa~Nkhye kundendurajataprabhAH
shlokas.18:
ApatantaM rathaM taM tu sha~NkhavarNairhayottamaiH |
parivavrustataH shUrA gajAnIkena sarvataH
kiranto vividhA.nstIkShNAnsAyakA.NllaghuvedhinaH
shlokas.19:
sAtvato.api shitairbANairgajAnIkamayodhayat |
parvatAniva varSheNa tapAnte jalado mahAn
shlokas.20:
vajrAshanisamasparshairvadhyamAnAH sharairgajAH |
prAdravanraNamutsRRijya shinivIryasamIritaiH
shlokas.21:
shIrNadantA virudhirA bhinnamastakapiNDakAH |
vishIrNakarNAsyakarA viniyantRRipatAkinaH
shlokas.22:
sambhinnavarmaghaNTAshcha saMnikRRittamahAdhvajAH |
hatArohA disho rAjanbhejire bhraShTakambalAH
shlokas.23:
ruvanto vividhAnrAvA~njaladopamanisvanAH |
nArAchairvatsadantaishcha sAtvatena vidAritAH
shlokas.24:
tasmindrute gajAnIke jalasandho mahArathaH |
yattaH samprApayannAgaM rajatAshvarathaM prati
shlokas.25:
rukmavarNakaraH shUrastapanIyA~NgadaH shuchiH |
kuNDalI mukuTI sha~NkhI raktachandanarUShitaH
shlokas.26:
shirasA dhArayandIptAM tapanIyamayIM srajam |
urasA dhArayanniShkaM kaNThasUtraM cha bhAsvaram
shlokas.27:
chApaM cha rukmavikRRitaM vidhunvangajamUrdhani |
ashobhata mahArAja savidyudiva toyadaH
shlokas.28:
tamApatantaM sahasA mAgadhasya gajottamam |
sAtyakirvArayAmAsa velevodvRRittamarNavam
shlokas.29:
nAgaM nivAritaM dRRiShTvA shaineyasya sharottamaiH |
akrudhyata raNe rAja~njalasandho mahAbalaH
shlokas.30:
tataH kruddho maheShvAso mArgaNairbhArasAdhanaiH |
avidhyata shineH pautraM jalasandho mahorasi
shlokas.31:
tato.apareNa bhallena pItena nishitena cha |
asyato vRRiShNivIrasya nichakarta sharAsanam
shlokas.32:
sAtyakiM ChinnadhanvAnaM prahasanniva bhArata |
avidhyanmAgadho vIraH pa~nchabhirnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.33:
sa viddho bahubhirbANairjalasandhena vIryavAn |
nAkampata mahAbAhustadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.34:
achintayanvai sa sharAnnAtyarthaM sambhramAdbalI |
dhanuranyatsamAdAya tiShTha tiShThetyuvAcha ha
shlokas.35:
etAvaduktvA shaineyo jalasandhaM mahorasi |
vivyAdha ShaShTyA subhRRishaM sharANAM prahasanniva
shlokas.36:
kShurapreNa cha pItena muShTideshe mahaddhanuH |
jalasandhasya chichCheda vivyAdha cha tribhiH sharaiH
shlokas.37:
jalasandhastu tattyaktvA sasharaM vai sharAsanam |
tomaraM vyasRRijattUrNaM sAtyakiM prati mAriSha
shlokas.38:
sa nirbhidya bhujaM savyaM mAdhavasya mahAraNe |
abhyagAddharaNIM ghoraH shvasanniva mahoragaH
shlokas.39:
nirbhinne tu bhuje savye sAtyakiH satyavikramaH |
tri.nshadbhirvishikhaistIkShNairjalasandhamatADayat
shlokas.40:
pragRRihya tu tataH khaDgaM jalasandho mahAbalaH |
ArShabhaM charma cha mahachChatachandramala~NkRRitam
tata Avidhya taM khaDgaM sAtvatAyotsasarja ha
shlokas.41:
shaineyasya dhanushChittvA sa khaDgo nyapatanmahIm |
alAtachakravachchaiva vyarochata mahIM gataH
shlokas.42:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya sarvakAyAvadAraNam |
shAlaskandhapratIkAshamindrAshanisamasvanam
visphArya vivyadhe kruddho jalasandhaM shareNa ha
shlokas.43:
tataH sAbharaNau bAhU kShurAbhyAM mAdhavottamaH |
sA~Ngadau jalasandhasya chichCheda prahasanniva
shlokas.44:
tau bAhU parighaprakhyau petaturgajasattamAt |
vasundharadharAdbhraShTau pa~nchashIrShAvivoragau
shlokas.45:
tataH sudaMShTraM suhanu chArukuNDalamunnasam |
kShureNAsya tRRitIyena shirashchichCheda sAtyakiH
shlokas.46:
tatpAtitashirobAhukabandhaM bhImadarshanam |
dviradaM jalasandhasya rudhireNAbhyaShi~nchata
shlokas.47:
jalasandhaM nihatyAjau tvaramANastu sAtvataH |
naiShAdiM pAtayAmAsa gajaskandhAdvishAM pate
shlokas.48:
rudhireNAvasiktA~Ngo jalasandhasya ku~njaraH |
vilambamAnamavahatsa.nshliShTaM paramAsanam
shlokas.49:
sharArditaH sAtvatena mardamAnaH svavAhinIm |
ghoramArtasvaraM kRRitvA vidudrAva mahAgajaH
shlokas.50:
hAhAkAro mahAnAsIttava sainyasya mAriSha |
jalasandhaM hataM dRRiShTvA vRRiShNInAmRRiShabheNa ha
shlokas.51:
vimukhAshchAbhyadhAvanta tava yodhAH samantataH |
palAyane kRRitotsAhA nirutsAhA dviShajjaye
shlokas.52:
etasminnantare rAjandroNaH shastrabhRRitAM varaH |
abhyayAjjavanairashvairyuyudhAnaM mahAratham
shlokas.53:
tamudIrNaM tathA dRRiShTvA shaineyaM kurupu~NgavAH |
droNenaiva saha kruddhAH sAtyakiM paryavArayan
shlokas.54:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM kurUNAM sAtvatasya cha |
droNasya cha raNe rAjanghoraM devAsuropamam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
te kirantaH sharavrAtAnsarve yattAH prahAriNaH |
tvaramANA mahArAja yuyudhAnamayodhayan
shlokas.2:
taM droNaH saptasaptatyA jaghAna nishitaiH sharaiH |
durmarShaNo dvAdashabhirduHsaho dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.3:
vikarNashchApi nishitaistri.nshadbhiH ka~NkapatribhiH |
vivyAdha savye pArshve tu stanAbhyAmantare tathA
shlokas.4:
durmukho dashabhirbANaistathA duHshAsano.aShTabhiH |
chitrasenashcha shaineyaM dvAbhyAM vivyAdha mAriSha
shlokas.5:
duryodhanashcha mahatA sharavarSheNa mAdhavam |
apIDayadraNe rAja~nshUrAshchAnye mahArathAH
shlokas.6:
sarvataH pratividdhastu tava putrairmahArathaiH |
tAnpratyavidhyachChaineyaH pRRithakpRRithagajihmagaiH
shlokas.7:
bhAradvAjaM tribhirbANairduHsahaM navabhistathA |
vikarNaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA chitrasenaM cha saptabhiH
shlokas.8:
durmarShaNaM dvAdashabhishchaturbhishcha vivi.nshatim |
satyavrataM cha navabhirvijayaM dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.9:
tato rukmA~NgadaM chApaM vidhunvAno mahArathaH |
abhyayAtsAtyakistUrNaM putraM tava mahAratham
shlokas.10:
rAjAnaM sarvalokasya sarvashastrabhRRitAM varam |
sharairabhyAhanadgADhaM tato yuddhamabhUttayoH
shlokas.11:
vimu~nchantau sharA.nstIkShNAnsa.ndadhAnau cha sAyakAn |
adRRishyaM samare.anyonyaM chakratustau mahArathau
shlokas.12:
sAtyakiH kururAjena nirviddho bahvashobhata |
asravadrudhiraM bhUri svarasaM chandano yathA
shlokas.13:
sAtvatena cha bANaughairnirviddhastanayastava |
shAtakumbhamayApIDo babhau yUpa ivochChritaH
shlokas.14:
mAdhavastu raNe rAjankururAjasya dhanvinaH |
dhanushchichCheda sahasA kShurapreNa hasanniva
athainaM ChinnadhanvAnaM sharairbahubhirAchinot
shlokas.15:
nirbhinnashcha sharaistena dviShatA kShiprakAriNA |
nAmRRiShyata raNe rAjA shatrorvijayalakShaNam
shlokas.16:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya hemapRRiShThaM durAsadam |
vivyAdha sAtyakiM tUrNaM sAyakAnAM shatena ha
shlokas.17:
so.atividdho balavatA putreNa tava dhanvinA |
amarShavashamApannastava putramapIDayat
shlokas.18:
pIDitaM nRRipatiM dRRiShTvA tava putrA mahArathAH |
sAtvataM sharavarSheNa ChAdayAmAsura~njasA
shlokas.19:
sa ChAdyamAno bahubhistava putrairmahArathaiH |
ekaikaM pa~nchabhirviddhvA punarvivyAdha saptabhiH
shlokas.20:
duryodhanaM cha tvarito vivyAdhAShTabhirAshugaiH |
prahasa.nshchAsya chichCheda kArmukaM ripubhIShaNam
shlokas.21:
nAgaM maNimayaM chaiva sharairdhvajamapAtayat |
hatvA tu chaturo vAhA.nshchaturbhirnishitaiH sharaiH
sArathiM pAtayAmAsa kShurapreNa mahAyashAH
shlokas.22:
etasminnantare chaiva kururAjaM mahAratham |
avAkirachCharairhRRiShTo bahubhirmarmabhedibhiH
shlokas.23:
sa vadhyamAnaH samare shaineyasya sharottamaiH |
prAdravatsahasA rAjanputro duryodhanastava
Aplutashcha tato yAnaM chitrasenasya dhanvinaH
shlokas.24:
hAhAbhUtaM jagachchAsIddRRiShTvA rAjAnamAhave |
grasyamAnaM sAtyakinA khe somamiva rAhuNA
shlokas.25:
taM tu shabdaM mahachChrutvA kRRitavarmA mahArathaH |
abhyayAtsahasA tatra yatrAste mAdhavaH prabhuH
shlokas.26:
vidhunvAno dhanuHshreShThaM chodaya.nshchaiva vAjinaH |
bhartsayansArathiM chograM yAhi yAhIti satvaraH
shlokas.27:
tamApatantaM samprekShya vyAditAsyamivAntakam |
yuyudhAno mahArAja yantAramidamabravIt
shlokas.28:
kRRitavarmA rathenaiSha drutamApatate sharI |
pratyudyAhi rathenainaM pravaraM sarvadhanvinAm
shlokas.29:
tataH prajavitAshvena vidhivatkalpitena cha |
AsasAda raNe bhojaM pratimAnaM dhanuShmatAm
shlokas.30:
tataH paramasa~Nkruddhau jvalantAviva pAvakau |
sameyAtAM naravyAghrau vyAghrAviva tarasvinau
shlokas.31:
kRRitavarmA tu shaineyaM ShaDvi.nshatyA samArpayat |
nishitaiH sAyakaistIkShNairyantAraM chAsya saptabhiH
shlokas.32:
chaturashcha hayodArA.nshchaturbhiH parameShubhiH |
avidhyatsAdhudAntAnvai saindhavAnsAtvatasya ha
shlokas.33:
rukmadhvajo rukmapRRiShThaM mahadvisphArya kArmukam |
rukmA~NgadI rukmavarmA rukmapu~NkhAnavAkirat
shlokas.34:
tato.ashItiM shineH pautraH sAyakAnkRRitavarmaNe |
prAhiNottvarayA yukto draShTukAmo dhana~njayam
shlokas.35:
so.atividdho balavatA shatruNA shatrutApanaH |
samakampata durdharShaH kShitikampe yathAchalaH
shlokas.36:
triShaShTyA chaturo.asyAshvAnsaptabhiH sArathiM sharaiH |
vivyAdha nishitaistUrNaM sAtyakiH kRRitavarmaNaH
shlokas.37:
suvarNapu~NkhaM vishikhaM samAdhAya sa sAtyakiH |
vyasRRijattaM mahAjvAlaM sa~Nkruddhamiva pannagam
shlokas.38:
so.avishatkRRitavarmANaM yamadaNDopamaH sharaH |
jAmbUnadavichitraM cha varma nirbhidya bhAnumat
abhyagAddharaNImugro rudhireNa samukShitaH
shlokas.39:
sa~njAtarudhirashchAjau sAtvateShubhirarditaH |
prachalandhanurutsRRijya nyapatatsyandanottame
shlokas.40:
sa siMhadaMShTro jAnubhyAmApanno.amitavikramaH |
sharArditaH sAtyakinA rathopasthe nararShabhaH
shlokas.41:
sahasrabAhoH sadRRishamakShobhyamiva sAgaram |
nivArya kRRitavarmANaM sAtyakiH prayayau tataH
shlokas.42:
khaDgashaktidhanuHkIrNAM gajAshvarathasa~NkulAm |
pravartitograrudhirAM shatashaH kShatriyarShabhaiH
shlokas.43:
prekShatAM sarvasainyAnAM madhyena shinipu~NgavaH |
abhyagAdvAhinIM bhittvA vRRitrahevAsurIM chamUm
shlokas.44:
samAshvAsya cha hArdikyo gRRihya chAnyanmahaddhanuH |
tasthau tatraiva balavAnvArayanyudhi pANDavAn

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
kAlyamAneShu sainyeShu shaineyena tatastataH |
bhAradvAjaH sharavrAtairmahadbhiH samavAkirat
shlokas.2:
sa samprahArastumulo droNasAtvatayorabhUt |
pashyatAM sarvasainyAnAM balivAsavayoriva
shlokas.3:
tato droNaH shineH pautraM chitraiH sarvAyasaiH sharaiH |
tribhirAshIviShAkArairlalATe samavidhyata
shlokas.4:
tairlalATArpitairbANairyuyudhAnastvajihmagaiH |
vyarochata mahArAja trishRRi~Nga iva parvataH
shlokas.5:
tato.asya bANAnaparAnindrAshanisamasvanAn |
bhAradvAjo.antaraprekShI preShayAmAsa sa.nyuge
shlokas.6:
tAndroNachApanirmuktAndAshArhaH patataH sharAn |
dvAbhyAM dvAbhyAM supu~NkhAbhyAM chichCheda paramAstravit
shlokas.7:
tAmasya laghutAM droNaH samavekShya vishAM pate |
prahasya sahasAvidhyadvi.nshatyA shinipu~Ngavam
shlokas.8:
punaH pa~nchAshateShUNAM shatena cha samArpayat |
laghutAM yuyudhAnasya lAghavena visheShayan
shlokas.9:
samutpatanti valmIkAdyathA kruddhA mahoragAH |
tathA droNarathAdrAjannutpatanti tanuchChidaH
shlokas.10:
tathaiva yuyudhAnena sRRiShTAH shatasahasrashaH |
avAkirandroNarathaM sharA rudhirabhojanAH
shlokas.11:
lAghavAddvijamukhyasya sAtvatasya cha mAriSha |
visheShaM nAdhyagachChAma samAvAstAM nararShabhau
shlokas.12:
sAtyakistu tato droNaM navabhirnataparvabhiH |
AjaghAna bhRRishaM kruddho dhvajaM cha nishitaiH sharaiH
sArathiM cha shatenaiva bhAradvAjasya pashyataH
shlokas.13:
lAghavaM yuyudhAnasya dRRiShTvA droNo mahArathaH |
saptatyA sAtyakiM viddhvA turagA.nshcha tribhistribhiH
dhvajamekena vivyAdha mAdhavasya rathe sthitam
shlokas.14:
athApareNa bhallena hemapu~Nkhena patriNA |
dhanushchichCheda samare mAdhavasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.15:
sAtyakistu tataH kruddho dhanustyaktvA mahArathaH |
gadAM jagrAha mahatIM bhAradvAjAya chAkShipat
shlokas.16:
tAmApatantIM sahasA paTTabaddhAmayasmayIm |
nyavArayachCharairdroNo bahubhirbahurUpibhiH
shlokas.17:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya sAtyakiH satyavikramaH |
vivyAdha bahubhirvIraM bhAradvAjaM shilAshitaiH
shlokas.18:
sa viddhvA samare droNaM siMhanAdamamu~nchata |
taM vai na mamRRiShe droNaH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.19:
tathaH shaktiM gRRihItvA tu rukmadaNDAmayasmayIm |
tarasA preShayAmAsa mAdhavasya rathaM prati
shlokas.20:
anAsAdya tu shaineyaM sA shaktiH kAlasaMnibhA |
bhittvA rathaM jagAmogrA dharaNIM dAruNasvanA
shlokas.21:
tato droNaM shineH pautro rAjanvivyAdha patriNA |
dakShiNaM bhujamAsAdya pIDayanbharatarShabha
shlokas.22:
droNo.api samare rAjanmAdhavasya mahaddhanuH |
ardhachandreNa chichCheda rathashaktyA cha sArathim
shlokas.23:
mumoha sarathistasya rathashaktyA samAhataH |
sa rathopasthamAsAdya muhUrtaM saMnyaShIdata
shlokas.24:
chakAra sAtyakI rAja.nstatra karmAtimAnuSham |
ayodhayachcha yaddroNaM rashmI~njagrAha cha svayam
shlokas.25:
tataH sharashatenaiva yuyudhAno mahArathaH |
avidhyadbrAhmaNaM sa~Nkhye hRRiShTarUpo vishAM pate
shlokas.26:
tasya droNaH sharAnpa~ncha preShayAmAsa bhArata |
te tasya kavachaM bhittvA papuH shoNitamAhave
shlokas.27:
nirviddhastu sharairghorairakrudhyatsAtyakirbhRRisham |
sAyakAnvyasRRijachchApi vIro rukmarathaM prati
shlokas.28:
tato droNasya yantAraM nipAtyaikeShuNA bhuvi |
ashvAnvyadrAvayadbANairhatasUtAnmahAtmanaH
shlokas.29:
sa rathaH pradrutaH sa~Nkhye maNDalAni sahasrashaH |
chakAra rAjato rAjanbhrAjamAna ivA.nshumAn
shlokas.30:
abhidravata gRRihNIta hayAndroNasya dhAvata |
iti sma chukrushuH sarve rAjaputrAH sarAjakAH
shlokas.31:
te sAtyakimapAsyAshu rAjanyudhi mahArathAH |
yato droNastataH sarve sahasA samupAdravan
shlokas.32:
tAndRRiShTvA pradrutAnsarvAnsAtvatena sharArditAn |
prabhagnaM punarevAsIttava sainyaM samAkulam
shlokas.33:
vyUhasyaiva punardvAraM gatvA droNo vyavasthitaH |
vAtAyamAnaistairashvairhRRito vRRiShNisharArditaiH
shlokas.34:
pANDupA~nchAlasambhagnaM vyUhamAlokya vIryavAn |
shaineye nAkarodyatnaM vyUhasyaivAbhirakShaNe
shlokas.35:
nivArya pANDupA~nchAlAndroNAgniH pradahanniva |
tasthau krodhAgnisa.ndIptaH kAlasUrya ivoditaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
droNaM sa jitvA puruShapravIra;stathaiva hArdikyamukhA.nstvadIyAn |
prahasya sUtaM vachanaM babhAShe; shinipravIraH kurupu~NgavAgrya
shlokas.2:
nimittamAtraM vayamatra sUta; dagdhArayaH keshavaphalgunAbhyAm |
hatAnnihanmeha nararShabheNa; vayaM sureshAtmasamudbhavena
shlokas.3:
tamevamuktvA shinipu~NgavastadA; mahAmRRidhe so.agryadhanurdharo.arihA |
kiransamantAtsahasA sharAnbalI; samApatachChyena ivAmiShaM yathA
shlokas.4:
taM yAntamashvaiH shashisha~NkhavarNai;rvigAhya sainyaM puruShapravIram |
nAshaknuvanvArayituM samantA;dAdityarashmipratimaM narAgryam
shlokas.5:
asahyavikrAntamadInasattvaM; sarve gaNA bhArata durviShahyam |
sahasranetrapratimaprabhAvaM; divIva sUryaM jaladavyapAye
shlokas.6:
amarShapUrNastvatichitrayodhI; sharAsanI kA~nchanavarmadhArI |
sudarshanaH sAtyakimApatantaM; nyavArayadrAjavaraH prasahya
shlokas.7:
tayorabhUdbharata samprahAraH; sudAruNastaM samabhiprasha.nsan |
yodhAstvadIyAshcha hi somakAshcha; vRRitrendrayoryuddhamivAmaraughAH
shlokas.8:
sharaiH sutIkShNaiH shatasho.abhyavidhya;tsudarshanaH sAtvatamukhyamAjau |
anAgatAneva tu tAnpRRiShatkAM;shchichCheda bANaiH shinipu~Ngavo.api
shlokas.9:
tathaiva shakrapratimo.api sAtyakiH; sudarshane yAnkShipati sma sAyakAn |
dvidhA tridhA tAnakarotsudarshanaH; sharottamaiH syandanavaryamAsthitaH
shlokas.10:
samprekShya bANAnnihatA.nstadAnIM; sudarshanaH sAtyakibANavegaiH |
krodhAddidhakShanniva tigmatejAH; sharAnamu~nchattapanIyachitrAn
shlokas.11:
punaH sa bANaistribhiragnikalpai;rAkarNapUrNairnishitaiH supu~NkhaiH |
vivyAdha dehAvaraNaM vibhidya; te sAtyakerAvivishuH sharIram
shlokas.12:
tathaiva tasyAvanipAlaputraH; sandhAya bANairaparairjvaladbhiH |
AjaghnivA.nstAnrajataprakAshAM;shchaturbhirashvA.nshchaturaH prasahya
shlokas.13:
tathA tu tenAbhihatastarasvI; naptA shinerindrasamAnavIryaH |
sudarshanasyeShugaNaiH sutIkShNai;rhayAnnihatyAshu nanAda nAdam
shlokas.14:
athAsya sUtasya shiro nikRRitya; bhallena vajrAshanisaMnibhena |
sudarshanasyApi shinipravIraH; kShureNa chichCheda shiraH prasahya
shlokas.15:
sakuNDalaM pUrNashashiprakAshaM; bhrAjiShNu vaktraM nichakarta dehAt |
yathA purA vajradharaH prasahya; balasya sa~Nkhye.atibalasya rAjan
shlokas.16:
nihatya taM pArthivaputrapautraM; raNe yadUnAmRRiShabhastarasvI |
mudA sametaH parayA mahAtmA; rarAja rAjansurarAjakalpaH
shlokas.17:
tato yayAvarjunameva yena; nivArya sainyaM tava mArgaNaughaiH |
sadashvayuktena rathena niryA;llokAnvisismApayiShurnRRivIraH
shlokas.18:
tattasya vismApayanIyamagrya;mapUjayanyodhavarAH sametAH |
yadvartamAnAniShugochare.arI;ndadAha bANairhutabhugyathaiva

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH sa sAtyakirdhImAnmahAtmA vRRiShNipu~NgavaH |
sudarshanaM nihatyAjau yantAramidamabravIt
shlokas.2:
rathAshvanAgakalilaM sharashaktyUrmimAlinam |
khaDgamatsyaM gadAgrAhaM shUrAyudhamahAsvanam
shlokas.3:
prANApahAriNaM raudraM vAditrotkruShTanAditam |
yodhAnAmasukhasparshaM durdharShamajayaiShiNAm
shlokas.4:
tIrNAH sma dustaraM tAta droNAnIkamahArNavam |
jalasandhabalenAjau puruShAdairivAvRRitam
shlokas.5:
ato.anyaM pRRitanAsheShaM manye kunadikAmiva |
tartavyAmalpasalilAM chodayAshvAnasambhramam
shlokas.6:
hastaprAptamahaM manye sAmprataM savyasAchinam |
nirjitya durdharaM droNaM sapadAnugamAhave
shlokas.7:
hArdikyaM yodhavaryaM cha prAptaM manye dhana~njayam |
na hi me jAyate trAso dRRiShTvA sainyAnyanekashaH
vahneriva pradIptasya grIShme shuShkaM tRRiNolapam
shlokas.8:
pashya pANDavamukhyena yAtAM bhUmiM kirITinA |
pattyashvarathanAgaughaiH patitairviShamIkRRitAm
shlokas.9:
abhyAshasthamahaM manye shvetAshvaM kRRiShNasArathim |
sa eSha shrUyate shabdo gANDIvasyAmitaujasaH
shlokas.10:
yAdRRishAni nimittAni mama prAdurbhavanti vai |
anasta~Ngata Aditye hantA saindhavamarjunaH
shlokas.11:
shanairvishrambhayannashvAnyAhi yatto.arivAhinIm |
yatraite satanutrANAH suyodhanapurogamAH
shlokas.12:
da.nshitAH krUrakarmANaH kAmbojA yuddhadurmadAH |
sharabANAsanadharA yavanAshcha prahAriNaH
shlokas.13:
shakAH kirAtA daradA barbarAstAmraliptakAH |
anye cha bahavo mlechChA vividhAyudhapANayaH
mAmevAbhimukhAH sarve tiShThanti samarArthinaH
shlokas.14:
etAnsarathanAgAshvAnnihatyAjau sapattinaH |
idaM durgaM mahAghoraM tIrNamevopadhAraya
shlokas.15:
sUta uvAcha||
na sambhramo me vArShNeya vidyate satyavikrama |
yadyapi syAtsusa~Nkruddho jAmadagnyo.agrataH sthitaH
shlokas.16:
droNo vA rathinAM shreShThaH kRRipo madreshvaro.api vA |
tathApi sambhramo na syAttvAmAshritya mahAbhuja
shlokas.17:
tvayA subahavo yuddhe nirjitAH shatrusUdana |
na cha me sambhramaH kashchidbhUtapUrvaH kadAchana
kimu chaitatsamAsAdya vIra sa.nyugagoShpadam
shlokas.18:
AyuShmankatareNa tvA prApayAmi dhana~njayam |
keShAM kruddho.asi vArShNeya keShAM mRRityurupasthitaH
keShAM sa.nyamanImadya gantumutsahate manaH
shlokas.19:
ke tvAM yudhi parAkrAntaM kAlAntakayamopamam |
dRRiShTvA vikramasampannaM vidraviShyanti sa.nyuge
keShAM vaivasvato rAjA smarate.adya mahAbhuja
shlokas.20:
sAtyakiruvAcha||
muNDAnetAnhaniShyAmi dAnavAniva vAsavaH |
pratij~nAM pArayiShyAmi kAmbojAneva mA vaha
adyaiShAM kadanaM kRRitvA kShipraM yAsyAmi pANDavam
shlokas.21:
adya drakShyanti me vIryaM kauravAH sasuyodhanAH |
muNDAnIke hate sUta sarvasainyeShu chAsakRRit
shlokas.22:
adya kauravasainyasya dIryamANasya sa.nyuge |
shrutvA virAvaM bahudhA santapsyati suyodhanaH
shlokas.23:
adya pANDavamukhyasya shvetAshvasya mahAtmanaH |
AchAryakakRRitaM mArgaM darshayiShyAmi sa.nyuge
shlokas.24:
adya madbANanihatAnyodhamukhyAnsahasrashaH |
dRRiShTvA duryodhano rAjA pashchAttApaM gamiShyati
shlokas.25:
adya me kShiprahastasya kShipataH sAyakottamAn |
alAtachakrapratimaM dhanurdrakShyanti kauravAH
shlokas.26:
matsAyakachitA~NgAnAM rudhiraM sravatAM bahu |
sainikAnAM vadhaM dRRiShTvA santapsyati suyodhanaH
shlokas.27:
adya me kruddharUpasya nighnatashcha varAnvarAn |
dvirarjunamimaM lokaM ma.nsyate sa suyodhanaH
shlokas.28:
adya rAjasahasrANi nihatAni mayA raNe |
dRRiShTvA duryodhano rAjA santapsyati mahAmRRidhe
shlokas.29:
adya snehaM cha bhaktiM cha pANDaveShu mahAtmasu |
hatvA rAjasahasrANi darshayiShyAmi rAjasu
shlokas.30:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamuktastadA sUtaH shikShitAnsAdhuvAhinaH |
shashA~NkasaMnikAshAnvai vAjino.achUchudadbhRRisham
shlokas.31:
te pibanta ivAkAshaM yuyudhAnaM hayottamAH |
prApayanyavanA~nshIghraM manaHpavanaraMhasaH
shlokas.32:
sAtyakiM te samAsAdya pRRitanAsvanivartinam |
bahavo laghuhastAshcha sharavarShairavAkiran
shlokas.33:
teShAmiShUnathAstrANi vegavannataparvabhiH |
achChinatsAtyakI rAjannainaM te prApnuva~nsharAH
shlokas.34:
rukmapu~NkhaiH sunishitairgArdhrapatrairajihmagaiH |
uchchakarta shirA.nsyugro yavanAnAM bhujAnapi
shlokas.35:
shaikyAyasAni varmANi kA.nsyAni cha samantataH |
bhittvA dehA.nstathA teShAM sharA jagmurmahItalam
shlokas.36:
te hanyamAnA vIreNa mlechChAH sAtyakinA raNe |
shatasho nyapata.nstatra vyasavo vasudhAtale
shlokas.37:
supUrNAyatamuktaistAnavyavachChinnapiNDitaiH |
pa~ncha ShaTsapta chAShTau cha bibheda yavanA~nsharaiH
shlokas.38:
kAmbojAnAM sahasraistu shakAnAM cha vishAM pate |
shabarANAM kirAtAnAM barbarANAM tathaiva cha
shlokas.39:
agamyarUpAM pRRithivIM mA.nsashoNitakardamAm |
kRRitavA.nstatra shaineyaH kShapaya.nstAvakaM balam
shlokas.40:
dasyUnAM sashirastrANaiH shirobhirlUnamUrdhajaiH |
tatra tatra mahI kIrNA vibarhairaNDajairiva
shlokas.41:
rudhirokShitasarvA~NgaistaistadAyodhanaM babhau |
kabandhaiH sa.nvRRitaM sarvaM tAmrAbhraiH khamivAvRRitam
shlokas.42:
vajrAshanisamasparshaiH suparvabhirajihmagaiH |
te sAshvayAnA nihatAH samAvavrurvasundharAm
shlokas.43:
alpAvashiShTAH sambhagnAH kRRichChraprANA vichetasaH |
jitAH sa~Nkhye mahArAja yuyudhAnena da.nshitAH
shlokas.44:
pArShNibhishcha kashAbhishcha tADayantastura~NgamAn |
javamuttamamAsthAya sarvataH prAdravanbhayAt
shlokas.45:
kAmbojasainyaM vidrAvya durjayaM yudhi bhArata |
yavanAnAM cha tatsainyaM shakAnAM cha mahadbalam
shlokas.46:
sa tataH puruShavyAghraH sAtyakiH satyavikramaH |
prahRRiShTastAvakA~njitvA sUtaM yAhItyachodayat
shlokas.47:
taM yAntaM pRRiShThagoptAramarjunasya vishAM pate |
chAraNAH prekShya saMhRRiShTAstvadIyAshchApyapUjayan

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
jitvA yavanakAmbojAnyuyudhAnastato.arjunam |
jagAma tava sainyasya madhyena rathinAM varaH
shlokas.2:
sharadaMShTro naravyAghro vichitrakavachachChaviH |
mRRigAnvyAghra ivAjighra.nstava sainyamabhIShayat
shlokas.3:
sa rathena charanmArgAndhanurabhrAmayadbhRRisham |
rukmapRRiShThaM mahAvegaM rukmachandrakasa~Nkulam
shlokas.4:
rukmA~NgadashirastrANo rukmavarmasamAvRRitaH |
rukmadhvajavaraH shUro merushRRi~Nga ivAbabhau
shlokas.5:
sadhanurmaNDalaH sa~Nkhye tejobhAsvararashmivAn |
sharadIvoditaH sUryo nRRisUryo virarAja ha
shlokas.6:
vRRiShabhaskandhavikrAnto vRRiShabhAkSho nararShabhaH |
tAvakAnAM babhau madhye gavAM madhye yathA vRRiShaH
shlokas.7:
mattadviradasa~NkAshaM mattadviradagAminam |
prabhinnamiva mAta~NgaM yUthamadhye vyavasthitam
vyAghrA iva jighA.nsantastvadIyAbhyadravanraNe
shlokas.8:
droNAnIkamatikrAntaM bhojAnIkaM cha dustaram |
jalasandhArNavaM tIrtvA kAmbojAnAM cha vAhinIm
shlokas.9:
hArdikyamakarAnmuktaM tIrNaM vai sainyasAgaram |
parivavruH susa~NkruddhAstvadIyAH sAtyakiM rathAH
shlokas.10:
duryodhanashchitraseno duHshAsanavivi.nshatI |
shakunirduHsahashchaiva yuvA durmarShaNaH krathaH
shlokas.11:
anye cha bahavaH shUrAH shastravanto durAsadAH |
pRRiShThataH sAtyakiM yAntamanvadhAvannamarShitAH
shlokas.12:
atha shabdo mahAnAsIttava sainyasya mAriSha |
mArutoddhUtavegasya sAgarasyeva parvaNi
shlokas.13:
tAnabhidravataH sarvAnsamIkShya shinipu~NgavaH |
shanairyAhIti yantAramabravItprahasanniva
shlokas.14:
idameti samuddhUtaM dhArtarAShTrasya yadbalam |
mAmevAbhimukhaM tUrNaM gajAshvarathapattimat
shlokas.15:
nAdayanvai dishaH sarvA rathaghoSheNa sArathe |
pRRithivIM chAntarikShaM cha kampayansAgarAnapi
shlokas.16:
etadbalArNavaM tAta vArayiShye mahAraNe |
paurNamAsyAmivoddhUtaM veleva salilAshayam
shlokas.17:
pashya me sUta vikrAntamindrasyeva mahAmRRidhe |
eSha sainyAni shatrUNAM vidhamAmi shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.18:
nihatAnAhave pashya padAtyashvarathadvipAn |
machCharairagnisa~NkAshairvidehAsUnsahasrashaH
shlokas.19:
ityevaM bruvatastasya sAtyakeramitaujasaH |
samIpaM sainikAste tu shIghramIyuryuyutsavaH
jahyAdravasva tiShTheti pashya pashyeti vAdinaH
shlokas.20:
tAnevaM bruvato vIrAnsAtyakirnishitaiH sharaiH |
jaghAna trishatAnashvAnku~njarA.nshcha chatuHshatAn
shlokas.21:
sa samprahArastumulastasya teShAM cha dhanvinAm |
devAsuraraNaprakhyaH prAvartata janakShayaH
shlokas.22:
meghajAlanibhaM sainyaM tava putrasya mAriSha |
pratyagRRihNAchChineH pautraH sharairAshIviShopamaiH
shlokas.23:
prachChAdyamAnaH samare sharajAlaiH sa vIryavAn |
asambhramaM mahArAja tAvakAnavadhIdbahUn
shlokas.24:
AshcharyaM tatra rAjendra sumahaddRRiShTavAnaham |
na moghaH sAyakaH kashchitsAtyakerabhavatprabho
shlokas.25:
rathanAgAshvakalilaH padAtyUrmisamAkulaH |
shaineyavelAmAsAdya sthitaH sainyamahArNavaH
shlokas.26:
sambhrAntanaranAgAshvamAvartata muhurmuhuH |
tatsainyamiShubhistena vadhyamAnaM samantataH
babhrAma tatra tatraiva gAvaH shItArditA iva
shlokas.27:
padAtinaM rathaM nAgaM sAdinaM turagaM tathA |
aviddhaM tatra nAdrAkShaM yuyudhAnasya sAyakaiH
shlokas.28:
na tAdRRikkadanaM rAjankRRitavA.nstatra phalgunaH |
yAdRRikkShayamanIkAnAmakarotsAtyakirnRRipa
atyarjunaM shineH pautro yudhyate bharatarShabha
shlokas.29:
tato duryodhano rAjA sAtvatasya tribhiH sharaiH |
vivyAdha sUtaM nishitaishchaturbhishchaturo hayAn
shlokas.30:
sAtyakiM cha tribhirviddhvA punarvivyAdha so.aShTabhiH |
duHshAsanaH ShoDashabhirvivyAdha shinipu~Ngavam
shlokas.31:
shakuniH pa~nchavi.nshatyA chitrasenashcha pa~nchabhiH |
duHsahaH pa~nchadashabhirvivyAdhorasi sAtyakim
shlokas.32:
utsmayanvRRiShNishArdUlastathA bANaiH samAhataH |
tAnavidhyanmahArAja sarvAneva tribhistribhiH
shlokas.33:
gADhaviddhAnarInkRRitvA mArgaNaiH so.atitejanaiH |
shaineyaH shyenavatsa~Nkhye vyacharallaghuvikramaH
shlokas.34:
saubalasya dhanushChittvA hastAvApaM nikRRitya cha |
duryodhanaM tribhirbANairabhyavidhyatstanAntare
shlokas.35:
chitrasenaM shatenaiva dashabhirduHsahaM tathA |
duHshAsanaM cha vi.nshatyA vivyAdha shinipu~NgavaH
shlokas.36:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya syAlastava vishAM pate |
aShTabhiH sAtyakiM viddhvA punarvivyAdha pa~nchabhiH
shlokas.37:
duHshAsanashcha dashabhirduHsahashcha tribhiH sharaiH |
durmukhashcha dvAdashabhI rAjanvivyAdha sAtyakim
shlokas.38:
duryodhanastrisaptatyA viddhvA bhArata mAdhavam |
tato.asya nishitairbANaistribhirvivyAdha sArathim
shlokas.39:
tAnsarvAnsahitA~nshUrAnyatamAnAnmahArathAn |
pa~nchabhiH pa~nchabhirbANaiH punarvivyAdha sAtyakiH
shlokas.40:
tataH sa rathinAM shreShThastava putrasya sArathim |
AjaghAnAshu bhallena sa hato nyapatadbhuvi
shlokas.41:
pAtite sArathau tasmi.nstava putrarathaH prabho |
vAtAyamAnaistairashvairapAnIyata sa~NgarAt
shlokas.42:
tatastava sutA rAjansainikAshcha vishAM pate |
rAj~no rathamabhiprekShya vidrutAH shatasho.abhavan
shlokas.43:
vidrutaM tatra tatsainyaM dRRiShTvA bhArata sAtyakiH |
avAkirachCharaistIkShNai rukmapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH
shlokas.44:
vidrAvya sarvasainyAni tAvakAni samantataH |
prayayau sAtyakI rAja~nshvetAshvasya rathaM prati
shlokas.45:
taM sharAnAdadAnaM cha rakShamANaM cha sArathim |
AtmAnaM mochayantaM cha tAvakAH samapUjayan

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sampramRRidya mahatsainyaM yAntaM shaineyamarjunam |
nirhrIkA mama te putrAH kimakurvata sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
kathaM chaiShAM tathA yuddhe dhRRitirAsInmumUrShatAm |
shaineyacharitaM dRRiShTvA sadRRishaM savyasAchinaH
shlokas.3:
kiM nu vakShyanti te kShAtraM sainyamadhye parAjitAH |
kathaM cha sAtyakiryuddhe vyatikrAnto mahAyashAH
shlokas.4:
kathaM cha mama putrANAM jIvatAM tatra sa~njaya |
shaineyo.abhiyayau yuddhe tanmamAchakShva tattvataH
shlokas.5:
atyadbhutamidaM tAta tvatsakAshAchChRRiNomyaham |
ekasya bahubhiryuddhaM shatrubhirvai mahArathaiH
shlokas.6:
viparItamahaM manye mandabhAgyAnsutAnprati |
yatrAvadhyanta samare sAtvatena mahAtmanA
shlokas.7:
ekasya hi na paryAptaM matsainyaM tasya sa~njaya |
kruddhasya yuyudhAnasya sarve tiShThantu pANDavAH
shlokas.8:
nirjitya samare droNaM kRRitinaM yuddhadurmadam |
yathA pashugaNAnsiMhastadvaddhantA sutAnmama
shlokas.9:
kRRitavarmAdibhiH shUrairyattairbahubhirAhave |
yuyudhAno na shakito hantuM yaH puruSharShabhaH
shlokas.10:
naitadIdRRishakaM yuddhaM kRRitavA.nstatra phalgunaH |
yAdRRishaM kRRitavAnyuddhaM shinernaptA mahAyashAH
shlokas.11:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tava durmantrite rAjanduryodhanakRRitena cha |
shRRiNuShvAvahito bhUtvA yatte vakShyAmi bhArata
shlokas.12:
te punaH saMnyavartanta kRRitvA sa.nshaptakAnmithaH |
parAM yuddhe matiM kRRitvA putrasya tava shAsanAt
shlokas.13:
trINi sAdisahasrANi duryodhanapurogamAH |
shakAH kAmbojabAhlIkA yavanAH pAradAstathA
shlokas.14:
kuNindAsta~NgaNAmbaShThAH paishAchAshcha samandarAH |
abhyadravanta shaineyaM shalabhAH pAvakaM yathA
shlokas.15:
yuktAshcha pArvatIyAnAM rathAH pAShANayodhinAm |
shUrAH pa~nchashatA rAja~nshaineyaM samupAdravan
shlokas.16:
tato rathasahasreNa mahArathashatena cha |
dviradAnAM sahasreNa dvisAhasraishcha vAjibhiH
shlokas.17:
sharavarShANi mu~nchanto vividhAni mahArathAH |
abhyadravanta shaineyamasa~NkhyeyAshcha pattayaH
shlokas.18:
tA.nshcha sa~nchodayansarvAnghnatainamiti bhArata |
duHshAsano mahArAja sAtyaktiM paryavArayat
shlokas.19:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma shaineyacharitaM mahat |
yadeko bahubhiH sArdhamasambhrAntamayudhyata
shlokas.20:
avadhIchcha rathAnIkaM dviradAnAM cha tadbalam |
sAdinashchaiva tAnsarvAndasyUnapi cha sarvashaH
shlokas.21:
tatra chakrairvimathitairbhagnaishcha paramAyudhaiH |
akShaishcha bahudhA bhagnairIShAdaNDakabandhuraiH
shlokas.22:
kUbarairmathitaishchApi dhvajaishchApi nipAtitaiH |
varmabhishchAmaraishchaiva vyavakIrNA vasundharA
shlokas.23:
sragbhirAbharaNairvastrairanukarShaishcha mAriSha |
sa~nChannA vasudhA tatra dyaurgrahairiva bhArata
shlokas.24:
girirUpadharAshchApi patitAH ku~njarottamAH |
a~njanasya kule jAtA vAmanasya cha bhArata
supratIkakule jAtA mahApadmakule tathA
shlokas.25:
airAvaNakule chaiva tathAnyeShu kuleShu cha |
jAtA dantivarA rAja~nsherate bahavo hatAH
shlokas.26:
vanAyujAnpArvatIyAnkAmbojAraTTabAhlikAn |
tathA hayavarAnrAjannijaghne tatra sAtyakiH
shlokas.27:
nAnAdeshasamutthA.nshcha nAnAjAtyA.nshcha pattinaH |
nijaghne tatra shaineyaH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.28:
teShu prakAlyamAneShu dasyUnduHshAsano.abravIt |
nivartadhvamadharmaj~nA yudhyadhvaM kiM sRRitena vaH
shlokas.29:
tA.nshchApi sarvAnsamprekShya putro duHshAsanastava |
pAShANayodhinaH shUrAnpArvatIyAnachodayat
shlokas.30:
ashmayuddheShu kushalA naitajjAnAti sAtyakiH |
ashmayuddhamajAnantaM ghnatainaM yuddhakAmukam
shlokas.31:
tathaiva kuravaH sarve nAshmayuddhavishAradAH |
abhidravata mA bhaiShTa na vaH prApsyati sAtyakiH
shlokas.32:
tato gajashishuprakhyairupalaiH shailavAsinaH |
udyatairyuyudhAnasya sthitA maraNakA~NkShiNaH
shlokas.33:
kShepaNIyaistathApyanye sAtvatasya vadhaiShiNaH |
choditAstava putreNa rurudhuH sarvatodisham
shlokas.34:
teShAmApatatAmeva shilAyuddhaM chikIrShatAm |
sAtyakiH pratisandhAya tri.nshataM prAhiNochCharAn
shlokas.35:
tAmashmavRRiShTiM tumulAM pArvatIyaiH samIritAm |
bibhedoragasa~NkAshairnArAchaiH shinipu~NgavaH
shlokas.36:
tairashmachUrNairdIpyadbhiH khadyotAnAmiva vrajaiH |
prAyaH sainyAnyavadhyanta hAhAbhUtAni mAriSha
shlokas.37:
tataH pa~nchashatAH shUrAH samudyatamahAshilAH |
nikRRittabAhavo rAjannipeturdharaNItale
shlokas.38:
pAShANayodhinaH shUrAnyatamAnAnavasthitAn |
avadhIdbahusAhasrA.nstadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.39:
tataH punarbastamukhairashmavRRiShTiM samantataH |
ayohastaiH shUlahastairdaradaiH khashata~NgaNaiH
shlokas.40:
ambaShThaishcha kuNindaishcha kShiptAM kShiptAM sa sAtyakiH |
nArAchaiH prativivyAdha prekShamANo mahAbalaH
shlokas.41:
adrINAM bhidyamAnAnAmantarikShe shitaiH sharaiH |
shabdena prAdravanrAjangajAshvarathapattayaH
shlokas.42:
ashmachUrNaiH samAkIrNA manuShyAshcha vayA.nsi cha |
nAshaknuvannavasthAtuM bhramarairiva da.nshitAH
shlokas.43:
hatashiShTA virudhirA bhinnamastakapiNDikAH |
ku~njarAH saMnyavartanta yuyudhAnarathaM prathi
shlokas.44:
tataH shabdaH samabhavattava sainyasya mAriSha |
mAdhavenArdyamAnasya sAgarasyeva dAruNaH
shlokas.45:
taM shabdaM tumulaM shrutvA droNo yantAramabravIt |
eSha sUta raNe kruddhaH sAtvatAnAM mahArathaH
shlokas.46:
dArayanbahudhA sainyaM raNe charati kAlavat |
yatraiSha shabdastumulastatra sUta rathaM naya
shlokas.47:
pAShANayodhibhirnUnaM yuyudhAnaH samAgataH |
tathA hi rathinaH sarve hriyante vidrutairhayaiH
shlokas.48:
vishastrakavachA rugNAstatra tatra patanti cha |
na shaknuvanti yantAraH sa.nyantuM tumule hayAn
shlokas.49:
ityevaM bruvato rAjanbhAradvAjasya dhImataH |
pratyuvAcha tato yantA droNaM shastrabhRRitAM varam
shlokas.50:
AyuShmandravate sainyaM kauraveyaM samantataH |
pashya yodhAnraNe bhinnAndhAvamAnA.nstatastataH
shlokas.51:
ete cha sahitAH shUrAH pA~nchAlAH pANDavaiH saha |
tvAmeva hi jighA.nsantaH prAdravanti samantataH
shlokas.52:
atra kAryaM samAdhatsva prAptakAlamari.ndama |
sthAne vA gamane vApi dUraM yAtashcha sAtyakiH
shlokas.53:
tathaivaM vadatastasya bhAradvAjasya mAriSha |
pratyadRRishyata shaineyo nighnanbahuvidhAnrathAn
shlokas.54:
te vadhyamAnAH samare yuyudhAnena tAvakAH |
yuyudhAnarathaM tyaktvA droNAnIkAya dudruvuH
shlokas.55:
yaistu duHshAsanaH sArdhaM rathaiH pUrvaM nyavartata |
te bhItAstvabhyadhAvanta sarve droNarathaM prati

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
duHshAsanarathaM dRRiShTvA samIpe paryavasthitam |
bhAradvAjastato vAkyaM duHshAsanamathAbravIt
shlokas.2:
duHshAsana rathAH sarve kasmAdete pravidrutAH |
kachchitkShemaM tu nRRipateH kachchijjIvati saindhavaH
shlokas.3:
rAjaputro bhavAnatra rAjabhrAtA mahArathaH |
kimarthaM dravase yuddhe yauvarAjyamavApya hi
shlokas.4:
svayaM vairaM mahatkRRitvA pA~nchAlaiH pANDavaiH saha |
ekaM sAtyakimAsAdya kathaM bhIto.asi sa.nyuge
shlokas.5:
na jAnIShe purA tvaM tu gRRihNannakShAndurodare |
sharA hyete bhaviShyanti dAruNAshIviShopamAH
shlokas.6:
apriyANAM cha vachanaM pANDaveShu visheShataH |
draupadyAshcha parikleshastvanmUlo hyabhavatpurA
shlokas.7:
kva te mAnashcha darpashcha kva cha tadvIra garjitam |
AshIviShasamAnpArthAnkopayitvA kva yAsyasi
shlokas.8:
shochyeyaM bhAratI senA rAjA chaiva suyodhanaH |
yasya tvaM karkasho bhrAtA palAyanaparAyaNaH
shlokas.9:
nanu nAma tvayA vIra dIryamANA bhayArditA |
svabAhubalamAsthAya rakShitavyA hyanIkinI
sa tvamadya raNaM tyaktvA bhIto harShayase parAn
shlokas.10:
vidrute tvayi sainyasya nAyake shatrusUdana |
ko.anyaH sthAsyati sa~NgrAme bhIto bhIte vyapAshraye
shlokas.11:
ekena sAtvatenAdya yudhyamAnasya chAnagha |
palAyane tava matiH sa~NgrAmAddhi pravartate
shlokas.12:
yadA gANDIvadhanvAnaM bhImasenaM cha kaurava |
yamau cha yudhi draShTAsi tadA tvaM kiM kariShyasi
shlokas.13:
yudhi phalgunabANAnAM sUryAgnisamatejasAm |
na tulyAH sAtyakisharA yeShAM bhItaH palAyase
shlokas.14:
yadi tAvatkRRitA buddhiH palAyanaparAyaNA |
pRRithivI dharmarAjasya shamenaiva pradIyatAm
shlokas.15:
yAvatphalgunanArAchA nirmuktoragasaMnibhAH |
nAvishanti sharIraM te tAvatsa.nshAmya pANDavaiH
shlokas.16:
yAvatte pRRithivIM pArthA hatvA bhrAtRRishataM raNe |
nAkShipanti mahAtmAnastAvatsa.nshAmya pANDavaiH
shlokas.17:
yAvanna krudhyate rAjA dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
kRRiShNashcha samarashlAghI tAvatsa.nshAmya pANDavaiH
shlokas.18:
yAvadbhImo mahAbAhurvigAhya mahatIM chamUm |
sodarA.nste na mRRidnAti tAvatsa.nshAmya pANDavaiH
shlokas.19:
pUrvamuktashcha te bhrAtA bhIShmeNa sa suyodhanaH |
ajeyAH pANDavAH sa~Nkhye saumya sa.nshAmya pANDavaiH
na cha tatkRRitavAnmandastava bhrAtA suyodhanaH
shlokas.20:
sa yuddhe dhRRitimAsthAya yatto yudhyasva pANDavaiH |
gachCha tUrNaM rathenaiva tatra tiShThati sAtyakiH
shlokas.21:
tvayA hInaM balaM hyetadvidraviShyati bhArata |
AtmArthaM yodhaya raNe sAtyakiM satyavikramam
shlokas.22:
evamuktastava suto nAbravItki~nchidapyasau |
shrutaM chAshrutavatkRRitvA prAyAdyena sa sAtyakiH
shlokas.23:
sainyena mahatA yukto mlechChAnAmanivartinAm |
AsAdya cha raNe yatto yuyudhAnamayodhayat
shlokas.24:
droNo.api rathinAM shreShThaH pA~nchAlAnpANDavA.nstathA |
abhyadravata sa~Nkruddho javamAsthAya madhyamam
shlokas.25:
pravishya cha raNe droNaH pA~nchAlAnAM varUthinIm |
drAvayAmAsa yodhAnvai shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.26:
tato droNo mahArAja nAma vishrAvya sa.nyuge |
pANDupA~nchAlamatsyAnAM prachakre kadanaM mahat
shlokas.27:
taM jayantamanIkAni bhAradvAjaM tatastataH |
pA~nchAlaputro dyutimAnvIraketuH samabhyayAt
shlokas.28:
sa droNaM pa~nchabhirviddhvA sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
dhvajamekena vivyAdha sArathiM chAsya saptabhiH
shlokas.29:
tatrAdbhutaM mahArAja dRRiShTavAnasmi sa.nyuge |
yaddroNo rabhasaM yuddhe pA~nchAlyaM nAbhyavartata
shlokas.30:
saMniruddhaM raNe droNaM pA~nchAlA vIkShya mAriSha |
AvavruH sarvato rAjandharmaputrajayaiShiNaH
shlokas.31:
te sharairagnisa~NkAshaistomaraishcha mahAdhanaiH |
shastraishcha vividhai rAjandroNamekamavAkiran
shlokas.32:
nihatya tAnbANagaNAndroNo rAjansamantataH |
mahAjaladharAnvyomni mAtarishvA vivAniva
shlokas.33:
tataH sharaM mahAghoraM sUryapAvakasaMnibham |
sa.ndadhe paravIraghno vIraketurathaM prati
shlokas.34:
sa bhittvA tu sharo rAjanpA~nchAlyaM kulanandanam |
abhyagAddharaNIM tUrNaM lohitArdro jvalanniva
shlokas.35:
tato.apatadrathAttUrNaM pA~nchAlyaH kulanandanaH |
parvatAgrAdiva mahA.nshchampako vAyupIDitaH
shlokas.36:
tasminhate maheShvAse rAjaputre mahAbale |
pA~nchAlAstvaritA droNaM samantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.37:
chitraketuH sudhanvA cha chitravarmA cha bhArata |
tathA chitrarathashchaiva bhrAtRRivyasanakarShitAH
shlokas.38:
abhyadravanta sahitA bhAradvAjaM yuyutsavaH |
mu~nchantaH sharavarShANi tapAnte jaladA iva
shlokas.39:
sa vadhyamAno bahudhA rAjaputrairmahArathaiH |
vyashvasUtarathA.nshchakre kumArAnkupito raNe
shlokas.40:
tathAparaiH sunishitairbhallaisteShAM mahAyashAH |
puShpANIva vichinvanhi sottamA~NgAnyapAtayat
shlokas.41:
te rathebhyo hatAH petuH kShitau rAjansuvarchasaH |
devAsure purA yuddhe yathA daiteyadAnavAH
shlokas.42:
tAnnihatya raNe rAjanbhAradvAjaH pratApavAn |
kArmukaM bhrAmayAmAsa hemapRRiShThaM durAsadam
shlokas.43:
pA~nchAlAnnihatAndRRiShTvA devakalpAnmahArathAn |
dhRRiShTadyumno bhRRishaM kruddho netrAbhyAM pAtaya~njalam
abhyavartata sa~NgrAme kruddho droNarathaM prati
shlokas.44:
tato hA heti sahasA nAdaH samabhavannRRipa |
pA~nchAlyena raNe dRRiShTvA droNamAvAritaM sharaiH
shlokas.45:
sa~nChAdyamAno bahudhA pArShatena mahAtmanA |
na vivyathe tato droNaH smayannevAnvayudhyata
shlokas.46:
tato droNaM mahArAja pA~nchAlyaH krodhamUrChitaH |
AjaghAnorasi kruddho navatyA nataparvaNAm
shlokas.47:
sa gADhaviddho balinA bhAradvAjo mahAyashAH |
niShasAda rathopasthe kashmalaM cha jagAma ha
shlokas.48:
taM vai tathAgataM dRRiShTvA dhRRiShTadyumnaH parAkramI |
samutsRRijya dhanustUrNamasiM jagrAha vIryavAn
shlokas.49:
avaplutya rathAchchApi tvaritaH sa mahArathaH |
Aruroha rathaM tUrNaM bhAradvAjasya mAriSha
hartumaichChachChiraH kAyAtkrodhasa.nraktalochanaH
shlokas.50:
pratyAshvastastato droNo dhanurgRRihya mahAbalaH |
sharairvaitastikai rAjannityamAsannayodhibhiH
yodhayAmAsa samare dhRRiShTadyumnaM mahAratham
shlokas.51:
te hi vaitastikA nAma sharA AsannayodhinaH |
droNasya viditA rAjandhRRiShTadyumnamavAkShipan
shlokas.52:
sa vadhyamAno bahubhiH sAyakaistairmahAbalaH |
avaplutya rathAttUrNaM bhagnavegaH parAkramI
shlokas.53:
Aruhya svarathaM vIraH pragRRihya cha mahaddhanuH |
vivyAdha samare droNaM dhRRiShTadyumno mahArathaH
shlokas.54:
tadadbhutaM tayoryuddhaM bhUtasa~NghA hyapUjayan |
kShatriyAshcha mahArAja ye chAnye tatra sainikAH
shlokas.55:
avashyaM samare droNo dhRRiShTadyumnena sa~NgataH |
vashameShyati no rAj~naH pA~nchAlA iti chukrushuH
shlokas.56:
droNastu tvarito yuddhe dhRRiShTadyumnasya sAratheH |
shiraH prachyAvayAmAsa phalaM pakvaM taroriva
tataste pradrutA vAhA rAja.nstasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.57:
teShu pradravamANeShu pA~nchAlAnsRRi~njayA.nstathA |
vyadrAvayadraNe droNastatra tatra parAkramI
shlokas.58:
vijitya pANDupA~nchAlAnbhAradvAjaH pratApavAn |
svaM vyUhaM punarAsthAya sthiro.abhavadari.ndamaH
na chainaM pANDavA yuddhe jetumutsahire prabho

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato duHshAsano rAja~nshaineyaM samupAdravat |
kira~nsharasahasrANi parjanya iva vRRiShTimAn
shlokas.2:
sa viddhvA sAtyakiM ShaShTyA tathA ShoDashabhiH sharaiH |
nAkampayatsthitaM yuddhe mainAkamiva parvatam
shlokas.3:
sa tu duHshAsanaM vIraH sAyakairAvRRiNodbhRRisham |
mashakaM samanuprAptamUrNanAbhirivorNayA
shlokas.4:
dRRiShTvA duHshAsanaM rAjA tathA sharashatAchitam |
trigartA.nshchodayAmAsa yuyudhAnarathaM prati
shlokas.5:
te.agachChanyuyudhAnasya samIpaM krUrakAriNaH |
trigartAnAM trisAhasrA rathA yuddhavishAradAH
shlokas.6:
te tu taM rathava.nshena mahatA paryavArayan |
sthirAM kRRitvA matiM yuddhe bhUtvA sa.nshaptakA mithaH
shlokas.7:
teShAM prayatatAM yuddhe sharavarShANi mu~nchatAm |
yodhAnpa~nchashatAnmukhyAnagrAnIke vyapothayat
shlokas.8:
te.apatanta hatAstUrNaM shinipravarasAyakaiH |
mahAmArutavegena rugNA iva mahAdrumAH
shlokas.9:
rathaishcha bahudhA Chinnairdhvajaishchaiva vishAM pate |
hayaishcha kanakApIDaiH patitaistatra medinI
shlokas.10:
shaineyasharasa~NkRRittaiH shoNitaughapariplutaiH |
ashobhata mahArAja ki.nshukairiva puShpitaiH
shlokas.11:
te vadhyamAnAH samare yuyudhAnena tAvakAH |
trAtAraM nAdhyagachChanta pa~NkamagnA iva dvipAH
shlokas.12:
tataste paryavartanta sarve droNarathaM prati |
bhayAtpatagarAjasya gartAnIva mahoragAH
shlokas.13:
hatvA pa~nchashatAnyodhA~nsharairAshIviShopamaiH |
prAyAtsa shanakairvIro dhana~njayarathaM prati
shlokas.14:
taM prayAntaM narashreShThaM putro duHshAsanastava |
vivyAdha navabhistUrNaM sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.15:
sa tu taM prativivyAdha pa~nchabhirnishitaiH sharaiH |
rukmapu~NkhairmaheShvAso gArdhrapatrairajihmagaiH
shlokas.16:
sAtyakiM tu mahArAja prahasanniva bhArata |
duHshAsanastribhirviddhvA punarvivyAdha pa~nchabhiH
shlokas.17:
shaineyastava putraM tu viddhvA pa~nchabhirAshugaiH |
dhanushchAsya raNe ChittvA vismayannarjunaM yayau
shlokas.18:
tato duHshAsanaH kruddho vRRiShNivIrAya gachChate |
sarvapArashavIM shaktiM visasarja jighA.nsayA
shlokas.19:
tAM tu shaktiM tadA ghorAM tava putrasya sAtyakiH |
chichCheda shatadhA rAjannishitaiH ka~NkapatribhiH
shlokas.20:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya putrastava janeshvara |
sAtyakiM dashabhirviddhvA siMhanAdaM nanAda ha
shlokas.21:
sAtyakistu raNe kruddho mohayitvA sutaM tava |
sharairagnishikhAkArairAjaghAna stanAntare
sarvAyasaistIkShNavaktrairaShTAbhirvivyadhe punaH
shlokas.22:
duHshAsanastu vi.nshatyA sAtyakiM pratyavidhyata |
sAtvato.api mahArAja taM vivyAdha stanAntare
tribhireva mahAvegaiH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.23:
tato.asya vAhAnnishitaiH sharairjaghne mahArathaH |
sArathiM cha susa~NkruddhaH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.24:
dhanurekena bhallena hastAvApaM cha pa~nchabhiH |
dhvajaM cha rathashaktiM cha bhallAbhyAM paramAstravit
chichCheda vishikhaistIkShNaistathobhau pArShNisArathI
shlokas.25:
sa ChinnadhanvA viratho hatAshvo hatasArathiH |
trigartasenApatinA svarathenApavAhitaH
shlokas.26:
tamabhidrutya shaineyo muhUrtamiva bhArata |
na jaghAna mahAbAhurbhImasenavachaH smaran
shlokas.27:
bhImasenena hi vadhaH sutAnAM tava bhArata |
pratij~nAtaH sabhAmadhye sarveShAmeva sa.nyuge
shlokas.28:
tathA duHshAsanaM jitvA sAtyakiH sa.nyuge prabho |
jagAma tvarito rAjanyena yAto dhana~njayaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
kiM tasyAM mama senAyAM nAsankechinmahArathAH |
ye tathA sAtyakiM yAntaM naivAghnannApyavArayan
shlokas.2:
eko hi samare karma kRRitavAnsatyavikramaH |
shakratulyabalo yuddhe mahendro dAnaveShviva
shlokas.3:
atha vA shUnyamAsIttadyena yAtaH sa sAtyakiH |
eko vai bahulAH senAH pramRRidnanpuruSharShabhaH
shlokas.4:
kathaM cha yudhyamAnAnAmapakrAnto mahAtmanAm |
eko bahUnAM shaineyastanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.5:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
rAjansenAsamudyogo rathanAgAshvapattimAn |
tumulastava sainyAnAM yugAntasadRRisho.abhavat
shlokas.6:
AhNikeShu samUheShu tava sainyasya mAnada |
nAsti loke samaH kashchitsamUha iti me matiH
shlokas.7:
tatra devAH sma bhAShante chAraNAshcha samAgatAH |
etadantAH samUhA vai bhaviShyanti mahItale
shlokas.8:
na chaiva tAdRRishaH kashchidvyUha AsIdvishAM pate |
yAdRRigjayadrathavadhe droNena vihito.abhavat
shlokas.9:
chaNDavAtAbhipannAnAM samudrANAmiva svanaH |
raNe.abhavadbalaughAnAmanyonyamabhidhAvatAm
shlokas.10:
pArthivAnAM sametAnAM bahUnyAsannarottama |
tvadbale pANDavAnAM cha sahasrANi shatAni cha
shlokas.11:
sa.nrabdhAnAM pravIrANAM samare dRRiDhakarmaNAm |
tatrAsItsumahA~nshabdastumulo lomaharShaNaH
shlokas.12:
athAkrandadbhImaseno dhRRiShTadyumnashcha mAriSha |
nakulaH sahadevashcha dharmarAjashcha pANDavaH
shlokas.13:
AgachChata praharata balavatparidhAvata |
praviShTAvarisenAM hi vIrau mAdhavapANDavau
shlokas.14:
yathA sukhena gachChetAM jayadrathavadhaM prati |
tathA prakuruta kShipramiti sainyAnyachodayat
tayorabhAve kuravaH kRRitArthAH syurvayaM jitAH
shlokas.15:
te yUyaM sahitA bhUtvA tUrNameva balArNavam |
kShobhayadhvaM mahAvegAH pavanAH sAgaraM yathA
shlokas.16:
bhImasenena te rAjanpA~nchAlyena cha choditAH |
AjaghnuH kauravAnsa~Nkhye tyaktvAsUnAtmanaH priyAn
shlokas.17:
ichChanto nidhanaM yuddhe shastrairuttamatejasaH |
svargArthaM mitrakAryArthaM nAbhyarakShanta jIvitam
shlokas.18:
tathaiva tAvakA rAjanprArthayanto mahadyashaH |
AryAM yuddhe matiM kRRitvA yuddhAyaivopatasthire
shlokas.19:
tasmi.nstu tumule yuddhe vartamAne mahAbhaye |
hatvA sarvANi sainyAni prAyAtsAtyakirarjunam
shlokas.20:
kavachAnAM prabhAstatra sUryarashmivichitritAH |
dRRiShTIH sa~Nkhye sainikAnAM pratijaghnuH samantataH
shlokas.21:
tathA prayatamAneShu pANDaveyeShu nirbhayaH |
duryodhano mahArAja vyagAhata mahadbalam
shlokas.22:
sa saMnipAtastumulasteShAM tasya cha bhArata |
abhavatsarvasainyAnAmabhAvakaraNo mahAn
shlokas.23:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tathA gateShu sainyeShu tathA kRRichChragataH svayam |
kachchidduryodhanaH sUta nAkArShItpRRiShThato raNam
shlokas.24:
ekasya cha bahUnAM cha saMnipAto mahAhave |
visheShato nRRipatinA viShamaH pratibhAti me
shlokas.25:
so.atyantasukhasa.nvRRiddho lakShmyA lokasya cheshvaraH |
eko bahUnsamAsAdya kachchinnAsItparA~NmukhaH
shlokas.26:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
rAjansa~NgrAmamAshcharyaM tava putrasya bhArata |
ekasya cha bahUnAM cha shRRiNuShva gadato.adbhutam
shlokas.27:
duryodhanena sahasA pANDavI pRRitanA raNe |
nalinI dviradeneva samantAdvipraloDitA
shlokas.28:
tathA senAM kRRitAM dRRiShTvA tava putreNa kaurava |
bhImasenapurogAstaM pA~nchAlAH samupAdravan
shlokas.29:
sa bhImasenaM dashabhirmAdrIputrau tribhistribhiH |
virATadrupadau ShaDbhiH shatena cha shikhaNDinam
shlokas.30:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha vi.nshatyA dharmaputraM cha saptabhiH |
kekayAndashabhirviddhvA draupadeyA.nstribhistribhiH
shlokas.31:
shatashashchAparAnyodhAnsadvipA.nshcha rathAnraNe |
sharairavachakartograiH kruddho.antaka iva prajAH
shlokas.32:
na sa.ndadhanvimu~nchanvA maNDalIkRRitakArmukaH |
adRRishyata ripUnnighna~nshikShayAstrabalena cha
shlokas.33:
tasya tAnnighnataH shatrUnhemapRRiShThaM mahaddhanuH |
bhallAbhyAM pANDavo jyeShThastridhA chichCheda mAriSha
shlokas.34:
vivyAdha chainaM bahubhiH samyagastaiH shitaiH sharaiH |
varmANyAshu samAsAdya te bhagnAH kShitimAvishan
shlokas.35:
tataH pramuditAH pArthAH parivavruryudhiShThiram |
yathA vRRitravadhe devA mudA shakraM maharShibhiH
shlokas.36:
atha duryodhano rAjA dRRiDhamAdAya kArmukam |
tiShTha tiShTheti rAjAnaM bruvanpANDavamabhyayAt
shlokas.37:
taM tathA vAdinaM rAja.nstava putraM mahAratham |
pratyudyayuH pramuditAH pA~nchAlA jayagRRiddhinaH
shlokas.38:
tAndroNaH pratijagrAha parIpsanyudhi pANDavam |
chaNDavAtoddhutAnmeghAnsajalAnachalo yathA
shlokas.39:
tatra rAjanmahAnAsItsa~NgrAmo bhUrivardhanaH |
rudrasyAkrIDasa~NkAshaH saMhAraH sarvadehinAm

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
aparAhNe mahArAja sa~NgrAmaH samapadyata |
parjanyasamanirghoShaH punardroNasya somakaiH
shlokas.2:
shoNAshvaM rathamAsthAya naravIraH samAhitaH |
samare.abhyadravatpANDU~njavamAsthAya madhyamam
shlokas.3:
tava priyahite yukto maheShvAso mahAbalaH |
chitrapu~NkhaiH shitairbANaiH kalashottamasambhavaH
shlokas.4:
varAnvarAnhi yodhAnAM vichinvanniva bhArata |
akrIData raNe rAjanbhAradvAjaH pratApavAn
shlokas.5:
tamabhyayAdbRRihatkShatraH kekayAnAM mahArathaH |
bhrAtR^INAM vIrapa~nchAnAM jyeShThaH samarakarkashaH
shlokas.6:
vimu~nchanvishikhA.nstIkShNAnAchAryaM ChAdayanbhRRisham |
mahAmegho yathA varShaM vimu~nchangandhamAdane
shlokas.7:
tasya droNo mahArAja svarNapu~NkhA~nshilAshitAn |
preShayAmAsa sa~NkruddhaH sAyakAndasha sapta cha
shlokas.8:
tA.nstu droNadhanurmuktAnghorAnAshIviShopamAn |
ekaikaM dashabhirbANairyudhi chichCheda hRRiShTavat
shlokas.9:
tasya tallAghavaM dRRiShTvA prahasandvijasattamaH |
preShayAmAsa vishikhAnaShTau saMnataparvaNaH
shlokas.10:
tAndRRiShTvA patataH shIghraM droNachApachyutA~nsharAn |
avArayachCharaireva tAvadbhirnishitairdRRiDhaiH
shlokas.11:
tato.abhavanmahArAja tava sainyasya vismayaH |
bRRihatkShatreNa tatkarma kRRitaM dRRiShTvA suduShkaram
shlokas.12:
tato droNo mahArAja kekayaM vai visheShayan |
prAdushchakre raNe divyaM brAhmamastraM mahAtapAH
shlokas.13:
tadasya rAjankaikeyaH pratyavArayadachyutaH |
brAhmeNaiva mahAbAhurAhave samudIritam
shlokas.14:
pratihanya tadastraM tu bhAradvAjasya sa.nyuge |
vivyAdha brAhmaNaM ShaShTyA svarNapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH
shlokas.15:
taM droNo dvipadAM shreShTho nArAchena samarpayat |
sa tasya kavachaM bhittvA prAvishaddharaNItalam
shlokas.16:
kRRiShNasarpo yathA mukto valmIkaM nRRipasattama |
tathAbhyagAnmahIM bANo bhittvA kaikeyamAhave
shlokas.17:
so.atividdho mahArAja droNenAstravidA bhRRisham |
krodhena mahatAviShTo vyAvRRitya nayane shubhe
shlokas.18:
droNaM vivyAdha saptatyA svarNapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH |
sArathiM chAsya bhallena bAhvorurasi chArpayat
shlokas.19:
droNastu bahudhA viddho bRRihatkShatreNa mAriSha |
asRRijadvishikhA.nstIkShNAnkekayasya rathaM prati
shlokas.20:
vyAkulIkRRitya taM droNo bRRihatkShatraM mahAratham |
vyasRRijatsAyakaM tIkShNaM kekayaM prati bhArata
shlokas.21:
sa gADhaviddhastenAshu mahArAja stanAntare |
rathAtpuruShashArdUlaH sambhinnahRRidayo.apatat
shlokas.22:
bRRihatkShatre hate rAjankekayAnAM mahArathe |
shaishupAliH susa~Nkruddho yantAramidamabravIt
shlokas.23:
sArathe yAhi yatraiSha droNastiShThati da.nshitaH |
vinighnankekayAnsarvAnpA~nchAlAnAM cha vAhinIm
shlokas.24:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA sArathI rathinAM varam |
droNAya prApayAmAsa kAmbojairjavanairhayaiH
shlokas.25:
dhRRiShTaketushcha chedInAmRRiShabho.atibaloditaH |
sahasA prApataddroNaM pata~Nga iva pAvakam
shlokas.26:
so.abhyavidhyattato droNaM ShaShTyA sAshvarathadhvajam |
punashchAnyaiH sharaistIkShNaiH suptaM vyAghraM tudanniva
shlokas.27:
tasya droNo dhanurmadhye kShurapreNa shitena ha |
chichCheda rAj~no balino yatamAnasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.28:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya shaishupAlirmahArathaH |
vivyAdha sAyakairdroNaM punaH sunishitairdRRiDhaiH
shlokas.29:
tasya droNo hayAnhatvA sArathiM cha mahAbalaH |
athainaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA sAyakAnAM samArpayat
shlokas.30:
viratho vidhanuShkashcha chedirAjo.api sa.nyuge |
gadAM chikShepa sa~Nkruddho bhAradvAjarathaM prati
shlokas.31:
tAmApatantIM sahasA ghorarUpAM bhayAvahAm |
ashmasAramayIM gurvIM tapanIyavibhUShitAm
sharairanekasAhasrairbhAradvAjo nyapAtayat
shlokas.32:
sA papAta gadA bhUmau bhAradvAjena sAditA |
raktamAlyAmbaradharA tAreva nabhasastalAt
shlokas.33:
gadAM vinihatAM dRRiShTvA dhRRiShTaketuramarShaNaH |
tomaraM vyasRRijattUrNaM shaktiM cha kanakojjvalAm
shlokas.34:
tomaraM tu tribhirbANairdroNashChittvA mahAmRRidhe |
shaktiM chichCheda sahasA kRRitahasto mahAbalaH
shlokas.35:
tato.asya vishikhaM tIkShNaM vadhArthaM vadhakA~NkShiNaH |
preShayAmAsa samare bhAradvAjaH pratApavAn
shlokas.36:
sa tasya kavachaM bhittvA hRRidayaM chAmitaujasaH |
abhyagAddharaNIM bANo ha.nsaH padmasaro yathA
shlokas.37:
pata~NgaM hi grasechchASho yathA rAjanbubhukShitaH |
tathA droNo.agrasachChUro dhRRiShTaketuM mahAmRRidhe
shlokas.38:
nihate chedirAje tu tatkhaNDaM pitryamAvishat |
amarShavashamApannaH putro.asya paramAstravit
shlokas.39:
tamapi prahasandroNaH sharairninye yamakShayam |
mahAvyAghro mahAraNye mRRigashAvaM yathA balI
shlokas.40:
teShu prakShIyamANeShu pANDaveyeShu bhArata |
jarAsandhasuto vIraH svayaM droNamupAdravat
shlokas.41:
sa tu droNaM mahArAja ChAdayansAyakaiH shitaiH |
adRRishyamakarottUrNaM jalado bhAskaraM yathA
shlokas.42:
tasya tallAghavaM dRRiShTvA droNaH kShatriyamardanaH |
vyasRRijatsAyakA.nstUrNaM shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.43:
ChAdayitvA raNe droNo rathasthaM rathinAM varam |
jArAsandhimatho jaghne miShatAM sarvadhanvinAm
shlokas.44:
yo yaH sma lIyate droNaM taM taM droNo.antakopamaH |
Adatta sarvabhUtAni prApte kAle yathAntakaH
shlokas.45:
tato droNo maheShvAso nAma vishrAvya sa.nyuge |
sharairanekasAhasraiH pANDaveyAnvyamohayat
shlokas.46:
tato droNA~NkitA bANAH svarNapu~NkhAH shilAshitAH |
narAnnAgAnhayA.nshchaiva nijaghnuH sarvato raNe
shlokas.47:
te vadhyamAnA droNena shakreNeva mahAsurAH |
samakampanta pA~nchAlA gAvaH shItArditA iva
shlokas.48:
tato niShTAnako ghoraH pANDavAnAmajAyata |
droNena vadhyamAneShu sainyeShu bharatarShabha
shlokas.49:
mohitAH sharavarSheNa bhAradvAjasya sa.nyuge |
UrugrAhagRRihItA hi pA~nchAlAnAM mahArathAH
shlokas.50:
chedayashcha mahArAja sRRi~njayAH somakAstathA |
abhyadravanta saMhRRiShTA bhAradvAjaM yuyutsayA
shlokas.51:
hata droNaM hata droNamiti te droNamabhyayuH |
yatantaH puruShavyAghrAH sarvashaktyA mahAdyutim
ninIShanto raNe droNaM yamasya sadanaM prati
shlokas.52:
yatamAnA.nstu tAnvIrAnbhAradvAjaH shilImukhaiH |
yamAya preShayAmAsa chedimukhyAnvisheShataH
shlokas.53:
teShu prakShIyamANeShu chedimukhyeShu bhArata |
pA~nchAlAH samakampanta droNasAyakapIDitAH
shlokas.54:
prAkroshanbhImasenaM te dhRRiShTadyumnarathaM prati |
dRRiShTvA droNasya karmANi tathArUpANi mAriSha
shlokas.55:
brAhmaNena tapo nUnaM charitaM dushcharaM mahat |
tathA hi yudhi vikrAnto dahati kShatriyarShabhAn
shlokas.56:
