dharmo yuddhaM kShatriyasya brAhmaNasya paraM tapaH |
tapasvI kRRitavidyashcha prekShitenApi nirdahet
shlokas.57:
droNAstramagnisa.nsparshaM praviShTAH kShatriyarShabhAH |
bahavo dustaraM ghoraM yatrAdahyanta bhArata
shlokas.58:
yathAbalaM yathotsAhaM yathAsattvaM mahAdyutiH |
mohayansarvabhUtAni droNo hanti balAni naH
shlokas.59:
teShAM tadvachanaM shrutvA kShatradharmA vyavasthitaH |
ardhachandreNa chichCheda droNasya sasharaM dhanuH
shlokas.60:
sa sa.nrabdhataro bhUtvA droNaH kShatriyamardanaH |
anyatkArmukamAdAya bhAsvaraM vegavattaram
shlokas.61:
tatrAdhAya sharaM tIkShNaM bhAraghnaM vimalaM dRRiDham |
AkarNapUrNamAchAryo balavAnabhyavAsRRijat
shlokas.62:
sa hatvA kShatradharmANaM jagAma dharaNItalam |
sa bhinnahRRidayo vAhAdapatanmedinItale
shlokas.63:
tataH sainyAnyakampanta dhRRiShTadyumnasute hate |
atha droNaM samArohachchekitAno mahArathaH
shlokas.64:
sa droNaM dashabhirbANaiH pratyavidhyatstanAntare |
chaturbhiH sArathiM chAsya chaturbhishchaturo hayAn
shlokas.65:
tasyAchAryaH ShoDashabhiravidhyaddakShiNaM bhujam |
dhvajaM ShoDashabhirbANairyantAraM chAsya saptabhiH
shlokas.66:
tasya sUte hate te.ashvA rathamAdAya vidrutAH |
samare sharasa.nvItA bhAradvAjena mAriSha
shlokas.67:
chekitAnarathaM dRRiShTvA vidrutaM hatasArathim |
pA~nchAlAnpANDavA.nshchaiva mahadbhayamathAvishat
shlokas.68:
tAnsametAnraNe shUrA.nshchedipA~nchAlasRRi~njayAn |
samantAddrAvayandroNo bahvashobhata mAriSha
shlokas.69:
AkarNapalitaH shyAmo vayasAshItikAtparaH |
raNe paryacharaddroNo vRRiddhaH ShoDashavarShavat
shlokas.70:
atha droNaM mahArAja vicharantamabhItavat |
vajrahastamamanyanta shatravaH shatrusUdanam
shlokas.71:
tato.abravInmahArAja drupado buddhimAnnRRipa |
lubdho.ayaM kShatriyAnhanti vyAghraH kShudramRRigAniva
shlokas.72:
kRRichChrAnduryodhano lokAnpApaH prApsyati durmatiH |
yasya lobhAdvinihatAH samare kShatriyarShabhAH
shlokas.73:
shatashaH sherate bhUmau nikRRittA govRRiShA iva |
rudhireNa parItA~NgAH shvasRRigAlAdanIkRRitAH
shlokas.74:
evamuktvA mahArAja drupado.akShauhiNIpatiH |
puraskRRitya raNe pArthAndroNamabhyadravaddrutam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vyUheShvAloDyamAneShu pANDavAnAM tatastataH |
sudUramanvayuH pArthAH pA~nchAlAH saha somakaiH
shlokas.2:
vartamAne tathA raudre sa~NgrAme lomaharShaNe |
prakShaye jagatastIvre yugAnta iva bhArata
shlokas.3:
droNe yudhi parAkrAnte nardamAne muhurmuhuH |
pA~nchAleShu cha kShINeShu vadhyamAneShu pANDuShu
shlokas.4:
nApashyachCharaNaM ki~nchiddharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
chintayAmAsa rAjendra kathametadbhaviShyati
shlokas.5:
tatrAvekShya dishaH sarvAH savyasAchididRRikShayA |
yudhiShThiro dadarshAtha naiva pArthaM na mAdhavam
shlokas.6:
so.apashyannarashArdUlaM vAnararShabhalakShaNam |
gANDIvasya cha nirghoShamashRRiNvanvyathitendriyaH
shlokas.7:
apashyansAtyakiM chApi vRRiShNInAM pravaraM ratham |
chintayAbhiparItA~Ngo dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
nAdhyagachChattadA shAntiM tAvapashyannararShabhau
shlokas.8:
lokopakroshabhIrutvAddharmarAjo mahAyashAH |
achintayanmahAbAhuH shaineyasya rathaM prati
shlokas.9:
padavIM preShitashchaiva phalgunasya mayA raNe |
shaineyaH sAtyakiH satyo mitrANAmabhaya~NkaraH
shlokas.10:
tadidaM hyekamevAsIddvidhA jAtaM mamAdya vai |
sAtyakishcha hi me j~neyaH pANDavashcha dhana~njayaH
shlokas.11:
sAtyakiM preShayitvA tu pANDavasya padAnugam |
sAtvatasyApi kaM yuddhe preShayiShye padAnugam
shlokas.12:
kariShyAmi prayatnena bhrAturanveShaNaM yadi |
yuyudhAnamananviShya loko mAM garhayiShyati
shlokas.13:
bhrAturanveShaNaM kRRitvA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
parityajati vArShNeyaM sAtyakiM satyavikramam
shlokas.14:
lokApavAdabhIrutvAtso.ahaM pArthaM vRRikodaram |
padavIM preShayiShyAmi mAdhavasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.15:
yathaiva cha mama prItirarjune shatrusUdane |
tathaiva vRRiShNivIre.api sAtvate yuddhadurmade
shlokas.16:
atibhAre niyuktashcha mayA shaineyanandanaH |
sa tu mitroparodhena gauravAchcha mahAbalaH
praviShTo bhAratIM senAM makaraH sAgaraM yathA
shlokas.17:
asau hi shrUyate shabdaH shUrANAmanivartinAm |
mithaH sa.nyudhyamAnAnAM vRRiShNivIreNa dhImatA
shlokas.18:
prAptakAlaM subalavannishchitya bahudhA hi me |
tatraiva pANDaveyasya bhImasenasya dhanvinaH
gamanaM rochate mahyaM yatra yAtau mahArathau
shlokas.19:
na chApyasahyaM bhImasya vidyate bhuvi ki~nchana |
shakto hyeSha raNe yattAnpRRithivyAM sarvadhanvinaH
svabAhubalamAsthAya prativyUhituma~njasA
shlokas.20:
yasya bAhubalaM sarve samAshritya mahAtmanaH |
vanavAsAnnivRRittAH sma na cha yuddheShu nirjitAH
shlokas.21:
ito gate bhImasene sAtvataM prati pANDave |
sanAthau bhavitArau hi yudhi sAtvataphalgunau
shlokas.22:
kAmaM tvashochanIyau tau raNe sAtvataphalgunau |
rakShitau vAsudevena svayaM chAstravishAradau
shlokas.23:
avashyaM tu mayA kAryamAtmanaH shokanAshanam |
tasmAdbhImaM niyokShyAmi sAtvatasya padAnugam
tataH pratikRRitaM manye vidhAnaM sAtyakiM prati
shlokas.24:
evaM nishchitya manasA dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
yantAramabravIdrAjanbhImaM prati nayasva mAm
shlokas.25:
dharmarAjavachaH shrutvA sArathirhayakovidaH |
rathaM hemapariShkAraM bhImAntikamupAnayat
shlokas.26:
bhImasenamanuprApya prAptakAlamanusmaran |
kashmalaM prAvishadrAjA bahu tatra samAdishan
shlokas.27:
yaH sadevAnsagandharvAndaityA.nshchaikaratho.ajayat |
tasya lakShma na pashyAmi bhImasenAnujasya te
shlokas.28:
tato.abravIddharmarAjaM bhImasenastathAgatam |
naivAdrAkShaM na chAshrauShaM tava kashmalamIdRRisham
shlokas.29:
purA hi duHkhadIrNAnAM bhavAngatirabhUddhi naH |
uttiShThottiShTha rAjendra shAdhi kiM karavANi te
shlokas.30:
na hyasAdhyamakAryaM vA vidyate mama mAnada |
Aj~nApaya kurushreShTha mA cha shoke manaH kRRithAH
shlokas.31:
tamabravIdashrupUrNaH kRRiShNasarpa iva shvasan |
bhImasenamidaM vAkyaM pramlAnavadano nRRipaH
shlokas.32:
yathA sha~Nkhasya nirghoShaH pA~nchajanyasya shrUyate |
prerito vAsudevena sa.nrabdhena yashasvinA
nUnamadya hataH shete tava bhrAtA dhana~njayaH
shlokas.33:
tasminvinihate nUnaM yudhyate.asau janArdanaH |
yasya sattvavato vIryamupajIvanti pANDavAH
shlokas.34:
yaM bhayeShvabhigachChanti sahasrAkShamivAmarAH |
sa shUraH saindhavaprepsuranvayAdbhAratIM chamUm
shlokas.35:
tasya vai gamanaM vidmo bhIma nAvartanaM punaH |
shyAmo yuvA guDAkesho darshanIyo mahAbhujaH
shlokas.36:
vyUDhorasko mahAskandho mattadviradavikramaH |
chakoranetrastAmrAkSho dviShatAmaghavardhanaH
shlokas.37:
tadidaM mama bhadraM te shokasthAnamari.ndama |
arjunArthaM mahAbAho sAtvatasya cha kAraNAt
shlokas.38:
vardhate haviShevAgniridhyamAnaH punaH punaH |
tasya lakShma na pashyAmi tena vindAmi kashmalam
shlokas.39:
taM viddhi puruShavyAghraM sAtvataM cha mahAratham |
sa taM mahArathaM pashchAdanuyAtastavAnujam
tamapashyanmahAbAhumahaM vindAmi kashmalam
shlokas.40:
tasmAtkRRiShNo raNe nUnaM yudhyate yuddhakovidaH |
yasya vIryavato vIryamupajIvanti pANDavAH
shlokas.41:
sa tatra gachCha kaunteya yatra yAto dhana~njayaH |
sAtyakishcha mahAvIryaH kartavyaM yadi manyase
vachanaM mama dharmaj~na jyeShTho bhrAtA bhavAmi te
shlokas.42:
na te.arjunastathA j~neyo j~nAtavyaH sAtyakiryathA |
chikIrShurmatpriyaM pArtha prayAtaH savyasAchinaH
padavIM durgamAM ghorAmagamyAmakRRitAtmabhiH
shlokas.43:
bhImasena uvAcha||
brahmeshAnendravaruNAnavahadyaH purA rathaH |
tamAsthAya gatau kRRiShNau na tayorvidyate bhayam
shlokas.44:
Aj~nAM tu shirasA bibhradeSha gachChAmi mA shuchaH |
sametya tAnnaravyAghrA.nstava dAsyAmi sa.nvidam
shlokas.45:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
etAvaduktvA prayayau paridAya yudhiShThiram |
dhRRiShTadyumnAya balavAnsuhRRidbhyashcha punaH punaH
dhRRiShTadyumnaM chedamAha bhImaseno mahAbalaH
shlokas.46:
viditaM te mahAbAho yathA droNo mahArathaH |
grahaNe dharmarAjasya sarvopAyena vartate
shlokas.47:
na cha me gamane kRRityaM tAdRRikpArShata vidyate |
yAdRRishaM rakShaNe rAj~naH kAryamAtyayikaM hi naH
shlokas.48:
evamukto.asmi pArthena prativaktuM sma notsahe |
prayAsye tatra yatrAsau mumUrShuH saindhavaH sthitaH
dharmarAjasya vachane sthAtavyamavisha~NkayA
shlokas.49:
so.adya yatto raNe pArthaM parirakSha yudhiShThiram |
etaddhi sarvakAryANAM paramaM kRRityamAhave
shlokas.50:
tamabravInmahArAja dhRRiShTadyumno vRRikodaram |
Ipsitena mahAbAho gachCha pArthAvichArayan
shlokas.51:
nAhatvA samare droNo dhRRiShTadyumnaM katha~nchana |
nigrahaM dharmarAjasya prakariShyati sa.nyuge
shlokas.52:
tato nikShipya rAjAnaM dhRRiShTadyumnAya pANDavaH |
abhivAdya guruM jyeShThaM prayayau yatra phalgunaH
shlokas.53:
pariShvaktastu kaunteyo dharmarAjena bhArata |
AghrAtashcha tathA mUrdhni shrAvitashchAshiShaH shubhAH
shlokas.54:
bhImaseno mahAbAhuH kavachI shubhakuNDalI |
sA~NgadaH satanutrANaH sasharI rathinAM varaH
shlokas.55:
tasya kArShNAyasaM varma hemachitraM maharddhimat |
vibabhau parvatashliShTaH savidyudiva toyadaH
shlokas.56:
pItaraktAsitasitairvAsobhishcha suveShTitaH |
kaNThatrANena cha babhau sendrAyudha ivAmbudaH
shlokas.57:
prayAte bhImasene tu tava sainyaM yuyutsayA |
pA~nchajanyaravo ghoraH punarAsIdvishAM pate
shlokas.58:
taM shrutvA ninadaM ghoraM trailokyatrAsanaM mahat |
punarbhImaM mahAbAhurdharmaputro.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.59:
eSha vRRiShNipravIreNa dhmAtaH salilajo bhRRisham |
pRRithivIM chAntarikShaM cha vinAdayati sha~NkharAT
shlokas.60:
nUnaM vyasanamApanne sumahatsavyasAchini |
kurubhiryudhyate sArdhaM sarvaishchakragadAdharaH
shlokas.61:
nUnamAryA mahatkuntI pApamadya nidarshanam |
draupadI cha subhadrA cha pashyanti saha bandhubhiH
shlokas.62:
sa bhImastvarayA yukto yAhi yatra dhana~njayaH |
muhyantIva hi me sarvA dhana~njayadidRRikShayA
dishaH sapradishaH pArtha sAtvatasya cha kAraNAt
shlokas.63:
gachCha gachCheti cha punarbhImasenamabhAShata |
bhRRishaM sa prahito bhrAtrA bhrAtA bhrAtuH priya~NkaraH
Ahatya dundubhiM bhImaH sha~NkhaM pradhmAya chAsakRRit
shlokas.64:
vinadya siMhanAdaM cha jyAM vikarShanpunaH punaH |
darshayanghoramAtmAnamamitrAnsahasAbhyayAt
shlokas.65:
tamUhurjavanA dAntA vikurvANA hayottamAH |
vishokenAbhisa.nyattA manomArutaraMhasaH
shlokas.66:
ArujanvirujanpArtho jyAM vikarSha.nshcha pANinA |
so.avakarShanvikarSha.nshcha senAgraM samaloDayat
shlokas.67:
taM prayAntaM mahAbAhuM pA~nchAlAH sahasomakAH |
pRRiShThato.anuyayuH shUrA maghavantamivAmarAH
shlokas.68:
taM sasenA mahArAja sodaryAH paryavArayan |
duHshalashchitrasenashcha kuNDabhedI vivi.nshatiH
shlokas.69:
durmukho duHsahashchaiva vikarNashcha shalastathA |
vindAnuvindau sumukho dIrghabAhuH sudarshanaH
shlokas.70:
vRRindArakaH suhastashcha suSheNo dIrghalochanaH |
abhayo raudrakarmA cha suvarmA durvimochanaH
shlokas.71:
vividhai rathinAM shreShThAH saha sainyaiH sahAnugaiH |
sa.nyattAH samare shUrA bhImasenamupAdravan
shlokas.72:
tAnsamIkShya tu kaunteyo bhImasenaH parAkramI |
abhyavartata vegena siMhaH kShudramRRigAniva
shlokas.73:
te mahAstrANi divyAni tatra vIrA adarshayan |
vArayantaH sharairbhImaM meghAH sUryamivoditam
shlokas.74:
sa tAnatItya vegena droNAnIkamupAdravat |
agratashcha gajAnIkaM sharavarShairavAkirat
shlokas.75:
so.achireNaiva kAlena tadgajAnIkamAshugaiH |
dishaH sarvAH samabhyasya vyadhamatpavanAtmajaH
shlokas.76:
trAsitAH sharabhasyeva garjitena vane mRRigAH |
prAdravandviradAH sarve nadanto bhairavAnravAn
shlokas.78:
lalATe.atADayachchainaM nArAchena smayanniva |
UrdhvarashmirivAdityo vibabhau tatra pANDavaH
shlokas.79:
sa manyamAnastvAchAryo mamAyaM phalguno yathA |
bhImaH kariShyate pUjAmityuvAcha vRRikodaram
shlokas.80:
bhImasena na te shakyaM praveShTumarivAhinIm |
mAmanirjitya samare shatrumadhye mahAbala
shlokas.81:
yadi te so.anujaH kRRiShNaH praviShTo.anumate mama |
anIkaM na tu shakyaM bhoH praveShTumiha vai tvayA
shlokas.82:
atha bhImastu tachChrutvA gurorvAkyamapetabhIH |
kruddhaH provAcha vai droNaM raktatAmrekShaNaH shvasan
shlokas.83:
tavArjuno nAnumate brahmabandho raNAjiram |
praviShTaH sa hi durdharShaH shakrasyApi vishedbalam
shlokas.84:
yena vai paramAM pUjAM kurvatA mAnito hyasi |
nArjuno.ahaM ghRRiNI droNa bhImaseno.asmi te ripuH
shlokas.85:
pitA nastvaM gururbandhustathA putrA hi te vayam |
iti manyAmahe sarve bhavantaM praNatAH sthitAH
shlokas.86:
adya tadviparItaM te vadato.asmAsu dRRishyate |
yadi shatruM tvamAtmAnaM manyase tattathAstviha
eSha te sadRRishaM shatroH karma bhImaH karomyaham
shlokas.87:
athodbhrAmya gadAM bhImaH kAladaNDamivAntakaH |
droNAyAvasRRijadrAjansa rathAdavapupluve
shlokas.89:
taM punaH parivavruste tava putrA rathottamam |
anyaM cha rathamAsthAya droNaH praharatAM varaH
shlokas.90:
tataH kruddho mahArAja bhImasenaH parAkramI |
agrataH syandanAnIkaM sharavarShairavAkirat
shlokas.91:
te vadhyamAnAH samare tava putrA mahArathAH |
bhImaM bhImabalaM yuddhe.ayodhaya.nstu jayaiShiNaH
shlokas.92:
tato duHshAsanaH kruddho rathashaktiM samAkShipat |
sarvapArashavIM tIkShNAM jighA.nsuH pANDunandanam
shlokas.93:
ApatantIM mahAshaktiM tava putraprachoditAm |
dvidhA chichCheda tAM bhImastadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.94:
athAnyairnishitairbANaiH sa~NkruddhaH kuNDabhedinam |
suSheNaM dIrghanetraM cha tribhistrInavadhIdbalI
shlokas.95:
tato vRRindArakaM vIraM kurUNAM kIrtivardhanam |
putrANAM tava vIrANAM yudhyatAmavadhItpunaH
shlokas.96:
abhayaM raudrakarmANaM durvimochanameva cha |
tribhistrInavadhIdbhImaH punareva sutA.nstava
shlokas.97:
vadhyamAnA mahArAja putrAstava balIyasA |
bhImaM praharatAM shreShThaM samantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.98:
vindAnuvindau sahitau suvarmANaM cha te sutam |
prahasanniva kaunteyaH sharairninye yamakShayam
shlokas.99:
tataH sudarshanaM vIraM putraM te bharatarShabha |
vivyAdha samare tUrNaM sa papAta mamAra cha
shlokas.100:
so.achireNaiva kAlena tadrathAnIkamAshugaiH |
dishaH sarvAH samabhyasya vyadhamatpANDunandanaH
shlokas.101:
tato vai rathaghoSheNa garjitena mRRigA iva |
vadhyamAnAshcha samare putrAstava vishAM pate
prAdravansarathAH sarve bhImasenabhayArditAH
shlokas.102:
anuyAya tu kaunteyaH putrANAM te mahadbalam |
vivyAdha samare rAjankauraveyAnsamantataH
shlokas.103:
vadhyamAnA mahArAja bhImasenena tAvakAH |
tyaktvA bhImaM raNe yAnti chodayanto hayottamAn
shlokas.104:
tA.nstu nirjitya samare bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
siMhanAdaravaM chakre bAhushabdaM cha pANDavaH
shlokas.105:
talashabdaM cha sumahatkRRitvA bhImo mahAbalaH |
vyatItya rathinashchApi droNAnIkamupAdravat

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tamuttIrNaM rathAnIkAttamaso bhAskaraM yathA |
didhArayiShurAchAryaH sharavarShairavAkirat
shlokas.2:
pibanniva sharaughA.nstAndroNachApavarAtigAn |
so.abhyavartata sodaryAnmAyayA mohayanbalam
shlokas.3:
taM mRRidhe vegamAsthAya paraM paramadhanvinaH |
choditAstava putraishcha sarvataH paryavArayan
shlokas.4:
sa tathA sa.nvRRito bhImaH prahasanniva bhArata |
udayachChadgadAM tebhyo ghorAM tAM siMhavannadan
avAsRRijachcha vegena teShu tAnpramathadbalI
shlokas.5:
sendrAshanirivendreNa praviddhA saMhatAtmanA |
ghoSheNa mahatA rAjanpUrayitveva medinIm
jvalantI tejasA bhImA trAsayAmAsa te sutAn
shlokas.6:
tAM patantIM mahAvegAM dRRiShTvA tejobhisa.nvRRitAm |
prAdrava.nstAvakAH sarve nadanto bhairavAnravAn
shlokas.7:
taM cha shabdamasa.nsahyaM tasyAH sa.nlakShya mAriSha |
prApatanmanujAstatra rathebhyo rathinastadA
shlokas.8:
sa tAnvidrAvya kaunteyaH sa~Nkhye.amitrAndurAsadaH |
suparNa iva vegena pakShirADatyagAchchamUm
shlokas.9:
tathA taM viprakurvANaM rathayUthapayUthapam |
bhAradvAjo mahArAja bhImasenaM samabhyayAt
shlokas.10:
droNastu samare bhImaM vArayitvA sharormibhiH |
akarotsahasA nAdaM pANDUnAM bhayamAdadhat
shlokas.11:
tadyuddhamAsItsumahadghoraM devAsuropamam |
droNasya cha mahArAja bhImasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.12:
yadA tu vishikhaistIkShNairdroNachApaviniHsRRitaiH |
vadhyante samare vIrAH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.13:
tato rathAdavaplutya vegamAsthAya pANDavaH |
nimIlya nayane rAjanpadAtirdroNamabhyayAt
shlokas.14:
yathA hi govRRiSho varShaM pratigRRihNAti lIlayA |
tathA bhImo naravyAghraH sharavarShaM samagrahIt
shlokas.15:
sa vadhyamAnaH samare rathaM droNasya mAriSha |
IShAyAM pANinA gRRihya prachikShepa mahAbalaH
shlokas.16:
droNastu satvaro rAjankShipto bhImena sa.nyuge |
rathamanyaM samAsthAya vyUhadvAramupAyayau
shlokas.17:
tasminkShaNe tasya yantA tUrNamashvAnachodayat |
bhImasenasya kauravya tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.18:
tataH svarathamAsthAya bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
abhyavartata vegena tava putrasya vAhinIm
shlokas.19:
sa mRRidnankShatriyAnAjau vAto vRRikShAnivoddhataH |
agachChaddArayansenAM sindhuvego nagAniva
shlokas.20:
bhojAnIkaM samAsAdya hArdikyenAbhirakShitam |
pramathya bahudhA rAjanbhImasenaH samabhyayAt
shlokas.21:
santrAsayannanIkAni talashabdena mAriSha |
ajayatsarvasainyAni shArdUla iva govRRiShAn
shlokas.22:
bhojAnIkamatikramya kAmbojAnAM cha vAhinIm |
tathA mlechChagaNA.nshchAnyAnbahUnyuddhavishAradAn
shlokas.23:
sAtyakiM chApi samprekShya yudhyamAnaM nararShabham |
rathena yattaH kaunteyo vegena prayayau tadA
shlokas.24:
bhImaseno mahArAja draShTukAmo dhana~njayam |
atItya samare yodhA.nstAvakAnpANDunandanaH
shlokas.25:
so.apashyadarjunaM tatra yudhyamAnaM nararShabham |
saindhavasya vadhArthaM hi parAkrAntaM parAkramI
shlokas.26:
arjunaM tatra dRRiShTvAtha chukrosha mahato ravAn |
taM tu tasya mahAnAdaM pArthaH shushrAva nardataH
shlokas.27:
tataH pArtho mahAnAdaM mu~nchanvai mAdhavashcha ha |
abhyayAtAM mahArAja nardantau govRRiShAviva
shlokas.28:
vAsudevArjunau shrutvA ninAdaM tasya shuShmiNaH |
punaH punaH praNadatAM didRRikShantau vRRikodaram
shlokas.29:
bhImasenaravaM shrutvA phalgunasya cha dhanvinaH |
aprIyata mahArAja dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.30:
vishokashchAbhavadrAjA shrutvA taM ninadaM mahat |
dhana~njayasya cha raNe jayamAshAstavAnvibhuH
shlokas.31:
tathA tu nardamAne vai bhImasene raNotkaTe |
smitaM kRRitvA mahAbAhurdharmaputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.32:
hRRidgataM manasA prAha dhyAtvA dharmabhRRitAM varaH |
dattA bhIma tvayA sa.nvitkRRitaM guruvachastathA
shlokas.33:
na hi teShAM jayo yuddhe yeShAM dveShTAsi pANDava |
diShTyA jIvati sa~NgrAme savyasAchI dhana~njayaH
shlokas.34:
diShTyA cha kushalI vIraH sAtyakiH satyavikramaH |
diShTyA shRRiNomi garjantau vAsudevadhana~njayau
shlokas.35:
yena shakraM raNe jitvA tarpito havyavAhanaH |
sa hantA dviShatAM sa~Nkhye diShTyA jIvati phalgunaH
shlokas.36:
yasya bAhubalaM sarve vayamAshritya jIvitAH |
sa hantA ripusainyAnAM diShTyA jIvati phalgunaH
shlokas.37:
nivAtakavachA yena devairapi sudurjayAH |
nirjitA rathinaikena diShTyA pArthaH sa jIvati
shlokas.38:
kauravAnsahitAnsarvAngograhArthe samAgatAn |
yo.ajayanmatsyanagare diShTyA pArthaH sa jIvati
shlokas.39:
kAlakeyasahasrANi chaturdasha mahAraNe |
yo.avadhIdbhujavIryeNa diShTyA pArthaH sa jIvati
shlokas.40:
gandharvarAjaM balinaM duryodhanakRRitena vai |
jitavAnyo.astravIryeNa diShTyA pArthaH sa jIvati
shlokas.41:
kirITamAlI balavA~nshvetAshvaH kRRiShNasArathiH |
mama priyashcha satataM diShTyA jIvati phalgunaH
shlokas.42:
putrashokAbhisantaptashchikIrShuH karma duShkaram |
jayadrathavadhAnveShI pratij~nAM kRRitavAnhi yaH
kachchitsa saindhavaM sa~Nkhye haniShyati dhana~njayaH
shlokas.43:
kachchittIrNapratij~naM hi vAsudevena rakShitam |
anastamita Aditye sameShyAmyahamarjunam
shlokas.44:
kachchitsaindhavako rAjA duryodhanahite rataH |
nandayiShyatyamitrANi phalgunena nipAtitaH
shlokas.45:
kachchidduryodhano rAjA phalgunena nipAtitam |
dRRiShTvA saindhavakaM sa~Nkhye shamamasmAsu dhAsyati
shlokas.46:
dRRiShTvA vinihatAnbhrAtR^InbhImasenena sa.nyuge |
kachchidduryodhano mandaH shamamasmAsu dhAsyati
shlokas.47:
dRRiShTvA chAnyAnbahUnyodhAnpAtitAndharaNItale |
kachchidduryodhano mandaH pashchAttApaM kariShyati
shlokas.48:
kachchidbhIShmeNa no vairamekenaiva prashAmyati |
sheShasya rakShaNArthaM cha sandhAsyati suyodhanaH
shlokas.49:
evaM bahuvidhaM tasya chintayAnasya pArthiva |
kRRipayAbhiparItasya ghoraM yuddhamavartata

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tathA tu nardamAnaM taM bhImasenaM mahAbalam |
meghastanitanirghoShaM ke vIrAH paryavArayan
shlokas.2:
na hi pashyAmyahaM taM vai triShu lokeShu sa~njaya |
kruddhasya bhimasenasya yastiShThedagrato raNe
shlokas.3:
gadAmudyachChamAnasya kAlasyeva mahAmRRidhe |
na hi pashyAmyahaM tAta yastiShTheta raNAjire
shlokas.4:
rathaM rathena yo hanyAtku~njaraM ku~njareNa cha |
kastasya samare sthAtA sAkShAdapi shatakratuH
shlokas.5:
kruddhasya bhImasenasya mama putrA~njighA.nsataH |
duryodhanahite yuktAH samatiShThanta ke.agrataH
shlokas.6:
bhImasenadavAgnestu mama putratRRiNolapam |
pradhakShyato raNamukhe ke vIrAH pramukhe sthitAH
shlokas.7:
kAlyamAnAnhi me putrAnbhImenAvekShya sa.nyuge |
kAleneva prajAH sarvAH ke bhImaM paryavArayan
shlokas.8:
bhImavahneH pradIptasya mama putrAndidhakShataH |
ke shUrAH paryavartanta tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.9:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tathA tu nardamAnaM taM bhImasenaM mahAratham |
tumulenaiva shabdena karNo.apyabhyapatadbalI
shlokas.10:
vyAkShipanbalavachchApamatimAtramamarShaNaH |
karNastu yuddhamAkA~NkShandarshayiShyanbalaM balI
shlokas.11:
prAvepanniva gAtrANi karNabhImasamAgame |
rathinAM sAdinAM chaiva tayoH shrutvA talasvanam
shlokas.12:
bhImasenasya ninadaM ghoraM shrutvA raNAjire |
khaM cha bhUmiM cha sambaddhAM menire kShatriyarShabhAH
shlokas.13:
punarghoreNa nAdena pANDavasya mahAtmanaH |
samare sarvayodhAnAM dhanUMShyabhyapatankShitau
shlokas.14:
vitrastAni cha sarvANi shakRRinmUtraM prasusruvuH |
vAhanAni mahArAja babhUvurvimanA.nsi cha
shlokas.15:
prAdurAsannimittAni ghorANi cha bahUni cha |
tasmi.nstu tumule rAjanbhImakarNasamAgame
shlokas.16:
tataH karNastu vi.nshatyA sharANAM bhImamArdayat |
vivyAdha chAsya tvaritaH sUtaM pa~nchabhirAshugaiH
shlokas.17:
prahasya bhImasenastu karNaM pratyarpayadraNe |
sAyakAnAM chatuHShaShTyA kShiprakArI mahAbalaH
shlokas.18:
tasya karNo maheShvAsaH sAyakA.nshchaturo.akShipat |
asamprAptA.nstu tAnbhImaH sAyakairnataparvabhiH
chichCheda bahudhA rAjandarshayanpANilAghavam
shlokas.19:
taM karNashChAdayAmAsa sharavrAtairanekashaH |
sa~nChAdyamAnaH karNena bahudhA pANDunandanaH
shlokas.20:
chichCheda chApaM karNasya muShTideshe mahArathaH |
vivyAdha chainaM bahubhiH sAyakairnataparvabhiH
shlokas.21:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya sajyaM kRRitvA cha sUtajaH |
vivyAdha samare bhImaM bhImakarmA mahArathaH
shlokas.22:
tasya bhImo bhRRishaM kruddhastrI~nsharAnnataparvaNaH |
nichakhAnorasi tadA sUtaputrasya vegitaH
shlokas.23:
taiH karNo.abhrAjata sharairuromadhyagataistadA |
mahIdhara ivodagrastrishRRi~Ngo bharatarShabha
shlokas.24:
susrAva chAsya rudhiraM viddhasya parameShubhiH |
dhAtuprasyandinaH shailAdyathA gairikarAjayaH
shlokas.25:
ki~nchidvichalitaH karNaH suprahArAbhipIDitaH |
sasAyakaM dhanuH kRRitvA bhImaM vivyAdha mAriSha
chikShepa cha punarbANA~nshatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.26:
sa ChAdyamAnaH sahasA karNena dRRiDhadhanvinA |
dhanurjyAmachChinattUrNamutsmayanpANDunandanaH
shlokas.27:
sArathiM chAsya bhallena prAhiNodyamasAdanam |
vAhA.nshcha chaturaH sa~Nkhye vyasU.nshchakre mahArathaH
shlokas.28:
hatAshvAttu rathAtkarNaH samAplutya vishAM pate |
syandanaM vRRiShasenasya samArohanmahArathaH
shlokas.29:
nirjitya tu raNe karNaM bhImasenaH pratApavAn |
nanAda sumahAnAdaM parjanyaninadopamam
shlokas.30:
tasya taM ninadaM shrutvA prahRRiShTo.abhUdyudhiShThiraH |
karNaM cha nirjitaM matvA bhImasenena bhArata
shlokas.31:
samantAchCha~NkhaninadaM pANDusenAkarottadA |
shatrusenAdhvaniM shrutvA tAvakA hyapi nAnadan
gANDIvaM prAkShipatpArthaH kRRiShNo.apyabjamavAdayat
shlokas.32:
tamantardhAya ninadaM dhvanirbhImasya nardataH |
ashrUyata mahArAja sarvasainyeShu bhArata
shlokas.33:
tato vyAyachChatAmastraiH pRRithakpRRithagari.ndamau |
mRRidupUrvaM cha rAdheyo dRRiDhapUrvaM cha pANDavaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasminvilulite sainye saindhavAyArjune gate |
sAtvate bhImasene cha putraste droNamabhyayAt
tvarannekarathenaiva bahukRRityaM vichintayan
shlokas.2:
sa rathastava putrasya tvarayA parayA yutaH |
tUrNamabhyapataddroNaM manomArutavegavAn
shlokas.3:
uvAcha chainaM putraste sa.nrambhAdraktalochanaH |
arjuno bhImasenashcha sAtyakishchAparAjitaH
shlokas.4:
vijitya sarvasainyAni sumahAnti mahArathAH |
samprAptAH sindhurAjasya samIpamarikarshanAH
vyAyachChanti cha tatrApi sarva evAparAjitAH
shlokas.5:
yadi tAvadraNe pArtho vyatikrAnto mahArathaH |
kathaM sAtyakibhImAbhyAM vyatikrAnto.asi mAnada
shlokas.6:
AshcharyabhUtaM loke.asminsamudrasyeva shoShaNam |
nirjayaM tava viprAgrya sAtvatenArjunena cha
shlokas.7:
tathaiva bhImasenena lokaH sa.nvadate bhRRisham |
kathaM droNo jitaH sa~Nkhye dhanurvedasya pAragaH
shlokas.8:
nAsha eva tu me nUnaM mandabhAgyasya sa.nyuge |
yatra tvAM puruShavyAghramatikrAntAstrayo rathAH
shlokas.9:
evaM gate tu kRRitye.asminbrUhi yatte vivakShitam |
yadgataM gatameveha sheShaM chintaya mAnada
shlokas.10:
yatkRRityaM sindhurAjasya prAptakAlamanantaram |
tadbravItu bhavAnkShipraM sAdhu tatsa.nvidhIyatAm
shlokas.11:
droNa uvAcha||
chintyaM bahu mahArAja kRRityaM yattatra me shRRiNu |
trayo hi samatikrAntAH pANDavAnAM mahArathAH
yAvadeva bhayaM pashchAttAvadeShAM puraHsaram
shlokas.12:
tadgarIyastaraM manye yatra kRRiShNadhana~njayau |
sA purastAchcha pashchAchcha gRRihItA bhAratI chamUH
shlokas.13:
tatra kRRityamahaM manye saindhavasyAbhirakShaNam |
sa no rakShyatamastAta kruddhAdbhIto dhana~njayAt
shlokas.14:
gatau hi saindhavaM vIrau yuyudhAnavRRikodarau |
samprAptaM tadidaM dyUtaM yattachChakunibuddhijam
shlokas.15:
na sabhAyAM jayo vRRitto nApi tatra parAjayaH |
iha no glahamAnAnAmadya tAta jayAjayau
shlokas.16:
yAnsma tAnglahate ghorA~nshakuniH kurusa.nsadi |
akShAnsaMmanyamAnaH sa prA kSharAste durAsadAH
shlokas.17:
yatra te bahavastAta kuravaH paryavasthitAH |
senAM durodaraM viddhi sharAnakShAnvishAM pate
shlokas.18:
glahaM cha saindhavaM rAjannatra dyUtasya nishchayaH |
saindhave hi mahAdyUtaM samAsaktaM paraiH saha
shlokas.19:
atra sarve mahArAja tyaktvA jIvitamAtmanaH |
saindhavasya raNe rakShAM vidhivatkartumarhatha
tatra no glahamAnAnAM dhruvau tAta jayAjayau
shlokas.20:
yatra te parameShvAsA yattA rakShanti saindhavam |
tatra yAhi svayaM shIghraM tA.nshcha rakShasva rakShiNaH
shlokas.21:
ihaiva tvahamAsiShye preShayiShyAmi chAparAn |
nirotsyAmi cha pA~nchAlAnsahitAnpANDusRRi~njayaiH
shlokas.22:
tato duryodhanaH prAyAttUrNamAchAryashAsanAt |
udyamyAtmAnamugrAya karmaNe sapadAnugaH
shlokas.23:
chakrarakShau tu pA~nchAlyau yudhAmanyUttamaujasau |
bAhyena senAmabhyetya jagmatuH savyasAchinam
shlokas.24:
tau hi pUrvaM mahArAja vAritau kRRitavarmaNA |
praviShTe tvarjune rAja.nstava sainyaM yuyutsayA
shlokas.25:
tAbhyAM duryodhanaH sArdhamagachChadyuddhamuttamam |
tvaritastvaramANAbhyAM bhrAtRRibhyAM bhArato balI
shlokas.26:
tAvabhidravatAmenamubhAvudyatakArmukau |
mahArathasamAkhyAtau kShatriyapravarau yudhi
shlokas.27:
yudhAmanyustu sa~NkruddhaH sharA.nstri.nshatamAyasAn |
vyasRRijattava putrasya tvaramANaH stanAntare
shlokas.28:
duryodhano.api rAjendra pA~nchAlyasyottamaujasaH |
jaghAna chaturashchAshvAnubhau cha pArShNisArathI
shlokas.29:
uttamaujA hatAshvastu hatasUtashcha sa.nyuge |
Aruroha rathaM bhrAturyudhAmanyorabhitvaran
shlokas.30:
sa rathaM prApya taM bhrAturduryodhanahayA~nsharaiH |
bahubhistADayAmAsa te hatAH prApatanbhuvi
shlokas.31:
hayeShu patiteShvasya chichCheda parameShuNA |
yudhAmanyurdhanuH shIghraM sharAvApaM cha sa.nyuge
shlokas.32:
hatAshvasUtAtsa rathAdavaplutya mahArathaH |
gadAmAdAya te putraH pA~nchAlyAvabhyadhAvata
shlokas.33:
tamApatantaM samprekShya kruddhaM parapura~njayam |
avaplutau rathopasthAdyudhAmanyUttamaujasau
shlokas.34:
tataH sa hemachitraM taM syandanapravaraM gadI |
gadayA pothayAmAsa sAshvasUtadhvajaM raNe
shlokas.35:
hatvA chainaM sa putraste hatAshvo hatasArathiH |
madrarAjarathaM tUrNamAruroha parantapaH
shlokas.36:
pA~nchAlAnAM tu mukhyau tau rAjaputrau mahAbalau |
rathamanyaM samAruhya dhana~njayamabhIyatuH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yau tau karNashcha bhImashcha samprayuddhau mahAbalau |
arjunasya rathopAnte kIdRRishaH so.abhavadraNaH
shlokas.2:
pUrvaM hi nirjitaH karNo bhImasenena sa.nyuge |
kathaM bhUyastu rAdheyo bhImamAgAnmahArathaH
shlokas.3:
bhImo vA sUtatanayaM pratyudyAtaH kathaM raNe |
mahArathasamAkhyAtaM pRRithivyAM pravaraM ratham
shlokas.4:
bhIShmadroNAvatikramya dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
nAnyato bhayamAdatta vinA karNaM dhanurdharam
shlokas.5:
bhayAnna shete satataM chintayanvai mahAratham |
taM kathaM sUtaputraM hi bhImo.ayudhyata sa.nyuge
shlokas.6:
brahmaNyaM vIryasampannaM samareShvanivartinam |
kathaM karNaM yudhAM shreShThaM bhImo.ayudhyata sa.nyuge
shlokas.7:
yau tau samIyaturvIrAvarjunasya rathaM prati |
kathaM nu tAvayudhyetAM sUtaputravRRikodarau
shlokas.8:
bhrAtRRitvaM darshitaM pUrvaM ghRRiNI chApi sa sUtajaH |
kathaM bhImena yuyudhe kuntyA vAkyamanusmaran
shlokas.9:
bhImo vA sUtaputreNa smaranvairaM purA kRRitam |
so.ayudhyata kathaM vIraH karNena saha sa.nyuge
shlokas.10:
AshAste cha sadA sUta putro duryodhano mama |
karNo jeShyati sa~NgrAme sahitAnpANDavAniti
shlokas.11:
jayAshA yatra mandasya putrasya mama sa.nyuge |
sa kathaM bhImakarmANaM bhImasenamayudhyata
shlokas.12:
yaM samAshritya putrairme kRRitaM vairaM mahArathaiH |
taM sUtatanayaM tAta kathaM bhImo hyayodhayat
shlokas.13:
anekAnviprakArA.nshcha sUtaputrasamudbhavAn |
smaramANaH kathaM bhImo yuyudhe sUtasUnunA
shlokas.14:
yo.ajayatpRRithivIM sarvAM rathenaikena vIryavAn |
taM sUtatanayaM yuddhe kathaM bhImo hyayodhayat
shlokas.15:
yo jAtaH kuNDalAbhyAM cha kavachena sahaiva cha |
taM sUtaputraM samare bhImaH kathamayodhayat
shlokas.16:
yathA tayoryuddhamabhUdyashchAsIdvijayI tayoH |
tanmamAchakShva tattvena kushalo hyasi sa~njaya
shlokas.17:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
bhImasenastu rAdheyamutsRRijya rathinAM varam |
iyeSha gantuM yatrAstAM vIrau kRRiShNadhana~njayau
shlokas.18:
taM prayAntamabhidrutya rAdheyaH ka~NkapatribhiH |
abhyavarShanmahArAja megho vRRiShTyeva parvatam
shlokas.19:
phullatA pa~Nkajeneva vaktreNAbhyutsmayanbalI |
AjuhAva raNe yAntaM bhImamAdhirathistadA
shlokas.20:
bhImasenastadAhvAnaM karNAnnAmarShayadyudhi |
ardhamaNDalamAvRRitya sUtaputramayodhayat
shlokas.21:
avakragAmibhirbANairabhyavarShanmahAyasaiH |
dvairathe da.nshitaM yattaM sarvashastrabhRRitAM varam
shlokas.22:
vidhitsuH kalahasyAntaM jighA.nsuH karNamakShiNot |
taM cha hatvetarAnsarvAnhantukAmo mahAbalaH
shlokas.23:
tasmai prAsRRijadugrANi vividhAni parantapaH |
amarShI pANDavaH kruddhaH sharavarShANi mAriSha
shlokas.24:
tasya tAnIShuvarShANi mattadviradagAminaH |
sUtaputro.astramAyAbhiragrasatsumahAyashAH
shlokas.25:
sa yathAvanmahArAja vidyayA vai supUjitaH |
AchAryavanmaheShvAsaH karNaH paryacharadraNe
shlokas.26:
sa.nrambheNa tu yudhyantaM bhImasenaM smayanniva |
abhyapadyata rAdheyastamamarShI vRRikodaram
shlokas.27:
tannAmRRiShyata kaunteyaH karNasya smitamAhave |
yudhyamAneShu vIreShu pashyatsu cha samantataH
shlokas.28:
taM bhImasenaH samprAptaM vatsadantaiH stanAntare |
vivyAdha balavAnkruddhastottrairiva mahAdvipam
shlokas.29:
sUtaM tu sUtaputrasya supu~NkhairnishitaiH sharaiH |
sumuktaishchitravarmANaM nirbibheda trisaptabhiH
shlokas.30:
karNo jAmbUnadairjAlaiH sa~nChannAnvAtaraMhasaH |
vivyAdha turagAnvIraH pa~nchabhiH pa~nchabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.31:
tato bANamayaM jAlaM bhImasenarathaM prati |
karNena vihitaM rAjannimeShArdhAdadRRishyata
shlokas.32:
sarathaH sadhvajastatra sasUtaH pANDavastadA |
prAchChAdyata mahArAja karNachApachyutaiH sharaiH
shlokas.33:
tasya karNashchatuHShaShTyA vyadhamatkavachaM dRRiDham |
kruddhashchApyahanatpArshve nArAchairmarmabhedibhiH
shlokas.34:
tato.achintya mahAvegAnkarNakArmukaniHsRRitAn |
samAshliShyadasambhrAntaH sUtaputraM vRRikodaraH
shlokas.35:
sa karNachApaprabhavAniShUnAshIviShopamAn |
bibhradbhImo mahArAja na jagAma vyathAM raNe
shlokas.36:
tato dvAtri.nshatA bhallairnishitaistigmatejanaiH |
vivyAdha samare karNaM bhImasenaH pratApavAn
shlokas.37:
ayatnenaiva taM karNaH sharairupa samAkirat |
bhImasenaM mahAbAhuM saindhavasya vadhaiShiNam
shlokas.38:
mRRidupUrvaM cha rAdheyo bhImamAjAvayodhayat |
krodhapUrvaM tathA bhImaH pUrvavairamanusmaran
shlokas.39:
taM bhImaseno nAmRRiShyadavamAnamamarShaNaH |
sa tasmai vyasRRijattUrNaM sharavarShamamitrajit
shlokas.40:
te sharAH preShitA rAjanbhImasenena sa.nyuge |
nipetuH sarvato bhImAH kUjanta iva pakShiNaH
shlokas.41:
hemapu~NkhA mahArAja bhImasenadhanushchyutAH |
abhyadrava.nste rAdheyaM vRRikAH kShudramRRigaM yathA
shlokas.42:
karNastu rathinAM shreShThashChAdyamAnaH samantataH |
rAjanvyasRRijadugrANi sharavarShANi sa.nyuge
shlokas.43:
tasya tAnashaniprakhyAniShUnsamarashobhinaH |
chichCheda bahubhirbhallairasamprAptAnvRRikodaraH
shlokas.44:
punashcha sharavarSheNa ChAdayAmAsa bhArata |
karNo vaikartano yuddhe bhImasenaM mahAratham
shlokas.45:
tatra bhArata bhImaM tu dRRiShTavantaH sma sAyakaiH |
samAchitatanuM sa~Nkhye shvAvidhaM shalalairiva
shlokas.46:
hemapu~NkhA~nshilAdhautAnkarNachApachyutA~nsharAn |
dadhAra samare vIraH svarashmIniva bhAskaraH
shlokas.47:
rudhirokShitasarvA~Ngo bhImaseno vyarochata |
tapanIyanibhaiH puShpaiH palAsha iva kAnane
shlokas.48:
tattu bhImo mahArAja karNasya charitaM raNe |
nAmRRiShyata maheShvAsaH krodhAdudvRRitya chakShuShI
shlokas.49:
sa karNaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA nArAchAnAM samArpayat |
mahIdharamiva shvetaM gUDhapAdairviSholbaNaiH
shlokas.50:
taM vivyAdha punarbhImaH ShaDbhiraShTAbhireva cha |
marmasvamaravikrAntaH sUtaputraM mahAraNe
shlokas.51:
tataH karNasya sa~Nkruddho bhImasenaH pratApavAn |
chichCheda kArmukaM tUrNaM sarvopakaraNAni cha
shlokas.52:
jaghAna chaturashchAshvAnsUtaM cha tvaritaH sharaiH |
nArAchairarkarashmyAbhaiH karNaM vivyAdha chorasi
shlokas.53:
te jagmurdharaNIM sarve karNaM nirbhidya mAriSha |
yathA hi jaladaM bhittvA rAjansUryasya rashmayaH
shlokas.54:
sa vaikalyaM mahatprApya ChinnadhanvA sharArditaH |
tathA puruShamAnI sa pratyapAyAdrathAntaram

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yasmi~njayAshA satataM putrANAM mama sa~njaya |
taM dRRiShTvA vimukhaM sa~Nkhye kiM nu duryodhano.abravIt
karNo vA samare tAta kimakArShIdataH param
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
bhImasenaM raNe dRRiShTvA jvalantamiva pAvakam |
rathamanyaM samAsthAya vidhivatkalpitaM punaH
abhyayAtpANDavaM karNo vAtoddhUta ivArNavaH
shlokas.3:
kruddhamAdhirathiM dRRiShTvA putrAstava vishAM pate |
bhImasenamamanyanta vaivasvatamukhe hutam
shlokas.4:
chApashabdaM mahatkRRitvA talashabdaM cha bhairavam |
abhyavartata rAdheyo bhImasenarathaM prati
shlokas.5:
punareva tato rAjanmahAnAsItsudAruNaH |
vimardaH sUtaputrasya bhImasya cha vishAM pate
shlokas.6:
sa.nrabdhau hi mahAbAhU parasparavadhaiShiNau |
anyonyamIkShAM chakrAte dahantAviva lochanaiH
shlokas.7:
krodharaktekShaNau kruddhau niHshvasantau mahArathau |
yuddhe.anyonyaM samAsAdya tatakShaturari.ndamau
shlokas.8:
vyAghrAviva susa.nrabdhau shyenAviva cha shIghragau |
sharabhAviva sa~Nkruddhau yuyudhAte parasparam
shlokas.9:
tato bhImaH smarankleshAnakShadyUte vane.api cha |
virATanagare chaiva prAptaM duHkhamari.ndamaH
shlokas.10:
rAShTrANAM sphItaratnAnAM haraNaM cha tavAtmajaiH |
satataM cha parikleshAnsaputreNa tvayA kRRitAn
shlokas.11:
dagdhumaichChashcha yatkuntIM saputrAM tvamanAgasam |
kRRiShNAyAshcha parikleshaM sabhAmadhye durAtmabhiH
shlokas.12:
patimanyaM parIpsasva na santi patayastava |
narakaM patitAH pArthAH sarve ShaNDhatilopamAH
shlokas.13:
samakShaM tava kauravya yadUchuH kuravastadA |
dAsIbhogena kRRiShNAM cha bhoktukAmAH sutAstava
shlokas.14:
yachchApi tAnpravrajataH kRRiShNAjinanivAsinaH |
paruShANyuktavAnkarNaH sabhAyAM saMnidhau tava
shlokas.15:
tRRiNIkRRitya cha yatpArthA.nstava putro vavalga ha |
viShamasthAnsamastho hi sa.nrambhAdgatachetasaH
shlokas.16:
bAlyAtprabhRRiti chArighnastAni duHkhAni chintayan |
niravidyata dharmAtmA jIvitena vRRikodaraH
shlokas.17:
tato visphArya sumahaddhemapRRiShThaM durAsadam |
chApaM bharatashArdUlastyaktAtmA karNamabhyayAt
shlokas.18:
sa sAyakamayairjAlairbhImaH karNarathaM prati |
bhAnumadbhiH shilAdhautairbhAnoH prachChAdayatprabhAm
shlokas.19:
tataH prahasyAdhirathistUrNamasya~nshitA~nsharAn |
vyadhamadbhImasenasya sharajAlAni patribhiH
shlokas.20:
mahAratho mahAbAhurmahAvegairmahAbalaH |
vivyAdhAdhirathirbhImaM navabhirnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.21:
sa tottrairiva mAta~Ngo vAryamANaH patatribhiH |
abhyadhAvadasambhrAntaH sUtaputraM vRRikodaraH
shlokas.22:
tamApatantaM vegena rabhasaM pANDavarShabham |
karNaH pratyudyayau yoddhuM matto mattamiva dvipam
shlokas.23:
tataH pradhmApya jalajaM bherIshataninAditam |
akShubhyata balaM harShAduddhUta iva sAgaraH
shlokas.24:
taduddhUtaM balaM dRRiShTva rathanAgAshvapattimat |
bhImaH karNaM samAsAdya ChAdayAmAsa sAyakaiH
shlokas.25:
ashvAnRRishyasavarNA.nstu ha.nsavarNairhayottamaiH |
vyAmishrayadraNe karNaH pANDavaM ChAdaya~nsharaiH
shlokas.26:
RRishyavarNAnhayAnkarkairmishrAnmArutaraMhasaH |
nirIkShya tava putrANAM hAhAkRRitamabhUdbalam
shlokas.27:
te hayA bahvashobhanta mishritA vAtaraMhasaH |
sitAsitA mahArAja yathA vyomni balAhakAH
shlokas.28:
sa.nrabdhau krodhatAmrAkShau prekShya karNavRRikodarau |
santrastAH samakampanta tvadIyAnAM mahArathAH
shlokas.29:
yamarAShTropamaM ghoramAsIdAyodhanaM tayoH |
durdarshaM bharatashreShTha pretarAjapuraM yathA
shlokas.30:
samAjamiva tachchitraM prekShamANA mahArathAH |
nAlakShaya~njayaM vyaktamekaikasya nivAraNe
shlokas.31:
tayoH praikShanta saMmardaM saMnikRRiShTamahAstrayoH |
tava durmantrite rAjansaputrasya vishAM pate
shlokas.32:
ChAdayantau hi shatrughnAvanyonyaM sAyakaiH shitaiH |
sharajAlAvRRitaM vyoma chakrAte sharavRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.33:
tAvanyonyaM jighA.nsantau sharaistIkShNairmahArathau |
prekShaNIyatarAvAstAM vRRiShTimantAvivAmbudau
shlokas.34:
suvarNavikRRitAnbANAnpramu~nchantAvari.ndamau |
bhAsvaraM vyoma chakrAte vahnyulkAbhiriva prabho
shlokas.35:
tAbhyAM muktA vyakAshanta ka~NkabarhiNavAsasaH |
pa~NktyaH sharadi mattAnAM sArasAnAmivAmbare
shlokas.36:
sa.nsaktaM sUtaputreNa dRRiShTvA bhImamari.ndamam |
atibhAramamanyetAM bhIme kRRiShNadhana~njayau
shlokas.37:
tatrAdhirathibhImAbhyAM sharairmuktairdRRiDhAhatAH |
iShupAtamatikramya peturashvanaradvipAH
shlokas.38:
patadbhiH patitaishchAnyairgatAsubhiranekashaH |
kRRito mahAnmahArAja putrANAM te janakShayaH
shlokas.39:
manuShyAshvagajAnAM cha sharIrairgatajIvitaiH |
kShaNena bhUmiH sa~njaj~ne sa.nvRRitA bharatarShabha

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
atyadbhutamahaM manye bhImasenasya vikramam |
yatkarNaM yodhayAmAsa samare laghuvikramam
shlokas.2:
tridashAnapi chodyuktAnsarvashastradharAnyudhi |
vArayedyo raNe karNaH sayakShAsuramAnavAn
shlokas.3:
sa kathaM pANDavaM yuddhe bhrAjamAnamiva shriyA |
nAtaratsa.nyuge tAta tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.4:
kathaM cha yuddhaM bhUyo.abhUttayoH prANadurodare |
atra manye samAyatto jayo vAjaya eva vA
shlokas.5:
karNaM prApya raNe sUta mama putraH suyodhanaH |
jetumutsahate pArthAnsagovindAnsasAtvatAn
shlokas.6:
shrutvA tu nirjitaM karNamasakRRidbhImakarmaNA |
bhImasenena samare moha AvishatIva mAm
shlokas.7:
vinaShTAnkauravAnmanye mama putrasya durnayaiH |
na hi karNo maheShvAsAnpArthA~njyeShyati sa~njaya
shlokas.8:
kRRitavAnyAni yuddhAni karNaH pANDusutaiH saha |
sarvatra pANDavAH karNamajayanta raNAjire
shlokas.9:
ajayyAH pANDavAstAta devairapi savAsavaiH |
na cha tadbudhyate mandaH putro duryodhano mama
shlokas.10:
dhanaM dhaneshvarasyeva hRRitvA pArthasya me sutaH |
madhuprepsurivAbuddhiH prapAtaM nAvabudhyate
shlokas.11:
nikRRityA nikRRitipraj~no rAjyaM hRRitvA mahAtmanAm |
jitAnityeva manvAnaH pANDavAnavamanyate
shlokas.12:
putrasnehAbhibhUtena mayA chApyakRRitAtmanA |
dharme sthitA mahAtmAno nikRRitAH pANDunandanAH
shlokas.13:
shamakAmaH sadA pArtho dIrghaprekShI yudhiShThiraH |
ashakta iti manvAnaiH putrairmama nirAkRRitaH
shlokas.14:
tAni duHkhAnyanekAni viprakArA.nshcha sarvashaH |
hRRidi kRRitvA mahAbAhurbhImo.ayudhyata sUtajam
shlokas.15:
tasmAnme sa~njaya brUhi karNabhImau yathA raNe |
ayudhyetAM yudhi shreShThau parasparavadhaiShiNau
shlokas.16:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjanyathA vRRittaH sa~NgrAmaH karNabhImayoH |
parasparavadhaprepsvorvane ku~njarayoriva
shlokas.17:
rAjanvaikartano bhImaM kruddhaH kruddhamari.ndamam |
parAkrAntaM parAkramya vivyAdha tri.nshatA sharaiH
shlokas.18:
mahAvegaiH prasannAgraiH shAtakumbhapariShkRRitaiH |
AhanadbharatashreShTha bhImaM vaikartanaH sharaiH
shlokas.19:
tasyAsyato dhanurbhImashchakarta nishitaistribhiH |
rathanIDAchcha yantAraM bhallenApAtayatkShitau
shlokas.20:
sa kA~NkShanbhImasenasya vadhaM vaikartano vRRiShaH |
shaktiM kanakavaiDUryachitradaNDAM parAmRRishat
shlokas.21:
pragRRihya cha mahAshaktiM kAlashaktimivAparAm |
samutkShipya cha rAdheyaH sandhAya cha mahAbalaH
chikShepa bhImasenAya jIvitAntakarImiva
shlokas.22:
shaktiM visRRijya rAdheyaH pura.ndara ivAshanim |
nanAda sumahAnAdaM balavAnsUtanandanaH
taM cha nAdaM tataH shrutvA putrAste hRRiShitAbhavan
shlokas.23:
tAM karNabhujanirmuktAmarkavaishvAnaraprabhAm |
shaktiM viyati chichCheda bhImaH saptabhirAshugaiH
shlokas.24:
ChittvA shaktiM tato bhImo nirmuktoragasaMnibhAm |
mArgamANa iva prANAnsUtaputrasya mAriSha
shlokas.25:
prAhiNonnava sa.nrabdhaH sharAnbarhiNavAsasaH |
svarNapu~NkhA~nshilAdhautAnyamadaNDopamAnmRRidhe
shlokas.26:
karNo.apyanyaddhanurgRRihya hemapRRiShThaM durAsadam |
vikRRiShya cha mahAtejA vyasRRijatsAyakAnnava
shlokas.27:
tAnpANDuputrashchichCheda navabhirnataparvabhiH |
vasuSheNena nirmuktAnnava rAjanmahAsharAn
ChittvA bhImo mahArAja nAdaM siMha ivAnadat
shlokas.28:
tau vRRiShAviva nardantau balinau vAshitAntare |
shArdUlAviva chAnyonyamatyarthaM cha hyagarjatAm
shlokas.29:
anyonyaM prajihIrShantAvanyonyasyAntaraiShiNau |
anyonyamabhivIkShantau goShTheShviva maharShabhau
shlokas.30:
mahAgajAvivAsAdya viShANAgraiH parasparam |
sharaiH pUrNAyatotsRRiShTairanyonyamabhijaghnatuH
shlokas.31:
nirdahantau mahArAja sharavRRiShTyA parasparam |
anyonyamabhivIkShantau kopAdvivRRitalochanau
shlokas.32:
prahasantau tathAnyonyaM bhartsayantau muhurmuhuH |
sha~NkhashabdaM cha kurvANau yuyudhAte parasparam
shlokas.33:
tasya bhImaH punashchApaM muShTau chichCheda mAriSha |
sha~NkhavarNAshcha tAnashvAnbANairninye yamakShayam
shlokas.34:
tathA kRRichChragataM dRRiShTvA karNaM duryodhano nRRipaH |
vepamAna iva krodhAdvyAdideshAtha durjayam
shlokas.35:
gachCha durjaya rAdheyaM purA grasati pANDavaH |
jahi tUbarakaM kShipraM karNasya balamAdadhat
shlokas.36:
evamuktastathetyuktvA tava putrastavAtmajam |
abhyadravadbhImasenaM vyAsaktaM vikira~nsharAn
shlokas.37:
sa bhImaM navabhirbANairashvAnaShTabhirardayat |
ShaDbhiH sUtaM tribhiH ketuM punastaM chApi saptabhiH
shlokas.38:
bhImaseno.api sa~NkruddhaH sAshvayantAramAshugaiH |
durjayaM bhinnamarmANamanayadyamasAdanam
shlokas.39:
svala~NkRRitaM kShitau kShuNNaM cheShTamAnaM yathoragam |
rudannArtastava sutaM karNashchakre pradakShiNam
shlokas.40:
sa tu taM virathaM kRRitvA smayannatyantavairiNam |
samAchinodbANagaNaiH shataghnImiva sha~NkubhiH
shlokas.41:
tathApyatirathaH karNo bhidyamAnaH sma sAyakaiH |
na jahau samare bhImaM kruddharUpaM parantapaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sa tathA virathaH karNaH punarbhImena nirjitaH |
rathamanyaM samAsthAya sadyo vivyAdha pANDavam
shlokas.2:
mahAgajAvivAsAdya viShANAgraiH parasparam |
sharaiH pUrNAyatotsRRiShTairanyonyamabhijaghnatuH
shlokas.3:
atha karNaH sharavrAtairbhImaM balavadardayat |
nanAda balavannAdaM punarvivyAdha chorasi
shlokas.4:
taM bhImo dashabhirbANaiH pratyavidhyadajihmagaiH |
punarvivyAdha vi.nshatyA sharANAM nataparvaNAm
shlokas.5:
karNastu navabhirbhImaM viddhvA rAjanstanAntare |
dhvajamekena vivyAdha sAyakena shitena ha
shlokas.6:
sAyakAnAM tataH pArthastriShaShTyA pratyavidhyata |
tottrairiva mahAnAgaM kashAbhiriva vAjinam
shlokas.7:
so.atividdho mahArAja pANDavena yashasvinA |
sRRikviNI lelihanvIraH krodhasa.nraktalochanaH
shlokas.8:
tataH sharaM mahArAja sarvakAyAvadAraNam |
prAhiNodbhImasenAya balAyendra ivAshanim
shlokas.9:
sa nirbhidya raNe pArthaM sUtaputradhanushchyutaH |
agachChaddArayanbhUmiM chitrapu~NkhaH shilImukhaH
shlokas.10:
sarvashaikyAM chatuShkiShkuM gurvIM rukmA~NgadAM gadAm |
prAhiNotsUtaputrAya ShaDasrAmavichArayan
shlokas.11:
tayA jaghAnAdhiratheH sadashvAnsAdhuvAhinaH |
gadayA bhArataH kruddho vajreNendra ivAsurAn
shlokas.12:
tato bhImo mahAbAhuH kShurAbhyAM bharatarShabha |
dhvajamAdhiratheshChittvA sUtamabhyahanattadA
shlokas.13:
hatAshvasUtamutsRRijya rathaM sa patitadhvajam |
visphArayandhanuH karNastasthau bhArata durmanAH
shlokas.14:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma rAdheyasya parAkramam |
viratho rathinAM shreShTho vArayAmAsa yadripum
shlokas.15:
virathaM taM rathashreShThaM dRRiShTvAdhirathimAhave |
duryodhanastato rAjannabhyabhAShata durmukham
shlokas.16:
eSha durmukha rAdheyo bhImena virathIkRRitaH |
taM rathena narashreShThaM sampAdaya mahAratham
shlokas.17:
duryodhanavachaH shrutvA tato bhArata durmukhaH |
tvaramANo.abyayAtkarNaM bhImaM chAvArayachCharaiH
shlokas.18:
durmukhaM prekShya sa~NgrAme sUtaputrapadAnugam |
vAyuputraH prahRRiShTo.abhUtsRRikkiNI parilelihan
shlokas.19:
tataH karNaM mahArAja vArayitvA shilImukhaiH |
durmukhAya rathaM shIghraM preShayAmAsa pANDavaH
shlokas.20:
tasminkShaNe mahArAja navabhirnataparvabhiH |
supu~NkhairdurmukhaM bhImaH sharairninye yamakShayam
shlokas.21:
tatastamevAdhirathiH syandanaM durmukhe hate |
AsthitaH prababhau rAjandIpyamAna ivA.nshumAn
shlokas.22:
shayAnaM bhinnamarmANaM durmukhaM shoNitokShitam |
dRRiShTvA karNo.ashrupUrNAkSho muhUrtaM nAbhyavartata
shlokas.23:
taM gatAsumatikramya kRRitvA karNaH pradakShiNam |
dIrghamuShNaM shvasanvIro na ki~nchitpratyapadyata
shlokas.24:
tasmi.nstu vivare rAjannArAchAngArdhravAsasaH |
prAhiNotsUtaputrAya bhImasenashchaturdasha
shlokas.25:
te tasya kavachaM bhittvA svarNapu~NkhA mahaujasaH |
hemachitrA mahArAja dyotayanto disho dasha
shlokas.26:
apibansUtaputrasya shoNitaM raktabhojanAH |
kruddhA iva manuShyendra bhujagAH kAlachoditAH
shlokas.27:
prasarpamANA medinyAM te vyarochanta mArgaNAH |
ardhapraviShTAH sa.nrabdhA bilAnIva mahoragAH
shlokas.28:
taM pratyavidhyadrAdheyo jAmbUnadavibhUShitaiH |
chaturdashabhiratyugrairnArAchairavichArayan
shlokas.29:
te bhImasenasya bhujaM savyaM nirbhidya patriNaH |
prAvishanmedinIM bhImAH krau~nchaM patrarathA iva
shlokas.30:
te vyarochanta nArAchAH pravishanto vasundharAm |
gachChatyastaM dinakare dIpyamAnA ivA.nshavaH
shlokas.31:
sa nirbhinno raNe bhImo nArAchairmarmabhedibhiH |
susrAva rudhiraM bhUri parvataH salilaM yathA
shlokas.32:
sa bhImastribhirAyastaH sUtaputraM patatribhiH |
suparNavegairvivyAdha sArathiM chAsya saptabhiH
shlokas.33:
sa vihvalo mahArAja karNo bhImabalArditaH |
prAdravajjavanairashvai raNaM hitvA mahAyashAH
shlokas.34:
bhImasenastu visphArya chApaM hemapariShkRRitam |
Ahave.atiratho.atiShThajjvalanniva hutAshanaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
daivameva paraM manye dhikpauruShamanarthakam |
yatrAdhirathirAyasto nAtaratpANDavaM raNe
shlokas.2:
karNaH pArthAnsagovindA~njetumutsahate raNe |
na cha karNasamaM yodhaM loke pashyAmi ka~nchana
iti duryodhanasyAhamashrauShaM jalpato muhuH
shlokas.3:
karNo hi balavA~nshUro dRRiDhadhanvA jitaklamaH |
iti mAmabravItsUta mando duryodhanaH purA
shlokas.4:
vasuSheNasahAyaM mAM nAlaM devApi sa.nyuge |
kimu pANDusutA rAjangatasattvA vichetasaH
shlokas.5:
tatra taM nirjitaM dRRiShTvA bhuja~Ngamiva nirviSham |
yuddhAtkarNamapakrAntaM kiM svidduryodhano.abravIt
shlokas.6:
aho durmukhamevaikaM yuddhAnAmavishAradam |
prAveshayaddhutavahaM pata~Ngamiva mohitaH
shlokas.7:
ashvatthAmA madrarAjaH kRRipaH karNashcha sa~NgatAH |
na shaktAH pramukhe sthAtuM nUnaM bhImasya sa~njaya
shlokas.8:
te.api chAsya mahAghoraM balaM nAgAyutopamam |
jAnanto vyavasAyaM cha krUraM mArutatejasaH
shlokas.9:
kimarthaM krUrakarmANaM yamakAlAntakopamam |
balasa.nrambhavIryaj~nAH kopayiShyanti sa.nyuge
shlokas.10:
karNastveko mahAbAhuH svabAhubalamAshritaH |
bhImasenamanAdRRitya raNe.ayudhyata sUtajaH
shlokas.11:
yo.ajayatsamare karNaM pura.ndara ivAsuram |
na sa pANDusuto jetuM shakyaH kenachidAhave
shlokas.12:
droNaM yaH sampramathyaikaH praviShTo mama vAhinIm |
bhImo dhana~njayAnveShI kastamarChejjijIviShuH
shlokas.13:
ko hi sa~njaya bhImasya sthAtumutsahate.agrataH |
udyatAshanivajrasya mahendrasyeva dAnavaH
shlokas.14:
pretarAjapuraM prApya nivartetApi mAnavaH |
na bhImasenaM samprApya nivarteta kadAchana
shlokas.15:
pata~NgA iva vahniM te prAvishannalpachetasaH |
ye bhImasenaM sa~NkruddhamabhyadhAvanvimohitAH
shlokas.16:
yattatsabhAyAM bhImena mama putravadhAshrayam |
shaptaM sa.nrambhiNogreNa kurUNAM shRRiNvatAM tadA
shlokas.17:
tannUnamabhisa~nchintya dRRiShTvA karNaM cha nirjitam |
duHshAsanaH saha bhrAtrA bhayAdbhImAdupAramat
shlokas.18:
yashcha sa~njaya durbuddhirabravItsamitau muhuH |
karNo duHshAsano.ahaM cha jeShyAmo yudhi pANDavAn
shlokas.19:
sa nUnaM virathaM dRRiShTvA karNaM bhImena nirjitam |
pratyAkhyAnAchcha kRRiShNasya bhRRishaM tapyati sa~njaya
shlokas.20:
dRRiShTvA bhrAtR^InhatAnyuddhe bhImasenena da.nshitAn |
AtmAparAdhAtsumahannUnaM tapyati putrakaH
shlokas.21:
ko hi jIvitamanvichChanpratIpaM pANDavaM vrajet |
bhImaM bhImAyudhaM kruddhaM sAkShAtkAlamiva sthitam
shlokas.22:
vaDavAmukhamadhyastho muchyetApi hi mAnavaH |
na bhImamukhasamprApto muchyeteti matirmama
shlokas.23:
na pANDavA na pA~nchAlA na cha keshavasAtyakI |
jAnanti yudhi sa.nrabdhA jIvitaM parirakShitum
shlokas.24:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
yatsa.nshochasi kauravya vartamAne janakShaye |
tvamasya jagato mUlaM vinAshasya na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.25:
svayaM vairaM mahatkRRitvA putrANAM vachane sthitaH |
uchyamAno na gRRihNIShe martyaH pathyamivauShadham
shlokas.26:
svayaM pItvA mahArAja kAlakUTaM sudurjaram |
tasyedAnIM phalaM kRRitsnamavApnuhi narottama
shlokas.27:
yattu kutsayase yodhAnyudhyamAnAnyathAbalam |
atra te varNayiShyAmi yathA yuddhamavartata
shlokas.28:
dRRiShTvA karNaM tu putrAste bhImasenaparAjitam |
nAmRRiShyanta maheShvAsAH sodaryAH pa~ncha mAriSha
shlokas.29:
durmarShaNo duHsahashcha durmado durdharo jayaH |
pANDavaM chitrasaMnAhAstaM pratIpamupAdravan
shlokas.30:
te samantAnmahAbAhuM parivArya vRRikodaram |
dishaH sharaiH samAvRRiNva~nshalabhAnAmiva vrajaiH
shlokas.31:
AgachChatastAnsahasA kumArAndevarUpiNaH |
pratijagrAha samare bhImaseno hasanniva
shlokas.32:
tava dRRiShTvA tu tanayAnbhImasenasamIpagAn |
abhyavartata rAdheyo bhImasenaM mahAbalam
shlokas.33:
visRRijanvishikhAnrAjansvarNapu~NkhA~nshilAshitAn |
taM tu bhImo.abhyayAttUrNaM vAryamANaH sutaistava
shlokas.34:
kuravastu tataH karNaM parivArya samantataH |
avAkiranbhImasenaM sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.35:
tAnbANaiH pa~nchavi.nshatyA sAshvAnrAjannararShabhAn |
sasUtAnbhImadhanuSho bhImo ninye yamakShayam
shlokas.36:
prApatansyandanebhyaste sArdhaM sUtairgatAsavaH |
chitrapuShpadharA bhagnA vAteneva mahAdrumAH
shlokas.37:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma bhImasenasya vikramam |
sa.nvAryAdhirathiM bANairyajjaghAna tavAtmajAn
shlokas.38:
sa vAryamANo bhImena shitairbANaiH samantataH |
sUtaputro mahArAja bhImasenamavaikShata
shlokas.39:
taM bhImasenaH sa.nrambhAtkrodhasa.nraktalochanaH |
visphArya sumahachchApaM muhuH karNamavaikShata

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tavAtmajA.nstu patitAndRRiShTvA karNaH pratApavAn |
krodhena mahatAviShTo nirviNNo.abhUtsa jIvitAt
shlokas.2:
AgaskRRitamivAtmAnaM mene chAdhirathistadA |
bhImasenaM tataH kruddhaH samAdravata sambhramAt
shlokas.3:
sa bhImaM pa~nchabhirviddhvA rAdheyaH prahasanniva |
punarvivyAdha saptatyA svarNapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH
shlokas.4:
avahAsaM tu taM pArtho nAmRRiShyata vRRikodaraH |
tato vivyAdha rAdheyaM shatena nataparvaNAm
shlokas.5:
punashcha vishikhaistIkShNairviddhvA pa~nchabhirAshugaiH |
dhanushchichCheda bhallena sUtaputrasya mAriSha
shlokas.6:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya karNo bhArata durmanAH |
iShubhishChAdayAmAsa bhImasenaM samantataH
shlokas.7:
tasya bhImo hayAnhatvA vinihatya cha sArathim |
prajahAsa mahAhAsaM kRRite pratikRRitaM punaH
shlokas.8:
iShubhiH kArmukaM chAsya chakarta puruSharShabhaH |
tatpapAta mahArAja svarNapRRiShThaM mahAsvanam
shlokas.9:
avArohadrathAttasmAdatha karNo mahArathaH |
gadAM gRRihItvA samare bhImasenAya chAkShipat
shlokas.10:
tAmApatantIM sahasA gadAM dRRiShTvA vRRikodaraH |
sharairavArayadrAjansarvasainyasya pashyataH
shlokas.11:
tato bANasahasrANi preShayAmAsa pANDavaH |
sUtaputravadhAkA~NkShI tvaramANaH parAkramI
shlokas.12:
tAniShUniShubhiH karNo vArayitvA mahAmRRidhe |
kavachaM bhImasenasya pAtayAmAsa sAyakaiH
shlokas.13:
athainaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA kShudrakANAM samArpayat |
pashyatAM sarvabhUtAnAM tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.14:
tato bhImo mahArAja navabhirnataparvaNAm |
raNe.apreShayata kruddhaH sUtaputrasya mAriSha
shlokas.15:
te tasya kavachaM bhittvA tathA bAhuM cha dakShiNam |
abhyagurdharaNIM tIkShNA valmIkamiva pannagAH
shlokas.16:
rAdheyaM tu raNe dRRiShTvA padAtinamavasthitam |
bhImasenena sa.nrabdhaM rAjA duryodhano.abravIt
tvaradhvaM sarvato yattA rAdheyasya rathaM prati
shlokas.17:
tatastava sutA rAja~nshrutvA bhrAturvacho drutam |
abhyayuH pANDavaM yuddhe visRRijantaH shitA~nsharAn
shlokas.18:
chitropachitrashchitrAkShashchAruchitraH sharAsanaH |
chitrAyudhashchitravarmA samare chitrayodhinaH
shlokas.19:
AgachChatastAnsahasA bhImo rAjanmahArathaH |
sAshvasUtadhvajAnyattAnpAtayAmAsa sa.nyuge
te hatA nyapatanbhUmau vAtanunnA iva drumAH
shlokas.20:
dRRiShTvA vinihatAnputrA.nstava rAjanmahArathAn |
ashrupUrNamukhaH karNaH kashmalaM samapadyata
shlokas.21:
rathamanyaM samAsthAya vidhivatkalpitaM punaH |
abhyayAtpANDavaM yuddhe tvaramANaH parAkramI
shlokas.22:
tAvanyonyaM sharairviddhvA svarNapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH |
vyabhrAjetAM mahArAja puShpitAviva ki.nshukau
shlokas.23:
ShaTtri.nshadbhistato bhallairnishitaistigmatejanaiH |
vyadhamatkavachaM kruddhaH sUtaputrasya pANDavaH
shlokas.24:
raktachandanadigdhA~Ngau sharaiH kRRitamahAvraNau |
shoNitAktau vyarAjetAM kAlasUryAvivoditau
shlokas.25:
tau shoNitokShitairgAtraiH sharaishChinnatanuchChadau |
vivarmANau vyarAjetAM nirmuktAviva pannagau
shlokas.26:
vyAghrAviva naravyAghrau daMShTrAbhiritaretaram |
sharadaMShTrA vidhunvAnau tatakShaturari.ndamau
shlokas.27:
vAraNAviva sa.nsaktau ra~Ngamadhye virejatuH |
tudantau vishikhaistIkShNairmattavAraNavikramau
shlokas.28:
prachChAdayantau samare sharajAlaiH parasparam |
rathAbhyAM nAdayantau cha dishaH sarvA vicheratuH
shlokas.29:
tau rathAbhyAM mahArAja maNDalAvartanAdiShu |
vyarochetAM mahAtmAnau vRRitravajradharAviva
shlokas.30:
sahastAbharaNAbhyAM tu bhujAbhyAM vikShipandhanuH |
vyarochata raNe bhImaH savidyudiva toyadaH
shlokas.31:
sa chApaghoShastanitaH sharadhArAmbudo mahAn |
bhImamegho mahArAja karNaparvatamabhyayAt
shlokas.32:
tataH sharasahasreNa dhanurmuktena bhArata |
pANDavo vyakiratkarNaM ghano.adrimiva vRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.33:
tatrAvaikShanta putrAste bhImasenasya vikramam |
supu~NkhaiH ka~NkavAsobhiryatkarNaM ChAdayachCharaiH
shlokas.34:
sa nandayanraNe pArthaM keshavaM cha yashasvinam |
sAtyakiM chakrarakShau cha bhImaH karNamayodhayat
shlokas.35:
vikramaM bhujayorvIryaM dhairyaM cha viditAtmanaH |
putrAstava mahArAja dadRRishuH pANDavasya ha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
bhImasenasya rAdheyaH shrutvA jyAtalanisvanam |
nAmRRiShyata yathA matto gajaH pratigajasvanam
shlokas.2:
apakramya sa bhImasya muhUrtaM sharagocharAt |
tava chAdhirathirdRRiShTvA syandanebhyashchyutAnsutAn
shlokas.3:
bhImasenena nihatAnvimanA duHkhito.abhavat |
niHshvasandIrghamuShNaM cha punaH pANDavamabhyayAt
shlokas.4:
sa tAmranayanaH krodhAchChvasanniva mahoragaH |
babhau karNaH sharAnasyanrashmivAniva bhAskaraH
shlokas.5:
rashmijAlairivArkasya vitatairbharatarShabha |
karNachApachyutairbANaiH prAchChAdyata vRRikodaraH
shlokas.6:
karNachApachyutAshchitrAH sharA barhiNavAsasaH |
vivishuH sarvataH pArthaM vAsAyevANDajA drumam
shlokas.7:
karNachApachyutA bANAH sampatantastatastataH |
rukmapu~NkhA vyarAjanta ha.nsAH shreNIkRRitA iva
shlokas.8:
chApadhvajopaskarebhyashChatrAdIShAmukhAdyugAt |
prabhavanto vyadRRishyanta rAjannAdhiratheH sharAH
shlokas.9:
khaM pUrayanmahAvegAnkhagamAnkhagavAsasaH |
suvarNavikRRitA.nshchitrAnmumochAdhirathiH sharAn
shlokas.10:
tamantakamivAyastamApatantaM vRRikodaraH |
tyaktvA prANAnabhikrudhya vivyAdha navabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.11:
tasya vegamasa.nsahyaM dRRiShTvA karNasya pANDavaH |
mahatashcha sharaughA.nstAnnaivAvyathata vIryavAn
shlokas.12:
tato vidhamyAdhiratheH sharajAlAni pANDavaH |
vivyAdha karNaM vi.nshatyA punaranyaiH shitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.13:
yathaiva hi sharaiH pArthaH sUtaputreNa ChAditaH |
tathaiva karNaM samare ChAdayAmAsa pANDavaH
shlokas.14:
dRRiShTvA tu bhImasenasya vikramaM yudhi bhArata |
abhyananda.nstvadIyAshcha samprahRRiShTAshcha chAraNAH
shlokas.15:
bhUrishravAH kRRipo drauNirmadrarAjo jayadrathaH |
uttamaujA yudhAmanyuH sAtyakiH keshavArjunau
shlokas.16:
kurupANDavAnAM pravarA dasha rAjanmahArathAH |
sAdhu sAdhviti vegena siMhanAdamathAnadan
shlokas.17:
tasmi.nstu tumule shabde pravRRitte lomaharShaNe |
abhyabhAShata putrA.nste rAjanduryodhanastvaran
shlokas.18:
rAj~nashcha rAjaputrA.nshcha sodaryA.nshcha visheShataH |
karNaM gachChata bhadraM vaH parIpsanto vRRikodarAt
shlokas.19:
purA nighnanti rAdheyaM bhImachApachyutAH sharAH |
te yatadhvaM maheShvAsAH sUtaputrasya rakShaNe
shlokas.20:
duryodhanasamAdiShTAH sodaryAH sapta mAriSha |
bhImasenamabhidrutya sa.nrabdhAH paryavArayan
shlokas.21:
te samAsAdya kaunteyamAvRRiNva~nsharavRRiShTibhiH |
parvataM vAridhArAbhiH prAvRRiShIva balAhakAH
shlokas.22:
te.apIDayanbhImasenaM kruddhAH sapta mahArathAH |
prajAsaMharaNe rAjansomaM sapta grahA iva
shlokas.23:
tato vAmena kaunteyaH pIDayitvA sharAsanam |
muShTinA pANDavo rAjandRRiDhena supariShkRRitam
shlokas.24:
manuShyasamatAM j~nAtvA sapta sandhAya sAyakAn |
tebhyo vyasRRijadAyastaH sUryarashminibhAnprabhuH
shlokas.25:
nirasyanniva dehebhyastanayAnAmasU.nstava |
bhImaseno mahArAja pUrvavairamanusmaran
shlokas.26:
te kShiptA bhImasenena sharA bhArata bhAratAn |
vidArya khaM samutpetuH svarNapu~NkhAH shilAshitAH
shlokas.27:
teShAM vidArya chetA.nsi sharA hemavibhUShitAH |
vyarAjanta mahArAja suparNA iva khecharAH
shlokas.28:
shoNitAdigdhavAjAgrAH sapta hemapariShkRRitAH |
putrANAM tava rAjendra pItvA shoNitamudgatAH
shlokas.29:
te sharairbhinnamarmANo rathebhyaH prApatankShitau |
girisAnuruhA bhagnA dvipeneva mahAdrumAH
shlokas.30:
shatru~njayaH shatrusahashchitrashchitrAyudho dRRiDhaH |
chitraseno vikarNashcha saptaite vinipAtitAH
shlokas.31:
tAnnihatya mahAbAhU rAdheyasyaiva pashyataH |
siMhanAdaravaM ghoramasRRijatpANDunandanaH
shlokas.32:
sa ravastasya shUrasya dharmarAjasya bhArata |
AchakhyAviva tadyuddhaM vijayaM chAtmano mahat
shlokas.33:
taM shrutvA sumahAnAdaM bhImasenasya dhanvinaH |
babhUva paramA prItirdharmarAjasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.34:
tato hRRiShTo mahArAja vAditrANAM mahAsvanaiH |
bhImasenaravaM pArthaH pratijagrAha sarvashaH
shlokas.35:
abhyayAchchaiva samare droNamastrabhRRitAM varam |
harSheNa mahatA yuktaH kRRitasa~nj~ne vRRikodare
shlokas.36:
ekatri.nshanmahArAja putrA.nstava mahArathAn |
hatAnduryodhano dRRiShTvA kShattuH sasmAra tadvachaH
shlokas.37:
tadidaM samanuprAptaM kShatturhitakaraM vachaH |
iti sa~nchintya rAjAsau nottaraM pratyapadyata
shlokas.38:
yaddyUtakAle durbuddhirabravIttanayastava |
yachcha karNo.abravItkRRiShNAM sabhAyAM paruShaM vachaH
shlokas.39:
pramukhe pANDuputrANAM tava chaiva vishAM pate |
kauravANAM cha sarveShAmAchAryasya cha saMnidhau
shlokas.40:
vinaShTAH pANDavAH kRRiShNe shAshvataM narakaM gatAH |
patimanyaM vRRiNIShveti tasyedaM phalamAgatam
shlokas.41:
yatsma tAM paruShANyAhuH sabhAmAnAyya draupadIm |
pANDavAnugradhanuShaH krodhayantastavAtmajAH
shlokas.42:
taM bhImasenaH krodhAgniM trayodasha samAH sthitam |
visRRija.nstava putrANAmantaM gachChati kaurava
shlokas.43:
vilapa.nshcha bahu kShattA shamaM nAlabhata tvayi |
saputro bharatashreShTha tasya bhu~NkShva phalodayam
hato vikarNo rAjendra chitrasenashcha vIryavAn
shlokas.44:
pravarAnAtmajAnAM te sutA.nshchAnyAnmahArathAn |
yAnyA.nshcha dadRRishe bhImashchakShurviShayamAgatAn
putrA.nstava mahAbAho tvarayA tA~njaghAna ha
shlokas.45:
tvatkRRite hyahamadrAkShaM dahyamAnAM varUthinIm |
sahasrashaH sharairmuktaiH pANDavena vRRiSheNa cha

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
mahAnapanayaH sUta mamaivAtra visheShataH |
sa idAnImanuprApto manye sa~njaya shochataH
shlokas.2:
yadgataM tadgatamiti mamAsInmanasi sthitam |
idAnImatra kiM kAryaM prakariShyAmi sa~njaya
shlokas.3:
yathA tveSha kShayo vRRitto mamApanayasambhavaH |
vIrANAM tanmamAchakShva sthirIbhUto.asmi sa~njaya
shlokas.4:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
karNabhImau mahArAja parAkrAntau mahAhave |
bANavarShANyavarShetAM vRRiShTimantAvivAmbudau
shlokas.5:
bhImanAmA~NkitA bANAH svarNapu~NkhAH shilAshitAH |
vivishuH karNamAsAdya bhindanta iva jIvitam
shlokas.6:
tathaiva karNanirmuktaiH saviShairiva pannagaiH |
AkIryata raNe bhImaH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.7:
tayoH sharairmahArAja sampatadbhiH samantataH |
babhUva tava sainyAnAM sa~NkShobhaH sAgaropamaH
shlokas.8:
bhImachApachyutairbANaistava sainyamari.ndama |
avadhyata chamUmadhye ghorairAshIviShopamaiH
shlokas.9:
vAraNaiH patitai rAjanvAjibhishcha naraiH saha |
adRRishyata mahI kIrNA vAtanunnairdrumairiva
shlokas.10:
te vadhyamAnAH samare bhImachApachyutaiH sharaiH |
prAdrava.nstAvakA yodhAH kimetaditi chAbruvan
shlokas.11:
tato vyudastaM tatsainyaM sindhusauvIrakauravam |
protsAritaM mahAvegaiH karNapANDavayoH sharaiH
shlokas.12:
te sharAturabhUyiShThA hatAshvanaravAhanAH |
utsRRijya karNaM bhImaM cha prAdravansarvatodisham
shlokas.13:
nUnaM pArthArthamevAsmAnmohayanti divaukasaH |
yatkarNabhImaprabhavairvadhyate no balaM sharaiH
shlokas.14:
evaM bruvanto yodhAste tAvakA bhayapIDitAH |
sharapAtaM samutsRRijya sthitA yuddhadidRRikShavaH
shlokas.15:
tataH prAvartata nadI ghorarUpA mahAhave |
babhUva cha visheSheNa bhIrUNAM bhayavardhinI
shlokas.16:
vAraNAshvamanuShyANAM rudhiraughasamudbhavA |
sa.nvRRitA gatasattvaishcha manuShyagajavAjibhiH
shlokas.17:
sAnukarShapatAkaishcha dvipAshvarathabhUShaNaiH |
syandanairapaviddhaishcha bhagnachakrAkShakUbaraiH
shlokas.18:
jAtarUpapariShkArairdhanurbhiH sumahAdhanaiH |
suvarNapu~NkhairiShubhirnArAchaishcha sahasrashaH
shlokas.19:
karNapANDavanirmuktairnirmuktairiva pannagaiH |
prAsatomarasa~NghAtaiH khaDgaishcha saparashvadhaiH
shlokas.20:
suvarNavikRRitaishchApi gadAmusalapaTTishaiH |
vajraishcha vividhAkAraiH shaktibhiH parighairapi
shataghnIbhishcha chitrAbhirbabhau bhArata medinI
shlokas.21:
kanakA~NgadakeyUraiH kuNDalairmaNibhiH shubhaiH |
tanutraiH satalatraishcha hArairniShkaishcha bhArata
shlokas.22:
vastraishChatraishcha vidhvastaishchAmaravyajanairapi |
gajAshvamanujairbhinnaiH shastraiH syandanabhUShaNaiH
shlokas.23:
taistaishcha vividhairbhAvaistatra tatra vasundharA |
patitairapaviddhaishcha sambabhau dyauriva grahaiH
shlokas.24:
achintyamadbhutaM chaiva tayoH karmAtimAnuSham |
dRRiShTvA chAraNasiddhAnAM vismayaH samapadyata
shlokas.25:
agnervAyusahAyasya gatiH kakSha ivAhave |
AsIdbhImasahAyasya raudramAdhirathergatam
nipAtitadhvajarathaM hatavAjinaradvipam
shlokas.26:
gajAbhyAM samprayuktAbhyAmAsInnaDavanaM yathA |
tathAbhUtaM mahatsainyamAsIdbhArata sa.nyuge
vimardaH karNabhImAbhyAmAsIchcha paramo raNe

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH karNo mahArAja bhImaM viddhvA tribhiH sharaiH |
mumocha sharavarShANi chitrANi cha bahUni cha
shlokas.2:
vadhyamAno mahArAja sUtaputreNa pANDavaH |
na vivyathe bhImaseno bhidyamAna ivAchalaH
shlokas.3:
sa karNaM karNinA karNe pItena nishitena cha |
vivyAdha yudhi rAjendra bhImasenaH patatriNA
shlokas.4:
sa kuNDalaM mahatkarNAtkarNasyApAtayadbhuvi |
tapanIyaM mahArAja dIptaM jyotirivAmbarAt
shlokas.5:
athApareNa bhallena sUtaputraM stanAntare |
AjaghAna bhRRishaM bhImaH smayanniva mahAbalaH
shlokas.6:
punarasya tvaranbhImo nArAchAndasha bhArata |
raNe praiShInmahAvegAnyamadaNDopamA.nstathA
shlokas.7:
te lalATaM samAsAdya sUtaputrasya mAriSha |
vivishushchoditAstena valmIkamiva pannagAH
shlokas.8:
lalATasthaistu tairbANaiH sUtaputro vyarochata |
nIlotpalamayIM mAlAM dhArayansa purA yathA
shlokas.9:
tataH kruddho raNe karNaH pIDito dRRiDhadhanvanA |
vegaM chakre mahAvego bhImasenavadhaM prati
shlokas.10:
tasmai karNaH shataM rAjanniShUNAM gArdhravAsasAm |
amarShI balavAnkruddhaH preShayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.11:
tataH prAsRRijadugrANi sharavarShANi pANDavaH |
samare tamanAdRRitya nAsya vIryamachintayat
shlokas.12:
tataH karNo mahArAja pANDavaM nishitaiH sharaiH |
AjaghAnorasi kruddhaH kruddharUpaM parantapaH
shlokas.13:
jImUtAviva chAnyonyaM tau vavarShaturAhave |
talashabdaravaishchaiva trAsayantau parasparam
shlokas.14:
sharajAlaishcha vividhaishChAdayAmAsaturmRRidhe |
anyonyaM samare kruddhau kRRitapratikRRitaiShiNau
shlokas.15:
tato bhImo mahAbAhU rAdheyasya mahAtmanaH |
kShurapreNa dhanushChittvA karNaM vivyAdha patriNA
shlokas.16:
tadapAsya dhanushChinnaM sUtaputro mahAmanAH |
anyatkArmukamAdatta vegaghnaM bhArasAdhanam
shlokas.17:
dRRiShTvA cha kurusauvIrasaindhavAnAM balakShayam |
savarmadhvajashastraishcha patitaiH sa.nvRRitAM mahIm
shlokas.18:
hastyashvanaradehA.nshcha gatAsUnprekShya sarvataH |
sUtaputrasya sa.nrambhAddIptaM vapurajAyata
shlokas.19:
sa visphArya mahachchApaM kArtasvaravibhUShitam |
bhImaM praikShata rAdheyo rAjanghoreNa chakShuShA
shlokas.20:
tataH kruddhaH sharAnasyansUtaputro vyarochata |
madhya.ndinagato.archiShmA~nsharadIva divAkaraH
shlokas.21:
marIchivikachasyeva rAjanbhAnumato vapuH |
AsIdAdhiratherghoraM vapuH sharashatArchiShaH
shlokas.22:
karAbhyAmAdadAnasya sa.ndadhAnasya chAshugAn |
vikarShato mu~nchato vA nAntaraM dadRRishU raNe
shlokas.23:
agnichakropamaM ghoraM maNDalIkRRitamAyudham |
karNasyAsInmahArAja savyadakShiNamasyataH
shlokas.24:
svarNapu~NkhAH sunishitAH karNachApachyutAH sharAH |
prAchChAdayanmahArAja dishaH sUryasya cha prabhAm
shlokas.25:
tataH kanakapu~NkhAnAM sharANAM nataparvaNAm |
dhanushchyutAnAM viyati dadRRishe bahudhA vrajaH
shlokas.26:
sharAsanAdAdhiratheH prabhavantaH sma sAyakAH |
shreNIkRRitA vyarAjanta rAjankrau~nchA ivAmbare
shlokas.27:
gArdhrapatrA~nshilAdhautAnkArtasvaravibhUShitAn |
mahAvegAnpradIptAgrAnmumochAdhirathiH sharAn
shlokas.28:
te tu chApabaloddhUtAH shAtakumbhavibhUShitAH |
ajasramanvakIryanta sharAH pArtharathaM prati
shlokas.29:
te vyomni ratnavikRRitA vyakAshanta sahasrashaH |
shalabhAnAmiva vrAtAH sharAH karNasamIritAH
shlokas.30:
chApAdAdhirathermuktAH prapatantaH sma sAyakAH |
eko dIrgha iva prA.nshuH prabhavandRRishyate sharaH
shlokas.31:
parvataM vAridhArAbhishChAdayanniva toyadaH |
karNaH prAchChAdayatkruddho bhImaM sAyakavRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.32:
tatra bhArata bhImasya balavIryaparAkramam |
vyavasAyaM cha putrAste praikShanta kurubhiH saha
shlokas.33:
tAM samudramivoddhUtAM sharavRRiShTiM samutthitAm |
achintayitvA bhImastu kruddhaH karNamupAdravat
shlokas.34:
rukmapRRiShThaM mahachchApaM bhImasyAsIdvishAM pate |
AkarShAnmaNDalIbhUtaM shakrachApamivAparam
tasmAchCharAH prAdurAsanpUrayanta ivAmbaram
shlokas.35:
suvarNapu~NkhairbhImena sAyakairnataparvabhiH |
gagane rachitA mAlA kA~nchanIva vyarAjata
shlokas.36:
tato vyomni viShaktAni sharajAlAni bhAgashaH |
AhatAni vyashIryanta bhImasenasya patribhiH
shlokas.37:
karNasya sharajAlaughairbhImasenasya chobhayoH |
agnisphuli~Ngasa.nsparshaira~njogatibhirAhave
taistaiH kanakapu~NkhAnAM dyaurAsItsa.nvRRitA vrajaiH
shlokas.38:
sa bhImaM ChAdayanbANaiH sUtaputraH pRRithagvidhaiH |
upArohadanAdRRitya tasya vIryaM mahAtmanaH
shlokas.39:
tayorvisRRijatostatra sharajAlAni mAriSha |
vAyubhUtAnyadRRishyanta sa.nsaktAnItaretaram
shlokas.40:
tasmai karNaH shitAnbANAnkarmAraparimArjitAn |
suvarNavikRRitAnkruddhaH prAhiNodvadhakA~NkShayA
shlokas.41:
tAnantarikShe vishikhaistridhaikaikamashAtayat |
visheShayansUtaputraM bhImastiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.42:
punashchAsRRijadugrANi sharavarShANi pANDavaH |
amarShI balavAnkruddho didhakShanniva pAvakaH
shlokas.43:
tasya tAnyAdade karNaH sarvANyastrANyabhItavat |
yudhyataH pANDuputrasya sUtaputro.astramAyayA
shlokas.44:
tasyeShudhI dhanurjyAM cha bANaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
rashmInyoktrANi chAshvAnAM karNo vaikartano.achChinat
shlokas.45:
athAsyAshvAnpunarhatvA tribhirvivyAdha sArathim |
so.avaplutya drutaM sUto yuyudhAnarathaM yayau
shlokas.46:
utsmayanniva bhImasya kruddhaH kAlAnalaprabhaH |
dhvajaM chichCheda rAdheyaH patAkAshcha nyapAtayat
shlokas.47:
sa vidhanvA mahArAja rathashaktiM parAmRRishat |
tAmavAsRRijadAvidhya kruddhaH karNarathaM prati
shlokas.48:
tAmAdhirathirAyastaH shaktiM hemapariShkRRitAm |
ApatantIM maholkAbhAM chichCheda dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.49:
sApataddashadhA rAjannikRRittA karNasAyakaiH |
asyataH sUtaputrasya mitrArthe chitrayodhinaH
shlokas.50:
sa charmAdatta kaunteyo jAtarUpapariShkRRitam |
khaDgaM chAnyataraprepsurmRRityoragre jayasya vA
tadasya sahasA karNo vyadhamatprahasanniva
shlokas.51:
sa vicharmA mahArAja virathaH krodhamUrChitaH |
asiM prAsRRijadAvidhya tvarankarNarathaM prati
shlokas.52:
sa dhanuH sUtaputrasya ChittvA jyAM cha susa.nshitaH |
apatadbhuvi nistri.nshashchyutaH sarpa ivAmbarAt
shlokas.53:
tataH prahasyAdhirathiranyadAdatta kArmukam |
shatrughnaM samare kruddho dRRiDhajyaM vegavattaram
shlokas.54:
sa bhImasenaH kupito balavAnsatyavikramaH |
vihAyasaM prAkramadvai karNasya vyathayanmanaH
shlokas.55:
tasya tachcharitaM dRRiShTvA sa~NgrAme vijayaiShiNaH |
layamAsthAya rAdheyo bhImasenamava~nchayat
shlokas.56:
tamadRRiShTvA rathopasthe nilInaM vyathitendriyam |
dhvajamasya samAsAdya tasthau sa dharaNItale
shlokas.57:
tadasya kuravaH sarve chAraNAshchAbhyapUjayan |
yadiyeSha rathAtkarNaM hantuM tArkShya ivoragam
shlokas.58:
sa ChinnadhanvA virathaH svadharmamanupAlayan |
svarathaM pRRiShThataH kRRitvA yuddhAyaiva vyavasthitaH
shlokas.59:
tadvihatyAsya rAdheyastata enaM samabhyayAt |
sa.nrabdhaH pANDavaM sa~Nkhye yuddhAya samupasthitam
shlokas.60:
tau sametau mahAra~Nge spardhamAnau mahAbalau |
jImUtAviva gharmAnte garjamAnau nabhastale
shlokas.61:
tayorAsItsamprahAraH kruddhayornarasiMhayoH |
amRRiShyamANayoH sa~Nkhye devadAnavayoriva
shlokas.62:
kShINashastrastu kaunteyaH karNena samabhidrutaH |
dRRiShTvArjunahatAnnAgAnpatitAnparvatopamAn
rathamArgavighAtArthaM vyAyudhaH pravivesha ha
shlokas.63:
hastinAM vrajamAsAdya rathadurgaM pravishya cha |
pANDavo jIvitAkA~NkShI rAdheyaM nAbhyahArayat
shlokas.64:
vyavasthAnamathAkA~NkShandhana~njayasharairhatam |
udyamya ku~njaraM pArthastasthau parapura~njayaH
shlokas.65:
tamasya vishikhaiH karNo vyadhamatku~njaraM punaH |
hastya~NgAnyatha karNAya prAhiNotpANDavo nadan
shlokas.66:
chakrANyashvA.nstathA vAhAnyadyatpashyati bhUtale |
tattadAdAya chikShepa kruddhaH karNAya pANDavaH
shlokas.67:
tadasya sarvaM chichCheda kShiptaM kShiptaM shitaiH sharaiH |
vyAyudhaM nAvadhIchchainaM karNaH kuntyA vachaH smaran
shlokas.68:
dhanuSho.agreNa taM karNastvabhidrutya parAmRRishat |
utsmayanniva rAdheyo bhImasenamuvAcha ha
shlokas.69:
punaH punastUbaraka mUDha audariketi cha |
akRRitAstraka mA yotsIrbAla sa~NgrAmakAtara
shlokas.70:
yatra bhojyaM bahuvidhaM bhakShyaM peyaM cha pANDava |
tatra tvaM durmate yogyo na yuddheShu katha~nchana
shlokas.71:
munirbhUtvAtha vA bhIma phalAnyaddhi sudurmate |
vanAya vraja kaunteya na tvaM yuddhavishAradaH
shlokas.72:
phalamUlAshane yuktastvaM tathAtithibhojane |
na tvAM shastrasamudyoge yogyaM manye vRRikodara
shlokas.73:
puShpamUlaphalAhAro vrateShu niyameShu cha |
uchitastvaM vane bhIma na tvaM yuddhavishAradaH
shlokas.74:
kva yuddhaM kva munitvaM cha vanaM gachCha vRRikodara |
na tvaM yuddhochitastAta vanavAsaratirbhava
shlokas.75:
sUdAnbhRRityajanAndAsA.nstvaM gRRihe tvarayanbhRRisham |
yogyastADayituM krodhAdbhojanArthaM vRRikodara
shlokas.76:
kaumAre yAni chApyAsannapriyANi vishAM pate |
pUrvavRRittAni chApyenaM rUkShANyashrAvayadbhRRisham
shlokas.77:
athainaM tatra sa.nlInamaspRRishaddhanuShA punaH |
prahasa.nshcha punarvAkyaM bhImamAha vRRiShastadA
shlokas.78:
yoddhavyamAvishAnyatra na yoddhavyaM tu mAdRRishaiH |
mAdRRishairyudhyamAnAnAmetachchAnyachcha vidyate
shlokas.79:
gachCha vA yatra tau kRRiShNau tau tvA rakShiShyato raNe |
gRRihaM vA gachCha kaunteya kiM te yuddhena bAlaka
shlokas.80:
evaM taM virathaM kRRitvA karNo rAjanvyakatthata |
pramukhe vRRiShNisiMhasya pArthasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.82:
tataH pArthabhujotsRRiShTAH sharAH kA~nchanabhUShaNAH |
gANDIvaprabhavAH karNaM ha.nsAH krau~nchamivAvishan
shlokas.84:
sa ChinnadhanvA bhImena dhana~njayasharAhataH |
karNo bhImAdapAyAsIdrathena mahatA drutam
shlokas.85:
bhImo.api sAtyakervAhaM samAruhya nararShabhaH |
anvayAdbhrAtaraM sa~Nkhye pANDavaM savyasAchinam
shlokas.86:
tataH karNaM samuddishya tvaramANo dhana~njayaH |
nArAchaM krodhatAmrAkShaH praiShInmRRityumivAntakaH
shlokas.87:
sa garutmAnivAkAshe prArthayanbhujagottamam |
nArAcho.abhyapatatkarNaM tUrNaM gANDIvachoditaH
shlokas.89:
tato drauNiM chatuHShaShTyA vivyAdha kupito.arjunaH |
shilImukhairmahArAja mA gAstiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.91:
tataH suvarNapRRiShThAnAM dhanuShAM kUjatAM raNe |
shabdaM gANDIvaghoSheNa kaunteyo.abhyabhavadbalI
shlokas.92:
dhana~njayastathA yAntaM pRRiShThato drauNimabhyayAt |
nAtidIrghamivAdhvAnaM sharaiH santrAsayanbalam
shlokas.94:
tadbalaM bharatashreShTha savAjidvipamAnavam |
pAkashAsanirAyastaH pArthaH saMnijaghAna ha

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
ahanyahani me dIptaM yashaH patati sa~njaya |
hatA me bahavo yodhA manye kAlasya paryayam
shlokas.2:
dhana~njayastu sa~NkruddhaH praviShTo mAmakaM balam |
rakShitaM droNakarNAbhyAmapraveshyaM surairapi
shlokas.3:
tAbhyAmUrjitavIryAbhyAmApyAyitaparAkramaH |
sahitaH kRRiShNabhImAbhyAM shinInAmRRiShabheNa cha
shlokas.4:
tadA prabhRRiti mA shoko dahatyagnirivAshayam |
grastAnhi pratipashyAmi bhUmipAlAnsasaindhavAn
shlokas.5:
apriyaM sumahatkRRitvA sindhurAjaH kirITinaH |
chakShurviShayamApannaH kathaM muchyeta jIvitaH
shlokas.6:
anumAnAchcha pashyAmi nAsti sa~njaya saindhavaH |
yuddhaM tu tadyathA vRRittaM tanmamAchakShva pRRichChataH
shlokas.7:
yachcha vikShobhya mahatIM senAM sa.nloDya chAsakRRit |
ekaH praviShTaH sa~Nkruddho nalinImiva ku~njaraH
shlokas.8:
tasya vRRiShNipravIrasya brUhi yuddhaM yathAtatham |
dhana~njayArthe yattasya kushalo hyasi sa~njaya
shlokas.9:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tathA tu vaikartanapIDitaM taM; bhImaM prayAntaM puruShapravIram |
samIkShya rAjannaravIramadhye; shinipravIro.anuyayau rathena
shlokas.10:
nadanyathA vajradharastapAnte; jvalanyathA jaladAnte cha sUryaH |
nighnannamitrAndhanuShA dRRiDhena; sa~Nkampaya.nstava putrasya senAm
shlokas.11:
taM yAntamashvai rajataprakAshai;rAyodhane naravIraM charantam |
nAshaknuvanvArayituM tvadIyAH; sarve rathA bhArata mAdhavAgryam
shlokas.12:
amarShapUrNastvanivRRittayodhI; sharAsanI kA~nchanavarmadhArI |
alambusaH sAtyakiM mAdhavAgrya;mavArayadrAjavaro.abhipatya
shlokas.13:
tayorabhUdbhArata samprahAra;stathAgato naiva babhUva kashchit |
praikShanta evAhavashobhinau tau; yodhAstvadIyAshcha pare cha sarve
shlokas.14:
avidhyadenaM dashabhiH pRRiShatkai;ralambuso rAjavaraH prasahya |
anAgatAneva tu tAnpRRiShatkAM;shchichCheda bANaiH shinipu~Ngavo.api
shlokas.15:
punaH sa bANaistribhiragnikalpai;rAkarNapUrNairnishitaiH supu~NkhaiH |
vivyAdha dehAvaraNaM vidArya; te sAtyakerAvivishuH sharIram
shlokas.16:
taiH kAyamasyAgnyanilaprabhAvai;rvidArya bANairaparairjvaladbhiH |
AjaghnivA.nstAnrajataprakAshA;nashvA.nshchaturbhishchaturaH prasahya
shlokas.17:
tathA tu tenAbhihatastarasvI; naptA shineshchakradharaprabhAvaH |
alambusasyottamavegavadbhi;rhayA.nshchaturbhirnijaghAna bANaiH
shlokas.18:
athAsya sUtasya shiro nikRRitya; bhallena kAlAnalasaMnibhena |
sakuNDalaM pUrNashashiprakAshaM; bhrAjiShNu vaktraM nichakarta dehAt
shlokas.19:
nihatya taM pArthivaputrapautraM; sa~Nkhye madhUnAmRRiShabhaH pramAthI |
tato.anvayAdarjunameva vIraH; sainyAni rAja.nstava saMnivArya
shlokas.20:
anvAgataM vRRiShNivaraM samIkShya; tathArimadhye parivartamAnam |
ghnantaM kurUNAmiShubhirbalAni; punaH punarvAyurivAbhrapUgAn
shlokas.21:
tato.avahansaindhavAH sAdhu dAntA; gokShIrakundenduhimaprakAshAH |
suvarNajAlAvatatAH sadashvA; yato yataH kAmayate nRRisiMhaH
shlokas.22:
athAtmajAste sahitAbhipetu;ranye cha yodhAstvaritAstvadIyAH |
kRRitvA mukhaM bhArata yodhamukhyaM; duHshAsanaM tvatsutamAjamIDha
shlokas.23:
te sarvataH samparivArya sa~Nkhye; shaineyamAjaghnuranIkasAhAH |
sa chApi tAnpravaraH sAtvatAnAM; nyavArayadbANajAlena vIraH
shlokas.24:
nivArya tA.nstUrNamamitraghAtI; naptA shineH patribhiragnikalpaiH |
duHshAsanasyApi jaghAna vAhA;nudyamya bANAsanamAjamIDha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tamudyataM mahAbAhuM duHshAsanarathaM prati |
tvaritaM tvaraNIyeShu dhana~njayahitaiShiNam
shlokas.2:
trigartAnAM maheShvAsAH suvarNavikRRitadhvajAH |
senAsamudramAviShTamAnartaM paryavArayan
shlokas.3:
athainaM rathava.nshena sarvataH saMnivArya te |
avAkira~nsharavrAtaiH kruddhAH paramadhanvinaH
shlokas.4:
ajayadrAjaputrA.nstAnyatamAnAnmahAraNe |
ekaH pa~nchAshataM shatrUnsAtyakiH satyavikramaH
shlokas.5:
samprApya bhAratImadhyaM talaghoShasamAkulam |
asishaktigadApUrNamaplavaM salilaM yathA
shlokas.6:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma shaineyacharitaM raNe |
pratIchyAM dishi taM dRRiShTvA prAchyAM pashyAma lAghavAt
shlokas.7:
udIchIM dakShiNAM prAchIM pratIchIM prasRRitastathA |
nRRityannivAcharachChUro yathA rathashataM tathA
shlokas.8:
taddRRiShTvA charitaM tasya siMhavikrAntagAminaH |
trigartAH saMnyavartanta santaptAH svajanaM prati
shlokas.9:
tamanye shUrasenAnAM shUrAH sa~Nkhye nyavArayan |
niyachChantaH sharavrAtairmattaM dvipamivA~NkushaiH
shlokas.10:
tAnnyavArayadAyastAnmuhUrtamiva sAtyakiH |
tataH kali~Ngairyuyudhe so.achintyabalavikramaH
shlokas.11:
tAM cha senAmatikramya kali~NgAnAM duratyayAm |
atha pArthaM mahAbAhurdhana~njayamupAsadat
shlokas.12:
taranniva jale shrAnto yathA sthalamupeyivAn |
taM dRRiShTvA puruShavyAghraM yuyudhAnaH samAshvasat
shlokas.13:
tamAyAntamabhiprekShya keshavo.arjunamabravIt |
asAvAyAti shaineyastava pArtha padAnugaH
shlokas.14:
eSha shiShyaH sakhA chaiva tava satyaparAkramaH |
sarvAnyodhA.nstRRiNIkRRitya vijigye puruSharShabhaH
shlokas.15:
eSha kauravayodhAnAM kRRitvA ghoramupadravam |
tava prANaiH priyataraH kirITinneti sAtyakiH
shlokas.16:
eSha droNaM tathA bhojaM kRRitavarmANameva cha |
kadarthIkRRitya vishikhaiH phalgunAbhyeti sAtyakiH
shlokas.17:
dharmarAjapriyAnveShI hatvA yodhAnvarAnvarAn |
shUrashchaiva kRRitAstrashcha phalgunAbhyeti sAtyakiH
shlokas.18:
kRRitvA suduShkaraM karma sainyamadhye mahAbalaH |
tava darshanamanvichChanpANDavAbhyeti sAtyakiH
shlokas.19:
bahUnekarathenAjau yodhayitvA mahArathAn |
AchAryapramukhAnpArtha AyAtyeSha hi sAtyakiH
shlokas.20:
svabAhubalamAshritya vidArya cha varUthinIm |
preShito dharmaputreNa parthaiSho.abhyeti sAtyakiH
shlokas.21:
yasya nAsti samo yodhaH kauraveShu katha~nchana |
so.ayamAyAti kaunteya sAtyakiH satyavikramaH
shlokas.22:
kurusainyAdvimukto vai siMho madhyAdgavAmiva |
nihatya bahulAH senAH pArthaiSho.abhyeti sAtyakiH
shlokas.23:
eSha rAjasahasrANAM vaktraiH pa~NkajasaMnibhaiH |
AstIrya vasudhAM pArtha kShipramAyAti sAtyakiH
shlokas.24:
eSha duryodhanaM jitvA bhrAtRRibhiH sahitaM raNe |
nihatya jalasandhaM cha kShipramAyAti sAtyakiH
shlokas.25:
rudhiraughavatIM kRRitvA nadIM shoNitakardamAm |
tRRiNavannyasya kauravyAneSha AyAti sAtyakiH
shlokas.26:
tato.aprahRRiShTaH kaunteyaH keshavaM vAkyamabravIt |
na me priyaM mahAbAho yanmAmabhyeti sAtyakiH
shlokas.27:
na hi jAnAmi vRRittAntaM dharmarAjasya keshava |
sAtvatena vihInaH sa yadi jIvati vA na vA
shlokas.28:
etena hi mahAbAho rakShitavyaH sa pArthivaH |
tameSha kathamutsRRijya mama kRRiShNa padAnugaH
shlokas.29:
rAjA droNAya chotsRRiShTaH saindhavashchAnipAtitaH |
pratyudyAtashcha shaineyameSha bhUrishravA raNe
shlokas.30:
so.ayaM gurutaro bhAraH saindhavAnme samAhitaH |
j~nAtavyashcha hi me rAjA rakShitavyashcha sAtyakiH
shlokas.31:
jayadrathashcha hantavyo lambate cha divAkaraH |
shrAntashchaiSha mahAbAhuralpaprANashcha sAmpratam
shlokas.32:
parishrAntA hayAshchAsya hayayantA cha mAdhava |
na cha bhUrishravAH shrAntaH sasahAyashcha keshava
shlokas.33:
apIdAnIM bhavedasya kShemamasminsamAgame |
kachchinna sAgaraM tIrtvA sAtyakiH satyavikramaH
goShpadaM prApya sIdeta mahaujAH shinipu~NgavaH
shlokas.34:
api kauravamukhyena kRRitAstreNa mahAtmanA |
sametya bhUrishravasA svastimAnsAtyakirbhavet
shlokas.35:
vyatikramamimaM manye dharmarAjasya keshava |
AchAryAdbhayamutsRRijya yaH preShayati sAtyakim
shlokas.36:
grahaNaM dharmarAjasya khagaH shyena ivAmiSham |
nityamAsha.nsate droNaH kachchitsyAtkushalI nRRipaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tamApatantaM samprekShya sAtvataM yuddhadurmadam |
krodhAdbhUrishravA rAjansahasA samupAdravat
shlokas.2:
tamabravInmahAbAhuH kauravyaH shinipu~Ngavam |
adya prApto.asi diShTyA me chakShurviShayamityuta
shlokas.3:
chirAbhilaShitaM kAmamadya prApsyAmi sa.nyuge |
na hi me mokShyase jIvanyadi notsRRijase raNam
shlokas.4:
adya tvAM samare hatvA nityaM shUrAbhimAninam |
nandayiShyAmi dAshArha kururAjaM suyodhanam
shlokas.5:
adya madbANanirdagdhaM patitaM dharaNItale |
drakShyatastvAM raNe vIrau sahitau keshavArjunau
shlokas.6:
adya dharmasuto rAjA shrutvA tvAM nihataM mayA |
savrIDo bhavitA sadyo yenAsIha praveshitaH
shlokas.7:
adya me vikramaM pArtho vij~nAsyati dhana~njayaH |
tvayi bhUmau vinihate shayAne rudhirokShite
shlokas.8:
chirAbhilaShito hyadya tvayA saha samAgamaH |
purA devAsure yuddhe shakrasya balinA yathA
shlokas.9:
adya yuddhaM mahAghoraM tava dAsyAmi sAtvata |
tato j~nAsyasi tattvena madvIryabalapauruSham
shlokas.10:
adya sa.nyamanIM yAtA mayA tvaM nihato raNe |
yathA rAmAnujenAjau rAvaNirlakShmaNena vai
shlokas.11:
