adya kRRiShNashcha pArthashcha dharmarAjashcha mAdhava |
hate tvayi nirutsAhA raNaM tyakShyantyasa.nshayam
shlokas.12:
adya te.apachitiM kRRitvA shitairmAdhava sAyakaiH |
tatstriyo nandayiShyAmi ye tvayA nihatA raNe
shlokas.13:
chakShurviShayasamprApto na tvaM mAdhava mokShyase |
siMhasya viShayaM prApto yathA kShudramRRigastathA
shlokas.14:
yuyudhAnastu taM rAjanpratyuvAcha hasanniva |
kauraveya na santrAso vidyate mama sa.nyuge
shlokas.15:
sa mAM nihanyAtsa~NgrAme yo mAM kuryAnnirAyudham |
samAstu shAshvatIrhanyAdyo mAM hanyAddhi sa.nyuge
shlokas.16:
kiM mRRiShoktena bahunA karmaNA tu samAchara |
shAradasyeva meghasya garjitaM niShphalaM hi te
shlokas.17:
shrutvaitadgarjitaM vIra hAsyaM hi mama jAyate |
chirakAlepsitaM loke yuddhamadyAstu kaurava
shlokas.18:
tvarate me matistAta tvayi yuddhAbhikA~NkShiNi |
nAhatvA saMnivartiShye tvAmadya puruShAdhama
shlokas.19:
anyonyaM tau tadA vAgbhistakShantau narapu~Ngavau |
jighA.nsU paramakruddhAvabhijaghnaturAhave
shlokas.20:
sametau tau naravyAghrau shuShmiNau spardhinau raNe |
dviradAviva sa~Nkruddhau vAshitArthe madotkaTau
shlokas.21:
bhUrishravAH sAtyakishcha vavarShaturari.ndamau |
sharavarShANi bhImAni meghAviva parasparam
shlokas.22:
saumadattistu shaineyaM prachChAdyeShubhirAshugaiH |
jighA.nsurbharatashreShTha vivyAdha nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.23:
dashabhiH sAtyakiM viddhvA saumadattirathAparAn |
mumocha nishitAnbANA~njighA.nsuH shinipu~Ngavam
shlokas.24:
tAnasya vishikhA.nstIkShNAnantarikShe vishAM pate |
aprAptAnastramAyAbhiragrasatsAtyakiH prabho
shlokas.25:
tau pRRithakSharavarShAbhyAmavarShetAM parasparam |
uttamAbhijanau vIrau kuruvRRiShNiyashaskarau
shlokas.26:
tau nakhairiva shArdUlau dantairiva mahAdvipau |
rathashaktibhiranyonyaM vishikhaishchApyakRRintatAm
shlokas.27:
nirbhidantau hi gAtrANi vikSharantau cha shoNitam |
vyaShTambhayetAmanyonyaM prANadyUtAbhidevinau
shlokas.28:
evamuttamakarmANau kuruvRRiShNiyashaskarau |
parasparamayudhyetAM vAraNAviva yUthapau
shlokas.29:
tAvadIrgheNa kAlena brahmalokapuraskRRitau |
jigIShantau paraM sthAnamanyonyamabhijaghnatuH
shlokas.30:
sAtyakiH saumadattishcha sharavRRiShTyA parasparam |
hRRiShTavaddhArtarAShTrANAM pashyatAmabhyavarShatAm
shlokas.31:
sampraikShanta janAstatra yudhyamAnau yudhAM patI |
yUthapau vAshitAhetoH prayuddhAviva ku~njarau
shlokas.32:
anyonyasya hayAnhatvA dhanuShI vinikRRitya cha |
virathAvasiyuddhAya sameyAtAM mahAraNe
shlokas.33:
ArShabhe charmaNI chitre pragRRihya vipule shubhe |
vikoshau chApyasI kRRitvA samare tau vicheratuH
shlokas.34:
charantau vividhAnmArgAnmaNDalAni cha bhAgashaH |
muhurAjaghnatuH kruddhAvanyonyamarimardanau
shlokas.35:
sakhaDgau chitravarmANau saniShkA~NgadabhUShaNau |
raNe raNotkaTau rAjannanyonyaM paryakarShatAm
shlokas.36:
muhUrtamiva rAjendra parikRRiShya parasparam |
pashyatAM sarvasainyAnAM vIrAvAshvasatAM punaH
shlokas.37:
asibhyAM charmaNI shubhre vipule cha sharAvare |
nikRRitya puruShavyAghrau bAhuyuddhaM prachakratuH
shlokas.38:
vyUDhoraskau dIrghabhujau niyuddhakushalAvubhau |
bAhubhiH samasajjetAmAyasaiH parighairiva
shlokas.39:
tayorAsanbhujAghAtA nigrahapragrahau tathA |
shikShAbalasamudbhUtAH sarvayodhapraharShaNAH
shlokas.40:
tayornRRivarayo rAjansamare yudhyamAnayoH |
bhImo.abhavanmahAshabdo vajraparvatayoriva
shlokas.41:
dvipAviva viShANAgraiH shRRi~Ngairiva maharShabhau |
yuyudhAte mahAtmAnau kurusAtvatapu~Ngavau
shlokas.42:
kShINAyudhe sAtvate yudhyamAne; tato.abravIdarjunaM vAsudevaH |
pashyasvainaM virathaM yudhyamAnaM; raNe ketuM sarvadhanurdharANAm
shlokas.43:
praviShTo bhAratIM senAM tava pANDava pRRiShThataH |
yodhitashcha mahAvIryaiH sarvairbhArata bhArataiH
shlokas.44:
parishrAnto yudhAM shreShThaH samprApto bhUridakShiNam |
yuddhakA~NkShiNamAyAntaM naitatsamamivArjuna
shlokas.45:
tato bhUrishravAH kruddhaH sAtyakiM yuddhadurmadam |
udyamya nyahanadrAjanmatto mattamiva dvipam
shlokas.46:
rathasthayordvayoryuddhe kruddhayoryodhamukhyayoH |
keshavArjunayo rAjansamare prekShamANayoH
shlokas.47:
atha kRRiShNo mahAbAhurarjunaM pratyabhAShata |
pashya vRRiShNyandhakavyAghraM saumadattivashaM gatam
shlokas.48:
parishrAntaM gataM bhUmau kRRitvA karma suduShkaram |
tavAntevAsinaM shUraM pAlayArjuna sAtyakim
shlokas.49:
na vashaM yaj~nashIlasya gachChedeSha varArihan |
tvatkRRite puruShavyAghra tadAshu kriyatAM vibho
shlokas.50:
athAbravIddhRRiShTamanA vAsudevaM dhana~njayaH |
pashya vRRiShNipravIreNa krIDantaM kurupu~Ngavam
mahAdvipeneva vane mattena hariyUthapam
shlokas.51:
hAhAkAro mahAnAsItsainyAnAM bharatarShabha |
yadudyamya mahAbAhuH sAtyakiM nyahanadbhuvi
shlokas.52:
sa siMha iva mAta~NgaM vikarShanbhUridakShiNaH |
vyarochata kurushreShThaH sAtvatapravaraM yudhi
shlokas.53:
atha koshAdviniShkRRiShya khaDgaM bhUrishravA raNe |
mUrdhajeShu nijagrAha padA chorasyatADayat
shlokas.54:
tathA tu parikRRiShyantaM dRRiShTvA sAtvatamAhave |
vAsudevastato rAjanbhUyo.arjunamabhAShata
shlokas.55:
pashya vRRiShNyandhakavyAghraM saumadattivashaM gatam |
tava shiShyaM mahAbAho dhanuShyanavaraM tvayA
shlokas.56:
asatyo vikramaH pArtha yatra bhUrishravA raNe |
visheShayati vArShNeyaM sAtyakiM satyavikramam
shlokas.57:
evamukto mahAbAhurvAsudevena pANDavaH |
manasA pUjayAmAsa bhUrishravasamAhave
shlokas.58:
vikarShansAtvatashreShThaM krIDamAna ivAhave |
saMharShayati mAM bhUyaH kurUNAM kIrtivardhanaH
shlokas.59:
pravaraM vRRiShNivIrANAM yanna hanyAddhi sAtyakim |
mahAdvipamivAraNye mRRigendra iva karShati
shlokas.60:
evaM tu manasA rAjanpArthaH sampUjya kauravam |
vAsudevaM mahAbAhurarjunaH pratyabhAShata
shlokas.61:
saindhavAsaktadRRiShTitvAnnainaM pashyAmi mAdhava |
eSha tvasukaraM karma yAdavArthe karomyaham
shlokas.62:
ityuktvA vachanaM kurvanvAsudevasya pANDavaH |
sakhaDgaM yaj~nashIlasya patriNA bAhumachChinat

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sa bAhurapatadbhUmau sakhaDgaH sashubhA~NgadaH |
AdadhajjIvalokasya duHkhamuttamamuttamaH
shlokas.2:
prahariShyanhRRito bAhuradRRishyena kirITinA |
vegenAbhyapatadbhUmau pa~nchAsya iva pannagaH
shlokas.3:
sa moghaM kRRitamAtmAnaM dRRiShTvA pArthena kauravaH |
utsRRijya sAtyakiM krodhAdgarhayAmAsa pANDavam
shlokas.4:
nRRisha.nsaM bata kaunteya karmedaM kRRitavAnasi |
apashyato viShaktasya yanme bAhumachichChidaH
shlokas.5:
kiM nu vakShyasi rAjAnaM dharmaputraM yudhiShThiram |
kiM kurvANo mayA sa~Nkhye hato bhUrishravA iti
shlokas.6:
idamindreNa te sAkShAdupadiShTaM mahAtmanA |
astraM rudreNa vA pArtha droNenAtha kRRipeNa vA
shlokas.7:
nanu nAma svadharmaj~nastvaM loke.abhyadhikaH paraiH |
ayudhyamAnasya kathaM raNe prahRRitavAnasi
shlokas.8:
na pramattAya bhItAya virathAya prayAchate |
vyasane vartamAnAya praharanti manasvinaH
shlokas.9:
idaM tu nIchAcharitamasatpuruShasevitam |
kathamAcharitaM pArtha tvayA karma suduShkaram
shlokas.10:
AryeNa sukaraM hyAhurAryakarma dhana~njaya |
anAryakarma tvAryeNa suduShkarataraM bhuvi
shlokas.11:
yeShu yeShu naraH pArtha yatra yatra cha vartate |
Ashu tachChIlatAmeti tadidaM tvayi dRRishyate
shlokas.12:
kathaM hi rAjava.nshyastvaM kauraveyo visheShataH |
kShatradharmAdapakrAntaH suvRRittashcharitavrataH
shlokas.13:
idaM tu yadatikShudraM vArShNeyArthe kRRitaM tvayA |
vAsudevamataM nUnaM naitattvayyupapadyate
shlokas.14:
ko hi nAma pramattAya pareNa saha yudhyate |
IdRRishaM vyasanaM dadyAdyo na kRRiShNasakho bhavet
shlokas.15:
vrAtyAH sa.nshliShTakarmANaH prakRRityaiva vigarhitAH |
vRRiShNyandhakAH kathaM pArtha pramANaM bhavatA kRRitAH
shlokas.16:
evamuktvA mahAbAhuryUpaketurmahAyashAH |
yuyudhAnaM parityajya raNe prAyamupAvishat
shlokas.17:
sharAnAstIrya savyena pANinA puNyalakShaNaH |
yiyAsurbrahmalokAya prANAnprANeShvathAjuhot
shlokas.18:
sUrye chakShuH samAdhAya prasannaM salile manaH |
dhyAyanmahopaniShadaM yogayukto.abhavanmuniH
shlokas.19:
tataH sa sarvasenAyAM janaH kRRiShNadhana~njayau |
garhayAmAsa taM chApi shasha.nsa puruSharShabham
shlokas.20:
nindyamAnau tathA kRRiShNau nochatuH ki~nchidapriyam |
prashasyamAnashcha tathA nAhRRiShyadyUpaketanaH
shlokas.21:
tA.nstathA vAdino rAjanputrA.nstava dhana~njayaH |
amRRiShyamANo manasA teShAM tasya cha bhAShitam
shlokas.22:
asa~NkruddhamanA vAchA smArayanniva bhArata |
uvAcha pANDutanayaH sAkShepamiva phalgunaH
shlokas.23:
mama sarve.api rAjAno jAnantyetanmahAvratam |
na shakyo mAmako hantuM yo me syAdbANagochare
shlokas.24:
yUpaketo samIkShya tvaM na mAM garhitumarhasi |
na hi dharmamavij~nAya yuktaM garhayituM param
shlokas.25:
Attashastrasya hi raNe vRRiShNivIraM jighA.nsataH |
yadahaM bAhumachChaitsaM na sa dharmo vigarhitaH
shlokas.26:
nyastashastrasya bAlasya virathasya vivarmaNaH |
abhimanyorvadhaM tAta dhArmikaH ko na pUjayet
shlokas.27:
evamuktastu pArthena shirasA bhUmimaspRRishat |
pANinA chaiva savyena prAhiNodasya dakShiNam
shlokas.28:
etatpArthasya tu vachastataH shrutvA mahAdyutiH |
yUpaketurmahArAja tUShNImAsIdavA~NmukhaH
shlokas.29:
arjuna uvAcha||
yA prItirdharmarAje me bhIme cha vadatAM vare |
nakule sahadeve cha sA me tvayi shalAgraja
shlokas.30:
mayA tu samanuj~nAtaH kRRiShNena cha mahAtmanA |
gachCha puNyakRRitA.NllokA~nshibiraushInaro yathA
shlokas.31:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tata utthAya shaineyo vimuktaH saumadattinA |
khaDgamAdAya chichChitsuH shirastasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.32:
nihataM pANDuputreNa pramattaM bhUridakShiNam |
iyeSha sAtyakirhantuM shalAgrajamakalmaSham
shlokas.33:
nikRRittabhujamAsInaM Chinnahastamiva dvipam |
kroshatAM sarvasainyAnAM nindyamAnaH sudurmanAH
shlokas.34:
vAryamANaH sa kRRiShNena pArthena cha mahAtmanA |
bhImena chakrarakShAbhyAmashvatthAmnA kRRipeNa cha
shlokas.35:
karNena vRRiShasenena saindhavena tathaiva cha |
vikroshatAM cha sainyAnAmavadhIttaM yatavratam
shlokas.36:
prAyopaviShTAya raNe pArthena ChinnabAhave |
sAtyakiH kauravendrAya khaDgenApAharachChiraH
shlokas.37:
nAbhyanandanta tatsainyAH sAtyakiM tena karmaNA |
arjunena hataM pUrvaM yajjaghAna kurUdvaham
shlokas.38:
sahasrAkShasamaM tatra siddhachAraNamAnavAH |
bhUrishravasamAlokya yuddhe prAyagataM hatam
shlokas.39:
apUjayanta taM devA vismitAstasya karmabhiH |
pakShavAdA.nshcha bahushaH prAvada.nstasya sainikAH
shlokas.40:
na vArShNeyasyAparAdho bhavitavyaM hi tattathA |
tasmAnmanyurna vaH kAryaH krodho duHkhakaro nRRiNAm
shlokas.41:
hantavyashchaiSha vIreNa nAtra kAryA vichAraNA |
vihito hyasya dhAtraiva mRRityuH sAtyakirAhave
shlokas.42:
sAtyakiruvAcha||
na hantavyo na hantavya iti yanmAM prabhAShatha |
dharmavAdairadharmiShThA dharmaka~nchukamAsthitAH
shlokas.43:
yadA bAlaH subhadrAyAH sutaH shastravinAkRRitaH |
yuShmAbhirnihato yuddhe tadA dharmaH kva vo gataH
shlokas.44:
mayA tvetatpratij~nAtaM kShepe kasmi.nshchideva hi |
yo mAM niShpiShya sa~NgrAme jIvanhanyAtpadA ruShA
sa me vadhyo bhavechChatruryadyapi syAnmunivrataH
shlokas.45:
cheShTamAnaM pratIghAte sabhujaM mAM sachakShuShaH |
manyadhvaM mRRitamityevametadvo buddhilAghavam
yukto hyasya pratIghAtaH kRRito me kurupu~NgavAH
shlokas.46:
yattu pArthena matsnehAtsvAM pratij~nAM cha rakShatA |
sakhaDgo.asya hRRito bAhuretenaivAsmi va~nchitaH
shlokas.47:
bhavitavyaM cha yadbhAvi daivaM cheShTayatIva cha |
so.ayaM hato vimarde.asminkimatrAdharmacheShTitam
shlokas.48:
api chAyaM purA gItaH shloko vAlmIkinA bhuvi |
pIDAkaramamitrANAM yatsyAtkartavyameva tat
shlokas.49:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamukte mahArAja sarve kauravapANDavAH |
na sma ki~nchidabhAShanta manasA samapUjayan
shlokas.50:
mantrairhi pUtasya mahAdhvareShu; yashasvino bhUrisahasradasya |
munerivAraNyagatasya tasya; na tatra kashchidvadhamabhyanandat
shlokas.51:
sunIlakeshaM varadasya tasya; shUrasya pArAvatalohitAkSham |
ashvasya medhyasya shiro nikRRittaM; nyastaM havirdhAnamivottareNa
shlokas.52:
sa tejasA shastrahatena pUto; mahAhave dehavaraM visRRijya |
AkrAmadUrdhvaM varado varArho; vyAvRRitya dharmeNa pareNa rodasI

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
ajito droNarAdheyavikarNakRRitavarmabhiH |
tIrNaH sainyArNavaM vIraH pratishrutya yudhiShThire
shlokas.2:
sa kathaM kauraveyeNa samareShvanivAritaH |
nigRRihya bhUrishravasA balAdbhuvi nipAtitaH
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjannihotpattiM shaineyasya yathA purA |
yathA cha bhUrishravaso yatra te sa.nshayo nRRipa
shlokas.4:
atreH putro.abhavatsomaH somasya tu budhaH smRRitaH |
budhasyAsInmahendrAbhaH putra ekaH purUravAH
shlokas.5:
purUravasa Ayustu AyuSho nahuShaH smRRitaH |
nahuShasya yayAtistu rAjarShirdevasaMmitaH
shlokas.6:
yayAterdevayAnyAM tu yadurjyeShTho.abhavatsutaH |
yadorabhUdanvavAye devamIDha iti shrutaH
shlokas.7:
yAdavastasya cha sutaH shUrastrailokyasaMmataH |
shUrasya shaurirnRRivaro vasudevo mahAyashAH
shlokas.8:
dhanuShyanavaraH shUraH kArtavIryasamo yudhi |
tadvIryashchApi tatraiva kule shinirabhUnnRRipaH
shlokas.9:
etasminneva kAle tu devakasya mahAtmanaH |
duhituH svaya.nvare rAjansarvakShatrasamAgame
shlokas.10:
tatra vai devakIM devIM vasudevArthamAptavAn |
nirjitya pArthivAnsarvAnrathamAropayachChiniH
shlokas.11:
tAM dRRiShTvA devakIM shaure rathasthAM puruSharShabhaH |
nAmRRiShyata mahAtejAH somadattaH shinernRRipa
shlokas.12:
tayoryuddhamabhUdrAjandinArdhaM chitramadbhutam |
bAhuyuddhaM subalinoH shakraprahrAdayoriva
shlokas.13:
shininA somadattastu prasahya bhuvi pAtitaH |
asimudyamya kesheShu pragRRihya cha padA hataH
shlokas.14:
madhye rAjasahasrANAM prekShakANAM samantataH |
kRRipayA cha punastena jIveti sa visarjitaH
shlokas.15:
tadavasthaH kRRitastena somadatto.atha mAriSha |
prasAdayanmahAdevamamarShavashamAsthitaH
shlokas.16:
tasya tuShTo mahAdevo varANAM varadaH prabhuH |
vareNa ChandayAmAsa sa tu vavre varaM nRRipaH
shlokas.17:
putramichChAmi bhagavanyo nihanyAchChineH sutam |
madhye rAjasahasrANAM padA hanyAchcha sa.nyuge
shlokas.18:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA somadattasya pArthiva |
evamastviti tatroktvA sa devo.antaradhIyata
shlokas.19:
sa tena varadAnena labdhavAnbhUridakShiNam |
nyapAtayachcha samare saumadattiH shineH sutam
shlokas.20:
etatte kathitaM rAjanyanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi |
na hi shakyA raNe jetuM sAtvatA manujarShabha
shlokas.21:
labdhalakShyAshcha sa~NgrAme bahavashchitrayodhinaH |
devadAnavagandharvAnvijetAro hyavismitAH
svavIryavijaye yuktA naite paraparigrahAH
shlokas.22:
na tulyaM vRRiShNibhiriha dRRishyate ki~nchana prabho |
bhUtaM bhavyaM bhaviShyachcha balena bharatarShabha
shlokas.23:
na j~nAtimavamanyante vRRiddhAnAM shAsane ratAH |
na devAsuragandharvA na yakShoragarAkShasAH
jetAro vRRiShNivIrANAM na punarmAnuShA raNe
shlokas.24:
brahmadravye gurudravye j~nAtidravye.apyahi.nsakAH |
eteShAM rakShitArashcha ye syuH kasyA~nchidApadi
shlokas.25:
arthavanto na chotsiktA brahmaNyAH satyavAdinaH |
samarthAnnAvamanyante dInAnabhyuddharanti cha
shlokas.26:
nityaM devaparA dAntA dAtArashchAvikatthanAH |
tena vRRiShNipravIrANAM chakraM na pratihanyate
shlokas.27:
api meruM vahetkashchittaredvA makarAlayam |
na tu vRRiShNipravIrANAM sametyAntaM vrajennRRipa
shlokas.28:
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM yatra te sa.nshayo vibho |
kururAja narashreShTha tava hyapanayo mahAn

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tadavasthe hate tasminbhUrishravasi kaurave |
yathA bhUyo.abhavadyuddhaM tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
bhUrishravasi sa~NkrAnte paralokAya bhArata |
vAsudevaM mahAbAhurarjunaH samachUchudat
shlokas.3:
chodayAshvAnbhRRishaM kRRiShNa yato rAjA jayadrathaH |
astameti mahAbAho tvaramANo divAkaraH
shlokas.4:
etaddhi puruShavyAghra mahadabhyudyataM mayA |
kAryaM sa.nrakShyate chaiSha kurusenAmahArathaiH
shlokas.5:
nAstameti yathA sUryo yathA satyaM bhavedvachaH |
chodayAshvA.nstathA kRRiShNa yathA hanyAM jayadratham
shlokas.6:
tataH kRRiShNo mahAbAhU rajatapratimAnhayAn |
hayaj~nashchodayAmAsa jayadratharathaM prati
shlokas.7:
taM prayAntamamogheShumutpatadbhirivAshugaiH |
tvaramANA mahArAja senAmukhyAH samAvrajan
shlokas.8:
duryodhanashcha karNashcha vRRiShaseno.atha madrarAT |
ashvatthAmA kRRipashchaiva svayameva cha saindhavaH
shlokas.9:
samAsAdya tu bIbhatsuH saindhavaM pramukhe sthitam |
netrAbhyAM krodhadIptAbhyAM sampraikShannirdahanniva
shlokas.10:
tato duryodhano rAjA rAdheyaM tvarito.abravIt |
arjunaM vIkShya sa.nyAntaM jayadratharathaM prati
shlokas.11:
ayaM sa vaikartana yuddhakAlo; vidarshayasvAtmabalaM mahAtman |
yathA na vadhyeta raNe.arjunena; jayadrathaH karNa tathA kuruShva
shlokas.12:
alpAvashiShTaM divasaM nRRivIra; vighAtayasvAdya ripuM sharaughaiH |
dinakShayaM prApya narapravIra; dhruvaM hi naH karNa jayo bhaviShyati
shlokas.13:
saindhave rakShyamANe tu sUryasyAstamayaM prati |
mithyApratij~naH kaunteyaH pravekShyati hutAshanam
shlokas.14:
anarjunAyAM cha bhuvi muhUrtamapi mAnada |
jIvituM notsaheranvai bhrAtaro.asya sahAnugAH
shlokas.15:
vinaShTaiH pANDaveyaishcha sashailavanakAnanAm |
vasundharAmimAM karNa bhokShyAmo hatakaNTakAm
shlokas.16:
daivenopahataH pArtho viparItashcha mAnada |
kAryAkAryamajAnanvai pratij~nAM kRRitavAnraNe
shlokas.17:
nUnamAtmavinAshAya pANDavena kirITinA |
pratij~neyaM kRRitA karNa jayadrathavadhaM prati
shlokas.18:
kathaM jIvati durdharShe tvayi rAdheya phalgunaH |
anasta~Ngata Aditye hanyAtsaindhavakaM nRRipam
shlokas.19:
rakShitaM madrarAjena kRRipeNa cha mahAtmanA |
jayadrathaM raNamukhe kathaM hanyAddhana~njayaH
shlokas.20:
drauNinA rakShyamANaM cha mayA duHshAsanena cha |
kathaM prApsyati bIbhatsuH saindhavaM kAlachoditaH
shlokas.21:
yudhyante bahavaH shUrA lambate cha divAkaraH |
sha~Nke jayadrathaM pArtho naiva prApsyati mAnada
shlokas.22:
sa tvaM karNa mayA sArdhaM shUraishchAnyairmahArathaiH |
yudhyasva yatnamAsthAya paraM pArthena sa.nyuge
shlokas.23:
evamuktastu rAdheyastava putreNa mAriSha |
duryodhanamidaM vAkyaM pratyuvAcha kurUttamam
shlokas.24:
dRRiDhalakShyeNa shUreNa bhImasenena dhanvinA |
bhRRishamudvejitaH sa~Nkhye sharajAlairanekashaH
shlokas.25:
sthAtavyamiti tiShThAmi raNe samprati mAnada |
naivA~Ngami~Ngati ki~nchinme santaptasya raNeShubhiH
shlokas.26:
yotsyAmi tu tathA rAja~nshaktyAhaM parayA raNe |
yathA pANDavamukhyo.asau na haniShyati saindhavam
shlokas.27:
na hi me yudhyamAnasya sAyakA.nshchAsyataH shitAn |
saindhavaM prApsyate vIraH savyasAchI dhana~njayaH
shlokas.28:
yattu shaktimatA kAryaM satataM hitakAriNA |
tatkariShyAmi kauravya jayo daive pratiShThitaH
shlokas.29:
adya yotsye.arjunamahaM pauruShaM svaM vyapAshritaH |
tvadarthaM puruShavyAghra jayo daive pratiShThitaH
shlokas.30:
adya yuddhaM kurushreShTha mama pArthasya chobhayoH |
pashyantu sarvabhUtAni dAruNaM lomaharShaNam
shlokas.31:
karNakauravayorevaM raNe sambhAShamANayoH |
arjuno nishitairbANairjaghAna tava vAhinIm
shlokas.32:
chichCheda tIkShNAgramukhaiH shUrANAmanivartinAm |
bhujAnparighasa~NkAshAnhastihastopamAnraNe
shlokas.33:
shirA.nsi cha mahAbAhushchichCheda nishitaiH sharaiH |
hastihastAnhayagrIvA rathAkShA.nshcha samantataH
shlokas.34:
shoNitAktAnhayArohAngRRihItaprAsatomarAn |
kShuraishchichCheda bIbhatsurdvidhaikaikaM tridhaiva cha
shlokas.35:
hayavAraNamukhyAshcha prApatanta sahasrashaH |
dhvajAshChatrANi chApAni chAmarANi shirA.nsi cha
shlokas.36:
kakShamagnimivoddhUtaH pradaha.nstava vAhinIm |
achireNa mahIM pArthashchakAra rudhirottarAm
shlokas.37:
hatabhUyiShThayodhaM tatkRRitvA tava balaM balI |
AsasAda durAdharShaH saindhavaM satyavikramaH
shlokas.38:
bIbhatsurbhImasenena sAtvatena cha rakShitaH |
sa babhau bharatashreShTha jvalanniva hutAshanaH
shlokas.39:
taM tathAvasthitaM dRRiShTvA tvadIyA vIryasaMmatAH |
nAmRRiShyanta maheShvAsAH phalgunaM puruSharShabhAH
shlokas.40:
duryodhanashcha karNashcha vRRiShaseno.atha madrarAT |
ashvatthAmA kRRipashchaiva svayameva cha saindhavaH
shlokas.41:
sa.nrabdhAH saindhavasyArthe samAvRRiNvankirITinam |
nRRityantaM rathamArgeShu dhanurjyAtalanisvanaiH
shlokas.42:
sa~NgrAmakovidaM pArthaM sarve yuddhavishAradAH |
abhItAH paryavartanta vyAditAsyamivAntakam
shlokas.43:
saindhavaM pRRiShThataH kRRitvA jighA.nsanto.arjunAchyutau |
sUryAstamayamichChanto lohitAyati bhAskare
shlokas.44:
te bhujairbhogibhogAbhairdhanUMShyAyamya sAyakAn |
mumuchuH sUryarashmyAbhA~nshatashaH phalgunaM prati
shlokas.45:
tAnastAnasyamAnA.nshcha kirITI yuddhadurmadaH |
dvidhA tridhAShTadhaikaikaM ChittvA vivyAdha tAnraNe
shlokas.46:
siMhalA~NgUlaketustu darshaya~nshaktimAtmanaH |
shAradvatIsuto rAjannarjunaM pratyavArayat
shlokas.47:
sa viddhvA dashabhiH pArthaM vAsudevaM cha saptabhiH |
atiShThadrathamArgeShu saindhavaM paripAlayan
shlokas.48:
athainaM kauravashreShThAH sarva eva mahArathAH |
mahatA rathava.nshena sarvataH paryavArayan
shlokas.49:
visphArayantashchApAni visRRijantashcha sAyakAn |
saindhavaM paryarakShanta shAsanAttanayasya te
shlokas.50:
tatra pArthasya shUrasya bAhvorbalamadRRishyata |
iShUNAmakShayatvaM cha dhanuSho gANDivasya cha
shlokas.51:
astrairastrANi sa.nvArya drauNeH shAradvatasya cha |
ekaikaM navabhirbANaiH sarvAneva samarpayat
shlokas.52:
taM drauNiH pa~nchavi.nshatyA vRRiShasenashcha saptabhiH |
duryodhanashcha vi.nshatyA karNashalyau tribhistribhiH
shlokas.53:
ta enamabhigarjanto vidhyantashcha punaH punaH |
vidhunvantashcha chApAni sarvataH paryavArayan
shlokas.54:
shliShTaM tu sarvatashchakrU rathamaNDalamAshu te |
sUryAstamayamichChantastvaramANA mahArathAH
shlokas.55:
ta enamabhinardanto vidhunvAnA dhanUMShi cha |
siShichurmArgaNairghorairgiriM meghA ivAmbubhiH
shlokas.56:
te mahAstrANi divyAni tatra rAjanvyadarshayan |
dhana~njayasya gAtreShu shUrAH parighabAhavaH
shlokas.57:
hatabhUyiShThayodhaM tatkRRitvA tava balaM balI |
AsasAda durAdharShaH saindhavaM satyavikramaH
shlokas.58:
taM karNaH sa.nyuge rAjanpratyavArayadAshugaiH |
miShato bhImasenasya sAtvatasya cha bhArata
shlokas.59:
taM pArtho dashabhirbANaiH pratyavidhyadraNAjire |
sUtaputraM mahAbAhuH sarvasainyasya pashyataH
shlokas.60:
sAtvatashcha tribhirbANaiH karNaM vivyAdha mAriSha |
bhImasenastribhishchaiva punaH pArthashcha saptabhiH
shlokas.61:
tAnkarNaH prativivyAdha ShaShTyA ShaShTyA mahArathaH |
tadyuddhamabhavadrAjankarNasya bahubhiH saha
shlokas.62:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma sUtaputrasya mAriSha |
yadekaH samare kruddhastrInrathAnparyavArayat
shlokas.63:
phalgunastu mahAbAhuH karNaM vaikartanaM raNe |
sAyakAnAM shatenaiva sarvamarmasvatADayat
shlokas.64:
rudhirokShitasarvA~NgaH sUtaputraH pratApavAn |
sharaiH pa~nchAshatA vIraH phalgunaM pratyavidhyata
tasya tallAghavaM dRRiShTvA nAmRRiShyata raNe.arjunaH
shlokas.65:
tataH pArtho dhanushChittvA vivyAdhainaM stanAntare |
sAyakairnavabhirvIrastvaramANo dhana~njayaH
shlokas.66:
vadhArthaM chAsya samare sAyakaM sUryavarchasam |
chikShepa tvarayA yuktastvarAkAle dhana~njayaH
shlokas.67:
tamApatantaM vegena drauNishchichCheda sAyakam |
ardhachandreNa tIkShNena sa ChinnaH prApatadbhuvi
shlokas.68:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya sUtaputraH pratApavAn |
karNo.api dviShatAM hantA ChAdayAmAsa phalgunam
sAyakairbahusAhasraiH kRRitapratikRRitepsayA
shlokas.69:
tau vRRiShAviva nardantau narasiMhau mahArathau |
sAyakaughapratichChannaM chakratuH khamajihmagaiH
adRRishyau cha sharaughaistau nighnatAmitaretaram
shlokas.70:
pArtho.ahamasmi tiShTha tvaM karNo.ahaM tiShTha phalguna |
ityevaM tarjayantau tau vAkShalyaistudatAM tathA
shlokas.71:
yudhyetAM samare vIrau chitraM laghu cha suShThu cha |
prekShaNIyau chAbhavatAM sarvayodhasamAgame
shlokas.72:
prashasyamAnau samare siddhachAraNavAtikaiH |
ayudhyetAM mahArAja parasparavadhaiShiNau
shlokas.73:
tato duryodhano rAja.nstAvakAnabhyabhAShata |
yattA rakShata rAdheyaM nAhatvA samare.arjunam
nivartiShyati rAdheya iti mAmuktavAnvRRiShaH
shlokas.74:
etasminnantare rAjandRRiShTvA karNasya vikramam |
AkarNamuktairiShubhiH karNasya chaturo hayAn
anayanmRRityulokAya chaturbhiH sAyakottamaiH
shlokas.75:
sArathiM chAsya bhallena rathanIDAdapAharat |
ChAdayAmAsa cha sharaistava putrasya pashyataH
shlokas.76:
sa ChAdyamAnaH samare hatAshvo hatasArathiH |
mohitaH sharajAlena kartavyaM nAbhyapadyata
shlokas.77:
taM tathA virathaM dRRiShTvA rathamAropya svaM tadA |
ashvatthAmA mahArAja bhUyo.arjunamayodhayat
shlokas.78:
madrarAjastu kaunteyamavidhyattri.nshatA sharaiH |
shAradvatastu vi.nshatyA vAsudevaM samArpayat
dhana~njayaM dvAdashabhirAjaghAna shilImukhaiH
shlokas.79:
chaturbhiH sindhurAjashcha vRRiShasenashcha saptabhiH |
pRRithakpRRitha~NmahArAja kRRiShNapArthAvavidhyatAm
shlokas.80:
tathaiva tAnpratyavidhyatkuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
droNaputraM chatuHShaShTyA madrarAjaM shatena cha
shlokas.81:
saindhavaM dashabhirbhallairvRRiShasenaM tribhiH sharaiH |
shAradvataM cha vi.nshatyA viddhvA pArthaH samunnadat
shlokas.83:
athArjunaH sarvatodhAramastraM; prAdushchakre trAsayandhArtarAShTrAn |
taM pratyudIyuH kuravaH pANDusUnuM; rathairmahArhaiH sharavarShANyavarShan
shlokas.84:
tatastu tasmi.nstumule samutthite; sudAruNe bhArata mohanIye |
nAmuhyata prApya sa rAjaputraH; kirITamAlI visRRijanpRRiShatkAn
shlokas.85:
rAjyaprepsuH savyasAchI kurUNAM; smarankleshAndvAdashavarShavRRittAn |
gANDIvamuktairiShubhirmahAtmA; sarvA disho vyAvRRiNodaprameyaiH
shlokas.86:
pradIptolkamabhavachchAntarikShaM; deheShu bhUrINyapatanvayA.nsi |
yatpi~Ngalajyena kirITamAlI; kruddho ripUnAjagavena hanti
shlokas.88:
gadAshcha gurvIH parighAnayasmayA;nasI.nshcha shaktIshcha raNe narAdhipAH |
mahAnti shastrANi cha bhImadarshanAH; pragRRihya pArthaM sahasAbhidudruvuH
shlokas.89:
sa tAnudIrNAnsarathAshvavAraNA;npadAtisa~NghA.nshcha mahAdhanurdharaH |
vipannasarvAyudhajIvitAnraNe; chakAra vIro yamarAShTravardhanAn

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sa raNe vyacharatpArthaH prekShaNIyo dhana~njayaH |
yugapaddikShu sarvAsu chitrANyastrANi darshayan
shlokas.2:
madhya.ndinagataM sUryaM pratapantamivAmbare |
na shekuH sarvabhUtAni pANDavaM prativIkShitum
shlokas.3:
prasRRitA.nstasya gANDIvAchCharavrAtAnmahAtmanaH |
sa~NgrAme samapashyAma ha.nsapa~NktIrivAmbare
shlokas.4:
vinivArya sa vIrANAmastrairastrANi sarvashaH |
darshayanraudramAtmAnamugre karmaNi dhiShThitaH
shlokas.5:
sa tAnrathavarAnrAjannabhyatikrAmadarjunaH |
mohayanniva nArAchairjayadrathavadhepsayA
shlokas.6:
visRRijandikShu sarvAsu sharAnasitasArathiH |
sa raNe vyacharattUrNaM prekShaNIyo dhana~njayaH
shlokas.7:
bhramanta iva shUrasya sharavrAtA mahAtmanaH |
adRRishyantAntarikShasthAH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.8:
AdadAnaM maheShvAsaM sa.ndadhAnaM cha pANDavam |
visRRijantaM cha kaunteyaM nAnupashyAmahe tadA
shlokas.9:
tathA sarvA disho rAjansarvA.nshcha rathino raNe |
AkulIkRRitya kaunteyo jayadrathamupAdravat
vivyAdha cha chatuHShaShTyA sharANAM nataparvaNAm
shlokas.10:
saindhavastu tathA viddhaH sharairgANDIvadhanvanA |
na chakShame susa~NkruddhastottrArdita iva dvipaH
shlokas.11:
sa varAhadhvajastUrNaM gArdhrapatrAnajihmagAn |
AshIviShasamaprakhyAnkarmAraparimArjitAn
mumocha nishitAnsa~Nkhye sAyakAnsavyasAchini
shlokas.12:
tribhistu viddhvA gANDIvaM nArAchaiH ShaDbhirarjunam |
aShTAbhirvAjino.avidhyaddhvajaM chaikena patriNA
shlokas.13:
sa vikShipyArjunastIkShNAnsaindhavapreShitA~nsharAn |
yugapattasya chichCheda sharAbhyAM saindhavasya ha
sAratheshcha shiraH kAyAddhvajaM cha samala~NkRRitam
shlokas.14:
sa ChinnayaShTiH sumahA~nshIryamANaH sharAhataH |
varAhaH sindhurAjasya papAtAgnishikhopamaH
shlokas.15:
etasminneva kAle tu drutaM gachChati bhAskare |
abravItpANDavaM tatra tvaramANo janArdanaH
shlokas.16:
dhana~njaya shirashChindhi saindhavasya durAtmanaH |
astaM mahIdharashreShThaM yiyAsati divAkaraH
shRRiNuShvaiva cha me vAkyaM jayadrathavadhaM prati
shlokas.17:
vRRiddhakShatraH saindhavasya pitA jagati vishrutaH |
sa kAleneha mahatA saindhavaM prAptavAnsutam
shlokas.18:
jayadrathamamitraghnaM taM chovAcha tato nRRipam |
antarhitA tadA vANI meghadundubhinisvanA
shlokas.19:
tavAtmajo.ayaM martyeShu kulashIladamAdibhiH |
guNairbhaviShyati vibho sadRRisho va.nshayordvayoH
kShatriyapravaro loke nityaM shUrAbhisatkRRitaH
shlokas.20:
shatrubhiryudhyamAnasya sa~NgrAme tvasya dhanvinaH |
shirashChetsyati sa~NkruddhaH shatrurnAlakShito bhuvi
shlokas.21:
etachChrutvA sindhurAjo dhyAtvA chiramari.ndama |
j~nAtInsarvAnuvAchedaM putrasnehAbhipIDitaH
shlokas.22:
sa~NgrAme yudhyamAnasya vahato mahatIM dhuram |
dharaNyAM mama putrasya pAtayiShyati yaH shiraH
tasyApi shatadhA mUrdhA phaliShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.23:
evamuktvA tato rAjye sthApayitvA jayadratham |
vRRiddhakShatro vanaM yAtastapashcheShTaM samAsthitaH
shlokas.24:
so.ayaM tapyati tejasvI tapo ghoraM durAsadam |
samantapa~nchakAdasmAdbahirvAnaraketana
shlokas.25:
tasmAjjayadrathasya tvaM shirashChittvA mahAmRRidhe |
divyenAstreNa ripuhanghoreNAdbhutakarmaNA
shlokas.26:
sakuNDalaM sindhupateH prabha~njanasutAnuja |
utsa~Nge pAtayasvAshu vRRiddhakShatrasya bhArata
shlokas.27:
atha tvamasya mUrdhAnaM pAtayiShyasi bhUtale |
tavApi shatadhA mUrdhA phaliShyati na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.28:
yathA chaitanna jAnIyAtsa rAjA pRRithivIpatiH |
tathA kuru kurushreShTha divyamastramupAshritaH
shlokas.29:
na hyasAdhyamakAryaM vA vidyate tava ki~nchana |
samasteShvapi lokeShu triShu vAsavanandana
shlokas.30:
etachChrutvA tu vachanaM sRRikkiNI parisa.nlihan |
indrAshanisamasparshaM divyamantrAbhimantritam
shlokas.31:
sarvabhArasahaM shashvadgandhamAlyArchitaM sharam |
visasarjArjunastUrNaM saindhavasya vadhe vRRitaH
shlokas.32:
sa tu gANDIvanirmuktaH sharaH shyena ivAshugaH |
shakuntamiva vRRikShAgrAtsaindhavasya shiro.aharat
shlokas.33:
aharattatpunashchaiva sharairUrdhvaM dhana~njayaH |
durhRRidAmapraharShAya suhRRidAM harShaNAya cha
shlokas.34:
sharaiH kadambakIkRRitya kAle tasmi.nshcha pANDavaH |
samantapa~nchakAdbAhyaM shirastadvyaharattataH
shlokas.35:
etasminneva kAle tu vRRiddhakShatro mahIpatiH |
sandhyAmupAste tejasvI sambandhI tava mAriSha
shlokas.36:
upAsInasya tasyAtha kRRiShNakeshaM sakuNDalam |
sindhurAjasya mUrdhAnamutsa~Nge samapAtayat
shlokas.37:
tasyotsa~Nge nipatitaM shirastachchArukuNDalam |
vRRiddhakShatrasya nRRipateralakShitamari.ndama
shlokas.38:
kRRitajapyasya tasyAtha vRRiddhakShatrasya dhImataH |
uttiShThatastatsahasA shiro.agachChaddharAtalam
shlokas.39:
tatastasya narendrasya putramUrdhani bhUtalam |
gate tasyApi shatadhA mUrdhAgachChadari.ndama
shlokas.40:
tataH sarvANi bhUtAni vismayaM jagmuruttamam |
vAsudevashcha bIbhatsuM prashasha.nsa mahAratham
shlokas.41:
tato dRRiShTvA vinihataM sindhurAjaM jayadratham |
putrANAM tava netrebhyo duHkhAdbahvapatajjalam
shlokas.42:
bhImaseno.api sa~NgrAme bodhayanniva pANDavam |
siMhanAdena mahatA pUrayAmAsa rodasI
shlokas.43:
taM shrutvA tu mahAnAdaM dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
saindhavaM nihataM mene phalgunena mahAtmanA
shlokas.44:
tato vAditraghoSheNa svAnyodhAnabhiharShayan |
abhyavartata sa~NgrAme bhAradvAjaM yuyutsayA
shlokas.45:
tataH pravavRRite rAjannastaM gachChati bhAskare |
droNasya somakaiH sArdhaM sa~NgrAmo lomaharShaNaH
shlokas.46:
te tu sarvaprayatnena bhAradvAjaM jighA.nsavaH |
saindhave nihate rAjannayudhyanta mahArathAH
shlokas.47:
pANDavAstu jayaM labdhvA saindhavaM vinihatya cha |
ayodhaya.nstato droNaM jayonmattAstatastataH
shlokas.48:
arjuno.api raNe yodhA.nstAvakAnrathasattamAn |
ayodhayanmahArAja hatvA saindhavakaM nRRipam
shlokas.49:
sa devashatrUniva devarAjaH; kirITamAlI vyadhamatsamantAt |
yathA tamA.nsyabhyuditastamoghnaH; pUrvAM pratij~nAM samavApya vIraH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tasminvinihate vIre saindhave savyasAchinA |
mAmakA yadakurvanta tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
saindhavaM nihataM dRRiShTvA raNe pArthena mAriSha |
amarShavashamApannaH kRRipaH shAradvatastadA
shlokas.3:
mahatA sharavarSheNa pANDavaM samavAkirat |
drauNishchAbhyadravatpArthaM rathamAsthAya phalgunam
shlokas.4:
tAvenaM rathinAM shreShThau rathAbhyAM rathasattamam |
ubhAvubhayatastIkShNairvishikhairabhyavarShatAm
shlokas.5:
sa tathA sharavarShAbhyAM sumahadbhyAM mahAbhujaH |
pIDyamAnaH parAmArtimagamadrathinAM varaH
shlokas.6:
so.ajighA.nsurguruM sa~Nkhye gurostanayameva cha |
chakArAchAryakaM tatra kuntIputro dhana~njayaH
shlokas.7:
astrairastrANi sa.nvArya drauNeH shAradvatasya cha |
mandavegAniShU.nstAbhyAmajighA.nsuravAsRRijat
shlokas.8:
te nAtibhRRishamabhyaghnanvishikhA jayachoditAH |
bahutvAttu parAmArtiM sharANAM tAvagachChatAm
shlokas.9:
atha shAradvato rAjankaunteyasharapIDitaH |
avAsIdadrathopasthe mUrchChAmabhijagAma ha
shlokas.10:
vihvalaM tamabhij~nAya bhartAraM sharapIDitam |
hato.ayamiti cha j~nAtvA sArathistamapAvahat
shlokas.11:
tasminsanne mahArAja kRRipe shAradvate yudhi |
ashvatthAmApyapAyAsItpANDaveyAdrathAntaram
shlokas.12:
dRRiShTvA shAradvataM pArtho mUrChitaM sharapIDitam |
ratha eva maheShvAsaH kRRipaNaM paryadevayat
shlokas.13:
pashyannidaM mahAprAj~naH kShattA rAjAnamuktavAn |
kulAntakaraNe pApe jAtamAtre suyodhane
shlokas.14:
nIyatAM paralokAya sAdhvayaM kulapA.nsanaH |
asmAddhi kurumukhyAnAM mahadutpatsyate bhayam
shlokas.15:
tadidaM samanuprAptaM vachanaM satyavAdinaH |
tatkRRite hyadya pashyAmi sharatalpagataM kRRipam
shlokas.16:
dhigastu kShAtramAchAraM dhigastu balapauruSham |
ko hi brAhmaNamAchAryamabhidruhyeta mAdRRishaH
shlokas.17:
RRiShiputro mamAchAryo droNasya dayitaH sakhA |
eSha shete rathopasthe madbANairabhipIDitaH
shlokas.18:
akAmayAnena mayA vishikhairardito bhRRisham |
avAsIdadrathopasthe prANAnpIDayatIva me
shlokas.19:
sharArditena hi mayA prekShaNIyo mahAdyutiH |
pratyasto bahubhirbANairdashadharmagatena vai
shlokas.20:
shochayatyeSha nipatanbhUyaH putravadhAddhi mAm |
kRRipaNaM svarathe sannaM pashya kRRiShNa yathA gatam
shlokas.21:
upAkRRitya tu vai vidyAmAchAryebhyo nararShabhAH |
prayachChantIha ye kAmAndevatvamupayAnti te
shlokas.22:
ye tu vidyAmupAdAya gurubhyaH puruShAdhamAH |
ghnanti tAneva durvRRittAste vai nirayagAminaH
shlokas.23:
tadidaM narakAyAdya kRRitaM karma mayA dhruvam |
AchAryaM sharavarSheNa rathe sAdayatA kRRipam
shlokas.24:
yattatpUrvamupAkurvannastraM mAmabravItkRRipaH |
na katha~nchana kauravya prahartavyaM gurAviti
shlokas.25:
tadidaM vachanaM sAdhorAchAryasya mahAtmanaH |
nAnuShThitaM tamevAjau vishikhairabhivarShatA
shlokas.26:
namastasmai supUjyAya gautamAyApalAyine |
dhigastu mama vArShNeya yo hyasmai praharAmyaham
shlokas.27:
tathA vilapamAne tu savyasAchini taM prati |
saindhavaM nihataM dRRiShTvA rAdheyaH samupAdravat
shlokas.28:
upAyAntaM tu rAdheyaM dRRiShTvA pArtho mahArathaH |
prahasandevakIputramidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.29:
eSha prayAtyAdhirathiH sAtyakeH syandanaM prati |
na mRRiShyati hataM nUnaM bhUrishravasamAhave
shlokas.30:
yatra yAtyeSha tatra tvaM chodayAshvA~njanArdana |
mA somadatteH padavIM gamayetsAtyakiM vRRiShaH
shlokas.31:
evamukto mahAbAhuH keshavaH savyasAchinA |
pratyuvAcha mahAtejAH kAlayuktamidaM vachaH
shlokas.32:
alameSha mahAbAhuH karNAyaiko hi pANDava |
kiM punardraupadeyAbhyAM sahitaH sAtvatarShabhaH
shlokas.33:
na cha tAvatkShamaH pArtha karNena tava sa~NgaraH |
prajvalantI maholkeva tiShThatyasya hi vAsavI
tvadarthaM pUjyamAnaiShA rakShyate paravIrahan
shlokas.34:
ataH karNaH prayAtvatra sAtvatasya yathA tathA |
ahaM j~nAsyAmi kauravya kAlamasya durAtmanaH
shlokas.35:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yo.asau karNena vIreNa vArShNeyasya samAgamaH |
hate tu bhUrishravasi saindhave cha nipAtite
shlokas.36:
sAtyakishchApi virathaH kaM samArUDhavAnratham |
chakrarakShau cha pA~nchAlyau tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.37:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
hanta te varNayiShyAmi yathAvRRittaM mahAraNe |
shushrUShasva sthiro bhUtvA durAcharitamAtmanaH
shlokas.38:
pUrvameva hi kRRiShNasya manogatamidaM prabho |
vijetavyo yathA vIraH sAtyakiryUpaketunA
shlokas.39:
atItAnAgataM rAjansa hi vetti janArdanaH |
ataH sUtaM samAhUya dArukaM sa.ndidesha ha
ratho me yujyatAM kAlyamiti rAjanmahAbalaH
shlokas.40:
na hi devA na gandharvA na yakShoragarAkShasAH |
mAnavA vA vijetAraH kRRiShNayoH santi kechana
shlokas.41:
pitAmahapurogAshcha devAH siddhAshcha taM viduH |
tayoH prabhAvamatulaM shRRiNu yuddhaM cha tadyathA
shlokas.42:
sAtyakiM virathaM dRRiShTvA karNaM chAbhyudyatAyudham |
dadhmau sha~NkhaM mahAvegamArShabheNAtha mAdhavaH
shlokas.43:
dAruko.avetya sa.ndeshaM shrutvA sha~Nkhasya cha svanam |
rathamanvAnayattasmai suparNochChritaketanam
shlokas.44:
sa keshavasyAnumate rathaM dArukasa.nyutam |
Aruroha shineH pautro jvalanAdityasaMnibham
shlokas.45:
kAmagaiH sainyasugrIvameghapuShpabalAhakaiH |
hayodagrairmahAvegairhemabhANDavibhUShitaiH
shlokas.46:
yuktaM samAruhya cha taM vimAnapratimaM ratham |
abhyadravata rAdheyaM pravapansAyakAnbahUn
shlokas.47:
chakrarakShAvapi tadA yudhAmanyUttamaujasau |
dhana~njayarathaM hitvA rAdheyaM pratyudIyayuH
shlokas.48:
rAdheyo.api mahArAja sharavarShaM samutsRRijan |
abhyadravatsusa~Nkruddho raNe shaineyamachyutam
shlokas.49:
naiva daivaM na gAndharvaM nAsuroragarAkShasam |
tAdRRishaM bhuvi vA yuddhaM divi vA shrutamityuta
shlokas.50:
upAramata tatsainyaM sarathAshvanaradvipam |
tayordRRiShTvA mahArAja karma saMmUDhachetanam
shlokas.51:
sarve cha samapashyanta tadyuddhamatimAnuSham |
tayornRRivarayo rAjansArathyaM dArukasya cha
shlokas.52:
gatapratyAgatAvRRittairmaNDalaiH saMnivartanaiH |
sArathestu rathasthasya kAshyapeyasya vismitAH
shlokas.53:
nabhastalagatAshchaiva devagandharvadAnavAH |
atIvAvahitA draShTuM karNashaineyayo raNam
shlokas.54:
mitrArthe tau parAkrAntau spardhinau shuShmiNau raNe |
karNashchAmarasa~NkAsho yuyudhAnashcha sAtyakiH
shlokas.55:
anyonyaM tau mahArAja sharavarShairavarShatAm |
pramamAtha shineH pautraM karNaH sAyakavRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.56:
amRRiShyamANo nidhanaM kauravyajalasandhayoH |
karNaH shokasamAviShTo mahoraga iva shvasan
shlokas.57:
sa shaineyaM raNe kruddhaH pradahanniva chakShuShA |
abhyadravata vegena punaH punarari.ndamaH
shlokas.58:
taM tu samprekShya sa~NkruddhaM sAtyakiH pratyavidhyata |
mahatA sharavarSheNa gajaH pratigajaM yathA
shlokas.59:
tau sametya naravyAghrau vyAghrAviva tarasvinau |
anyonyaM santatakShAte raNe.anupamavikramau
shlokas.60:
tataH karNaM shineH pautraH sarvapArashavaiH sharaiH |
bibheda sarvagAtreShu punaH punarari.ndamaH
shlokas.61:
sArathiM chAsya bhallena rathanIDAdapAharat |
ashvA.nshcha chaturaH shvetAnnijaghne nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.62:
ChittvA dhvajaM shatenaiva shatadhA puruSharShabhaH |
chakAra virathaM karNaM tava putrasya pashyataH
shlokas.63:
tato vimanaso rAja.nstAvakAH puruSharShabhAH |
vRRiShasenaH karNasutaH shalyo madrAdhipastathA
shlokas.64:
droNaputrashcha shaineyaM sarvataH paryavArayan |
tataH paryAkulaM sarvaM na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.65:
tathA sAtyakinA vIre virathe sUtaje kRRite |
hAhAkArastato rAjansarvasainyeShu chAbhavat
shlokas.66:
karNo.api vihvalo rAjansAtvatenArditaH sharaiH |
duryodhanarathaM rAjannAruroha viniHshvasan
shlokas.67:
mAnaya.nstava putrasya bAlyAtprabhRRiti sauhRRidam |
kRRitAM rAjyapradAnena pratij~nAM paripAlayan
shlokas.68:
tathA tu virathe karNe putrAnvai tava pArthiva |
duHshAsanamukhA~nshUrAnnAvadhItsAtyakirvashI
shlokas.69:
rakShanpratij~nAM cha punarbhImasenakRRitAM purA |
virathAnvihvalA.nshchakre na tu prANairvyayojayat
shlokas.70:
bhImasenena tu vadhaH putrANAM te pratishrutaH |
punardyUte cha pArthena vadhaH karNasya sha.nshrutaH
shlokas.71:
vadhe tvakurvanyatnaM te tasya karNamukhAstadA |
nAshaknuva.nshcha taM hantuM sAtyakiM pravarA rathAH
shlokas.72:
drauNishcha kRRitavarmA cha tathaivAnye mahArathAH |
nirjitA dhanuShaikena shatashaH kShatriyarShabhAH
kA~NkShatA paralokaM cha dharmarAjasya cha priyam
shlokas.73:
kRRiShNayoH sadRRisho vIrye sAtyakiH shatrukarshanaH |
kRRiShNo vApi bhavelloke pArtho vApi dhanurdharaH
shaineyo vA naravyAghrashchaturtho nopalabhyate
shlokas.74:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
ajayyaM rathamAsthAya vAsudevasya sAtyakiH |
virathaM kRRitavAnkarNaM vAsudevasamo yuvA
shlokas.75:
dArukeNa samAyuktaM svabAhubaladarpitaH |
kachchidanyaM samArUDhaH sa rathaM sAtyakiH punaH
shlokas.76:
etadichChAmyahaM shrotuM kushalo hyasi bhAShitum |
asahyaM tamahaM manye tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.77:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shRRiNu rAjanyathA tasya rathamanyaM mahAmatiH |
dArukasyAnujastUrNaM kalpanAvidhikalpitam
shlokas.78:
AyasaiH kA~nchanaishchApi paTTairnaddhaM sakUbaram |
tArAsahasrakhachitaM siMhadhvajapatAkinam
shlokas.82:
taM samAruhya shaineyastava sainyamupAdravat |
dAruko.api yathAkAmaM prayayau keshavAntikam
shlokas.84:
hemakakShyAdhvajopetaM kL^iptayantrapatAkinam |
agryaM rathaM suyantAraM bahushastraparichChadam
shlokas.85:
upAjahrustamAsthAya karNo.apyabhyadravadripUn |
etatte sarvamAkhyAtaM yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi
shlokas.86:
bhUyashchApi nibodha tvaM tavApanayajaM kShayam |
ekatri.nshattava sutA bhImasenena pAtitAH
shlokas.87:
durmukhaM pramukhe kRRitvA satataM chitrayodhinam |
shatasho nihatAH shUrAH sAtvatenArjunena cha
shlokas.88:
bhIShmaM pramukhataH kRRitvA bhagadattaM cha mAriSha |
evameSha kShayo vRRitto rAjandurmantrite tava

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tathA gateShu shUreShu teShAM mama cha sa~njaya |
kiM vai bhImastadAkArShIttanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
viratho bhImaseno vai karNavAkShalyapIDitaH |
amarShavashamApannaH phalgunaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.3:
punaH punastUbaraka mUDha audariketi cha |
akRRitAstraka mA yodhIrbAla sa~NgrAmakAtara
shlokas.4:
iti mAmabravItkarNaH pashyataste dhana~njaya |
evaM vaktA cha me vadhyastena chokto.asmi bhArata
shlokas.5:
etadvrataM mahAbAho tvayA saha kRRitaM mayA |
yathaitanmama kaunteya tathA tava na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.6:
tadvadhAya narashreShTha smaraitadvachanaM mama |
yathA bhavati tatsatyaM tathA kuru dhana~njaya
shlokas.7:
tachChrutvA vachanaM tasya bhImasyAmitavikramaH |
tato.arjuno.abravItkarNaM ki~nchidabhyetya sa.nyuge
shlokas.8:
karNa karNa vRRithAdRRiShTe sUtaputrAtmasa.nstuta |
adharmabuddhe shRRiNu me yattvA vakShyAmi sAmpratam
shlokas.9:
dvividhaM karma shUrANAM yuddhe jayaparAjayau |
tau chApyanityau rAdheya vAsavasyApi yudhyataH
shlokas.10:
mumUrShuryuyudhAnena viratho.asi visarjitaH |
yadRRichChayA bhImasenaM virathaM kRRitavAnasi
shlokas.11:
adharmastveSha rAdheya yattvaM bhImamavochathAH |
yuddhadharmaM vijAnanvai yudhyantamapalAyinam
pUrayantaM yathAshakti shUrakarmAhave tathA
shlokas.12:
pashyatAM sarvasainyAnAM keshavasya mamaiva cha |
viratho bhImasenena kRRito.asi bahusho raNe
na cha tvAM paruShaM ki~nchiduktavAnpaNDunandanaH
shlokas.13:
yasmAttu bahu rUkShaM cha shrAvitaste vRRikodaraH |
parokShaM yachcha saubhadro yuShmAbhirnihato mama
shlokas.14:
tasmAdasyAvalepasya sadyaH phalamavApnuhi |
tvayA tasya dhanushChinnamAtmanAshAya durmate
shlokas.15:
tasmAdvadhyo.asi me mUDha sabhRRityabalavAhanaH |
kuru tvaM sarvakRRityAni mahatte bhayamAgatam
shlokas.16:
hantAsmi vRRiShasenaM te prekShamANasya sa.nyuge |
ye chAnye.apyupayAsyanti buddhimohena mAM nRRipAH
tA.nshcha sarvAnhaniShyAmi satyenAyudhamAlabhe
shlokas.17:
tvAM cha mUDhAkRRitapraj~namatimAninamAhave |
dRRiShTvA duryodhano mando bhRRishaM tapsyati pAtitam
shlokas.18:
arjunena pratij~nAte vadhe karNasutasya tu |
mahAnsutumulaH shabdo babhUva rathinAM tadA
shlokas.19:
tasminnAkulasa~NgrAme vartamAne mahAbhaye |
mandarashmiH sahasrA.nshurastaM girimupAgamat
shlokas.20:
tato rAjanhRRiShIkeshaH sa~NgrAmashirasi sthitam |
tIrNapratij~naM bIbhatsuM pariShvajyedamabravIt
shlokas.21:
diShTyA sampAditA jiShNo pratij~nA mahatI tvayA |
diShTyA cha nihataH pApo vRRiddhakShatraH sahAtmajaH
shlokas.22:
dhArtarAShTrabalaM prApya devasenApi bhArata |
sIdeta samare jiShNo nAtra kAryA vichAraNA
shlokas.23:
na taM pashyAmi lokeShu chintayanpuruShaM kvachit |
tvadRRite puruShavyAghra ya etadyodhayedbalam
shlokas.24:
mahAprabhAvA bahavastvayA tulyAdhikApi vA |
sametAH pRRithivIpAlA dhArtarAShTrasya kAraNAt
te tvAM prApya raNe kruddhaM nAbhyavartanta da.nshitAH
shlokas.25:
tava vIryaM balaM chaiva rudrashakrAntakopamam |
nedRRishaM shaknuyAtkashchidraNe kartuM parAkramam
yAdRRishaM kRRitavAnadya tvamekaH shatrutApanaH
shlokas.26:
evameva hate karNe sAnubandhe durAtmani |
vardhayiShyAmi bhUyastvAM vijitAriM hatadviSham
shlokas.27:
tamarjunaH pratyuvAcha prasAdAttava mAdhava |
pratij~neyaM mayottIrNA vibudhairapi dustarA
shlokas.28:
anAshcharyo jayasteShAM yeShAM nAtho.asi mAdhava |
tvatprasAdAnmahIM kRRitsnAM samprApsyati yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.29:
tavaiva bhAro vArShNeya tavaiva vijayaH prabho |
vardhanIyAstava vayaM preShyAshcha madhusUdana
shlokas.30:
evamuktaH smayankRRiShNaH shanakairvAhayanhayAn |
darshayAmAsa pArthAya krUramAyodhanaM mahat
shlokas.31:
shrIkRRiShNa uvAcha||
prArthayanto jayaM yuddhe prathitaM cha mahadyashaH |
pRRithivyAM sherate shUrAH pArthivAstvachCharairhatAH
shlokas.32:
vikIrNashastrAbharaNA vipannAshvarathadvipAH |
sa~nChinnabhinnavarmANo vaiklavyaM paramaM gatAH
shlokas.33:
sasattvA gatasattvAshcha prabhayA parayA yutAH |
sajIvA iva lakShyante gatasattvA narAdhipAH
shlokas.34:
teShAM sharaiH svarNapu~NkhaiH shastraishcha vividhaiH shitaiH |
vAhanairAyudhaishchaiva sampUrNAM pashya medinIm
shlokas.35:
varmabhishcharmabhirhAraiH shirobhishcha sakuNDalaiH |
uShNIShairmukuTaiH sragbhishchUDAmaNibhirambaraiH
shlokas.36:
kaNThasUtraira~Ngadaishcha niShkairapi cha suprabhaiH |
anyaishchAbharaNaishchitrairbhAti bhArata medinI
shlokas.37:
chAmarairvyajanaishchitrairdhvajaishchAshvarathadvipaiH |
vividhaishcha paristomairashvAnAM cha prakIrNakaiH
shlokas.38:
kuthAbhishcha vichitrAbhirvarUthaishcha mahAdhanaiH |
sa.nstIrNAM vasudhAM pashya chitrapaTTairivAvRRitAm
shlokas.39:
nAgebhyaH patitAnanyAnkalpitebhyo dvipaiH saha |
siMhAnvajrapraNunnebhyo giryagrebhya iva chyutAn
shlokas.40:
sa.nsyUtAnvAjibhiH sArdhaM dharaNyAM pashya chAparAn |
padAtisAdisa~NghA.nshcha kShatajaughapariplutAn
shlokas.41:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evaM sa.ndarshayankRRiShNo raNabhUmiM kirITinaH |
svaiH sametaH sa muditaH pA~nchajanyaM vyanAdayat

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA rathAdAplutya bhArata |
paryaShvajattadA kRRiShNAvAnandAshrupariplutaH
shlokas.2:
pramRRijya vadanaM shubhraM puNDarIkasamaprabham |
abravIdvAsudevaM cha pANDavaM cha dhana~njayam
shlokas.3:
diShTyA pashyAmi sa~NgrAme tIrNabhArau mahArathau |
diShTyA cha nihataH pApaH saindhavaH puruShAdhamaH
shlokas.4:
kRRiShNa diShTyA mama prItirmahatI pratipAditA |
diShTyA shatrugaNAshchaiva nimagnAH shokasAgare
shlokas.5:
na teShAM duShkaraM ki~nchittriShu lokeShu vidyate |
sarvalokagururyeShAM tvaM nAtho madhusUdana
shlokas.6:
tava prasAdAdgovinda vayaM jeShyAmahe ripUn |
yathA pUrvaM prasAdAtte dAnavAnpAkashAsanaH
shlokas.7:
pRRithivIvijayo vApi trailokyavijayo.api vA |
dhruvo hi teShAM vArShNeya yeShAM tuShTo.asi mAdhava
shlokas.8:
na teShAM vidyate pApaM sa~NgrAme vA parAjayaH |
tridasheshvaranAthastvaM yeShAM tuShTo.asi mAdhava
shlokas.9:
tvatprasAdAddhRRiShIkesha shakraH suragaNeshvaraH |
trailokyavijayaM shrImAnprAptavAnraNamUrdhani
shlokas.10:
tava chaiva prasAdena tridashAstridasheshvara |
amaratvaM gatAH kRRiShNa lokA.nshchAshnuvate.akShayAn
shlokas.11:
tvatprasAdasamutthena vikrameNArisUdana |
sureshatvaM gataH shakro hatvA daityAnsahasrashaH
shlokas.12:
tvatprasAdAddhRRiShIkesha jagatsthAvaraja~Ngamam |
svavartmani sthitaM vIra japahomeShu vartate
shlokas.13:
ekArNavamidaM pUrvaM sarvamAsIttamomayam |
tvatprasAdAtprakAshatvaM jagatprAptaM narottama
shlokas.14:
sraShTAraM sarvalokAnAM paramAtmAnamachyutam |
ye prapannA hRRiShIkeshaM na te muhyanti karhichit
shlokas.15:
anAdinidhanaM devaM lokakartAramavyayam |
tvAM bhaktA ye hRRiShIkesha durgANyatitaranti te
shlokas.16:
paraM purANaM puruShaM purANAnAM paraM cha yat |
prapadyatastaM paramaM parA bhUtirvidhIyate
shlokas.17:
yo.agAta chaturo vedAnyashcha vedeShu gIyate |
taM prapadya mahAtmAnaM bhUtimApnotyanuttamAm
shlokas.18:
dhana~njayasakhA yashcha dhana~njayahitashcha yaH |
taM dhana~njayagoptAraM prapadya sukhamedhate
shlokas.19:
ityuktau tau mahAtmAnAvubhau keshavapANDavau |
tAvabrUtAM tadA hRRiShTau rAjAnaM pRRithivIpatim
shlokas.20:
tava kopAgninA dagdhaH pApo rAjA jayadrathaH |
udIrNaM chApi sumahaddhArtarAShTrabalaM raNe
shlokas.21:
hanyate nihataM chaiva vina~NkShyati cha bhArata |
tava krodhahatA hyete kauravAH shatrusUdana
shlokas.22:
tvAM hi chakShurhaNaM vIraM kopayitvA suyodhanaH |
samitrabandhuH samare prANA.nstyakShyati durmatiH
shlokas.23:
tava krodhahataH pUrvaM devairapi sudurjayaH |
sharatalpagataH shete bhIShmaH kurupitAmahaH
shlokas.24:
durlabho hi jayasteShAM sa~NgrAme ripusUdana |
yAtA mRRityuvashaM te vai yeShAM kruddho.asi pANDava
shlokas.25:
rAjyaM prANAH priyAH putrAH saukhyAni vividhAni cha |
achirAttasya nashyanti yeShAM kruddho.asi mAnada
shlokas.26:
vinaShTAnkauravAnmanye saputrapashubAndhavAn |
rAjadharmapare nityaM tvayi kruddhe yudhiShThira
shlokas.27:
tato bhImo mahAbAhuH sAtyakishcha mahArathaH |
abhivAdya guruM jyeShThaM mArgaNaiH kShatavikShatau
sthitAvAstAM maheShvAsau pA~nchAlyaiH parivAritau
shlokas.28:
tau dRRiShTva muditau vIrau prA~njalI chAgrataH sthitau |
abhyanandata kaunteyastAvubhau bhImasAtyakI
shlokas.29:
diShTyA pashyAmi vAM vIrau vimuktau sainyasAgarAt |
droNagrAhAddurAdharShAddhArdikyamakarAlayAt
diShTyA cha nirjitAH sa~Nkhye pRRithivyAM sarvapArthivAH
shlokas.30:
yuvAM vijayinau chApi diShTyA pashyAmi sa.nyuge |
diShTyA droNo jitaH sa~Nkhye hArdikyashcha mahAbalaH
shlokas.31:
sainyArNavaM samuttIrNau diShTyA pashyAmi chAnaghau |
samarashlAghinau vIrau samareShvapalAyinau
mama prANasamau chaiva diShTyA pashyAmi vAmaham
shlokas.32:
ityuktvA pANDavo rAjA yuyudhAnavRRikodarau |
sasvaje puruShavyAghrau harShAdbAShpaM mumocha ha
shlokas.33:
tataH pramuditaM sarvaM balamAsIdvishAM pate |
pANDavAnAM jayaM dRRiShTvA yuddhAya cha mano dadhe

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
saindhave nihate rAjanputrastava suyodhanaH |
ashruklinnamukho dIno nirutsAho dviShajjaye
amanyatArjunasamo yodho bhuvi na vidyate
shlokas.2:
na droNo na cha rAdheyo nAshvatthAmA kRRipo na cha |
kruddhasya pramukhe sthAtuM paryAptA iti mAriSha
shlokas.3:
nirjitya hi raNe pArthaH sarvAnmama mahArathAn |
avadhItsaindhavaM sa~Nkhye nainaM kashchidavArayat
shlokas.4:
sarvathA hatamevaitatkauravANAM mahadbalam |
na hyasya vidyate trAtA sAkShAdapi pura.ndaraH
shlokas.5:
yamupAshritya sa~NgrAme kRRitaH shastrasamudyamaH |
sa karNo nirjitaH sa~Nkhye hatashchaiva jayadrathaH
shlokas.6:
paruShANi sabhAmadhye proktavAnyaH sma pANDavAn |
sa karNo nirjitaH sa~Nkhye saindhavashcha nipAtitaH
shlokas.7:
yasya vIryaM samAshritya shamaM yAchantamachyutam |
tRRiNavattamahaM manye sa karNo nirjito yudhi
shlokas.8:
evaM klAntamanA rAjannupAyAddroNamIkShitum |
AgaskRRitsarvalokasya putraste bharatarShabha
shlokas.9:
tatastatsarvamAchakhyau kurUNAM vaishasaM mahat |
parAnvijayatashchApi dhArtarAShTrAnnimajjataH
shlokas.10:
duryodhana uvAcha||
pashya mUrdhAvasiktAnAmAchArya kadanaM kRRitam |
kRRitvA pramukhataH shUraM bhIShmaM mama pitAmaham
shlokas.11:
taM nihatya pralubdho.ayaM shikhaNDI pUrNamAnasaH |
pA~nchAlaiH sahitaH sarvaiH senAgramabhikarShati
shlokas.12:
aparashchApi durdharShaH shiShyaste savyasAchinA |
akShauhiNIH sapta hatvA hato rAjA jayadrathaH
shlokas.13:
asmadvijayakAmAnAM suhRRidAmupakAriNAm |
gantAsmi kathamAnRRiNyaM gatAnAM yamasAdanam
shlokas.14:
ye madarthaM parIpsanti vasudhAM vasudhAdhipAH |
te hitvA vasudhaishvaryaM vasudhAmadhisherate
shlokas.15:
so.ahaM kApuruShaH kRRitvA mitrANAM kShayamIdRRisham |
nAshvamedhasahasreNa pAtumAtmAnamutsahe
shlokas.16:
mama lubdhasya pApasya tathA dharmApachAyinaH |
vyAyachChanto jigIShantaH prAptA vaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.17:
kathaM patitavRRittasya pRRithivI suhRRidAM druhaH |
vivaraM nAshakaddAtuM mama pArthivasa.nsadi
shlokas.18:
so.ahaM rudhirasiktA~NgaM rAj~nAM madhye pitAmaham |
shayAnaM nAshakaM trAtuM bhIShmamAyodhane hatam
shlokas.19:
taM mAmanAryapuruShaM mitradruhamadhArmikam |
kiM sa vakShyati durdharShaH sametya paralokajit
shlokas.20:
jalasandhaM maheShvAsaM pashya sAtyakinA hatam |
madarthamudyataM shUraM prANA.nstyaktvA mahAratham
shlokas.21:
kAmbojaM nihataM dRRiShTvA tathAlambusameva cha |
anyAnbahU.nshcha suhRRido jIvitArtho.adya ko mama
shlokas.22:
vyAyachChanto hatAH shUrA madarthe ye.aparA~NmukhAH |
yatamAnAH paraM shaktyA vijetumahitAnmama
shlokas.23:
teShAM gatvAhamAnRRiNyamadya shaktyA parantapa |
tarpayiShyAmi tAneva jalena yamunAmanu
shlokas.24:
satyaM te pratijAnAmi sarvashastrabhRRitAM vara |
iShTApUrtena cha shape vIryeNa cha sutairapi
shlokas.25:
nihatya tAnraNe sarvAnpA~nchAlAnpANDavaiH saha |
shAntiM labdhAsmi teShAM vA raNe gantA salokatAm
shlokas.26:
na hIdAnIM sahAyA me parIpsantyanupaskRRitAH |
shreyo hi pANDUnmanyante na tathAsmAnmahAbhuja
shlokas.27:
svayaM hi mRRityurvihitaH satyasandhena sa.nyuge |
bhavAnupekShAM kurute sushiShyatvAddhana~njaye
shlokas.28:
ato vinihatAH sarve ye.asmajjayachikIrShavaH |
karNameva tu pashyAmi sampratyasmajjayaiShiNam
shlokas.29:
yo hi mitramavij~nAya yAthAtathyena mandadhIH |
mitrArthe yojayatyenaM tasya so.artho.avasIdati
shlokas.30:
tAdRRigrUpamidaM kAryaM kRRitaM mama suhRRidbruvaiH |
mohAllubdhasya pApasya jihmAchAraistatastataH
shlokas.31:
hato jayadrathashchaiva saumadattishcha vIryavAn |
abhIShAhAH shUrasenAH shibayo.atha vasAtayaH
shlokas.32:
so.ahamadya gamiShyAmi yatra te puruSharShabhAH |
hatA madarthaM sa~NgrAme yudhyamAnAH kirITinA
shlokas.33:
na hi me jIvitenArthastAnRRite puruSharShabhAn |
AchAryaH pANDuputrANAmanujAnAtu no bhavAn

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sindhurAje hate tAta samare savyasAchinA |
tathaiva bhUrishravasi kimAsIdvo manastadA
shlokas.2:
duryodhanena cha droNastathoktaH kurusa.nsadi |
kimuktavAnparaM tasmAttanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
niShTAnako mahAnAsItsainyAnAM tava bhArata |
saindhavaM nihataM dRRiShTvA bhUrishravasameva cha
shlokas.4:
mantritaM tava putrasya te sarvamavamenire |
yena mantreNa nihatAH shatashaH kShatriyarShabhAH
shlokas.5:
droNastu tadvachaH shrutvA putrasya tava durmanAH |
muhUrtamiva tu dhyAtvA bhRRishamArto.abhyabhAShata
shlokas.6:
duryodhana kimevaM mAM vAkSharairabhikRRintasi |
ajayyaM samare nityaM bruvANaM savyasAchinam
shlokas.7:
etenaivArjunaM j~nAtumalaM kaurava sa.nyuge |
yachChikhaNDyavadhIdbhIShmaM pAlyamAnaH kirITinA
shlokas.8:
avadhyaM nihataM dRRiShTvA sa.nyuge devamAnuShaiH |
tadaivAj~nAsiShamahaM neyamastIti bhAratI
shlokas.9:
yaM pu.nsAM triShu lokeShu sarvashUramama.nsmahi |
tasminvinihate shUre kiM sheShaM paryupAsmahe
shlokas.10:
yAnsma tAnglahate tAtaH shakuniH kurusa.nsadi |
akShAnna te.akShA nishitA bANAste shatrutApanAH
shlokas.11:
ta ete ghnanti nastAta vishikhA jayachoditAH |
yA.nstadA khyApyamAnA.nstvaM vidureNa na budhyase
shlokas.12:
tAstA vilapatashchApi vidurasya mahAtmanaH |
dhIrasya vAcho nAshrauShIH kShemAya vadataH shivAH
shlokas.13:
tadidaM vartate ghoramAgataM vaishasaM mahat |
tasyAvamAnAdvAkyasya duryodhana kRRite tava
shlokas.14:
yachcha naH prekShamANAnAM kRRiShNAmAnAyayaH sabhAm |
anarhatIM kule jAtAM sarvadharmAnuchAriNIm
shlokas.15:
tasyAdharmasya gAndhAre phalaM prAptamidaM tvayA |
no chetpApaM pare loke tvamarchChethAstato.adhikam
shlokas.16:
yachcha tAnpANDavAndyUte viShameNa vijitya ha |
prAvrAjayastadAraNye rauravAjinavAsasaH
shlokas.17:
putrANAmiva chaiteShAM dharmamAcharatAM sadA |
druhyetko nu naro loke madanyo brAhmaNabruvaH
shlokas.18:
pANDavAnAmayaM kopastvayA shakuninA saha |
AhRRito dhRRitarAShTrasya saMmate kurusa.nsadi
shlokas.19:
duHshAsanena sa.nyuktaH karNena parivardhitaH |
kShatturvAkyamanAdRRitya tvayAbhyastaH punaH punaH
shlokas.20:
yattatsarve parAbhUya paryavArayatArjunim |
sindhurAjAnamAshritya sa vo madhye kathaM hataH
shlokas.21:
kathaM tvayi cha karNe cha kRRipe shalye cha jIvati |
ashvatthAmni cha kauravya nidhanaM saindhavo.agamat
shlokas.22:
yadvastatsarvarAjAnastejastigmamupAsate |
sindhurAjaM paritrAtuM sa vo madhye kathaM hataH
shlokas.23:
mayyeva hi visheSheNa tathA duryodhana tvayi |
Asha.nsata paritrANamarjunAtsa mahIpatiH
shlokas.24:
tatastasminparitrANamalabdhavati phalgunAt |
na ki~nchidanupashyAmi jIvitatrANamAtmanaH
shlokas.25:
majjantamiva chAtmAnaM dhRRiShTadyumnasya kilbiShe |
pashyAmyahatvA pA~nchAlAnsaha tena shikhaNDinA
shlokas.26:
tanmA kimabhitapyantaM vAkSharairabhikRRintasi |
ashaktaH sindhurAjasya bhUtvA trANAya bhArata
shlokas.27:
sauvarNaM satyasandhasya dhvajamakliShTakarmaNaH |
apashyanyudhi bhIShmasya kathamAsha.nsase jayam
shlokas.28:
madhye mahArathAnAM cha yatrAhanyata saindhavaH |
hato bhUrishravAshchaiva kiM sheShaM tatra manyase
shlokas.29:
kRRipa eva cha durdharSho yadi jIvati pArthiva |
yo nAgAtsindhurAjasya vartma taM pUjayAmyaham
shlokas.30:
yachchApashyaM hataM bhIShmaM pashyataste.anujasya vai |
duHshAsanasya kauravya kurvANaM karma duShkaram
avadhyakalpaM sa~NgrAme devairapi savAsavaiH
shlokas.31:
na te vasundharAstIti tadahaM chintaye nRRipa |
imAni pANDavAnAM cha sRRi~njayAnAM cha bhArata
anIkAnyAdravante mAM sahitAnyadya mAriSha
shlokas.32:
nAhatvA sarvapA~nchAlAnkavachasya vimokShaNam |
kartAsmi samare karma dhArtarAShTra hitaM tava
shlokas.33:
rAjanbrUyAH sutaM me tvamashvatthAmAnamAhave |
na somakAH pramoktavyA jIvitaM parirakShatA
shlokas.34:
yachcha pitrAnushiShTo.asi tadvachaH paripAlaya |
AnRRisha.nsye dame satye Arjave cha sthiro bhava
shlokas.35:
dharmArthakAmakushalo dharmArthAvapyapIDayan |
dharmapradhAnaH kAryANi kuryAshcheti punaH punaH
shlokas.36:
chakShurmanobhyAM santoShyA viprAH sevyAshcha shaktitaH |
na chaiShAM vipriyaM kAryaM te hi vahnishikhopamAH
shlokas.37:
eSha tvahamanIkAni pravishAmyarisUdana |
raNAya mahate rAja.nstvayA vAkShalyapIDitaH
shlokas.38:
tvaM cha duryodhana balaM yadi shaknoShi dhAraya |
rAtrAvapi hi yotsyante sa.nrabdhAH kurusRRi~njayAH
shlokas.39:
evamuktvA tataH prAyAddroNaH pANDavasRRi~njayAn |
muShNankShatriyatejA.nsi nakShatrANAmivA.nshumAn

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato duryodhano rAjA droNenaivaM prachoditaH |
amarShavashamApanno yuddhAyaiva mano dadhe
shlokas.2:
abravIchcha tadA karNaM putro duryodhanastava |
pashya kRRiShNasahAyena pANDavena kirITinA
AchAryavihitaM vyUhaM bhinnaM devaiH sudurbhidam
shlokas.3:
tava vyAyachChamAnasya droNasya cha mahAtmanaH |
miShatAM yodhamukhyAnAM saindhavo vinipAtitaH
shlokas.4:
pashya rAdheya rAjAnaH pRRithivyAM pravarA yudhi |
pArthenaikena nihatAH siMhenevetarA mRRigAH
shlokas.5:
mama vyAyachChamAnasya samare shatrusUdana |
alpAvasheShaM sainyaM me kRRitaM shakrAtmajena ha
shlokas.6:
kathaM hyanichChamAnasya droNasya yudhi phalgunaH |
bhindyAtsudurbhidaM vyUhaM yatamAno.api sa.nyuge
shlokas.7:
priyo hi phalguno nityamAchAryasya mahAtmanaH |
tato.asya dattavAndvAraM nayuddhenArimardana
shlokas.8:
abhayaM saindhavasyAjau dattvA droNaH parantapaH |
prAdAtkirITine dvAraM pashya nirguNatAM mama
shlokas.9:
yadyadAsyamanuj~nAM vai pUrvameva gRRihAnprati |
sindhurAjasya samare nAbhaviShyajjanakShayaH
shlokas.10:
jayadratho jIvitArthI gachChamAno gRRihAnprati |
mayAnAryeNa sa.nruddho droNAtprApyAbhayaM raNe
shlokas.11:
adya me bhrAtaraH kShINAshchitrasenAdayo yudhi |
bhImasenaM samAsAdya pashyatAM no durAtmanAm
shlokas.12:
karNa uvAcha||
AchAryaM mA vigarhasva shaktyA yudhyatyasau dvijaH |
ajayyAnpANDavAnmanye droNenAstravidA mRRidhe
shlokas.13:
tathA hyenamatikramya praviShTaH shvetavAhanaH |
daivadRRiShTo.anyathAbhAvo na manye vidyate kvachit
shlokas.14:
tato no yudhyamAnAnAM paraM shaktyA suyodhana |
saindhavo nihato rAjandaivamatra paraM smRRitam
shlokas.15:
paraM yatnaM kurvatAM cha tvayA sArdhaM raNAjire |
hatvAsmAkaM pauruShaM hi daivaM pashchAtkaroti naH
satataM cheShTamAnAnAM nikRRityA vikrameNa cha
shlokas.16:
daivopasRRiShTaH puruSho yatkarma kurute kvachit |
kRRitaM kRRitaM sma tattasya daivena vinihanyate
shlokas.17:
yatkartavyaM manuShyeNa vyavasAyavatA satA |
tatkAryamavisha~Nkena siddhirdaive pratiShThitA
shlokas.18:
nikRRityA nikRRitAH pArthA viShayogaishcha bhArata |
dagdhA jatugRRihe chApi dyUtena cha parAjitAH
shlokas.19:
rAjanItiM vyapAshritya prahitAshchaiva kAnanam |
yatnena cha kRRitaM yatte daivena vinipAtitam
shlokas.20:
yudhyasva yatnamAsthAya mRRityuM kRRitvA nivartanam |
yatatastava teShAM cha daivaM mArgeNa yAsyati
shlokas.21:
na teShAM matipUrvaM hi sukRRitaM dRRishyate kvachit |
duShkRRitaM tava vA vIra buddhyA hInaM kurUdvaha
shlokas.22:
daivaM pramANaM sarvasya sukRRitasyetarasya vA |
ananyakarma daivaM hi jAgarti svapatAmapi
shlokas.23:
bahUni tava sainyAni yodhAshcha bahavastathA |
na tathA pANDuputrANAmevaM yuddhamavartata
shlokas.24:
tairalpairbahavo yUyaM kShayaM nItAH prahAriNaH |
sha~Nke daivasya tatkarma pauruShaM yena nAshitam
shlokas.25:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evaM sambhAShamANAnAM bahu tattajjanAdhipa |
pANDavAnAmanIkAni samadRRishyanta sa.nyuge
shlokas.26:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM vyatiShaktarathadvipam |
tAvakAnAM paraiH sArdhaM rAjandurmantrite tava

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tadudIrNagajAshvaughaM balaM tava janAdhipa |
pANDusenAmabhidrutya yodhayAmAsa sarvataH
shlokas.2:
pA~nchAlAH kuravashchaiva yodhayantaH parasparam |
yamarAShTrAya mahate paralokAya dIkShitAH
shlokas.3:
shUrAH shUraiH samAgamya sharatomarashaktibhiH |
vivyadhuH samare tUrNaM ninyushchaiva yamakShayam
shlokas.4:
rathinAM rathibhiH sArdhaM rudhirasrAvi dAruNam |
prAvartata mahadyuddhaM nighnatAmitaretaram
shlokas.5:
vAraNAshcha mahArAja samAsAdya parasparam |
viShANairdArayAmAsuH sa~NkruddhAshcha madotkaTAH
shlokas.6:
hayArohAnhayArohAH prAsashaktiparashvadhaiH |
bibhidustumule yuddhe prArthayanto mahadyashaH
shlokas.7:
pattayashcha mahAbAho shatashaH shastrapANayaH |
anyonyamArdayanrAjannityayattAH parAkrame
shlokas.8:
gotrANAM nAmadheyAnAM kulAnAM chaiva mAriSha |
shravaNAddhi vijAnImaH pA~nchAlAnkurubhiH saha
shlokas.9:
anyonyaM samare yodhAH sharashaktiparashvadhaiH |
preShayanparalokAya vicharanto hyabhItavat
shlokas.10:
sharairdasha disho rAja.nsteShAM muktaiH sahasrashaH |
na bhrAjanta yathApUrvaM bhAskare.astaM gate.api cha
shlokas.11:
tathA prayudhyamAneShu pANDaveyeShu nirbhayaH |
duryodhano mahArAja vyavagAhata tadbalam
shlokas.12:
saindhavasya vadhenaiva bhRRishaM duHkhasamanvitaH |
martavyamiti sa~nchintya prAvishattu dviShadbalam
shlokas.13:
nAdayanrathaghoSheNa kampayanniva medinIm |
abhyavartata putraste pANDavAnAmanIkinIm
shlokas.14:
sa saMnipAtastumulastasya teShAM cha bhArata |
abhavatsarvasainyAnAmabhAvakaraNo mahAn
shlokas.15:
madhya.ndinagataM sUryaM pratapantaM gabhastibhiH |
tathA tava sutaM madhye pratapantaM sharormibhiH
shlokas.16:
na shekurbhArataM yuddhe pANDavAH samavekShitum |
palAyane kRRitotsAhA nirutsAhA dviShajjaye
shlokas.17:
paryadhAvanta pA~nchAlA vadhyamAnA mahAtmanA |
rukmapu~NkhaiH prasannAgraistava putreNa dhanvinA
ardyamAnAH sharaistUrNaM nyapatanpANDusainikAH
shlokas.18:
na tAdRRishaM raNe karma kRRitavantastu tAvakAH |
yAdRRishaM kRRitavAnrAjA putrastava vishAM pate
shlokas.19:
putreNa tava sA senA pANDavI mathitA raNe |
nalinI dviradeneva samantAtphullapa~NkajA
shlokas.20:
kShINatoyAnilArkAbhyAM hatatviDiva padminI |
babhUva pANDavI senA tava putrasya tejasA
shlokas.21:
pANDusenAM hatAM dRRiShTvA tava putreNa bhArata |
bhImasenapurogAstu pA~nchAlAH samupAdravan
shlokas.22:
sa bhImasenaM dashabhirmAdrIputrau tribhistribhiH |
virATadrupadau ShaDbhiH shatena cha shikhaNDinam
shlokas.23:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha saptatyA dharmaputraM cha saptabhiH |
kekayA.nshchaiva chedI.nshcha bahubhirnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.24:
sAtvataM pa~nchabhirviddhvA draupadeyA.nstribhistribhiH |
ghaTotkachaM cha samare viddhvA siMha ivAnadat
shlokas.25:
shatashashchAparAnyodhAnsadvipAshvarathAnraNe |
sharairavachakartograiH kruddho.antaka iva prajAH
shlokas.26:
tasya tAnnighnataH shatrUnrukmapRRiShThaM mahaddhanuH |
bhallAbhyAM pANDavo jyeShThastridhA chichCheda mAriSha
shlokas.27:
vivyAdha chainaM dashabhiH samyagastaiH shitaiH sharaiH |
marmANi bhittvA te sarve sambhagnAH kShitimAvishan
shlokas.28:
tataH pramuditA yodhAH parivavruryudhiShThiram |
vRRitrahatyai yathA devAH parivavruH pura.ndaram
shlokas.29:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA tava putrasya mAriSha |
sharaM paramadurvAraM preShayAmAsa sa.nyuge
sa tena bhRRishasa.nviddho niShasAda rathottame
shlokas.30:
tataH pA~nchAlasainyAnAM bhRRishamAsIdravo mahAn |
hato rAjeti rAjendra muditAnAM samantataH
shlokas.31:
bANashabdaravashchograH shushruve tatra mAriSha |
atha droNo drutaM tatra pratyadRRishyata sa.nyuge
shlokas.32:
hRRiShTo duryodhanashchApi dRRiDhamAdAya kArmukam |
tiShTha tiShTheti rAjAnaM bruvanpANDavamabhyayAt
shlokas.33:
pratyudyayustaM tvaritAH pA~nchAlA rAjagRRiddhinaH |
tAndroNaH pratijagrAha parIpsankurusattamam
chaNDavAtoddhatAnmeghAnnighnanrashmimucho yathA
shlokas.34:
tato rAjanmahAnAsItsa~NgrAmo bhUrivardhanaH |
tAvakAnAM pareShAM cha sametAnAM yuyutsayA

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yattadA prAvishatpANDUnAchAryaH kupito vashI |
uktvA duryodhanaM samya~Nmama shAstrAtigaM sutam
shlokas.2:
pravishya vicharantaM cha raNe shUramavasthitam |
kathaM droNaM maheShvAsaM pANDavAH paryavArayan
shlokas.3:
ke.arakShandakShiNaM chakramAchAryasya mahAtmanaH |
ke chottaramarakShanta nighnataH shAtravAnraNe
shlokas.4:
nRRityansa rathamArgeShu sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH |
dhUmaketuriva kruddhaH kathaM mRRityumupeyivAn
shlokas.5:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sAyAhne saindhavaM hatvA rAj~nA pArthaH sametya cha |
sAtyakishcha maheShvAso droNamevAbhyadhAvatAm
shlokas.6:
tathA yudhiShThirastUrNaM bhImasenashcha pANDavaH |
pRRithakchamUbhyAM sa.nsaktau droNamevAbhyadhAvatAm
shlokas.7:
tathaiva nakulo dhImAnsahadevashcha durjayaH |
dhRRiShTadyumnaH shatAnIko virATashcha sakekayaH
matsyAH shAlveyasenAshcha droNameva yayuryudhi
shlokas.8:
drupadashcha tathA rAjA pA~nchAlairabhirakShitaH |
dhRRiShTadyumnapitA rAjandroNamevAbhyavartata
shlokas.9:
draupadeyA maheShvAsA rAkShasashcha ghaTotkachaH |
sasenAste.abhyavartanta droNameva mahAdyutim
shlokas.10:
prabhadrakAshcha pA~nchAlAH ShaTsahasrAH prahAriNaH |
droNamevAbhyavartanta puraskRRitya shikhaNDinam
shlokas.11:
tathetare naravyAghrAH pANDavAnAM mahArathAH |
sahitAH saMnyavartanta droNameva dvijarShabham
shlokas.12:
teShu shUreShu yuddhAya gateShu bharatarShabha |
babhUva rajanI ghorA bhIrUNAM bhayavardhinI
shlokas.13:
yodhAnAmashivA raudrA rAjannantakagAminI |
ku~njarAshvamanuShyANAM prANAntakaraNI tadA
shlokas.14:
tasyAM rajanyAM ghorAyAM nadantyaH sarvataH shivAH |
nyavedayanbhayaM ghoraM sajvAlakavalairmukhaiH
shlokas.15:
ulUkAshchApyadRRishyanta sha.nsanto vipulaM bhayam |
visheShataH kauravANAM dhvajinyAmatidAruNam
shlokas.16:
tataH sainyeShu rAjendra shabdaH samabhavanmahAn |
bherIshabdena mahatA mRRida~NgAnAM svanena cha
shlokas.17:
gajAnAM garjitaishchApi tura~NgANAM cha heShitaiH |
khurashabdanipAtaishcha tumulaH sarvato.abhavat
shlokas.18:
tataH samabhavadyuddhaM sandhyAyAmatidAruNam |
droNasya cha mahArAja sRRi~njayAnAM cha sarvashaH
shlokas.19:
tamasA chAvRRite loke na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana |
sainyena rajasA chaiva samantAdutthitena ha
shlokas.20:
narasyAshvasya nAgasya samasajjata shoNitam |
nApashyAma rajo bhaumaM kashmalenAbhisa.nvRRitAH
shlokas.21:
rAtrau va.nshavanasyeva dahyamAnasya parvate |
ghorashchaTachaTAshabdaH shastrANAM patatAmabhUt
shlokas.22:
naiva sve na pare rAjanprAj~nAyanta tamovRRite |
unmattamiva tatsarvaM babhUva rajanImukhe
shlokas.23:
bhaumaM rajo.atha rAjendra shoNitena prashAmitam |
shAtakaumbhaishcha kavachairbhUShaNaishcha tamo.abhyagAt
shlokas.24:
tataH sA bhAratI senA maNihemavibhUShitA |
dyaurivAsItsanakShatrA rajanyAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.25:
gomAyubaDasa~NghuShTA shaktidhvajasamAkulA |
dAruNAbhirutA ghorA kShveDitotkruShTanAditA
shlokas.26:
tato.abhavanmahAshabdastumulo lomaharShaNaH |
samAvRRiNvandishaH sarvA mahendrAshaninisvanaH
shlokas.27:
sA nishIthe mahArAja senAdRRishyata bhAratI |
a~NgadaiH kuNDalairniShkaiH shastraishchaivAvabhAsitA
shlokas.28:
tatra nAgA rathAshchaiva jAmbUnadavibhUShitAH |
nishAyAM pratyadRRishyanta meghA iva savidyutaH
shlokas.29:
RRiShTishaktigadAbANamusalaprAsapaTTishAH |
sampatanto vyadRRishyanta bhrAjamAnA ivAgnayaH
shlokas.30:
duryodhanapurovAtAM rathanAgabalAhakAm |
vAditraghoShastanitAM chApavidyuddhvajairvRRitAm
shlokas.31:
droNapANDavaparjanyAM khaDgashaktigadAshanim |
sharadhArAstrapavanAM bhRRishaM shItoShNasa~NkulAm
shlokas.32:
ghorAM vismApanImugrAM jIvitachChidamaplavAm |
tAM prAvishannatibhayAM senAM yuddhachikIrShavaH
shlokas.33:
tasminrAtrimukhe ghore mahAshabdaninAdite |
bhIrUNAM trAsajanane shUrANAM harShavardhane
shlokas.34:
rAtriyuddhe tadA ghore vartamAne sudAruNe |
droNamabhyadravankruddhAH sahitAH pANDusRRi~njayAH
shlokas.35:
ye ye pramukhato rAjannyavartanta mahAtmanaH |
tAnsarvAnvimukhA.nshchakre kA.nshchinninye yamakShayam

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tasminpraviShTe durdharShe sRRi~njayAnamitaujasi |
amRRiShyamANe sa.nrabdhe kA vo.abhUdvai matistadA
shlokas.2:
duryodhanaM tathA putramuktvA shAstrAtigaM mama |
yatprAvishadameyAtmA kiM pArthaH pratyapadyata
shlokas.3:
nihate saindhave vIre bhUrishravasi chaiva hi |
yadabhyagAnmahAtejAH pA~nchAlAnaparAjitaH
shlokas.4:
kimamanyata durdharShaH praviShTe shatrutApane |
duryodhanashcha kiM kRRityaM prAptakAlamamanyata
shlokas.5:
ke cha taM varadaM vIramanvayurdvijasattamam |
ke chAsya pRRiShThato.agachChanvIrAH shUrasya yudhyataH
ke purastAdayudhyanta nighnataH shAtravAnraNe
shlokas.6:
manye.ahaM pANDavAnsarvAnbhAradvAjasharArditAn |
shishire kampamAnA vai kRRishA gAva ivAbhibho
shlokas.7:
pravishya sa maheShvAsaH pA~nchAlAnarimardanaH |
kathaM nu puruShavyAghraH pa~nchatvamupajagmivAn
shlokas.8:
sarveShu sainyeShu cha sa~NgateShu; rAtrau sameteShu mahAratheShu |
sa.nloDyamAneShu pRRithagvidheShu; ke vastadAnIM matimanta Asan
shlokas.9:
hatA.nshchaiva viShaktA.nshcha parAbhUtA.nshcha sha.nsasi |
rathino virathA.nshchaiva kRRitAnyuddheShu mAmakAn
shlokas.10:
kathameShAM tadA tatra pArthAnAmapalAyinAm |
prakAshamabhavadrAtrau kathaM kuruShu sa~njaya
shlokas.11:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
rAtriyuddhe tadA rAjanvartamAne sudAruNe |
droNamabhyadravanrAtrau pANDavAH sahasainikAH
shlokas.12:
tato droNaH kekayA.nshcha dhRRiShTadyumnasya chAtmajAn |
preShayanmRRityulokAya sarvAniShubhirAshugaiH
shlokas.13:
tasya pramukhato rAjanye.avartanta mahArathAH |
tAnsarvAnpreShayAmAsa paralokAya bhArata
shlokas.14:
pramathnantaM tadA vIraM bhAradvAjaM mahAratham |
abhyavartata sa~NkruddhaH shibI rAjanpratApavAn
shlokas.15:
tamApatantaM samprekShya pANDavAnAM mahAratham |
vivyAdha dashabhirdroNaH sarvapArashavaiH sharaiH
shlokas.16:
taM shibiH prativivyAdha tri.nshatA nishitaiH sharaiH |
sArathiM chAsya bhallena smayamAno nyapAtayat
shlokas.17:
tasya droNo hayAnhatvA sArathiM cha mahAtmanaH |
athAsya sashirastrANaM shiraH kAyAdapAharat
shlokas.18:
kali~NgAnAM cha sainyena kali~Ngasya suto raNe |
pUrvaM pitRRivadhAtkruddho bhImasenamupAdravat
shlokas.19:
sa bhImaM pa~nchabhirviddhvA punarvivyAdha saptabhiH |
vishokaM tribhirAjaghne dhvajamekena patriNA
shlokas.20:
kali~NgAnAM tu taM shUraM kruddhaM kruddho vRRikodaraH |
rathAdrathamabhidrutya muShTinAbhijaghAna ha
shlokas.21:
tasya muShTihatasyAjau pANDavena balIyasA |
sarvANyasthIni sahasA prApatanvai pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.22:
taM karNo bhrAtarashchAsya nAmRRiShyanta mahArathAH |
te bhImasenaM nArAchairjaghnurAshIviShopamaiH
shlokas.23:
tataH shatrurathaM tyaktvA bhImo dhruvarathaM gataH |
dhruvaM chAsyantamanishaM muShTinA samapothayat
sa tathA pANDuputreNa balinA nihato.apatat
shlokas.24:
taM nihatya mahArAja bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
jayarAtarathaM prApya muhuH siMha ivAnadat
shlokas.25:
jayarAtamathAkShipya nadansavyena pANinA |
talena nAshayAmAsa karNasyaivAgrataH sthitam
shlokas.26:
karNastu pANDave shaktiM kA~nchanIM samavAsRRijat |
tatastAmeva jagrAha prahasanpANDunandanaH
shlokas.27:
karNAyaiva cha durdharShashchikShepAjau vRRikodaraH |
tAmantarikShe chichCheda shakunistailapAyinA
shlokas.28:
tatastava sutA rAjanbhImasya rathamAvrajan |
mahatA sharavarSheNa ChAdayanto vRRikodaram
shlokas.29:
durmadasya tato bhImaH prahasanniva sa.nyuge |
sArathiM cha hayA.nshchaiva sharairninye yamakShayam
durmadastu tato yAnaM duShkarNasyAvapupluve
shlokas.30:
tAvekarathamArUDhau bhrAtarau paratApanau |
sa~NgrAmashiraso madhye bhImaM dvAvabhyadhAvatAm
yathAmbupatimitrau hi tArakaM daityasattamam
shlokas.31:
tatastu durmadashchaiva duShkarNashcha tavAtmajau |
rathamekaM samAruhya bhImaM bANairavidhyatAm
shlokas.32:
tataH karNasya miShato drauNerduryodhanasya cha |
kRRipasya somadattasya bAhlIkasya cha pANDavaH
shlokas.33:
durmadasya cha vIrasya duShkarNasya cha taM ratham |
pAdaprahAreNa dharAM prAveshayadari.ndamaH
shlokas.34:
tataH sutau te balinau shUrau duShkarNadurmadau |
muShTinAhatya sa~Nkruddho mamarda charaNena cha
shlokas.35:
tato hAhAkRRite sainye dRRiShTvA bhImaM nRRipAbruvan |
rudro.ayaM bhImarUpeNa dhArtarAShTreShu gRRidhyati
shlokas.36:
evamuktvApalAyanta sarve bhArata pArthivAH |
visa~nj~nAvAhayanvAhAnna cha dvau saha dhAvataH
shlokas.37:
tato bale bhRRishalulite nishAmukhe; supUjito nRRipavRRiShabhairvRRikodaraH |
mahAbalaH kamalavibuddhalochano; yudhiShThiraM nRRipatimapUjayadbalI
shlokas.38:
tato yamau drupadavirATakekayA; yudhiShThirashchApi parAM mudaM yayuH |
vRRikodaraM bhRRishamabhipUjaya.nshcha te; yathAndhake pratinihate haraM surAH
shlokas.39:
tataH sutAstava varuNAtmajopamA; ruShAnvitAH saha guruNA mahAtmanA |
vRRikodaraM sarathapadAtiku~njarA; yuyutsavo bhRRishamabhiparyavArayan
shlokas.40:
tato.abhavattimiraghanairivAvRRitaM; mahAbhaye bhayadamatIva dAruNam |
nishAmukhe baDavRRikagRRidhramodanaM; mahAtmanAM nRRipavarayuddhamadbhutam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
prAyopaviShTe tu hate putre sAtyakinA tataH |
somadatto bhRRishaM kruddhaH sAtyakiM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.2:
kShatradharmaH purA dRRiShTo yastu devairmahAtmabhiH |
taM tvaM sAtvata santyajya dasyudharme kathaM rataH
shlokas.3:
parA~NmukhAya dInAya nyastashastrAya yAchate |
kShatradharmarataH prAj~naH kathaM nu praharedraNe
shlokas.4:
dvAveva kila vRRiShNInAM tatra khyAtau mahArathau |
pradyumnashcha mahAbAhustvaM chaiva yudhi sAtvata
shlokas.5:
kathaM prAyopaviShTAya pArthena ChinnabAhave |
nRRisha.nsaM patanIyaM cha tAdRRishaM kRRitavAnasi
shlokas.6:
shape sAtvata putrAbhyAmiShTena sukRRitena cha |
anatItAmimAM rAtriM yadi tvAM vIramAninam
shlokas.7:
arakShyamANaM pArthena jiShNunA sasutAnujam |
na hanyAM niraye ghore pateyaM vRRiShNipA.nsana
shlokas.8:
evamuktvA susa~NkruddhaH somadatto mahAbalaH |
dadhmau sha~NkhaM cha tAreNa siMhanAdaM nanAda cha
shlokas.9:
tataH kamalapatrAkShaH siMhadaMShTro mahAbalaH |
sAtvato bhRRishasa~NkruddhaH somadattamathAbravIt
shlokas.10:
hato bhUrishravA vIrastava putro mahArathaH |
shalashchaiva tathA rAjanbhrAtRRivyasanakarshitaH
shlokas.11:
tvAM chApyadya vadhiShyAmi saputrapashubAndhavam |
tiShThedAnIM raNe yattaH kauravo.asi visheShataH
shlokas.12:
yasmindAnaM damaH shauchamahi.nsA hrIrdhRRitiH kShamA |
anapAyIni sarvANi nityaM rAj~ni yudhiShThire
shlokas.13:
mRRida~Ngaketostasya tvaM tejasA nihataH purA |
sakarNasaubalaH sa~Nkhye vinAshaM samupeShyasi
shlokas.14:
shape.ahaM kRRiShNacharaNairiShTApUrtena chaiva ha |
yadi tvAM sasutaM pApaM na hanyAM yudhi roShitaH
apayAsyasi chettyaktvA tato mukto bhaviShyasi
shlokas.15:
evamAbhAShya chAnyonyaM krodhasa.nraktalochanau |
pravRRittau sharasampAtaM kartuM puruShasattamau
shlokas.16:
tato gajasahasreNa rathAnAmayutena cha |
duryodhanaH somadattaM parivArya vyavasthitaH
shlokas.17:
shakunishcha susa~NkruddhaH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH |
putrapautraiH parivRRito bhrAtRRibhishchendravikramaiH
syAlastava mahAbAhurvajrasaMhanano yuvA
shlokas.18:
sAgraM shatasahasraM tu hayAnAM tasya dhImataH |
somadattaM maheShvAsaM samantAtparyarakShata
shlokas.19:
rakShyamANashcha balibhishChAdayAmAsa sAtyakim |
taM ChAdyamAnaM vishikhairdRRiShTvA saMnataparvabhiH
dhRRiShTadyumno.abhyayAtkruddhaH pragRRihya mahatIM chamUm
shlokas.20:
chaNDavAtAbhisRRiShTAnAmudadhInAmiva svanaH |
AsIdrAjanbalaughAnAmanyonyamabhinighnatAm
shlokas.21:
vivyAdha somadattastu sAtvataM navabhiH sharaiH |
sAtyakirdashabhishchainamavadhItkurupu~Ngavam
shlokas.22:
so.atividdho balavatA samare dRRiDhadhanvanA |
rathopasthaM samAsAdya mumoha gatachetanaH
shlokas.23:
taM vimUDhaM samAlakShya sArathistvarayAnvitaH |
apovAha raNAdvIraM somadattaM mahAratham
shlokas.24:
taM visa~nj~naM samAlokya yuyudhAnasharArditam |
drauNirabhyadravatkruddhaH sAtvataM raNamUrdhani
shlokas.25:
tamApatantaM samprekShya shaineyasya rathaM prati |
bhaimaseniH susa~NkruddhaH pratyamitramavArayat
shlokas.26:
kArShNAyasamayaM ghoramRRikShacharmAvRRitaM mahat |
yuktaM gajanibhairvAhairna hayairnApi vA gajaiH
shlokas.27:
vikShiptamaShTachakreNa vivRRitAkSheNa kUjatA |
dhvajenochChritatuNDena gRRidhrarAjena rAjatA
shlokas.28:
lohitArdrapatAkaM tamantramAlAvibhUShitam |
aShTachakrasamAyuktamAsthAya vipulaM ratham
shlokas.29:
shUlamudgaradhAriNyA shailapAdapahastayA |
rakShasAM ghorarUpANAmakShauhiNyA samAvRRitaH
shlokas.30:
tamudyatamahAchApaM nishAmya vyathitA nRRipAH |
yugAntakAlasamaye daNDahastamivAntakam
shlokas.31:
bhayArditA prachukShobha putrasya tava vAhinI |
vAyunA kShobhitAvartA ga~Ngevordhvatara~NgiNI
shlokas.32:
ghaTotkachaprayuktena siMhanAdena bhIShitAH |
prasusruvurgajA mUtraM vivyathushcha narA bhRRisham
shlokas.33:
tato.ashmavRRiShTiratyarthamAsIttatra samantataH |
sandhyAkAlAdhikabalaiH pramuktA rAkShasaiH kShitau
shlokas.34:
AyasAni cha chakrANi bhushuNDyaH prAsatomarAH |
patantyaviralAH shUlAH shataghnyaH paTTishAstathA
shlokas.35:
tadugramatiraudraM cha dRRiShTvA yuddhaM narAdhipAH |
tanayAstava karNashcha vyathitAH prAdravandishaH
shlokas.36:
tatraiko.astrabalashlAghI drauNirmAnI na vivyathe |
vyadhamachcha sharairmAyAM ghaTotkachavinirmitAm
shlokas.37:
nihatAyAM tu mAyAyAmamarShI sa ghaTotkachaH |
visasarja sharAnghorA.nste.ashvatthAmAnamAvishan
shlokas.38:
bhujagA iva vegena valmIkaM krodhamUrChitAH |
te sharA rudhirAbhyaktA bhittvA shAradvatIsutam
vivishurdharaNIM shIghrA rukmapu~NkhAH shilAshitAH
shlokas.39:
ashvatthAmA tu sa~Nkruddho laghuhastaH pratApavAn |
ghaTotkachamabhikruddhaM bibheda dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.40:
ghaTotkacho.atividdhastu droNaputreNa marmasu |
chakraM shatasahasrAramagRRihNAdvyathito bhRRisham
shlokas.41:
kShurAntaM bAlasUryAbhaM maNivajravibhUShitam |
ashvatthAmnastu chikShepa bhaimasenirjighA.nsayA
shlokas.42:
vegena mahatA gachChadvikShiptaM drauNinA sharaiH |
abhAgyasyeva sa~NkalpastanmoghaM nyapatadbhuvi
shlokas.43:
ghaTotkachastatastUrNaM dRRiShTvA chakraM nipAtitam |
drauNiM prAchChAdayadbANaiH svarbhAnuriva bhAskaram
shlokas.44:
ghaTotkachasutaH shrImAnbhinnA~njanachayopamaH |
rurodha drauNimAyAntaM prabha~njanamivAdrirAT
shlokas.45:
pautreNa bhImasenasya sharaiH so.a~njanaparvaNA |
babhau meghena dhArAbhirgirirmerurivArditaH
shlokas.46:
ashvatthAmA tvasambhrAnto rudropendrendravikramaH |
dhvajamekena bANena chichChedA~njanaparvaNaH
shlokas.47:
dvAbhyAM tu rathayantAraM tribhishchAsya triveNukam |
dhanurekena chichCheda chaturbhishchaturo hayAn
shlokas.48:
virathasyodyataM hastAddhemabindubhirAchitam |
vishikhena sutIkShNena khaDgamasya dvidhAkarot
shlokas.49:
gadA hemA~NgadA rAja.nstUrNaM haiDimbasUnunA |
bhrAmyotkShiptA sharaiH sApi drauNinAbhyAhatApatat
shlokas.50:
tato.antarikShamutpatya kAlamegha ivonnadan |
vavarShA~njanaparvA sa drumavarShaM nabhastalAt
shlokas.51:
tato mAyAdharaM drauNirghaTotkachasutaM divi |
mArgaNairabhivivyAdha ghanaM sUrya ivA.nshubhiH
shlokas.52:
so.avatIrya punastasthau rathe hemapariShkRRite |
mahIdhara ivAtyuchchaH shrImAna~njanaparvataH
shlokas.53:
tamayasmayavarmANaM drauNirbhImAtmajAtmajam |
jaghAnA~njanaparvANaM maheshvara ivAndhakam
shlokas.54:
atha dRRiShTvA hataM putramashvatthAmnA mahAbalam |
drauNeH sakAshamabhyetya roShAtprachalitA~NgadaH
shlokas.55:
prAha vAkyamasambhrAnto vIraM shAradvatIsutam |
dahantaM pANDavAnIkaM vanamagnimivoddhatam
shlokas.56:
tiShTha tiShTha na me jIvandroNaputra gamiShyasi |
tvAmadya nihaniShyAmi krau~nchamagnisuto yathA
shlokas.57:
ashvatthAmovAcha||
gachCha vatsa sahAnyaistvaM yudhyasvAmaravikrama |
na hi putreNa haiDimbe pitA nyAyyaM prabAdhitum
shlokas.58:
kAmaM khalu na me roSho haiDimbe vidyate tvayi |
kiM tu roShAnvito janturhanyAdAtmAnamapyuta
shlokas.59:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shrutvaitatkrodhatAmrAkShaH putrashokasamanvitaH |
ashvatthAmAnamAyasto bhaimasenirabhAShata
shlokas.60:
kimahaM kAtaro drauNe pRRithagjana ivAhave |
bhImAtkhalvahamutpannaH kurUNAM vipule kule
shlokas.61:
pANDavAnAmahaM putraH samareShvanivartinAm |
rakShasAmadhirAjo.ahaM dashagrIvasamo bale
shlokas.62:
tiShTha tiShTha na me jIvandroNaputra gamiShyasi |
yuddhashraddhAmahaM te.adya vineShyAmi raNAjire
shlokas.63:
ityuktvA roShatAmrAkSho rAkShasaH sumahAbalaH |
drauNimabhyadravatkruddho gajendramiva kesarI
shlokas.64:
rathAkShamAtrairiShubhirabhyavarShadghaTotkachaH |
rathinAmRRiShabhaM drauNiM dhArAbhiriva toyadaH
shlokas.65:
sharavRRiShTiM sharairdrauNiraprAptAM tAM vyashAtayat |
tato.antarikShe bANAnAM sa~NgrAmo.anya ivAbhavat
shlokas.66:
athAstrasa~NgharShakRRitairvisphuli~NgaiH samAbabhau |
vibhAvarImukhe vyoma khadyotairiva chitritam
shlokas.67:
nishAmya nihatAM mAyAM drauNinA raNamAninA |
ghaTotkachastato mAyAM sasarjAntarhitaH punaH
shlokas.68:
so.abhavadgiriratyuchchaH shikharaistarusa~NkaTaiH |
shUlaprAsAsimusalajalaprasravaNo mahAn
shlokas.69:
tama~njanachayaprakhyaM drauNirdRRiShTvA mahIdharam |
prapatadbhishcha bahubhiH shastrasa~Nghairna chukShubhe
shlokas.70:
tataH smayanniva drauNirvajramastramudIrayat |
sa tenAstreNa shailendraH kShiptaH kShipramanashyata
shlokas.71:
tataH sa toyado bhUtvA nIlaH sendrAyudho divi |
ashmavRRiShTibhiratyugro drauNimAchChAdayadraNe
shlokas.72:
atha sandhAya vAyavyamastramastravidAM varaH |
vyadhamaddroNatanayo nIlameghaM samutthitam
shlokas.73:
sa mArgaNagaNairdrauNirdishaH prachChAdya sarvataH |
