shataM rathasahasrANAM jaghAna dvipadAM varaH
shlokas.74:
sa dRRiShTvA punarAyAntaM rathenAyatakArmukam |
ghaTotkachamasambhrAntaM rAkShasairbahubhirvRRitam
shlokas.78:
upasthitaistato yuddhe rAkShasairyuddhadurmadaiH |
viShaNNamabhisamprekShya putraM te drauNirabravIt
shlokas.79:
tiShTha duryodhanAdya tvaM na kAryaH sambhramastvayA |
sahaibhirbhrAtRRibhirvIraiH pArthivaishchendravikramaiH
shlokas.80:
nihaniShyAmyamitrA.nste na tavAsti parAjayaH |
satyaM te pratijAnAmi paryAshvAsaya vAhinIm
shlokas.81:
duryodhana uvAcha||
na tvetadadbhutaM manye yatte mahadidaM manaH |
asmAsu cha parA bhaktistava gautaminandana
shlokas.82:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
ashvatthAmAnamuktvaivaM tataH saubalamabravIt |
vRRitaH shatasahasreNa rathAnAM raNashobhinAm
shlokas.83:
ShaShTyA gajasahasraishcha prayAhi tvaM dhana~njayam |
karNashcha vRRiShasenashcha kRRipo nIlastathaiva cha
shlokas.84:
udIchyAH kRRitavarmA cha purumitraH shrutArpaNaH |
duHshAsano nikumbhashcha kuNDabhedI urukramaH
shlokas.85:
pura~njayo dRRiDharathaH patAkI hemapa~NkajaH |
shalyAruNIndrasenAshcha sa~njayo vijayo jayaH
shlokas.86:
kamalAkShaH puruH krAthI jayavarmA sudarshanaH |
ete tvAmanuyAsyanti pattInAmayutAni ShaT
shlokas.87:
jahi bhImaM yamau chobhau dharmarAjaM cha mAtula |
asurAniva devendro jayAshA me tvayi sthitA
shlokas.88:
dAritAndrauNinA bANairbhRRishaM vikShatavigrahAn |
jahi mAtula kaunteyAnasurAniva pAvakiH
shlokas.89:
evamukto yayau shIghraM putreNa tava saubalaH |
piprIShuste sutAnrAjandidhakShushchaiva pANDavAn
shlokas.90:
atha pravavRRite yuddhaM drauNirAkShasayormRRidhe |
vibhAvaryAM sutumulaM shakraprahrAdayoriva
shlokas.91:
tato ghaTotkacho bANairdashabhirgautamIsutam |
jaghAnorasi sa~Nkruddho viShAgnipratimairdRRiDhaiH
shlokas.92:
sa tairabhyAhato gADhaM sharairbhImasuteritaiH |
chachAla rathamadhyastho vAtoddhUta iva drumaH
shlokas.93:
bhUyashchA~njalikenAsya mArgaNena mahAprabham |
drauNihastasthitaM chApaM chichChedAshu ghaTotkachaH
shlokas.94:
tato.anyaddrauNirAdAya dhanurbhArasahaM mahat |
vavarSha vishikhA.nstIkShNAnvAridhArA ivAmbudaH
shlokas.96:
tadbANairarditaM yUthaM rakShasAM pInavakShasAm |
siMhairiva babhau mattaM gajAnAmAkulaM kulam
shlokas.97:
vidhamya rAkShasAnbANaiH sAshvasUtarathAnvibhuH |
dadAha bhagavAnvahnirbhUtAnIva yugakShaye
shlokas.98:
sa dagdhvAkShauhiNIM bANairnairRRitAnruruche bhRRisham |
pureva tripuraM dagdhvA divi devo maheshvaraH
shlokas.99:
yugAnte sarvabhUtAni dagdhveva vasurulbaNaH |
rarAja jayatAM shreShTho droNaputrastavAhitAn
shlokas.100:
teShu rAjasahasreShu pANDaveyeShu bhArata |
nainaM nirIkShituM kashchichChaknoti drauNimAhave
RRite ghaTotkachAdvIrAdrAkShasendrAnmahAbalAt
shlokas.101:
sa punarbharatashreShTha krodhAdraktAntalochanaH |
talaM talena saMhatya sa.ndashya dashanachChadam
svasUtamabravItkruddho droNaputrAya mAM vaha
shlokas.102:
sa yayau ghorarUpeNa tena jaitrapatAkinA |
dvairathaM droNaputreNa punarapyarisUdanaH
shlokas.103:
sa chikShepa tataH kruddho droNaputrAya rAkShasaH |
aShTachakrAM mahAraudrAmashanIM rudranirmitAm
shlokas.104:
tAmavaplutya jagrAha drauNirnyasya rathe dhanuH |
chikShepa chainAM tasyaiva syandanAtso.avapupluve
shlokas.105:
sAshvasUtadhvajaM vAhaM bhasma kRRitvA mahAprabhA |
vivesha vasudhAM bhittvA sAshanirbhRRishadAruNA
shlokas.106:
drauNestatkarma dRRiShTvA tu sarvabhUtAnyapUjayan |
yadavaplutya jagrAha ghorAM sha~NkaranirmitAm
shlokas.107:
dhRRiShTadyumnarathaM gatvA bhaimasenistato nRRipa |
mumocha nishitAnbANAnpunardrauNermahorasi
shlokas.109:
tato mumocha nArAchAndrauNistAbhyAM sahasrashaH |
tAvapyagnishikhAprakhyairjaghnatustasya mArgaNAn
shlokas.110:
atitIvramabhUdyuddhaM tayoH puruShasiMhayoH |
yodhAnAM prItijananaM drauNeshcha bharatarShabha
shlokas.111:
tato rathasahasreNa dviradAnAM shataistribhiH |
ShaDbhirvAjisahasraishcha bhImastaM deshamAvrajat
shlokas.112:
tato bhImAtmajaM rakSho dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha sAnugam |
ayodhayata dharmAtmA drauNirakliShTakarmakRRit
shlokas.113:
tatrAdbhutatamaM drauNirdarshayAmAsa vikramam |
ashakyaM kartumanyena sarvabhUteShu bhArata
shlokas.115:
miShato bhImasenasya haiDimbeH pArShatasya cha |
yamayordharmaputrasya vijayasyAchyutasya cha
shlokas.117:
nikRRittairhastihastaishcha vichaladbhiritastataH |
rarAja vasudhA kIrNA visarpadbhirivoragaiH
shlokas.118:
kShiptaiH kA~nchanadaNDaishcha nRRipachChatraiH kShitirbabhau |
dyaurivoditachandrArkA grahAkIrNA yugakShaye
shlokas.125:
punarapyatisa~NkruddhaH savRRikodarapArShatAn |
sa nArAchagaNaiH pArthAndrauNirviddhvA mahAbalaH
shlokas.126:
jaghAna surathaM nAma drupadasya sutaM vibhuH |
punaH shruta~njayaM nAma surathasyAnujaM raNe
shlokas.127:
balAnIkaM jayAnIkaM jayAshvaM chAbhijaghnivAn |
shrutAhvayaM cha rAjendra drauNirninye yamakShayam
shlokas.128:
tribhishchAnyaiH sharaistIkShNaiH supu~Nkhai rukmamAlinam |
shatru~njayaM cha balinaM shakralokaM ninAya ha
shlokas.129:
jaghAna sa pRRiShadhraM cha chandradevaM cha mAninam |
kuntibhojasutA.nshchAjau dashabhirdasha jaghnivAn
shlokas.130:
ashvatthAmA susa~NkruddhaH sandhAyogramajihmagam |
mumochAkarNapUrNena dhanuShA sharamuttamam
yamadaNDopamaM ghoramuddishyAshu ghaTotkacham
shlokas.131:
sa bhittvA hRRidayaM tasya rAkShasasya mahAsharaH |
vivesha vasudhAM shIghraM sapu~NkhaH pRRithivIpate
shlokas.132:
taM hataM patitaM j~nAtvA dhRRiShTadyumno mahArathaH |
drauNeH sakAshAdrAjendra apaninye rathAntaram
shlokas.133:
tathA parA~NmukharathaM sainyaM yaudhiShThiraM nRRipa |
parAjitya raNe vIro droNaputro nanAda ha
pUjitaH sarvabhUtaishcha tava putraishcha bhArata
shlokas.134:
atha sharashatabhinnakRRittadehai;rhatapatitaiH kShaNadAcharaiH samantAt |
nidhanamupagatairmahI kRRitAbhU;dgirishikharairiva durgamAtiraudrA
shlokas.135:
taM siddhagandharvapishAchasa~NghA; nAgAH suparNAH pitaro vayA.nsi |
rakShogaNA bhUtagaNAshcha drauNi;mapUjayannapsarasaH surAshcha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
drupadasyAtmajAndRRiShTvA kuntibhojasutA.nstathA |
droNaputreNa nihatAnrAkShasA.nshcha sahasrashaH
shlokas.2:
yudhiShThiro bhImaseno dhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
yuyudhAnashcha sa.nyattA yuddhAyaiva mano dadhuH
shlokas.3:
somadattaH punaH kurddho dRRiShTvA sAtyakimAhave |
mahatA sharavarSheNa ChAdayAmAsa sarvataH
shlokas.4:
tataH samabhavadyuddhamatIva bhayavardhanam |
tvadIyAnAM pareShAM cha ghoraM vijayakA~NkShiNAm
shlokas.5:
dashabhiH sAtvatasyArthe bhImo vivyAdha kauravam |
somadatto.api taM vIraM shatena pratyavidhyata
shlokas.6:
sAtvatastvabhisa~NkruddhaH putrAdhibhirabhiplutam |
vRRiddhamRRiddhaM guNaiH sarvairyayAtimiva nAhuSham
shlokas.7:
vivyAdha dashabhistIkShNaiH sharairvajranipAtibhiH |
shaktyA chainamathAhatya punarvivyAdha saptabhiH
shlokas.8:
tatastu sAtyakerarthe bhImaseno navaM dRRiDham |
mumocha parighaM ghoraM somadattasya mUrdhani
shlokas.9:
sAtyakishchAgnisa~NkAshaM mumocha sharamuttamam |
somadattorasi kruddhaH supatraM nishitaM yudhi
shlokas.10:
yugapatpetaturatha ghorau parighamArgaNau |
sharIre somadattasya sa papAta mahArathaH
shlokas.11:
vyAmohite tu tanaye bAhlIkaH samupAdravat |
visRRija~nsharavarShANi kAlavarShIva toyadaH
shlokas.12:
bhImo.atha sAtvatasyArthe bAhlIkaM navabhiH sharaiH |
pIDayanvai mahAtmAnaM vivyAdha raNamUrdhani
shlokas.13:
prAtipIyastu sa~NkruddhaH shaktiM bhImasya vakShasi |
nichakhAna mahAbAhuH pura.ndara ivAshanim
shlokas.14:
sa tayAbhihato bhImashchakampe cha mumoha cha |
prApya chetashcha balavAngadAmasmai sasarja ha
shlokas.15:
sA pANDavena prahitA bAhlIkasya shiro.aharat |
sa papAta hataH pRRithvyAM vajrAhata ivAdrirAT
shlokas.16:
tasminvinihate vIre bAhlIke puruSharShabhe |
putrAste.abhyardayanbhImaM dasha dAsharatheH samAH
shlokas.17:
nArAchairdashabhirbhImastAnnihatya tavAtmajAn |
karNasya dayitaM putraM vRRiShasenamavAkirat
shlokas.18:
tato vRRiSharatho nAma bhrAtA karNasya vishrutaH |
jaghAna bhImaM nArAchaistamapyabhyavadhIdbalI
shlokas.19:
tataH sapta rathAnvIraH syAlAnAM tava bhArata |
nihatya bhImo nArAchaiH shatachandramapothayat
shlokas.20:
amarShayanto nihataM shatachandraM mahAratham |
shakunerbhrAtaro vIrA gajAkShaH sharabho vibhuH
abhidrutya sharaistIkShNairbhImasenamatADayan
shlokas.21:
sa tudyamAno nArAchairvRRiShTivegairivarShabhaH |
jaghAna pa~nchabhirbANaiH pa~nchaivAtibalo rathAn
tAndRRiShTvA nihatAnvIrAnvichelurnRRipasattamAH
shlokas.22:
tato yudhiShThiraH kruddhastavAnIkamashAtayat |
miShataH kumbhayoneshcha putrANAM cha tavAnagha
shlokas.23:
ambaShThAnmAlavA~nshUrA.nstrigartAnsashibInapi |
prAhiNonmRRityulokAya gaNAnyuddhe yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.24:
abhIShAhA~nshUrasenAnbAhlIkAnsavasAtikAn |
nikRRitya pRRithivIM rAjA chakre shoNitakardamAm
shlokas.25:
yaudheyAraTTarAjanyamadrakANAM gaNAnyudhi |
prAhiNonmRRityulokAya shUrAnbANairyudhiShThiraH
shlokas.26:
hatAharata gRRihNIta vidhyata vyavakRRintata |
ityAsIttumulaH shabdo yudhiShThirarathaM prati
shlokas.27:
sainyAni drAvayantaM taM droNo dRRiShTvA yudhiShThiram |
choditastava putreNa sAyakairabhyavAkirat
shlokas.28:
droNastu paramakruddho vAyavyAstreNa pArthivam |
vivyAdha so.asya taddivyamastramastreNa jaghnivAn
shlokas.29:
tasminvinihate chAstre bhAradvAjo yudhiShThire |
vAruNaM yAmyamAgneyaM tvAShTraM sAvitrameva cha
chikShepa paramakruddho jighA.nsuH pANDunandanam
shlokas.30:
kShiptAni kShipyamANAni tAni chAstrANi dharmajaH |
jaghAnAstrairmahAbAhuH kumbhayoneravitrasan
shlokas.31:
satyAM chikIrShamANastu pratij~nAM kumbhasambhavaH |
prAdushchakre.astramaindraM vai prAjApatyaM cha bhArata
jighA.nsurdharmatanayaM tava putrahite rataH
shlokas.32:
patiH kurUNAM gajasiMhagAmI; vishAlavakShAH pRRithulohitAkShaH |
prAdushchakArAstramahInatejA; mAhendramanyatsa jaghAna te.astre
shlokas.33:
vihanyamAneShvastreShu droNaH krodhasamanvitaH |
yudhiShThiravadhaprepsurbrAhmamastramudairayat
shlokas.34:
tato nAj~nAsiShaM ki~nchidghoreNa tamasAvRRite |
sarvabhUtAni cha paraM trAsaM jagmurmahIpate
shlokas.35:
brahmAstramudyataM dRRiShTvA kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
brahmAstreNaiva rAjendra tadastraM pratyavArayat
shlokas.36:
tataH sainikamukhyAste prashasha.nsurnararShabhau |
droNapArthau maheShvAsau sarvayuddhavishAradau
shlokas.37:
tataH pramuchya kaunteyaM droNo drupadavAhinIm |
vyadhamadroShatAmrAkSho vAyavyAstreNa bhArata
shlokas.38:
te hanyamAnA droNena pA~nchAlAH prAdravanbhayAt |
pashyato bhImasenasya pArthasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.39:
tataH kirITI bhImashcha sahasA saMnyavartatAm |
mahadbhyAM rathava.nshAbhyAM parigRRihya balaM tava
shlokas.40:
bIbhatsurdakShiNaM pArshvamuttaraM tu vRRikodaraH |
bhAradvAjaM sharaughAbhyAM mahadbhyAmabhyavarShatAm
shlokas.41:
tau tadA sRRi~njayAshchaiva pA~nchAlAshcha mahaujasaH |
anvagachChanmahArAja matsyAshcha saha sAtvataiH
shlokas.42:
tataH sA bhAratI senA vadhyamAnA kirITinA |
droNena vAryamANAste svayaM tava sutena cha
nAshakyanta mahArAja yodhA vArayituM tadA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
udIryamANaM taddRRiShTvA pANDavAnAM mahadbalam |
aviShahyaM cha manvAnaH karNaM duryodhano.abravIt
shlokas.2:
ayaM sa kAlaH samprApto mitrANAM mitravatsala |
trAyasva samare karNa sarvAnyodhAnmahAbala
shlokas.3:
pA~nchAlairmatsyakaikeyaiH pANDavaishcha mahArathaiH |
vRRitAnsamantAtsa~NkruddhairniHshvasadbhirivoragaiH
shlokas.4:
ete nadanti saMhRRiShTAH pANDavA jitakAshinaH |
shakropamAshcha bahavaH pA~nchAlAnAM rathavrajAH
shlokas.5:
karNa uvAcha||
paritrAtumiha prApto yadi pArthaM pura.ndaraH |
tamapyAshu parAjitya tato hantAsmi pANDavam
shlokas.6:
satyaM te pratijAnAmi samAshvasihi bhArata |
hantAsmi pANDutanayAnpA~nchAlA.nshcha samAgatAn
shlokas.7:
jayaM te pratijAnAmi vAsavasyeva pAvakiH |
priyaM tava mayA kAryamiti jIvAmi pArthiva
shlokas.8:
sarveShAmeva pArthAnAM phalguno balavattaraH |
tasyAmoghAM vimokShyAmi shaktiM shakravinirmitAm
shlokas.9:
tasminhate maheShvAse bhrAtarastasya mAnada |
tava vashyA bhaviShyanti vanaM yAsyanti vA punaH
shlokas.10:
mayi jIvati kauravya viShAdaM mA kRRithAH kvachit |
ahaM jeShyAmi samare sahitAnsarvapANDavAn
shlokas.11:
pA~nchAlAnkekayA.nshchaiva vRRiShNI.nshchApi samAgatAn |
bANaughaiH shakalIkRRitya tava dAsyAmi medinIm
shlokas.12:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evaM bruvANaM karNaM tu kRRipaH shAradvato.abravIt |
smayanniva mahAbAhuH sUtaputramidaM vachaH
shlokas.13:
shobhanaM shobhanaM karNa sanAthaH kurupu~NgavaH |
tvayA nAthena rAdheya vachasA yadi sidhyati
shlokas.14:
bahushaH katthase karNa kauravyasya samIpataH |
na tu te vikramaH kashchiddRRishyate balameva vA
shlokas.15:
samAgamaH pANDusutairdRRiShTaste bahusho yudhi |
sarvatra nirjitashchAsi pANDavaiH sUtanandana
shlokas.16:
hriyamANe tadA karNa gandharvairdhRRitarAShTraje |
tadAyudhyanta sainyAni tvamekastu palAyathAH
shlokas.17:
virATanagare chApi sametAH sarvakauravAH |
pArthena nirjitA yuddhe tvaM cha karNa sahAnujaH
shlokas.18:
ekasyApyasamarthastvaM phalgunasya raNAjire |
kathamutsahase jetuM sakRRiShNAnsarvapANDavAn
shlokas.19:
abruvankarNa yudhyasva bahu katthasi sUtaja |
anuktvA vikramedyastu tadvai satpuruShavratam
shlokas.20:
garjitvA sUtaputra tvaM shAradAbhramivAjalam |
niShphalo dRRishyase karNa tachcha rAjA na budhyate
shlokas.21:
tAvadgarjasi rAdheya yAvatpArthaM na pashyasi |
purA pArthaM hi te dRRiShTvA durlabhaM garjitaM bhavet
shlokas.22:
tvamanAsAdya tAnbANAnphalgunasya vigarjasi |
pArthasAyakaviddhasya durlabhaM garjitaM bhavet
shlokas.23:
bAhubhiH kShatriyAH shUrA vAgbhiH shUrA dvijAtayaH |
dhanuShA phalgunaH shUraH karNaH shUro manorathaiH
shlokas.24:
evaM paruShitastena tadA shAradvatena saH |
karNaH praharatAM shreShThaH kRRipaM vAkyamathAbravIt
shlokas.25:
shUrA garjanti satataM prAvRRiShIva balAhakAH |
phalaM chAshu prayachChanti bIjamuptamRRitAviva
shlokas.26:
doShamatra na pashyAmi shUrANAM raNamUrdhani |
tattadvikatthamAnAnAM bhAraM chodvahatAM mRRidhe
shlokas.27:
yaM bhAraM puruSho voDhuM manasA hi vyavasyati |
daivamasya dhruvaM tatra sAhAyyAyopapadyate
shlokas.28:
vyavasAyadvitIyo.ahaM manasA bhAramudvahan |
garjAmi yadyahaM vipra tava kiM tatra nashyati
shlokas.29:
vRRithA shUrA na garjanti sajalA iva toyadAH |
sAmarthyamAtmano j~nAtvA tato garjanti paNDitAH
shlokas.30:
so.ahamadya raNe yattaH sahitau kRRiShNapANDavau |
utsahe tarasA jetuM tato garjAmi gautama
shlokas.31:
pashya tvaM garjitasyAsya phalaM me vipra sAnugaH |
hatvA pANDusutAnAjau sahakRRiShNAnsasAtvatAn
duryodhanAya dAsyAmi pRRithivIM hatakaNTakAm
shlokas.32:
kRRipa uvAcha||
manorathapralApo me na grAhyastava sUtaja |
yadA kShipasi vai kRRiShNau dharmarAjaM cha pANDavam
shlokas.33:
dhruvastatra jayaH karNa yatra yuddhavishAradau |
devagandharvayakShANAM manuShyoragarakShasAm
da.nshitAnAmapi raNe ajeyau kRRiShNapANDavau
shlokas.34:
brahmaNyaH satyavAgdAnto gurudaivatapUjakaH |
nityaM dharmaratashchaiva kRRitAstrashcha visheShataH
dhRRitimA.nshcha kRRitaj~nashcha dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.35:
bhrAtarashchAsya balinaH sarvAstreShu kRRitashramAH |
guruvRRittiratAH prAj~nA dharmanityA yashasvinaH
shlokas.36:
sambandhinashchendravIryAH svanuraktAH prahAriNaH |
dhRRiShTadyumnaH shikhaNDI cha daurmukhirjanamejayaH
shlokas.37:
chandraseno bhadrasenaH kIrtidharmA dhruvo dharaH |
vasuchandro dAmachandraH siMhachandraH suvedhanaH
shlokas.38:
drupadasya tathA putrA drupadashcha mahAstravit |
yeShAmarthAya sa.nyatto matsyarAjaH sahAnugaH
shlokas.39:
shatAnIkaH sudashanaH shrutAnIkaH shrutadhvajaH |
balAnIko jayAnIko jayAshvo rathavAhanaH
shlokas.40:
chandrodayaH kAmaratho virATabhrAtaraH shubhAH |
yamau cha draupadeyAshcha rAkShasashcha ghaTotkachaH
yeShAmarthAya yudhyante na teShAM vidyate kShayaH
shlokas.41:
kAmaM khalu jagatsarvaM sadevAsuramAnavam |
sayakSharAkShasagaNaM sabhUtabhujagadvipam
niHsheShamastravIryeNa kuryAtAM bhImaphalgunau
shlokas.42:
yudhiShThirashcha pRRithivIM nirdahedghorachakShuShA |
aprameyabalaH shauriryeShAmarthe cha da.nshitaH
kathaM tAnsa.nyuge karNa jetumutsahase parAn
shlokas.43:
mahAnapanayastveSha tava nityaM hi sUtaja |
yastvamutsahase yoddhuM samare shauriNA saha
shlokas.44:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamuktastu rAdheyaH prahasanbharatarShabha |
abravIchcha tadA karNo guruM shAradvataM kRRipam
shlokas.45:
satyamuktaM tvayA brahmanpANDavAnprati yadvachaH |
ete chAnye cha bahavo guNAH pANDusuteShu vai
shlokas.46:
ajayyAshcha raNe pArthA devairapi savAsavaiH |
sadaityayakShagandharvapishAchoragarAkShasaiH
tathApi pArthA~njeShyAmi shaktyA vAsavadattayA
shlokas.47:
mamApyamoghA datteyaM shaktiH shakreNa vai dvija |
etayA nihaniShyAmi savyasAchinamAhave
shlokas.48:
hate tu pANDave kRRiShNo bhrAtarashchAsya sodarAH |
anarjunA na shakShyanti mahIM bhoktuM katha~nchana
shlokas.49:
teShu naShTeShu sarveShu pRRithivIyaM sasAgarA |
ayatnAtkauraveyasya vashe sthAsyati gautama
shlokas.50:
sunItairiha sarvArthAH sidhyante nAtra sa.nshayaH |
etamarthamahaM j~nAtvA tato garjAmi gautama
shlokas.51:
tvaM tu vRRiddhashcha viprashcha ashaktashchApi sa.nyuge |
kRRitasnehashcha pArtheShu mohAnmAmavamanyase
shlokas.52:
yadyevaM vakShyase bhUyo mAmapriyamiha dvija |
tataste khaDgamudyamya jihvAM ChetsyAmi durmate
shlokas.53:
yachchApi pANDavAnvipra stotumichChasi sa.nyuge |
bhIShayansarvasainyAni kauraveyANi durmate
atrApi shRRiNu me vAkyaM yathAvadgadato dvija
shlokas.54:
duryodhanashcha droNashcha shakunirdurmukho jayaH |
duHshAsano vRRiShaseno madrarAjastvameva cha
somadattashcha bhUrishcha tathA drauNirvivi.nshatiH
shlokas.55:
tiShTheyurda.nshitA yatra sarve yuddhavishAradAH |
jayedetAnraNe ko nu shakratulyabalo.apyariH
shlokas.56:
shUrAshcha hi kRRitAstrAshcha balinaH svargalipsavaH |
dharmaj~nA yuddhakushalA hanyuryuddhe surAnapi
shlokas.57:
ete sthAsyanti sa~NgrAme pANDavAnAM vadhArthinaH |
jayamAkA~NkShamANA hi kauraveyasya da.nshitAH
shlokas.58:
daivAyattamahaM manye jayaM subalinAmapi |
yatra bhIShmo mahAbAhuH shete sharashatAchitaH
shlokas.59:
vikarNashchitrasenashcha bAhlIko.atha jayadrathaH |
bhUrishravA jayashchaiva jalasandhaH sudakShiNaH
shlokas.60:
shalashcha rathinAM shreShTho bhagadattashcha vIryavAn |
ete chAnye cha rAjAno devairapi sudurjayAH
shlokas.61:
nihatAH samare shUrAH pANDavairbalavattarAH |
kimanyaddaivasa.nyogAnmanyase puruShAdhama
shlokas.62:
yA.nshcha tAnstauShi satataM duryodhanaripUndvija |
teShAmapi hatAH shUrAH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.63:
kShIyante sarvasainyAni kurUNAM pANDavaiH saha |
prabhAvaM nAtra pashyAmi pANDavAnAM katha~nchana
shlokas.64:
yA.nstAnbalavato nityaM manyase tvaM dvijAdhama |
yatiShye.ahaM yathAshakti yoddhuM taiH saha sa.nyuge
duryodhanahitArthAya jayo daive pratiShThitaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tathA paruShitaM dRRiShTvA sUtaputreNa mAtulam |
khaDgamudyamya vegena drauNirabhyapataddrutam
shlokas.2:
ashvatthAmovAcha||
karNa pashya sudurbuddhe tiShThedAnIM narAdhama |
eSha te.adya shiraH kAyAduddharAmi sudurmate
shlokas.3:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tamutpatantaM vegena rAjA duryodhanaH svayam |
nyavArayanmahArAja kRRipashcha dvipadAM varaH
shlokas.4:
karNa uvAcha||
shUro.ayaM samarashlAghI durmatishcha dvijAdhamaH |
AsAdayatu madvIryaM mu~nchemaM kurusattama
shlokas.5:
ashvatthAmovAcha||
tavaitatkShamyate.asmAbhiH sUtAtmaja sudurmate |
darpamutsiktametatte phalguno nAshayiShyati
shlokas.6:
duryodhana uvAcha||
ashvatthAmanprasIdasva kShantumarhasi mAnada |
kopaH khalu na kartavyaH sUtaputre katha~nchana
shlokas.7:
tvayi karNe kRRipe droNe madrarAje.atha saubale |
mahatkAryaM samAyattaM prasIda dvijasattama
shlokas.8:
ete hyabhimukhAH sarve rAdheyena yuyutsavaH |
AyAnti pANDavA brahmannAhvayantaH samantataH
shlokas.9:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
karNo.api rathinAM shreShThashchApamudyamya vIryavAn |
kauravAgryaiH parivRRitaH shakro devagaNairiva
paryatiShThata tejasvI svabAhubalamAshritaH
shlokas.10:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM karNasya saha pANDavaiH |
sa.nrabdhasya mahArAja siMhanAdavinAditam
shlokas.11:
tataste pANDavA rAjanpA~nchAlAshcha yashasvinaH |
dRRiShTvA karNaM mahAbAhumuchchaiH shabdamathAnadan
shlokas.12:
ayaM karNaH kutaH karNastiShTha karNa mahAraNe |
yudhyasva sahito.asmAbhirdurAtmanpuruShAdhama
shlokas.13:
anye tu dRRiShTvA rAdheyaM krodharaktekShaNAbruvan |
hanyatAmayamutsiktaH sUtaputro.alpachetanaH
shlokas.14:
sarvaiH pArthivashArdUlairnAnenArtho.asti jIvatA |
atyantavairI pArthAnAM satataM pApapUruShaH
shlokas.15:
eSha mUlaM hyanarthAnAM duryodhanamate sthitaH |
hatainamiti jalpantaH kShatriyAH samupAdravan
shlokas.16:
mahatA sharavarSheNa ChAdayanto mahArathAH |
vadhArthaM sUtaputrasya pANDaveyena choditAH
shlokas.17:
tA.nstu sarvA.nstathA dRRiShTvA dhAvamAnAnmahArathAn |
na vivyathe sUtaputro na cha trAsamagachChata
shlokas.18:
dRRiShTvA nagarakalpaM tamuddhUtaM sainyasAgaram |
piprIShustava putrANAM sa~NgrAmeShvaparAjitaH
shlokas.19:
sAyakaughena balavAnkShiprakArI mahAbalaH |
vArayAmAsa tatsainyaM samantAdbharatarShabha
shlokas.20:
tatastu sharavarSheNa pArthivAstamavArayan |
dhanUMShi te vidhunvAnAH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
ayodhayanta rAdheyaM shakraM daityagaNA iva
shlokas.21:
sharavarShaM tu tatkarNaH pArthivaiH samudIritam |
sharavarSheNa mahatA samantAdvyakiratprabho
shlokas.22:
tadyuddhamabhavatteShAM kRRitapratikRRitaiShiNAm |
yathA devAsure yuddhe shakrasya saha dAnavaiH
shlokas.23:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma sUtaputrasya lAghavam |
yadenaM samare yattA nApnuvanta pare yudhi
shlokas.24:
nivArya cha sharaughA.nstAnpArthivAnAM mahArathaH |
yugeShvIShAsu ChatreShu dhvajeShu cha hayeShu cha
AtmanAmA~NkitAnbANAnrAdheyaH prAhiNochChitAn
shlokas.25:
tataste vyAkulIbhUtA rAjAnaH karNapIDitAH |
babhramustatra tatraiva gAvaH shItArditA iva
shlokas.26:
hayAnAM vadhyamAnAnAM gajAnAM rathinAM tathA |
tatra tatrAbhyavekShAmaH sa~NghAnkarNena pAtitAn
shlokas.27:
shirobhiH patitai rAjanbAhubhishcha samantataH |
AstIrNA vasudhA sarvA shUrANAmanivartinAm
shlokas.28:
hataishcha hanyamAnaishcha niShTanadbhishcha sarvashaH |
babhUvAyodhanaM raudraM vaivasvatapuropamam
shlokas.29:
tato duryodhano rAjA dRRiShTvA karNasya vikramam |
ashvatthAmAnamAsAdya tadA vAkyamuvAcha ha
shlokas.30:
yudhyate.asau raNe karNo da.nshitaH sarvapArthivaiH |
pashyaitAM dravatIM senAM karNasAyakapIDitAm
kArttikeyena vidhvastAmAsurIM pRRitanAmiva
shlokas.31:
dRRiShTvaitAM nirjitAM senAM raNe karNena dhImatA |
abhiyAtyeSha bIbhatsuH sUtaputrajighA.nsayA
shlokas.32:
tadyathA pashyamAnAnAM sUtaputraM mahAratham |
na hanyAtpANDavaH sa~Nkhye tathA nItirvidhIyatAm
shlokas.33:
tato drauNiH kRRipaH shalyo hArdikyashcha mahArathaH |
pratyudyayustadA pArthaM sUtaputraparIpsayA
shlokas.34:
AyAntaM dRRishya kaunteyaM vRRitraM devachamUmiva |
pratyudyayau tadA karNo yathA shakraH pratApavAn
shlokas.35:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sa.nrabdhaM phalgunaM dRRiShTvA kAlAntakayamopamam |
karNo vaikartanaH sUta pratyapadyatkimuttaram
shlokas.36:
sa hyaspardhata pArthena nityameva mahArathaH |
Asha.nsate cha bIbhatsuM yuddhe jetuM sudAruNe
shlokas.37:
sa tu taM sahasA prAptaM nityamatyantavairiNam |
karNo vaikartanaH sUta kimuttaramapadyata
shlokas.38:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
AyAntaM pANDavaM dRRiShTvA gajaH pratigajaM yathA |
asambhrAntataraH karNaH partyudIyAddhana~njayam
shlokas.39:
tamApatantaM vegena vaikartanamajihmagaiH |
vArayAmAsa tejasvI pANDavaH shatrutApanaH
shlokas.40:
taM karNaH sharajAlena ChAdayAmAsa mAriSha |
vivyAdha cha susa~NkruddhaH sharaistribhirajihmagaiH
shlokas.41:
tasya tallAghavaM pArtho nAmRRiShyata mahAbalaH |
tasmai bANA~nshilAdhautAnprasannAgrAnajihmagAn
shlokas.42:
prAhiNotsUtaputrAya tri.nshataM shatrutApanaH |
vivyAdha chainaM sa.nrabdho bANenaikena vIryavAn
shlokas.43:
savye bhujAgre balavAnnArAchena hasanniva |
tasya viddhasya vegena karAchchApaM papAta ha
shlokas.44:
punarAdAya tachchApaM nimeShArdhAnmahAbalaH |
ChAdayAmAsa bANaughaiH phalgunaM kRRitahastavat
shlokas.45:
sharavRRiShTiM tu tAM muktAM sUtaputreNa bhArata |
vyadhamachCharavarSheNa smayanniva dhana~njayaH
shlokas.46:
tau parasparamAsAdya sharavarSheNa pArthiva |
ChAdayetAM maheShvAsau kRRitapratikRRitaiShiNau
shlokas.47:
tadadbhutamabhUdyuddhaM karNapANDavayormRRidhe |
kruddhayorvAshitAhetorvanyayorgajayoriva
shlokas.48:
tataH pArtho maheShvAso dRRiShTvA karNasya vikramam |
muShTideshe dhanustasya chichCheda tvarayAnvitaH
shlokas.49:
ashvA.nshcha chaturo bhallairanayadyamasAdanam |
sAratheshcha shiraH kAyAdaharachChatrutApanaH
shlokas.50:
athainaM ChinnadhanvAnaM hatAshvaM hatasArathim |
vivyAdha sAyakaiH pArthashchaturbhiH pANDunandanaH
shlokas.51:
hatAshvAttu rathAttUrNamavaplutya nararShabhaH |
Aruroha rathaM tUrNaM kRRipasya sharapIDitaH
shlokas.52:
rAdheyaM nirjitaM dRRiShTvA tAvakA bharatarShabha |
dhana~njayasharairnunnAH prAdravanta disho dasha
shlokas.53:
dravatastAnsamAlokya rAjA duryodhano nRRipa |
nivartayAmAsa tadA vAkyaM chedamuvAcha ha
shlokas.54:
alaM drutena vaH shUrAstiShThadhvaM kShatriyarShabhAH |
eSha pArthavadhAyAhaM svayaM gachChAmi sa.nyuge
ahaM pArthAnhaniShyAmi sapA~nchAlAnsasomakAn
shlokas.55:
adya me yudhyamAnasya saha gANDIvadhanvanA |
drakShyanti vikramaM pArthAH kAlasyeva yugakShaye
shlokas.56:
adya madbANajAlAni vimuktAni sahasrashaH |
drakShyanti samare yodhAH shalabhAnAmivAyatIH
shlokas.57:
adya bANamayaM varShaM sRRijato mama dhanvinaH |
jImUtasyeva gharmAnte drakShyanti yudhi sainikAH
shlokas.58:
jeShyAmyadya raNe pArthaM sAyakairnataparvabhiH |
tiShThadhvaM samare shUrA bhayaM tyajata phalgunAt
shlokas.59:
na hi madvIryamAsAdya phalgunaH prasahiShyati |
yathA velAM samAsAdya sAgaro makarAlayaH
shlokas.60:
ityuktvA prayayau rAjA sainyena mahatA vRRitaH |
phalgunaM prati durdharShaH krodhasa.nraktalochanaH
shlokas.61:
taM prayAntaM mahAbAhuM dRRiShTvA shAradvatastadA |
ashvatthAmAnamAsAdya vAkyametaduvAcha ha
shlokas.62:
eSha rAjA mahAbAhuramarShI krodhamUrChitaH |
pata~NgavRRittimAsthAya phalgunaM yoddhumichChati
shlokas.63:
yAvannaH pashyamAnAnAM prANAnpArthena sa~NgataH |
na jahyAtpuruShavyAghrastAvadvAraya kauravam
shlokas.64:
yAvatphalgunabANAnAM gocharaM nAdhigachChati |
kauravaH pArthivo vIrastAvadvAraya taM drutam
shlokas.65:
yAvatpArthasharairghorairnirmuktoragasaMnibhaiH |
na bhasmIkriyate rAjA tAvadyuddhAnnivAryatAm
shlokas.66:
ayuktamiva pashyAmi tiShThatsvasmAsu mAnada |
svayaM yuddhAya yadrAjA pArthaM yAtyasahAyavAn
shlokas.67:
durlabhaM jIvitaM manye kauravyasya kirITinA |
yudhyamAnasya pArthena shArdUleneva hastinaH
shlokas.68:
mAtulenaivamuktastu drauNiH shastrabhRRitAM varaH |
duryodhanamidaM vAkyaM tvaritaM samabhAShata
shlokas.69:
mayi jIvati gAndhAre na yuddhaM gantumarhasi |
mAmanAdRRitya kauravya tava nityaM hitaiShiNam
shlokas.70:
na hi te sambhramaH kAryaH pArthasya vijayaM prati |
ahamAvArayiShyAmi pArthaM tiShTha suyodhana
shlokas.71:
duryodhana uvAcha||
AchAryaH pANDuputrAnvai putravatparirakShati |
tvamapyupekShAM kuruShe teShu nityaM dvijottama
shlokas.72:
mama vA mandabhAgyatvAnmandaste vikramo yudhi |
dharmarAjapriyArthaM vA draupadyA vA na vidma tat
shlokas.73:
dhigastu mama lubdhasya yatkRRite sarvabAndhavAH |
sukhArhAH paramaM duHkhaM prApnuvantyaparAjitAH
shlokas.74:
ko hi shastrabhRRitAM mukhyo maheshvarasamo yudhi |
shatrUnna kShapayechChakto yo na syAdgautamIsutaH
shlokas.75:
ashvatthAmanprasIdasva nAshayaitAnmamAhitAn |
tavAstragochare shaktAH sthAtuM devApi nAnagha
shlokas.76:
pA~nchAlAnsomakA.nshchaiva jahi drauNe sahAnugAn |
vayaM sheShAnhaniShyAmastvayaiva parirakShitAH
shlokas.77:
ete hi somakA vipra pA~nchAlAshcha yashasvinaH |
mama sainyeShu sa.nrabdhA vicharanti davAgnivat
shlokas.78:
tAnvAraya mahAbAho kekayA.nshcha narottama |
purA kurvanti niHsheShaM rakShyamANAH kirITinA
shlokas.79:
Adau vA yadi vA pashchAttavedaM karma mAriSha |
tvamutpanno mahAbAho pA~nchAlAnAM vadhaM prati
shlokas.80:
kariShyasi jagatsarvamapA~nchAlaM kilAchyuta |
evaM siddhAbruvanvAcho bhaviShyati cha tattathA
shlokas.81:
na te.astragochare shaktAH sthAtuM devAH savAsavAH |
kimu pArthAH sapA~nchAlAH satyametadvacho mama

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
duryodhanenaivamukto drauNirAhavadurmadaH |
pratyuvAcha mahAbAho yathA vadasi kaurava
shlokas.2:
priyA hi pANDavA nityaM mama chApi pitushcha me |
tathaivAvAM priyau teShAM na tu yuddhe kurUdvaha
shaktitastAta yudhyAmastyaktvA prANAnabhItavat
shlokas.3:
ahaM karNashcha shalyashcha kRRipo hArdikya eva cha |
nimeShAtpANDavIM senAM kShapayema nRRipottama
shlokas.4:
te chApi kauravIM senAM nimeShArdhAtkurUdvaha |
kShapayeyurmahAbAho na syAma yadi sa.nyuge
shlokas.5:
yudhyatAM pANDavA~nshaktyA teShAM chAsmAnyuyutsatAm |
tejastu teja AsAdya prashamaM yAti bhArata
shlokas.6:
ashakyA tarasA jetuM pANDavAnAmanIkinI |
jIvatsu pANDuputreShu taddhi satyaM bravImi te
shlokas.7:
AtmArthaM yudhyamAnAste samarthAH pANDunandanAH |
kimarthaM tava sainyAni na haniShyanti bhArata
shlokas.8:
tvaM hi lubdhatamo rAjannikRRitij~nashcha kaurava |
sarvAtisha~NkI mAnI cha tato.asmAnatisha~Nkase
shlokas.9:
ahaM tu yatnamAsthAya tvadarthe tyaktajIvitaH |
eSha gachChAmi sa~NgrAmaM tvatkRRite kurunandana
shlokas.10:
yotsye.ahaM shatrubhiH sArdhaM jeShyAmi cha varAnvarAn |
pA~nchAlaiH saha yotsyAmi somakaiH kekayaistathA
pANDaveyaishcha sa~NgrAme tvatpriyArthamari.ndama
shlokas.11:
adya madbANanirdagdhAH pA~nchAlAH somakAstathA |
siMhenevArditA gAvo vidraviShyanti sarvataH
shlokas.12:
adya dharmasuto rAjA dRRiShTvA mama parAkramam |
ashvatthAmamayaM lokaM ma.nsyate saha somakaiH
shlokas.13:
AgamiShyati nirvedaM dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
dRRiShTvA vinihatAnsa~Nkhye pA~nchAlAnsomakaiH saha
shlokas.14:
ye mAM yuddhe.abhiyotsyanti tAnhaniShyAmi bhArata |
na hi te vIra muchyeranmadbAhvantaramAgatAH
shlokas.15:
evamuktvA mahAbAhuH putraM duryodhanaM tava |
abhyavartata yuddhAya drAvayansarvadhanvinaH
chikIrShustava putrANAM priyaM prANabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.16:
tato.abravItsakaikeyAnpA~nchAlAngautamIsutaH |
praharadhvamitaH sarve mama gAtre mahArathAH
sthirIbhUtAshcha yudhyadhvaM darshayanto.astralAghavam
shlokas.17:
evamuktAstu te sarve shastravRRiShTimapAtayan |
drauNiM prati mahArAja jalaM jaladharA iva
shlokas.18:
tAnnihatya sharAndrauNirdasha vIrAnapothayat |
pramukhe pANDuputrANAM dhRRiShTadyumnasya chAbhibho
shlokas.19:
te hanyamAnAH samare pA~nchAlAH sRRi~njayAstathA |
parityajya raNe drauNiM vyadravanta disho dasha
shlokas.20:
tAndRRiShTvA dravataH shUrAnpA~nchAlAnsahasomakAn |
dhRRiShTadyumno mahArAja drauNimabhyadravadyudhi
shlokas.21:
tataH kA~nchanachitrANAM sajalAmbudanAdinAm |
vRRitaH shatena shUrANAM rathAnAmanivartinAm
shlokas.22:
putraH pA~nchAlarAjasya dhRRiShTadyumno mahArathaH |
drauNimityabravIdvAkyaM dRRiShTvA yodhAnnipAtitAn
shlokas.23:
AchAryaputra durbuddhe kimanyairnihataistava |
samAgachCha mayA sArdhaM yadi shUro.asi sa.nyuge
ahaM tvAM nihaniShyAmi tiShThedAnIM mamAgrataH
shlokas.24:
tatastamAchAryasutaM dhRRiShTadyumnaH pratApavAn |
marmabhidbhiH sharaistIkShNairjaghAna bharatarShabha
shlokas.25:
te tu pa~NktIkRRitA drauNiM sharA vivishurAshugAH |
rukmapu~NkhAH prasannAgrAH sarvakAyAvadAraNAH
madhvarthina ivoddAmA bhramarAH puShpitaM drumam
shlokas.26:
so.atividdho bhRRishaM kruddhaH padAkrAnta ivoragaH |
mAnI drauNirasambhrAnto bANapANirabhAShata
shlokas.27:
dhRRiShTadyumna sthiro bhUtvA muhUrtaM pratipAlaya |
yAvattvAM nishitairbANaiH preShayAmi yamakShayam
shlokas.28:
drauNirevamathAbhAShya pArShataM paravIrahA |
ChAdayAmAsa bANaughaiH samantAllaghuhastavat
shlokas.29:
sa ChAdyamAnaH samare drauNinA yuddhadurmadaH |
drauNiM pA~nchAlatanayo vAgbhirAtarjayattadA
shlokas.30:
na jAnIShe pratij~nAM me viprotpattiM tathaiva cha |
droNaM hatvA kila mayA hantavyastvaM sudurmate
tatastvAhaM na hanmyadya droNe jIvati sa.nyuge
shlokas.31:
imAM tu rajanIM prAptAmaprabhAtAM sudurmate |
nihatya pitaraM te.adya tatastvAmapi sa.nyuge
neShyAmi mRRityulokAyetyevaM me manasi sthitam
shlokas.32:
yaste pArtheShu vidveSho yA bhaktiH kauraveShu cha |
tAM darshaya sthiro bhUtvA na me jIvanvimokShyase
shlokas.33:
yo hi brAhmaNyamutsRRijya kShatradharmarato dvijaH |
sa vadhyaH sarvalokasya yathA tvaM puruShAdhama
shlokas.34:
ityuktaH paruShaM vAkyaM pArShatena dvijottamaH |
krodhamAhArayattIvraM tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.35:
nirdahanniva chakShurbhyAM pArShataM so.abhyavaikShata |
ChAdayAmAsa cha sharairniHshvasanpannago yathA
shlokas.36:
sa ChAdyamAnaH samare drauNinA rAjasattama |
sarvapA~nchAlasenAbhiH sa.nvRRito rathasattamaH
shlokas.37:
nAkampata mahAbAhuH svadhairyaM samupAshritaH |
sAyakA.nshchaiva vividhAnashvatthAmni mumocha ha
shlokas.38:
tau punaH saMnyavartetAM prANadyUtapare raNe |
nivArayantau bANaughaiH parasparamamarShiNau
utsRRijantau maheShvAsau sharavRRiShTIH samantataH
shlokas.39:
drauNipArShatayoryuddhaM ghorarUpaM bhayAnakam |
dRRiShTvA sampUjayAmAsuH siddhachAraNavAtikAH
shlokas.40:
sharaughaiH pUrayantau tAvAkAshaM pradishastathA |
alakShyau samayudhyetAM mahatkRRitvA sharaistamaH
shlokas.41:
nRRityamAnAviva raNe maNDalIkRRitakArmukau |
parasparavadhe yattau parasparajayaiShiNau
shlokas.42:
ayudhyetAM mahAbAhU chitraM laghu cha suShThu cha |
sampUjyamAnau samare yodhamukhyaiH sahasrashaH
shlokas.43:
tau prayuddhau raNe dRRiShTvA vane vanyau gajAviva |
ubhayoH senayorharShastumulaH samapadyata
shlokas.44:
siMhanAdaravAshchAsandadhmuH sha~NkhA.nshcha mAriSha |
vAditrANyabhyavAdyanta shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.45:
tasmi.nstu tumule yuddhe bhIrUNAM bhayavardhane |
muhUrtamiva tadyuddhaM samarUpaM tadAbhavat
shlokas.46:
tato drauNirmahArAja pArShatasya mahAtmanaH |
dhvajaM dhanustathA Chatramubhau cha pArShNisArathI
sUtamashvA.nshcha chaturo nihatyAbhyadravadraNe
shlokas.47:
pA~nchAlA.nshchaiva tAnsarvAnbANaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
vyadrAvayadameyAtmA shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.48:
tataH pravivyathe senA pANDavI bharatarShabha |
dRRiShTvA drauNermahatkarma vAsavasyeva sa.nyuge
shlokas.49:
shatena cha shataM hatvA pA~nchAlAnAM mahArathaH |
tribhishcha nishitairbANairhatvA trInvai mahArathAn
shlokas.50:
drauNirdrupadaputrasya phalgunasya cha pashyataH |
nAshayAmAsa pA~nchAlAnbhUyiShThaM ye vyavasthitAH
shlokas.51:
te vadhyamAnAH pA~nchAlAH samare saha sRRi~njayaiH |
agachChandrauNimutsRRijya viprakIrNarathadhvajAH
shlokas.52:
sa jitvA samare shatrUndroNaputro mahArathaH |
nanAda sumahAnAdaM tapAnte jalado yathA
shlokas.53:
sa nihatya bahU~nshUrAnashvatthAmA vyarochata |
yugAnte sarvabhUtAni bhasma kRRitveva pAvakaH
shlokas.54:
sampUjyamAno yudhi kauraveyai;rvijitya sa~Nkhye.arigaNAnsahasrashaH |
vyarochata droNasutaH pratApavA;nyathA surendro.arigaNAnnihatya

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato yudhiShThirashchaiva bhImasenashcha pANDavaH |
droNaputraM mahArAja samantAtparyavArayan
shlokas.2:
tato duryodhano rAjA bhAradvAjena sa.nvRRitaH |
abhyayAtpANDavAnsa~Nkhye tato yuddhamavartata
ghorarUpaM mahArAja bhIrUNAM bhayavardhanam
shlokas.3:
ambaShThAnmAlavAnva~NgA~nshibI.nstraigartakAnapi |
prAhiNonmRRityulokAya gaNAnkruddho yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.4:
abhIShAhA~nshUrasenAnkShatriyAnyuddhadurmadAn |
nikRRitya pRRithivIM chakre bhImaH shoNitakardamAm
shlokas.5:
yaudheyAraTTarAjanyAnmadrakA.nshcha gaNAnyudhi |
prAhiNonmRRityulokAya kirITI nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.6:
pragADhama~njogatibhirnArAchairabhipIDitAH |
nipeturdviradA bhUmau dvishRRi~NgA iva parvatAH
shlokas.7:
nikRRittairhastihastaishcha luThamAnaistatastataH |
rarAja vasudhA kIrNA visarpadbhirivoragaiH
shlokas.8:
kShiptaiH kanakachitraishcha nRRipachChatraiH kShitirbabhau |
dyaurivAdityachandrAdyairgrahaiH kIrNA yugakShaye
shlokas.9:
hata praharatAbhItA vidhyata vyavakRRintata |
ityAsIttumulaH shabdaH shoNAshvasya rathaM prati
shlokas.10:
droNastu paramakruddho vAyavyAstreNa sa.nyuge |
vyadhamattAnyathA vAyurmeghAniva duratyayaH
shlokas.11:
te hanyamAnA droNena pA~nchAlAH prAdravanbhayAt |
pashyato bhImasenasya pArthasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.12:
tataH kirITI bhImashcha sahasA saMnyavartatAm |
mahatA rathava.nshena parigRRihya balaM tava
shlokas.13:
bIbhatsurdakShiNaM pArshvamuttaraM tu vRRikodaraH |
bhAradvAjaM sharaughAbhyAM mahadbhyAmabhyavarShatAm
shlokas.14:
tau tadA sRRi~njayAshchaiva pA~nchAlAshcha mahArathAH |
anvagachChanmahArAja matsyAshcha saha somakaiH
shlokas.15:
tathaiva tava putrasya rathodArAH prahAriNaH |
mahatyA senayA sArdhaM jagmurdroNarathaM prati
shlokas.16:
tataH sA bharatI senA vadhyamAnA kirITinA |
tamasA nidrayA chaiva punareva vyadIryata
shlokas.17:
droNena vAryamANAste svayaM tava sutena cha |
na shakyante mahArAja yodhA vArayituM tadA
shlokas.18:
sA pANDuputrasya sharairdAryamANA mahAchamUH |
tamasA sa.nvRRite loke vyadravatsarvatomukhI
shlokas.19:
utsRRijya shatasho vAhA.nstatra kechinnarAdhipAH |
prAdravanta mahArAja bhayAviShTAH samantataH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
somadattaM tu samprekShya vidhunvAnaM mahaddhanuH |
sAtyakiH prAha yantAraM somadattAya mAM vaha
shlokas.2:
na hyahatvA raNe shatruM bAhlIkaM kauravAdhamam |
nivartiShye raNAtsUta satyametadvacho mama
shlokas.3:
tataH sampreShayadyantA saindhavA.nstAnmahAjavAn |
tura~NgamA~nsha~NkhavarNAnsarvashabdAtigAnraNe
shlokas.4:
te.avahanyuyudhAnaM tu manomArutaraMhasaH |
yathendraM harayo rAjanpurA daityavadhodyatam
shlokas.5:
tamApatantaM samprekShya sAtvataM rabhasaM raNe |
somadatto mahAbAhurasambhrAnto.abhyavartata
shlokas.6:
vimu~ncha~nsharavarShANi parjanya iva vRRiShTimAn |
ChAdayAmAsa shaineyaM jalado bhAskaraM yathA
shlokas.7:
asambhrAntashcha samare sAtyakiH kurupu~Ngavam |
ChAdayAmAsa bANaughaiH samantAdbharatarShabha
shlokas.8:
somadattastu taM ShaShTyA vivyAdhorasi mAdhavam |
sAtyakishchApi taM rAjannavidhyatsAyakaiH shitaiH
shlokas.9:
tAvanyonyaM sharaiH kRRittau vyarAjetAM nararShabhau |
supuShpau puShpasamaye puShpitAviva ki.nshukau
shlokas.10:
rudhirokShitasarvA~Ngau kuruvRRiShNiyashaskarau |
parasparamavekShetAM dahantAviva lochanaiH
shlokas.11:
rathamaNDalamArgeShu charantAvarimardanau |
ghorarUpau hi tAvAstAM vRRiShTimantAvivAmbudau
shlokas.12:
sharasambhinnagAtrau tau sarvataH shakalIkRRitau |
shvAvidhAviva rAjendra vyadRRiShyetAM sharakShatau
shlokas.13:
suvarNapu~NkhairiShubhirAchitau tau vyarochatAm |
khadyotairAvRRitau rAjanprAvRRiShIva vanaspatI
shlokas.14:
sampradIpitasarvA~Ngau sAyakaistau mahArathau |
adRRishyetAM raNe kruddhAvulkAbhiriva ku~njarau
shlokas.15:
tato yudhi mahArAja somadatto mahArathaH |
ardhachandreNa chichCheda mAdhavasya mahaddhanuH
shlokas.16:
athainaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA sAyakAnAM samArpayat |
tvaramANastvarAkAle punashcha dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.17:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya sAtyakirvegavattaram |
pa~nchabhiH sAyakaistUrNaM somadattamavidhyata
shlokas.18:
tato.apareNa bhallena dhvajaM chichCheda kA~nchanam |
bAhlIkasya raNe rAjansAtyakiH prahasanniva
shlokas.19:
somadattastvasambhrAnto dRRiShTvA ketuM nipAtitam |
shaineyaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA sAyakAnAM samAchinot
shlokas.20:
sAtvato.api raNe kruddhaH somadattasya dhanvinaH |
dhanushchichCheda samare kShurapreNa shitena ha
shlokas.21:
athainaM rukmapu~NkhAnAM shatena nataparvaNAm |
AchinodbahudhA rAjanbhagnadaMShTramiva dvipam
shlokas.22:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya somadatto mahArathaH |
sAtyakiM ChAdayAmAsa sharavRRiShTyA mahAbalaH
shlokas.23:
somadattaM tu sa~Nkruddho raNe vivyAdha sAtyakiH |
sAtyakiM cheShujAlena somadatto apIDayat
shlokas.24:
dashabhiH sAtvatasyArthe bhImo.ahanbAhlikAtmajam |
somadatto.apyasambhrAntaH shaineyamavadhIchCharaiH
shlokas.25:
tatastu sAtvatasyArthe bhaimasenirnavaM dRRiDham |
mumocha parighaM ghoraM somadattasya vakShasi
shlokas.26:
tamApatantaM vegena parighaM ghoradarshanam |
dvidhA chichCheda samare prahasanniva kauravaH
shlokas.27:
sa papAta dvidhA Chinna AyasaH parigho mahAn |
mahIdharasyeva mahachChikharaM vajradAritam
shlokas.28:
tatastu sAtyakI rAjansomadattasya sa.nyuge |
dhanushchichCheda bhallena hastAvApaM cha pa~nchabhiH
shlokas.29:
chaturbhistu sharaistUrNaM chaturasturagottamAn |
samIpaM preShayAmAsa pretarAjasya bhArata
shlokas.30:
sAratheshcha shiraH kAyAdbhallena nataparvaNA |
jahAra rathashArdUlaH prahasa~nshinipu~NgavaH
shlokas.31:
tataH sharaM mahAghoraM jvalantamiva pAvakam |
mumocha sAtvato rAjansvarNapu~NkhaM shilAshitam
shlokas.32:
sa vimukto balavatA shaineyena sharottamaH |
ghorastasyorasi vibho nipapAtAshu bhArata
shlokas.33:
so.atividdho balavatA sAtvatena mahArathaH |
somadatto mahAbAhurnipapAta mamAra cha
shlokas.34:
taM dRRiShTvA nihataM tatra somadattaM mahArathAH |
mahatA sharavarSheNa yuyudhAnamupAdravan
shlokas.35:
ChAdyamAnaM sharairdRRiShTvA yuyudhAnaM yudhiShThiraH |
mahatyA senayA sArdhaM droNAnIkamupAdravat
shlokas.36:
tato yudhiShThiraH kruddhastAvakAnAM mahAbalam |
sharairvidrAvayAmAsa bhAradvAjasya pashyataH
shlokas.37:
sainyAni drAvayantaM tu droNo dRRiShTvA yudhiShThiram |
abhidudrAva vegena krodhasa.nraktalochanaH
shlokas.38:
tataH sunishitairbANaiH pArthaM vivyAdha saptabhiH |
so.atividdho mahAbAhuH sRRikkiNI parisa.nlihan
yudhiShThirasya chichCheda dhvajaM kArmukameva cha
shlokas.39:
sa ChinnadhanvA tvaritastvarAkAle nRRipottamaH |
anyadAdatta vegena kArmukaM samare dRRiDham
shlokas.40:
tataH sharasahasreNa droNaM vivyAdha pArthivaH |
sAshvasUtadhvajarathaM tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.41:
tato muhUrtaM vyathitaH sharaghAtaprapIDitaH |
niShasAda rathopasthe droNo bharatasattama
shlokas.42:
pratilabhya tataH sa~nj~nAM muhUrtAddvijasattamaH |
krodhena mahatAviShTo vAyavyAstramavAsRRijat
shlokas.43:
asambhrAntastataH pArtho dhanurAkRRiShya vIryavAn |
tadastramastreNa raNe stambhayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.44:
tato.abravIdvAsudevaH kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram |
yudhiShThira mahAbAho yattvA vakShyAmi tachChRRiNu
shlokas.45:
upAramasva yuddhAya droNAdbharatasattama |
gRRidhyate hi sadA droNo grahaNe tava sa.nyuge
shlokas.46:
nAnurUpamahaM manye yuddhamasya tvayA saha |
yo.asya sRRiShTo vinAshAya sa enaM shvo haniShyati
shlokas.47:
parivarjya guruM yAhi yatra rAjA suyodhanaH |
bhImashcha rathashArdUlo yudhyate kauravaiH saha
shlokas.48:
vAsudevavachaH shrutvA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
muhUrtaM chintayitvA tu tato dAruNamAhavam
shlokas.49:
prAyAddrutamamitraghno yatra bhImo vyavasthitaH |
vinighna.nstAvakAnyodhAnvyAditAsya ivAntakaH
shlokas.50:
rathaghoSheNa mahatA nAdayanvasudhAtalam |
parjanya iva gharmAnte nAdayanvai disho dasha
shlokas.51:
bhImasya nighnataH shatrUnpArShNiM jagrAha pANDavaH |
droNo.api pANDupA~nchAlAnvyadhamadrajanImukhe

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vartamAne tathA yuddhe ghorarUpe bhayAvahe |
tamasA sa.nvRRite loke rajasA cha mahIpate
nApashyanta raNe yodhAH parasparamavasthitAH
shlokas.2:
anumAnena sa~nj~nAbhiryuddhaM tadvavRRite mahat |
naranAgAshvamathanaM paramaM lomaharShaNam
shlokas.3:
droNakarNakRRipA vIrA bhImapArShatasAtyakAH |
anyonyaM kShobhayAmAsuH sainyAni nRRipasattama
shlokas.4:
vadhyamAnAni sainyAni samantAttairmahArathaiH |
tamasA rajasA chaiva samantAdvipradudruvuH
shlokas.5:
te sarvato vidravanto yodhA vitrastachetasaH |
ahanyanta mahArAja dhAvamAnAshcha sa.nyuge
shlokas.6:
mahArathasahasrANi jaghnuranyonyamAhave |
andhe tamasi mUDhAni putrasya tava mantrite
shlokas.7:
tataH sarvANi sainyAni senAgopAshcha bhArata |
vyamuhyanta raNe tatra tamasA sa.nvRRite sati
shlokas.8:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
teShAM sa.nloDyamAnAnAM pANDavairnihataujasAm |
andhe tamasi magnAnAmAsItkA vo matistadA
shlokas.9:
kathaM prakAshasteShAM vA mama sainyeShu vA punaH |
babhUva loke tamasA tathA sa~njaya sa.nvRRite
shlokas.10:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH sarvANi sainyAni hatashiShTAni yAni vai |
senAgoptR^InathAdishya punarvyUhamakalpayat
shlokas.11:
droNaH purastAjjaghane tu shalya;stathA drauNiH pArshvataH saubalashcha |
svayaM tu sarvANi balAni rAja;nrAjAbhyayAdgopayanvai nishAyAm
shlokas.12:
uvAcha sarvA.nshcha padAtisa~NghA;nduryodhanaH pArthiva sAntvapUrvam |
utsRRijya sarve paramAyudhAni; gRRihNIta hastairjvalitAnpradIpAn
shlokas.13:
te choditAH pArthivasattamena; tataH prahRRiShTA jagRRihuH pradIpAn |
sA bhUya eva dhvajinI vibhaktA; vyarochatAgniprabhayA nishAyAm
shlokas.14:
mahAdhanairAbharaNaishcha divyaiH; shastraiH pradIptairabhisampatadbhiH |
kShaNena sarve vihitAH pradIpA; vyadIpaya.nshcha dhvajinIM tadAshu
shlokas.15:
sarvAstu senA vyatisevyamAnAH; padAtibhiH pAvakatailahastaiH |
prakAshyamAnA dadRRishurnishAyAM; yathAntarikShe jaladAstaDidbhiH
shlokas.16:
prakAshitAyAM tu tathA dhvajinyAM; droNo.agnikalpaH pratapansamantAt |
rarAja rAjendra suvarNavarmA; madhyaM gataH sUrya ivA.nshumAlI
shlokas.17:
jAmbUnadeShvAbharaNeShu chaiva; niShkeShu shuddheShu sharAvareShu |
pIteShu shastreShu cha pAvakasya; pratiprabhAstatra tato babhUvuH
shlokas.18:
gadAshcha shaikyAH parighAshcha shubhrA; ratheShu shaktyashcha vivartamAnAH |
pratiprabhA rashmibhirAjamIDha; punaH punaH sa~njanayanti dIptAH
shlokas.19:
ChatrANi bAlavyajanAnuSha~NgA; dIptA maholkAshcha tathaiva rAjan |
vyAghUrNamAnAshcha suvarNamAlA; vyAyachChatAM tatra tadA virejuH
shlokas.20:
shastraprabhAbhishcha virAjamAnaM; dIpaprabhAbhishcha tadA balaM tat |
prakAshitaM chAbharaNaprabhAbhi;rbhRRishaM prakAshaM nRRipate babhUva
shlokas.21:
pItAni shastrANyasRRigukShitAni; vIrAvadhUtAni tanudruhANi |
dIptAM prabhAM prAjanayanta tatra; tapAtyaye vidyudivAntarikShe
shlokas.22:
prakampitAnAmabhighAtavegai;rabhighnatAM chApatatAM javena |
vaktrANyashobhanta tadA narANAM; vAyvIritAnIva mahAmbujAni
shlokas.23:
mahAvane dAva iva pradIpte; yathA prabhA bhAskarasyApi nashyet |
tathA tavAsIddhvajinI pradIptA; mahAbhaye bhArata bhImarUpA
shlokas.24:
tatsampradIptaM balamasmadIyaM; nishAmya pArthAstvaritAstathaiva |
sarveShu sainyeShu padAtisa~NghA;nachodaya.nste.atha chakruH pradIpAn
shlokas.25:
gaje gaje sapta kRRitAH pradIpA; rathe rathe chaiva dasha pradIpAH |
dvAvashvapRRiShThe paripArshvato.anye; dhvajeShu chAnye jaghaneShu chAnye
shlokas.26:
senAsu sarvAsu cha pArshvato.anye; pashchAtpurastAchcha samantatashcha |
madhye tathAnye jvalitAgnihastAH; senAdvaye.api sma narA vicheruH
shlokas.27:
sarveShu sainyeShu padAtisa~NghA; vyAmishritA hastirathAshvavRRindaiH |
madhye tathAnye jvalitAgnihastA; vyadIpayanpANDusutasya senAm
shlokas.28:
tena pradIptena tathA pradIptaM; balaM tadAsIdbalavadbalena |
bhAH kurvatA bhAnumatA graheNa; divAkareNAgnirivAbhitaptaH
shlokas.29:
tayoH prabhAH pRRithivImantarikShaM; sarvA vyatikramya dishashcha vRRiddhAH |
tena prakAshena bhRRishaM prakAshaM; babhUva teShAM tava chaiva sainyam
shlokas.30:
tena prakAshena diva~Ngamena; sambodhitA devagaNAshcha rAjan |
gandharvayakShAsurasiddhasa~NghAH; samAgamannapsarasashcha sarvAH
shlokas.31:
taddevagandharvasamAkulaM cha; yakShAsurendrApsarasAM gaNaishcha |
hataishcha vIrairdivamAruhadbhi;rAyodhanaM divyakalpaM babhUva
shlokas.32:
rathAshvanAgAkuladIpadIptaM; sa.nrabdhayodhAhatavidrutAshvam |
mahadbalaM vyUDharathAshvanAgaM; surAsuravyUhasamaM babhUva
shlokas.33:
tachChaktisa~NghAkulachaNDavAtaM; mahArathAbhraM rathavAjighoSham |
shastraughavarShaM rudhirAmbudhAraM; nishi pravRRittaM naradevayuddham
shlokas.34:
tasminmahAgnipratimo mahAtmA; santApayanpANDavAnvipramukhyaH |
gabhastibhirmadhyagato yathArko; varShAtyaye tadvadabhUnnarendra

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
prakAshite tathA loke rajasA cha tamovRRite |
samAjagmuratho vIrAH parasparavadhaiShiNaH
shlokas.2:
te sametya raNe rAja~nshastraprAsAsidhAriNaH |
parasparamudaikShanta parasparakRRitAgasaH
shlokas.3:
pradIpAnAM sahasraishcha dIpyamAnaiH samantataH |
virarAja tadA bhUmirdyaurgrahairiva bhArata
shlokas.4:
ulkAshataiH prajvalitai raNabhUmirvyarAjata |
dahyamAneva lokAnAmabhAve vai vasundharA
shlokas.5:
prAdIpyanta dishaH sarvAH pradIpaistaiH samantataH |
varShApradoShe khadyotairvRRitA vRRikShA ivAbabhuH
shlokas.6:
asajjanta tato vIrA vIreShveva pRRithakpRRithak |
nAgA nAgaiH samAjagmusturagAH saha vAjibhiH
shlokas.7:
rathA rathavaraireva samAjagmurmudAnvitAH |
tasminrAtrimukhe ghore putrasya tava shAsanAt
shlokas.8:
tato.arjuno mahArAja kauravANAmanIkinIm |
vyadhamattvarayA yuktaH kShapayansarvapArthivAn
shlokas.9:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tasminpraviShTe sa.nrabdhe mama putrasya vAhinIm |
amRRiShyamANe durdharShe kiM va AsInmanastadA
shlokas.10:
kimamanyanta sainyAni praviShTe shatrutApane |
duryodhanashcha kiM kRRityaM prAptakAlamamanyata
shlokas.11:
ke chainaM samare vIraM pratyudyayurari.ndamam |
ke.arakShandakShiNaM chakraM ke cha droNasya savyataH
shlokas.12:
ke pRRiShThato.asya hyabhavanvIrA vIrasya yudhyataH |
ke purastAdagachChanta nighnataH shAtravAnraNe
shlokas.13:
yatprAvishanmaheShvAsaH pA~nchAlAnaparAjitaH |
nRRityanniva naravyAghro rathamArgeShu vIryavAn
shlokas.14:
dadAha cha sharairdroNaH pA~nchAlAnAM rathavrajAn |
dhUmaketuriva kruddhaH sa kathaM mRRityumIyivAn
shlokas.15:
avyagrAneva hi parAnkathayasyaparAjitAn |
hatA.nshchaiva viShaNNA.nshcha viprakIrNA.nshcha sha.nsasi
rathino virathA.nshchaiva kRRitAnyuddheShu mAmakAn
shlokas.16:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
droNasya matamAj~nAya yoddhukAmasya tAM nishAm |
duryodhano mahArAja vashyAnbhrAtR^InabhAShata
shlokas.17:
vikarNaM chitrasenaM cha mahAbAhuM cha kauravam |
durdharShaM dIrghabAhuM cha ye cha teShAM padAnugAH
shlokas.18:
droNaM yattAH parAkrAntAH sarve rakShata pRRiShThataH |
hArdikyo dakShiNaM chakraM shalyashchaivottaraM tathA
shlokas.19:
trigartAnAM cha ye shUrA hatashiShTA mahArathAH |
tA.nshchaiva sarvAnputraste samachodayadagrataH
shlokas.20:
AchAryo hi susa.nyatto bhRRishaM yattAshcha pANDavAH |
taM rakShata susa.nyattA nighnantaM shAtravAnraNe
shlokas.21:
droNo hi balavAnyuddhe kShiprahastaH parAkramI |
nirjayettridashAnyuddhe kimu pArthAnsasomakAn
shlokas.22:
te yUyaM sahitAH sarve bhRRishaM yattA mahArathAH |
droNaM rakShata pA~nchAlyAddhRRiShTadyumnAnmahArathAt
shlokas.23:
pANDaveyeShu sainyeShu yodhaM pashyAmyahaM na tam |
yo jayeta raNe droNaM dhRRiShTadyumnAdRRite nRRipAH
shlokas.24:
tasya sarvAtmanA manye bhAradvAjasya rakShaNam |
sa guptaH somakAnhanyAtsRRi~njayA.nshcha sarAjakAn
shlokas.25:
sRRi~njayeShvatha sarveShu nihateShu chamUmukhe |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM raNe drauNirnAshayiShyatyasa.nshayam
shlokas.26:
tathArjunaM raNe karNo vijeShyati mahArathaH |
bhImasenamahaM chApi yuddhe jeShyAmi da.nshitaH
shlokas.27:
so.ayaM mama jayo vyaktaM dIrghakAlaM bhaviShyati |
tasmAdrakShata sa~NgrAme droNameva mahArathAH
shlokas.28:
ityuktvA bharatashreShTha putro duryodhanastava |
vyAdidesha tataH sainyaM tasmi.nstamasi dAruNe
shlokas.29:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM rAtrau tadbharatarShabha |
ubhayoH senayorghoraM vijayaM prati kA~NkShiNoH
shlokas.30:
arjunaH kauravaM sainyamarjunaM chApi kauravAH |
nAnAshastrasamAvApairanyonyaM paryapIDayan
shlokas.31:
drauNiH pA~nchAlarAjAnaM bhAradvAjashcha sRRi~njayAn |
ChAdayAmAsatuH sa~Nkhye sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.32:
pANDupA~nchAlasenAnAM kauravANAM cha mAriSha |
AsInniShTAnako ghoro nighnatAmitaretaram
shlokas.33:
naivAsmAbhirna pUrvairno dRRiShTaM pUrvaM tathAvidham |
yuddhaM yAdRRishamevAsIttAM rAtriM sumahAbhayam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vartamAne tathA raudre rAtriyuddhe vishAM pate |
sarvabhUtakShayakare dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.2:
abravItpANDavA.nshchaiva pA~nchAlA.nshcha sasomakAn |
abhyadravata gachChadhvaM droNameva jighA.nsayA
shlokas.3:
rAj~naste vachanAdrAjanpA~nchAlAH somakAstathA |
droNamevAbhyavartanta nadanto bhairavAnravAn
shlokas.4:
tAnvayaM pratigarjantaH pratyudyAtAstvamarShitAH |
yathAshakti yathotsAhaM yathAsattvaM cha sa.nyuge
shlokas.5:
kRRitavarmA cha hArdikyo yudhiShThiramupAdravat |
droNaM prati jighA.nsantaM matto mattamiva dvipam
shlokas.6:
shaineyaM sharavarShANi vikirantaM samantataH |
abhyayAtkauravo rAjanbhUriH sa~NgrAmamUrdhani
shlokas.7:
sahadevamathAyAntaM droNaprepsuM mahAratham |
karNo vaikartano rAjanvArayAmAsa pANDavam
shlokas.8:
bhImasenamathAyAntaM vyAditAsyamivAntakam |
svayaM duryodhano yuddhe pratIpaM mRRityumAvrajat
shlokas.9:
nakulaM cha yudhAM shreShThaM sarvayuddhavishAradam |
shakuniH saubalo rAjanvArayAmAsa satvaraH
shlokas.10:
shikhaNDinamathAyAntaM rathena rathinAM varam |
kRRipo shAradvato rAjanvArayAmAsa sa.nyuge
shlokas.11:
prativindhyamathAyAntaM mayUrasadRRishairhayaiH |
duHshAsano mahArAja yatto yattamavArayat
shlokas.12:
bhaimasenimathAyAntaM mAyAshatavishAradam |
ashvatthAmA piturmAnaM kurvANaH pratyaShedhayat
shlokas.13:
drupadaM vRRiShasenastu sasainyaM sapadAnugam |
vArayAmAsa samare droNaprepsuM mahAratham
shlokas.14:
virATaM drutamAyAntaM droNasya nidhanaM prati |
madrarAjaH susa~Nkruddho vArayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.15:
shatAnIkamathAyAntaM nAkuliM rabhasaM raNe |
chitraseno rurodhAshu sharairdroNavadhepsayA
shlokas.16:
arjunaM cha yudhAM shreShThaM prAdravantaM mahAratham |
alambuso mahArAja rAkShasendro nyavArayat
shlokas.17:
tathA droNaM maheShvAsaM nighnantaM shAtravAnraNe |
dhRRiShTadyumno.atha pA~nchAlyo hRRiShTarUpamavArayat
shlokas.18:
tathAnyAnpANDuputrANAM samAyAtAnmahArathAn |
tAvakA rathino rAjanvArayAmAsurojasA
shlokas.19:
gajArohA gajaistUrNaM saMnipatya mahAmRRidhe |
yodhayantaH sma dRRishyante shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.20:
nishIthe turagA rAjannAdravantaH parasparam |
samadRRishyanta vegena pakShavanta ivAdrayaH
shlokas.21:
sAdinaH sAdibhiH sArdhaM prAsashaktyRRiShTipANayaH |
samAgachChanmahArAja vinadantaH pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.22:
narAstu bahavastatra samAjagmuH parasparam |
gadAbhirmusalaishchaiva nAnAshastraishcha sa~NghashaH
shlokas.23:
kRRitavarmA tu hArdikyo dharmaputraM yudhiShThiram |
vArayAmAsa sa~Nkruddho velevodvRRittamarNavam
shlokas.24:
yudhiShThirastu hArdikyaM viddhvA pa~nchabhirAshugaiH |
punarvivyAdha vi.nshatyA tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.25:
kRRitavarmA tu sa~Nkruddho dharmaputrasya mAriSha |
dhanushchichCheda bhallena taM cha vivyAdha saptabhiH
shlokas.26:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
hArdikyaM dashabhirbANairbAhvorurasi chArpayat
shlokas.27:
mAdhavastu raNe viddho dharmaputreNa mAriSha |
prAkampata cha roSheNa saptabhishchArdayachCharaiH
shlokas.28:
tasya pArtho dhanushChittvA hastAvApaM nikRRitya cha |
prAhiNonnishitAnbANAnpa~ncha rAja~nshilAshitAn
shlokas.29:
te tasya kavachaM bhittvA hemachitraM mahAdhanam |
prAvishandharaNImugrA valmIkamiva pannagAH
shlokas.30:
akShNornimeShamAtreNa so.anyadAdAya kArmukam |
vivyAdha pANDavaM ShaShTyA sUtaM cha navabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.31:
tasya shaktimameyAtmA pANDavo bhujagopamAm |
chikShepa bharatashreShTha rathe nyasya mahaddhanuH
shlokas.32:
sA hemachitrA mahatI pANDavena praveritA |
nirbhidya dakShiNaM bAhuM prAvishaddharaNItalam
shlokas.33:
etasminneva kAle tu gRRihya pArthaH punardhanuH |
hArdikyaM ChAdayAmAsa sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.34:
tatastu samare shUro vRRiShNInAM pravaro rathI |
vyashvasUtarathaM chakre nimeShArdhAdyudhiShThiram
shlokas.35:
tatastu pANDavo jyeShThaH khaDgacharma samAdade |
tadasya nishitairbANairvyadhamanmAdhavo raNe
shlokas.36:
tomaraM tu tato gRRihya svarNadaNDaM durAsadam |
preShayatsamare tUrNaM hArdikyasya yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.37:
tamApatantaM sahasA dharmarAjabhujachyutam |
dvidhA chichCheda hArdikyaH kRRitahastaH smayanniva
shlokas.38:
tataH sharashatenAjau dharmaputramavAkirat |
kavachaM chAsya sa~NkruddhaH sharaistIkShNairadArayat
shlokas.39:
hArdikyasharasa~nChinnaM kavachaM tanmahAtmanaH |
vyashIryata raNe rAja.nstArAjAlamivAmbarAt
shlokas.40:
sa ChinnadhanvA virathaH shIrNavarmA sharArditaH |
apAyAsIdraNAttUrNaM dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.41:
kRRitavarmA tu nirjitya dharmaputraM yudhiShThiram |
punardroNasya jugupe chakrameva mahAbalaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
bhUristu samare rAja~nshaineyaM rathinAM varam |
ApatantamapAsedhatprapAnAdiva ku~njaram
shlokas.2:
athainaM sAtyakiH kruddhaH pa~nchabhirnishitaiH sharaiH |
vivyAdha hRRidaye tUrNaM prAsravattasya shoNitam
shlokas.3:
tathaiva kauravo yuddhe shaineyaM yuddhadurmadam |
dashabhirvishikhaistIkShNairavidhyata bhujAntare
shlokas.4:
tAvanyonyaM mahArAja tatakShAte sharairbhRRisham |
krodhasa.nraktanayanau krodhAdvisphArya kArmuke
shlokas.5:
tayorAsInmahArAja shastravRRiShTiH sudAruNA |
kruddhayoH sAyakamuchoryamAntakanikAshayoH
shlokas.6:
tAvanyonyaM sharai rAjanprachChAdya samare sthitau |
muhUrtaM chaiva tadyuddhaM samarUpamivAbhavat
shlokas.7:
tataH kruddho mahArAja shaineyaH prahasanniva |
dhanushchichCheda samare kauravyasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.8:
athainaM ChinnadhanvAnaM navabhirnishitaiH sharaiH |
vivyAdha hRRidaye tUrNaM tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.9:
so.atividdho balavatA shatruNA shatrutApanaH |
dhanuranyatsamAdAya sAtvataM pratyavidhyata
shlokas.10:
sa viddhvA sAtvataM bANaistribhireva vishAM pate |
dhanushchichCheda bhallena sutIkShNena hasanniva
shlokas.11:
ChinnadhanvA mahArAja sAtyakiH krodhamUrChitaH |
prajahAra mahAvegAM shaktiM tasya mahorasi
shlokas.12:
sa tu shaktyA vibhinnA~Ngo nipapAta rathottamAt |
lohitA~Nga ivAkAshAddIptarashmiryadRRichChayA
shlokas.13:
taM tu dRRiShTvA hataM shUramashvatthAmA mahArathaH |
abhyadhAvata vegena shaineyaM prati sa.nyuge
abhyavarShachCharaugheNa meruM vRRiShTyA yathAmbudaH
shlokas.14:
tamApatantaM sa.nrabdhaM shaineyasya rathaM prati |
ghaTotkacho.abravIdrAjannAdaM muktvA mahArathaH
shlokas.15:
tiShTha tiShTha na me jIvandroNaputra gamiShyasi |
eSha tvAdya haniShyAmi mahiShaM skandarADiva
yuddhashraddhAmahaM te.adya vineShyAmi raNAjire
shlokas.16:
ityuktvA roShatAmrAkSho rAkShasaH paravIrahA |
drauNimabhyadravatkruddho gajendramiva kesarI
shlokas.17:
rathAkShamAtrairiShubhirabhyavarShadghaTotkachaH |
rathinAmRRiShabhaM drauNiM dhArAbhiriva toyadaH
shlokas.18:
sharavRRiShTiM tu tAM prAptAM sharairAshIviShopamaiH |
shAtayAmAsa samare tarasA drauNirutsmayan
shlokas.19:
tataH sharashataistIkShNairmarmabhedibhirAshugaiH |
samAchinodrAkShasendraM ghaTotkachamari.ndama
shlokas.20:
sa sharairAchitastena rAkShaso raNamUrdhani |
vyakAshata mahArAja shvAvichChalalito yathA
shlokas.21:
tataH krodhasamAviShTo bhaimaseniH pratApavAn |
sharairavachakartograirdrauNiM vajrAshanisvanaiH
shlokas.22:
kShuraprairardhachandraishcha nArAchaiH sashilImukhaiH |
varAhakarNairnAlIkaistIkShNaishchApi vikarNibhiH
shlokas.23:
tAM shastravRRiShTimatulAM vajrAshanisamasvanAm |
patantImupari kruddho drauNiravyathitendriyaH
shlokas.24:
suduHsahAM sharairghorairdivyAstrapratimantritaiH |
vyadhamatsa mahAtejA mahAbhrANIva mArutaH
shlokas.25:
tato.antarikShe bANAnAM sa~NgrAmo.anya ivAbhavat |
ghorarUpo mahArAja yodhAnAM harShavardhanaH
shlokas.26:
tato.astrasa~NgharShakRRitairvisphuli~NgaiH samantataH |
babhau nishAmukhe vyoma khadyotairiva sa.nvRRitam
shlokas.27:
sa mArgaNagaNairdrauNirdishaH prachChAdya sarvataH |
priyArthaM tava putrANAM rAkShasaM samavAkirat
shlokas.28:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM drauNirAkShasayormRRidhe |
vigADhe rajanImadhye shakraprahrAdayoriva
shlokas.29:
tato ghaTotkacho bANairdashabhirdrauNimAhave |
jaghAnorasi sa~NkruddhaH kAlajvalanasaMnibhaiH
shlokas.30:
sa tairabhyAyatairviddho rAkShasena mahAbalaH |
chachAla samare drauNirvAtanunna iva drumaH
sa mohamanusamprApto dhvajayaShTiM samAshritaH
shlokas.31:
tato hAhAkRRitaM sainyaM tava sarvaM janAdhipa |
hataM sma menire sarve tAvakAstaM vishAM pate
shlokas.32:
taM tu dRRiShTvA tathAvasthamashvatthAmAnamAhave |
pA~nchAlAH sRRi~njayAshchaiva siMhanAdaM prachakrire
shlokas.33:
pratilabhya tataH sa~nj~nAmashvatthAmA mahAbalaH |
dhanuH prapIDya vAmena kareNAmitrakarshanaH
shlokas.34:
mumochAkarNapUrNena dhanuShA sharamuttamam |
yamadaNDopamaM ghoramuddishyAshu ghaTotkacham
shlokas.35:
sa bhittvA hRRidayaM tasya rAkShasasya sharottamaH |
vivesha vasudhAmugraH supu~NkhaH pRRithivIpate
shlokas.36:
so.atividdho mahArAja rathopastha upAvishat |
rAkShasendraH subalavAndrauNinA raNamAninA
shlokas.37:
dRRiShTvA vimUDhaM haiDimbaM sArathistaM raNAjirAt |
drauNeH sakAshAtsambhrAntastvapaninye tvarAnvitaH
shlokas.38:
tathA tu samare viddhvA rAkShasendraM ghaTotkacham |
nanAda sumahAnAdaM droNaputro mahAbalaH
shlokas.39:
pUjitastava putraishcha sarvayodhaishcha bhArata |
vapuShA pratijajvAla madhyAhna iva bhAskaraH
shlokas.40:
bhImasenaM tu yudhyantaM bhAradvAjarathaM prati |
svayaM duryodhano rAjA pratyavidhyachChitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.41:
taM bhImaseno navabhiH sharairvivyAdha mAriSha |
duryodhano.api vi.nshatyA sharANAM pratyavidhyata
shlokas.42:
tau sAyakairavachChannAvadRRishyetAM raNAjire |
meghajAlasamAchChannau nabhasIvendubhAskarau
shlokas.43:
atha duryodhano rAjA bhImaM vivyAdha patribhiH |
pa~nchabhirbharatashreShTha tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.44:
tasya bhImo dhanushChittvA dhvajaM cha navabhiH sharaiH |
vivyAdha kauravashreShThaM navatyA nataparvaNAm
shlokas.45:
tato duryodhanaH kruddho bhImasenasya mAriSha |
chikShepa sa sharAnrAjanpashyatAM sarvadhanvinAm
shlokas.46:
tAnnihatya sharAnbhImo duryodhanadhanushchyutAn |
kauravaM pa~nchavi.nshatyA kShudrakANAM samArpayat
shlokas.47:
duryodhanastu sa~Nkruddho bhImasenasya mAriSha |
kShurapreNa dhanushChittvA dashabhiH pratyavidhyata
shlokas.48:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
vivyAdha nRRipatiM tUrNaM saptabhirnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.49:
tadapyasya dhanuH kShipraM chichCheda laghuhastavat |
dvitIyaM cha tRRitIyaM cha chaturthaM pa~nchamaM tathA
shlokas.50:
AttamAttaM mahArAja bhImasya dhanurAchChinat |
tava putro mahArAja jitakAshI madotkaTaH
shlokas.51:
sa tadA ChidyamAneShu kArmukeShu punaH punaH |
shaktiM chikShepa samare sarvapArashavIM shubhAm
shlokas.52:
aprAptAmeva tAM shaktiM tridhA chichCheda kauravaH |
pashyataH sarvalokasya bhImasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.53:
tato bhImo mahArAja gadAM gurvIM mahAprabhAm |
chikShepAvidhya vegena duryodhanarathaM prati
shlokas.54:
tataH sA sahasA vAhA.nstava putrasya sa.nyuge |
sArathiM cha gadA gurvI mamarda bharatarShabha
shlokas.55:
putrastu tava rAjendra rathAddhemapariShkRRitAt |
AplutaH sahasA yAnaM nandakasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.56:
tato bhImo hataM matvA tava putraM mahAratham |
siMhanAdaM mahachchakre tarjayanniva kauravAn
shlokas.57:
tAvakAH sainikAshchApi menire nihataM nRRipam |
tato vichukrushuH sarve hA heti cha samantataH
shlokas.58:
teShAM tu ninadaM shrutvA trastAnAM sarvayodhinAm |
bhImasenasya nAdaM cha shrutvA rAjanmahAtmanaH
shlokas.59:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA hataM matvA suyodhanam |
abhyavartata vegena yatra pArtho vRRikodaraH
shlokas.60:
pA~nchAlAH kekayA matsyAH sRRi~njayAshcha vishAM pate |
sarvodyogenAbhijagmurdroNameva yuyutsayA
shlokas.61:
tatrAsItsumahadyuddhaM droNasyAtha paraiH saha |
ghore tamasi magnAnAM nighnatAmitaretaram

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sahadevamathAyAntaM droNaprepsuM vishAM pate |
karNo vaikartano yuddhe vArayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.2:
sahadevastu rAdheyaM viddhvA navabhirAshugaiH |
punarvivyAdha dashabhirnishitairnataparvabhiH
shlokas.3:
taM karNaH prativivyAdha shatena nataparvaNAm |
sajyaM chAsya dhanuH shIghraM chichCheda laghuhastavat
shlokas.4:
tato.anyaddhanurAdAya mAdrIputraH pratApavAn |
karNaM vivyAdha vi.nshatyA tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.5:
tasya karNo hayAnhatvA sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
sArathiM chAsya bhallena drutaM ninye yamakShayam
shlokas.6:
virathaH sahadevastu khaDgaM charma samAdade |
tadapyasya sharaiH karNo vyadhamatprahasanniva
shlokas.7:
tato gurvIM mahAghorAM hemachitrAM mahAgadAm |
preShayAmAsa samare vaikartanarathaM prati
shlokas.8:
tAmApatantIM sahasA sahadevapraveritAm |
vyaShTambhayachCharaiH karNo bhUmau chainAmapAtayat
shlokas.9:
gadAM vinihatAM dRRiShTvA sahadevastvarAnvitaH |
shaktiM chikShepa karNAya tAmapyasyAchChinachCharaiH
shlokas.10:
sasambhramastatastUrNamavaplutya rathottamAt |
sahadevo mahArAja dRRiShTvA karNaM vyavasthitam
rathachakraM tato gRRihya mumochAdhirathiM prati
shlokas.11:
tamApatantaM sahasA kAlachakramivodyatam |
sharairanekasAhasrairachChinatsUtanandanaH
shlokas.12:
tasmi.nstu vitathe chakre kRRite tena mahAtmanA |
vAryamANashcha vishikhaiH sahadevo raNaM jahau
shlokas.13:
tamabhidrutya rAdheyo muhUrtAdbharatarShabha |
abravItprahasanvAkyaM sahadevaM vishAM pate
shlokas.14:
mA yudhyasva raNe vIra vishiShTai rathibhiH saha |
sadRRishairyudhya mAdreya vacho me mA visha~NkithAH
shlokas.15:
athainaM dhanuSho.agreNa tudanbhUyo.abravIdvachaH |
eSho.arjuno raNe yatto yudhyate kurubhiH saha
tatra gachChasva mAdreya gRRihaM vA yadi manyase
shlokas.16:
evamuktvA tu taM karNo rathena rathinAM varaH |
prAyAtpA~nchAlapANDUnAM sainyAni prahasanniva
shlokas.17:
vadhaprAptaM tu mAdreyaM nAvadhItsamare.arihA |
kuntyAH smRRitvA vacho rAjansatyasandho mahArathaH
shlokas.18:
sahadevastato rAjanvimanAH sharapIDitaH |
karNavAkShalyataptashcha jIvitAnniravidyata
shlokas.19:
Aruroha rathaM chApi pA~nchAlyasya mahAtmanaH |
janamejayasya samare tvarAyukto mahArathaH
shlokas.20:
virATaM sahasenaM tu droNArthe drutamAgatam |
madrarAjaH sharaugheNa ChAdayAmAsa dhanvinam
shlokas.21:
tayoH samabhavadyuddhaM samare dRRiDhadhanvinoH |
yAdRRishaM hyabhavadrAja~njambhavAsavayoH purA
shlokas.22:
madrarAjo mahArAja virATaM vAhinIpatim |
Ajaghne tvaritaM tIkShNaiH shatena nataparvaNAm
shlokas.23:
prativivyAdha taM rAjA navabhirnishitaiH sharaiH |
punashchaiva trisaptatyA bhUyashchaiva shatena ha
shlokas.24:
tasya madrAdhipo hatvA chaturo rathavAjinaH |
sUtaM dhvajaM cha samare rathopasthAdapAtayat
shlokas.25:
hatAshvAttu rathAttUrNamavaplutya mahArathaH |
tasthau visphAraya.nshchApaM vimu~ncha.nshcha shitA~nsharAn
shlokas.26:
shatAnIkastato dRRiShTvA bhrAtaraM hatavAhanam |
rathenAbhyapatattUrNaM sarvalokasya pashyataH
shlokas.27:
shatAnIkamathAyAntaM madrarAjo mahAmRRidhe |
vishikhairbahubhirviddhvA tato ninye yamakShayam
shlokas.28:
tasmi.nstu nihate vIre virATo rathasattamaH |
Aruroha rathaM tUrNaM tameva dhvajamAlinam
shlokas.29:
tato visphArya nayane krodhAddviguNavikramaH |
madrarAjarathaM tUrNaM ChAdayAmAsa patribhiH
shlokas.30:
tato madrAdhipaH kruddhaH shatena nataparvaNAm |
AjaghAnorasi dRRiDhaM virATaM vAhinIpatim
shlokas.31:
so.atividdho mahArAja rathopastha upAvishat |
kashmalaM chAvishattIvraM virATo bharatarShabha
sArathistamapovAha samare sharavikShatam
shlokas.32:
tataH sA mahatI senA prAdravannishi bhArata |
vadhyamAnA sharashataiH shalyenAhavashobhinA
shlokas.33:
tAM dRRiShTvA vidrutAM senAM vAsudevadhana~njayau |
prAyAtAM tatra rAjendra yatra shalyo vyavasthitaH
shlokas.34:
tau tu pratyudyayau rAjanrAkShasendro hyalambusaH |
aShTachakrasamAyuktamAsthAya pravaraM ratham
shlokas.35:
tura~NgamamukhairyuktaM pishAchairghoradarshanaiH |
lohitArdrapatAkaM taM raktamAlyavibhUShitam
kArShNAyasamayaM ghoramRRikShacharmAvRRitaM mahat
shlokas.36:
raudreNa chitrapakSheNa vivRRitAkSheNa kUjatA |
dhvajenochChritatuNDena gRRidhrarAjena rAjatA
shlokas.37:
sa babhau rAkShaso rAjanbhinnA~njanachayopamaH |
rurodhArjunamAyAntaM prabha~njanamivAdrirAT
kiranbANagaNAnrAja~nshatasho.arjunamUrdhani
shlokas.38:
atitIvramabhUdyuddhaM nararAkShasayormRRidhe |
draShTR^INAM prItijananaM sarveShAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.39:
tamarjunaH shatenaiva patriNAmabhyatADayat |
navabhishcha shitairbANaishchichCheda dhvajamuchChritam
shlokas.40:
sArathiM cha tribhirbANaistribhireva triveNukam |
dhanurekena chichCheda chaturbhishchaturo hayAn
virathasyodyataM khaDgaM shareNAsya dvidhAchChinat
shlokas.41:
athainaM nishitairbANaishchaturbhirbharatarShabha |
pArtho.ardayadrAkShasendraM sa viddhaH prAdravadbhayAt
shlokas.42:
taM vijityArjunastUrNaM droNAntikamupAyayau |
kira~nsharagaNAnrAjannaravAraNavAjiShu
shlokas.43:
vadhyamAnA mahArAja pANDavena yashasvinA |
sainikA nyapatannurvyAM vAtanunnA iva drumAH
shlokas.44:
teShu tUtsAdyamAneShu phalgunena mahAtmanA |
samprAdravadbalaM sarvaM putrANAM te vishAM pate

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shatAnIkaM sharaistUrNaM nirdahantaM chamUM tava |
chitrasenastava suto vArayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.2:
nAkulishchitrasenaM tu nArAchenArdayadbhRRisham |
sa cha taM prativivyAdha dashabhirnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.3:
chitraseno mahArAja shatAnIkaM punaryudhi |
navabhirnishitairbANairAjaghAna stanAntare
shlokas.4:
nAkulistasya vishikhairvarma saMnataparvabhiH |
gAtrAtsa~nchyAvayAmAsa tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.5:
so.apetavarmA putraste virarAja bhRRishaM nRRipa |
utsRRijya kAle rAjendra nirmokamiva pannagaH
shlokas.6:
tato.asya nishitairbANairdhvajaM chichCheda nAkuliH |
dhanushchaiva mahArAja yatamAnasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.7:
sa ChinnadhanvA samare vivarmA cha mahArathaH |
dhanuranyanmahArAja jagrAhArividAraNam
shlokas.8:
tatastUrNaM chitraseno nAkuliM navabhiH sharaiH |
vivyAdha samare kruddho bharatAnAM mahArathaH
shlokas.9:
shatAnIko.atha sa~Nkruddhashchitrasenasya mAriSha |
jaghAna chaturo vAhAnsArathiM cha narottamaH
shlokas.10:
avaplutya rathAttasmAchchitraseno mahArathaH |
nAkuliM pa~nchavi.nshatyA sharANAmArdayadbalI
shlokas.11:
tasya tatkurvataH karma nakulasya suto raNe |
ardhachandreNa chichCheda chApaM ratnavibhUShitam
shlokas.12:
sa ChinnadhanvA viratho hatAshvo hatasArathiH |
Aruroha rathaM tUrNaM hArdikyasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.13:
drupadaM tu sahAnIkaM droNaprepsuM mahAratham |
vRRiShaseno.abhyayAttUrNaM kira~nsharashataistadA
shlokas.14:
yaj~nasenastu samare karNaputraM mahAratham |
ShaShTyA sharANAM vivyAdha bAhvorurasi chAnagha
shlokas.15:
vRRiShasenastu sa~Nkruddho yaj~nasenaM rathe sthitam |
bahubhiH sAyakaistIkShNairAjaghAna stanAntare
shlokas.16:
tAvubhau sharanunnA~Ngau sharakaNTakinau raNe |
vyabhrAjetAM mahArAja shvAvidhau shalalairiva
shlokas.17:
rukmapu~NkhairajihmAgraiH sharaishChinnatanuchChadau |
rudhiraughapariklinnau vyabhrAjetAM mahAmRRidhe
shlokas.18:
tapanIyanibhau chitrau kalpavRRikShAvivAdbhutau |
ki.nshukAviva chotphullau vyakAshetAM raNAjire
shlokas.19:
vRRiShasenastato rAjannavabhirdrupadaM sharaiH |
viddhvA vivyAdha saptatyA punashchAnyaistribhiH sharaiH
shlokas.20:
tataH sharasahasrANi vimu~nchanvibabhau tadA |
karNaputro mahArAja varShamANa ivAmbudaH
shlokas.21:
tatastu drupadAnIkaM sharaishChinnatanuchChadam |
samprAdravadraNe rAjannishIthe bhairave sati
shlokas.22:
pradIpairhi parityaktairjvaladbhistaiH samantataH |
vyarAjata mahI rAjanvItAbhrA dyauriva grahaiH
shlokas.23:
tathA~NgadairnipatitairvyarAjata vasundharA |
prAvRRiTkAle mahArAja vidyudbhiriva toyadaH
shlokas.24:
tataH karNasutatrastAH somakA vipradudruvuH |
yathendrabhayavitrastA dAnavAstArakAmaye
shlokas.25:
tenArdyamAnAH samare dravamANAshcha somakAH |
vyarAjanta mahArAja pradIpairavabhAsitAH
shlokas.26:
tA.nstu nirjitya samare karNaputro vyarochata |
madhya.ndinamanuprApto gharmA.nshuriva bhArata
shlokas.27:
teShu rAjasahasreShu tAvakeShu pareShu cha |
eka eva jvala.nstasthau vRRiShasenaH pratApavAn
shlokas.28:
sa vijitya raNe shUrAnsomakAnAM mahArathAn |
jagAma tvaritastatra yatra rAjA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.29:
prativindhyamatha kruddhaM pradahantaM raNe ripUn |
duHshAsanastava sutaH pratyudgachChanmahArathaH
shlokas.30:
tayoH samAgamo rAja.nshchitrarUpo babhUva ha |
vyapetajalade vyomni budhabhArgavayoriva
shlokas.31:
prativindhyaM tu samare kurvANaM karma duShkaram |
duHshAsanastribhirbANairlalATe samavidhyata
shlokas.32:
so.atividdho balavatA putreNa tava dhanvinA |
virarAja mahAbAhuH sashRRi~Nga iva parvataH
shlokas.33:
duHshAsanaM tu samare prativindhyo mahArathaH |
navabhiH sAyakairviddhvA punarvivyAdha saptabhiH
shlokas.34:
tatra bhArata putraste kRRitavAnkarma duShkaram |
prativindhyahayAnugraiH pAtayAmAsa yachCharaiH
shlokas.35:
sArathiM chAsya bhallena dhvajaM cha samapAtayat |
rathaM cha shatasho rAjanvyadhamattasya dhanvinaH
shlokas.36:
patAkAshcha sa tUNIrAnrashmInyoktrANi chAbhibho |
chichCheda tilashaH kruddhaH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.37:
virathaH sa tu dharmAtmA dhanuShpANiravasthitaH |
ayodhayattava sutaM kira~nsharashatAnbahUn
shlokas.38:
kShurapreNa dhanustasya chichCheda kRRitahastavat |
athainaM dashabhirbhallaishChinnadhanvAnamArdayat
shlokas.39:
taM dRRiShTvA virathaM tatra bhrAtaro.asya mahArathAH |
anvavartanta vegena mahatyA senayA saha
shlokas.40:
AplutaH sa tato yAnaM sutasomasya bhAsvaram |
dhanurgRRihya mahArAja vivyAdha tanayaM tava
shlokas.41:
tatastu tAvakAH sarve parivArya sutaM tava |
abhyavartanta sa~NgrAme mahatyA senayA vRRitAH
shlokas.42:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM tava teShAM cha bhArata |
nishIthe dAruNe kAle yamarAShTravivardhanam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
nakulaM rabhasaM yuddhe nighnantaM vAhinIM tava |
abhyayAtsaubalaH kruddhastiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.2:
kRRitavairau tu tau vIrAvanyonyavadhakA~NkShiNau |
sharaiH pUrNAyatotsRRiShTairanyonyamabhijaghnatuH
shlokas.3:
yathaiva saubalaH kShipraM sharavarShANi mu~nchati |
tathaiva nakulo rAja~nshikShAM sa.ndarshayanyudhi
shlokas.4:
tAvubhau samare shUrau sharakaNTakinau tadA |
vyarAjetAM mahArAja kaNTakairiva shAlmalI
shlokas.5:
sujihmaM prekShamANau cha rAjanvivRRitalochanau |
krodhasa.nraktanayanau nirdahantau parasparam
shlokas.6:
syAlastu tava sa~Nkruddho mAdrIputraM hasanniva |
karNinaikena vivyAdha hRRidaye nishitena ha
shlokas.7:
nakulastu bhRRishaM viddhaH syAlena tava dhanvinA |
niShasAda rathopasthe kashmalaM chainamAvishat
shlokas.8:
atyantavairiNaM dRRiptaM dRRiShTvA shatruM tathAgatam |
nanAda shakunI rAja.nstapAnte jalado yathA
shlokas.9:
pratilabhya tataH sa~nj~nAM nakulaH pANDunandanaH |
abhyayAtsaubalaM bhUyo vyAttAnana ivAntakaH
shlokas.10:
sa~NkruddhaH shakuniM ShaShTyA vivyAdha bharatarShabha |
punashchaiva shatenaiva nArAchAnAM stanAntare
shlokas.11:
tato.asya sasharaM chApaM muShTideshe sa chichChide |
dhvajaM cha tvaritaM ChittvA rathAdbhUmAvapAtayat
shlokas.12:
so.atividdho mahArAja rathopastha upAvishat |
taM visa~nj~naM nipatitaM dRRiShTvA syAlaM tavAnagha
apovAha rathenAshu sArathirdhvajinImukhAt
shlokas.13:
tataH sa~nchukrushuH pArthA ye cha teShAM padAnugAH |
nirjitya cha raNe shatrUnnakulaH shatrutApanaH
abravItsArathiM kruddho droNAnIkAya mAM vaha
shlokas.14:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA mAdrIputrasya dhImataH |
prAyAttena raNe rAjanyena droNo.anvayudhyata
shlokas.15:
shikhaNDinaM tu samare droNaprepsuM vishAM pate |
kRRipaH shAradvato yattaH pratyudgachChatsuvegitaH
shlokas.16:
gautamaM drutamAyAntaM droNAntikamari.ndamam |
vivyAdha navabhirbhallaiH shikhaNDI prahasanniva
shlokas.17:
tamAchAryo mahArAja viddhvA pa~nchabhirAshugaiH |
punarvivyAdha vi.nshatyA putrANAM priyakRRittava
shlokas.18:
mahadyuddhaM tayorAsIdghorarUpaM vishAM pate |
yathA devAsure yuddhe shambarAmararAjayoH
shlokas.19:
sharajAlAvRRitaM vyoma chakratustau mahArathau |
prakRRityA ghorarUpaM tadAsIdghorataraM punaH
shlokas.20:
rAtrishcha bharatashreShTha yodhAnAM yuddhashAlinAm |
kAlarAtrinibhA hyAsIdghorarUpA bhayAvahA
shlokas.21:
shikhaNDI tu mahArAja gautamasya mahaddhanuH |
ardhachandreNa chichCheda sajyaM savishikhaM tadA
shlokas.22:
tasya kruddhaH kRRipo rAja~nshaktiM chikShepa dAruNAm |
svarNadaNDAmakuNThAgrAM karmAraparimArjitAm
shlokas.23:
tAmApatantIM chichCheda shikhaNDI bahubhiH sharaiH |
sApatanmedinIM dIptA bhAsayantI mahAprabhA
shlokas.24:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya gautamo rathinAM varaH |
prAchChAdayachChitairbANairmahArAja shikhaNDinam
shlokas.25:
sa ChAdyamAnaH samare gautamena yashasvinA |
vyaShIdata rathopasthe shikhaNDI rathinAM varaH
shlokas.26:
sIdantaM chainamAlokya kRRipaH shAradvato yudhi |
Ajaghne bahubhirbANairjighA.nsanniva bhArata
shlokas.27:
vimukhaM taM raNe dRRiShTvA yAj~naseniM mahAratham |
pA~nchAlAH somakAshchaiva parivavruH samantataH
shlokas.28:
tathaiva tava putrAshcha parivavrurdvijottamam |
mahatyA senayA sArdhaM tato yuddhamabhUtpunaH
shlokas.29:
rathAnAM cha raNe rAjannanyonyamabhidhAvatAm |
babhUva tumulaH shabdo meghAnAM nadatAmiva
shlokas.30:
dravatAM sAdinAM chaiva gajAnAM cha vishAM pate |
anyonyamabhito rAjankrUramAyodhanaM babhau
shlokas.31:
pattInAM dravatAM chaiva padashabdena medinI |
akampata mahArAja bhayatrasteva chA~NganA
shlokas.32:
rathA rathAnsamAsAdya pradrutA vegavattaram |
nyagRRihNanbahavo rAja~nshalabhAnvAyasA iva
shlokas.33:
tathA gajAnprabhinnA.nshcha suprabhinnA mahAgajAH |
tasminneva pade yattA nigRRihNanti sma bhArata
shlokas.34:
sAdI sAdinamAsAdya padAtI cha padAtinam |
samAsAdya raNe.anyonyaM sa.nrabdhA nAtichakramuH
shlokas.35:
dhAvatAM dravatAM chaiva punarAvartatAmapi |
babhUva tatra sainyAnAM shabdaH sutumulo nishi
shlokas.36:
dIpyamAnAH pradIpAshcha rathavAraNavAjiShu |
adRRishyanta mahArAja maholkA iva khAchchyutAH
shlokas.37:
sA nishA bharatashreShTha pradIpairavabhAsitA |
divasapratimA rAjanbabhUva raNamUrdhani
shlokas.38:
Adityena yathA vyAptaM tamo loke praNashyati |
tathA naShTaM tamo ghoraM dIpairdIptairala~NkRRitam
shlokas.39:
shastrANAM kavachAnAM cha maNInAM cha mahAtmanAm |
antardadhuH prabhAH sarvA dIpaistairavabhAsitAH
shlokas.40:
tasminkolAhale yuddhe vartamAne nishAmukhe |
avadhItsamare putraM pitA bharatasattama
shlokas.41:
putrashcha pitaraM mohAtsakhAyaM cha sakhA tathA |
sambandhinaM cha sambandhI svasrIyaM chApi mAtulaH
shlokas.42:
sve svAnpare parA.nshchApi nijaghnuritaretaram |
nirmaryAdamabhUdyuddhaM rAtrau ghoraM bhayAvaham

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasminsutumule yuddhe vartamAne bhayAvahe |
dhRRiShTadyumno mahArAja droNamevAbhyavartata
shlokas.2:
saMmRRijAno dhanuH shreShThaM jyAM vikarShanpunaH punaH |
abhyavartata droNasya rathaM rukmavibhUShitam
shlokas.3:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM tadAyAntaM droNasyAntachikIrShayA |
parivavrurmahArAja pA~nchAlAH pANDavaiH saha
shlokas.4:
tathA parivRRitaM dRRiShTvA droNamAchAryasattamam |
putrAste sarvato yattA rarakShurdroNamAhave
shlokas.5:
balArNavau tatastau tu sameyAtAM nishAmukhe |
vAtoddhUtau kShubdhasattvau bhairavau sAgarAviva
shlokas.6:
tato droNaM mahArAja pA~nchAlyaH pa~nchabhiH sharaiH |
vivyAdha hRRidaye tUrNaM siMhanAdaM nanAda cha
shlokas.7:
taM droNaH pa~nchavi.nshatyA viddhvA bhArata sa.nyuge |
chichChedAnyena bhallena dhanurasya mahAprabham
shlokas.8:
dhRRiShTadyumnastu nirviddho droNena bharatarShabha |
utsasarja dhanustUrNaM sa.ndashya dashanachChadam
shlokas.9:
tataH kruddho mahArAja dhRRiShTadyumnaH pratApavAn |
Adade.anyaddhanuH shreShThaM droNasyAntachikIrShayA
shlokas.10:
vikRRiShya cha dhanushchitramAkarNAtparavIrahA |
droNasyAntakaraM ghoraM vyasRRijatsAyakaM tataH
shlokas.11:
sa visRRiShTo balavatA sharo ghoro mahAmRRidhe |
bhAsayAmAsa tatsainyaM divAkara ivoditaH
shlokas.12:
taM dRRiShTvA tu sharaM ghoraM devagandharvamAnavAH |
svastyastu samare rAjandroNAyetyabruvanvachaH
shlokas.13:
taM tu sAyakamaprAptamAchAryasya rathaM prati |
karNo dvAdashadhA rAja.nshchichCheda kRRitahastavat
shlokas.14:
sa Chinno bahudhA rAjansUtaputreNa mAriSha |
nipapAta sharastUrNaM nikRRittaH karNasAyakaiH
shlokas.15:
ChittvA tu samare bANaM sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM raNe karNo vivyAdha dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.16:
pa~nchabhirdroNaputrastu svayaM droNashcha saptabhiH |
shalyashcha navabhirbANaistribhirduHshAsanastathA
shlokas.17:
duryodhanashcha vi.nshatyA shakunishchApi pa~nchabhiH |
pA~nchAlyaM tvaritAvidhyansarva eva mahArathAH
shlokas.18:
sa viddhaH saptabhirvIrairdroNatrANArthamAhave |
sarvAnasambhramAdrAjanpratyavidhyattribhistribhiH
droNaM drauNiM cha karNaM cha vivyAdha tava chAtmajam
shlokas.19:
te viddhvA dhanvinA tena dhRRiShTadyumnaM punarmRRidhe |
vivyadhuH pa~nchabhistUrNamekaiko rathinAM varaH
shlokas.20:
drumasenastu sa~Nkruddho rAjanvivyAdha patriNA |
tribhishchAnyaiH sharaistUrNaM tiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.21:
sa tu taM prativivyAdha tribhistIkShNairajihmagaiH |
svarNapu~NkhaiH shilAdhautaiH prANAntakaraNairyudhi
shlokas.22:
bhallenAnyena tu punaH suvarNojjvalakuNDalam |
unmamAtha shiraH kAyAddrumasenasya vIryavAn
shlokas.23:
tachChiro nyapatadbhUmau sa.ndaShTauShThapuTaM raNe |
mahAvAtasamuddhUtaM pakvaM tAlaphalaM yathA
shlokas.24:
tA.nshcha viddhvA punarvIrAnvIraH sunishitaiH sharaiH |
rAdheyasyAchChinadbhallaiH kArmukaM chitrayodhinaH
shlokas.25:
na tu tanmamRRiShe karNo dhanuShashChedanaM tathA |
nikartanamivAtyugro lA~NgUlasya yathA hariH
shlokas.26:
so.anyaddhanuH samAdAya krodharaktekShaNaH shvasan |
abhyavarShachCharaughaistaM dhRRiShTadyumnaM mahAbalam
shlokas.27:
dRRiShTvA tu karNaM sa.nrabdhaM te vIrAH ShaDratharShabhAH |
pA~nchAlyaputraM tvaritAH parivavrurjighA.nsayA
shlokas.28:
ShaNNAM yodhapravIrANAM tAvakAnAM puraskRRitam |
mRRityorAsyamanuprAptaM dhRRiShTadyumnamama.nsmahi
shlokas.29:
etasminneva kAle tu dAshArho vikira~nsharAn |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM parAkrAntaM sAtyakiH pratyapadyata
shlokas.30:
tamAyAntaM maheShvAsaM sAtyakiM yuddhadurmadam |
rAdheyo dashabhirbANaiH pratyavidhyadajihmagaiH
shlokas.31:
taM sAtyakirmahArAja vivyAdha dashabhiH sharaiH |
pashyatAM sarvavIrANAM mA gAstiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.32:
sa sAtyakestu balinaH karNasya cha mahAtmanaH |
AsItsamAgamo ghoro balivAsavayoriva
shlokas.33:
trAsaya.nstalaghoSheNa kShatriyAnkShatriyarShabhaH |
rAjIvalochanaM karNaM sAtyakiH pratyavidhyata
shlokas.34:
kampayanniva ghoSheNa dhanuSho vasudhAM balI |
sUtaputro mahArAja sAtyakiM pratyayodhayat
shlokas.35:
vipAThakarNinArAchairvatsadantaiH kShurairapi |
karNaH sharashataishchApi shaineyaM pratyavidhyata
shlokas.36:
tathaiva yuyudhAno.api vRRiShNInAM pravaro rathaH |
abhyavarShachCharaiH karNaM tadyuddhamabhavatsamam
shlokas.37:
tAvakAshcha mahArAja karNaputrashcha da.nshitaH |
sAtyakiM vivyadhustUrNaM samantAnnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.38:
astrairastrANi sa.nvArya teShAM karNasya chAbhibho |
avidhyatsAtyakiH kruddho vRRiShasenaM stanAntare
shlokas.39:
tena bANena nirviddho vRRiShaseno vishAM pate |
nyapatatsa rathe mUDho dhanurutsRRijya vIryavAn
shlokas.40:
tataH karNo hataM matvA vRRiShasenaM mahArathaH |
putrashokAbhisantaptaH sAtyakiM pratyapIDayat
shlokas.41:
pIDyamAnastu karNena yuyudhAno mahArathaH |
vivyAdha bahubhiH karNaM tvaramANaH punaH punaH
shlokas.42:
sa karNaM dashabhirviddhvA vRRiShasenaM cha saptabhiH |
sahastAvApadhanuShI tayoshchichCheda sAtvataH
shlokas.43:
tAvanye dhanuShI sajye kRRitvA shatrubhaya~Nkare |
yuyudhAnamavidhyetAM samantAnnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.44:
vartamAne tu sa~NgrAme tasminvIravarakShaye |
atIva shushruve rAjangANDIvasya mahAsvanaH
shlokas.45:
