shrutvA tu rathanirghoShaM gANDIvasya cha nisvanam |
sUtaputro.abravIdrAjanduryodhanamidaM vachaH
shlokas.46:
eSha sarvA~nshibInhatvA mukhyashashcha nararShabhAn |
pauravA.nshcha maheShvAsAngANDIvaninado mahAn
shlokas.47:
shrUyate rathaghoShashcha vAsavasyeva nardataH |
karoti pANDavo vyaktaM karmaupayikamAtmanaH
shlokas.48:
eShA vidIryate rAjanbahudhA bhAratI chamUH |
viprakIrNAnyanIkAni nAvatiShThanti karhichit
shlokas.49:
vAteneva samuddhUtamabhrajAlaM vidIryate |
savyasAchinamAsAdya bhinnA nauriva sAgare
shlokas.50:
dravatAM yodhamukhyAnAM gANDIvapreShitaiH sharaiH |
viddhAnAM shatasho rAja~nshrUyate ninado mahAn
nishIthe rAjashArdUla stanayitnorivAmbare
shlokas.51:
hAhAkAraravA.nshchaiva siMhanAdA.nshcha puShkalAn |
shRRiNu shabdAnbahuvidhAnarjunasya rathaM prati
shlokas.52:
ayaM madhye sthito.asmAkaM sAtyakiH sAtvatAdhamaH |
iha chellabhyate lakShyaM kRRitsnA~njeShyAmahe parAn
shlokas.53:
eSha pA~nchAlarAjasya putro droNena sa~NgataH |
sarvataH sa.nvRRito yodhai rAjanpuruShasattamaiH
shlokas.54:
sAtyakiM yadi hanyAmo dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha pArShatam |
asa.nshayaM mahArAja dhruvo no vijayo bhavet
shlokas.55:
saubhadravadimau vIrau parivArya mahArathau |
prayatAmo mahArAja nihantuM vRRiShNipArShatau
shlokas.56:
savyasAchI puro.abhyeti droNAnIkAya bhArata |
sa.nsaktaM sAtyakiM j~nAtvA bahubhiH kurupu~NgavaiH
shlokas.57:
tatra gachChantu bahavaH pravarA rathasattamAH |
yAvatpArtho na jAnAti sAtyakiM bahubhirvRRitam
shlokas.58:
te tvaradhvaM yathA shUrAH sharANAM mokShaNe bhRRisham |
yathA tUrNaM vrajatyeSha paralokAya mAdhavaH
shlokas.59:
karNasya matamAj~nAya putraste prAha saubalam |
yathendraH samare rAjanprAha viShNuM yashasvinam
shlokas.60:
vRRitaH sahasrairdashabhirgajAnAmanivartinAm |
rathaishcha dashasAhasrairvRRito yAhi dhana~njayam
shlokas.61:
duHshAsano durviShahaH subAhurduShpradharShaNaH |
ete tvAmanuyAsyanti pattibhirbahubhirvRRitAH
shlokas.62:
jahi kRRiShNau mahAbAho dharmarAjaM cha mAtula |
nakulaM sahadevaM cha bhImasenaM cha bhArata
shlokas.63:
devAnAmiva devendre jayAshA me tvayi sthitA |
jahi mAtula kaunteyAnasurAniva pAvakiH
shlokas.64:
evamukto yayau pArthAnputreNa tava saubalaH |
mahatyA senayA sArdhaM tava putraistathA vibho
shlokas.65:
priyArthaM tava putrANAM didhakShuH pANDunandanAn |
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM tAvakAnAM paraiH saha
shlokas.66:
prayAte saubale rAjanpANDavAnAmanIkinIm |
balena mahatA yuktaH sUtaputrastu sAtvatam
shlokas.67:
abhyayAttvaritaM yuddhe kira~nsharashatAnbahUn |
tathaiva pANDavAH sarve sAtyakiM paryavArayan
shlokas.68:
mahadyuddhaM tadAsIttu droNasya nishi bhArata |
dhRRiShTadyumnena shUreNa pA~nchAlaishcha mahAtmanaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataste prAdravansarve tvaritA yuddhadurmadAH |
amRRiShyamANAH sa.nrabdhA yuyudhAnarathaM prati
shlokas.2:
te rathaiH kalpitai rAjanhemarUpyavibhUShitaiH |
sAdibhishcha gajaishchaiva parivavruH sma sAtvatam
shlokas.3:
athainaM koShThakIkRRitya sarvataste mahArathAH |
siMhanAdA.nstadA chakrustarjayantaH sma sAtyakim
shlokas.4:
te.abhyavarSha~nsharaistIkShNaiH sAtyakiM satyavikramam |
tvaramANA mahAvIryA mAdhavasya vadhaiShiNaH
shlokas.5:
tAndRRiShTvA patatastUrNaM shaineyaH paravIrahA |
pratyagRRihNAnmahAbAhuH pramu~nchanvishikhAnbahUn
shlokas.6:
tatra vIro maheShvAsaH sAtyakiryuddhadurmadaH |
nichakarta shirA.nsyugraiH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.7:
hastihastAnhayagrIvAnbAhUnapi cha sAyudhAn |
kShurapraiH pAtayAmAsa tAvakAnAM sa mAdhavaH
shlokas.8:
patitaishchAmaraishchaiva shvetachChatraishcha bhArata |
babhUva dharaNI pUrNA nakShatrairdyauriva prabho
shlokas.9:
teShAM tu yuyudhAnena yudhyatAM yudhi bhArata |
babhUva tumulaH shabdaH pretAnAmiva krandatAm
shlokas.10:
tena shabdena mahatA pUritAsIdvasundharA |
rAtriH samabhavachchaiva tIvrarUpA bhayAvahA
shlokas.11:
dIryamANaM balaM dRRiShTvA yuyudhAnasharAhatam |
shrutvA cha vipulaM nAdaM nishIthe lomaharShaNam
shlokas.12:
sutastavAbravIdrAjansArathiM rathinAM varaH |
yatraiSha shabdastatrAshvA.nshchodayeti punaH punaH
shlokas.13:
tena sa~nchodyamAnastu tatastA.nsturagottamAn |
sUtaH sa~nchodayAmAsa yuyudhAnarathaM prati
shlokas.14:
tato duryodhanaH kruddho dRRiDhadhanvA jitaklamaH |
shIghrahastashchitrayodhI yuyudhAnamupAdravat
shlokas.15:
tataH pUrNAyatotsRRiShTairmA.nsashoNitabhojanaiH |
duryodhanaM dvAdashabhirmAdhavaH pratyavidhyata
shlokas.16:
duryodhanastena tathA pUrvamevArditaH sharaiH |
shaineyaM dashabhirbANaiH pratyavidhyadamarShitaH
shlokas.17:
tataH samabhavadyuddhamAkulaM bharatarShabha |
pA~nchAlAnAM cha sarveShAM bhAratAnAM cha dAruNam
shlokas.18:
shaineyastu raNe kruddhastava putraM mahAratham |
sAyakAnAmashItyA tu vivyAdhorasi bhArata
shlokas.19:
tato.asya vAhAnsamare sharairninye yamakShayam |
sArathiM cha rathAttUrNaM pAtayAmAsa patriNA
shlokas.20:
hatAshve tu rathe tiShThanputrastava vishAM pate |
mumocha nishitAnbANA~nshaineyasya rathaM prati
shlokas.21:
sharAnpa~nchAshatastA.nstu shaineyaH kRRitahastavat |
chichCheda samare rAjanpreShitA.nstanayena te
shlokas.22:
athApareNa bhallena muShTideshe mahaddhanuH |
chichCheda rabhaso yuddhe tava putrasya mAriSha
shlokas.23:
viratho vidhanuShkashcha sarvalokeshvaraH prabhuH |
Aruroha rathaM tUrNaM bhAsvaraM kRRitavarmaNaH
shlokas.24:
duryodhane parAvRRitte shaineyastava vAhinIm |
drAvayAmAsa vishikhairnishAmadhye vishAM pate
shlokas.25:
shakunishchArjunaM rAjanparivArya samantataH |
rathairanekasAhasrairgajaishchaiva sahasrashaH
tathA hayasahasraishcha tumulaM sarvato.akarot
shlokas.26:
te mahAstrANi divyAni vikiranto.arjunaM prati |
arjunaM yodhayanti sma kShatriyAH kAlachoditAH
shlokas.27:
tAnyarjunaH sahasrANi rathavAraNavAjinAm |
pratyavArayadAyastaH prakurvanvipulaM kShayam
shlokas.28:
tatastu samare shUraH shakuniH saubalastadA |
vivyAdha nishitairbANairarjunaM prahasanniva
shlokas.29:
punashchaiva shatenAsya sa.nrurodha mahAratham |
tamarjunastu vi.nshatyA vivyAdha yudhi bhArata
shlokas.30:
athetarAnmaheShvAsA.nstribhistribhiravidhyata |
sa.nvArya tAnbANagaNairyudhi rAjandhana~njayaH
avadhIttAvakAnyodhAnvajrapANirivAsurAn
shlokas.31:
bhujaishChinnairmahArAja sharIraishcha sahasrashaH |
samAstIrNA dharA tatra babhau puShpairivAchitA
shlokas.32:
sa viddhvA shakuniM bhUyaH pa~nchabhirnataparvabhiH |
ulUkaM tribhirAjaghne tribhireva mahAyasaiH
shlokas.33:
tamulUkastathA viddhvA vAsudevamatADayat |
nanAda cha mahAnAdaM pUrayanvasudhAtalam
shlokas.34:
arjunastu drutaM gatvA shakunerdhanurAchChinat |
ninye cha chaturo vAhAnyamasya sadanaM prati
shlokas.35:
tato rathAdavaplutya saubalo bharatarShabha |
ulUkasya rathaM tUrNamAruroha vishAM pate
shlokas.36:
tAvekarathamArUDhau pitAputrau mahArathau |
pArthaM siShichaturbANairgiriM meghAvivotthitau
shlokas.37:
tau tu viddhvA mahArAja pANDavo nishitaiH sharaiH |
vidrAvaya.nstava chamUM shatasho vyadhamachCharaiH
shlokas.38:
anilena yathAbhrANi vichChinnAni samantataH |
vichChinnAni tathA rAjanbalAnyAsanvishAM pate
shlokas.39:
tadbalaM bharatashreShTha vadhyamAnaM tathA nishi |
pradudrAva dishaH sarvA vIkShamANaM bhayArditam
shlokas.40:
utsRRijya vAhAnsamare chodayantastathApare |
sambhrAntAH paryadhAvanta tasmi.nstamasi dAruNe
shlokas.41:
vijitya samare yodhA.nstAvakAnbharatarShabha |
dadhmaturmuditau sha~Nkhau vAsudevadhana~njayau
shlokas.42:
dhRRiShTadyumno mahArAja droNaM viddhvA tribhiH sharaiH |
chichCheda dhanuShastUrNaM jyAM shareNa shitena ha
shlokas.43:
tannidhAya dhanurnIDe droNaH kShatriyamardanaH |
Adade.anyaddhanuH shUro vegavatsAravattaram
shlokas.44:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM tato droNo viddhvA saptabhirAshugaiH |
sArathiM pa~nchabhirbANai rAjanvivyAdha sa.nyuge
shlokas.45:
taM nivArya sharaistUrNaM dhRRiShTadyumno mahArathaH |
vyadhamatkauravIM senAM shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.46:
vadhyamAne bale tasmi.nstava putrasya mAriSha |
prAvartata nadI ghorA shoNitaughatara~NgiNI
shlokas.47:
ubhayoH senayormadhye narAshvadvipavAhinI |
yathA vaitaraNI rAjanyamarAShTrapuraM prati
shlokas.48:
drAvayitvA tu tatsainyaM dhRRiShTadyumnaH pratApavAn |
atyarAjata tejasvI shakro devagaNeShviva
shlokas.49:
atha dadhmurmahAsha~NkhAndhRRiShTadyumnashikhaNDinau |
yamau cha yuyudhAnashcha pANDavashcha vRRikodaraH
shlokas.50:
jitvA rathasahasrANi tAvakAnAM mahArathAH |
siMhanAdaravA.nshchakruH pANDavA jitakAshinaH
shlokas.51:
pashyatastava putrasya karNasya cha madotkaTAH |
tathA droNasya shUrasya drauNeshchaiva vishAM pate

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
vidrutaM svabalaM dRRiShTvA vadhyamAnaM mahAtmabhiH |
krodhena mahatAviShTaH putrastava vishAM pate
shlokas.2:
abhyetya sahasA karNaM droNaM cha jayatAM varam |
amarShavashamApanno vAkyaj~no vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.3:
bhavadbhyAmiha sa~NgrAmo kruddhAbhyAM sampravartitaH |
Ahave nihataM dRRiShTvA saindhavaM savyasAchinA
shlokas.4:
nihanyamAnAM pANDUnAM balena mama vAhinIm |
bhUtvA tadvijaye shaktAvashaktAviva pashyataH
shlokas.5:
yadyahaM bhavatostyAjyo na vAchyo.asmi tadaiva hi |
AvAM pANDusutAnsa~Nkhye jeShyAva iti mAnadau
shlokas.6:
tadaivAhaM vachaH shrutvA bhavadbhyAmanusaMmatam |
kRRitavAnpANDavaiH sArdhaM vairaM yodhavinAshanam
shlokas.7:
yadi nAhaM parityAjyo bhavadbhyAM puruSharShabhau |
yudhyetAmanurUpeNa vikrameNa suvikramau
shlokas.8:
vAkpratodena tau vIrau praNunnau tanayena te |
prAvartayetAM tau yuddhaM ghaTTitAviva pannagau
shlokas.9:
tatastau rathinAM shreShThau sarvalokadhanurdharau |
shaineyapramukhAnpArthAnabhidudruvatU raNe
shlokas.10:
tathaiva sahitAH pArthAH svena sainyena sa.nvRRitAH |
abhyavartanta tau vIrau nardamAnau muhurmuhuH
shlokas.11:
atha droNo maheShvAso dashabhiH shinipu~Ngavam |
avidhyattvaritaM kruddhaH sarvashastrabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.12:
karNashcha dashabhirbANaiH putrashcha tava saptabhiH |
dashabhirvRRiShasenashcha saubalashchApi saptabhiH
ete kaurava sa~Nkrande shaineyaM paryavArayan
shlokas.13:
dRRiShTvA cha samare droNaM nighnantaM pANDavIM chamUm |
vivyadhuH somakAstUrNaM samantAchCharavRRiShTibhiH
shlokas.14:
tato droNo.aharatprANAnkShatriyANAM vishAM pate |
rashmibhirbhAskaro rAja.nstamasAmiva bhArata
shlokas.15:
droNena vadhyamAnAnAM pA~nchAlAnAM vishAM pate |
shushruve tumulaH shabdaH kroshatAmitaretaram
shlokas.16:
putrAnanye pitR^Inanye bhrAtR^Inanye cha mAtulAn |
bhAgineyAnvayasyA.nshcha tathA sambandhibAndhavAn
utsRRijyotsRRijya gachChanti tvaritA jIvitepsavaH
shlokas.17:
apare mohitA mohAttamevAbhimukhA yayuH |
pANDavAnAM raNe yodhAH paralokaM tathApare
shlokas.18:
sA tathA pANDavI senA vadhyamAnA mahAtmabhiH |
nishi samprAdravadrAjannutsRRijyolkAH sahasrashaH
shlokas.19:
pashyato bhImasenasya vijayasyAchyutasya cha |
yamayordharmaputrasya pArShatasya cha pashyataH
shlokas.20:
tamasA sa.nvRRite loke na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana |
kauravANAM prakAshena dRRishyante tu drutAH pare
shlokas.21:
dravamANaM tu tatsainyaM droNakarNau mahArathau |
jaghnatuH pRRiShThato rAjankirantau sAyakAnbahUn
shlokas.22:
pA~nchAleShu prabhagneShu dIryamANeShu sarvashaH |
janArdano dInamanAH pratyabhAShata phalgunam
shlokas.23:
droNakarNau maheShvAsAvetau pArShatasAtyakI |
pA~nchAlA.nshchaiva sahitau jaghnatuH sAyakairbhRRisham
shlokas.24:
etayoH sharavarSheNa prabhagnA no mahArathAH |
vAryamANApi kaunteya pRRitanA nAvatiShThate
shlokas.25:
etAvAvAM sarvasainyairvyUDhaiH samyagudAyudhaiH |
droNaM cha sUtaputraM cha prayatAvaH prabAdhitum
shlokas.26:
etau hi balinau shUrau kRRitAstrau jitakAshinau |
upekShitau balaM kruddhau nAshayetAM nishAmimAm
eSha bhImo.abhiyAtyugraH punarAvartya vAhinIm
shlokas.27:
vRRikodaraM tathAyAntaM dRRiShTvA tatra janArdanaH |
punarevAbravIdrAjanharShayanniva pANDavam
shlokas.28:
eSha bhImo raNashlAghI vRRitaH somakapANDavaiH |
ruShito.abhyeti vegena droNakarNau mahAbalau
shlokas.29:
etena sahito yudhya pA~nchAlaishcha mahArathaiH |
AshvAsanArthaM sarveShAM sainyAnAM pANDunandana
shlokas.30:
tatastau puruShavyAghrAvubhau mAdhavapANDavau |
droNakarNau samAsAdya dhiShThitau raNamUrdhani
shlokas.31:
tatastatpunarAvRRittaM yudhiShThirabalaM mahat |
tato droNashcha karNashcha parAnmamRRidaturyudhi
shlokas.32:
sa samprahArastumulo nishi pratyabhavanmahAn |
yathA sAgarayo rAja.nshchandrodayavivRRiddhayoH
shlokas.33:
tata utsRRijya pANibhyaH pradIpA.nstava vAhinI |
yuyudhe pANDavaiH sArdhamunmattavadahaHkShaye
shlokas.34:
rajasA tamasA chaiva sa.nvRRite bhRRishadAruNe |
kevalaM nAmagotreNa prAyudhyanta jayaiShiNaH
shlokas.35:
ashrUyanta hi nAmAni shrAvyamANAni pArthivaiH |
praharadbhirmahArAja svaya.nvara ivAhave
shlokas.36:
niHshabdamAsItsahasA punaH shabdo mahAnabhUt |
kruddhAnAM yudhyamAnAnAM jayatAM jIyatAmapi
shlokas.37:
yatra yatra sma dRRishyante pradIpAH kurusattama |
tatra tatra sma te shUrA nipatanti pata~Ngavat
shlokas.38:
tathA sa.nyudhyamAnAnAM vigADhAbhUnmahAnishA |
pANDavAnAM cha rAjendra kauravANAM cha sarvashaH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH karNo raNe dRRiShTvA pArShataM paravIrahA |
AjaghAnorasi sharairdashabhirmarmabhedibhiH
shlokas.2:
prativivyAdha taM tUrNaM dhRRiShTadyumno.api mAriSha |
pa~nchabhiH sAyakairhRRiShTastiShTha tiShTheti chAbravIt
shlokas.3:
tAvanyonyaM sharaiH sa~Nkhye sa~nChAdya sumahArathau |
punaH pUrNAyatotsRRiShTairvivyadhAte parasparam
shlokas.4:
tataH pA~nchAlamukhyasya dhRRiShTadyumnasya sa.nyuge |
sArathiM chaturashchAshvAnkarNo vivyAdha sAyakaiH
shlokas.5:
kArmukapravaraM chAsya prachichCheda shitaiH sharaiH |
sArathiM chAsya bhallena rathanIDAdapAtayat
shlokas.6:
dhRRiShTadyumnastu viratho hatAshvo hatasArathiH |
gRRihItvA parighaM ghoraM karNasyAshvAnapIpiShat
shlokas.7:
viddhashcha bahubhistena sharairAshIviShopamaiH |
tato yudhiShThirAnIkaM padbhyAmevAnvavartata
Aruroha rathaM chApi sahadevasya mAriSha
shlokas.8:
karNasyApi rathe vAhAnanyAnsUto nyayojayat |
sha~NkhavarNAnmahAvegAnsaindhavAnsAdhuvAhinaH
shlokas.9:
labdhalakShyastu rAdheyaH pA~nchAlAnAM mahArathAn |
abhyapIDayadAyastaH sharairmegha ivAchalAn
shlokas.10:
sA pIDyamAnA karNena pA~nchAlAnAM mahAchamUH |
samprAdravatsusantrastA siMhenevArditA mRRigI
shlokas.11:
patitAsturagebhyashcha gajebhyashcha mahItale |
rathebhyashcha narAstUrNamadRRishyanta tatastataH
shlokas.12:
dhAvamAnasya yodhasya kShurapraiH sa mahAmRRidhe |
bAhU chichCheda vai karNaH shirashchaiva sakuNDalam
shlokas.13:
UrU chichCheda chAnyasya gajasthasya vishAM pate |
vAjipRRiShThagatasyApi bhUmiShThasya cha mAriSha
shlokas.14:
nAj~nAsiShurdhAvamAnA bahavashcha mahArathAH |
sa~nChinnAnyAtmagAtrANi vAhanAni cha sa.nyuge
shlokas.15:
te vadhyamAnAH samare pA~nchAlAH sRRi~njayaiH saha |
tRRiNapraspandanAchchApi sUtaputraM sma menire
shlokas.16:
api svaM samare yodhaM dhAvamAnaM vichetasaH |
karNamevAbhyamanyanta tato bhItA dravanti te
shlokas.17:
tAnyanIkAni bhagnAni dravamANAni bhArata |
abhyadravaddrutaM karNaH pRRiShThato vikira~nsharAn
shlokas.18:
avekShamANAste.anyonyaM susaMmUDhA vichetasaH |
nAshaknuvannavasthAtuM kAlyamAnA mahAtmanA
shlokas.19:
karNenAbhyAhatA rAjanpA~nchAlAH parameShubhiH |
droNena cha dishaH sarvA vIkShamANAH pradudruvuH
shlokas.20:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA svasainyaM prekShya vidrutam |
apayAne matiM kRRitvA phalgunaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.21:
pashya karNaM maheShvAsaM dhanuShpANimavasthitam |
nishIthe dAruNe kAle tapantamiva bhAskaram
shlokas.22:
karNasAyakanunnAnAM kroshatAmeSha nisvanaH |
anishaM shrUyate pArtha tvadbandhUnAmanAthavat
shlokas.23:
yathA visRRijatashchAsya sa.ndadhAnasya chAshugAn |
pashyAmi jayavikrAntaM kShapayiShyati no dhruvam
shlokas.24:
yadatrAnantaraM kAryaM prAptakAlaM prapashyasi |
karNasya vadhasa.nyuktaM tatkuruShva dhana~njaya
shlokas.25:
evamukto mahAbAhuH pArthaH kRRiShNamathAbravIt |
bhItaH kuntIsuto rAjA rAdheyasyAtivikramAt
shlokas.26:
evaM gate prAptakAlaM karNAnIke punaH punaH |
bhavAnvyavasyatAM kShipraM dravate hi varUthinI
shlokas.27:
droNasAyakanunnAnAM bhagnAnAM madhusUdana |
karNena trAsyamAnAnAmavasthAnaM na vidyate
shlokas.28:
pashyAmi cha tathA karNaM vicharantamabhItavat |
dravamANAnrathodArAnkirantaM vishikhaiH shitaiH
shlokas.29:
naitadasyotsahe soDhuM charitaM raNamUrdhani |
pratyakShaM vRRiShNishArdUla pAdasparshamivoragaH
shlokas.30:
sa bhavAnatra yAtvAshu yatra karNo mahArathaH |
ahamenaM vadhiShyAmi mAM vaiSha madhusUdana
shlokas.31:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
pashyAmi karNaM kaunteya devarAjamivAhave |
vicharantaM naravyAghramatimAnuShavikramam
shlokas.32:
naitasyAnyo.asti samare pratyudyAtA dhana~njaya |
RRite tvAM puruShavyAghra rAkShasAdvA ghaTotkachAt
shlokas.33:
na tu tAvadahaM manye prAptakAlaM tavAnagha |
samAgamaM mahAbAho sUtaputreNa sa.nyuge
shlokas.34:
dIpyamAnA maholkeva tiShThatyasya hi vAsavI |
tvadarthaM hi mahAbAho raudrarUpaM bibharti cha
shlokas.35:
ghaTotkachastu rAdheyaM pratyudyAtu mahAbalaH |
sa hi bhImena balinA jAtaH suraparAkramaH
shlokas.36:
tasminnastrANi divyAni rAkShasAnyAsurANi cha |
satataM chAnurakto vo hitaiShI cha ghaTotkachaH
vijeShyati raNe karNamiti me nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.37:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamuktvA mahAbAhuH pArthaM puShkaralochanaH |
AjuhAvAtha tadrakShaH tachchAsItprAduragrataH
shlokas.38:
kavachI sa sharI khaDgI sadhanvA cha vishAM pate |
abhivAdya tataH kRRiShNaM pANDavaM cha dhana~njayam
abravIttaM tadA hRRiShTastvayamasmyanushAdhi mAm
shlokas.39:
tatastaM meghasa~NkAshaM dIptAsyaM dIptakuNDalam |
abhyabhAShata haiDimbaM dAshArhaH prahasanniva
shlokas.40:
ghaTotkacha vijAnIhi yattvAM vakShyAmi putraka |
prApto vikramakAlo.ayaM tava nAnyasya kasyachit
shlokas.41:
sa bhavAnmajjamAnAnAM bandhUnAM tvaM plavo yathA |
vividhAni tavAstrANi santi mAyA cha rAkShasI
shlokas.42:
pashya karNena haiDimba pANDavAnAmanIkinI |
kAlyamAnA yathA gAvaH pAlena raNamUrdhani
shlokas.43:
eSha karNo maheShvAso matimAndRRiDhavikramaH |
pANDavAnAmanIkeShu nihanti kShatriyarShabhAn
shlokas.44:
kirantaH sharavarShANi mahAnti dRRiDhadhanvinaH |
na shaknuvantyavasthAtuM pIDyamAnAH sharArchiShA
shlokas.45:
nishIthe sUtaputreNa sharavarSheNa pIDitAH |
ete dravanti pA~nchAlAH siMhasyeva bhayAnmRRigAH
shlokas.46:
etasyaivaM pravRRiddhasya sUtaputrasya sa.nyuge |
niSheddhA vidyate nAnyastvadRRite bhImavikrama
shlokas.47:
sa tvaM kuru mahAbAho karma yuktamihAtmanaH |
mAtulAnAM pitR^INAM cha tejaso.astrabalasya cha
shlokas.48:
etadarthaM hi haiDimba putrAnichChanti mAnavAH |
kathaM nastArayedduHkhAtsa tvaM tAraya bAndhavAn
shlokas.49:
tava hyastrabalaM bhImaM mAyAshcha tava dustarAH |
sa~NgrAme yudhyamAnasya satataM bhImanandana
shlokas.50:
pANDavAnAM prabhagnAnAM karNena shitasAyakaiH |
majjatAM dhArtarAShTreShu bhava pAraM parantapa
shlokas.51:
rAtrau hi rAkShasA bhUyo bhavantyamitavikramAH |
balavantaH sudurdharShAH shUrA vikrAntachAriNaH
shlokas.52:
jahi karNaM maheShvAsaM nishIthe mAyayA raNe |
pArthA droNaM vadhiShyanti dhRRiShTadyumnapurogamAH
shlokas.53:
keshavasya vachaH shrutvA bIbhatsurapi rAkShasam |
abhyabhAShata kauravya ghaTotkachamari.ndamam
shlokas.54:
ghaTotkacha bhavA.nshchaiva dIrghabAhushcha sAtyakiH |
matau me sarvasainyeShu bhImasenashcha pANDavaH
shlokas.55:
sa bhavAnyAtu karNena dvairathaM yudhyatAM nishi |
sAtyakiH pRRiShThagopaste bhaviShyati mahArathaH
shlokas.56:
jahi karNaM raNe shUraM sAtvatena sahAyavAn |
yathendrastArakaM pUrvaM skandena saha jaghnivAn
shlokas.57:
ghaTotkacha uvAcha||
alamevAsmi karNAya droNAyAlaM cha sattama |
anyeShAM kShatriyANAM cha kRRitAstrANAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.58:
adya dAsyAmi sa~NgrAmaM sUtaputrAya taM nishi |
yaM janAH sampravakShyanti yAvadbhUmirdhariShyati
shlokas.59:
na chAtra shUrAnmokShyAmi na bhItAnna kRRitA~njalIn |
sarvAneva vadhiShyAmi rAkShasaM dharmamAsthitaH
shlokas.60:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamuktvA mahAbAhurhaiDimbaH paravIrahA |
abhyayAttumule karNaM tava sainyaM vibhIShayan
shlokas.61:
tamApatantaM sa~NkruddhaM dIptAsyamiva pannagam |
abhyasyanparameShvAsaH pratijagrAha sUtajaH
shlokas.62:
tayoH samabhavadyuddhaM karNarAkShasayornishi |
garjato rAjashArdUla shakraprahrAdayoriva

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
dRRiShTvA ghaTotkachaM rAjansUtaputrarathaM prati |
prayAntaM tvararyA yuktaM jighA.nsuM karNamAhave
shlokas.2:
abravIttava putrastu duHshAsanamidaM vachaH |
etadrakSho raNe tUrNaM dRRiShTvA karNasya vikramam
shlokas.3:
abhiyAti drutaM karNaM tadvAraya mahAratham |
vRRitaH sainyena mahatA yAhi yatra mahAbalaH
shlokas.4:
karNo vaikartano yuddhe rAkShasena yuyutsati |
rakSha karNaM raNe yatto vRRitaH sainyena mAnada
shlokas.5:
etasminnantare rAja~njaTAsurasuto balI |
duryodhanamupAgamya prAha praharatAM varaH
shlokas.6:
duryodhana tavAmitrAnprakhyAtAnyuddhadurmadAn |
pANDavAnhantumichChAmi tvayAj~naptaH sahAnugAn
shlokas.7:
jaTAsuro mama pitA rakShasAmagraNIH purA |
prayujya karma rakShoghnaM kShudraiH pArthairnipAtitaH
tasyApachitimichChAmi tvaddiShTo gantumIshvara
shlokas.8:
tamabravIttato rAjA prIyamANaH punaH punaH |
droNakarNAdibhiH sArdhaM paryApto.ahaM dviShadvadhe
tvaM tu gachCha mayAj~napto jahi yuddhaM ghaTotkacham
shlokas.9:
tathetyuktvA mahAkAyaH samAhUya ghaTotkacham |
jaTAsurirbhaimaseniM nAnAshastrairavAkirat
shlokas.10:
alambalaM cha karNaM cha kurusainyaM cha dustaram |
haiDimbaH pramamAthaiko mahAvAto.ambudAniva
shlokas.11:
tato mAyAmayaM dRRiShTvA rathaM tUrNamalambalaH |
ghaTotkachaM sharavrAtairnAnAli~NgaiH samArdayat
shlokas.12:
viddhvA cha bahubhirbANairbhaimasenimalambalaH |
vyadrAvayachCharavrAtaiH pANDavAnAmanIkinIm
shlokas.13:
tena vidrAvyamANAni pANDusainyAni mAriSha |
nishIthe viprakIryanta vAtanunnA ghanA iva
shlokas.14:
ghaTotkachasharairnunnA tathaiva kuruvAhinI |
nishIthe prAdravadrAjannutsRRijyolkAH sahasrashaH
shlokas.15:
alambalastataH kruddho bhaimaseniM mahAmRRidhe |
Ajaghne nishitairbANaistottrairiva mahAdvipam
shlokas.16:
tilashastasya tadyAnaM sUtaM sarvAyudhAni cha |
ghaTotkachaH prachichCheda prANadachchAtidAruNam
shlokas.17:
tataH karNaM sharavrAtaiH kurUnanyAnsahasrashaH |
alambalaM chAbhyavarShanmegho merumivAchalam
shlokas.18:
tataH sa~nchukShubhe sainyaM kurUNAM rAkShasArditam |
uparyupari chAnyonyaM chatura~NgaM mamarda ha
shlokas.19:
jaTAsurirmahArAja viratho hatasArathiH |
ghaTotkachaM raNe kruddho muShTinAbhyahanaddRRiDham
shlokas.20:
muShTinAbhihatastena prachachAla ghaTotkachaH |
kShitikampe yathA shailaH savRRikShagaNagulmavAn
shlokas.21:
tataH sa parighAbhena dviTsa~Nghaghnena bAhunA |
jaTAsuriM bhaimaseniravadhInmuShTinA bhRRisham
shlokas.22:
taM pramathya tataH kruddhastUrNaM haiDimbirAkShipat |
dorbhyAmindradhvajAbhAbhyAM niShpipeSha mahItale
shlokas.23:
alambalo.api vikShipya samutkShipya cha rAkShasam |
ghaTotkachaM raNe roShAnniShpipeSha mahItale
shlokas.24:
tayoH samabhavadyuddhaM garjatoratikAyayoH |
ghaTotkachAlambalayostumulaM lomaharShaNam
shlokas.25:
visheShayantAvanyonyaM mAyAbhiratimAyinau |
yuyudhAte mahAvIryAvindravairochanAviva
shlokas.26:
pAvakAmbunidhI bhUtvA punargaruDatakShakau |
punarmeghamahAvAtau punarvajramahAchalau
punaH ku~njarashArdUlau punaH svarbhAnubhAskarau
shlokas.27:
evaM mAyAshatasRRijAvanyonyavadhakA~NkShiNau |
bhRRishaM chitramayudhyetAmalambalaghaTotkachau
shlokas.28:
parighaishcha gadAbhishcha prAsamudgarapaTTishaiH |
musalaiH parvatAgraishcha tAvanyonyaM nijaghnatuH
shlokas.29:
hayAbhyAM cha gajAbhyAM cha padAtirathinau punaH |
yuyudhAte mahAmAyau rAkShasapravarau yudhi
shlokas.30:
tato ghaTotkacho rAjannalambalavadhepsayA |
utpapAta bhRRishaM kruddhaH shyenavannipapAta ha
shlokas.31:
gRRihItvA cha mahAkAyaM rAkShasendramalambalam |
udyamya nyavadhIdbhUmau mayaM viShNurivAhave
shlokas.32:
tato ghaTotkachaH khaDgamudgRRihyAdbhutadarshanam |
chakarta kAyAddhi shiro bhImaM vikRRitadarshanam
shlokas.33:
tachChiro rudhirAbhyaktaM gRRihya kesheShu rAkShasaH |
ghaTotkacho yayAvAshu duryodhanarathaM prati
shlokas.34:
abhyetya cha mahAbAhuH smayamAnaH sa rAkShasaH |
rathe.asya nikShipya shiro vikRRitAnanamUrdhajam
prANadadbhairavaM nAdaM prAvRRiShIva balAhakaH
shlokas.35:
abravIchcha tato rAjanduryodhanamidaM vachaH |
eSha te nihato bandhustvayA dRRiShTo.asya vikramaH
punardraShTAsi karNasya niShThAmetAM tathAtmanaH
shlokas.36:
evamuktvA tataH prAyAtkarNaM prati janeshvara |
kira~nsharashatA.nstIkShNAnvimu~nchankarNamUrdhani
shlokas.37:
tataH samabhavadyuddhaM ghorarUpaM bhayAnakam |
vismApanaM mahArAja nararAkShasayormRRidhe

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yatra vaikartanaH karNo rAkShasashcha ghaTotkachaH |
nishIthe samasajjetAM tadyuddhamabhavatkatham
shlokas.2:
kIdRRishaM chAbhavadyuddhaM tasya ghorasya rakShasaH |
rathashcha kIdRRishastasya mAyAH sarvAyudhAni cha
shlokas.3:
kimpramANA hayAstasya rathaketurdhanustathA |
kIdRRishaM varma chaivAsya kaNThatrANaM cha kIdRRisham
pRRiShTastvametadAchakShva kushalo hyasi sa~njaya
shlokas.4:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
lohitAkSho mahAkAyastAmrAsyo nimnitodaraH |
UrdhvaromA harishmashruH sha~NkukarNo mahAhanuH
shlokas.5:
AkarNAddAritAsyashcha tIkShNadaMShTraH karAlavAn |
sudIrghatAmrajihvoShTho lambabhrUH sthUlanAsikaH
shlokas.6:
nIlA~Ngo lohitagrIvo girivarShmA bhaya~NkaraH |
mahAkAyo mahAbAhurmahAshIrSho mahAbalaH
shlokas.7:
vikachaH paruShasparsho vikaTodbaddhapiNDikaH |
sthUlasphiggUDhanAbhishcha shithilopachayo mahAn
shlokas.8:
tathaiva hastAbharaNI mahAmAyo.a~NgadI tathA |
urasA dhArayanniShkamagnimAlAM yathAchalaH
shlokas.9:
tasya hemamayaM chitraM bahurUpA~Ngashobhitam |
toraNapratimaM shubhraM kirITaM mUrdhnyashobhata
shlokas.10:
kuNDale bAlasUryAbhe mAlAM hemamayIM shubhAm |
dhArayanvipulaM kA.nsyaM kavachaM cha mahAprabham
shlokas.11:
ki~NkiNIshatanirghoShaM raktadhvajapatAkinam |
RRikShacharmAvanaddhA~NgaM nalvamAtraM mahAratham
shlokas.12:
sarvAyudhavaropetamAsthito dhvajamAlinam |
aShTachakrasamAyuktaM meghagambhIranisvanam
shlokas.13:
tatra mAta~Ngasa~NkAshA lohitAkShA vibhIShaNAH |
kAmavarNajavA yuktA balavanto.avahanhayAH
shlokas.14:
rAkShaso.asya virUpAkShaH sUto dIptAsyakuNDalaH |
rashmibhiH sUryarashmyAbhaiH sa~njagrAha hayAnraNe
sa tena sahitastasthAvaruNena yathA raviH
shlokas.15:
sa.nsakta iva chAbhreNa yathAdrirmahatA mahAn |
divaspRRiksumahAnketuH syandane.asya samuchChritaH
raktottamA~NgaH kravyAdo gRRidhraH paramabhIShaNaH
shlokas.16:
vAsavAshaninirghoShaM dRRiDhajyamabhivikShipan |
vyaktaM kiShkuparINAhaM dvAdashAratni kArmukam
shlokas.17:
rathAkShamAtrairiShubhiH sarvAH prachChAdayandishaH |
tasyAM vIrApahAriNyAM nishAyAM karNamabhyayAt
shlokas.18:
tasya vikShipatashchApaM rathe viShTabhya tiShThataH |
ashrUyata dhanurghoSho visphUrjitamivAshaneH
shlokas.19:
tena vitrAsyamAnAni tava sainyAni bhArata |
samakampanta sarvANi sindhoriva mahormayaH
shlokas.20:
tamApatantaM samprekShya virUpAkShaM vibhIShaNam |
utsmayanniva rAdheyastvaramANo.abhyavArayat
shlokas.21:
tataH karNo.abhyayAdenamasyannasyantamantikAt |
mAta~Nga iva mAta~NgaM yUtharShabha ivarShabham
shlokas.22:
sa saMnipAtastumulastayorAsIdvishAM pate |
karNarAkShasayo rAjannindrashambarayoriva
shlokas.23:
tau pragRRihya mahAvege dhanuShI bhImanisvane |
prAchChAdayetAmanyonyaM takShamANau maheShubhiH
shlokas.24:
tataH pUrNAyatotsRRiShTaiH sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH |
nyavArayetAmanyonyaM kA.nsye nirbhidya varmaNI
shlokas.25:
tau nakhairiva shArdUlau dantairiva mahAdvipau |
rathashaktibhiranyonyaM vishikhaishcha tatakShatuH
shlokas.26:
sa~nChindantau hi gAtrANi sa.ndadhAnau cha sAyakAn |
dhakShyamANau sharavrAtairnodIkShitumashaknutAm
shlokas.27:
tau tu vikShatasarvA~Ngau rudhiraughapariplutau |
vyabhrAjetAM yathA vAriprasrutau gairikAchalau
shlokas.28:
tau sharAgravibhinnA~Ngau nirbhindantau parasparam |
nAkampayetAmanyonyaM yatamAnau mahAdyutI
shlokas.29:
tatpravRRittaM nishAyuddhaM chiraM samamivAbhavat |
prANayordIvyato rAjankarNarAkShasayormRRidhe
shlokas.30:
tasya sa.ndadhatastIkShNA~nsharA.nshchAsaktamasyataH |
dhanurghoSheNa vitrastAH sve pare cha tadAbhavan
ghaTotkachaM yadA karNo visheShayati no nRRipa
shlokas.31:
tataH prAduShkaroddivyamastramastravidAM varaH |
karNena vihitaM dRRiShTvA divyamastraM ghaTotkachaH
prAdushchakre mahAmAyAM rAkShasaH pANDunandanaH
shlokas.32:
shUlamudgaradhAriNyA shailapAdapahastayA |
rakShasAM ghorarUpANAM mahatyA senayA vRRitaH
shlokas.33:
tamudyatamahAchApaM dRRiShTvA te vyathitA nRRipAH |
bhUtAntakamivAyAntaM kAladaNDogradhAriNam
shlokas.34:
ghaTotkachapramuktena siMhanAdena bhIShitAH |
prasusruvurgajA mUtraM vivyathushcha narA bhRRisham
shlokas.35:
tato.ashmavRRiShTiratyugrA mahatyAsItsamantataH |
ardharAtre.adhikabalairvimuktA rakShasAM balaiH
shlokas.36:
AyasAni cha chakrANi bhushuNDyaH shaktitomarAH |
patantyaviralAH shUlAH shataghnyaH paTTishAstathA
shlokas.37:
tadugramatiraudraM cha dRRiShTvA yuddhaM narAdhipAH |
putrAshcha tava yodhAshcha vyathitA vipradudruvuH
shlokas.38:
tatraiko.astrabalashlAghI karNo mAnI na vivyathe |
vyadhamachcha sharairmAyAM ghaTotkachavinirmitAm
shlokas.39:
mAyAyAM tu prahINAyAmamarShAtsa ghaTotkachaH |
visasarja sharAnghorAnsUtaputraM ta Avishan
shlokas.40:
tataste rudhirAbhyaktA bhittvA karNaM mahAhave |
vivishurdharaNIM bANAH sa~NkruddhA iva pannagAH
shlokas.41:
sUtaputrastu sa~Nkruddho laghuhastaH pratApavAn |
ghaTotkachamatikramya bibheda dashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.42:
ghaTotkacho vinirbhinnaH sUtaputreNa marmasu |
chakraM divyaM sahasrAramagRRihNAdvyathito bhRRisham
shlokas.43:
kShurAntaM bAlasUryAbhaM maNiratnavibhUShitam |
chikShepAdhiratheH kruddho bhaimasenirjighA.nsayA
shlokas.44:
praviddhamativegena vikShiptaM karNasAyakaiH |
abhAgyasyeva sa~Nkalpastanmoghamapatadbhuvi
shlokas.45:
ghaTotkachastu sa~Nkruddho dRRiShTvA chakraM nipAtitam |
karNaM prAchChAdayadbANaiH svarbhAnuriva bhAskaram
shlokas.46:
sUtaputrastvasambhrAnto rudropendrendravikramaH |
ghaTotkacharathaM tUrNaM ChAdayAmAsa patribhiH
shlokas.47:
ghaTotkachena kruddhena gadA hemA~NgadA tadA |
kShiptA bhrAmya sharaiH sApi karNenAbhyAhatApatat
shlokas.48:
tato.antarikShamutpatya kAlamegha ivonnadan |
pravavarSha mahAkAyo drumavarShaM nabhastalAt
shlokas.49:
tato mAyAvinaM karNo bhImasenasutaM divi |
mArgaNairabhivivyAdha ghanaM sUrya ivA.nshubhiH
shlokas.50:
tasya sarvAnhayAnhatvA sa~nChidya shatadhA ratham |
abhyavarShachCharaiH karNaH parjanya iva vRRiShTimAn
shlokas.51:
na chAsyAsIdanirbhinnaM gAtre dvya~Ngulamantaram |
so.adRRishyata muhUrtena shvAvichChalalito yathA
shlokas.52:
na hayAnna rathaM tasya na dhvajaM na ghaTotkacham |
dRRiShTavantaH sma samare sharaughairabhisa.nvRRitam
shlokas.53:
sa tu karNasya taddivyamastramastreNa shAtayan |
mAyAyuddhena mAyAvI sUtaputramayodhayat
shlokas.54:
so.ayodhayattadA karNaM mAyayA lAghavena cha |
alakShyamANo.atha divi sharajAleShu sampatan
shlokas.55:
bhaimasenirmahAmAyo mAyayA kurusattama |
prachakAra mahAmAyAM mohayanniva bhArata
shlokas.56:
sa sma kRRitvA virUpANi vadanAnyashubhAnanaH |
agrasatsUtaputrasya divyAnyastrANi mAyayA
shlokas.57:
punashchApi mahAkAyaH sa~nChinnaH shatadhA raNe |
gatasattvo nirutsAhaH patitaH khAdvyadRRishyata
hataM taM manyamAnAH sma prANadankurupu~NgavAH
shlokas.58:
atha dehairnavairanyairdikShu sarvAsvadRRishyata |
punashchApi mahAkAyaH shatashIrShaH shatodaraH
shlokas.59:
vyadRRishyata mahAbAhurmainAka iva parvataH |
a~NguShThamAtro bhUtvA cha punareva sa rAkShasaH
sAgarormirivoddhUtastiryagUrdhvamavartata
shlokas.60:
vasudhAM dArayitvA cha punarapsu nyamajjata |
adRRishyata tadA tatra punarunmajjito.anyataH
shlokas.61:
so.avatIrya punastasthau rathe hemapariShkRRite |
kShitiM dyAM cha dishashchaiva mAyayAvRRitya da.nshitaH
shlokas.62:
gatvA karNarathAbhyAshaM vichalatkuNDalAnanaH |
prAha vAkyamasambhrAntaH sUtaputraM vishAM pate
shlokas.63:
tiShThedAnIM na me jIvansUtaputra gamiShyasi |
yuddhashraddhAmahaM te.adya vineShyAmi raNAjire
shlokas.64:
ityuktvA roShatAmrAkShaM rakShaH krUraparAkramam |
utpapAtAntarikShaM cha jahAsa cha suvisvaram
karNamabhyAhanachchaiva gajendramiva kesarI
shlokas.65:
rathAkShamAtrairiShubhirabhyavarShadghaTotkachaH |
rathinAmRRiShabhaM karNaM dhArAbhiriva toyadaH
sharavRRiShTiM cha tAM karNo dUraprAptAmashAtayat
shlokas.66:
dRRiShTvA cha vihatAM mAyAM karNena bharatarShabha |
ghaTotkachastato mAyAM sasarjAntarhitaH punaH
shlokas.67:
so.abhavadgirirityuchchaH shikharaistarusa~NkaTaiH |
shUlaprAsAsimusalajalaprasravaNo mahAn
shlokas.68:
tama~njanachayaprakhyaM karNo dRRiShTvA mahIdharam |
prapAtairAyudhAnyugrANyudvahantaM na chukShubhe
shlokas.69:
smayanniva tataH karNo divyamastramudIrayat |
tataH so.astreNa shailendro vikShipto vai vyanashyata
shlokas.70:
tataH sa toyado bhUtvA nIlaH sendrAyudho divi |
ashmavRRiShTibhiratyugraH sUtaputramavAkirat
shlokas.71:
atha sandhAya vAyavyamastramastravidAM varaH |
vyadhamatkAlameghaM taM karNo vaikartano vRRiShA
shlokas.72:
sa mArgaNagaNaiH karNo dishaH prachChAdya sarvashaH |
jaghAnAstraM mahArAja ghaTotkachasamIritam
shlokas.73:
tataH prahasya samare bhaimasenirmahAbalaH |
prAdushchakre mahAmAyAM karNaM prati mahAratham
shlokas.74:
sa dRRiShTvA punarAyAntaM rathena rathinAM varam |
ghaTotkachamasambhrAntaM rAkShasairbahubhirvRRitam
shlokas.76:
nAnAshastradharairghorairnAnAkavachabhUShaNaiH |
vRRitaM ghaTotkachaM krUrairmarudbhiriva vAsavam
dRRiShTvA karNo maheShvAso yodhayAmAsa rAkShasam
shlokas.77:
ghaTotkachastataH karNaM viddhvA pa~nchabhirAshugaiH |
nanAda bhairavaM nAdaM bhIShayansarvapArthivAn
shlokas.78:
bhUyashchA~njalikenAtha samArgaNagaNaM mahat |
karNahastasthitaM chApaM chichChedAshu ghaTotkachaH
shlokas.79:
athAnyaddhanurAdAya dRRiDhaM bhArasahaM mahat |
vyakarShata balAtkarNa indrAyudhamivochChritam
shlokas.81:
tadbANairarditaM yUthaM rakShasAM pInavakShasAm |
siMhenevArditaM vanyaM gajAnAmAkulaM kulam
shlokas.82:
vidhamya rAkShasAnbANaiH sAshvasUtagajAnvibhuH |
dadAha bhagavAnvahnirbhUtAnIva yugakShaye
shlokas.83:
sa hatvA rAkShasIM senAM shushubhe sUtanandanaH |
pureva tripuraM dagdhvA divi devo maheshvaraH
shlokas.84:
teShu rAjasahasreShu pANDaveyeShu mAriSha |
nainaM nirIkShitumapi kashchichChaknoti pArthiva
shlokas.86:
tasya kruddhasya netrAbhyAM pAvakaH samajAyata |
maholkAbhyAM yathA rAjansArchiShaH snehabindavaH
shlokas.87:
talaM talena saMhatya sa.ndashya dashanachChadam |
rathamAsthAya cha punarmAyayA nirmitaM punaH
shlokas.88:
yuktaM gajanibhairvAhaiH pishAchavadanaiH kharaiH |
sa sUtamabravItkruddhaH sUtaputrAya mA vaha
shlokas.89:
sa yayau ghorarUpeNa rathena rathinAM varaH |
dvairathaM sUtaputreNa punareva vishAM pate
shlokas.90:
sa chikShepa punaH kruddhaH sUtaputrAya rAkShasaH |
aShTachakrAM mahAghorAmashaniM rudranirmitAm
shlokas.91:
tAmavaplutya jagrAha karNo nyasya rathe dhanuH |
chikShepa chainAM tasyaiva syandanAtso.avapupluve
shlokas.92:
sAshvasUtadhvajaM yAnaM bhasma kRRitvA mahAprabhA |
vivesha vasudhAM bhittvA surAstatra visismiyuH
shlokas.93:
karNaM tu sarvabhUtAni pUjayAmAsura~njasA |
yadavaplutya jagrAha devasRRiShTAM mahAshanim
shlokas.94:
evaM kRRitvA raNe karNa Aruroha rathaM punaH |
tato mumocha nArAchAnsUtaputraH parantapaH
shlokas.95:
ashakyaM kartumanyena sarvabhUteShu mAnada |
yadakArShIttadA karNaH sa~NgrAme bhImadarshane
shlokas.96:
sa hanyamAno nArAchairdhArAbhiriva parvataH |
gandharvanagarAkAraH punarantaradhIyata
shlokas.97:
evaM sa vai mahAmAyo mAyayA lAghavena cha |
astrANi tAni divyAni jaghAna ripusUdanaH
shlokas.98:
nihanyamAneShvastreShu mAyayA tena rakShasA |
asambhrAntastataH karNastadrakShaH pratyayudhyata
shlokas.99:
tataH kruddho mahArAja bhaimasenirmahAbalaH |
chakAra bahudhAtmAnaM bhIShayANo narAdhipAn
shlokas.100:
tato digbhyaH samApetuH siMhavyAghratarakShavaH |
agnijihvAshcha bhujagA vihagAshchApyayomukhAH
shlokas.101:
sa kIryamANo nishitaiH karNachApachyutaiH sharaiH |
nagarAdrivanaprakhyastatraivAntaradhIyata
shlokas.102:
rAkShasAshcha pishAchAshcha yAtudhAnAH shalAvRRikAH |
te karNaM bhakShayiShyantaH sarvataH samupAdravan
athainaM vAgbhirugrAbhistrAsayAM chakrire tadA
shlokas.103:
udyatairbahubhirghorairAyudhaiH shoNitokShitaiH |
teShAmanekairekaikaM karNo vivyAdha chAshugaiH
shlokas.104:
pratihatya tu tAM mAyAM divyenAstreNa rAkShasIm |
AjaghAna hayAnasya sharaiH saMnataparvabhiH
shlokas.105:
te bhagnA vikRRitA~NgAshcha ChinnapRRiShThAshcha sAyakaiH |
vasudhAmanvapadyanta pashyatastasya rakShasaH
shlokas.106:
sa bhagnamAyo haiDimbaH karNaM vaikartanaM tataH |
eSha te vidadhe mRRityumityuktvAntaradhIyata

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasmi.nstathA vartamAne karNarAkShasayormRRidhe |
alAyudho rAkShasendro vIryavAnabhyavartata
shlokas.2:
mahatyA senayA yuktaH suyodhanamupAgamat |
rAkShasAnAM virUpANAM sahasraiH parivAritaH
nAnArUpadharairvIraiH pUrvavairamanusmaran
shlokas.3:
tasya j~nAtirhi vikrAnto brAhmaNAdo bako hataH |
kirmIrashcha mahAtejA hiDimbashcha sakhA tathA
shlokas.4:
sa dIrghakAlAdhyuShitaM pUrvavairamanusmaran |
vij~nAyaitannishAyuddhaM jighA.nsurbhImamAhave
shlokas.5:
sa matta iva mAta~NgaH sa~Nkruddha iva choragaH |
duryodhanamidaM vAkyamabravIdyuddhalAlasaH
shlokas.6:
viditaM te mahArAja yathA bhImena rAkShasAH |
hiDimbabakakirmIrA nihatA mama bAndhavAH
shlokas.7:
parAmarshashcha kanyAyA hiDimbAyAH kRRitaH purA |
kimanyadrAkShasAnanyAnasmA.nshcha paribhUya ha
shlokas.8:
tamahaM sagaNaM rAjansavAjirathaku~njaram |
haiDimbaM cha sahAmAtyaM hantumabhyAgataH svayam
shlokas.9:
adya kuntIsutAnsarvAnvAsudevapurogamAn |
hatvA sambhakShayiShyAmi sarvairanucharaiH saha
nivAraya balaM sarvaM vayaM yotsyAma pANDavAn
shlokas.10:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA hRRiShTo duryodhanastadA |
pratipUjyAbravIdvAkyaM bhrAtRRibhiH parivAritaH
shlokas.11:
tvAM puraskRRitya sagaNaM vayaM yotsyAmahe parAn |
na hi vairAntamanasaH sthAsyanti mama sainikAH
shlokas.12:
evamastviti rAjAnamuktvA rAkShasapu~NgavaH |
abhyayAttvarito bhImaM sahitaH puruShAshanaiH
shlokas.13:
dIpyamAnena vapuShA rathenAdityavarchasA |
tAdRRishenaiva rAjendra yAdRRishena ghaTotkachaH
shlokas.14:
tasyApyatulanirghoSho bahutoraNachitritaH |
RRikShacharmAvanaddhA~Ngo nalvamAtro mahArathaH
shlokas.15:
tasyApi turagAH shIghrA hastikAyAH kharasvanAH |
shataM yuktA mahAkAyA mA.nsashoNitabhojanAH
shlokas.16:
tasyApi rathanirghoSho mahAmegharavopamaH |
tasyApi sumahachchApaM dRRiDhajyaM balavattaram
shlokas.17:
tasyApyakShasamA bANA rukmapu~NkhAH shilAshitAH |
so.api vIro mahAbAhuryathaiva sa ghaTotkachaH
shlokas.18:
tasyApi gomAyubaDAbhigupto; babhUva keturjvalanArkatulyaH |
sa chApi rUpeNa ghaTotkachasya; shrImattamo vyAkuladIpitAsyaH
shlokas.19:
dIptA~Ngado dIptakirITamAlI; baddhasraguShNIShanibaddhakhaDgaH |
gadI bhushuNDI musalI halI cha; sharAsanI vAraNatulyavarShmA
shlokas.20:
rathena tenAnalavarchasA cha; vidrAvayanpANDavavAhinIM tAm |
rarAja sa~Nkhye parivartamAno; vidyunmAlI megha ivAntarikShe
shlokas.21:
te chApi sarve pravarA narendrA; mahAbalA varmiNashcharmiNashcha |
harShAnvitA yuyudhustatra rAja;nsamantataH pANDavayodhavIrAH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tamAgatamabhiprekShya bhImakarmANamAhave |
harShamAhArayAM chakruH kuravaH sarva eva te
shlokas.2:
tathaiva tava putrAste duryodhanapurogamAH |
aplavAH plavamAsAdya tartukAmA ivArNavam
shlokas.3:
punarjAtamivAtmAnaM manvAnAH pArthivAstadA |
alAyudhaM rAkShasendraM svAgatenAbhyapUjayan
shlokas.4:
tasmi.nstvamAnuShe yuddhe vartamAne bhayAvahe |
karNarAkShasayornaktaM dAruNapratidarshane
shlokas.5:
upapraikShanta pA~nchAlAH smayamAnAH sarAjakAH |
tathaiva tAvakA rAjanghUrNamAnAstatastataH
shlokas.6:
chukrushurnedamastIti droNadrauNikRRipAdayaH |
tatkarma dRRiShTvA sambhrAntA haiDimbasya raNAjire
shlokas.7:
sarvamAvignamabhavaddhAhAbhUtamachetanam |
tava sainyaM mahArAja nirAshaM karNajIvite
shlokas.8:
duryodhanastu samprekShya karNamArtiM parAM gatam |
alAyudhaM rAkShasendramAhUyedamathAbravIt
shlokas.9:
eSha vaikartanaH karNo haiDimbena samAgataH |
kurute karma sumahadyadasyaupayikaM mRRidhe
shlokas.10:
pashyaitAnpArthivA~nshUrAnnihatAnbhaimaseninA |
nAnAshastrairabhihatAnpAdapAniva dantinA
shlokas.11:
tavaiSha bhAgaH samare rAjamadhye mayA kRRitaH |
tavaivAnumate vIra taM vikramya nibarhaya
shlokas.12:
purA vaikartanaM karNameSha pApo ghaTotkachaH |
mAyAbalamupAshritya karshayatyarikarshanaH
shlokas.13:
evamuktaH sa rAj~nA tu rAkShasastIvravikramaH |
tathetyuktvA mahAbAhurghaTotkachamupAdravat
shlokas.14:
tataH karNaM samutsRRijya bhaimasenirapi prabho |
pratyamitramupAyAntaM mardayAmAsa mArgaNaiH
shlokas.15:
tayoH samabhavadyuddhaM kruddhayo rAkShasendrayoH |
mattayorvAshitAhetordvipayoriva kAnane
shlokas.16:
rakShasA vipramuktastu karNo.api rathinAM varaH |
abhyadravadbhImasenaM rathenAdityavarchasA
shlokas.17:
tamAyAntamanAdRRitya dRRiShTvA grastaM ghaTotkacham |
alAyudhena samare siMheneva gavAM patim
shlokas.18:
rathenAdityavapuShA bhImaH praharatAM varaH |
kira~nsharaughAnprayayAvalAyudharathaM prati
shlokas.19:
tamAyAntamabhiprekShya sa tadAlAyudhaH prabho |
ghaTotkachaM samutsRRijya bhImasenaM samAhvayat
shlokas.20:
taM bhImaH sahasAbhyetya rAkShasAntakaraH prabho |
sagaNaM rAkShasendraM taM sharavarShairavAkirat
shlokas.21:
tathaivAlAyudho rAja~nshilAdhautairajihmagaiH |
abhyavarShata kaunteyaM punaH punarari.ndamaH
shlokas.22:
tathA te rAkShasAH sarve bhImasenamupAdravan |
nAnApraharaNA bhImAstvatsutAnAM jayaiShiNaH
shlokas.23:
sa tADyamAno balibhirbhImaseno mahAbalaH |
pa~nchabhiH pa~nchabhiH sarvA.nstAnavidhyachChitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.24:
te vadhyamAnA bhImena rAkShasAH kharayonayaH |
vinedustumulAnnAdAndudruvushcha disho dasha
shlokas.25:
tA.nstrAsyamAnAnbhImena dRRiShTvA rakSho mahAbalam |
abhidudrAva vegena sharaishchainamavAkirat
shlokas.26:
taM bhImasenaH samare tIkShNAgrairakShiNochCharaiH |
alAyudhastu tAnastAnbhImena vishikhAnraNe
chichCheda kA.nshchitsamare tvarayA kA.nshchidagrahIt
shlokas.27:
sa taM dRRiShTvA rAkShasendraM bhImo bhImaparAkramaH |
gadAM chikShepa vegena vajrapAtopamAM tadA
shlokas.28:
tAmApatantIM vegena gadAM jvAlAkulAM tataH |
gadayA tADayAmAsa sA gadA bhImamAvrajat
shlokas.29:
sa rAkShasendraM kaunteyaH sharavarShairavAkirat |
tAnapyasyAkaronmoghAnrAkShaso nishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.30:
te chApi rAkShasAH sarve sainikA bhImarUpiNaH |
shAsanAdrAkShasendrasya nijaghnU rathaku~njarAn
shlokas.31:
pA~nchAlAH sRRi~njayAshchaiva vAjinaH paramadvipAH |
na shAntiM lebhire tatra rakShasairbhRRishapIDitAH
shlokas.32:
taM tu dRRiShTvA mahAghoraM vartamAnaM mahAhave |
abravItpuruShashreShTho dhana~njayamidaM vachaH
shlokas.33:
pashya bhImaM mahAbAho rAkShasendravashaM gatam |
padavImasya gachCha tvaM mA vichAraya pANDava
shlokas.34:
dhRRiShTadyumnaH shikhaNDI cha yudhAmanyUttamaujasau |
sahitA draupadeyAshcha karNaM yAntu mahArathAH
shlokas.35:
nakulaH sahadevashcha yuyudhAnashcha vIryavAn |
itarAnrAkShasAnghnantu shAsanAttava pANDava
shlokas.36:
tvamapImAM mahAbAho chamUM droNapuraskRRitAm |
vArayasva naravyAghra mahaddhi bhayamAgatam
shlokas.37:
evamukte tu kRRiShNena yathoddiShTA mahArathAH |
jagmurvaikartanaM karNaM rAkShasA.nshchetarAnraNe
shlokas.38:
atha pUrNAyatotsRRiShTaiH sharairAshIviShopamaiH |
dhanushchichCheda bhImasya rAkShasendraH pratApavAn
shlokas.39:
hayA.nshchAsya shitairbANaiH sArathiM cha mahAbalaH |
jaghAna miShataH sa~Nkhye bhImasenasya bhArata
shlokas.40:
so.avatIrya rathopasthAddhatAshvo hatasArathiH |
tasmai gurvIM gadAM ghorAM sa vinadyotsasarja ha
shlokas.41:
tatastAM bhImanirghoShAmApatantIM mahAgadAm |
gadayA rAkShaso ghoro nijaghAna nanAda cha
shlokas.42:
taddRRiShTvA rAkShasendrasya ghoraM karma bhayAvaham |
bhImasenaH prahRRiShTAtmA gadAmAshu parAmRRishat
shlokas.43:
tayoH samabhavadyuddhaM tumulaM nararakShasoH |
gadAnipAtasaMhrAdairbhuvaM kampayatorbhRRisham
shlokas.44:
gadAvimuktau tau bhUyaH samAsAdyetaretaram |
muShTibhirvajrasaMhrAdairanyonyamabhijaghnatuH
shlokas.45:
rathachakrairyugairakShairadhiShThAnairupaskaraiH |
yathAsannamupAdAya nijaghnaturamarShaNau
shlokas.46:
tau vikSharantau rudhiraM samAsAdyetaretaram |
mattAviva mahAnAgAvakRRiShyetAM punaH punaH
shlokas.47:
tamapashyaddhRRiShIkeshaH pANDavAnAM hite rataH |
sa bhImasenarakShArthaM haiDimbaM pratyachodayat

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
samprekShya samare bhImaM rakShasA grastamantikAt |
vAsudevo.abravIdvAkyaM ghaTotkachamidaM tadA
shlokas.2:
pashya bhImaM mahAbAho rakShasA grastamantikAt |
pashyatAM sarvasainyAnAM tava chaiva mahAdyute
shlokas.3:
sa karNaM tvaM samutsRRijya rAkShasendramalAyudham |
jahi kShipraM mahAbAho pashchAtkarNaM vadhiShyasi
shlokas.4:
sa vArShNeyavachaH shrutvA karNamutsRRijya vIryavAn |
yuyudhe rAkShasendreNa bakabhrAtrA ghaTotkachaH
tayoH sutumulaM yuddhaM babhUva nishi rakShasoH
shlokas.5:
alAyudhasya yodhA.nstu rAkShasAnbhImadarshanAn |
vegenApatataH shUrAnpragRRihItasharAsanAn
shlokas.6:
AttAyudhaH susa~Nkruddho yuyudhAno mahArathaH |
nakulaH sahadevashcha chichChidurnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.7:
sarvA.nshcha samare rAjankirITI kShatriyarShabhAn |
parichikShepa bIbhatsuH sarvataH prakShipa~nsharAn
shlokas.8:
karNashcha samare rAjanvyadrAvayata pArthivAn |
dhRRiShTadyumnashikhaNDyAdInpA~nchAlAnAM mahArathAn
shlokas.9:
tAnvadhyamAnAndRRiShTvA tu bhImo bhImaparAkramaH |
abhyayAttvaritaH karNaM vishikhAnvikiranraNe
shlokas.10:
tataste.apyAyayurhatvA rAkShasAnyatra sUtajaH |
nakulaH sahadevashcha sAtyakishcha mahArathaH
te karNaM yodhayAmAsuH pA~nchAlA droNameva cha
shlokas.11:
alAyudhastu sa~Nkruddho ghaTotkachamari.ndamam |
parigheNAtikAyena tADayAmAsa mUrdhani
shlokas.12:
sa tu tena prahAreNa bhaimasenirmahAbalaH |
IShanmUrChAnvito.a.atmAnaM sa.nstambhayata vIryavAn
shlokas.13:
tato dIptAgnisa~NkAshAM shataghaNTAmala~NkRRitAm |
chikShepa samare tasmai gadAM kA~nchanabhUShaNAm
shlokas.14:
sA hayAnsArathiM chaiva rathaM chAsya mahAsvanA |
chUrNayAmAsa vegena visRRiShTA bhImakarmaNA
shlokas.15:
sa bhagnahayachakrAkSho vishIrNadhvajakUbaraH |
utpapAta rathAttUrNaM mAyAmAsthAya rAkShasIm
shlokas.16:
sa samAsthAya mAyAM tu vavarSha rudhiraM bahu |
vidyudvibhrAjitaM chAsIttimirAbhrAkulaM nabhaH
shlokas.17:
tato vajranipAtAshcha sAshanistanayitnavaH |
mahA.nshchaTachaTAshabdastatrAsIddhi mahAhave
shlokas.18:
tAM prekShya vihitAM mAyAM rAkShaso rAkShasena tu |
Urdhvamutpatya haiDimbastAM mAyAM mAyayAvadhIt
shlokas.19:
so.abhivIkShya hatAM mAyAM mAyAvI mAyayaiva hi |
ashmavarShaM sutumulaM visasarja ghaTotkache
shlokas.20:
ashmavarShaM sa tadghoraM sharavarSheNa vIryavAn |
disho vidhva.nsayAmAsa tadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.21:
tato nAnApraharaNairanyonyamabhivarShatAm |
AyasaiH parighaiH shUlairgadAmusalamudgaraiH
shlokas.22:
pinAkaiH karavAlaishcha tomaraprAsakampanaiH |
nArAchairnishitairbhallaiH sharaishchakraiH parashvadhaiH
shlokas.23:
ayoguDairbhiNDipAlairgoshIrSholUkhalairapi |
utpATya cha mahAshAkhairvividhairjagatIruhaiH
shlokas.24:
shamIpIlukarIraishcha shamyAkaishchaiva bhArata |
i~NgudairbadarIbhishcha kovidAraishcha puShpitaiH
shlokas.25:
palAshairarimedaishcha plakShanyagrodhapippalaiH |
mahadbhiH samare tasminnanyonyamabhijaghnatuH
shlokas.26:
vividhaiH parvatAgraishcha nAnAdhAtubhirAchitaiH |
teShAM shabdo mahAnAsIdvajrANAM bhidyatAmiva
shlokas.27:
yuddhaM tadabhavadghoraM bhaimyalAyudhayornRRipa |
harIndrayoryathA rAjanvAlisugrIvayoH purA
shlokas.28:
tau yuddhvA vividhairghorairAyudhairvishikhaistathA |
pragRRihya nishitau khaDgAvanyonyamabhijaghnatuH
shlokas.29:
tAvanyonyamabhidrutya kesheShu sumahAbalau |
bhujAbhyAM paryagRRihNItAM mahAkAyau mahAbalau
shlokas.30:
tau bhinnagAtrau prasvedaM susruvAte janAdhipa |
rudhiraM cha mahAkAyAvabhivRRiShTAvivAchalau
shlokas.31:
athAbhipatya vegena samudbhrAmya cha rAkShasam |
balenAkShipya haiDimbashchakartAsya shiro mahat
shlokas.32:
so.apahRRitya shirastasya kuNDalAbhyAM vibhUShitam |
tadA sutumulaM nAdaM nanAda sumahAbalaH
shlokas.33:
hataM dRRiShTvA mahAkAyaM bakaj~nAtimari.ndamam |
pA~nchAlAH pANDavAshchaiva siMhanAdAnvinedire
shlokas.34:
tato bherIsahasrANi sha~NkhAnAmayutAni cha |
avAdayanpANDaveyAstasminrakShasi pAtite
shlokas.35:
atIva sA nishA teShAM babhUva vijayAvahA |
vidyotamAnA vibabhau samantAddIpamAlinI
shlokas.36:
alAyudhasya tu shiro bhaimasenirmahAbalaH |
duryodhanasya pramukhe chikShepa gatachetanam
shlokas.37:
atha duryodhano rAjA dRRiShTvA hatamalAyudham |
babhUva paramodvignaH saha sainyena bhArata
shlokas.38:
tena hyasya pratij~nAtaM bhImasenamahaM yudhi |
hanteti svayamAgamya smaratA vairamuttamam
shlokas.39:
dhruvaM sa tena hantavya ityamanyata pArthivaH |
jIvitaM chirakAlAya bhrAtR^INAM chApyamanyata
shlokas.40:
sa taM dRRiShTvA vinihataM bhImasenAtmajena vai |
pratij~nAM bhImasenasya pUrNAmevAbhyamanyata

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
nihatyAlAyudhaM rakShaH prahRRiShTAtmA ghaTotkachaH |
nanAda vividhAnnAdAnvAhinyAH pramukhe sthitaH
shlokas.2:
tasya taM tumulaM shabdaM shrutvA ku~njarakampanam |
tAvakAnAM mahArAja bhayamAsItsudAruNam
shlokas.3:
alAyudhaviShaktaM tu bhaimaseniM mahAbalam |
dRRiShTvA karNo mahAbAhuH pA~nchAlAnsamupAdravat
shlokas.4:
dashabhirdashabhirbANairdhRRiShTadyumnashikhaNDinau |
dRRiDhaiH pUrNAyatotsRRiShTairbibheda nataparvabhiH
shlokas.5:
tataH paramanArAchairyudhAmanyUttamaujasau |
sAtyakiM cha rathodAraM kampayAmAsa mArgaNaiH
shlokas.6:
teShAmabhyasyatAM tatra sarveShAM savyadakShiNam |
maNDalAnyeva chApAni vyadRRishyanta janAdhipa
shlokas.7:
teShAM jyAtalanirghoSho rathanemisvanashcha ha |
meghAnAmiva gharmAnte babhUva tumulo nishi
shlokas.8:
jyAnemighoShastanayitnumAnvai; dhanustaDinmaNDalaketushRRi~NgaH |
sharaughavarShAkulavRRiShTimA.nshcha; sa~NgrAmameghaH sa babhUva rAjan
shlokas.9:
taduddhataM shaila ivAprakampyo; varShaM mahachChailasamAnasAraH |
vidhva.nsayAmAsa raNe narendra; vaikartanaH shatrugaNAvamardI
shlokas.10:
tato.atulairvajranipAtakalpaiH; shitaiH sharaiH kA~nchanachitrapu~NkhaiH |
shatrUnvyapohatsamare mahAtmA; vaikartanaH putrahite rataste
shlokas.11:
sa~nChinnabhinnadhvajinashcha ke chi;tkechichCharairarditabhinnadehAH |
kechidvisUtA vihayAshcha ke chi;dvaikartanenAshu kRRitA babhUvuH
shlokas.12:
avindamAnAstvatha sharma sa~Nkhye; yaudhiShThiraM te balamanvapadyan |
tAnprekShya bhagnAnvimukhIkRRitA.nshcha; ghaTotkacho roShamatIva chakre
shlokas.13:
AsthAya taM kA~nchanaratnachitraM; rathottamaM siMha ivonnanAda |
vaikartanaM karNamupetya chApi; vivyAdha vajrapratimaiH pRRiShatkaiH
shlokas.14:
tau karNinArAchashilImukhaishcha; nAlIkadaNDaishcha savatsadantaiH |
varAhakarNaiH saviShANashRRi~NgaiH; kShurapravarShaishcha vinedatuH kham
shlokas.15:
tadbANadhArAvRRitamantarikShaM; tiryaggatAbhiH samare rarAja |
suvarNapu~NkhajvalitaprabhAbhi;rvichitrapuShpAbhiriva srajAbhiH
shlokas.16:
samaM hi tAvapratimaprabhAvA;vanyonyamAjaghnaturuttamAstraiH |
tayorhi vIrottamayorna kashchi;ddadarsha tasminsamare visheSham
shlokas.17:
atIva tachchitramatIva rUpaM; babhUva yuddhaM ravibhImasUnvoH |
samAkulaM shastranipAtaghoraM; divIva rAhva.nshumatoH prataptam
shlokas.18:
ghaTotkacho yadA karNaM na visheShayate nRRipa |
tadA prAdushchakArogramastramastravidAM varaH
shlokas.19:
tenAstreNa hayAnpUrvaM hatvA karNasya rAkShasaH |
sArathiM chaiva haiDimbaH kShipramantaradhIyata
shlokas.20:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tathA hyantarhite tasminkUTayodhini rAkShase |
mAmakaiH pratipannaM yattanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.21:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
antarhitaM rAkShasaM taM viditvA; samprAkroshankuravaH sarva eva |
kathaM nAyaM rAkShasaH kUTayodhI; hanyAtkarNaM samare.adRRishyamAnaH
shlokas.22:
tataH karNo laghuchitrAstrayodhI; sarvA disho vyAvRRiNodbANajAlaiH |
na vai ki~nchidvyApatattatra bhUtaM; tamobhUte sAyakairantarikShe
shlokas.23:
na chAdadAno na cha sa.ndadhAno; na cheShudhI spRRishamAnaH karAgraiH |
adRRishyadvai lAghavAtsUtaputraH; sarvaM bANaishChAdayAno.antarikSham
shlokas.24:
tato mAyAM vihitAmantarikShe; ghorAM bhImAM dAruNAM rAkShasena |
sampashyAmo lohitAbhraprakAshAM; dedIpyantImagnishikhAmivogrAm
shlokas.25:
tatastasyA vidyutaH prAdurAsa;nnulkAshchApi jvalitAH kauravendra |
ghoShashchAnyaH prAdurAsItsughoraH; sahasrasho nadatAM dundubhInAm
shlokas.26:
tataH sharAH prApatanrukmapu~NkhAH; shaktyaH prAsA musalAnyAyudhAni |
parashvadhAstailadhautAshcha khaDgAH; pradIptAgrAH paTTishAstomarAshcha
shlokas.27:
mayUkhinaH parighA lohabaddhA; gadAshchitrAH shitadhArAshcha shUlAH |
gurvyo gadA hemapaTTAvanaddhAH; shataghnyashcha prAdurAsansamantAt
shlokas.28:
mahAshilAshchApata.nstatra tatra; sahasrashaH sAshanayaH savajrAH |
chakrANi chAnekashatakShurANi; prAdurbabhUvurjvalanaprabhANi
shlokas.29:
tAM shaktipAShANaparashvadhAnAM; prAsAsivajrAshanimudgarANAm |
vRRiShTiM vishAlAM jvalitAM patantIM; karNaH sharaughairna shashAka hantum
shlokas.30:
sharAhatAnAM patatAM hayAnAM; vajrAhatAnAM patatAM gajAnAm |
shilAhatAnAM cha mahArathAnAM; mahAnninAdaH patatAM babhUva
shlokas.31:
subhImanAnAvidhashastrapAtai;rghaTotkachenAbhihataM samantAt |
dauryodhanaM tadbalamArtarUpa;mAvartamAnaM dadRRishe bhramantam
shlokas.32:
hAhAkRRitaM samparivartamAnaM; sa.nlIyamAnaM cha viShaNNarUpam |
te tvAryabhAvAtpuruShapravIrAH; parA~NmukhA na babhUvustadAnIm
shlokas.33:
tAM rAkShasIM ghoratarAM subhImAM; vRRiShTiM mahAshastramayIM patantIm |
dRRiShTvA balaughA.nshcha nipAtyamAnA;nmahadbhayaM tava putrAnvivesha
shlokas.34:
shivAshcha vaishvAnaradIptajihvAH; subhImanAdAH shatasho nadantyaH |
rakShogaNAnnardatashchAbhivIkShya; narendrayodhA vyathitA babhUvuH
shlokas.35:
te dIptajihvAnanatIkShNadaMShTrA; vibhIShaNAH shailanikAshakAyAH |
nabhogatAH shaktiviShaktahastA; meghA vyamu~nchanniva vRRiShTimArgam
shlokas.36:
tairAhatAste sharashaktishUlai;rgadAbhirugraiH parighaishcha dIptaiH |
vajraiH pinAkairashaniprahArai;shchakraiH shataghnyunmathitAshcha petuH
shlokas.37:
huDA bhushuNDyo.ashmaguDAH shataghnyaH; sthUNAshcha kArShNAyasapaTTanaddhAH |
avAkira.nstava putrasya sainyaM; tathA raudraM kashmalaM prAdurAsIt
shlokas.38:
niShkIrNAntrA vihatairuttamA~NgaiH; sambhagnA~NgAH sherate tatra shUrAH |
bhinnA hayAH ku~njarAshchAvabhagnAH; sa~nchUrNitAshchaiva rathAH shilAbhiH
shlokas.39:
evaM mahachChastravarShaM sRRijanta;ste yAtudhAnA bhuvi ghorarUpAH |
mAyAH sRRiShTAstatra ghaTotkachena; nAmu~nchanvai yAchamAnaM na bhItam
shlokas.40:
tasminghore kuruvIrAvamarde; kAlotsRRiShTe kShatriyANAmabhAve |
te vai bhagnAH sahasA vyadravanta; prAkroshantaH kauravAH sarva eva
shlokas.41:
palAyadhvaM kuravo naitadasti; sendrA devA ghnanti naH pANDavArthe |
tathA teShAM majjatAM bhAratAnAM; na sma dvIpastatra kashchidbabhUva
shlokas.42:
tasminsa~Nkrande tumule vartamAne; sainye bhagne lIyamAne kurUNAm |
anIkAnAM pravibhAge.aprakAshe; na j~nAyante kuravo netare vA
shlokas.43:
nirmaryAde vidrave ghorarUpe; sarvA dishaH prekShamANAH sma shUnyAH |
tAM shastravRRiShTimurasA gAhamAnaM; karNaM chaikaM tatra rAjannapashyam
shlokas.44:
tato bANairAvRRiNodantarikShaM; divyAM mAyAM yodhayanrAkShasasya |
hrImAnkurvanduShkaramAryakarma; naivAmuhyatsa.nyuge sUtaputraH
shlokas.45:
tato bhItAH samudaikShanta karNaM; rAjansarve saindhavA bAhlikAshcha |
asaMmohaM pUjayanto.asya sa~Nkhye; sampashyanto vijayaM rAkShasasya
shlokas.46:
tenotsRRiShTA chakrayuktA shataghnI; samaM sarvA.nshchaturo.ashvA~njaghAna |
te jAnubhirjagatImanvapadya;ngatAsavo nirdashanAkShijihvAH
shlokas.47:
tato hatAshvAdavaruhya vAhA;dantarmanAH kuruShu prAdravatsu |
divye chAstre mAyayA vadhyamAne; naivAmuhyachchintayanprAptakAlam
shlokas.48:
tato.abruvankuravaH sarva eva; karNaM dRRiShTvA ghorarUpAM cha mAyAm |
shaktyA rakSho jahi karNAdya tUrNaM; nashyantyete kuravo dhArtarAShTrAH
shlokas.49:
kariShyataH kiM cha no bhImapArthau; tapantamenaM jahi rakSho nishIthe |
yo naH sa~NgrAmAdghorarUpAdvimuchye;tsa naH pArthAnsamare yodhayeta
shlokas.50:
tasmAdenaM rAkShasaM ghorarUpaM; jahi shaktyA dattayA vAsavena |
mA kauravAH sarva evendrakalpA; rAtrImukhe karNa neshuH sayodhAH
shlokas.51:
sa vadhyamAno rakShasA vai nishIthe; dRRiShTvA rAjannashyamAnaM balaM cha |
mahachcha shrutvA ninadaM kauravANAM; matiM dadhre shaktimokShAya karNaH
shlokas.52:
sa vai kruddhaH siMha ivAtyamarShI; nAmarShayatpratighAtaM raNe tam |
shaktiM shreShThAM vaijayantImasahyAM; samAdade tasya vadhaM chikIrShan
shlokas.53:
yAsau rAjannihitA varShapUgA;nvadhAyAjau satkRRitA phalgunasya |
yAM vai prAdAtsUtaputrAya shakraH; shaktiM shreShThAM kuNDalAbhyAM nimAya
shlokas.54:
tAM vai shaktiM lelihAnAM pradIptAM; pAshairyuktAmantakasyeva rAtrim |
mRRityoH svasAraM jvalitAmivolkAM; vaikartanaH prAhiNodrAkShasAya
shlokas.55:
tAmuttamAM parakAyApahantrIM; dRRiShTvA sauterbAhusa.nsthAM jvalantIm |
bhItaM rakSho vipradudrAva rAja;nkRRitvAtmAnaM vindhyapAdapramANam
shlokas.56:
dRRiShTvA shaktiM karNabAhvantarasthAM; nedurbhUtAnyantarikShe narendra |
vavurvAtAstumulAshchApi rAja;nsanirghAtA chAshAnirgAM jagAma
shlokas.57:
sA tAM mAyAM bhasma kRRitvA jvalantI; bhittvA gADhaM hRRidayaM rAkShasasya |
UrdhvaM yayau dIpyamAnA nishAyAM; nakShatrANAmantarANyAvishantI
shlokas.58:
yuddhvA chitrairvividhaiH shastrapUgai;rdivyairvIro mAnuShai rAkShasaishcha |
nadannAdAnvividhAnbhairavA.nshcha; prANAniShTA.nstyAjitaH shakrashaktyA
shlokas.59:
idaM chAnyachchitramAshcharyarUpaM; chakArAsau karma shatrukShayAya |
tasminkAle shaktinirbhinnamarmA; babhau rAjanmeghashailaprakAshaH
shlokas.60:
tato.antarikShAdapatadgatAsuH; sa rAkShasendro bhuvi bhinnadehaH |
avAkShirAH stabdhagAtro vijihvo; ghaTotkacho mahadAsthAya rUpam
shlokas.61:
sa tadrUpaM bhairavaM bhImakarmA; bhImaM kRRitvA bhaimaseniH papAta |
hato.apyevaM tava sainyekadesha;mapothayatkauravAnbhIShayANaH
shlokas.62:
tato mishrAH prANadansiMhanAdai;rbheryaH sha~NkhA murajAshchAnakAshcha |
dagdhAM mAyAM nihataM rAkShasaM cha; dRRiShTvA hRRiShTAH prANadankauraveyAH
shlokas.63:
tataH karNaH kurubhiH pUjyamAno; yathA shakro vRRitravadhe marudbhiH |
anvArUDhastava putraM rathasthaM; hRRiShTashchApi prAvishatsvaM sa sainyam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
haiDimbaM nihataM dRRiShTvA vikIrNamiva parvatam |
pANDavA dInamanasaH sarve bAShpAkulekShaNAH
shlokas.2:
vAsudevastu harSheNa mahatAbhipariplutaH |
nanAda siMhavannAdaM vyathayanniva bhArata
vinadya cha mahAnAdaM paryaShvajata phalgunam
shlokas.3:
sa vinadya mahAnAdamabhIshUnsaMniyamya cha |
nanarta harShasa.nvIto vAtoddhUta iva drumaH
shlokas.4:
tato vinirbhrAmya punaH pArthamAsphoTya chAsakRRit |
rathopasthagato bhImaM prANadatpunarachyutaH
shlokas.5:
prahRRiShTamanasaM j~nAtvA vAsudevaM mahAbalam |
abravIdarjuno rAjannAtihRRiShTamanA iva
shlokas.6:
atiharSho.ayamasthAne tavAdya madhusUdana |
shokasthAne pare prApte haiDimbasya vadhena vai
shlokas.7:
vimukhAni cha sainyAni hataM dRRiShTvA ghaTotkacham |
vayaM cha bhRRishamAvignA haiDimbasya nipAtanAt
shlokas.8:
naitatkAraNamalpaM hi bhaviShyati janArdana |
tadadya sha.nsa me pRRiShTaH satyaM satyavatAM vara
shlokas.9:
yadyetanna rahasyaM te vaktumarhasyari.ndama |
dhairyasya vaikRRitaM brUhi tvamadya madhusUdana
shlokas.10:
samudrasyeva sa~NkShobho meroriva visarpaNam |
tathaitallAghavaM manye tava karma janArdana
shlokas.11:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
atiharShamimaM prAptaM shRRiNu me tvaM dhana~njaya |
atIva manasaH sadyaH prasAdakaramuttamam
shlokas.12:
shaktiM ghaTotkachenemAM vya.nsayitvA mahAdyute |
karNaM nihatamevAjau viddhi sadyo dhana~njaya
shlokas.13:
shaktihastaM punaH karNaM ko loke.asti pumAniha |
ya enamabhitastiShThetkArttikeyamivAhave
shlokas.14:
diShTyApanItakavacho diShTyApahRRitakuNDalaH |
diShTyA cha vya.nsitA shaktiramoghAsya ghaTotkache
shlokas.15:
yadi hi syAtsakavachastathaiva cha sakuNDalaH |
sAmarAnapi lokA.nstrInekaH karNo jayedbalI
shlokas.16:
vAsavo vA kubero vA varuNo vA jaleshvaraH |
yamo vA notsahetkarNaM raNe pratisamAsitum
shlokas.17:
gANDIvamAyamya bhavA.nshchakraM vAhaM sudarshanam |
na shaktau svo raNe jetuM tathAyuktaM nararShabham
shlokas.18:
tvaddhitArthaM tu shakreNa mAyayA hRRitakuNDalaH |
vihInakavachashchAyaM kRRitaH parapura~njayaH
shlokas.19:
utkRRitya kavachaM yasmAtkuNDale vimale cha te |
prAdAchChakrAya karNo vai tena vaikartanaH smRRitaH
shlokas.20:
AshIviSha iva kruddhaH stambhito mantratejasA |
tathAdya bhAti karNo me shAntajvAla ivAnalaH
shlokas.21:
yadA prabhRRiti karNAya shaktirdattA mahAtmanA |
vAsavena mahAbAho prAptA yAsau ghaTotkache
shlokas.22:
kuNDalAbhyAM nimAyAtha divyena kavachena cha |
tAM prApyAmanyata vRRiShA satataM tvAM hataM raNe
shlokas.23:
evaM gate.api shakyo.ayaM hantuM nAnyena kenachit |
RRite tvA puruShavyAghra shape satyena chAnagha
shlokas.24:
brahmaNyaH satyavAdI cha tapasvI niyatavrataH |
ripuShvapi dayAvA.nshcha tasmAtkarNo vRRiShA smRRitaH
shlokas.25:
yuddhashauNDo mahAbAhurnityodyatasharAsanaH |
kesarIva vane mardanmattamAta~NgayUthapAn
vimadAnrathashArdUlAnkurute raNamUrdhani
shlokas.26:
madhya~Ngata ivAdityo yo na shakyo nirIkShitum |
tvadIyaiH puruShavyAghra yodhamukhyairmahAtmabhiH
sharajAlasahasrA.nshuH sharadIva divAkaraH
shlokas.27:
tapAnte toyado yadvachCharadhArAH kSharatyasau |
divyAstrajaladaH karNaH parjanya iva vRRiShTimAn
so.adya mAnuShatAM prApto vimuktaH shakradattayA
shlokas.28:
eko hi yogo.asya bhavedvadhAya; Chidre hyenaM svapramattaH pramattam |
kRRichChraprAptaM rathachakre nimagne; hanyAH pUrvaM tvaM tu sa~nj~nAM vichArya
shlokas.29:
jarAsandhashchedirAjo mahAtmA; mahAbalashchaikalavyo niShAdaH |
ekaikasho nihatAH sarva eva; yogaistaistaistvaddhitArthaM mayaiva
shlokas.30:
athApare nihatA rAkShasendrA; hiDimbakirmIrabakapradhAnAH |
alAyudhaH parasainyAvamardI; ghaTotkachashchograkarmA tarasvI

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
kathamasmaddhitArthaM te kaishcha yogairjanArdana |
jarAsandhaprabhRRitayo ghAtitAH pRRithivIShvarAH
shlokas.2:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
jarAsandhashchedirAjo naiShAdishcha mahAbalaH |
yadi syurna hatAH pUrvamidAnIM syurbhaya~NkarAH
shlokas.3:
suyodhanastAnavashyaM vRRiNuyAdrathasattamAn |
te.asmAbhirnityasa.nduShTAH sa.nshrayeyushcha kauravAn
shlokas.4:
te hi vIrA mahAtmAnaH kRRitAstrA dRRiDhayodhinaH |
dhArtarAShTrIM chamUM kRRitsnAM rakSheyuramarA iva
shlokas.5:
sUtaputro jarAsandhashchedirAjo niShAdajaH |
suyodhanaM samAshritya taperanpRRithivImimAm
shlokas.6:
yogairapi hatA yaiste tAnme shRRiNu dhana~njaya |
ajayyA hi vinA yogairmRRidhe te daivatairapi
shlokas.7:
ekaiko hi pRRithakteShAM samastAM suravAhinIm |
yodhayetsamare pArtha lokapAlAbhirakShitAm
shlokas.8:
jarAsandho hi ruShito rauhiNeyapradharShitaH |
asmadvadhArthaM chikShepa gadAM vai lohitAmukhIm
shlokas.9:
sImantamiva kurvANAM nabhasaH pAvakaprabhAm |
vyadRRishyatApatantI sA shakramuktA yathAshaniH
shlokas.10:
tAmApatantIM dRRiShTvaiva gadAM rohiNinandanaH |
pratighAtArthamastraM vai sthUNAkarNamavAsRRijat
shlokas.11:
astravegapratihatA sA gadA prApatadbhuvi |
dArayantI dharAM devIM kampayantIva parvatAn
shlokas.12:
tatra sma rAkShasI ghorA jarA nAmAshuvikramA |
sandhayAmAsa taM jAtaM jarAsandhamari.ndamam
shlokas.13:
dvAbhyAM jAto hi mAtRRibhyAmardhadehaH pRRithakpRRithak |
tayA sa sandhito yasmAjjarAsandhastataH smRRitaH
shlokas.14:
sA tu bhUmigatA pArtha hatA sasutabAndhavA |
gadayA tena chAstreNa sthUNAkarNena rAkShasI
shlokas.15:
vinAbhUtaH sa gadayA jarAsandho mahAmRRidhe |
nihato bhImasenena pashyataste dhana~njaya
shlokas.16:
yadi hi syAdgadApANirjarAsandhaH pratApavAn |
sendrA devA na taM hantuM raNe shaktA narottama
shlokas.17:
tvaddhitArthaM hi naiShAdira~NguShThena viyojitaH |
droNenAchAryakaM kRRitvA ChadmanA satyavikramaH
shlokas.18:
sa tu baddhA~NgulitrANo naiShAdirdRRiDhavikramaH |
asyanneko vanacharo babhau rAma ivAparaH
shlokas.19:
ekalavyaM hi sA~NguShThamashaktA devadAnavAH |
sarAkShasoragAH pArtha vijetuM yudhi karhichit
shlokas.20:
kimu mAnuShamAtreNa shakyaH syAtprativIkShitum |
dRRiDhamuShTiH kRRitI nityamasyamAno divAnisham
shlokas.21:
tvaddhitArthaM tu sa mayA hataH sa~NgrAmamUrdhani |
chedirAjashcha vikrAntaH pratyakShaM nihatastava
shlokas.22:
sa chApyashakyaH sa~NgrAme jetuM sarvaiH surAsuraiH |
vadhArthaM tasya jAto.ahamanyeShAM cha suradviShAm
shlokas.23:
tvatsahAyo naravyAghra lokAnAM hitakAmyayA |
hiDimbabakakirmIrA bhImasenena pAtitAH
rAvaNena samaprANA brahmayaj~navinAshanAH
shlokas.24:
hatastathaiva mAyAvI haiDimbenApyalAyudhaH |
haiDimbashchApyupAyena shaktyA karNena ghAtitaH
shlokas.25:
yadi hyenaM nAhaniShyatkarNaH shaktyA mahAmRRidhe |
mayA vadhyo.abhaviShyatsa bhaimasenirghaTotkachaH
shlokas.26:
mayA na nihataH pUrvameSha yuShmatpriyepsayA |
eSha hi brAhmaNadveShI yaj~nadveShI cha rAkShasaH
shlokas.27:
dharmasya loptA pApAtmA tasmAdeSha nipAtitaH |
vya.nsitA chApyupAyena shakradattA mayAnagha
shlokas.28:
ye hi dharmasya loptAro vadhyAste mama pANDava |
dharmasa.nsthApanArthaM hi pratij~naiShA mamAvyayA
shlokas.29:
brahma satyaM damaH shauchaM dharmo hrIH shrIrdhRRitiH kShamA |
yatra tatra rame nityamahaM satyena te shape
shlokas.30:
na viShAdastvayA kAryaH karNaM vaikartanaM prati |
upadekShyAmyupAyaM te yena taM prasahiShyasi
shlokas.31:
suyodhanaM chApi raNe haniShyati vRRikodaraH |
tasya chApi vadhopAyaM vakShyAmi tava pANDava
shlokas.32:
vardhate tumulastveSha shabdaH parachamUM prati |
vidravanti cha sainyAni tvadIyAni disho dasha
shlokas.33:
labdhalakShyA hi kauravyA vidhamanti chamUM tava |
dahatyeSha cha vaH sainyaM droNaH praharatAM varaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
ekavIravadhe moghA shaktiH sUtAtmaje yadA |
kasmAtsarvAnsamutsRRijya sa tAM pArthe na muktavAn
shlokas.2:
tasminhate hatA hi syuH sarve pANDavasRRi~njayAH |
ekavIravadhe kasmAnna yuddhe jayamAdadhat
shlokas.3:
AhUto na nivarteyamiti tasya mahAvratam |
svayamAhvayitavyaH sa sUtaputreNa phalgunaH
shlokas.4:
tato dvairathamAnIya phalgunaM shakradattayA |
na jaghAna vRRiShA kasmAttanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.5:
nUnaM buddhivihInashchApyasahAyashcha me sutaH |
shatrubhirvya.nsitopAyaH kathaM nu sa jayedarIn
shlokas.6:
yA hyasya paramA shaktirjayasya cha parAyaNam |
sA shaktirvAsudevena vya.nsitAsya ghaTotkache
shlokas.7:
kuNeryathA hastagataM hriyedbilvaM balIyasA |
tathA shaktiramoghA sA moghIbhUtA ghaTotkache
shlokas.8:
yathA varAhasya shunashcha yudhyato;stayorabhAve shvapachasya lAbhaH |
manye vidvanvAsudevasya tadva;dyuddhe lAbhaH karNahaiDimbayorvai
shlokas.9:
ghaTotkacho yadi hanyAddhi karNaM; paro lAbhaH sa bhavetpANDavAnAm |
vaikartano vA yadi taM nihanyA;ttathApi kRRityaM shaktinAshAtkRRitaM syAt
shlokas.10:
iti prAj~naH praj~nayaitadvichArya; ghaTotkachaM sUtaputreNa yuddhe |
ayodhayadvAsudevo nRRisiMhaH; priyaM kurvanpANDavAnAM hitaM cha
shlokas.11:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
etachchikIrShitaM j~nAtvA karNe madhunihA nRRipa |
niyojayAmAsa tadA dvairathe rAkShaseshvaram
shlokas.12:
ghaTotkachaM mahAvIryaM mahAbuddhirjanArdanaH |
amoghAyA vighAtArthaM rAjandurmantrite tava
shlokas.13:
tadaiva kRRitakAryA hi vayaM syAma kurUdvaha |
na rakShedyadi kRRiShNastaM pArthaM karNAnmahArathAt
shlokas.14:
sAshvadhvajarathaH sa~Nkhye dhRRitarAShTra patedbhuvi |
vinA janArdanaM pArtho yogAnAmIshvaraM prabhum
shlokas.15:
taistairupAyairbahubhI rakShyamANaH sa pArthiva |
jayatyabhimukhaH shatrUnpArthaH kRRiShNena pAlitaH
shlokas.16:
savisheShaM tvamoghAyAH kRRiShNo.arakShata pANDavam |
hanyAtkShiptA hi kaunteyaM shaktirvRRikShamivAshaniH
shlokas.17:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
virodhI cha kumantrI cha prAj~namAnI mamAtmajaH |
yasyaiSha samatikrAnto vadhopAyo jayaM prati
shlokas.18:
tavApi samatikrAntametadgAvalgaNe katham |
etamarthaM mahAbuddhe yattvayA nAvabodhitaH
shlokas.19:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
duryodhanasya shakunermama duHshAsanasya cha |
rAtrau rAtrau bhavatyeShA nityameva samarthanA
shlokas.20:
shvaH sarvasainyAnutsRRijya jahi karNa dhana~njayam |
preShyavatpANDupA~nchAlAnupabhokShyAmahe tataH
shlokas.21:
atha vA nihate pArthe pANDuShvanyatamaM tataH |
sthApayedyudhi vArShNeyastasmAtkRRiShNo nipAtyatAm
shlokas.22:
kRRiShNo hi mUlaM pANDUnAM pArthaH skandha ivodgataH |
shAkhA ivetare pArthAH pA~nchAlAH patrasa~nj~nitAH
shlokas.23:
kRRiShNAshrayAH kRRiShNabalAH kRRiShNanAthAshcha pANDavAH |
kRRiShNaH parAyaNaM chaiShAM jyotiShAmiva chandramAH
shlokas.24:
tasmAtparNAni shAkhAshcha skandhaM chotsRRijya sUtaja |
kRRiShNaM nikRRindhi pANDUnAM mUlaM sarvatra sarvadA
shlokas.25:
hanyAdyadi hi dAshArhaM karNo yAdavanandanam |
kRRitsnA vasumatI rAjanvashe te syAnna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.26:
yadi hi sa nihataH shayIta bhUmau; yadukulapANDavanandano mahAtmA |
nanu tava vasudhA narendra sarvA; sagirisamudravanA vashaM vrajeta
shlokas.27:
sA tu buddhiH kRRitApyevaM jAgrati tridasheshvare |
aprameye hRRiShIkeshe yuddhakAle vyamuhyata
shlokas.28:
arjunaM chApi kaunteyaM sadA rakShati keshavaH |
na hyenamaichChatpramukhe sauteH sthApayituM raNe
shlokas.29:
anyA.nshchAsmai rathodArAnupasthApayadachyutaH |
amoghAM tAM kathaM shaktiM moghAM kuryAmiti prabho
shlokas.30:
tataH kRRiShNaM mahAbAhuH sAtyakiH satyavikramaH |
paprachCha rathashArdUla karNaM prati mahAratham
shlokas.31:
ayaM cha pratyayaH karNe shaktyA chAmitavikrama |
kimarthaM sUtaputreNa na muktA phalgune tu sA
shlokas.32:
vAsudeva uvAcha||
duHShAsanashcha karNashcha shakunishcha sasaindhavaH |
satataM mantrayanti sma duryodhanapurogamAH
shlokas.33:
karNa karNa maheShvAsa raNe.amitaparAkrama |
nAnyasya shaktireShA te moktavyA jayatAM vara
shlokas.34:
RRite mahArathAtpArthAtkuntIputrAddhana~njayAt |
sa hi teShAmatiyashA devAnAmiva vAsavaH
shlokas.35:
tasminvinihate sarve pANDavAH sRRi~njayaiH saha |
bhaviShyanti gatAtmAnaH surA iva niragnayaH
shlokas.36:
tatheti cha pratij~nAtaM karNena shinipu~Ngava |
hRRidi nityaM tu karNasya vadho gANDIvadhanvanaH
shlokas.37:
ahameva tu rAdheyaM mohayAmi yudhAM vara |
yato nAvasRRijachChaktiM pANDave shvetavAhane
shlokas.38:
phalgunasya hi tAM mRRityumavagamya yuyutsataH |
na nidrA na cha me harSho manaso.asti yudhAM vara
shlokas.39:
ghaTotkache vya.nsitAM tu dRRiShTvA tAM shinipu~Ngava |
mRRityorAsyAntarAnmuktaM pashyAmyadya dhana~njayam
shlokas.40:
na pitA na cha me mAtA na yUyaM bhrAtarastathA |
na cha prANAstathA rakShyA yathA bIbhatsurAhave
shlokas.41:
trailokyarAjyAdyatki~nchidbhavedanyatsudurlabham |
nechCheyaM sAtvatAhaM tadvinA pArthaM dhana~njayam
shlokas.42:
ataH praharShaH sumahAnyuyudhAnAdya me.abhavat |
mRRitaM pratyAgatamiva dRRiShTvA pArthaM dhana~njayam
shlokas.43:
atashcha prahito yuddhe mayA karNAya rAkShasaH |
na hyanyaH samare rAtrau shaktaH karNaM prabAdhitum
shlokas.44:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
iti sAtyakaye prAha tadA devakinandanaH |
dhana~njayahite yuktastatpriye satataM rataH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
karNaduryodhanAdInAM shakuneH saubalasya cha |
apanItaM mahattAta tava chaiva visheShataH
shlokas.2:
yadAjAnIta tAM shaktimekaghnIM satataM raNe |
anivAryAmasahyAM cha devairapi savAsavaiH
shlokas.3:
sA kimarthaM na karNena pravRRitte samare purA |
na devakIsute muktA phalgune vApi sa~njaya
shlokas.4:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sa~NgrAmAdvinivRRittAnAM sarveShAM no vishAM pate |
rAtrau kurukulashreShTha mantro.ayaM samajAyata
shlokas.5:
prabhAtamAtre shvobhUte keshavAyArjunAya vA |
shaktireShA vimoktavyA karNa karNeti nityashaH
shlokas.6:
tataH prabhAtasamaye rAjankarNasya daivataiH |
anyeShAM chaiva yodhAnAM sA buddhirnashyate punaH
shlokas.7:
daivameva paraM manye yatkarNo hastasa.nsthayA |
na jaghAna raNe pArthaM kRRiShNaM vA devakIsutam
shlokas.8:
tasya hastasthitA shaktiH kAlarAtririvodyatA |
daivopahatabuddhitvAnna tAM karNo vimuktavAn
shlokas.9:
kRRiShNe vA devakIputre mohito devamAyayA |
pArthe vA shakrakalpe vai vadhArthaM vAsavIM prabho
shlokas.10:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
daivenaiva hatA yUyaM svabuddhyA keshavasya cha |
gatA hi vAsavI hatvA tRRiNabhUtaM ghaTotkacham
shlokas.11:
karNashcha mama putrAshcha sarve chAnye cha pArthivAH |
anena duShpraNItena gatA vaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.12:
bhUya eva tu me sha.nsa yathA yuddhamavartata |
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha haiDimbe nihate tadA
shlokas.13:
ye cha te.abhyadravandroNaM vyUDhAnIkAH prahAriNaH |
sRRi~njayAH saha pA~nchAlaiste.apyakurvankathaM raNam
shlokas.14:
saumadattervadhAddroNamAyastaM saindhavasya cha |
amarShAjjIvitaM tyaktvA gAhamAnaM varUthinIm
shlokas.15:
jRRimbhamANamiva vyAghraM vyAttAnanamivAntakam |
kathaM pratyudyayurdroNamasyantaM pANDusRRi~njayAH
shlokas.16:
AchAryaM ye cha te.arakShanduryodhanapurogamAH |
drauNikarNakRRipAstAta te.apyakurvankimAhave
shlokas.17:
bhAradvAjaM jighA.nsantau savyasAchivRRikodarau |
samArChanmAmakA yuddhe kathaM sa~njaya sha.nsa me
shlokas.18:
sindhurAjavadheneme ghaTotkachavadhena te |
amarShitAH susa~NkruddhA raNaM chakruH kathaM nishi
shlokas.19:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
hate ghaTotkache rAjankarNena nishi rAkShase |
praNadatsu cha hRRiShTeShu tAvakeShu yuyutsuShu
shlokas.20:
Apatatsu cha vegena vadhyamAne bale.api cha |
vigADhAyAM rajanyAM cha rAjA dainyaM paraM gataH
shlokas.21:
abravIchcha mahAbAhurbhImasenaM parantapaH |
AvAraya mahAbAho dhArtarAShTrasya vAhinIm
haiDimbasyAbhighAtena moho mAmAvishanmahAn
shlokas.22:
evaM bhImaM samAdishya svarathe samupAvishat |
ashrupUrNamukho rAjA niHshvasa.nshcha punaH punaH
kashmalaM prAvishadghoraM dRRiShTvA karNasya vikramam
shlokas.23:
taM tathA vyathitaM dRRiShTvA kRRiShNo vachanamabravIt |
mA vyathAM kuru kaunteya naitattvayyupapadyate
vaiklavyaM bharatashreShTha yathA prAkRRitapUruShe
shlokas.24:
uttiShTha rAjanyudhyasva vaha gurvIM dhuraM vibho |
tvayi vaiklavyamApanne sa.nshayo vijaye bhavet
shlokas.25:
shrutvA kRRiShNasya vachanaM dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
vimRRijya netre pANibhyAM kRRiShNaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.26:
viditA te mahAbAho dharmANAM paramA gatiH |
brahmahatyAphalaM tasya yaH kRRitaM nAvabudhyate
shlokas.27:
asmAkaM hi vanasthAnAM haiDimbena mahAtmanA |
bAlenApi satA tena kRRitaM sAhyaM janArdana
shlokas.28:
astrahetorgataM j~nAtvA pANDavaM shvetavAhanam |
asau kRRiShNa maheShvAsaH kAmyake mAmupasthitaH
uShitashcha sahAsmAbhiryAvannAsIddhana~njayaH
shlokas.29:
gandhamAdanayAtrAyAM durgebhyashcha sma tAritAH |
pA~nchAlI cha parishrAntA pRRiShThenoDhA mahAtmanA
shlokas.30:
ArambhAchchaiva yuddhAnAM yadeSha kRRitavAnprabho |
madarthaM duShkaraM karma kRRitaM tena mahAtmanA
shlokas.31:
svabhAvAdyA cha me prItiH sahadeve janArdana |
saiva me dviguNA prItI rAkShasendre ghaTotkache
shlokas.32:
bhaktashcha me mahAbAhuH priyo.asyAhaM priyashcha me |
yena vindAmi vArShNeya kashmalaM shokatApitaH
shlokas.33:
pashya sainyAni vArShNeya drAvyamANAni kauravaiH |
droNakarNau cha sa.nyattau pashya yuddhe mahArathau
shlokas.34:
nishIthe pANDavaM sainyamAbhyAM pashya pramarditam |
gajAbhyAmiva mattAbhyAM yathA naDavanaM mahat
shlokas.35:
anAdRRitya balaM bAhvorbhImasenasya mAdhava |
chitrAstratAM cha pArthasya vikramante sma kauravAH
shlokas.36:
eSha droNashcha karNashcha rAjA chaiva suyodhanaH |
nihatya rAkShasaM yuddhe hRRiShTA nardanti sa.nyuge
shlokas.37:
kathamasmAsu jIvatsu tvayi chaiva janArdana |
haiDimbaH prAptavAnmRRityuM sUtaputreNa sa~NgataH
shlokas.38:
kadarthIkRRitya naH sarvAnpashyataH savyasAchinaH |
nihato rAkShasaH kRRiShNa bhaimasenirmahAbalaH
shlokas.39:
yadAbhimanyurnihato dhArtarAShTrairdurAtmabhiH |
nAsIttatra raNe kRRiShNa savyasAchI mahArathaH
shlokas.40:
niruddhAshcha vayaM sarve saindhavena durAtmanA |
nimittamabhavaddroNaH saputrastatra karmaNi
shlokas.41:
upadiShTo vadhopAyaH karNasya guruNA svayam |
vyAyachChatashcha khaDgena dvidhA khaDgaM chakAra ha
shlokas.42:
vyasane vartamAnasya kRRitavarmA nRRisha.nsavat |
ashvA~njaghAna sahasA tathobhau pArShNisArathI
tathetare maheShvAsAH saubhadraM yudhyapAtayan
shlokas.43:
alpe cha kAraNe kRRiShNa hato gANDIvadhanvanA |
saindhavo yAdavashreShTha tachcha nAtipriyaM mama
shlokas.44:
yadi shatruvadhe nyAyyo bhavetkartuM cha pANDavaiH |
droNakarNau raNe pUrvaM hantavyAviti me matiH
shlokas.45:
etau mUlaM hi duHkhAnAmasmAkaM puruSharShabha |
etau raNe samAsAdya parAshvastaH suyodhanaH
shlokas.46:
yatra vadhyo bhaveddroNaH sUtaputrashcha sAnugaH |
tatrAvadhInmahAbAhuH saindhavaM dUravAsinam
shlokas.47:
avashyaM tu mayA kAryaH sUtaputrasya nigrahaH |
tato yAsyAmyahaM vIra svayaM karNajighA.nsayA
bhImaseno mahAbAhurdroNAnIkena sa~NgataH
shlokas.48:
evamuktvA yayau tUrNaM tvaramANo yudhiShThiraH |
sa visphArya mahachchApaM sha~NkhaM pradhmApya bhairavam
shlokas.49:
tato rathasahasreNa gajAnAM cha shataistribhiH |
vAjibhiH pa~nchasAhasraistrisAhasraiH prabhadrakaiH
vRRitaH shikhaNDI tvarito rAjAnaM pRRiShThato.anvayAt
shlokas.50:
tato bherIH samAjaghnuH sha~NkhAndadhmushcha da.nshitAH |
pA~nchAlAH pANDavAshchaiva yudhiShThirapurogamAH
shlokas.51:
tato.abravInmahAbAhurvAsudevo dhana~njayam |
eSha prayAti tvarito krodhAviShTo yudhiShThiraH
jighA.nsuH sUtaputrasya tasyopekShA na yujyate
shlokas.52:
evamuktvA hRRiShIkeshaH shIghramashvAnachodayat |
dUraM cha yAtaM rAjAnamanvagachChajjanArdanaH
shlokas.53:
taM dRRiShTvA sahasA yAntaM sUtaputrajighA.nsayA |
shokopahatasa~NkalpaM dahyamAnamivAgninA
abhigamyAbravIdvyAso dharmaputraM yudhiShThiram
shlokas.54:
karNamAsAdya sa~NgrAme diShTyA jIvati phalgunaH |
savyasAchivadhAkA~NkShI shaktiM rakShitavAnhi saH
shlokas.55:
na chAgAddvairathaM jiShNurdiShTyA taM bharatarShabha |
sRRijetAM spardhinAvetau divyAnyastrANi sarvashaH
shlokas.56:
vadhyamAneShu chAstreShu pIDitaH sUtanandanaH |
vAsavIM samare shaktiM dhruvaM mu~nchedyudhiShThira
shlokas.57:
tato bhavette vyasanaM ghoraM bharatasattama |
diShTyA rakSho hataM yuddhe sUtaputreNa mAnada
shlokas.58:
vAsavIM kAraNaM kRRitvA kAlenApahato hyasau |
tavaiva kAraNAdrakSho nihataM tAta sa.nyuge
shlokas.59:
mA krudho bharatashreShTha mA cha shoke manaH kRRithAH |
prANinAmiha sarveShAmeShA niShThA yudhiShThira
shlokas.60:
bhrAtRRibhiH sahitaH sarvaiH pArthivaishcha mahAtmabhiH |
kauravAnsamare rAjannabhiyudhyasva bhArata
pa~nchame divase chaiva pRRithivI te bhaviShyati
shlokas.61:
nityaM cha puruShavyAghra dharmameva vichintaya |
AnRRisha.nsyaM tapo dAnaM kShamAM satyaM cha pANDava
shlokas.62:
sevethAH paramaprIto yato dharmastato jayaH |
ityuktvA pANDavaM vyAsastatraivAntaradhIyata

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
ghaTotkache tu nihate sUtaputreNa tAM nishAm |
duHkhAmarShavashaM prApto dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.2:
dRRiShTva bhImena mahatIM vAryamANAM chamUM tava |
dhRRiShTadyumnamuvAchedaM kumbhayoniM nivAraya
shlokas.3:
tvaM hi droNavinAshAya samutpanno hutAshanAt |
sasharaH kavachI khaDgI dhanvI cha paratApanaH
abhidrava raNe hRRiShTo na cha te bhIH katha~nchana
shlokas.4:
janamejayaH shikhaNDI cha daurmukhishcha yashodhanaH |
abhidravantu saMhRRiShTAH kumbhayoniM samantataH
shlokas.5:
nakulaH sahadevashcha draupadeyAH prabhadrakAH |
drupadashcha virATashcha putrabhrAtRRisamanvitau
shlokas.6:
sAtyakiH kekayAshchaiva pANDavashcha dhana~njayaH |
abhidravantu vegena bhAradvAjavadhepsayA
shlokas.7:
tathaiva rathinaH sarve hastyashvaM yachcha ki~nchana |
pAdAtAshcha raNe droNaM prApayantu mahAratham
shlokas.8:
tathAj~naptAstu te sarve pANDavena mahAtmanA |
abhyadravanta vegena kumbhayoniM yuyutsayA
shlokas.9:
AgachChatastAnsahasA sarvodyogena pANDavAn |
pratijagrAha samare droNaH shastrabhRRitAM varaH
shlokas.10:
tato duryodhano rAjA sarvodyogena pANDavAn |
abhyadravatsusa~Nkruddha ichChandroNasya jIvitam
shlokas.11:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM shrAntavAhanasainikam |
pANDavAnAM kurUNAM cha garjatAmitaretaram
shlokas.12:
nidrAndhAste mahArAja parishrAntAshcha sa.nyuge |
nAbhyapadyanta samare kA~nchichcheShTAM mahArathAH
shlokas.13:
triyAmA rajanI chaiShA ghorarUpA bhayAnakA |
sahasrayAmapratimA babhUva prANahAriNI
vadhyatAM cha tathA teShAM kShatAnAM cha visheShataH
shlokas.14:
aho rAtriH samAjaj~ne nidrAndhAnAM visheShataH |
sarve hyAsannirutsAhAH kShatriyA dInachetasaH
tava chaiva pareShAM cha gatAstrA vigateShavaH
shlokas.15:
te tathA pArayantashcha hrImantashcha visheShataH |
svadharmamanupashyanto na jahuH svAmanIkinIm
shlokas.16:
shastrANyanye samutsRRijya nidrAndhAH sherate janAH |
gajeShvanye ratheShvanye hayeShvanye cha bhArata
shlokas.17:
nidrAndhA no bubudhire kA~nchichcheShTAM narAdhipAH |
te.anyonyaM samare yodhAH preShayanta yamakShayam
shlokas.18:
svapnAyamAnAstvapare parAniti vichetasaH |
AtmAnaM samare jaghnuH svAneva cha parAnapi
shlokas.19:
nAnAvAcho vimu~nchanto nidrAndhAste mahAraNe |
yoddhavyamiti tiShThanto nidrAsa.nsaktalochanAH
shlokas.20:
saMmardyAnye raNe kechinnidrAndhAshcha parasparam |
jaghnuH shUrA raNe rAja.nstasmi.nstamasi dAruNe
shlokas.21:
hanyamAnaM tathAtmAnaM parebhyo bahavo janAH |
nAbhyajAnanta samare nidrayA mohitA bhRRisham
shlokas.22:
teShAmetAdRRishIM cheShTAM vij~nAya puruSharShabhaH |
uvAcha vAkyaM bIbhatsuruchchaiH saMnAdayandishaH
shlokas.23:
shrAntA bhavanto nidrAndhAH sarva eva savAhanAH |
tamasA chAvRRite sainye rajasA bahulena cha
shlokas.24:
te yUyaM yadi manyadhvamupAramata sainikAH |
nimIlayata chAtraiva raNabhUmau muhUrtakam
shlokas.25:
tato vinidrA vishrAntAshchandramasyudite punaH |
sa.nsAdhayiShyathAnyonyaM svargAya kurupANDavAH
shlokas.26:
tadvachaH sarvadharmaj~nA dhArmikasya nishamya te |
arochayanta sainyAni tathA chAnyonyamabruvan
shlokas.27:
chukrushuH karNa karNeti rAjanduryodhaneti cha |
upAramata pANDUnAM viratA hi varUthinI
shlokas.28:
tathA vikroshamAnasya phalgunasya tatastataH |
upAramata pANDUnAM senA tava cha bhArata
shlokas.29:
tAmasya vAchaM devAshcha RRiShayashcha mahAtmanaH |
sarvasainyAni chAkShudrAH prahRRiShTAH pratyapUjayan
shlokas.30:
tatsampUjya vacho.akrUraM sarvasainyAni bhArata |
muhUrtamasvapanrAja~nshrAntAni bharatarShabha
shlokas.31:
sA tu samprApya vishrAmaM dhvajinI tava bhArata |
sukhamAptavatI vIramarjunaM pratyapUjayat
shlokas.32:
tvayi vedAstathAstrANi tvayi buddhiparAkramau |
dharmastvayi mahAbAho dayA bhUteShu chAnagha
shlokas.33:
yachchAshvastAstavechChAmaH sharma pArtha tadastu te |
manasashcha priyAnarthAnvIra kShipramavApnuhi
shlokas.34:
iti te taM naravyAghraM prasha.nsanto mahArathAH |
nidrayA samavAkShiptAstUShNImAsanvishAM pate
shlokas.35:
ashvapRRiShTheShu chApyanye rathanIDeShu chApare |
gajaskandhagatAshchAnye sherate chApare kShitau
shlokas.36:
sAyudhAH sagadAshchaiva sakhaDgAH saparashvadhAH |
saprAsakavachAshchAnye narAH suptAH pRRithakpRRithak
shlokas.37:
gajAste pannagAbhogairhastairbhUreNurUShitaiH |
nidrAndhA vasudhAM chakrurghrANaniHshvAsashItalAm
