shlokas.38:
gajAH shushubhire tatra niHshvasanto mahItale |
vishIrNA girayo yadvanniHshvasadbhirmahoragaiH
shlokas.39:
samAM cha viShamAM chakruH khurAgrairvikShatAM mahIm |
hayAH kA~nchanayoktrAshcha kesarAlambibhiryugaiH
suShupustatra rAjendra yuktA vAheShu sarvashaH
shlokas.40:
tattathA nidrayA bhagnamavAchamasvapadbalam |
kushalairiva vinyastaM paTe chitramivAdbhutam
shlokas.41:
te kShatriyAH kuNDalino yuvAnaH; parasparaM sAyakavikShatA~NgAH |
kumbheShu lInAH suShupurgajAnAM; kucheShu lagnA iva kAminInAm
shlokas.42:
tataH kumudanAthena kAminIgaNDapANDunA |
netrAnandena chandreNa mAhendrI digala~NkRRitA
shlokas.43:
tato muhUrtAdbhagavAnpurastAchChashalakShaNaH |
aruNaM darshayAmAsa grasa~njyotiHprabhaM prabhuH
shlokas.44:
aruNasya tu tasyAnu jAtarUpasamaprabham |
rashmijAlaM mahachchandro mandaM mandamavAsRRijat
shlokas.45:
utsArayantaH prabhayA tamaste chandrarashmayaH |
paryagachCha~nshanaiH sarvA dishaH khaM cha kShitiM tathA
shlokas.46:
tato muhUrtAdbhuvanaM jyotirbhUtamivAbhavat |
aprakhyamaprakAshaM cha jagAmAshu tamastathA
shlokas.47:
pratiprakAshite loke divAbhUte nishAkare |
vicherurna vicherushcha rAjannakta~ncharAstataH
shlokas.48:
bodhyamAnaM tu tatsainyaM rAja.nshchandrasya rashmibhiH |
bubudhe shatapatrANAM vanaM mahadivAmbhasi
shlokas.49:
yathA chandrodayoddhUtaH kShubhitaH sAgaro bhavet |
tathA chandrodayoddhUtaH sa babhUva balArNavaH
shlokas.50:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM punareva vishAM pate |
loke lokavinAshAya paraM lokamabhIpsatAm

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato duryodhano droNamabhigamyedamabravIt |
amarShavashamApanno janayanharShatejasI
shlokas.2:
na marShaNIyAH sa~NgrAme vishramantaH shramAnvitAH |
sapatnA glAnamanaso labdhalakShyA visheShataH
shlokas.3:
tattu marShitamasmAbhirbhavataH priyakAmyayA |
ta ete parivishrAntAH pANDavA balavattarAH
shlokas.4:
sarvathA parihInAH sma tejasA cha balena cha |
bhavatA pAlyamAnAste vivardhante punaH punaH
shlokas.5:
divyAnyastrANi sarvANi brahmAstrAdIni yAnyapi |
tAni sarvANi tiShThanti bhavatyeva visheShataH
shlokas.6:
na pANDaveyA na vayaM nAnye loke dhanurdharAH |
yudhyamAnasya te tulyAH satyametadbravImi te
shlokas.7:
sasurAsuragandharvAnimA.NllokAndvijottama |
sarvAstravidbhavAnhanyAddivyairastrairna sa.nshayaH
shlokas.8:
sa bhavAnmarShayatyenA.nstvatto bhItAnvisheShataH |
shiShyatvaM vA puraskRRitya mama vA mandabhAgyatAm
shlokas.9:
evamuddharShito droNaH kopitashchAtmajena te |
samanyurabravIdrAjanduryodhanamidaM vachaH
shlokas.10:
sthaviraH sanparaM shaktyA ghaTe duryodhanAhave |
ataH paraM mayA kAryaM kShudraM vijayagRRiddhinA
anastravidayaM sarvo hantavyo.astravidA janaH
shlokas.11:
yadbhavAnmanyate chApi shubhaM vA yadi vAshubham |
tadvai kartAsmi kauravya vachanAttava nAnyathA
shlokas.12:
nihatya sarvapA~nchAlAnyuddhe kRRitvA parAkramam |
vimokShye kavachaM rAjansatyenAyudhamAlabhe
shlokas.13:
manyase yachcha kaunteyamarjunaM shrAntamAhave |
tasya vIryaM mahAbAho shRRiNu satyena kaurava
shlokas.14:
taM na devA na gandharvA na yakShA na cha rAkShasAH |
utsahante raNe soDhuM kupitaM savyasAchinam
shlokas.15:
khANDave yena bhagavAnpratyudyAtaH sureshvaraH |
sAyakairvAritashchApi varShamANo mahAtmanA
shlokas.16:
yakShA nAgAstathA daityA ye chAnye balagarvitAH |
nihatAH puruShendreNa tachchApi viditaM tava
shlokas.17:
gandharvA ghoShayAtrAyAM chitrasenAdayo jitAH |
yUyaM tairhriyamANAshcha mokShitA dRRiDhadhanvanA
shlokas.18:
nivAtakavachAshchApi devAnAM shatravastathA |
surairavadhyAH sa~NgrAme tena vIreNa nirjitAH
shlokas.19:
dAnavAnAM sahasrANi hiraNyapuravAsinAm |
vijigye puruShavyAghraH sa shakyo mAnuShaiH katham
shlokas.20:
pratyakShaM chaiva te sarvaM yathA balamidaM tava |
kShapitaM pANDuputreNa cheShTatAM no vishAM pate
shlokas.21:
taM tathAbhiprasha.nsantamarjunaM kupitastadA |
droNaM tava suto rAjanpunarevedamabravIt
shlokas.22:
ahaM duHshAsanaH karNaH shakunirmAtulashcha me |
haniShyAmo.arjunaM sa~Nkhye dvaidhIkRRityAdya bhAratIm
shlokas.23:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA bhAradvAjo hasanniva |
anvavartata rAjAnaM svasti te.astviti chAbravIt
shlokas.24:
ko hi gANDIvadhanvAnaM jvalantamiva tejasA |
akShayaM kShapayetkashchitkShatriyaH kShatriyarShabham
shlokas.25:
taM na vittapatirnendro na yamo na jaleshvaraH |
nAsuroragarakShA.nsi kShapayeyuH sahAyudham
shlokas.26:
mUDhAstvetAni bhAShante yAnImAnyAttha bhArata |
yuddhe hyarjunamAsAdya svastimAnko vrajedgRRihAn
shlokas.27:
tvaM tu sarvAtisha~NkitvAnniShThuraH pApanishchayaH |
shreyasastvaddhite yuktA.nstattadvaktumihechChasi
shlokas.28:
gachCha tvamapi kaunteyamAtmArthebhyo hi mAchiram |
tvamapyAsha.nsase yoddhuM kulajaH kShatriyo hyasi
shlokas.29:
imAnkiM pArthivAnsarvAnghAtayiShyasyanAgasaH |
tvamasya mUlaM vairasya tasmAdAsAdayArjunam
shlokas.30:
eSha te mAtulaH prAj~naH kShatradharmamanuvrataH |
dUrdyUtadevI gAndhAriH prayAtvarjunamAhave
shlokas.31:
eSho.akShakushalo jihmo dyUtakRRitkitavaH shaThaH |
devitA nikRRitipraj~no yudhi jeShyati pANDavAn
shlokas.32:
tvayA kathitamatyantaM karNena saha hRRiShTavat |
asakRRichChUnyavanmohAddhRRitarAShTrasya shRRiNvataH
shlokas.33:
ahaM cha tAta karNashcha bhrAtA duHshAsanashcha me |
pANDuputrAnhaniShyAmaH sahitAH samare trayaH
shlokas.34:
iti te katthamAnasya shrutaM sa.nsadi sa.nsadi |
anutiShTha pratij~nAM tAM satyavAgbhava taiH saha
shlokas.35:
eSha te pANDavaH shatruraviShahyo.agrataH sthitaH |
kShatradharmamavekShasva shlAghyastava vadho jayAt
shlokas.36:
dattaM bhuktamadhItaM cha prAptamaishvaryamIpsitam |
kRRitakRRityo.anRRiNashchAsi mA bhairyudhyasva pANDavam
shlokas.37:
ityuktvA samare droNo nyavartata yataH pare |
dvaidhIkRRitya tataH senAM yuddhaM samabhavattadA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tribhAgamAtrasheShAyAM rAtryAM yuddhamavartata |
kurUNAM pANDavAnAM cha saMhRRiShTAnAM vishAM pate
shlokas.2:
atha chandraprabhAM muShNannAdityasya puraHsaraH |
aruNo.abhyudayAM chakre tAmrIkurvannivAmbaram
shlokas.3:
tato dvaidhIkRRite sainye droNaH somakapANDavAn |
abhyadravatsapA~nchAlAnduryodhanapurogamaH
shlokas.4:
dvaidhIbhUtAnkurUndRRiShTvA mAdhavo.arjunamabravIt |
sapatnAnsavyataH kurmi savyasAchinnimAnkurUn
shlokas.5:
sa mAdhavamanuj~nAya kuruShveti dhana~njayaH |
droNakarNau maheShvAsau savyataH paryavartata
shlokas.6:
abhiprAyaM tu kRRiShNasya j~nAtvA parapura~njayaH |
AjishIrShagataM dRRiShTvA bhImasenaM samAsadat
shlokas.7:
bhIma uvAcha||
arjunArjuna bIbhatso shRRiNu me tattvato vachaH |
yadarthaM kShatriyA sUte tasya kAlo.ayamAgataH
shlokas.8:
asmi.nshchedAgate kAle shreyo na pratipatsyase |
asambhAvitarUpaH sannAnRRisha.nsyaM kariShyasi
shlokas.9:
satyashrIdharmayashasAM vIryeNAnRRiNyamApnuhi |
bhindhyanIkaM yudhAM shreShTha savyasAchinnimAnkuru
shlokas.10:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
sa savyasAchI bhImena choditaH keshavena cha |
karNadroNAvatikramya samantAtparyavArayat
shlokas.11:
tamAjishIrShamAyAntaM dahantaM kShatriyarShabhAn |
parAkrAntaM parAkramya yatantaH kShatriyarShabhAH
nAshaknuvanvArayituM vardhamAnamivAnalam
shlokas.12:
atha duryodhanaH karNaH shakunishchApi saubalaH |
abhyavarSha~nsharavrAtaiH kuntIputraM dhana~njayam
shlokas.13:
teShAmastrANi sarveShAmuttamAstravidAM varaH |
kadarthIkRRitya rAjendra sharavarShairavAkirat
shlokas.14:
astrairastrANi sa.nvArya laghuhasto dhana~njayaH |
sarvAnavidhyannishitairdashabhirdashabhiH sharaiH
shlokas.15:
uddhUtA rajaso vRRiShTiH sharavRRiShTistathaiva cha |
tamashcha ghoraM shabdashcha tadA samabhavanmahAn
shlokas.16:
na dyaurna bhUmirna dishaH prAj~nAyanta tathA gate |
sainyena rajasA mUDhaM sarvamandhamivAbhavat
shlokas.17:
naiva te na vayaM rAjanpraj~nAsiShma parasparam |
uddeshena hi tena sma samayudhyanta pArthivAH
shlokas.18:
virathA rathino rAjansamAsAdya parasparam |
keSheshu samasajjanta kavacheShu bhujeShu cha
shlokas.19:
hatAshvA hatasUtAshcha nishcheShTA rathinastadA |
jIvanta iva tatra sma vyadRRishyanta bhayArditAH
shlokas.20:
hatAngajAnsamAshliShya parvatAniva vAjinaH |
gatasattvA vyadRRishyanta tathaiva saha sAdibhiH
shlokas.21:
tatastvabhyavasRRityaiva sa~NgrAmAduttarAM disham |
atiShThadAhave droNo vidhUma iva pAvakaH
shlokas.22:
tamAjishIrShAdekAntamapakrAntaM nishAmya tu |
samakampanta sainyAni pANDavAnAM vishAM pate
shlokas.23:
bhrAjamAnaM shriyA yuktaM jvalantamiva tejasA |
droNaM dRRiShTvArayastresushchelurmamlushcha mAriSha
shlokas.24:
AhvayantaM parAnIkaM prabhinnamiva vAraNam |
nainaM shasha.nsire jetuM dAnavA vAsavaM yathA
shlokas.25:
kechidAsannirutsAhAH kechitkruddhA manasvinaH |
vismitAshchAbhavankechitkechidAsannamarShitAH
shlokas.26:
hastairhastAgramapare pratyapiMShannarAdhipAH |
apare dashanairoShThAnadashankrodhamUrChitAH
shlokas.27:
vyAkShipannAyudhAnanye mamRRidushchApare bhujAn |
anye chAnvapatandroNaM tyaktAtmAno mahaujasaH
shlokas.28:
pA~nchAlAstu visheSheNa droNasAyakapIDitAH |
samasajjanta rAjendra samare bhRRishavedanAH
shlokas.29:
tato virATadrupadau droNaM pratiyayU raNe |
tathA charantaM sa~NgrAme bhRRishaM samaradurjayam
shlokas.30:
drupadasya tataH pautrAstraya eva vishAM pate |
chedayashcha maheShvAsA droNamevAbhyayuryudhi
shlokas.31:
teShAM drupadapautrANAM trayANAM nishitaiH sharaiH |
tribhirdroNo.aharatprANA.nste hatA nyapatanbhuvi
shlokas.32:
tato droNo.ajayadyuddhe chedikekayasRRi~njayAn |
matsyA.nshchaivAjayatsarvAnbhAradvAjo mahArathaH
shlokas.33:
tatastu drupadaH krodhAchCharavarShamavAkirat |
droNaM prati mahArAja virATashchaiva sa.nyuge
shlokas.34:
tato droNaH supItAbhyAM bhallAbhyAmarimardanaH |
drupadaM cha virATaM cha praiShIdvaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.35:
hate virATe drupade kekayeShu tathaiva cha |
tathaiva chedimatsyeShu pA~nchAleShu tathaiva cha
hateShu triShu vIreShu drupadasya cha naptRRiShu
shlokas.36:
droNasya karma taddRRiShTvA kopaduHkhasamanvitaH |
shashApa rathinAM madhye dhRRiShTadyumno mahAmanAH
shlokas.37:
iShTApUrtAttathA kShAtrAdbrAhmaNyAchcha sa nashyatu |
droNo yasyAdya muchyeta yo vA droNAtparA~NmukhaH
shlokas.38:
iti teShAM pratishrutya madhye sarvadhanuShmatAm |
AyAddroNaM sahAnIkaH pA~nchAlyaH paravIrahA
pA~nchAlAstvekato droNamabhyaghnanpANDavAnyataH
shlokas.39:
duryodhanashcha karNashcha shakunishchApi saubalaH |
sodaryAshcha yathA mukhyAste.arakShandroNamAhave
shlokas.40:
rakShyamANaM tathA droNaM samare tairmahAtmabhiH |
yatamAnApi pA~nchAlA na shekuH prativIkShitum
shlokas.41:
tatrAkrudhyadbhImaseno dhRRiShTadyumnasya mAriSha |
sa enaM vAgbhirugrAbhistatakSha puruSharShabha
shlokas.42:
drupadasya kule jAtaH sarvAstreShvastravittamaH |
kaH kShatriyo manyamAnaH prekShetArimavasthitam
shlokas.43:
pitRRiputravadhaM prApya pumAnkaH parihApayet |
visheShatastu shapathaM shapitvA rAjasa.nsadi
shlokas.44:
eSha vaishvAnara iva samiddhaH svena tejasA |
sharachApendhano droNaH kShatraM dahati tejasA
shlokas.45:
purA karoti niHsheShAM pANDavAnAmanIkinIm |
sthitAH pashyata me karma droNameva vrajAmyaham
shlokas.46:
ityuktvA prAvishatkruddho droNAnIkaM vRRikodaraH |
dRRiDhaiH pUrNAyatotsRRiShTairdrAvaya.nstava vAhinIm
shlokas.47:
dhRRiShTadyumno.api pA~nchAlyaH pravishya mahatIM chamUm |
AsasAda raNe droNaM tadAsIttumulaM mahat
shlokas.48:
naiva nastAdRRishaM yuddhaM dRRiShTapUrvaM na cha shrutam |
yathA sUryodaye rAjansamutpi~njo.abhavanmahAn
shlokas.49:
sa.nsaktAni vyadRRishyanta rathavRRindAni mAriSha |
hatAni cha vikIrNAni sharIrANi sharIriNAm
shlokas.50:
kechidanyatra gachChantaH pathi chAnyairupadrutAH |
vimukhAH pRRiShThatashchAnye tADyante pArshvato.apare
shlokas.51:
tathA sa.nsaktayuddhaM tadabhavadbhRRishadAruNam |
atha sandhyAgataH sUryaH kShaNena samapadyata

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
te tathaiva mahArAja da.nshitA raNamUrdhani |
sandhyAgataM sahasrA.nshumAdityamupatasthire
shlokas.2:
udite tu sahasrA.nshau taptakA~nchanasaprabhe |
prakAshiteShu lokeShu punaryuddhamavartata
shlokas.3:
dva.ndvAni yAni tatrAsansa.nsaktAni purodayAt |
tAnyevAbhyudite sUrye samasajjanta bhArata
shlokas.4:
rathairhayA hayairnAgAH pAdAtAshchApi ku~njaraiH |
hayA hayaiH samAjagmuH pAdAtAshcha padAtibhiH
sa.nsaktAshcha viyuktAshcha yodhAH saMnyapatanraNe
shlokas.5:
te rAtrau kRRitakarmANaH shrAntAH sUryasya tejasA |
kShutpipAsAparItA~NgA visa~nj~nA bahavo.abhavan
shlokas.6:
sha~NkhabherImRRida~NgAnAM ku~njarANAM cha garjatAm |
visphAritavikRRiShTAnAM kArmukANAM cha kUjatAm
shlokas.7:
shabdaH samabhavadrAjandivispRRigbharatarShabha |
dravatAM cha padAtInAM shastrANAM vinipAtyatAm
shlokas.8:
hayAnAM heShatAM chaiva rathAnAM cha nivartatAm |
kroshatAM garjatAM chaiva tadAsIttumulaM mahat
shlokas.9:
vivRRiddhastumulaH shabdo dyAmagachChanmahAsvanaH |
nAnAyudhanikRRittAnAM cheShTatAmAturaH svanaH
shlokas.10:
bhUmAvashrUyata mahA.nstadAsItkRRipaNaM mahat |
patatAM patitAnAM cha pattyashvarathahastinAm
shlokas.11:
teShu sarveShvanIkeShu vyatiShakteShvanekashaH |
sve svA~njaghnuH pare svA.nshcha sve parA.nshcha parAnpare
shlokas.12:
vIrabAhuvisRRiShTAshcha yodheShu cha gajeShu cha |
asayaH pratyadRRishyanta vAsasAM nejaneShviva
shlokas.13:
udyatapratipiShTAnAM khaDgAnAM vIrabAhubhiH |
sa eva shabdastadrUpo vAsasAM nijyatAmiva
shlokas.14:
ardhAsibhistathA khaDgaistomaraiH saparashvadhaiH |
nikRRiShTayuddhaM sa.nsaktaM mahadAsItsudAruNam
shlokas.15:
gajAshvakAyaprabhavAM naradehapravAhinIm |
shastramatsyasusampUrNAM mA.nsashoNitakardamAm
shlokas.16:
ArtanAdasvanavatIM patAkAvastraphenilAm |
nadIM prAvartayanvIrAH paralokapravAhinIm
shlokas.17:
sharashaktyarditAH klAntA rAtrimUDhAlpachetasaH |
viShTabhya sarvagAtrANi vyatiShThangajavAjinaH
sa.nshuShkavadanA vIrAH shirobhishchArukuNDalaiH
shlokas.18:
yuddhopakaraNaishchAnyaistatra tatra prakAshitaiH |
kravyAdasa~NghairAkIrNaM mRRitairardhamRRitairapi
nAsIdrathapathastatra sarvamAyodhanaM prati
shlokas.19:
majjatsu chakreShu rathAnsattvamAsthAya vAjinaH |
katha~nchidavaha~nshrAntA vepamAnAH sharArditAH
kulasattvabalopetA vAjino vAraNopamAH
shlokas.20:
vihvalaM tatsamudbhrAntaM sabhayaM bhAratAturam |
balamAsIttadA sarvamRRite droNArjunAvubhau
shlokas.21:
tAvevAstAM nilayanaM tAvArtAyanameva cha |
tAvevAnye samAsAdya jagmurvaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.22:
AvignamabhavatsarvaM kauravANAM mahadbalam |
pA~nchAlAnAM cha sa.nsaktaM na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.23:
antakAkrIDasadRRishe bhIrUNAM bhayavardhane |
pRRithivyAM rAjava.nshAnAmutthite mahati kShaye
shlokas.24:
na tatra karNaM na droNaM nArjunaM na yudhiShThiram |
na bhImasenaM na yamau na pA~nchAlyaM na sAtyakim
shlokas.25:
na cha duHshAsanaM drauNiM na duryodhanasaubalau |
na kRRipaM madrarAjaM vA kRRitavarmANameva cha
shlokas.26:
na chAnyAnnaiva chAtmAnaM na kShitiM na dishastathA |
pashyAma rAjansa.nsaktAnsainyena rajasAvRRitAn
shlokas.27:
sambhrAnte tumule ghore rajomeghe samutthite |
dvitIyAmiva samprAptAmamanyanta nishAM tadA
shlokas.28:
na j~nAyante kauraveyA na pA~nchAlA na pANDavAH |
na disho na divaM norvIM na samaM viShamaM tathA
shlokas.29:
hastasa.nsparshamApannAnparAnvApyatha vA svakAn |
nyapAtaya.nstadA yuddhe narAH sma vijayaiShiNaH
shlokas.30:
uddhUtatvAttu rajasaH prasekAchChoNitasya cha |
prashashAma rajo bhaumaM shIghratvAdanilasya cha
shlokas.31:
tatra nAgA hayA yodhA rathino.atha padAtayaH |
pArijAtavanAnIva vyarochanrudhirokShitAH
shlokas.32:
tato duryodhanaH karNo droNo duHshAsanastathA |
pANDavaiH samasajjanta chaturbhishchaturo rathAH
shlokas.33:
duryodhanaH saha bhrAtrA yamAbhyAM samasajjata |
vRRikodareNa rAdheyo bhAradvAjena chArjunaH
shlokas.34:
tadghoraM mahadAshcharyaM sarve praikShansamantataH |
ratharShabhANAmugrANAM saMnipAtamamAnuSham
shlokas.35:
rathamArgairvichitraishcha vichitrarathasa~Nkulam |
apashyanrathino yuddhaM vichitraM chitrayodhinAm
shlokas.36:
yatamAnAH parAkrAntAH parasparajigIShavaH |
jImUtA iva gharmAnte sharavarShairavAkiran
shlokas.37:
te rathAnsUryasa~NkAshAnAsthitAH puruSharShabhAH |
ashobhanta yathA meghAH shAradAH samupasthitAH
shlokas.38:
spardhinaste maheShvAsAH kRRitayatnA dhanurdharAH |
abhyagachCha.nstathAnyonyaM mattA gajavRRiShA iva
shlokas.39:
na nUnaM dehabhedo.asti kAle tasminsamAgate |
yatra sarve na yugapadvyashIryanta mahArathAH
shlokas.40:
bAhubhishcharaNaishChinnaiH shirobhishchArukuNDalaiH |
kArmukairvishikhaiH prAsaiH khaDgaiH parashupaTTishaiH
shlokas.41:
nAlIkakShuranArAchairnakharaiH shaktitomaraiH |
anyaishcha vividhAkArairdhautaiH praharaNottamaiH
shlokas.42:
chitraishcha vividhAkAraiH sharIrAvaraNairapi |
vichitraishcha rathairbhagnairhataishcha gajavAjibhiH
shlokas.43:
shUnyaishcha nagarAkArairhatayodhadhvajai rathaiH |
amanuShyairhayaistrastaiH kRRiShyamANaistatastataH
shlokas.44:
vAtAyamAnairasakRRiddhatavIrairala~NkRRitaiH |
vyajanaiH ka~NkaTaishchaiva dhvajaishcha vinipAtitaiH
shlokas.45:
ChatrairAbharaNairvastrairmAlyaishcha susugandhibhiH |
hAraiH kirITairmukuTairuShNIShaiH ki~NkiNIgaNaiH
shlokas.46:
urasyairmaNibhirniShkaishchUDAmaNibhireva cha |
AsIdAyodhanaM tatra nabhastArAgaNairiva
shlokas.47:
tato duryodhanasyAsInnakulena samAgamaH |
amarShitena kruddhasya kruddhenAmarShitasya cha
shlokas.48:
apasavyaM chakArAtha mAdrIputrastavAtmajam |
kira~nsharashatairhRRiShTastatra nAdo mahAnabhUt
shlokas.49:
apasavyaM kRRitaH sa~Nkhye bhrAtRRivyenAtyamarShiNA |
so.amarShitastamapyAjau pratichakre.apasavyataH
shlokas.50:
tataH pratichikIrShantamapasavyaM tu te sutam |
nyavArayata tejasvI nakulashchitramArgavit
shlokas.51:
sarvato vinivAryainaM sharajAlena pIDayan |
vimukhaM nakulashchakre tatsainyAH samapUjayan
shlokas.52:
tiShTha tiShTheti nakulo babhAShe tanayaM tava |
sa.nsmRRitya sarvaduHkhAni tava durmantritena cha

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tato duHshAsanaH kruddhaH sahadevamupAdravat |
rathavegena tIvreNa kampayanniva medinIm
shlokas.2:
tasyApatata evAshu bhallenAmitrakarshanaH |
mAdrIsutaH shiro yantuH sashirastrANamachChinat
shlokas.3:
nainaM duHshAsanaH sUtaM nApi kashchana sainikaH |
hRRitottamA~NgamAshutvAtsahadevena buddhavAn
shlokas.4:
yadA tvasa~NgRRihItatvAtprayAntyashvA yathAsukham |
tato duHshAsanaH sUtaM buddhavAngatachetasam
shlokas.5:
sa hayAnsaMnigRRihyAjau svayaM hayavishAradaH |
yuyudhe rathinAM shreShThashchitraM laghu cha suShThu cha
shlokas.6:
tadasyApUjayankarma sve pare chaiva sa.nyuge |
hatasUtarathenAjau vyacharadyadabhItavat
shlokas.7:
sahadevastu tAnashvA.nstIkShNairbANairavAkirat |
pIDyamAnAH sharaishchAshu prAdrava.nste tatastataH
shlokas.8:
sa rashmiShu viShaktatvAdutsasarja sharAsanam |
dhanuShA karma kurva.nstu rashmInsa punarutsRRijat
shlokas.9:
ChidreShu teShu taM bANairmAdrIputro.abhyavAkirat |
parIpsa.nstvatsutaM karNastadantaramavApatat
shlokas.10:
vRRikodarastataH karNaM tribhirbhallaiH samAhitaiH |
AkarNapUrNairabhyaghnanbAhvorurasi chAnadat
shlokas.11:
saMnyavartata taM karNaH sa~NghaTTita ivoragaH |
tadabhUttumulaM yuddhaM bhImarAdheyayostadA
shlokas.12:
tau vRRiShAviva sa~Nkruddhau vivRRittanayanAvubhau |
vegena mahatAnyonyaM sa.nrabdhAvabhipetatuH
shlokas.13:
abhisa.nshliShTayostatra tayorAhavashauNDayoH |
abhinnasharapAtatvAdgadAyuddhamavartata
shlokas.14:
gadayA bhImasenastu karNasya rathakUbaram |
bibhedAshu tadA rAja.nstadadbhutamivAbhavat
shlokas.15:
tato bhImasya rAdheyo gadAmAdAya vIryavAn |
avAsRRijadrathe tAM tu bibheda gadayA gadAm
shlokas.16:
tato bhImaH punargurvIM chikShepAdhirathergadAm |
tAM sharairdashabhiH karNaH supu~NkhaiH susamAhitaiH
pratyavidhyatpunashchAnyaiH sA bhImaM punarAvrajat
shlokas.17:
tasyAH pratinipAtena bhImasya vipulo dhvajaH |
papAta sArathishchAsya mumoha gadayA hataH
shlokas.18:
sa karNe sAyakAnaShTau vyasRRijatkrodhamUrChitaH |
dhvaje sharAsane chaiva sharAvApe cha bhArata
shlokas.19:
tataH punastu rAdheyo hayAnasya ratheShubhiH |
RRiShyavarNA~njaghAnAshu tathobhau pArShNisArathI
shlokas.20:
sa vipannaratho bhImo nakulasyApluto ratham |
hariryathA gireH shRRi~NgaM samAkrAmadari.ndamaH
shlokas.21:
tathA droNArjunau chitramayudhyetAM mahArathau |
AchAryashiShyau rAjendra kRRitapraharaNau yudhi
shlokas.22:
laghusandhAnayogAbhyAM rathayoshcha raNena cha |
mohayantau manuShyANAM chakShUMShi cha manA.nsi cha
shlokas.23:
upAramanta te sarve yodhAsmAkaM pare tathA |
adRRiShTapUrvaM pashyantastadyuddhaM gurushiShyayoH
shlokas.24:
vichitrAnpRRitanAmadhye rathamArgAnudIryataH |
anyonyamapasavyaM cha kartuM vIrau tadaiShatuH
parAkramaM tayoryodhA dadRRishustaM suvismitAH
shlokas.25:
tayoH samabhavadyuddhaM droNapANDavayormahat |
AmiShArthaM mahArAja gagane shyenayoriva
shlokas.26:
yadyachchakAra droNastu kuntIputrajigIShayA |
tattatpratijaghAnAshu prahasa.nstasya pANDavaH
shlokas.27:
yadA droNo na shaknoti pANDavasya visheShaNe |
tataH prAdushchakArAstramastramArgavishAradaH
shlokas.28:
aindraM pAshupataM tvAShTraM vAyavyamatha vAruNam |
muktaM muktaM droNachApAttajjaghAna dhana~njayaH
shlokas.29:
astrANyastrairyadA tasya vidhivaddhanti pANDavaH |
tato.astraiH paramairdivyairdroNaH pArthamavAkirat
shlokas.30:
yadyadastraM sa pArthAya prayu~Nkte vijigIShayA |
tasyAstrasya vighAtArthaM tattatsa kurute.arjunaH
shlokas.31:
sa vadhyamAneShvastreShu divyeShvapi yathAvidhi |
arjunenArjunaM droNo manasaivAbhyapUjayat
shlokas.32:
mene chAtmAnamadhikaM pRRithivyAmapi bhArata |
tena shiShyeNa sarvebhyaH shastravidbhyaH samantataH
shlokas.33:
vAryamANastu pArthena tathA madhye mahAtmanAm |
yatamAno.arjunaM prItyA pratyavArayadutsmayan
shlokas.34:
tato.antarikShe devAshcha gandharvAshcha sahasrashaH |
RRiShayaH siddhasa~NghAshcha vyatiShThanta didRRikShayA
shlokas.35:
tadapsarobhirAkIrNaM yakSharAkShasasa~Nkulam |
shrImadAkAshamabhavadbhUyo meghAkulaM yathA
shlokas.36:
tatra smAntarhitA vAcho vyacharanta punaH punaH |
droNasya stavasa.nyuktAH pArthasya cha mahAtmanaH
visRRijyamAneShvastreShu jvAlayatsu disho dasha
shlokas.37:
naivedaM mAnuShaM yuddhaM nAsuraM na cha rAkShasam |
na daivaM na cha gAndharvaM brAhmaM dhruvamidaM param
vichitramidamAshcharyaM na no dRRiShTaM na cha shrutam
shlokas.38:
ati pANDavamAchAryo droNaM chApyati pANDavaH |
nAnayorantaraM draShTuM shakyamastreNa kenachit
shlokas.39:
yadi rudro dvidhAkRRitya yudhyetAtmAnamAtmanA |
tatra shakyopamA kartumanyatra tu na vidyate
shlokas.40:
j~nAnamekasthamAchArye j~nAnaM yogashcha pANDave |
shauryamekasthamAchArye balaM shauryaM cha pANDave
shlokas.41:
nemau shakyau maheShvAsau raNe kShepayituM paraiH |
ichChamAnau punarimau hanyetAM sAmaraM jagat
shlokas.42:
ityabruvanmahArAja dRRiShTvA tau puruSharShabhau |
antarhitAni bhUtAni prakAshAni cha sa~NghashaH
shlokas.43:
tato droNo brAhmamastraM prAdushchakre mahAmatiH |
santApayanraNe pArthaM bhUtAnyantarhitAni cha
shlokas.44:
tatashchachAla pRRithivI saparvatavanadrumA |
vavau cha viShamo vAyuH sAgarAshchApi chukShubhuH
shlokas.45:
tatastrAso mahAnAsItkurupANDavasenayoH |
sarveShAM chaiva bhUtAnAmudyate.astre mahAtmanA
shlokas.46:
tataH pArtho.apyasambhrAntastadastraM pratijaghnivAn |
brahmAstreNaiva rAjendra tataH sarvamashIshamat
shlokas.47:
yadA na gamyate pAraM tayoranyatarasya vA |
tataH sa~Nkulayuddhena tadyuddhaM vyakulIkRRitam
shlokas.48:
nAj~nAyata tataH ki~nchitpunareva vishAM pate |
pravRRitte tumule yuddhe droNapANDavayormRRidhe
shlokas.49:
sharajAlaiH samAkIrNe meghajAlairivAmbare |
na sma sampatate kashchidantarikShacharastadA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasmi.nstathA vartamAne narAshvagajasa~NkShaye |
duHshAsano mahArAja dhRRiShTadyumnamayodhayat
shlokas.2:
sa tu rukmarathAsakto duHshAsanasharArditaH |
amarShAttava putrasya sharairvAhAnavAkirat
shlokas.3:
kShaNena sa rathastasya sadhvajaH sahasArathiH |
nAdRRishyata mahArAja pArShatasya sharaishchitaH
shlokas.4:
duHshAsanastu rAjendra pA~nchAlyasya mahAtmanaH |
nAshakatpramukhe sthAtuM sharajAlaprapIDitaH
shlokas.5:
sa tu duHshAsanaM bANairvimukhIkRRitya pArShataH |
kira~nsharasahasrANi droNamevAbhyayAdraNe
shlokas.6:
pratyapadyata hArdikyaH kRRitavarmA tadantaram |
sodaryANAM trayashchaiva ta enaM paryavArayan
shlokas.7:
taM yamau pRRiShThato.anvaitAM rakShantau puruSharShabhau |
droNAyAbhimukhaM yAntaM dIpyamAnamivAnalam
shlokas.8:
samprahAramakurva.nste sarve sapta mahArathAH |
amarShitAH sattvavantaH kRRitvA maraNamagrataH
shlokas.9:
shuddhAtmAnaH shuddhavRRittA rAjansvargapuraskRRitAH |
AryaM yuddhamakurvanta parasparajigIShavaH
shlokas.10:
shuklAbhijanakarmANo matimanto janAdhipAH |
dharmayuddhamayudhyanta prekShanto gatimuttamAm
shlokas.11:
na tatrAsIdadharmiShThamashastraM yuddhameva cha |
nAtra karNI na nAlIko na lipto na cha vastakaH
shlokas.12:
na sUchI kapisho nAtra na gavAsthirgajAsthikaH |
iShurAsInna sa.nshliShTo na pUtirna cha jihmagaH
shlokas.13:
RRijUnyeva vishuddhAni sarve shastrANyadhArayan |
suyuddhena parA.NllokAnIpsantaH kIrtimeva cha
shlokas.14:
tadAsIttumulaM yuddhaM sarvadoShavivarjitam |
chaturNAM tava yodhAnAM taistribhiH pANDavaiH saha
shlokas.15:
dhRRiShTadyumnastu tAnhitvA tava rAjanratharShabhAn |
yamAbhyAM vAritAndRRiShTvA shIghrAstro droNamabhyayAt
shlokas.16:
nivAritAstu te vIrAstayoH puruShasiMhayoH |
samasajjanta chatvAro vAtAH parvatayoriva
shlokas.17:
dvAbhyAM dvAbhyAM yamau sArdhaM rathAbhyAM rathapu~Ngavau |
samAsaktau tato droNaM dhRRiShTadyumno.abhyavartata
shlokas.18:
dRRiShTvA droNAya pA~nchAlyaM vrajantaM yuddhadurmadam |
yamAbhyAM tA.nshcha sa.nsaktA.nstadantaramupAdravat
shlokas.19:
duryodhano mahArAja kira~nshoNitabhojanAn |
taM sAtyakiH shIghrataraM punarevAbhyavartata
shlokas.20:
tau parasparamAsAdya samIpe kurumAdhavau |
hasamAnau nRRishArdUlAvabhItau samagachChatAm
shlokas.21:
bAlye vRRittAni sarvANi prIyamANau vichintya tau |
anyonyaM prekShamANau cha hasamAnau punaH punaH
shlokas.22:
atha duryodhano rAjA sAtyakiM pratyabhAShata |
priyaM sakhAyaM satataM garhayanvRRittamAtmanaH
shlokas.23:
dhikkrodhaM dhiksakhe lobhaM dhi~NmohaM dhigamarShitam |
dhigastu kShAtramAchAraM dhigastu balamaurasam
shlokas.24:
yattvaM mAmabhisandhatse tvAM chAhaM shinipu~Ngava |
tvaM hi prANaiH priyataro mamAhaM cha sadA tava
shlokas.25:
smarAmi tAni sarvANi bAlye vRRittAni yAni nau |
tAni sarvANi jIrNAni sAmprataM nau raNAjire
kimanyatkrodhalobhAbhyAM yudhyAmi tvAdya sAtvata
shlokas.26:
taM tathAvAdinaM rAjansAtyakiH pratyabhAShata |
prahasanvishikhA.nstIkShNAnudyamya paramAstravit
shlokas.27:
neyaM sabhA rAjaputra na chAchAryaniveshanam |
yatra krIDitamasmAbhistadA rAjansamAgataiH
shlokas.28:
duryodhana uvAcha||
kva sA krIDA gatAsmAkaM bAlye vai shinipu~Ngava |
kva cha yuddhamidaM bhUyaH kAlo hi duratikramaH
shlokas.29:
kiM nu no vidyate kRRityaM dhanena dhanalipsayA |
yatra yudhyAmahe sarve dhanalobhAtsamAgatAH
shlokas.30:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
taM tathAvAdinaM tatra rAjAnaM mAdhavo.abravIt |
eva.nvRRittaM sadA kShatraM yaddhantIha gurUnapi
shlokas.31:
yadi te.ahaM priyo rAja~njahi mAM mA chiraM kRRithAH |
tvatkRRite sukRRitA.NllokAngachCheyaM bharatarShabha
shlokas.32:
yA te shaktirbalaM chaiva tatkShipraM mayi darshaya |
nechChAmyetadahaM draShTuM mitrANAM vyasanaM mahat
shlokas.33:
ityevaM vyaktamAbhAShya pratibhAShya cha sAtyakiH |
abhyayAttUrNamavyagro nirapekSho vishAM pate
shlokas.34:
tamAyAntamabhiprekShya pratyagRRihNAttavAtmajaH |
sharaishchAvAkiradrAja~nshaineyaM tanayastava
shlokas.35:
tataH pravavRRite yuddhaM kurumAdhavasiMhayoH |
anyonyaM kruddhayorghoraM yathA dviradasiMhayoH
shlokas.36:
tataH pUrNAyatotsRRiShTaiH sAtvataM yuddhadurmadam |
duryodhanaH pratyavidhyaddashabhirnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.37:
taM sAtyakiH pratyaviddhattathaiva dashabhiH sharaiH |
pa~nchAshatA punashchAjau tri.nshatA dashabhishcha ha
shlokas.38:
tasya sa.ndadhatashcheShUnsaMhiteShuM cha kArmukam |
achChinatsAtyakistUrNaM sharaishchaivAbhyavIvRRiShat
shlokas.39:
sa gADhaviddho vyathitaH pratyapAyAdrathAntaram |
duryodhano mahArAja dAshArhasharapIDitaH
shlokas.40:
samAshvasya tu putraste sAtyakiM punarabhyayAt |
visRRijanniShujAlAni yuyudhAnarathaM prati
shlokas.41:
tathaiva sAtyakirbANAnduryodhanarathaM prati |
pratataM vyasRRijadrAja.nstatsa~Nkulamavartata
shlokas.42:
tatreShubhiH kShipyamANaiH patadbhishcha samantataH |
agneriva mahAkakShe shabdaH samabhavanmahAn
shlokas.43:
tatrAbhyadhikamAlakShya mAdhavaM rathasattamam |
kShipramabhyapatatkarNaH parIpsa.nstanayaM tava
shlokas.44:
na tu taM marShayAmAsa bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
abhyayAttvaritaH karNaM visRRijansAyakAnbahUn
shlokas.45:
tasya karNaH shitAnbANAnpratihanya hasanniva |
dhanuH sharA.nshcha chichCheda sUtaM chAbhyahanachCharaiH
shlokas.46:
bhImasenastu sa~Nkruddho gadAmAdAya pANDavaH |
dhvajaM dhanushcha sUtaM cha saMmamardAhave ripoH
shlokas.47:
amRRiShyamANaH karNastu bhImasenamayudhyata |
vividhairiShujAlaishcha nAnAshastraishcha sa.nyuge
shlokas.48:
sa~Nkule vartamAne tu rAjA dharmasuto.abravIt |
pA~nchAlAnAM naravyAghrAnmatsyAnAM cha nararShabhAn
shlokas.49:
ye naH prANAH shiro ye no ye no yodhA mahAbalAH |
ta ete dhArtarAShTreShu viShaktAH puruSharShabhAH
shlokas.50:
kiM tiShThata yathA mUDhAH sarve vigatachetasaH |
tatra gachChata yatraite yudhyante mAmakA rathAH
shlokas.51:
kShatradharmaM puraskRRitya sarva eva gatajvarAH |
jayanto vadhyamAnA vA gatimiShTAM gamiShyatha
shlokas.52:
jitvA cha bahubhiryaj~nairyakShyadhvaM bhUridakShiNaiH |
hatA vA devasAdbhUtvA lokAnprApsyatha puShkalAn
shlokas.53:
te rAj~nA choditA vIrA yotsyamAnA mahArathAH |
chaturdhA vahinIM kRRitvA tvaritA droNamabhyayuH
shlokas.54:
pA~nchAlAstvekato droNamabhyaghnanbahubhiH sharaiH |
bhImasenapurogAshcha ekataH paryavArayan
shlokas.55:
Asa.nstu pANDuputrANAM trayo.ajihmA mahArathAH |
yamau cha bhImasenashcha prAkroshanta dhana~njayam
shlokas.56:
abhidravArjuna kShipraM kurUndroNAdapAnuda |
tata enaM haniShyanti pA~nchAlA hatarakShiNam
shlokas.57:
kauraveyA.nstataH pArthaH sahasA samupAdravat |
pA~nchAlAneva tu droNo dhRRiShTadyumnapurogamAn
shlokas.58:
pA~nchAlAnAM tato droNo.apyakarotkadanaM mahat |
yathA kruddho raNe shakro dAnavAnAM kShayaM purA
shlokas.59:
droNAstreNa mahArAja vadhyamAnAH pare yudhi |
nAtrasanta raNe droNAtsattvavanto mahArathAH
shlokas.60:
vadhyamAnA mahArAja pA~nchAlAH sRRi~njayAstathA |
droNamevAbhyayuryuddhe mohayanto mahAratham
shlokas.61:
teShAM tUtsAdyamAnAnAM pA~nchAlAnAM samantataH |
abhavadbhairavo nAdo vadhyatAM sharashaktibhiH
shlokas.62:
vadhyamAneShu sa~NgrAme pA~nchAleShu mahAtmanA |
udIryamANe droNAstre pANDavAnbhayamAvishat
shlokas.63:
dRRiShTvAshvanarasa~NghAnAM vipulaM cha kShayaM yudhi |
pANDaveyA mahArAja nAsha.nsurvijayaM tadA
shlokas.64:
kachchiddroNo na naH sarvAnkShapayetparamAstravit |
samiddhaH shishirApAye dahankakShamivAnalaH
shlokas.65:
na chainaM sa.nyuge kashchitsamarthaH prativIkShitum |
na chainamarjuno jAtu pratiyudhyeta dharmavit
shlokas.66:
trastAnkuntIsutAndRRiShTvA droNasAyakapIDitAn |
matimA~nshreyase yuktaH keshavo.arjunamabravIt
shlokas.67:
naiSha yuddhena sa~NgrAme jetuM shakyaH katha~nchana |
api vRRitrahaNA yuddhe rathayUthapayUthapaH
shlokas.68:
AsthIyatAM jaye yogo dharmamutsRRijya pANDava |
yathA vaH sa.nyuge sarvAnna hanyAdrukmavAhanaH
shlokas.69:
ashvatthAmni hate naiSha yudhyediti matirmama |
taM hataM sa.nyuge kashchidasmai sha.nsatu mAnavaH
shlokas.70:
etannArochayadrAjankuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
anye tvarochayansarve kRRichChreNa tu yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.71:
tato bhImo mahAbAhuranIke sve mahAgajam |
jaghAna gadayA rAjannashvatthAmAnamityuta
shlokas.72:
bhImasenastu savrIDamupetya droNamAhave |
ashvatthAmA hata iti shabdamuchchaishchakAra ha
shlokas.73:
ashvatthAmeti hi gajaH khyAto nAmnA hato.abhavat |
kRRitvA manasi taM bhImo mithyA vyAhRRitavA.nstadA
shlokas.74:
bhImasenavachaH shrutvA droNastatparamapriyam |
manasA sannagAtro.abhUdyathA saikatamambhasi
shlokas.75:
sha~NkamAnaH sa tanmithyA vIryaj~naH svasutasya vai |
hataH sa iti cha shrutvA naiva dhairyAdakampata
shlokas.76:
sa labdhvA chetanAM droNaH kShaNenaiva samAshvasat |
anuchintyAtmanaH putramaviShahyamarAtibhiH
shlokas.77:
sa pArShatamabhidrutya jighA.nsurmRRityumAtmanaH |
avAkiratsahasreNa tIkShNAnAM ka~NkapatriNAm
shlokas.78:
taM vai vi.nshatisAhasrAH pA~nchAlAnAM nararShabhAH |
tathA charantaM sa~NgrAme sarvato vyakira~nsharaiH
shlokas.79:
tataH prAduShkaroddroNo brAhmamastraM parantapaH |
vadhAya teShAM shUrANAM pA~nchAlAnAmamarShitaH
shlokas.80:
tato vyarochata droNo vinighnansarvasomakAn |
shirA.nsyapAtayachchApi pA~nchAlAnAM mahAmRRidhe
tathaiva parighAkArAnbAhUnkanakabhUShaNAn
shlokas.81:
te vadhyamAnAH samare bhAradvAjena pArthivAH |
medinyAmanvakIryanta vAtanunnA iva drumAH
shlokas.82:
ku~njarANAM cha patatAM hayaughAnAM cha bhArata |
agamyarUpA pRRithivI mA.nsashoNitakardamA
shlokas.83:
hatvA vi.nshatisAhasrAnpA~nchAlAnAM rathavrajAn |
atiShThadAhave droNo vidhUmo.agniriva jvalan
shlokas.84:
tathaiva cha punaH kruddho bhAradvAjaH pratApavAn |
vasudAnasya bhallena shiraH kAyAdapAharat
shlokas.85:
punaH pa~nchashatAnmatsyAnShaTsahasrA.nshcha sRRi~njayAn |
hastinAmayutaM hatvA jaghAnAshvAyutaM punaH
shlokas.87:
vishvAmitro jamadagnirbhAradvAjo.atha gautamaH |
vasiShThaH kashyapo.atrishcha brahmalokaM ninIShavaH
shlokas.88:
sikatAH pRRishnayo gargA bAlakhilyA marIchipAH |
bhRRigavo.a~Ngirasashchaiva sUkShmAshchAnye maharShayaH
shlokas.89:
ta enamabruvansarve droNamAhavashobhinam |
adharmataH kRRitaM yuddhaM samayo nidhanasya te
shlokas.90:
nyasyAyudhaM raNe droNa sametyAsmAnavasthitAn |
nAtaH krUrataraM karma punaH kartuM tvamarhasi
shlokas.91:
vedavedA~NgaviduShaH satyadharmaparasya cha |
brAhmaNasya visheSheNa tavaitannopapadyate
shlokas.92:
nyasyAyudhamamogheSho tiShTha vartmani shAshvate |
paripUrNashcha kAlaste vastuM loke.adya mAnuShe
shlokas.93:
iti teShAM vachaH shrutvA bhImasenavachashcha tat |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha samprekShya raNe sa vimanAbhavat
shlokas.94:
sa dahyamAno vyathitaH kuntIputraM yudhiShThiram |
ahataM vA hataM veti paprachCha sutamAtmanaH
shlokas.95:
sthirA buddhirhi droNasya na pArtho vakShyate.anRRitam |
trayANAmapi lokAnAmaishvaryArthe katha~nchana
shlokas.96:
tasmAttaM paripaprachCha nAnyaM ka~nchidvisheShataH |
tasmi.nstasya hi satyAshA bAlyAtprabhRRiti pANDave
shlokas.97:
tato niShpANDavAmurvIM kariShyantaM yudhAM patim |
droNaM j~nAtvA dharmarAjaM govindo vyathito.abravIt
shlokas.98:
yadyardhadivasaM droNo yudhyate manyumAsthitaH |
satyaM bravImi te senA vinAshaM samupaiShyati
shlokas.99:
sa bhavA.nstrAtu no droNAtsatyAjjyAyo.anRRitaM bhavet |
anRRitaM jIvitasyArthe vadanna spRRishyate.anRRitaiH
shlokas.100:
tayoH sa.nvadatorevaM bhImaseno.abravIdidam |
shrutvaiva taM mahArAja vadhopAyaM mahAtmanaH
shlokas.101:
gAhamAnasya te senAM mAlavasyendravarmaNaH |
ashvatthAmeti vikhyAto gajaH shakragajopamaH
shlokas.102:
nihato yudhi vikramya tato.ahaM droNamabruvam |
ashvatthAmA hato brahmannivartasvAhavAditi
shlokas.103:
nUnaM nAshraddadhadvAkyameSha me puruSharShabhaH |
sa tvaM govindavAkyAni mAnayasva jayaiShiNaH
shlokas.104:
droNAya nihataM sha.nsa rAja~nshAradvatIsutam |
tvayokto naiSha yudhyeta jAtu rAjandvijarShabhaH
satyavAnhi nRRiloke.asminbhavAnkhyAto janAdhipa
shlokas.105:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA kRRiShNavAkyaprachoditaH |
bhAvitvAchcha mahArAja vaktuM samupachakrame
shlokas.106:
tamatathyabhaye magno jaye sakto yudhiShThiraH |
avyaktamabravIdrAjanhataH ku~njara ityuta
shlokas.107:
tasya pUrvaM rathaH pRRithvyAshchatura~Ngula uttaraH |
babhUvaivaM tu tenokte tasya vAhAspRRishanmahIm
shlokas.108:
yudhiShThirAttu tadvAkyaM shrutvA droNo mahArathaH |
putravyasanasantapto nirAsho jIvite.abhavat
shlokas.109:
AgaskRRitamivAtmAnaM pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
RRiShivAkyaM cha manvAnaH shrutvA cha nihataM sutam
shlokas.110:
vichetAH paramodvigno dhRRiShTadyumnamavekShya cha |
yoddhuM nAshaknuvadrAjanyathApUrvamari.ndama
shlokas.111:
taM dRRiShTvA paramodvignaM shokopahatachetasam |
pA~nchAlarAjasya suto dhRRiShTadyumnaH samAdravat
shlokas.112:
ya iShTvA manujendreNa drupadena mahAmakhe |
labdho droNavinAshAya samiddhAddhavyavAhanAt
shlokas.113:
sa dhanurjaitramAdAya ghoraM jaladanisvanam |
dRRiDhajyamajaraM divyaM sharA.nshchAshIviShopamAn
shlokas.114:
sa.ndadhe kArmuke tasmi~nsharamAshIviShopamam |
droNaM jighA.nsuH pA~nchAlyo mahAjvAlamivAnalam
shlokas.115:
tasya rUpaM sharasyAsIddhanurjyAmaNDalAntare |
dyotato bhAskarasyeva ghanAnte pariveshinaH
shlokas.116:
pArShatena parAmRRiShTaM jvalantamiva taddhanuH |
antakAlamiva prAptaM menire vIkShya sainikAH
shlokas.117:
tamiShuM saMhitaM tena bhAradvAjaH pratApavAn |
dRRiShTvAmanyata dehasya kAlaparyAyamAgatam
shlokas.118:
tataH sa yatnamAtiShThadAchAryastasya vAraNe |
na chAsyAstrANi rAjendra prAdurAsanmahAtmanaH
shlokas.119:
tasya tvahAni chatvAri kShapA chaikAsyato gatA |
tasya chAhnastribhAgena kShayaM jagmuH patatriNaH
shlokas.120:
sa sharakShayamAsAdya putrashokena chArditaH |
vividhAnAM cha divyAnAmastrANAmaprasannatAm
shlokas.121:
utsraShTukAmaH shastrANi vipravAkyAbhichoditaH |
tejasA preryamANashcha yuyudhe so.atimAnuSham
shlokas.122:
athAnyatsa samAdAya divyamA~NgirasaM dhanuH |
sharA.nshcha brahmadaNDAbhAndhRRiShTadyumnamayodhayat
shlokas.123:
tatastaM sharavarSheNa mahatA samavAkirat |
vyashAtayachcha sa~Nkruddho dhRRiShTadyumnamamarShaNaH
shlokas.124:
taM sharaM shatadhA chAsya droNashchichCheda sAyakaiH |
dhvajaM dhanushcha nishitaiH sArathiM chApyapAtayat
shlokas.125:
dhRRiShTadyumnaH prahasyAnyatpunarAdAya kArmukam |
shitena chainaM bANena pratyavidhyatstanAntare
shlokas.126:
so.atividdho maheShvAsaH sambhrAnta iva sa.nyuge |
bhallena shitadhAreNa chichChedAsya mahaddhanuH
shlokas.127:
yachchAsya bANaM vikRRitaM dhanUMShi cha vishAM pate |
sarvaM sa~nChidya durdharSho gadAM khaDgamathApi cha
shlokas.128:
dhRRiShTadyumnaM tato.avidhyannavabhirnishitaiH sharaiH |
jIvitAntakaraiH kruddhaH kruddharUpaM parantapaH
shlokas.130:
te mishrA bahvashobhanta javanA vAtaraMhasaH |
pArAvatasavarNAshcha shoNAshcha bharatarShabha
shlokas.131:
yathA savidyuto meghA nadanto jaladAgame |
tathA rejurmahArAja mishritA raNamUrdhani
shlokas.132:
IShAbandhaM chakrabandhaM rathabandhaM tathaiva cha |
praNAshayadameyAtmA dhRRiShTadyumnasya sa dvijaH
shlokas.133:
sa ChinnadhanvA viratho hatAshvo hatasArathiH |
uttamAmApadaM prApya gadAM vIraH parAmRRishat
shlokas.134:
tAmasya vishikhaistIkShNaiH kShipyamANAM mahArathaH |
nijaghAna sharairdroNaH kruddhaH satyaparAkramaH
shlokas.135:
tAM dRRiShTvA tu naravyAghro droNena nihatAM sharaiH |
vimalaM khaDgamAdatta shatachandraM cha bhAnumat
shlokas.136:
asa.nshayaM tathAbhUte pA~nchAlyaH sAdhvamanyata |
vadhamAchAryamukhyasya prAptakAlaM mahAtmanaH
shlokas.137:
tataH svarathanIDasthaH svarathasya ratheShayA |
agachChadasimudyamya shatachandraM cha bhAnumat
shlokas.138:
chikIrShurduShkaraM karma dhRRiShTadyumno mahArathaH |
iyeSha vakSho bhettuM cha bhAradvAjasya sa.nyuge
shlokas.139:
so.atiShThadyugamadhye vai yugasaMnahaneShu cha |
shoNAnAM jaghanArdheShu tatsainyAH samapUjayan
shlokas.141:
kShipraM shyenasya charato yathaivAmiShagRRiddhinaH |
tadvadAsIdabhIsAro droNaM prArthayato raNe
shlokas.142:
tasyAshvAnrathashaktyAsau tadA kruddhaH parAkramI |
sarvAnekaikasho droNaH kapotAbhAnajIghanat
shlokas.143:
te hatA nyapatanbhUmau dhRRiShTadyumnasya vAjinaH |
shoNAshcha paryamuchyanta rathabandhAdvishAM pate
shlokas.144:
tAnhayAnnihatAndRRiShTvA dvijAgryeNa sa pArShataH |
nAmRRiShyata yudhAM shreShTho yAj~nasenirmahArathaH
shlokas.145:
virathaH sa gRRihItvA tu khaDgaM khaDgabhRRitAM varaH |
droNamabhyapatadrAjanvainateya ivoragam
shlokas.146:
tasya rUpaM babhau rAjanbhAradvAjaM jighA.nsataH |
yathA rUpaM paraM viShNorhiraNyakashiporvadhe
shlokas.148:
parivRRittaM nivRRittaM cha khaDgaM charma cha dhArayan |
sampAtaM samudIrNaM cha darshayAmAsa pArShataH
shlokas.149:
tataH sharasahasreNa shatachandramapAtayat |
khaDgaM charma cha sambAdhe dhRRiShTadyumnasya sa dvijaH
shlokas.150:
te tu vaitastikA nAma sharA hyAsannaghAtinaH |
nikRRiShTayuddhe droNasya nAnyeShAM santi te sharAH
shlokas.151:
shAradvatasya pArthasya drauNervaikartanasya cha |
pradyumnayuyudhAnAbhyAmabhimanyoshcha te sharAH
shlokas.152:
athAsyeShuM samAdhatta dRRiDhaM paramasa.nshitam |
antevAsinamAchAryo jighA.nsuH putrasaMmitam
shlokas.153:
taM sharairdashabhistIkShNaishchichCheda shinipu~NgavaH |
pashyatastava putrasya karNasya cha mahAtmanaH
grastamAchAryamukhyena dhRRiShTadyumnamamochayat
shlokas.154:
charantaM rathamArgeShu sAtyakiM satyavikramam |
droNakarNAntaragataM kRRipasyApi cha bhArata
apashyetAM mahAtmAnau viShvaksenadhana~njayau
shlokas.155:
apUjayetAM vArShNeyaM bruvANau sAdhu sAdhviti |
divyAnyastrANi sarveShAM yudhi nighnantamachyutam
abhipatya tataH senAM viShvaksenadhana~njayau
shlokas.156:
dhana~njayastataH kRRiShNamabravItpashya keshava |
AchAryavaramukhyAnAM madhye krIDanmadhUdvahaH
shlokas.157:
Anandayati mAM bhUyaH sAtyakiH satyavikramaH |
mAdrIputrau cha bhImaM cha rAjAnaM cha yudhiShThiram
shlokas.158:
yachChikShayAnuddhataH sanraNe charati sAtyakiH |
mahArathAnupakrIDanvRRiShNInAM kIrtivardhanaH
shlokas.159:
tamete pratinandanti siddhAH sainyAshcha vismitAH |
ajayyaM samare dRRiShTvA sAdhu sAdhviti sAtvatam
yodhAshchobhayataH sarve karmabhiH samapUjayan

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
krUramAyodhanaM jaj~ne tasminrAjasamAgame |
rudrasyeva hi kruddhasya nighnatastu pashUnyathA
shlokas.2:
hastAnAmuttamA~NgAnAM kArmukANAM cha bhArata |
ChatrANAM chApaviddhAnAM chAmarANAM cha sa.nyuge
shlokas.3:
bhagnachakrai rathaishchApi pAtitaishcha mahAdhvajaiH |
sAdibhishcha hataiH shUraiH sa~NkIrNA vasudhAbhavat
shlokas.4:
bANapAtanikRRittAstu yodhAste kurusattama |
cheShTanto vividhAshcheShTA vyadRRishyanta mahAhave
shlokas.5:
vartamAne tathA yuddhe ghore devAsuropame |
abravItkShatriyA.nstatra dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
abhidravata sa.nyattAH kumbhayoniM mahArathAH
shlokas.6:
eSha vai pArShato vIro bhAradvAjena sa~NgataH |
ghaTate cha yathAshakti bhAradvAjasya nAshane
shlokas.7:
yAdRRishAni hi rUpANi dRRishyante no mahAraNe |
adya droNaM raNe kruddhaH pAtayiShyati pArShataH
te yUyaM sahitA bhUtvA kumbhayoniM parIpsata
shlokas.8:
yudhiShThirasamAj~naptAH sRRi~njayAnAM mahArathAH |
abhyadravanta sa.nyattA bhAradvAjaM jighA.nsavaH
shlokas.9:
tAnsamApatataH sarvAnbhAradvAjo mahArathaH |
abhyadravata vegena martavyamiti nishchitaH
shlokas.10:
prayAte satyasandhe tu samakampata medinI |
vavurvAtAH sanirghAtAstrAsayanto varUthinIm
shlokas.11:
papAta mahatI cholkA AdityAnnirgateva ha |
dIpayantIva tApena sha.nsantIva mahadbhayam
shlokas.12:
jajvalushchaiva shastrANi bhAradvAjasya mAriSha |
rathAH svananti chAtyarthaM hayAshchAshrUNyavAsRRijan
shlokas.13:
hataujA iva chApyAsIdbhAradvAjo mahArathaH |
RRiShINAM brahmavAdAnAM svargasya gamanaM prati
suyuddhena tataH prANAnutsraShTumupachakrame
shlokas.14:
tatashchaturdishaM sainyairdrupadasyAbhisa.nvRRitaH |
nirdahankShatriyavrAtAndroNaH paryacharadraNe
shlokas.15:
hatvA vi.nshatisAhasrAnkShatriyAnarimardanaH |
dashAyutAni tIkShNAgrairavadhIdvishikhaiH shitaiH
shlokas.16:
so.atiShThadAhave yatto vidhUma iva pAvakaH |
kShatriyANAmabhAvAya brAhmamAtmAnamAsthitaH
shlokas.17:
pA~nchAlyaM virathaM bhImo hatasarvAyudhaM vashI |
aviShaNNaM mahAtmAnaM tvaramANaH samabhyayAt
shlokas.18:
tataH svarathamAropya pA~nchAlyamarimardanaH |
abravIdabhisamprekShya droNamasyantamantikAt
shlokas.19:
na tvadanya ihAchAryaM yoddhumutsahate pumAn |
tvarasva prAgvadhAyaiva tvayi bhAraH samAhitaH
shlokas.20:
sa tathokto mahAbAhuH sarvabhArasahaM navam |
abhipatyAdade kShipramAyudhapravaraM dRRiDham
shlokas.21:
sa.nrabdhashcha sharAnasyandroNaM durvAraNaM raNe |
vivArayiShurAchAryaM sharavarShairavAkirat
shlokas.22:
tau nyavArayatAM shreShThau sa.nrabdhau raNashobhinau |
udIrayetAM brAhmANi divyAnyastrANyanekashaH
shlokas.23:
sa mahAstrairmahArAja droNamAchChAdayadraNe |
nihatya sarvANyastrANi bhAradvAjasya pArShataH
shlokas.24:
sa vasAtI~nshibI.nshchaiva bAhlIkAnkauravAnapi |
rakShiShyamANAnsa~NgrAme droNaM vyadhamadachyutaH
shlokas.25:
dhRRiShTadyumnastadA rAjangabhastibhirivA.nshumAn |
babhau prachChAdayannAshAH sharajAlaiH samantataH
shlokas.26:
tasya droNo dhanushChittvA viddhvA chainaM shilImukhaiH |
marmANyabhyahanadbhUyaH sa vyathAM paramAmagAt
shlokas.27:
tato bhImo dRRiDhakrodho droNasyAshliShya taM ratham |
shanakairiva rAjendra droNaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.28:
yadi nAma na yudhyera~nshikShitA brahmabandhavaH |
svakarmabhirasantuShTA na sma kShatraM kShayaM vrajet
shlokas.29:
ahi.nsA sarvabhUteShu dharmaM jyAyastaraM viduH |
tasya cha brAhmaNo mUlaM bhavA.nshcha brahmavittamaH
shlokas.30:
shvapAkavanmlechChagaNAnhatvA chAnyAnpRRithagvidhAn |
aj~nAnAnmUDhavadbrahmanputradAradhanepsayA
shlokas.31:
ekasyArthe bahUnhatvA putrasyAdharmavidyathA |
svakarmasthAnvikarmastho na vyapatrapase katham
shlokas.32:
sa chAdya patitaH shete pRRiShTenAveditastava |
dharmarAjena tadvAkyaM nAtisha~Nkitumarhasi
shlokas.33:
evamuktastato droNo bhImenotsRRijya taddhanuH |
sarvANyastrANi dharmAtmA hAtukAmo.abhyabhAShata
karNa karNa maheShvAsa kRRipa duryodhaneti cha
shlokas.34:
sa~NgrAme kriyatAM yatno bravImyeSha punaH punaH |
pANDavebhyaH shivaM vo.astu shastramabhyutsRRijAmyaham
shlokas.35:
iti tatra mahArAja prAkroshaddrauNimeva cha |
utsRRijya cha raNe shastraM rathopasthe niveshya cha
abhayaM sarvabhUtAnAM pradadau yogayuktavAn
shlokas.36:
tasya tachChidramAj~nAya dhRRiShTadyumnaH samutthitaH |
khaDgI rathAdavaplutya sahasA droNamabhyayAt
shlokas.37:
hAhAkRRitAni bhUtAni mAnuShANItarANi cha |
droNaM tathAgataM dRRiShTvA dhRRiShTadyumnavashaM gatam
shlokas.38:
hAhAkAraM bhRRishaM chakruraho dhigiti chAbruvan |
droNo.api shastrANyutsRRijya paramaM sAmyamAsthitaH
shlokas.39:
tathoktvA yogamAsthAya jyotirbhUto mahAtapAH |
divamAkrAmadAchAryaH sadbhiH saha durAkramam
shlokas.40:
dvau sUryAviti no buddhirAsIttasmi.nstathA gate |
ekAgramiva chAsIddhi jyotirbhiH pUritaM nabhaH
samapadyata chArkAbhe bhAradvAjanishAkare
shlokas.41:
nimeShamAtreNa cha tajjyotirantaradhIyata |
AsItkilakilAshabdaH prahRRiShTAnAM divaukasAm
brahmalokaM gate droNe dhRRiShTadyumne cha mohite
shlokas.42:
vayameva tadAdrAkShma pa~ncha mAnuShayonayaH |
yogayuktaM mahAtmAnaM gachChantaM paramAM gatim
shlokas.43:
ahaM dhana~njayaH pArthaH kRRipaH shAradvato dvijaH |
vAsudevashcha vArShNeyo dharmarAjashcha pANDavaH
shlokas.44:
anye tu sarve nApashyanbhAradvAjasya dhImataH |
mahimAnaM mahArAja yogamuktasya gachChataH
shlokas.45:
gatiM paramikAM prAptamajAnanto nRRiyonayaH |
nApashyangachChamAnaM hi taM sArdhamRRiShipu~NgavaiH
AchAryaM yogamAsthAya brahmalokamari.ndamam
shlokas.46:
vitunnA~NgaM sharashatairnyastAyudhamasRRikkSharam |
dhikkRRitaH pArShatastaM tu sarvabhUtaiH parAmRRishat
shlokas.47:
tasya mUrdhAnamAlambya gatasattvasya dehinaH |
ki~nchidabruvataH kAyAdvichakartAsinA shiraH
shlokas.48:
harSheNa mahatA yukto bhAradvAje nipAtite |
siMhanAdaravaM chakre bhrAmayankhaDgamAhave
shlokas.49:
AkarNapalitaH shyAmo vayasAshItipa~nchakaH |
tvatkRRite vyacharatsa~Nkhye sa tu ShoDashavarShavat
shlokas.50:
uktavA.nshcha mahAbAhuH kuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
jIvantamAnayAchAryaM mA vadhIrdrupadAtmaja
shlokas.51:
na hantavyo na hantavya iti te sainikAshcha ha |
utkroshannarjunashchaiva sAnukroshastamAdravat
shlokas.52:
kroshamAne.arjune chaiva pArthiveShu cha sarvashaH |
dhRRiShTadyumno.avadhIddroNaM rathatalpe nararShabham
shlokas.53:
shoNitena pariklinno rathAdbhUmimari.ndamaH |
lohitA~Nga ivAdityo durdarshaH samapadyata
evaM taM nihataM sa~Nkhye dadRRishe sainiko janaH
shlokas.54:
dhRRiShTadyumnastu tadrAjanbhAradvAjashiro mahat |
tAvakAnAM maheShvAsaH pramukhe tatsamAkShipat
shlokas.55:
te tu dRRiShTvA shiro rAjanbhAradvAjasya tAvakAH |
palAyanakRRitotsAhA dudruvuH sarvatodisham
shlokas.56:
droNastu divamAsthAya nakShatrapathamAvishat |
ahameva tadAdrAkShaM droNasya nidhanaM nRRipa
shlokas.57:
RRiSheH prasAdAtkRRiShNasya satyavatyAH sutasya cha |
vidhUmAmiva sa.nyAntImulkAM prajvalitAmiva
apashyAma divaM stabdhvA gachChantaM taM mahAdyutim
shlokas.58:
hate droNe nirutsAhAnkurUnpANDavasRRi~njayAH |
abhyadravanmahAvegAstataH sainyaM vyadIryata
shlokas.59:
nihatA hayabhUyiShThAH sa~NgrAme nishitaiH sharaiH |
tAvakA nihate droNe gatAsava ivAbhavan
shlokas.60:
parAjayamathAvApya paratra cha mahadbhayam |
ubhayenaiva te hInA nAvindandhRRitimAtmanaH
shlokas.61:
anvichChantaH sharIraM tu bhAradvAjasya pArthivAH |
nAdhyagachCha.nstadA rAjankabandhAyutasa~Nkule
shlokas.62:
pANDavAstu jayaM labdhvA paratra cha mahadyashaH |
bANashabdaravA.nshchakruH siMhanAdA.nshcha puShkalAn
shlokas.63:
bhImasenastato rAjandhRRiShTadyumnashcha pArShataH |
varUthinyAmanRRityetAM pariShvajya parasparam
shlokas.64:
abravIchcha tadA bhImaH pArShataM shatrutApanam |
bhUyo.ahaM tvAM vijayinaM pariShvakShyAmi pArShata
sUtaputre hate pApe dhArtarAShTre cha sa.nyuge
shlokas.65:
etAvaduktvA bhImastu harSheNa mahatA yutaH |
bAhushabdena pRRithivIM kampayAmAsa pANDavaH
shlokas.66:
tasya shabdena vitrastAH prAdrava.nstAvakA yudhi |
kShatradharmaM samutsRRijya palAyanaparAyaNAH
shlokas.67:
pANDavAstu jayaM labdhvA hRRiShTA hyAsanvishAM pate |
arikShayaM cha sa~NgrAme tena te sukhamApnuvan
shlokas.68:
tato droNe hate rAjankuravaH shastrapIDitAH |
hatapravIrA vidhvastA bhRRishaM shokaparAyaNAH
shlokas.69:
vichetaso hatotsAhAH kashmalAbhihataujasaH |
ArtasvareNa mahatA putraM te paryavArayan
shlokas.70:
rajasvalA vepamAnA vIkShamANA disho dasha |
ashrukaNThA yathA daityA hiraNyAkShe purA hate
shlokas.71:
sa taiH parivRRito rAjA trastaiH kShudramRRigairiva |
ashaknuvannavasthAtumapAyAttanayastava
shlokas.72:
kShutpipAsAparishrAntAste yodhAstava bhArata |
Adityena cha santaptA bhRRishaM vimanaso.abhavan
shlokas.73:
bhAskarasyeva patanaM samudrasyeva shoShaNam |
viparyAsaM yathA merorvAsavasyeva nirjayam
shlokas.74:
amarShaNIyaM taddRRiShTvA bhAradvAjasya pAtanam |
trastarUpatarA rAjankauravAH prAdravanbhayAt
shlokas.75:
gAndhArarAjaH shakunistrastastrastataraiH saha |
hataM rukmarathaM dRRiShTvA prAdravatsahito rathaiH
shlokas.76:
varUthinIM vegavatIM vidrutAM sapatAkinIm |
parigRRihya mahAsenAM sUtaputro.apayAdbhayAt
shlokas.77:
rathanAgAshvakalilAM puraskRRitya tu vAhinIm |
madrANAmIshvaraH shalyo vIkShamANo.apayAdbhayAt
shlokas.78:
hatapravIrairbhUyiShThaM dvipairbahupadAtibhiH |
vRRitaH shAradvato.agachChatkaShTaM kaShTamiti bruvan
shlokas.79:
bhojAnIkena shiShTena kali~NgAraTTabAhlikaiH |
kRRitavarmA vRRito rAjanprAyAtsujavanairhayaiH
shlokas.80:
padAtigaNasa.nyuktastrasto rAjanbhayArditaH |
ulUkaH prAdravattatra dRRiShTvA droNaM nipAtitam
shlokas.81:
darshanIyo yuvA chaiva shaurye cha kRRitalakShaNaH |
duHshAsano bhRRishodvignaH prAdravadgajasa.nvRRitaH
shlokas.82:
gajAshvarathasa.nyukto vRRitashchaiva padAtibhiH |
duryodhano mahArAja prAyAttatra mahArathaH
shlokas.83:
gajAnrathAnsamAruhya parasyApi hayA~njanAH |
prakIrNakeshA vidhvastA na dvAvekatra dhAvataH
shlokas.84:
nedamastIti puruShA hatotsAhA hataujasaH |
utsRRijya kavachAnanye prAdrava.nstAvakA vibho
shlokas.85:
anyonyaM te samAkroshansainikA bharatarShabha |
tiShTha tiShTheti na cha te svayaM tatrAvatasthire
shlokas.86:
dhuryAnpramuchya tu rathAddhatasUtAnsvala~NkRRitAn |
adhiruhya hayAnyodhAH kShipraM padbhirachodayan
shlokas.87:
dravamANe tathA sainye trastarUpe hataujasi |
pratisrota iva grAho droNaputraH parAniyAt
shlokas.88:
hatvA bahuvidhAM senAM pANDUnAM yuddhadurmadaH |
katha~nchitsa~NkaTAnmukto mattadviradavikramaH
shlokas.89:
dravamANaM balaM dRRiShTvA palAyanakRRitakShaNam |
duryodhanaM samAsAdya droNaputro.abravIdidam
shlokas.90:
kimiyaM dravate senA trastarUpeva bhArata |
dravamANAM cha rAjendra nAvasthApayase raNe
shlokas.91:
tvaM chApi na yathApUrvaM prakRRitistho narAdhipa |
karNaprabhRRitayashcheme nAvatiShThanti pArthivAH
shlokas.92:
anyeShvapi cha yuddheShu naiva senAdravattadA |
kachchitkShemaM mahAbAho tava sainyasya bhArata
shlokas.93:
kasminnidaM hate rAjanrathasiMhe balaM tava |
etAmavasthAM samprAptaM tanmamAchakShva kaurava
shlokas.94:
tattu duryodhanaH shrutvA droNaputrasya bhAShitam |
ghoramapriyamAkhyAtuM nAshakatpArthivarShabhaH
shlokas.95:
bhinnA nauriva te putro nimagnaH shokasAgare |
bAShpeNa pihito dRRiShTvA droNaputraM rathe sthitam
shlokas.96:
tataH shAradvataM rAjA savrIDamidamabravIt |
sha.nseha sarvaM bhadraM te yathA sainyamidaM drutam
shlokas.97:
atha shAradvato rAjannArtiM gachChanpunaH punaH |
shasha.nsa droNaputrAya yathA droNo nipAtitaH
shlokas.98:
kRRipa uvAcha||
vayaM droNaM puraskRRitya pRRithivyAM pravaraM ratham |
prAvartayAma sa~NgrAmaM pA~nchAlaireva kevalaiH
shlokas.99:
tataH pravRRitte sa~NgrAme vimishrAH kurusomakAH |
anyonyamabhigarjantaH shastrairdehAnapAtayan
shlokas.100:
tato droNo brAhmamastraM vikurvANo nararShabhaH |
ahanachChAtravAnbhallaiH shatasho.atha sahasrashaH
shlokas.101:
pANDavAH kekayA matsyAH pA~nchAlAshcha visheShataH |
sa~Nkhye droNarathaM prApya vyanashankAlachoditAH
shlokas.102:
sahasraM rathasiMhAnAM dvisAhasraM cha dantinAm |
droNo brahmAstranirdagdhaM preShayAmAsa mRRityave
shlokas.103:
AkarNapalitaH shyAmo vayasAshItipa~nchakaH |
raNe paryacharaddroNo vRRiddhaH ShoDashavarShavat
shlokas.104:
klishyamAneShu sainyeShu vadhyamAneShu rAjasu |
amarShavashamApannAH pA~nchAlA vimukhAbhavan
shlokas.105:
teShu ki~nchitprabhagneShu vimukheShu sapatnajit |
divyamastraM vikurvANo babhUvArka ivoditaH
shlokas.106:
sa madhyaM prApya pANDUnAM shararashmiH pratApavAn |
madhya~Ngata ivAdityo duShprekShyaste pitAbhavat
shlokas.107:
te dahyamAnA droNena sUryeNeva virAjatA |
dagdhavIryA nirutsAhA babhUvurgatachetasaH
shlokas.108:
tAndRRiShTvA pIDitAnbANairdroNena madhusUdanaH |
jayaiShI pANDuputrANAmidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.109:
naiSha jAtu paraiH shakyo jetuM shastrabhRRitAM varaH |
api vRRitrahaNA sa~Nkhye rathayUthapayUthapaH
shlokas.110:
te yUyaM dharmamutsRRijya jayaM rakShata pANDavAH |
yathA vaH sa.nyuge sarvAnna hanyAdrukmavAhanaH
shlokas.111:
ashvatthAmni hate naiSha yudhyediti matirmama |
hataM taM sa.nyuge kashchidAkhyAtvasmai mRRiShA naraH
shlokas.112:
etannArochayadvAkyaM kuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
arochaya.nstu sarve.anye kRRichChreNa tu yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.113:
bhImasenastu savrIDamabravItpitaraM tava |
ashvatthAmA hata iti tachchAbudhyata te pitA
shlokas.114:
sa sha~NkamAnastanmithyA dharmarAjamapRRichChata |
hataM vApyahataM vAjau tvAM pitA putravatsalaH
shlokas.115:
tadatathyabhaye magno jaye sakto yudhiShThiraH |
ashvatthAmAnamAhedaM hataH ku~njara ityuta
bhImena girivarShmANaM mAlavasyendravarmaNaH
shlokas.116:
upasRRitya tadA droNamuchchairidamabhAShata |
yasyArthe shastramAdhatse yamavekShya cha jIvasi
putraste dayito nityaM sho.ashvatthAmA nipAtitaH
shlokas.117:
tachChrutvA vimanAstatra AchAryo mahadapriyam |
niyamya divyAnyastrANi nAyudhyata yathA purA
shlokas.118:
taM dRRiShTvA paramodvignaM shokopahatachetasam |
pA~nchAlarAjasya sutaH krUrakarmA samAdravat
shlokas.119:
taM dRRiShTvA vihitaM mRRityuM lokatattvavichakShaNaH |
divyAnyastrANyathotsRRijya raNe prAya upAvishat
shlokas.120:
tato.asya keshAnsavyena gRRihItvA pANinA tadA |
pArShataH kroshamAnAnAM vIrANAmachChinachChiraH
shlokas.121:
na hantavyo na hantavya iti te sarvato.abruvan |
tathaiva chArjuno vAhAdavaruhyainamAdravat
shlokas.122:
udyamya bAhU tvarito bruvANashcha punaH punaH |
jIvantamAnayAchAryaM mA vadhIriti dharmavit
shlokas.123:
tathApi vAryamANena kauravairarjunena cha |
hata eva nRRisha.nsena pitA tava nararShabha
shlokas.124:
sainikAshcha tataH sarve prAdravanta bhayArditAH |
vayaM chApi nirutsAhA hate pitari te.anagha
shlokas.125:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tachChrutvA droNaputrastu nidhanaM piturAhave |
krodhamAhArayattIvraM padAhata ivoragaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
adharmeNa hataM shrutvA dhRRiShTadyumnena sa~njaya |
brAhmaNaM pitaraM vRRiddhamashvatthAmA kimabravIt
shlokas.2:
mAnuShaM vAruNAgneyaM brAhmamastraM cha vIryavAn |
aindraM nArAyaNaM chaiva yasminnityaM pratiShThitam
shlokas.3:
tamadharmeNa dharmiShThaM dhRRiShTadyumnena sa~njaya |
shrutvA nihatamAchAryamashvatthAmA kimabravIt
shlokas.4:
yena rAmAdavApyeha dhanurvedaM mahAtmanA |
proktAnyastrANi divyAni putrAya gurukA~NkShiNe
shlokas.5:
ekameva hi loke.asminnAtmano guNavattaram |
ichChanti putraM puruShA loke nAnyaM katha~nchana
shlokas.6:
AchAryANAM bhavantyeva rahasyAni mahAtmanAm |
tAni putrAya vA dadyuH shiShyAyAnugatAya vA
shlokas.7:
sa shilpaM prApya tatsarvaM savisheShaM cha sa~njaya |
shUraH shAradvatIputraH sa~Nkhye droNAdanantaraH
shlokas.8:
rAmasyAnumataH shAstre pura.ndarasamo yudhi |
kArtavIryasamo vIrye bRRihaspatisamo matau
shlokas.9:
mahIdharasamo dhRRityA tejasAgnisamo yuvA |
samudra iva gAmbhIrye krodhe sarpaviShopamaH
shlokas.10:
sa rathI prathamo loke dRRiDhadhanvA jitaklamaH |
shIghro.anila ivAkrande charankruddha ivAntakaH
shlokas.11:
asyatA yena sa~NgrAme dharaNyabhinipIDitA |
yo na vyathati sa~NgrAme vIraH satyaparAkramaH
shlokas.12:
vedasnAto vratasnAto dhanurvede cha pAragaH |
mahodadhirivAkShobhyo rAmo dAsharathiryathA
shlokas.13:
tamadharmeNa dharmiShThaM dhRRiShTadyumnena sa.nyuge |
shrutvA nihatamAchAryamashvatthAmA kimabravIt
shlokas.14:
dhRRiShTadyumnasya yo mRRityuH sRRiShTastena mahAtmanA |
yathA droNasya pA~nchAlyo yaj~nasenasuto.abhavat
shlokas.15:
taM nRRisha.nsena pApena krUreNAtyalpadarshinA |
shrutvA nihatamAchAryamashvatthAmA kimabravIt
shlokas.16:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
ChadmanA nihataM shrutvA pitaraM pApakarmaNA |
bAShpeNApUryata drauNI roSheNa cha nararShabha
shlokas.17:
tasya kruddhasya rAjendra vapurdivyamadRRishyata |
antakasyeva bhUtAni jihIrShoH kAlaparyaye
shlokas.18:
ashrupUrNe tato netre apamRRijya punaH punaH |
uvAcha kopAnniHshvasya duryodhanamidaM vachaH
shlokas.19:
pitA mama yathA kShudrairnyastashastro nipAtitaH |
dharmadhvajavatA pApaM kRRitaM tadviditaM mama
anAryaM sunRRisha.nsasya dharmaputrasya me shrutam
shlokas.20:
yuddheShvapi pravRRittAnAM dhruvau jayaparAjayau |
dvayametadbhavedrAjanvadhastatra prashasyate
shlokas.21:
nyAyavRRitto vadho yastu sa~NgrAme yudhyato bhavet |
na sa duHkhAya bhavati tathA dRRiShTo hi sa dvijaH
shlokas.22:
gataH sa vIralokAya pitA mama na sa.nshayaH |
na shochyaH puruShavyAghrastathA sa nidhanaM gataH
shlokas.23:
yattu dharmapravRRittaH sankeshagrahaNamAptavAn |
pashyatAM sarvasainyAnAM tanme marmANi kRRintati
shlokas.24:
kAmAtkrodhAdavaj~nAnAddarpAdbAlyena vA punaH |
vaidharmikAni kurvanti tathA paribhavena cha
shlokas.25:
tadidaM pArShateneha mahadAdharmikaM kRRitam |
avaj~nAya cha mAM nUnaM nRRisha.nsena durAtmanA
shlokas.26:
tasyAnubandhaM sa draShTA dhRRiShTadyumnaH sudAruNam |
anAryaM paramaM kRRitvA mithyAvAdI cha pANDavaH
shlokas.27:
yo hyasau ChadmanAchAryaM shastraM saMnyAsayattadA |
tasyAdya dharmarAjasya bhUmiH pAsyati shoNitam
shlokas.28:
sarvopAyairyatiShyAmi pA~nchAlAnAmahaM vadhe |
dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha samare hantAhaM pApakAriNam
shlokas.29:
karmaNA yena teneha mRRidunA dAruNena vA |
pA~nchAlAnAM vadhaM kRRitvA shAntiM labdhAsmi kaurava
shlokas.30:
yadarthaM puruShavyAghra putramichChanti mAnavAH |
pretya cheha cha samprAptaM trANAya mahato bhayAt
shlokas.31:
pitrA tu mama sAvasthA prAptA nirbandhunA yathA |
mayi shailapratIkAshe putre shiShye cha jIvati
shlokas.32:
dhi~NmamAstrANi divyAni dhigbAhU dhikparAkramam |
yanmAM droNaH sutaM prApya keshagrahaNamAptavAn
shlokas.33:
sa tathAhaM kariShyAmi yathA bharatasattama |
paralokagatasyApi gamiShyAmyanRRiNaH pituH
shlokas.34:
AryeNa tu na vaktavyA kadAchitstutirAtmanaH |
piturvadhamamRRiShya.nstu vakShyAmyadyeha pauruSham
shlokas.35:
adya pashyantu me vIryaM pANDavAH sajanArdanAH |
mRRidnataH sarvasainyAni yugAntamiva kurvataH
shlokas.36:
na hi devA na gandharvA nAsurA na cha rAkShasAH |
adya shaktA raNe jetuM rathasthaM mAM nararShabha
shlokas.37:
madanyo nAsti loke.asminnarjunAdvAstravittamaH |
ahaM hi jvalatAM madhye mayUkhAnAmivA.nshumAn
prayoktA devasRRiShTAnAmastrANAM pRRitanAgataH
shlokas.38:
kRRishAshvatanayA hyadya matprayuktA mahAmRRidhe |
darshayanto.a.atmano vIryaM pramathiShyanti pANDavAn
shlokas.39:
adya sarvA disho rAjandhArAbhiriva sa~NkulAH |
AvRRitAH patribhistIkShNairdraShTAro mAmakairiha
shlokas.40:
kiranhi sharajAlAni sarvato bhairavasvaram |
shatrUnnipAtayiShyAmi mahAvAta iva drumAn
shlokas.41:
na cha jAnAti bIbhatsustadastraM na janArdanaH |
na bhImaseno na yamau na cha rAjA yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.42:
na pArShato durAtmAsau na shikhaNDI na sAtyakiH |
yadidaM mayi kauravya sakalyaM sanivartanam
shlokas.43:
nArAyaNAya me pitrA praNamya vidhipUrvakam |
upahAraH purA datto brahmarUpa upasthite
shlokas.44:
taM svayaM pratigRRihyAtha bhagavAnsa varaM dadau |
vavre pitA me paramamastraM nArAyaNaM tataH
shlokas.45:
athainamabravIdrAjanbhagavAndevasattamaH |
bhavitA tvatsamo nAnyaH kashchidyudhi naraH kvachit
shlokas.46:
na tvidaM sahasA brahmanprayoktavyaM katha~nchana |
na hyetadastramanyatra vadhAchChatrornivartate
shlokas.47:
na chaitachChakyate j~nAtuM ko na vadhyediti prabho |
avadhyamapi hanyAddhi tasmAnnaitatprayojayet
shlokas.48:
vadhaH sa~Nkhye dravashchaiva shastrANAM cha visarjanam |
prayAchanaM cha shatrUNAM gamanaM sharaNasya cha
shlokas.49:
ete prashamane yogA mahAstrasya parantapa |
sarvathA pIDito hi syAdavadhyAnpIDayanraNe
shlokas.50:
tajjagrAha pitA mahyamabravIchchaiva sa prabhuH |
tvaM varShiShyasi divyAni shastravarShANyanekashaH
anenAstreNa sa~NgrAme tejasA cha jvaliShyasi
shlokas.51:
evamuktvA sa bhagavAndivamAchakrame prabhuH |
etannArAyaNAdastraM tatprAptaM mama bandhunA
shlokas.52:
tenAhaM pANDavA.nshchaiva pA~nchAlAnmatsyakekayAn |
vidrAvayiShyAmi raNe shachIpatirivAsurAn
shlokas.53:
yathA yathAhamichCheyaM tathA bhUtvA sharA mama |
nipateyuH sapatneShu vikramatsvapi bhArata
shlokas.54:
yatheShTamashmavarSheNa pravarShiShye raNe sthitaH |
ayomukhaishcha vihagairdrAvayiShye mahArathAn
parashvadhA.nshcha vividhAnprasakShye.ahamasa.nshayam
shlokas.55:
so.ahaM nArAyaNAstreNa mahatA shatrutApana |
shatrUnvidhva.nsayiShyAmi kadarthIkRRitya pANDavAn
shlokas.56:
mitrabrahmagurudveShI jAlmakaH suvigarhitaH |
pA~nchAlApasadashchAdya na me jIvanvimokShyate
shlokas.57:
tachChrutvA droNaputrasya paryavartata vAhinI |
tataH sarve mahAsha~NkhAndadhmuH puruShasattamAH
shlokas.58:
bherIshchAbhyahananhRRiShTA DiNDimA.nshcha sahasrashaH |
tathA nanAda vasudhA khuranemiprapIDitA
sa shabdastumulaH khaM dyAM pRRithivIM cha vyanAdayat
shlokas.59:
taM shabdaM pANDavAH shrutvA parjanyaninadopamam |
sametya rathinAM shreShThAH sahitAH saMnyamantrayan
shlokas.60:
tathoktvA droNaputro.api tadopaspRRishya bhArata |
prAdushchakAra taddivyamastraM nArAyaNaM tadA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
prAdurbhUte tatastasminnastre nArAyaNe tadA |
prAvAtsapRRiShato vAyuranabhre stanayitnumAn
shlokas.2:
chachAla pRRithivI chApi chukShubhe cha mahodadhiH |
pratisrotaH pravRRittAshcha gantuM tatra samudragAH
shlokas.3:
shikharANi vyadIryanta girINAM tatra bhArata |
apasavyaM mRRigAshchaiva pANDuputrAnprachakrire
shlokas.4:
tamasA chAvakIryanta sUryashcha kaluSho.abhavat |
sampatanti cha bhUtAni kravyAdAni prahRRiShTavat
shlokas.5:
devadAnavagandharvAstrastA AsanvishAM pate |
kathaM kathAbhavattIvrA dRRiShTvA tadvyAkulaM mahat
shlokas.6:
vyathitAH sarvarAjAnastadA hyAsanvichetasaH |
taddRRiShTvA ghorarUpaM tu drauNerastraM bhayAvaham
shlokas.7:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
nivartiteShu sainyeShu droNaputreNa sa.nyuge |
bhRRishaM shokAbhitaptena piturvadhamamRRiShyatA
shlokas.8:
kurUnApatato dRRiShTvA dhRRiShTadyumnasya rakShaNe |
ko mantraH pANDaveShvAsIttanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.9:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
prAgeva vidrutAndRRiShTvA dhArtarAShTrAnyudhiShThiraH |
punashcha tumulaM shabdaM shrutvArjunamabhAShata
shlokas.10:
AchArye nihate droNe dhRRiShTadyumnena sa.nyuge |
nihate vajrahastena yathA vRRitre mahAsure
shlokas.11:
nAsha.nsanta jayaM yuddhe dInAtmAno dhana~njaya |
AtmatrANe matiM kRRitvA prAdravankuravo yathA
shlokas.12:
kechidbhrAntai rathaistUrNaM nihatapArShNiyantRRibhiH |
vipatAkadhvajachChatraiH pArthivAH shIrNakUbaraiH
shlokas.13:
bhagnanIDairAkulAshvairAruhyAnye vichetasaH |
bhItAH pAdairhayAnkechittvarayantaH svayaM rathaiH
yugachakrAkShabhagnaishcha drutAH kechidbhayAturAH
shlokas.14:
gajaskandheShu sa.nsyUtA nArAchaishchalitAsanAH |
sharArtairvidrutairnAgairhRRitAH kechiddisho dasha
shlokas.15:
vishastrakavachAshchAnye vAhanebhyaH kShitiM gatAH |
sa~nChinnA nemiShu gatA mRRiditAshcha hayadvipaiH
shlokas.16:
kroshantastAta putreti palAyanto.apare bhayAt |
nAbhijAnanti chAnyonyaM kashmalAbhihataujasaH
shlokas.17:
putrAnpitR^InsakhInbhrAtR^InsamAropya dRRiDhakShatAn |
jalena kledayantyanye vimuchya kavachAnyapi
shlokas.18:
avasthAM tAdRRishIM prApya hate droNe drutaM balam |
punarAvartitaM kena yadi jAnAsi sha.nsa me
shlokas.19:
hayAnAM heShatAM shabdaH ku~njarANAM cha bRRiMhatAm |
rathanemisvanashchAtra vimishraH shrUyate mahAn
shlokas.20:
ete shabdA bhRRishaM tIvrAH pravRRittAH kurusAgare |
muhurmuhurudIryantaH kampayanti hi mAmakAn
shlokas.21:
ya eSha tumulaH shabdaH shrUyate lomaharShaNaH |
sendrAnapyeSha lokA.nstrInbha~njyAditi matirmama
shlokas.22:
manye vajradharasyaiSha ninAdo bhairavasvanaH |
droNe hate kauravArthaM vyaktamabhyeti vAsavaH
shlokas.23:
prahRRiShTalomakUpAH sma sa.nvignarathaku~njarAH |
dhana~njaya guruM shrutvA tatra nAdaM subhIShaNam
shlokas.24:
ka eSha kauravAndIrNAnavasthApya mahArathaH |
nivartayati yuddhArthaM mRRidhe deveshvaro yathA
shlokas.25:
arjuna uvAcha||
udyamyAtmAnamugrAya karmaNe dhairyamAsthitAH |
dhamanti kauravAH sha~NkhAnyasya vIryamupAshritAH
shlokas.26:
yatra te sa.nshayo rAjannyastashastre gurau hate |
dhArtarAShTrAnavasthApya ka eSha nadatIti ha
shlokas.27:
hrImantaM taM mahAbAhuM mattadviradagAminam |
vyAkhyAsyAmyugrakarmANaM kurUNAmabhaya~Nkaram
shlokas.28:
yasmi~njAte dadau droNo gavAM dashashataM dhanam |
brAhmaNebhyo mahArhebhyaH so.ashvatthAmaiSha garjati
shlokas.29:
jAtamAtreNa vIreNa yenochchaiHshravasA iva |
heShatA kampitA bhUmirlokAshcha sakalAstrayaH
shlokas.30:
tachChrutvAntarhitaM bhUtaM nAma chAsyAkarottadA |
ashvatthAmeti so.adyaiSha shUro nadati pANDava
shlokas.31:
yo.adyAnAtha ivAkramya pArShatena hatastathA |
karmaNA sunRRisha.nsena tasya nAtho vyavasthitaH
shlokas.32:
guruM me yatra pA~nchAlyaH keshapakShe parAmRRishat |
tanna jAtu kShameddrauNirjAnanpauruShamAtmanaH
shlokas.33:
upachIrNo gururmithyA bhavatA rAjyakAraNAt |
dharmaj~nena satA nAma so.adharmaH sumahAnkRRitaH
shlokas.34:
sarvadharmopapanno.ayaM mama shiShyashcha pANDavaH |
nAyaM vakShyati mithyeti pratyayaM kRRitavA.nstvayi
shlokas.35:
sa satyaka~nchukaM nAma praviShTena tato.anRRitam |
AchArya ukto bhavatA hataH ku~njara ityuta
shlokas.36:
tataH shastraM samutsRRijya nirmamo gatachetanaH |
AsItsa vihvalo rAjanyathA dRRiShTastvayA vibhuH
shlokas.37:
sa tu shokena chAviShTo vimukhaH putravatsalaH |
shAshvataM dharmamutsRRijya guruH shiShyeNa ghAtitaH
shlokas.38:
nyastashastramadharmeNa ghAtayitvA guruM bhavAn |
rakShatvidAnIM sAmAtyo yadi shaknoShi pArShatam
shlokas.39:
grastamAchAryaputreNa kruddhena hatabandhunA |
sarve vayaM paritrAtuM na shakShyAmo.adya pArShatam
shlokas.40:
sauhArdaM sarvabhUteShu yaH karotyatimAtrashaH |
so.adya keshagrahaM shrutvA piturdhakShyati no raNe
shlokas.41:
vikroshamAne hi mayi bhRRishamAchAryagRRiddhini |
avakIrya svadharmaM hi shiShyeNa nihato guruH
shlokas.42:
yadA gataM vayo bhUyaH shiShTamalpataraM cha naH |
tasyedAnIM vikAro.ayamadharmo yatkRRito mahAn
shlokas.43:
piteva nityaM sauhArdAtpiteva sa hi dharmataH |
so.alpakAlasya rAjyasya kAraNAnnihato guruH
shlokas.44:
dhRRitarAShTreNa bhIShmAya droNAya cha vishAM pate |
visRRiShTA pRRithivI sarvA saha putraishcha tatparaiH
shlokas.45:
sa prApya tAdRRishIM vRRittiM satkRRitaH satataM paraiH |
avRRiNIta sadA putrAnmAmevAbhyadhikaM guruH
shlokas.46:
akShIyamANo nyastAstrastvadvAkyenAhave hataH |
na tvenaM yudhyamAnaM vai hanyAdapi shatakratuH
shlokas.47:
tasyAchAryasya vRRiddhasya droho nityopakAriNaH |
kRRito hyanAryairasmAbhI rAjyArthe laghubuddhibhiH
shlokas.48:
putrAnbhrAtR^InpitR^IndArA~njIvitaM chaiva vAsaviH |
tyajetsarvaM mama premNA jAnAtyetaddhi me guruH
shlokas.49:
sa mayA rAjyakAmena hanyamAno.apyupekShitaH |
tasmAdavAkShirA rAjanprApto.asmi narakaM vibho
shlokas.50:
brAhmaNaM vRRiddhamAchAryaM nyastashastraM yathA munim |
ghAtayitvAdya rAjyArthe mRRitaM shreyo na jIvitam

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
arjunasya vachaH shrutvA nochustatra mahArathAH |
apriyaM vA priyaM vApi mahArAja dhana~njayam
shlokas.2:
tataH kruddho mahAbAhurbhImaseno.abhyabhAShata |
utsmayanniva kaunteyamarjunaM bharatarShabha
shlokas.3:
muniryathAraNyagato bhAShase dharmasaMhitam |
nyastadaNDo yathA pArtha brAhmaNaH sa.nshitavrataH
shlokas.4:
kShatAttrAtA kShatAjjIvankShAntastriShvapi sAdhuShu |
kShatriyaH kShitimApnoti kShipraM dharmaM yashaH shriyam
shlokas.5:
sa bhavAnkShatriyaguNairyuktaH sarvaiH kulodvahaH |
avipashchidyathA vAkyaM vyAharannAdya shobhase
shlokas.6:
parAkramaste kaunteya shakrasyeva shachIpateH |
na chAtivartase dharmaM velAmiva mahodadhiH
shlokas.7:
na pUjayettvA ko.anvadya yattrayodashavArShikam |
amarShaM pRRiShThataH kRRitvA dharmamevAbhikA~NkShase
shlokas.8:
diShTyA tAta manaste.adya svadharmamanuvartate |
AnRRisha.nsye cha te diShTyA buddhiH satatamachyuta
shlokas.9:
yattu dharmapravRRittasya hRRitaM rAjyamadharmataH |
draupadI cha parAmRRiShTA sabhAmAnIya shatrubhiH
shlokas.10:
vanaM pravrAjitAshchAsma valkalAjinavAsasaH |
anarhamANAstaM bhAvaM trayodasha samAH paraiH
shlokas.11:
etAnyamarShasthAnAni marShitAni tvayAnagha |
kShatradharmaprasaktena sarvametadanuShThitam
shlokas.12:
tamadharmamapAkraShTumArabdhaH sahitastvayA |
sAnubandhAnhaniShyAmi kShudrAnrAjyaharAnaham
shlokas.13:
tvayA tu kathitaM pUrvaM yuddhAyAbhyAgatA vayam |
ghaTAmashcha yathAshakti tvaM tu no.adya jugupsase
shlokas.14:
svadharmaM nechChase j~nAtuM mithyA vachanameva te |
bhayArditAnAmasmAkaM vAchA marmANi kRRintasi
shlokas.15:
vapanvraNe kShAramiva kShatAnAM shatrukarshana |
vidIryate me hRRidayaM tvayA vAkShalyapIDitam
shlokas.16:
adharmametadvipulaM dhArmikaH sanna budhyase |
yattvamAtmAnamasmA.nshcha prasha.nsyAnna prasha.nsasi
yaH kalAM ShoDashIM tvatto nArhate taM prasha.nsasi
shlokas.17:
svayamevAtmano vaktuM na yuktaM guNasa.nstavam |
dArayeyaM mahIM krodhAdvikireyaM cha parvatAn
shlokas.18:
Avidhya cha gadAM gurvIM bhImAM kA~nchanamAlinIm |
giriprakAshAnkShitijAnbha~njeyamanilo yathA
shlokas.19:
sa tvameva.nvidhaM jAnanbhrAtaraM mAM nararShabha |
droNaputrAdbhayaM kartuM nArhasyamitavikrama
shlokas.20:
atha vA tiShTha bIbhatso saha sarvairnararShabhaiH |
ahamenaM gadApANirjeShyAmyeko mahAhave
shlokas.21:
tataH pA~nchAlarAjasya putraH pArthamathAbravIt |
sa~Nkruddhamiva nardantaM hiraNyakashipuM hariH
shlokas.22:
bIbhatso viprakarmANi viditAni manIShiNAm |
yAjanAdhyApane dAnaM tathA yaj~napratigrahau
shlokas.23:
ShaShThamadhyayanaM nAma teShAM kasminpratiShThitaH |
hato droNo mayA yattatkiM mAM pArtha vigarhase
shlokas.24:
apakrAntaH svadharmAchcha kShatradharmamupAshritaH |
amAnuSheNa hantyasmAnastreNa kShudrakarmakRRit
shlokas.25:
tathA mAyAM prayu~njAnamasahyaM brAhmaNabruvam |
mAyayaiva nihanyAdyo na yuktaM pArtha tatra kim
shlokas.26:
tasmi.nstathA mayA shaste yadi drauNAyanI ruShA |
kurute bhairavaM nAdaM tatra kiM mama hIyate
shlokas.27:
na chAdbhutamidaM manye yaddrauNiH shuddhagarjayA |
ghAtayiShyati kauravyAnparitrAtumashaknuvan
shlokas.28:
yachcha mAM dhArmiko bhUtvA bravIShi gurughAtinam |
tadarthamahamutpannaH pA~nchAlyasya suto.analAt
shlokas.29:
yasya kAryamakAryaM vA yudhyataH syAtsamaM raNe |
taM kathaM brAhmaNaM brUyAH kShatriyaM vA dhana~njaya
shlokas.30:
yo hyanastravido hanyAdbrahmAstraiH krodhamUrChitaH |
sarvopAyairna sa kathaM vadhyaH puruShasattama
shlokas.31:
vidharmiNaM dharmavidbhiH proktaM teShAM viShopamam |
jAnandharmArthatattvaj~naH kimarjuna vigarhase
shlokas.32:
nRRisha.nsaH sa mayAkramya ratha eva nipAtitaH |
tanmAbhinandyaM bIbhatso kimarthaM nAbhinandase
shlokas.33:
kRRite raNe kathaM pArtha jvalanArkaviShopamam |
bhImaM droNashirashChede prashasyaM na prasha.nsasi
shlokas.34:
yo.asau mamaiva nAnyasya bAndhavAnyudhi jaghnivAn |
ChittvApi tasya mUrdhAnaM naivAsmi vigatajvaraH
shlokas.35:
tachcha me kRRintate marma yanna tasya shiro mayA |
niShAdaviShaye kShiptaM jayadrathashiro yathA
shlokas.36:
avadhashchApi shatrUNAmadharmaH shiShyate.arjuna |
kShatriyasya hyayaM dharmo hanyAddhanyeta vA punaH
shlokas.37:
sa shatrurnihataH sa~Nkhye mayA dharmeNa pANDava |
yathA tvayA hataH shUro bhagadattaH pituH sakhA
shlokas.38:
pitAmahaM raNe hatvA manyase dharmamAtmanaH |
mayA shatrau hate kasmAtpApe dharmaM na manyase
shlokas.39:
nAnRRitaH pANDavo jyeShTho nAhaM vAdhArmiko.arjuna |
shiShyadhru~NnihataH pApo yudhyasva vijayastava

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sA~NgA vedA yathAnyAyaM yenAdhItA mahAtmanA |
yasminsAkShAddhanurvedo hrIniShedhe pratiShThitaH
shlokas.2:
tasminnAkrushyati droNe maharShitanaye tadA |
nIchAtmanA nRRisha.nsena kShudreNa gurughAtinA
shlokas.3:
yasya prasAdAtkarmANi kurvanti puruSharShabhAH |
amAnuShANi sa~NgrAme devairasukarANi cha
shlokas.4:
tasminnAkrushyati droNe samakShaM pApakarmiNaH |
nAmarShaM tatra kurvanti dhikkShatraM dhigamarShitam
shlokas.5:
pArthAH sarve cha rAjAnaH pRRithivyAM ye dhanurdharAH |
shrutvA kimAhuH pA~nchAlyaM tanmamAchakShva sa~njaya
shlokas.6:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
shrutvA drupadaputrasya tA vAchaH krUrakarmaNaH |
tUShNIM babhUvU rAjAnaH sarva eva vishAM pate
shlokas.7:
arjunastu kaTAkSheNa jihmaM prekShya cha pArShatam |
sabAShpamabhiniHshvasya dhigdhigdhigiti chAbravIt
shlokas.8:
yudhiShThirashcha bhImashcha yamau kRRiShNastathApare |
AsansuvrIDitA rAjansAtyakiridamabravIt
shlokas.9:
nehAsti puruShaH kashchidya imaM pApapUruSham |
bhAShamANamakalyANaM shIghraM hanyAnnarAdhamam
shlokas.10:
kathaM cha shatadhA jihvA na te mUrdhA cha dIryate |
gurumAkroshataH kShudra na chAdharmeNa pAtyase
shlokas.11:
yApyastvamasi pArthaishcha sarvaishchAndhakavRRiShNibhiH |
yatkarma kaluShaM kRRitvA shlAghase janasa.nsadi
shlokas.12:
akAryaM tAdRRishaM kRRitvA punareva guruM kShipan |
vadhyastvaM na tvayArtho.asti muhUrtamapi jIvatA
shlokas.13:
kastvetadvyavasedAryastvadanyaH puruShAdhamaH |
nigRRihya kesheShu vadhaM gurordharmAtmanaH sataH
shlokas.14:
saptAvare tathA pUrve bAndhavAste nipAtitAH |
yashasA cha parityaktAstvAM prApya kulapA.nsanam
shlokas.15:
uktavA.nshchApi yatpArthaM bhIShmaM prati nararShabham |
tathAnto vihitastena svayameva mahAtmanA
shlokas.16:
tasyApi tava sodaryo nihantA pApakRRittamaH |
nAnyaH pA~nchAlaputrebhyo vidyate bhuvi pApakRRit
shlokas.17:
sa chApi sRRiShTaH pitrA te bhIShmasyAntakaraH kila |
shikhaNDI rakShitastena sa cha mRRityurmahAtmanaH
shlokas.18:
pA~nchAlAshchalitA dharmAtkShudrA mitragurudruhaH |
tvAM prApya sahasodaryaM dhikkRRitaM sarvasAdhubhiH
shlokas.19:
punashchedIdRRishIM vAchaM matsamIpe vadiShyasi |
shiraste pAtayiShyAmi gadayA vajrakalpayA
shlokas.20:
sAtvatenaivamAkShiptaH pArShataH paruShAkSharam |
sa.nrabdhaH sAtyakiM prAha sa~NkruddhaH prahasanniva
shlokas.21:
shrUyate shrUyate cheti kShamyate cheti mAdhava |
na chAnArya shubhaM sAdhuM puruShaM kSheptumarhasi
shlokas.22:
kShamA prashasyate loke na tu pApo.arhati kShamAm |
kShamAvantaM hi pApAtmA jito.ayamiti manyate
shlokas.23:
sa tvaM kShudrasamAchAro nIchAtmA pApanishchayaH |
A keshAgrAnnakhAgrAchcha vaktavyo vaktumichChasi
shlokas.24:
yaH sa bhUrishravAshChinne bhuje prAyagatastvayA |
vAryamANena nihatastataH pApataraM nu kim
shlokas.25:
vyUhamAno mayA droNo divyenAstreNa sa.nyuge |
visRRiShTashastro nihataH kiM tatra krUra duShkRRitam
shlokas.26:
ayudhyamAnaM yastvAjau tathA prAyagataM munim |
ChinnabAhuM parairhanyAtsAtyake sa kathaM bhavet
shlokas.27:
nihatya tvAM yadA bhUmau sa vikrAmati vIryavAn |
kiM tadA na niha.nsyenaM bhUtvA puruShasattamaH
shlokas.28:
tvayA punaranAryeNa pUrvaM pArthena nirjitaH |
yadA tadA hataH shUraH saumadattiH pratApavAn
shlokas.29:
yatra yatra tu pANDUnAM droNo drAvayate chamUm |
kira~nsharasahasrANi tatra tatra prayAmyaham
shlokas.30:
sa tvameva.nvidhaM kRRitvA karma chANDAlavatsvayam |
vaktumichChasi vaktavyaH kasmAnmAM paruShANyatha
shlokas.31:
kartA tvaM karmaNograsya nAhaM vRRiShNikulAdhama |
pApAnAM cha tvamAvAsaH karmaNAM mA punarvada
shlokas.32:
joShamAssva na mAM bhUyo vaktumarhasyataH param |
adharottarametaddhi yanmA tvaM vaktumichChasi
shlokas.33:
atha vakShyasi mAM maurkhyAdbhUyaH paruShamIdRRisham |
gamayiShyAmi bANaistvAM yudhi vaivasvatakShayam
shlokas.34:
na chaiva mUrkha dharmeNa kevalenaiva shakyate |
teShAmapi hyadharmeNa cheShTitaM shRRiNu yAdRRisham
shlokas.35:
va~nchitaH pANDavaH pUrvamadharmeNa yudhiShThiraH |
draupadI cha parikliShTA tathAdharmeNa sAtyake
shlokas.36:
pravrAjitA vanaM sarve pANDavAH saha kRRiShNayA |
sarvasvamapakRRiShTaM cha tathAdharmeNa bAlisha
shlokas.37:
adharmeNApakRRiShTashcha madrarAjaH parairitaH |
ito.apyadharmeNa hato bhIShmaH kurupitAmahaH
bhUrishravA hyadharmeNa tvayA dharmavidA hataH
shlokas.38:
evaM parairAcharitaM pANDaveyaishcha sa.nyuge |
rakShamANairjayaM vIrairdharmaj~nairapi sAtvata
shlokas.39:
durj~neyaH paramo dharmastathAdharmaH sudurvidaH |
yudhyasva kauravaiH sArdhaM mA gAH pitRRiniveshanam
shlokas.40:
evamAdIni vAkyAni krUrANi paruShANi cha |
shrAvitaH sAtyakiH shrImAnAkampita ivAbhavat
shlokas.41:
tachChrutvA krodhatAmrAkShaH sAtyakistvAdade gadAm |
viniHshvasya yathA sarpaH praNidhAya rathe dhanuH
shlokas.42:
tato.abhipatya pA~nchAlyaM sa.nrambheNedamabravIt |
na tvAM vakShyAmi paruShaM haniShye tvAM vadhakShamam
shlokas.43:
tamApatantaM sahasA mahAbalamamarShaNam |
pA~nchAlyAyAbhisa~NkruddhamantakAyAntakopamam
shlokas.44:
chodito vAsudevena bhImaseno mahAbalaH |
avaplutya rathAttUrNaM bAhubhyAM samavArayat
shlokas.45:
dravamANaM tathA kruddhaM sAtyakiM pANDavo balI |
praskandamAnamAdAya jagAma balinaM balAt
shlokas.46:
sthitvA viShTabhya charaNau bhImena shinipu~NgavaH |
nigRRihItaH pade ShaShThe balena balinAM varaH
shlokas.47:
avaruhya rathAttaM tu hriyamANaM balIyasA |
uvAcha shlakShNayA vAchA sahadevo vishAM pate
shlokas.48:
asmAkaM puruShavyAghra mitramanyanna vidyate |
paramandhakavRRiShNibhyaH pA~nchAlebhyashcha mAdhava
shlokas.49:
tathaivAndhakavRRiShNInAM tava chaiva visheShataH |
kRRiShNasya cha tathAsmatto mitramanyanna vidyate
shlokas.50:
pA~nchAlAnAM cha vArShNeya samudrAntAM vichinvatAm |
nAnyadasti paraM mitraM yathA pANDavavRRiShNayaH
shlokas.51:
sa bhavAnIdRRishaM mitraM manyate cha yathA bhavAn |
bhavantashcha yathAsmAkaM bhavatAM cha tathA vayam
shlokas.52:
sa evaM sarvadharmaj~no mitradharmamanusmaran |
niyachCha manyuM pA~nchAlyAtprashAmya shinipu~Ngava
shlokas.53:
pArShatasya kShama tvaM vai kShamatAM tava pArShataH |
vayaM kShamayitArashcha kimanyatra shamAdbhavet
shlokas.54:
prashAmyamAne shaineye sahadevena mAriSha |
pA~nchAlarAjasya sutaH prahasannidamabravIt
shlokas.55:
mu~ncha mu~ncha shineH pautraM bhIma yuddhamadAnvitam |
AsAdayatu mAmeSha dharAdharamivAnilaH
shlokas.56:
yAvadasya shitairbANaiH sa.nrambhaM vinayAmyaham |
yuddhashraddhAM cha kaunteya jIvitasya cha sa.nyuge
shlokas.57:
kiM nu shakyaM mayA kartuM kAryaM yadidamudyatam |
sumahatpANDuputrANAmAyAntyete hi kauravAH
shlokas.58:
atha vA phalgunaH sarvAnvArayiShyati sa.nyuge |
ahamapyasya mUrdhAnaM pAtayiShyAmi sAyakaiH
shlokas.59:
manyate ChinnabAhuM mAM bhUrishravasamAhave |
utsRRijainamahaM vainameSha mAM vA haniShyati
shlokas.60:
shRRiNvanpA~nchAlavAkyAni sAtyakiH sarpavachChvasan |
bhImabAhvantare sakto visphuratyanishaM balI
shlokas.61:
tvarayA vAsudevashcha dharmarAjashcha mAriSha |
yatnena mahatA vIrau vArayAmAsatustataH
shlokas.62:
nivArya parameShvAsau krodhasa.nraktalochanau |
yuyutsavaH parAnsa~Nkhye pratIyuH kShatriyarShabhAH

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tataH sa kadanaM chakre ripUNAM droNanandanaH |
yugAnte sarvabhUtAnAM kAlasRRiShTa ivAntakaH
shlokas.2:
dhvajadrumaM shastrashRRi~NgaM hatanAgamahAshilam |
ashvakimpuruShAkIrNaM sharAsanalatAvRRitam
shlokas.3:
shUlakravyAdasa~NghuShTaM bhUtayakShagaNAkulam |
nihatya shAtravAnbhallaiH so.achinoddehaparvatam
shlokas.4:
tato vegena mahatA vinadya sa nararShabhaH |
pratij~nAM shrAvayAmAsa punareva tavAtmajam
shlokas.5:
yasmAdyudhyantamAchAryaM dharmaka~nchukamAsthitaH |
mu~ncha shastramiti prAha kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.6:
tasmAtsampashyatastasya drAvayiShyAmi vAhinIm |
vidrAvya satyaM hantAsmi pApaM pA~nchAlyameva tu
shlokas.7:
sarvAnetAnhaniShyAmi yadi yotsyanti mAM raNe |
satyaM te pratijAnAmi parAvartaya vAhinIm
shlokas.8:
tachChrutvA tava putrastu vAhinIM paryavartayat |
siMhanAdena mahatA vyapohya sumahadbhayam
shlokas.9:
tataH samAgamo rAjankurupANDavasenayoH |
punarevAbhavattIvraH pUrNasAgarayoriva
shlokas.10:
sa.nrabdhA hi sthirIbhUtA droNaputreNa kauravAH |
udagrAH pANDupA~nchAlA droNasya nidhanena cha
shlokas.11:
teShAM paramahRRiShTAnAM jayamAtmani pashyatAm |
sa.nrabdhAnAM mahAvegaH prAdurAsIdraNAjire
shlokas.12:
yathA shilochchaye shailaH sAgare sAgaro yathA |
pratihanyeta rAjendra tathAsankurupANDavAH
shlokas.13:
tataH sha~NkhasahasrANi bherINAmayutAni cha |
avAdayanta saMhRRiShTAH kurupANDavasainikAH
shlokas.14:
tato nirmathyamAnasya sAgarasyeva nisvanaH |
abhavattasya sainyasya sumahAnadbhutopamaH
shlokas.15:
prAdushchakre tato drauNirastraM nArAyaNaM tadA |
abhisandhAya pANDUnAM pA~nchAlAnAM cha vAhinIm
shlokas.16:
prAdurAsa.nstato bANA dIptAgrAH khe sahasrashaH |
pANDavAnbhakShayiShyanto dIptAsyA iva pannagAH
shlokas.17:
te dishaH khaM cha sainyaM cha samAvRRiNvanmahAhave |
muhUrtAdbhAskarasyeva rAja.NllokaM gabhastayaH
shlokas.18:
tathApare dyotamAnA jyotIMShIvAmbare.amale |
prAdurAsanmahIpAla kArShNAyasamayA guDAH
shlokas.19:
chaturdishaM vichitrAshcha shataghnyo.atha hutAshadAH |
chakrANi cha kShurAntAni maNDalAnIva bhAsvataH
shlokas.20:
shastrAkRRitibhirAkIrNamatIva bharatarShabha |
dRRiShTvAntarikShamAvignAH pANDupA~nchAlasRRi~njayAH
