shlokas.21:
yathA yathA hyayudhyanta pANDavAnAM mahArathAH |
tathA tathA tadastraM vai vyavardhata janAdhipa
shlokas.22:
vadhyamAnAstathAstreNa tena nArAyaNena vai |
dahyamAnAnaleneva sarvato.abhyarditA raNe
shlokas.23:
yathA hi shishirApAye dahetkakShaM hutAshanaH |
tathA tadastraM pANDUnAM dadAha dhvajinIM prabho
shlokas.24:
ApUryamANenAstreNa sainye kShIyati chAbhibho |
jagAma paramaM trAsaM dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.25:
dravamANaM tu tatsainyaM dRRiShTvA vigatachetanam |
madhyasthatAM cha pArthasya dharmaputro.abravIdidam
shlokas.26:
dhRRiShTadyumna palAyasva saha pA~nchAlasenayA |
sAtyake tvaM cha gachChasva vRRiShNyandhakavRRito gRRihAn
shlokas.27:
vAsudevo.api dharmAtmA kariShyatyAtmanaH kShamam |
upadeShTuM samartho.ayaM lokasya kimutAtmanaH
shlokas.28:
sa~NgrAmastu na kartavyaH sarvasainyAnbravImi vaH |
ahaM hi saha sodaryaiH pravekShye havyavAhanam
shlokas.29:
bhIShmadroNArNavaM tIrtvA sa~NgrAmaM bhIrudustaram |
avasatsyAmyasalile sagaNo drauNigoShpade
shlokas.30:
kAmaH sampadyatAmasya bIbhatsorAshu mAM prati |
kalyANavRRitta AchAryo mayA yudhi nipAtitaH
shlokas.31:
yena bAlaH sa saubhadro yuddhAnAmavishAradaH |
samarthairbahubhiH krUrairghAtito nAbhipAlitaH
shlokas.32:
yenAvibruvatA prashnaM tathA kRRiShNA sabhAM gatA |
upekShitA saputreNa dAsabhAvaM niyachChatI
shlokas.33:
jighA.nsurdhArtarAShTrashcha shrAnteShvashveShu phalgunam |
kavachena tathA yukto rakShArthaM saindhavasya cha
shlokas.34:
yena brahmAstraviduShA pA~nchAlAH satyajinmukhAH |
kurvANA majjaye yatnaM samUlA vinipAtitAH
shlokas.35:
yena pravrAjyamAnAshcha rAjyAdvayamadharmataH |
nivAryamANenAsmAbhiranugantuM tadeShitAH
shlokas.36:
yo.asAvatyantamasmAsu kurvANaH sauhRRidaM param |
hatastadarthe maraNaM gamiShyAmi sabAndhavaH
shlokas.37:
evaM bruvati kaunteye dAshArhastvaritastataH |
nivArya sainyaM bAhubhyAmidaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.38:
shIghraM nyasyata shastrANi vAhebhyashchAvarohata |
eSha yogo.atra vihitaH pratighAto mahAtmanA
shlokas.39:
dvipAshvasyandanebhyashcha kShitiM sarve.avarohata |
evametanna vo hanyAdastraM bhUmau nirAyudhAn
shlokas.40:
yathA yathA hi yudhyante yodhA hyastrabalaM prati |
tathA tathA bhavantyete kauravA balavattarAH
shlokas.41:
nikShepsyanti cha shastrANi vAhanebhyo.avaruhya ye |
tAnnaitadastraM sa~NgrAme nihaniShyati mAnavAn
shlokas.42:
ye tvetatpratiyotsyanti manasApIha kechana |
nihaniShyati tAnsarvAnrasAtalagatAnapi
shlokas.43:
te vachastasya tachChrutvA vAsudevasya bhArata |
IShuH sarve.astramutsraShTuM manobhiH karaNena cha
shlokas.44:
tata utsraShTukAmA.nstAnastrANyAlakShya pANDavaH |
bhImaseno.abravIdrAjannidaM saMharShayanvachaH
shlokas.45:
na katha~nchana shastrANi moktavyAnIha kenachit |
ahamAvArayiShyAmi droNaputrAstramAshugaiH
shlokas.46:
atha vApyanayA gurvyA hemavigrahayA raNe |
kAlavadvichariShyAmi drauNerastraM vishAtayan
shlokas.47:
na hi me vikrame tulyaH kashchidasti pumAniha |
yathaiva savitustulyaM jyotiranyanna vidyate
shlokas.48:
pashyadhvaM me dRRiDhau bAhU nAgarAjakaropamA |
samarthau parvatasyApi shaishirasya nipAtane
shlokas.49:
nAgAyutasamaprANo hyahameko nareShviha |
shakro yathA pratidva.ndvo divi deveShu vishrutaH
shlokas.50:
adya pashyata me vIryaM bAhvoH pInA.nsayoryudhi |
jvalamAnasya dIptasya drauNerastrasya vAraNe
shlokas.51:
yadi nArAyaNAstrasya pratiyoddhA na vidyate |
adyainaM pratiyotsyAmi pashyatsu kurupANDuShu
shlokas.52:
evamuktvA tato bhImo droNaputramari.ndamaH |
abhyayAnmeghaghoSheNa rathenAdityavarchasA
shlokas.53:
sa enamiShujAlena laghutvAchChIghravikramaH |
nimeShamAtreNAsAdya kuntIputro.abhyavAkirat
shlokas.54:
tato drauNiH prahasyainamudAsamabhibhAShya cha |
avAkiratpradIptAgraiH sharaistairabhimantritaiH
shlokas.55:
pannagairiva dIptAsyairvamadbhiranalaM raNe |
avakIrNo.abhavatpArthaH sphuli~Ngairiva kA~nchanaiH
shlokas.56:
tasya rUpamabhUdrAjanbhImasenasya sa.nyuge |
khadyotairAvRRitasyeva parvatasya dinakShaye
shlokas.57:
tadastraM droNaputrasya tasminpratisamasyati |
avardhata mahArAja yathAgniraniloddhataH
shlokas.58:
vivardhamAnamAlakShya tadastraM bhImavikramam |
pANDusainyamRRite bhImaM sumahadbhayamAvishat
shlokas.59:
tataH shastrANi te sarve samutsRRijya mahItale |
avArohanrathebhyashcha hastyashvebhyashcha sarvashaH
shlokas.60:
teShu nikShiptashastreShu vAhanebhyashchyuteShu cha |
tadastravIryaM vipulaM bhImamUrdhanyathApatat
shlokas.61:
hAhAkRRitAni bhUtAni pANDavAshcha visheShataH |
bhImasenamapashyanta tejasA sa.nvRRitaM tadA

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
bhImasenaM samAkIrNaM dRRiShTvAstreNa dhana~njayaH |
tejasaH pratighAtArthaM vAruNena samAvRRiNot
shlokas.2:
nAlakShayata taM kashchidvAruNAstreNa sa.nvRRitam |
arjunasya laghutvAchcha sa.nvRRitatvAchcha tejasaH
shlokas.3:
sAshvasUtaratho bhImo droNaputrAstrasa.nvRRitaH |
agnAvagniriva nyasto jvAlAmAlI sudurdRRishaH
shlokas.4:
yathA rAtrikShaye rAja~njyotIMShyastagiriM prati |
samApetustathA bANA bhImasenarathaM prati
shlokas.5:
sa hi bhImo rathashchAsya hayAH sUtashcha mAriSha |
sa.nvRRitA droNaputreNa pAvakAntargatAbhavan
shlokas.6:
yathA dagdhvA jagatkRRitsnaM samaye sacharAcharam |
gachChedagnirvibhorAsyaM tathAstraM bhImamAvRRiNot
shlokas.7:
sUryamagniH praviShTaH syAdyathA chAgniM divAkaraH |
tathA praviShTaM tattejo na prAj~nAyata ki~nchana
shlokas.8:
vikIrNamastraM taddRRiShTvA tathA bhImarathaM prati |
udIryamANaM drauNiM cha niShpratidva.ndvamAhave
shlokas.9:
sarvasainyAni pANDUnAM nyastashastrANyachetasaH |
yudhiShThirapurogA.nshcha vimukhA.nstAnmahArathAn
shlokas.10:
arjuno vAsudevashcha tvaramANau mahAdyutI |
avaplutya rathAdvIrau bhImamAdravatAM tataH
shlokas.11:
tatastaddroNaputrasya tejo.astrabalasambhavam |
vigAhya tau subalinau mAyayAvishatAM tadA
shlokas.12:
nyastashastrau tatastau tu nAdahadastrajo.analaH |
vAruNAstraprayogAchcha vIryavattvAchcha kRRiShNayoH
shlokas.13:
tatashchakRRiShaturbhImaM tasya sarvAyudhAni cha |
nArAyaNAstrashAntyarthaM naranArAyaNau balAt
shlokas.14:
apakRRiShyamANaH kaunteyo nadatyeva mahArathaH |
vardhate chaiva tadghoraM drauNerastraM sudurjayam
shlokas.15:
tamabravIdvAsudevaH kimidaM pANDunandana |
vAryamANo.api kaunteya yadyuddhAnna nivartase
shlokas.16:
yadi yuddhena jeyAH syurime kauravanandanAH |
vayamapyatra yudhyema tathA cheme nararShabhAH
shlokas.17:
rathebhyastvavatIrNAstu sarva eva sma tAvakAH |
tasmAttvamapi kaunteya rathAttUrNamapAkrama
shlokas.18:
evamuktvA tataH kRRiShNo rathAdbhUmimapAtayat |
niHshvasantaM yathA nAgaM krodhasa.nraktalochanam
shlokas.19:
yadApakRRiShTaH sa rathAnnyAsitashchAyudhaM bhuvi |
tato nArAyaNAstraM tatprashAntaM shatrutApanam
shlokas.20:
tasminprashAnte vidhinA tadA tejasi duHsahe |
babhUvurvimalAH sarvA dishaH pradisha eva cha
shlokas.21:
pravavushcha shivA vAtAH prashAntA mRRigapakShiNaH |
vAhanAni cha hRRiShTAni yodhAshcha manujeshvara
shlokas.22:
vyapoDhe cha tato ghore tasmi.nstejasi bhArata |
babhau bhImo nishApAye dhImAnsUrya ivoditaH
shlokas.23:
hatasheShaM balaM tatra pANDavAnAmatiShThata |
astravyuparamAddhRRiShTaM tava putrajighA.nsayA
shlokas.24:
vyavasthite bale tasminnastre pratihate tathA |
duryodhano mahArAja droNaputramathAbravIt
shlokas.25:
ashvatthAmanpunaH shIghramastrametatprayojaya |
vyavasthitA hi pA~nchAlAH punareva jayaiShiNaH
shlokas.26:
ashvatthAmA tathoktastu tava putreNa mAriSha |
sudInamabhiniHshvasya rAjAnamidamabravIt
shlokas.27:
naitadAvartate rAjannastraM dvirnopapadyate |
AvartayannihantyetatprayoktAraM na sa.nshayaH
shlokas.28:
eSha chAstrapratIghAtaM vAsudevaH prayuktavAn |
anyathA vihitaH sa~Nkhye vadhaH shatrorjanAdhipa
shlokas.29:
parAjayo vA mRRityurvA shreyo mRRityurna nirjayaH |
nirjitAshchArayo hyete shastrotsargAnmRRitopamAH
shlokas.30:
duryodhana uvAcha||
AchAryaputra yadyetaddvirastraM na prayujyate |
anyairgurughnA vadhyantAmastrairastravidAM vara
shlokas.31:
tvayi hyastrANi divyAni yathA syustryambake tathA |
ichChato na hi te muchyetkruddhasyApi pura.ndaraH
shlokas.32:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tasminnastre pratihate droNe chopadhinA hate |
tathA duryodhanenokto drauNiH kimakarotpunaH
shlokas.33:
dRRiShTvA pArthA.nshcha sa~NgrAme yuddhAya samavasthitAn |
nArAyaNAstranirmuktA.nshcharataH pRRitanAmukhe
shlokas.34:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
jAnanpituH sa nidhanaM siMhalA~NgUlaketanaH |
sakrodho bhayamutsRRijya abhidudrAva pArShatam
shlokas.35:
abhidrutya cha vi.nshatyA kShudrakANAM nararShabhaH |
pa~nchabhishchAtivegena vivyAdha puruSharShabham
shlokas.36:
dhRRiShTadyumnastato rAja~njvalantamiva pAvakam |
droNaputraM triShaShTyA tu rAjanvivyAdha patriNAm
shlokas.37:
sArathiM chAsya vi.nshatyA svarNapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH |
hayA.nshcha chaturo.avidhyachchaturbhirnishitaiH sharaiH
shlokas.38:
viddhvA viddhvAnadaddrauNiH kampayanniva medinIm |
Adadatsarvalokasya prANAniva mahAraNe
shlokas.39:
pArShatastu balI rAjankRRitAstraH kRRitanishramaH |
drauNimevAbhidudrAva kRRitvA mRRityuM nivartanam
shlokas.40:
tato bANamayaM varShaM droNaputrasya mUrdhani |
avAsRRijadameyAtmA pA~nchAlyo rathinAM varaH
shlokas.41:
taM drauNiH samare kruddhashChAdayAmAsa patribhiH |
vivyAdha chainaM dashabhiH piturvadhamanusmaran
shlokas.42:
dvAbhyAM cha suvikRRiShTAbhyAM kShurAbhyAM dhvajakArmuke |
ChittvA pA~nchAlarAjasya drauNiranyaiH samArdayat
shlokas.43:
vyashvasUtarathaM chainaM drauNishchakre mahAhave |
tasya chAnucharAnsarvAnkruddhaH prAchChAdayachCharaiH
shlokas.44:
pradrudrAva tataH sainyaM pA~nchAlAnAM vishAM pate |
sambhrAntarUpamArtaM cha sharavarShaparikShatam
shlokas.45:
dRRiShTvA cha vimukhAnyodhAndhRRiShTadyumnaM cha pIDitam |
shaineyo.achodayattUrNaM raNaM drauNirathaM prati
shlokas.46:
aShTabhirnishitaishchaiva so.ashvatthAmAnamArdayat |
vi.nshatyA punarAhatya nAnArUpairamarShaNam
vivyAdha cha tathA sUtaM chaturbhishchaturo hayAn
shlokas.47:
so.atividdho maheShvAso nAnAli~NgairamarShaNaH |
yuyudhAnena vai drauNiH prahasanvAkyamabravIt
shlokas.48:
shaineyAbhyavapattiM te jAnAmyAchAryaghAtinaH |
na tvenaM trAsyasi mayA grastamAtmAnameva cha
shlokas.49:
evamuktvArkarashmyAbhaM suparvANaM sharottamam |
vyasRRijatsAtvate drauNirvajraM vRRitre yathA hariH
shlokas.50:
sa taM nirbhidya tenAstaH sAyakaH sasharAvaram |
vivesha vasudhAM bhittvA shvasanbilamivoragaH
shlokas.51:
sa bhinnakavachaH shUrastottrArdita iva dvipaH |
vimuchya sasharaM chApaM bhUrivraNaparisravaH
shlokas.52:
sIdanrudhirasiktashcha rathopastha upAvishat |
sUtenApahRRitastUrNaM droNaputrAdrathAntaram
shlokas.53:
athAnyena supu~Nkhena shareNa nataparvaNA |
AjaghAna bhruvormadhye dhRRiShTadyumnaM parantapaH
shlokas.54:
sa pUrvamatividdhashcha bhRRishaM pashchAchcha pIDitaH |
sasAda yudhi pA~nchAlyo vyapAshrayata cha dhvajam
shlokas.55:
taM mattamiva siMhena rAjanku~njaramarditam |
javenAbhyadrava~nshUrAH pa~ncha pANDavato rathAH
shlokas.56:
kirITI bhImasenashcha vRRiddhakShatrashcha pauravaH |
yuvarAjashcha chedInAM mAlavashcha sudarshanaH
pa~nchabhiH pa~nchabhirbANairabhyaghnansarvataH samam
shlokas.57:
AshIviShAbhairvi.nshadbhiH pa~nchabhishchApi tA~nsharaiH |
chichCheda yugapaddrauNiH pa~nchavi.nshatisAyakAn
shlokas.58:
saptabhishcha shitairbANaiH pauravaM drauNirArdayat |
mAlavaM tribhirekena pArthaM ShaDbhirvRRikodaram
shlokas.59:
tataste vivyadhuH sarve drauNiM rAjanmahArathAH |
yugapachcha pRRithakchaiva rukmapu~NkhaiH shilAshitaiH
shlokas.60:
yuvarAjastu vi.nshatyA drauNiM vivyAdha patriNAm |
pArthashcha punaraShTAbhistathA sarve tribhistribhiH
shlokas.61:
tato.arjunaM ShaDbhirathAjaghAna; drauNAyanirdashabhirvAsudevam |
bhImaM dashArdhairyuvarAjaM chaturbhi;rdvAbhyAM ChittvA kArmukaM cha dhvajaM cha
punaH pArthaM sharavarSheNa viddhvA; drauNirghoraM siMhanAdaM nanAda
shlokas.62:
tasyAsyataH sunishitAnpItadhArA;ndrauNeH sharAnpRRiShThatashchAgratashcha |
dharA viyaddyauH pradisho dishashcha; ChannA bANairabhavanghorarUpaiH
shlokas.63:
AsInasya svarathaM tUgratejAH; sudarshanasyendraketuprakAshau |
bhujau shirashchendrasamAnavIrya;stribhiH sharairyugapatsa~nchakarta
shlokas.64:
sa pauravaM rathashaktyA nihatya; ChittvA rathaM tilashashchApi bANaiH |
ChittvAsya bAhU varachandanAktau; bhallena kAyAchChira uchchakarta
shlokas.65:
yuvAnamindIvaradAmavarNaM; chedipriyaM yuvarAjaM prahasya |
bANaistvarAvA~njvalitAgnikalpai;rviddhvA prAdAnmRRityave sAshvasUtam
shlokas.66:
tAnnihatya raNe vIro droNaputro yudhAM patiH |
dadhmau pramuditaH sha~NkhaM bRRihantamaparAjitaH
shlokas.67:
tataH sarve cha pA~nchAlA bhImasenashcha pANDavaH |
dhRRiShTadyumnarathaM bhItAstyaktvA samprAdravandishaH
shlokas.68:
tAnprabhagnA.nstathA drauNiH pRRiShThato vikira~nsharaiH |
abhyavartata vegena kAlavatpANDuvAhinIm
shlokas.69:
te vadhyamAnAH samare droNaputreNa kShatriyAH |
droNaputraM bhayAdrAjandikShu sarvAsu menire

shlokas.1:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tatprabhagnaM balaM dRRiShTvA kuntIputro dhana~njayaH |
nyavArayadameyAtmA droNaputravadhepsayA
shlokas.2:
tataste sainikA rAjannaiva tatrAvatasthire |
sa.nsthApyamAnA yatnena govindenArjunena cha
shlokas.3:
eka eva tu bIbhatsuH somakAvayavaiH saha |
matsyairanyaishcha sandhAya kauravaiH saMnyavartata
shlokas.4:
tato drutamatikramya siMhalA~NgUlaketanam |
savyasAchI maheShvAsamashvatthAmAnamabravIt
shlokas.5:
yA shaktiryachcha te vIryaM yajj~nAnaM yachcha pauruSham |
dhArtarAShTreShu yA prItiH pradveSho.asmAsu yashcha te
yachcha bhUyo.asti tejastatparamaM mama darshaya
shlokas.6:
sa eva droNahantA te darpaM bhetsyati pArShataH |
kAlAnalasamaprakhyo dviShatAmantako yudhi
samAsAdaya pA~nchAlyaM mAM chApi sahakeshavam
shlokas.7:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
AchAryaputro mAnArho balavA.nshchApi sa~njaya |
prItirdhana~njaye chAsya priyashchApi sa vAsaveH
shlokas.8:
na bhUtapUrvaM bIbhatsorvAkyaM paruShamIdRRisham |
atha kasmAtsa kaunteyaH sakhAyaM rUkShamabravIt
shlokas.9:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
yuvarAje hate chaiva vRRiddhakShatre cha paurave |
iShvastravidhisampanne mAlave cha sudarshane
shlokas.10:
dhRRiShTadyumne sAtyakau cha bhIme chApi parAjite |
yudhiShThirasya tairvAkyairmarmaNyapi cha ghaTTite
shlokas.11:
antarbhede cha sa~njAte duHkhaM sa.nsmRRitya cha prabho |
abhUtapUrvo bIbhatsorduHkhAnmanyurajAyata
shlokas.12:
tasmAdanarhamashlIlamapriyaM drauNimuktavAn |
mAnyamAchAryatanayaM rUkShaM kApuruSho yathA
shlokas.13:
evamuktaH shvasankrodhAnmaheShvAsatamo nRRipa |
pArthena paruShaM vAkyaM sarvamarmaghnayA girA
drauNishchukopa pArthAya kRRiShNAya cha visheShataH
shlokas.14:
sa tu yatto rathe sthitvA vAryupaspRRishya vIryavAn |
devairapi sudurdharShamastramAgneyamAdade
shlokas.15:
dRRishyAdRRishyAnarigaNAnuddishyAchAryanandanaH |
so.abhimantrya sharaM dIptaM vidhUmamiva pAvakam
sarvataH krodhamAvishya chikShepa paravIrahA
shlokas.16:
tatastumulamAkAshe sharavarShamajAyata |
vavushcha shishirA vAtAH sUryo naiva tatApa cha
shlokas.17:
chukrushurdAnavAshchApi dikShu sarvAsu bhairavam |
rudhiraM chApi varShanto vinedustoyadAmbare
shlokas.18:
pakShiNaH pashavo gAvo munayashchApi suvratAH |
paramaM prayatAtmAno na shAntimupalebhire
shlokas.19:
bhrAntasarvamahAbhUtamAvarjitadivAkaram |
trailokyamabhisantaptaM jvarAviShTamivAturam
shlokas.20:
sharatejo.abhisantaptA nAgA bhUmishayAstathA |
niHshvasantaH samutpetustejo ghoraM mumukShavaH
shlokas.21:
jalajAni cha sattvAni dahyamAnAni bhArata |
na shAntimupajagmurhi tapyamAnairjalAshayaiH
shlokas.22:
dishaH khaM pradishashchaiva bhuvaM cha sharavRRiShTayaH |
uchchAvachA nipeturvai garuDAnilaraMhasaH
shlokas.23:
taiH sharairdroNaputrasya vajravegasamAhitaiH |
pradagdhAH shatravaH peturagnidagdhA iva drumAH
shlokas.24:
dahyamAnA mahAnAgAH petururvyAM samantataH |
nadanto bhairavAnnAdA~njaladopamanisvanAn
shlokas.25:
apare pradrutAstatra dahyamAnA mahAgajAH |
tresustathApare ghore vane dAvAgnisa.nvRRitAH
shlokas.26:
drumANAM shikharANIva dAvadagdhAni mAriSha |
ashvavRRindAnyadRRishyanta rathavRRindAni chAbhibho
apatanta rathaughAshcha tatra tatra sahasrashaH
shlokas.27:
tatsainyaM bhagavAnagnirdadAha yudhi bhArata |
yugAnte sarvabhUtAni sa.nvartaka ivAnalaH
shlokas.28:
dRRiShTvA tu pANDavIM senAM dahyamAnAM mahAhave |
prahRRiShTAstAvakA rAjansiMhanAdAnvinedire
shlokas.29:
tatastUryasahasrANi nAnAli~NgAni bhArata |
tUrNamAjaghnire hRRiShTAstAvakA jitakAshinaH
shlokas.30:
kRRitsnA hyakShauhiNI rAjansavyasAchI cha pANDavaH |
tamasA sa.nvRRite loke nAdRRishyata mahAhave
shlokas.31:
naiva nastAdRRishaM rAjandRRiShTapUrvaM na cha shrutam |
yAdRRishaM droNaputreNa sRRiShTamastramamarShiNA
shlokas.32:
arjunastu mahArAja brAhmamastramudairayat |
sarvAstrapratighAtAya vihitaM padmayoninA
shlokas.33:
tato muhUrtAdiva tattamo vyupashashAma ha |
pravavau chAnilaH shIto dishashcha vimalAbhavan
shlokas.34:
tatrAdbhutamapashyAma kRRitsnAmakShauhiNIM hatAm |
anabhij~neyarUpAM cha pradagdhAmastramAyayA
shlokas.35:
tato vIrau maheShvAsau vimuktau keshavArjunau |
sahitau sampradRRishyetAM nabhasIva tamonudau
shlokas.36:
sapatAkadhvajahayaH sAnukarShavarAyudhaH |
prababhau sa ratho muktastAvakAnAM bhaya~NkaraH
shlokas.37:
tataH kilakilAshabdaH sha~NkhabherIravaiH saha |
pANDavAnAM prahRRiShTAnAM kShaNena samajAyata
shlokas.38:
hatAviti tayorAsItsenayorubhayormatiH |
tarasAbhyAgatau dRRiShTvA vimuktau keshavArjunau
shlokas.39:
tAvakShatau pramuditau dadhmaturvArijottamau |
dRRiShTvA pramuditAnpArthA.nstvadIyA vyathitAbhavan
shlokas.40:
vimuktau cha mahAtmAnau dRRiShTvA drauNiH suduHkhitaH |
muhUrtaM chintayAmAsa kiM tvetaditi mAriSha
shlokas.41:
chintayitvA tu rAjendra dhyAnashokaparAyaNaH |
niHshvasandIrghamuShNaM cha vimanAshchAbhavattadA
shlokas.42:
tato drauNirdhanurnyasya rathAtpraskandya vegitaH |
dhigdhiksarvamidaM mithyetyuktvA samprAdravadraNAt
shlokas.43:
tataH snigdhAmbudAbhAsaM vedavyAsamakalmaSham |
AvAsaM cha sarasvatyAH sa vai vyAsaM dadarsha ha
shlokas.44:
taM drauNiragrato dRRiShTvA sthitaM kurukulodvaha |
sannakaNTho.abravIdvAkyamabhivAdya sudInavat
shlokas.45:
bho bho mAyA yadRRichChA vA na vidmaH kimidaM bhavet |
astraM tvidaM kathaM mithyA mama kashcha vyatikramaH
shlokas.46:
adharottarametadvA lokAnAM vA parAbhavaH |
yadimau jIvataH kRRiShNau kAlo hi duratikramaH
shlokas.47:
nAsurAmaragandharvA na pishAchA na rAkShasAH |
na sarpayakShapatagA na manuShyAH katha~nchana
shlokas.48:
utsahante.anyathA kartumetadastraM mayeritam |
tadidaM kevalaM hatvA yuktAmakShauhiNIM jvalat
shlokas.49:
kenemau martyadharmANau nAvadhItkeshavArjunau |
etatprabrUhi bhagavanmayA pRRiShTo yathAtatham
shlokas.50:
vyAsa uvAcha||
mahAntametamarthaM mAM yaM tvaM pRRichChasi vismayAt |
tatpravakShyAmi te sarvaM samAdhAya manaH shRRiNu
shlokas.51:
yo.asau nArAyaNo nAma pUrveShAmapi pUrvajaH |
ajAyata cha kAryArthaM putro dharmasya vishvakRRit
shlokas.52:
sa tapastIvramAtasthe mainAkaM girimAsthitaH |
UrdhvabAhurmahAtejA jvalanAdityasaMnibhaH
shlokas.53:
ShaShTiM varShasahasrANi tAvantyeva shatAni cha |
ashoShayattadAtmAnaM vAyubhakSho.ambujekShaNaH
shlokas.54:
athAparaM tapastaptvA dvistato.anyatpunarmahat |
dyAvApRRithivyorvivaraM tejasA samapUrayat
shlokas.55:
sa tena tapasA tAta brahmabhUto yadAbhavat |
tato vishveshvaraM yoniM vishvasya jagataH patim
shlokas.56:
dadarsha bhRRishadurdarshaM sarvadevairapIshvaram |
aNIyasAmaNIyA.nsaM bRRihadbhyashcha bRRihattaram
shlokas.57:
rudramIshAnamRRiShabhaM chekitAnamajaM param |
gachChatastiShThato vApi sarvabhUtahRRidi sthitam
shlokas.58:
durvAraNaM durdRRishaM tigmamanyuM; mahAtmAnaM sarvaharaM prachetasam |
divyaM chApamiShudhI chAdadAnaM; hiraNyavarmANamanantavIryam
shlokas.59:
pinAkinaM vajriNaM dIptashUlaM; parashvadhiM gadinaM svAyatAsim |
subhruM jaTAmaNDalachandramauliM; vyAghrAjinaM parighaM daNDapANim
shlokas.60:
shubhA~NgadaM nAgayaj~nopavItiM; vishvairgaNaiH shobhitaM bhUtasa~NghaiH |
ekIbhUtaM tapasAM saMnidhAnaM; vayotigaiH suShTutamiShTavAgbhiH
shlokas.61:
jalaM divaM khaM kShitiM chandrasUryau; tathA vAyvagnI pratimAnaM jagachcha |
nAlaM draShTuM yamajaM bhinnavRRittA; brahmadviShaghnamamRRitasya yonim
shlokas.62:
yaM pashyanti brAhmaNAH sAdhuvRRittAH; kShINe pApe manasA ye vishokAH |
sa tanniShThastapasA dharmamIDyaM; tadbhaktyA vai vishvarUpaM dadarsha
dRRiShTvA chainaM vA~NmanobuddhidehaiH; saMhRRiShTAtmA mumude devadevam
shlokas.63:
akShamAlAparikShiptaM jyotiShAM paramaM nidhim |
tato nArAyaNo dRRiShTvA vavande vishvasambhavam
shlokas.64:
varadaM pRRithuchArva~NgyA pArvatyA sahitaM prabhum |
ajamIshAnamavyagraM kAraNAtmAnamachyutam
shlokas.65:
abhivAdyAtha rudrAya sadyo.andhakanipAtine |
padmAkShastaM virUpAkShamabhituShTAva bhaktimAn
shlokas.66:
tvatsambhUtA bhUtakRRito vareNya; goptAro.adya bhuvanaM pUrvadevAH |
AvishyemAM dharaNIM ye.abhyarakSha;npurA purANAM tava deva sRRiShTim
shlokas.67:
surAsurAnnAgarakShaHpishAchA;nnarAnsuparNAnatha gandharvayakShAn |
pRRithagvidhAnbhUtasa~NghA.nshcha vishvAM;stvatsambhUtAnvidma sarvA.nstathaiva
aindraM yAmyaM vAruNaM vaittapAlyaM; maitraM tvAShTraM karma saumyaM cha tubhyam
shlokas.68:
rUpaM jyotiH shabda AkAshavAyuH; sparshaH svAdyaM salilaM gandha urvI |
kAmo brahmA brahma cha brAhmaNAshcha; tvatsambhUtaM sthAsnu chariShNu chedam
shlokas.69:
adbhyaH stokA yAnti yathA pRRithaktvaM; tAbhishchaikyaM sa~NkShaye yAnti bhUyaH |
evaM vidvAnprabhavaM chApyayaM cha; hitvA bhUtAnAM tatra sAyujyameti
shlokas.70:
divyAvRRitau mAnasau dvau suparNA;vavAkShAkhaH pippalaH sapta gopAH |
dashApyanye ye puraM dhArayanti; tvayA sRRiShTAste hi tebhyaH parastvam
bhUtaM bhavyaM bhavitA chApyadhRRiShyaM; tvatsambhUtA bhuvanAnIha vishvA
shlokas.71:
bhaktaM cha mAM bhajamAnaM bhajasva; mA rIriSho mAmahitAhitena |
AtmAnaM tvAmAtmano.ananyabhAvo; vidvAnevaM gachChati brahma shukram
shlokas.72:
astauShaM tvAM tava saMmAnamichCha;nvichinvanvai savRRiShaM devavarya |
sudurlabhAndehi varAnmameShTA;nabhiShTutaH pratikArShIshcha mA mAm
shlokas.73:
tasmai varAnachintyAtmA nIlakaNThaH pinAkadhRRik |
arhate devamukhyAya prAyachChadRRiShisa.nstutaH
shlokas.74:
nIlakaNTha uvAcha||
matprasAdAnmanuShyeShu devagandharvayoniShu |
aprameyabalAtmA tvaM nArAyaNa bhaviShyasi
shlokas.75:
na cha tvA prasahiShyanti devAsuramahoragAH |
na pishAchA na gandharvA na narA na cha rAkShasAH
shlokas.76:
na suparNAstathA nAgA na cha vishve viyonijAH |
na kashchittvAM cha devo.api samareShu vijeShyati
shlokas.77:
na shastreNa na vajreNa nAgninA na cha vAyunA |
nArdreNa na cha shuShkeNa trasena sthAvareNa vA
shlokas.78:
kashchittava rujaM kartA matprasAdAtkatha~nchana |
api chetsamaraM gatvA bhaviShyasi mamAdhikaH
shlokas.79:
vyAsa uvAcha||
evamete varA labdhAH purastAdviddhi shauriNA |
sa eSha devashcharati mAyayA mohaya~njagat
shlokas.80:
tasyaiva tapasA jAtaM naraM nAma mahAmunim |
tulyametena devena taM jAnIhyarjunaM sadA
shlokas.81:
tAvetau pUrvadevAnAM paramopachitAvRRiShI |
lokayAtrAvidhAnArthaM sa~njAyete yuge yuge
shlokas.82:
tathaiva karmaNaH kRRitsnaM mahatastapaso.api cha |
tejomanyushcha vidva.nstvaM jAto raudro mahAmate
shlokas.83:
sa bhavAndevavatprAj~no j~nAtvA bhavamayaM jagat |
avAkarShastvamAtmAnaM niyamaistatpriyepsayA
shlokas.84:
shubhamaurvaM navaM kRRitvA mahApuruShavigraham |
IjivA.nstvaM japairhomairupahAraishcha mAnada
shlokas.85:
sa tathA pUjyamAnaste pUrvadevo.apyatUtuShat |
puShkalA.nshcha varAnprAdAttava vidvanhRRidi sthitAn
shlokas.86:
janmakarmatapoyogAstayostava cha puShkalAH |
tAbhyAM li~Nge.archito devastvayArchAyAM yuge yuge
shlokas.87:
sarvarUpaM bhavaM j~nAtvA li~Nge yo.archayati prabhum |
AtmayogAshcha tasminvai shAstrayogAshcha shAshvatAH
shlokas.88:
evaM devA yajanto hi siddhAshcha paramarShayaH |
prArthayanti paraM loke sthAnameva cha shAshvatam
shlokas.89:
sa eSha rudrabhaktashcha keshavo rudrasambhavaH |
kRRiShNa eva hi yaShTavyo yaj~naishchaiSha sanAtanaH
shlokas.90:
sarvabhUtabhavaM j~nAtvA li~Nge.archayati yaH prabhum |
tasminnabhyadhikAM prItiM karoti vRRiShabhadhvajaH
shlokas.91:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA droNaputro mahArathaH |
namashchakAra rudrAya bahu mene cha keshavam
shlokas.92:
hRRiShTalomA cha vashyAtmA namaskRRitya maharShaye |
varUthinImabhipretya avahAramakArayat
shlokas.93:
tataH pratyavahAro.abhUtpANDavAnAM vishAM pate |
kauravANAM cha dInAnAM droNe yudhi nipAtite
shlokas.94:
yuddhaM kRRitvA dinAnpa~ncha droNo hatvA varUthinIm |
brahmalokaM gato rAjanbrAhmaNo vedapAragaH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tasminnatirathe droNe nihate tatra sa~njaya |
mAmakAH pANDavAshchaiva kimakurvannataH param
shlokas.2:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
tasminnatirathe droNe nihate pArShatena vai |
kauraveShu cha bhagneShu kuntIputro dhana~njayaH
shlokas.3:
dRRiShTvA sumahadAshcharyamAtmano vijayAvaham |
yadRRichChayAgataM vyAsaM paprachCha bharatarShabha
shlokas.4:
sa~NgrAme nighnataH shatrU~nsharaughairvimalairaham |
agrato lakShaye yAntaM puruShaM pAvakaprabham
shlokas.5:
jvalantaM shUlamudyamya yAM dishaM pratipadyate |
tasyAM dishi vishIryante shatravo me mahAmune
shlokas.6:
na padbhyAM spRRishate bhUmiM na cha shUlaM vimu~nchati |
shUlAchChUlasahasrANi niShpetustasya tejasA
shlokas.7:
tena bhagnAnarInsarvAnmadbhagnAnmanyate janaH |
tena dagdhAni sainyAni pRRiShThato.anudahAmyaham
shlokas.8:
bhagava.nstanmamAchakShva ko vai sa puruShottamaH |
shUlapANirmahAnkRRiShNa tejasA sUryasaMnibhaH
shlokas.9:
vyAsa uvAcha||
prajApatInAM prathamaM taijasaM puruShaM vibhum |
bhuvanaM bhUrbhuvaM devaM sarvalokeshvaraM prabhum
shlokas.10:
IshAnaM varadaM pArtha dRRiShTavAnasi sha~Nkaram |
taM gachCha sharaNaM devaM sarvAdiM bhuvaneshvaram
shlokas.11:
mahAdevaM mahAtmAnamIshAnaM jaTilaM shivam |
tryakShaM mahAbhujaM rudraM shikhinaM chIravAsasam
dAtAraM chaiva bhaktAnAM prasAdavihitAnvarAn
shlokas.12:
tasya te pArShadA divyA rUpairnAnAvidhaiH vibhoH |
vAmanA jaTilA muNDA hrasvagrIvA mahodarAH
shlokas.13:
mahAkAyA mahotsAhA mahAkarNAstathApare |
AnanairvikRRitaiH pAdaiH pArtha veShaishcha vaikRRitaiH
shlokas.14:
IdRRishaiH sa mahAdevaH pUjyamAno maheshvaraH |
sa shivastAta tejasvI prasAdAdyAti te.agrataH
tasminghore tadA pArtha sa~NgrAme lomaharShaNe
shlokas.15:
droNakarNakRRipairguptAM maheShvAsaiH prahAribhiH |
kastAM senAM tadA pArtha manasApi pradharShayet
RRite devAnmaheShvAsAdbahurUpAnmaheshvarAt
shlokas.16:
sthAtumutsahate kashchinna tasminnagrataH sthite |
na hi bhUtaM samaM tena triShu lokeShu vidyate
shlokas.17:
gandhenApi hi sa~NgrAme tasya kruddhasya shatravaH |
visa~nj~nA hatabhUyiShThA vepanti cha patanti cha
shlokas.18:
tasmai namastu kurvanto devAstiShThanti vai divi |
ye chAnye mAnavA loke ye cha svargajito narAH
shlokas.19:
ye bhaktA varadaM devaM shivaM rudramumApatim |
iha loke sukhaM prApya te yAnti paramAM gatim
shlokas.20:
namaskuruShva kaunteya tasmai shAntAya vai sadA |
rudrAya shitikaNThAya kaniShThAya suvarchase
shlokas.21:
kapardine karAlAya haryakShNe varadAya cha |
yAmyAyAvyaktakeshAya sadvRRitte sha~NkarAya cha
shlokas.22:
kAmyAya harinetrAya sthANave puruShAya cha |
harikeshAya muNDAya kRRishAyottaraNAya cha
shlokas.23:
bhAskarAya sutIrthAya devadevAya raMhase |
bahurUpAya sharvAya priyAya priyavAsase
shlokas.24:
uShNIShiNe suvaktrAya sahasrAkShAya mIDhuShe |
girishAya prashAntAya pataye chIravAsase
shlokas.25:
hiraNyabAhave chaiva ugrAya pataye dishAm |
parjanyapataye chaiva bhUtAnAM pataye namaH
shlokas.26:
vRRikShANAM pataye chaiva apAM cha pataye tathA |
vRRikShairAvRRitakAyAya senAnye madhyamAya cha
shlokas.27:
sruvahastAya devAya dhanvine bhArgavAya cha |
bahurUpAya vishvasya pataye chIravAsase
shlokas.28:
sahasrashirase chaiva sahasranayanAya cha |
sahasrabAhave chaiva sahasracharaNAya cha
shlokas.29:
sharaNaM prApya kaunteya varadaM bhuvaneshvaram |
umApatiM virUpAkShaM dakShayaj~nanibarhaNam
prajAnAM patimavyagraM bhUtAnAM patimavyayam
shlokas.30:
kapardinaM vRRiShAvartaM vRRiShanAbhaM vRRiShadhvajam |
vRRiShadarpaM vRRiShapatiM vRRiShashRRi~NgaM vRRiSharShabham
shlokas.31:
vRRiShA~NkaM vRRiShabhodAraM vRRiShabhaM vRRiShabhekShaNam |
vRRiShAyudhaM vRRiShasharaM vRRiShabhUtaM maheshvaram
shlokas.32:
mahodaraM mahAkAyaM dvIpicharmanivAsinam |
lokeshaM varadaM muNDaM brahmaNyaM brAhmaNapriyam
shlokas.33:
trishUlapANiM varadaM khaDgacharmadharaM prabhum |
pinAkinaM khaNDaparashuM lokAnAM patimIshvaram
prapadye sharaNaM devaM sharaNyaM chIravAsasam
shlokas.34:
namastasmai sureshAya yasya vaishravaNaH sakhA |
suvAsase namo nityaM suvratAya sudhanvine
shlokas.35:
sruvahastAya devAya sukhadhanvAya dhanvine |
dhanvantarAya dhanuShe dhanvAchAryAya dhanvine
shlokas.36:
ugrAyudhAya devAya namaH suravarAya cha |
namo.astu bahurUpAya namashcha bahudhanvine
shlokas.37:
namo.astu sthANave nityaM suvratAya sudhanvine |
namo.astu tripuraghnAya bhagaghnAya cha vai namaH
shlokas.38:
vanaspatInAM pataye narANAM pataye namaH |
apAM cha pataye nityaM yaj~nAnAM pataye namaH
shlokas.39:
pUShNo dantavinAshAya tryakShAya varadAya cha |
nIlakaNThAya pi~NgAya svarNakeshAya vai namaH
shlokas.40:
karmANi chaiva divyAni mahAdevasya dhImataH |
tAni te kIrtayiShyAmi yathApraj~naM yathAshrutam
shlokas.41:
na surA nAsurA loke na gandharvA na rAkShasAH |
sukhamedhanti kupite tasminnapi guhAgatAH
shlokas.42:
vivyAdha kupito yaj~naM nirbhayastu bhavastadA |
dhanuShA bANamutsRRijya saghoShaM vinanAda cha
shlokas.43:
te na sharma kutaH shAntiM lebhire sma surAstadA |
vidrute sahasA yaj~ne kupite cha maheshvare
shlokas.44:
tena jyAtalaghoSheNa sarve lokAH samAkulAH |
babhUvurvashagAH pArtha nipetushcha surAsurAH
shlokas.45:
ApashchukShubhire sarvAshchakampe cha vasundharA |
parvatAshcha vyashIryanta disho nAgAshcha mohitAH
shlokas.46:
andhAshcha tamasA lokA na prakAshanta sa.nvRRitAH |
jaghnivAnsaha sUryeNa sarveShAM jyotiShAM prabhAH
shlokas.47:
chukrushurbhayabhItAshcha shAntiM chakrustathaiva cha |
RRiShayaH sarvabhUtAnAmAtmanashcha sukhaiShiNaH
shlokas.48:
pUShANamabhyadravata sha~NkaraH prahasanniva |
puroDAshaM bhakShayato dashanAnvai vyashAtayat
shlokas.49:
tato nishchakramurdevA vepamAnA natAH sma tam |
punashcha sa.ndadhe dIptaM devAnAM nishitaM sharam
shlokas.50:
rudrasya yaj~nabhAgaM cha vishiShTaM te nvakalpayan |
bhayena tridashA rAja~nsharaNaM cha prapedire
shlokas.51:
tena chaivAtikopena sa yaj~naH sandhitastadA |
yattAshchApi surA AsanyattAshchAdyApi taM prati
shlokas.52:
asurANAM purANyAsa.nstrINi vIryavatAM divi |
AyasaM rAjataM chaiva sauvarNamaparaM mahat
shlokas.53:
AyasaM tArakAkShasya kamalAkShasya rAjatam |
sauvarNaM paramaM hyAsIdvidyunmAlina eva cha
shlokas.54:
na shaktastAni maghavAnbhettuM sarvAyudhairapi |
atha sarve.amarA rudraM jagmuH sharaNamarditAH
shlokas.55:
te tamUchurmahAtmAnaM sarve devAH savAsavAH |
rudra raudrA bhaviShyanti pashavaH sarvakarmasu
nipAtayiShyase chainAnasurAnbhuvaneshvara
shlokas.56:
sa tathoktastathetyuktvA devAnAM hitakAmyayA |
atiShThatsthANubhUtaH sa sahasraM parivatsarAn
shlokas.57:
yadA trINi sametAni antarikShe purANi vai |
triparvaNA trishalyena tena tAni bibheda saH
shlokas.58:
purANi na cha taM shekurdAnavAH prativIkShitum |
sharaM kAlAgnisa.nyuktaM viShNusomasamAyutam
shlokas.59:
bAlama~NkagataM kRRitvA svayaM pa~nchashikhaM punaH |
umA jij~nAsamAnA vai ko.ayamityabravItsurAn
shlokas.60:
bAhuM savajraM shakrasya kruddhasyAstambhayatprabhuH |
sa eSha bhagavAndevaH sarvalokeshvaraH prabhuH
shlokas.61:
na sambubudhire chainaM devAstaM bhuvaneshvaram |
saprajApatayaH sarve bAlArkasadRRishaprabham
shlokas.62:
athAbhyetya tato brahmA dRRiShTvA cha sa maheshvaram |
ayaM shreShTha iti j~nAtvA vavande taM pitAmahaH
shlokas.63:
tataH prasAdayAmAsurumAM rudraM cha te surAH |
abhavachcha punarbAhuryathAprakRRiti vajriNaH
shlokas.64:
teShAM prasanno bhagavAnsapatnIko vRRiShadhvajaH |
devAnAM tridashashreShTho dakShayaj~navinAshanaH
shlokas.65:
sa vai rudraH sa cha shivaH so.agniH sharvaH sa sarvavit |
sa chendrashchaiva vAyushcha so.ashvinau sa cha vidyutaH
shlokas.66:
sa bhavaH sa cha parjanyo mahAdevaH sa chAnaghaH |
sa chandramAH sa cheshAnaH sa sUryo varuNashcha saH
shlokas.67:
sa kAlaH so.antako mRRityuH sa yamo rAtryahAni cha |
mAsArdhamAsA RRitavaH sandhye sa.nvatsarashcha saH
shlokas.68:
sa cha dhAtA vidhAtA cha vishvAtmA vishvakarmakRRit |
sarvAsAM devatAnAM cha dhArayatyavapurvapuH
shlokas.69:
sarvairdevaiH stuto devaH saikadhA bahudhA cha saH |
shatadhA sahasradhA chaiva tathA shatasahasradhA
shlokas.70:
IdRRishaH sa mahAdevo bhUyashcha bhagavAnajaH |
na hi sarve mayA shakyA vaktuM bhagavato guNAH
shlokas.71:
sarvairgrahairgRRihItAnvai sarvapApasamanvitAn |
sa mochayati suprItaH sharaNyaH sharaNAgatAn
shlokas.72:
AyurArogyamaishvaryaM vittaM kAmA.nshcha puShkalAn |
sa dadAti manuShyebhyaH sa chaivAkShipate punaH
shlokas.73:
sendrAdiShu cha deveShu tasya chaishvaryamuchyate |
sa chaiva vyAhRRite loke manuShyANAM shubhAshubhe
shlokas.74:
aishvaryAchchaiva kAmAnAmIshvaraH punaruchyate |
maheshvarashcha bhUtAnAM mahatAmIshvarashcha saH
shlokas.75:
bahubhirbahudhA rUpairvishvaM vyApnoti vai jagat |
asya devasya yadvaktraM samudre tadatiShThata
shlokas.76:
eSha chaiva shmashAneShu devo vasati nityashaH |
yajantyenaM janAstatra vIrasthAna itIshvaram
shlokas.77:
asya dIptAni rUpANi ghorANi cha bahUni cha |
loke yAnyasya kurvanti manuShyAH pravadanti cha
shlokas.78:
nAmadheyAni lokeShu bahUnyatra yathArthavat |
niruchyante mahattvAchcha vibhutvAtkarmabhistathA
shlokas.79:
vede chAsya samAmnAtaM shatarudrIyamuttamam |
nAmnA chAnantarudreti upasthAnaM mahAtmanaH
shlokas.80:
sa kAmAnAM prabhurdevo ye divyA ye cha mAnuShAH |
sa vibhuH sa prabhurdevo vishvaM vyApnuvate mahat
shlokas.81:
jyeShThaM bhUtaM vadantyenaM brAhmaNA munayastathA |
prathamo hyeSha devAnAM mukhAdasyAnalo.abhavat
shlokas.82:
sarvathA yatpashUnpAti taishcha yadramate punaH |
teShAmadhipatiryachcha tasmAtpashupatiH smRRitaH
shlokas.83:
nityena brahmacharyeNa li~Ngamasya yadA sthitam |
mahayanti cha lokAshcha maheshvara iti smRRitaH
shlokas.84:
RRiShayashchaiva devAshcha gandharvApsarasastathA |
li~NgamasyArchayanti sma tachchApyUrdhvaM samAsthitam
shlokas.85:
pUjyamAne tatastasminmodate sa maheshvaraH |
sukhI prItashcha bhavati prahRRiShTashchaiva sha~NkaraH
shlokas.86:
yadasya bahudhA rUpaM bhUtabhavyabhavatsthitam |
sthAvaraM ja~NgamaM chaiva bahurUpastataH smRRitaH
shlokas.87:
ekAkSho jAjvalannAste sarvatokShimayo.api vA |
krodhAdyashchAvishallokA.nstasmAchCharva iti smRRitaH
shlokas.88:
dhUmraM rUpaM cha yattasya dhUrjaTistena uchyate |
vishve devAshcha yattasminvishvarUpastataH smRRitaH
shlokas.89:
tisro devIryadA chaiva bhajate bhuvaneshvaraH |
dyAmapaH pRRithivIM chaiva tryambakashcha tataH smRRitaH
shlokas.90:
samedhayati yannityaM sarvArthAnsarvakarmasu |
shivamichChanmanuShyANAM tasmAdesha shivaH smRRitaH
shlokas.91:
sahasrAkSho.ayutAkSho vA sarvatokShimayo.api vA |
yachcha vishvaM mahatpAti mahAdevastataH smRRitaH
shlokas.92:
dahatyUrdhvaM sthito yachcha prANotpattisthitashcha yat |
sthitali~Ngashcha yannityaM tasmAtsthANuriti smRRitaH
shlokas.93:
viShamasthaH sharIreShu samashcha prANinAmiha |
sa vAyurviShamastheShu prANApAnasharIriShu
shlokas.94:
pUjayedvigrahaM yastu li~NgaM vApi samarchayet |
li~NgaM pUjayitA nityaM mahatIM shriyamashnute
shlokas.95:
UrubhyAmardhamAgneyaM somArdhaM cha shivA tanuH |
Atmano.ardhaM cha tasyAgniH somo.ardhaM punaruchyate
shlokas.96:
taijasI mahatI dIptA devebhyashcha shivA tanuH |
bhAsvatI mAnuSheShvasya tanurghorAgniruchyate
shlokas.97:
brahmacharyaM charatyeSha shivA yAsya tanustayA |
yAsya ghoratarA mUrtiH sarvAnatti tayeshvaraH
shlokas.98:
yannirdahati yattIkShNo yadugro yatpratApavAn |
mA.nsashoNitamajjAdo yattato rudra uchyate
shlokas.99:
eSha devo mahAdevo yo.asau pArtha tavAgrataH |
sa~NgrAme shAtravAnnighna.nstvayA dRRiShTaH pinAkadhRRik
shlokas.100:
eSha vai bhagavAndevaH sa~NgrAme yAti te.agrataH |
yena dattAni te.astrANi yaistvayA dAnavA hatAH
shlokas.101:
dhanyaM yashasyamAyuShyaM puNyaM vedaishcha sa~nj~nitam |
devadevasya te pArtha vyAkhyAtaM shatarudriyam
shlokas.103:
chaturvidhamidaM stotraM yaH shRRiNoti naraH sadA |
vijitya sarvA~nshatrUnsa rudraloke mahIyate
shlokas.104:
charitaM mahAtmano divyaM sA~NgrAmikamidaM shubham |
paThanvai shatarudrIyaM shRRiNva.nshcha satatotthitaH
shlokas.105:
bhakto vishveshvaraM devaM mAnuSheShu tu yaH sadA |
varAnsa kAmA.Nllabhate prasanne tryambake naraH
shlokas.106:
gachCha yudhyasva kaunteya na tavAsti parAjayaH |
yasya mantrI cha goptA cha pArshvataste janArdanaH
shlokas.107:
sa~njaya uvAcha||
evamuktvArjunaM sa~Nkhye parAsharasutastadA |
jagAma bharatashreShTha yathAgatamari.ndama
